name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: Waste of money! don\'t buy it. I ended up throwing it away after one use. It takes long to dry. Just stay with a regular bath tub with mesh/foam cushion in it.

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: The pictures shown of this product are somewhat deceiving, in my opinion.First of all, this tub is recommended only for babies over one year old but the baby pictured looks much younger than that.Secondly, it appears as if the baby is submerged in a few inches of water but it\'s really only bubbles around the baby because this tub doesn\'t actually hold any water in it.Even worse than not holding water was the fact that it "floats" when put into a a larger tub with anything more than an inch or two of water.  This in turn creates a "taco" effect around the baby... making it so my daughter couldn\'t sit up in it even though she was steady while sitting up elsewhere.  I feel this tub was much too unsafe to use unless the water in the larger bathtub was only 1-2 inches deep (in which case she would become too cold and didn\'t care for her baths).I finally purchased a bath ring for her and bathing became fun again.On the plus side, I think this item would be perfect for a baby learning to sit up on the floor... just NOT in the bathtub.

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: This is a great product!  My daughter is very tall and grew out of her baby bathtub at 4 months.  I did not know what to do.  I found this and it works great.  I can lay her back on the bumper and she does not go under water.  Plus, I know that if she slips a little, she won\'t hit the side of the tub.  She enjoys splashing with my help holding her up.  I believe we will use this for a long time!

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: We have a set of twins, my boy did like, but my daughter kept crying so I didn\'t use it. I guess because of the feel...

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: This tub is perfect!  I was scared to try the plastic ones for fear of him falling (he just started sitting up) and the inflatables looked too time consuming.  We love the beads in this one because they are soft and dry quickly.  Our son loves picking at the material and tries to grab the designs while taking a bath.  The tub must be at least half full for this one to work.  I would recommend this product to my family and friends.  Thanks Leachco!

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: This is a great product- especially for those in-between stages.  My daughter loves this tub and has the support if she falls backwards when she is sitting.  Also great to lay down in...  One hint though- fill up the bath tub and then put the \'bath n bumper\' in it- otherwise, you get the top of the \'bumper\' wet and it gets cold because it\'s not covered in water...  That\'s what I did the first time I used it and my daughter wasn\'t too happy ;)  If used correctly- I would say the best investment I\'ve made!  I went through two other bath tubs before I got to this one.  My daughter used to hate baths and now she loves them!

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: I love the Leach Co Products. We purchased a safer bather for my son when he was an infant and loved it. When he outgrew it we looked for something that would support him in the tub while he was learning to sit up. So we purchased the Bath n Bumper and have been very happy with it. I love the support that it offers. We have been very please with this product and would highly recommend it

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: Our 8 month old loves sitting in this tub in our bathtub. He fits great in there, and sometimes will even lay back on the back part of it to rest his head. There is plenty of room for some of his favorite bath toys in there as well. It comes with a hook, so we just hang it on a rail in the bath tub, and it drys out completely by the next day. I read some reviews that said it wouldn\'t dry out for them, but so far that hasn\'t been a problem for us.

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: This is an almost perfect transitional baby bath product.  The baby tub is too small, the adult tub to big and slippery for my 9 month old daughter.  This tub is soft, with ample cushion on the sides which creates a nice bumper and no slip bottom for my wiggle worm.  The only down side...it can sort of float if you fill the tub up with to much water, doesn\'t seem to bother my daughter though.  Overall, a good, safe, comfortable product!

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: It doesn\'t slip around in the tub and I feel that my daughter is more secure in it than she was in the plastic ducky tub.  You do need to make sure it dries very well though as it is made of material.

name: Leachco Bath \'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review: Bought this when our son was too big for the baby tub.  He can sit up on his own, but didn\'t want him in the big tub just yet.  This is perfect.  It\'s nice and soft, and you don\'t have to blow it up every time he takes a bath like an inflatable tub.  It doesn\'t slide on the tub either.  It\'s just enough support for him.

name: Delta Children\'s Products Sleigh Toddler Bed - Natural
review: This bed is great my son loves it, but I didnt buy it from here I bought the same bed on ebay for only $65 and it was new in the box .

name: Delta Children\'s Products Sleigh Toddler Bed - Natural
review: To give you an idea of what we think, we have 2 of these and will buy the 3rd in a few months. Knowing these are on the market, I would not recommend putting your child into a full size bed. The bed is in proper proportion to the child - they can sit on the bed, get in and out easily. Assembly is easy. The wood is hardwood, so durability is not as issue.Very good product.

name: Delta Children\'s Products Sleigh Toddler Bed - Natural
review: My grandson loves it.  It is a safe and sturdy bed. More style I think because of the curves of the head and footboard. Easy to assemble and looks so nice in the room..fast delivery also.

name: Delta Children\'s Products Sleigh Toddler Bed - Natural
review: I bought this bed for my 22 month old daughter who jumped head first out of her crib.  It\'s was time for a Big Girl bed. This bed is sturdy and CUTE!  She loves it! She has slept in this bed since the first night.  I\'ve had no problems with the bed or putting it together.  I would highly recommend it to anyone in search of a toddler bed!

name: CHOU CHOU Changing Backpack
review: My four year old daughter received the changing backpack for Christmas along with the bouncy seat and feeding set.  The backpack is very good quality, although I feel a bit pricey (but grandma bought it).  She uses the changing pad as a doll blanket.  The backpack fits the feeding set inside along with the other accessories.  The best thing about it is she loves to change her doll\'s diaper and the blanket matches the bouncy seat. The two zippers on the backpack are very easy for her to use.

name: Chou Chou Care Set
review: This set is the perfect accessory for a Chou Chou doll, or any baby doll for that matter. The set includes a bottle that does the disappearing milk act, a soft cloth bib with velcro enclosure with a teddy bear "pocket" that fits a binky perfectly, a cute feeding bowl, and the cutest little spoon with the Chou Chou teddy on the handle. The price may look a little steep for four pieces when compared with other sets out there, but believe me the quality can not be beat.  The plastic used for the bottle, bowl, and spoon is very durable and is of better quality than all the other ones out there.  The bib is also very much like a real bib with it\'s soft fabric, much better than those cheap plastic bibs. The only thing that I did not like is that the bottom of the bottle is rounded and therefore will not stand.  Otherwise this set is the best one I\'ve seen, both in it\'s styling(cute design) and it\'s material.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This was really great for my newborn daughter.  It got a little smelly despite rinsing and air drying every use.  But it had served its purpose before becoming unusable.  At 4 weeks we switched to the Primo Eurobath Tub (which is TERRIFIC).

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We have loved this bather, and after 3 months of use have not experienced any mildew problem.  Note that we have used baby soaps, Dove, and baby shampoo with this product, and weren\'t particularly careful about rinsing off any product when bathtime was over, and still did not have a mildew problem.  This bather worked great in the sink, and we started baby off in it before she was a week old.  She has always felt very secure and comfortable in the bather b/c it is soft and conforms to her body, and supports her head and neck.  She has even almost fell asleep in it during her bath!  At around 3 weeks, we started placing the safer bather inside our regular bathtub, and I have loved the ease and convenience of using this bather inside our regular tub.  I also love that it stores easily, just hanging on our shower curtain rod to dry.  At 13 weeks and 15 lbs., our daughter is beginning to outgrow it, but she is ready to move on to a larger tub.  I will really miss this bather though.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: The Leachco safer bather is wonderful.  It fits in my kitchen sink and is nicely padded for the baby.  Because it is so firm, I can put my baby on her tummey and wash her back very easily.  The bather dries quickly after the bath by hanging it up.  I am very happy with it.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We bought two different baby baths before trying this product, and I wish we had just skipped to this. You don\'t have to worry about the baby sliding, or fitting into the right spot, plus other baby baths keep them up out of the water. With this product, you have complete control over how submerged your child is. My son is 4.5 months old, and we\'ve been using this for about 2.5 months. He is much more comfortable and relaxed on this pillow than he ever was in a baby bath or the sink. It\'s perfect for us because we have a small house and small bathroom, and it doesn\'t take up much room. If you don\'t squeeze as much water out as you can before you hang it to dry, yes it gets a little mildew-smelling but no big deal. After using daily for a few months, the fabric that holds the plastic hangar is starting to unravel but I would guess we\'ll be able to use it for a year or so before we need to try to repair or replace. It was a great deal.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We love this bather for our son as a newborn.  We put it right in the bath tub with a little water and he was comfortable and easy to wash.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is by far the best thing I have seen out there yet. First, I have read and tried a lot of the other items out there- the foam mats, slings, tubs.... I bought the euro tub and it may in the future be a good thing but not right now...The Safer Bather works like a contoured pillow/sponge. It will support baby on a slight incline and will keep her from rolling off either side or down. It was the most perfect thing to use when our daughter\'s belly button had not yet healed.Our daughter loved being placed on it when the warm water would press thru with her weight on the cushion. It also dries very very quickly and can hand up in your shower.I have even used it in our sink and it supports her perfectly!With all the others out there to choose from, this one is the best way to spend your $!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: this is a great washing tool for baby.  i wouldn\'t dream of using anything else.  since the umbilical cord fell off, my baby has been using this in our adult bathtub.  he doesn\'t slip and is comfortable lying on this.  he enjoys feeling like hes taking a bath even though the water level doesn\'t come past the point of the mat.  this is probably good up until baby can sit up and move around on their own

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: After only a couple uses it started to smell like mildew.  And I always washed it out and hung it up to dry after using it.  Other than that it was a big help.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: For the first two weeks our daughter was home we used the Safer Bather on the kitchen counter for her sponge baths.  I loved it then because I could lay her down comfortably and it\'s not big and bulky like the plastic tubs.  Once she was a little older and we could give her more of a bath, I was skeptical about how well it would work, so much so that I ran out and bought a hard plastic tub.  We used the plastic tub for two nights (which was really difficult - our daughter is very little and it was hard to hold her in place).  Then I wised up and tried the Safer Bather in our bathtub.  She LOVED it.  She just relaxes on the soft pillow with warm water all around her while I have two hands free to get her cleaned up.  It\'s GREAT.  Plus, I\'m really impressed with the company.  We lost the plastic hook to hang it up with, so I called the company.  They sent me a new one in a couple of days.  Very impressive. Other positives  - it\'s very inexpensive and easy to throw in the trunk for road trips.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We have used this tub since his very first bath and he just loves it! He now splashes, kicks, and plays and never gets afraid of the tub. Its cozy and easy to use.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I absolutely love this product...it is the best on the market to keep a baby comfortable. My daughter, Isabella is 4 months old and has loved bathtime since day 1  of using it. Those yellow sponges are the worst! The only problem I do have is the smell. I am adament about hanging it up after each use, but there is no window in my bathroom for proper ventilation and that may be part of the problem. Otherwise...I highly recommmend it!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My 3 month old loves bath time.  This bather is a great tool!  It is soft and comfortable for baby and cradles him in a pool of warm water.  I don\'t worry about him kicking around and flopping out of a seat or lopping over onto a hard plastic edge.  Strongly recommend.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is my FAVORITE baby item as a first time mom.  My infant son loves his baths thanks to this product.  He is safe, warm and cozy in this fabric cushion that literally dries faster than anything I\'ve ever witnessed. Just hang it up and it drips dries fast for no mess or mold.  Forget the old hard plastic tubs that are slippery!  GET THIS!  You and your baby will love it.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I got this tub for my second son because I was not happy with the other tubs I had used with my first. We started out with one of the plastic tubs and ended up switching to an inflatable tub. Neither of them was as good as this one. This one is great b/c all you have to do is run a regular bath and stick this in it, it keeps the baby in a good safe position and soaks up all the warm tub water which helps keep the little one warm. And when you\'re done, just hang it from your shower head to dry. It takes up much less space and dries MUCH easier than any of the plastic tubs. I highly recommend this item.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My newborn screamed through his baths until we ordered this and began to use it. Now he LOVES the bath! What a relief... This is the best bathing help I have found. It holds him securely so that I can scrub away. Keeps him warm and cozy the entire time.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This was seriously one of the single most useful baby items I got.  I iced it in the sink and then transitioned him to the regular tub with it.  It was so much easier than the clunky baby tub that we never used.  I used this thing right up until my son was ready for a regular bath.  Best 15 bucks I spent!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is a must-have for bathing baby.  We bought it together with the primo eurobath tub after seeing a recommendation for it and couldn\'t be happier!  Like some of the other reviewers, we initially used the safer bather on the counter top to sponge bathe our newborn, then moved it to the baby tub.  Baby was so comfortable and I had no worries about slipping.  From time to time I tried it without the safer bather, and wanted a third hand to hold him!Now, our big boy is ready for the grown up tub and uses the safer bather there.  He seems so secure, and I think the familiarity might even help make the big tub less daunting.Well worth the price.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We got this for my daughter when she was about six weeks old when I didn\'t like either of the two hard plastic tubs that we had.  I wish we would have had this from the beginning, it is great!  I find it much easier to use and store than the hard plastic options.I have been using it every day for about 8 weeks now and have not had any problems with it getting musty.  I have run it through the wash with bleach once to sanitize it and a couple times I have run it on the spin cycle when I want to dry it out quickly, but most days I just squeeze out the excess water and hang it in the shower with the curtain open and it will be dry by morning.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I highly recommend this item.  My son has always loved bath time thanks to the safer bather.  I have seen some reviews about this product starting to mildew. The manufacturer suggests using baby wash without oil or moisturizers to prevent mildew. However, I have used baby wash w/ moisturizers and I haven\'t had any problems.  I just throw it in the washing machine after every couple baths and it\'s fine.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is a for sure MUST for babies! So much better then those hard plastic tubs.. and a lot easier then folding up towel in the sink! It stays warm like the bath water so your child doesnt get chilled! When done using just squeeze out and hang to dry!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: mildews so bad! i bought a second one thinking that I was doing something wrong. I rinsed and even put outside every night to dry completely. I now need to buy a bath for my 6 mo old since she cant sit up all that great just yet. i emailed the company and this is what they said_____________________________________________________________Hello-We are sorry to hear about the problems you are having with your bather.While the bather is not mildew proof, it will resist mildew with proper care and maintenance.  This product may develop some mildew if you use a baby shampoo that contains skin conditioners such as aloe, vita E or any type of moisturizing lotion.The care instructions are on the label, but you can wash your bather in the washing machine gentle cycle and use a non-chlorine bleach if needed.  Be sure and allow your bather to air dry in a well-ventilated area.  Leave the bathroom door open and do not store behind a shower curtain.Please contact us if we can be of further assistance._____________________________________________________________I didn\'t use any of the products that they listed and it still got moldy

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: The reason for the 1 star is because baby is not due until Dec 1 2013, and it has not been used. Mother to be is excited about it, but we won\'t know the thoughts until its used, then I\'ll re-rate it

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This bathing pillow is the best!  It keeps baby warm and is very comfy.  My baby loves it - she can still kick around in the water while her head is elevated.  I highly recommend this product for babies that are not sitting up.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is wonderful! The only reason I didn\'t give it 5 stars is because it is kind of a pain to dry out, but other than that it is great. My little boy has used this since his first bath, he is 8 weeks now. It fits perfectly in our sink and he stays in place. I highly recommend it.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I love this product!! So soft for baby to lay on and works perfect for in the sink! It hadn\'t smelled or molded yet and dries quickly!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This little bathtub is GREAT.  It has a nice texture to keep slippery baby in place while you\'re bathing her, and it\'s VERY soft.  One thing that added a little extra is it comes with its own (detachable) clothes hanger, making it easy to hang dry.This also makes a great back rest for momma\'s bath time!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My grandson got this as a hand me down, and now I buy it for every expectant mother I know. It was so easy for one person to bathe him. It was great in the sink, not too big or too small, and no slipping and sliding. We used it in the bath tub until he could sit up by himself, then we used it as a cushion that he could sit on in the bath. I am expecting another grand-daughter and am getting one for her!  If only they had these 30 years ago!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Great little bathing tool, the only downside, is the baby has a tendency to slip down. But much better than our plastic tub & sling, baby much more comfortable and not kicking the hard plastic of the tub. My wife had one previously and when the tub/sling did not work for our new little one, we specifically sought this one out. We are happy with our purchase.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I read the reviews of the Safer Bather and was excited, but was skeptical when it arrived and it was a giant sponge.  I wondered if it could actually dry quickly in time for the next day\'s bath.  It really works great, baby loves taking his bath, AND it really dries up right away!  I washed it in the washing machine after my baby pooped all over it, and it came out just fine - a little mis-shapen, but still perfectly good.  Highly recommended!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My grand baby loves this. She didn\'t like her bath tub, usually fused the whole time. When My daughter used this the first time, my grand baby just kicked and splashed with her hands. Keeps baby off the hard surface of the tub, is curved around the baby so they can\'t roll over and get their face in the water. Great buy!!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is so wonderful!  Our son is 1 month old, and we have used this with no problems at all.  I wish I would have had this 8 years ago with my other son.  It keeps baby from slipping around, and he sort of floats above the water in this little raft of fabric.  The fabric is soft and holds the temperature of the water very nicely.  I suggest this product, and plan to buy this for my friends when they have babies!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bathed my daughter in a plastic tub when she was smaller but now that she\'s getting bigger, I moved her to the tub.  I tried using towels to cushion her and raise her head but filling the tub with towels (then laying them out to dry) was time consuming and a hassle.  Soo I looked about for something else to use.  I was torn between the seats, a simple foam pad, and a cushion like this.I\'m SOOO glad I chose the cushion.  The foam that I looked at in the store was so thin, I don\'t see it offering much comfort or support.  This cushion is thick and soft.  My daughter is able to lay back on it with her head raised or I can sit her up and her lil tush doesn\'t slide around any.  Simply squeeze the water out of it when done and hang it up to dry.I think it can also be used as a nice baby seat.The first thing I did when it arrived was put a fuzzy blanket ( Kids Line Faux Fur/Satin Blanket, Chocolate ) over it, lay my 4 month old daughter down and take pictures.  It\'s a nice comfy seat that held her securely and comfortably and I was able to get some "professional" looking photos :D

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this for my daughter when she outgrew the infant bath (around 4 months old) and wanted more room to splash and kick. She loves this! It makes it feel like she\'s in the big bath, but she\'s safe in the water. It can also be a great item when its dry just for keeping baby in one spot and able to play with her toes, etc.  I highly recommend it!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Easy way to bath a baby. I like it because it dries faster than expected.  Comes with hanger built in for drip dry, which works pretty well.  Baby loves it!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Love this product.  It makes bath time much easier.  I\'m only giving it one star because it requires a lot of maintenance.  It takes forever to dry.  The only way I can get it dry is to hang it outside in the sun.  Hanging inside takes 2-3 days to dry.  With an infant, it\'s hard to find time to hang outside and remember to bring back in.  It\'s sure to mold with the 2 day drying time.  Guess I will be trashing it soon.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: What a great, soft, secure, unslippery bath aid! I\'ve never felt so comfortable and confident giving a newborn a bath as I do when using the Safer Bather. And my baby girl doesn\'t cry through her baths anymore because she\'s warm and feels secure since she\'s not slipping around everywhere like she did in her other baby bathtub (the kind with the sling insert).Let me add ... the majority of the reviews I\'ve read that are unfavorable are from folks who seem to be using the Safer Bather improperly. For the ones who said it ends up being a "cold sponge" for their baby to lay on ... you need to fill the tub a bit more. For those who said it didn\'t work well inside their infant tub ... it\'s made to put in a regular tub. For those who are trying to wring it dry ... it\'s made to drip dry. If you can\'t hang it out to dry in your tub, take it outside to drip dry. All I can say is the way I\'m using the Safer Bather ... it\'s a lifesaver!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Our son LOVES taking a bath and it\'s worry-free for us, thanks to the Safer Bather.  This leight-weight bath pillow is perfect for baths in the kitchen sink or inside another tub.  Although our son still fits in the kitchen sink with it, we bought it along with the Primo baby tub and it\'s an ideal match together.The soft pillow protects our son\'s head and little body from the sink/tub.  There is a little sunken-in area for his little bottom and he LOVES to sit in it and splash around while we bathe him.  After the bath, we simply give it a squeeze and hang it in the shower to drip-dry overnight.  It can be machine washed but will pill-up if it goes through the dryer.  (still works beautifully, though.)This is a FANTASTIC product to bring while traveling - it\'s allowed us to give him his bath while on vacation or at grandma\'s house.I HIGHLY recommend this product!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Our daughter outgrew her infant tub pretty quickly and still can\'t sit up so this works perfectl!  We\'ll use it from the beginning with #2!  She\'s longer than the insert - but that just means her feet are free to kick and splash.  She loves it and bathtime is a blast now.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Overall good quality.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this bath pillow after listening to three months of screaming from my little boy during bath time. I knew something had to change. Although the plastic tub I was using was highly rated, I thought that maybe he needed something softer, so I tried this. It made a huge difference! He doesn\'t cry at all during bath time. It is easier to store and smaller than the other too. I haven\'t had it long enough to comment on the mildew comments others have left, but I plan on washing it in the machine every once in awhile. The hook doesn\'t work in my shower, but I think it is the placement of my shower head. I set it upright in the sink to dry. I wish I had bought it from the beginning!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I ordered this because I don\'t have a lot of storage space and thought this bath would be easier to store than a big plastic tub. It arrived sealed in plastic but when I attempted to use it for the first time black dirt seeped out. I have attempted to wash it 3 times through the washing machine and still get black dirt.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My oldest loved to lay on this thing and listen to the water so I could have her with me and take a nice long hot shower as a single mom, it was my single most favorite product. My new baby does not like the sound or feel of shower water and isn\'t too keen on being naked either so this isn\'t quite the same but it still functions really well as a safe place to lay her and clean her up and putting her on it at an angle with warm bath water just up over her tummy her seems to get her to push out gas that is bothering her.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I purchased this item due to the great reviews.  My granddaughter was born July 1, and my daughter really liked the Safer Bather, as well as my granddaughter, who would stop crying when she was put in the bather in warm water. But, now the bather has mildew on it and she can\'t use it.  My daughter did hang it up to dry as instructed, but it still mildewed.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Our babies love this pillow so much, they don\'t want to get out of the tub.  It makes for a safe, comfortable bathing experience and it dries very quickly when it hangs.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: OK, I\'m not a "stuff" person.  When we had our new baby, everyone tried to give us baby items, most of which we politely declined.  We figured if our moms raised us without a bunch of designed-just-for-baby gear, we could too.  Then came bath time for our 6 week old.  Not good.  She HATED it and cried so much that we just stopped doing baths all together.  After much research, I bought the Safer Bather.  Voila!  Instant fix.  She now loves the bath and has one every night.  It dries quickly, takes up very little space and most of all keeps the baby warm and comfy.  Great product - even other "baby minimalists" should invest in this one.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Love this bather. Makes bath time with a lil guy MUCH FASTER AND EASIER !  +this thing dries in a second !!!  I ordered one because my sister had gotten one and also loved it.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is by far the most comfortable item ever invented for baby.Baby doesn\'t slip, baby is comfortable, baby enjoys bathing and more importantly, mom feels at ease knowing that her baby is safe while she bends to pick up the towel or reaches over for the baby soap.  The baby doesn\'t move or wiggle around and kudos to whoever invented this product.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This bather is "DA BOMB"!  I don\'t know how I bathed my first child without it!!!  No trying to manage a wiggly newborn in a hard, slippery, cold plastic tub.  Baby fits comfortably and snugly, with an elevated head, in this cushion, allowing mom or dad to use both hands to get the job done!  (And don\'t tell my hubby, but when "Calgon Takes Me Away" -- this bather makes an EXCELLENT cushion behind MY back!)  This is the first product I\'ve used in a long time that has me wanting to tell everyone what a great find I\'ve made!!  I can\'t say enough good things about this bather.  You won\'t be sorry!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My son is 3 months old and we have been using this bath pad since his first bath when we could only sponge bathe him.  We set the pillow on the counter next to the kithen sink, and then put him on it and gave him his sponge bath.  Once we could submerge him, we just put the pillow into the kitchen sink and added water and put him in.  It works great!  He gets to lie in the bath but he is very comfortable and secure.  Once you finish you just have to find a good place to hang the pillow to drip dry.  We have been using this pillow for all of our 3 month old baby\'s baths.  Great item and especially a must have if you have a nice big kitchen sink!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I have been using this bather for about 4 months now. I loved it at first. It made bathing baby very easy and she did not slip and slide all over the place. I bought a hook to hang on the wall so that I could hang it up and it would drain and dry properly. However, after about 4 months I started to notice that it was beginning to get small moldy spots. I located my "instruction sheet" that came with the bather and followed the washing instructions. No luck. The moldy spots were still there. I have decided not to use it any longer.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Why put your newborn in a hard plastic seat, when you can have him/her lie on a virtual pillow? My kitchen sink is one of those not evenly split; it has a tiny section on one side and extra wide on the other and this bather fits perfectly into it. My baby has never cried (not even the first time)in this. Why should he? He\'s covered in warm water, has his head propped up just right, and is on a soft pillow. The really great thing about this bather is that it becomes heavy when wet, so it won\'t slide around. But when you squeeze some of the water out, it instantly becomes light again.  Simply brilliant! Don\'t even consider any of the others - this one is perfect!!!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I really do like the product, however it did mildew (the tag says it won\'t). I am having to throw it out after having it for 2 months.  It just keeps getting mildew spots no matter what I do!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I loved my safer bather. My daughter used it until she was able to sit up in the tub and I was sad to see it put away. My favorite thing about this product is that I can throw it in the washer and know that it is clean. I\'ve seen the plastic baby baths get gross from mildew and soap buildup. You can be a crazy cleaner and still not get everything unless you use bleach. But this product is so comfortable for babies, no plastic anywhere except the hook it hangs from (that is also removeable while you bathe baby). I\'ve used it in the kitchen sink as well as the bathtub and both places were comfortable for me, my husband, or my baby. I am getting ready to have my second baby and can\'t wait to break this out again.I love this product so much I am buying two for my friends today which is why I wrote a quick review.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This worked for giving our newborn sponge baths, but I ended up getting a tub with a newborn insert when it came time for giving real baths. Overall, I wouldn\'t buy it again.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: The bath was comfortable for my baby and he enjoyed it. But after 20 uses it reeked. I followed directions on how to clean it and it still stunk. Also it shed little lint balls. I now have a basic baby plastic seat where you slip the baby\'s legs through. It is a lot cleaner then this cloth bath.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this based on so many parents\' reviews here. I should have listened to the negative ones instead of the raves. My son is now almost 5 months old and I\'m going to have to buy another bath tub. Mildew is growing on this pad, despite having been washed in the washing machine and put outside to dry. This pad absorbs ALOT of water when in the tub, it gets really heavy and will leave a lake on your bathroom floor if you hang it to dry anywhere other than inside the tub/shower. This isn\'t practical to use inside a regular tub. I ended up using it on the bathroom counter most of the time.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I love this thing!  I recieved it as a shower gift and used it right when Kyler came home from the hosital to sponge bathe him.  I then put it in my sink for easy bathing and now he is in the big tub with it!  No problems at all with mildew (I hang it up after every use).  I would never use anything else!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: i reccomend this to anyone looking for a safe baby bath. awesome for first time parents. its soft and cushy and baby doesn\'t slide around. my daughter is 10 months old and still uses it. she has used it since day oen. i wouldn\'t go with any other tub. safest tub you can buy.it does hold a lot of water, but as long as you hang it to dry, it is fine. drys overnight when its hung up. the best part.. you can toss it in the washer when it gets dirty.A MUST HAVE for new mothers and fathers!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: The best tub - no slipping, she stays warm, and you don\'t have to hold her the entire bath time. Just throw it in the wash one in a while and make sure to hang dry. Way better than a sponge bath tub that falls apart and mildews or a cold, slippery plastic tub. We love it!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I was looking for something I could put my 2 month old in the bath tub with my 3 year old. For some reason I thought this was a plastic blow up pillow and was shocked when it came and was a soft pillow. It absorbs like 2 gallons of water and doesn\'t dry completely between each bath. We would hang it in the shower to drain and have it air out at night through the next day and it would still feel damp. After awhile I noticed it was starting to turn black in spots and I instantly threw it out.I then chose the AngelCare bath chair and Im so happy with it....I wish I bought it first. My baby is now 6 months and still sits in it and I would highly recommend that.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Love this products. Baby tubs are so silly, overpriced and dont use them very long. This is perfect because you can use it as a baby or just as a bath toy later. The baby really goes with it. I will never by a baby bath tub again. Dries nice and easy to fit anywhere.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I am a new mother of a 3 week old boy. I was all excited when I got the Safer Bather until I used it a few times. I placed the bather ontop my sink counter for sponge baths,before his belly button fell off. It did keep him comfortable but I had to place a towel under it to catch the water. After I hung it in the shower to drain and dry it developed some black mold. I didn\'t want to bath him on it like that so I washed it.What a mistake! Now I can\'t use it anymore. I called the store and they said I could return it, which is great. I am just sticking with a regular baby tub now.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We love this bath pad. The only con is it takes a while to dry and finding somewhere good to hang it can be a pain. It\'s a great size for bathing our daughter in the sink comfortably.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Love this !!! Purchased for my grandson to make bath time easier for mom since hes so tiny. Very soft .nicely quilted for comfort. Would highly recommend to any new moms ! Nice price too!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this for my pregnant niece, who also used one with her first child.  She requested another one, and they\'re not easy to find.  A safe and comfortable way to bathe and support baby.  No need for a portable tub.  Just set the pad in your bathtub.  Can be used for newborns and until baby is able to sit up on their own.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: The Leacho Bather is amazing! It is so much better than the plastic tubs that are SO uncomfortable! It dries fast too. I would and have told others about this =) I just wish the hanger did not slide off so easily, but it makes sense that it was made that way in order to be able to wash if needed. Thanks so much amazon, shipping was also fast =)

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is such a cool idea.  No more awkward plastic baby bath tubs.  This is pillow like, but firm.  After bath time it has a hook to hang it to drip dry in the tub.  It seems that it would be easier to bathe baby in this and more comfortable too.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This was one of the best items we bought for our daughter. Laid it in the tub and put her on it and filled the tub with a little water. Never felt like she could slip off it. Don\'t buy a big bulky bath tub buy this!! Super easy to ring out and air dry!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is the best thing ever.  The baby stays calm while he is being bathed and since he\'s resting on the safer bather he doesn\'t slip out of your hands.  Makes washing baby much more efficient and gives you a chance to have fun with them while they relax!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I have used this bathing pillow since my baby was a newborn and now she is 6 months old. I really can\'t say anything bad about it. It works in the sink or the bathtub. It doesn\'t mold. I rinse it off and it dries in a few hours so I can use it the next day.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This was the best gift that I received at my shower.  I had purchased a baby tub when my daughter was born, but she slid all around in the slippery tub.  We had to wait for daddy to get home to give her a bath because it required two hands to keep her upright.  I pulled this bath pillow from the closet and put it to use.  It fit in my kitchen sink and cushioned my little one perfectly.  I could now easily bathe her myself.  She is almost 5 months old now, and we use it in the tub.  The pad absorbs enough water to weight it down safely. Although it does dry quickly hanging overnight, it has developed a mildew smell, I would recommend washing it every couple of weeks to prevent this.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Very nice and soft for my grand daughter. I love that it hangs and dries very easy. I recommend this to any new mom.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This things gets incredibly scratchy/itchy when wet and takes FOREVER to drain the water out of when we hang it.  It serves it\'s purpose but it\'s not as nice as I\'d hoped

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We love this bathing pillow! My 2 month old son has been using and enjoying it since day one. It is comfy and does not allow him to slip around. I am actually on the way to buy another one for Grandma\'s house!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Nice and plush and keeps the baby warm while bathing. A bit bit at times but drys quick easy to hang.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My baby didn\'t like baths so this was a huge help. With this, he could lie down comfortably while I clean him up, I don\'t have to worry about him slipping around. It fits our sink perfectly and while the color has started to fade but it still serves its purpose. The hanger is very convenient, i just hang the whole thing to dry and it\'s ready for the next use.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I am in love with this pillow!  With my third baby I was looking for a better solution to the bath time situation.  In the past I used one of those hard plastic tubs, but was tired of storing it in our tiny bathroom.  A friend suggested this and it is perfect for us.I saw some other reviews said it floats on the water - that is not how this works. It is essentially a pillow - filled with stuffing.  You just put it in the tub and then fill with as much water as you wish.  It is a little puffier in the back to keep the babies head out of the water.  I personally like to put a lot of water in the tub, so I just folded up a little hand towel and shoved it under the head to give her a little more of an angle.  We hang it to dry over the tub and have never had a problem with mildew.  I have thrown it into the washer a few times just to be on the safe side.It worked beautifully with an infant laying down AND for an older baby once they start sitting up but aren\'t balancing well.  We\'ve used it for a year now and I have no complaints!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This has to be the most helpful thing I purchased.  My daughter doesn\'t slip and slide in the tub (as she did with the plastic baby tub I bought), it keeps her warm by retaining the warm water, and is easy to clean.  It is machine washable, so if you forget to hang it in the tub to dry after the bath and are concerned about mildew, you just throw it in the wash machine.  My daughter is a year old and we still use it every bath time.  I\'ve had it since she was three weeks old after having an awful time with a plastic bath.  This is a must have!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My 2 month old baby loves this bath!  I had originally bought a plastic tub, but my baby would slip and slide and it was very uncomfortable for him.  This is a must have for anybody bathing their baby!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this item based on reviews that I had read here, and I have to say I was thoroughly satisfied.  The product is made well, so that it contours my baby\'s body and keeps her so cozy and comfortable!  It\'s pillow-like and dries nicely.  I will say, though, that the picture was a little misleading for me, because I thought that this item is shaped in a seat-like form, so that my baby\'s head would be inclined in the bathbub while the rest of her is covered in water. Instead, it lies flat so that the baby\'s body is not fully covered.  Still, I really liked it.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Jessi is 4 months old and we have struggled bathing her since she was born, she would slip all over the place and her arms would fly all over the place and she would scream out of insecurity and fear. So I got this as a gift and tried it last night.  I put her in it, fully dressed and dry, so she could be comfortable in it.  And she was fine.  Then later, I put the pillow in her little tub filled it with water, and sat her down in it, and she loved it!  Not a peep out of her, she let us wash her and wash her hair.  She smiled...it was wonderful, we even video taped it (she\'ll love that later on).  When it was over, we wrung it out real good and hung it on the shower bar to dry.  It was great! I highly recommend this to any parent that needs to make the bath easier and more pleasant.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Like many others, I found this bath pillow to be great for bathing my baby in the adult tub (in a few inches of water), though it was too big to fit into his little countertop tub.I was worried about the mold factor that others have mentioned, but I\'ve had it for two months and have had no mold or mildew problems so far, even though our shower curtain tends to get moldy quickly. The bather dries out right away if I hang it on the shampoo organizer in the tub.I\'ve also found the safer bather very useful for a shared bath (and a heck of a lot easier on my back than bending over the tub).  I\'ve seen nursing in a warm bath recommended for nursing strikes or helping baby calm down after some kind of trauma, but I like it just for bonding, and my 7-week-old loves it.Either I use the safer bather as a bath pillow that I lean back on (perfect size and shape) and nurse in the cradle hold, or I lean forward and wedge it under my baby and nurse him in the football hold.  He often falls asleep right away, his little feet waving in the warm water like pink seaweed.Then I can wash him and nurse him at the same time as he\'s napping. (Talk about multitasking!)Just don\'t expect to get a lot of washing of yourself done, as then there\'ll be harsh soap in the bath water, and anyway who has enough hands to hold the baby and wash, too?  (I usually do a quick 60-second wash before I run the bath water and bring him in.)

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My grandson has used this since he was a newborn...he is now 3 months old....he feels so secure on this "pillow", as it is shaped to "fit" thier little bodies.  The warm water from the bathtub warms the pillow, so he doesn\'t get chilled when put into the tub ...I loved this so much...I bought one for my house for when we have sleepovers !!  Bath time is relaxing for everyone with the safer bather.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: At 1 mo old didn\'t cry fr baths.  Covered his belly with a wet washcloth and he just smiles and coos.  Can\'t beat the softness of this bath cushion.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this bather because the other bathers that I saw did not look comfortable or safe.  We\'ve used this bather since my son was born - he\'s now 5 months.  We love it and so does he.  It is not slippery at all and offers him a very comfortable, reclining place while being bathed.  I also love the fact that you can run it under the water while preparing the bath and it holds the warmth from the water.  There is no hard, cold plastic.  The only downside is after a few months, it must be replaced due to the fact that it\'s not plastic and absorbs water every time you bath your baby.  But for the price, you can\'t beat it!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: this thing rocks... when I was pregnant with my second son the one thing I dreaded was bathing a squirmy, slippery infant, my first had hated being bathed until he was about three months old and I always wound up almost as wet as the baby because of him squirming and how awckward using a tub was.  Well, I found out about this on the BRU website and read all the reviews and decided this was for me.  I don\'t regret getting it one bit and am looking forward to many years of use.  It was SO easy to bathe my newborn in it, I can\'t imagine ever wanting to use one of those horrible plastic tubs again.  You get to use both arms to bathe and rinse your baby while the comfy warm pillow holds him in place for you.  It\'s just great!  And I don\'t wind up soaking wet after bathing my baby anymore, which is another big plus.  Just make sure you squeeze out all the water every time you\'re done using it, so you don\'t have to worry about mildew.  If for some reason you do get some mildew in it, soak it in hot water and one cup white vinegar for an hour, then wash in your washing machine and it should be good as new.Enjoy bath-time with your baby, it\'s one of the fondest memories you\'ll have!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I received the Safer Bather from my mother in law after I saw the item online here. The reviews were what sold me. Not to mention the price! I just had my fourth child 6 weeks ago, and we love this item. None of my other children enjoyed baths at this age. I use to have one of those yellow and blue fold up hard plastic tubs. Well, I sold that at a garage sale two years ago. When I found we were expecting this child, I knew I wanted something different. This product supports the baby AND keeps her warm IN THE WATER!!! My daughter just floats there, totally supported by the cushion. I like the nifty hanger too, when we are done I just hang it in the tub and it dries up. GREAT product with a great price tag!!!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this because honestly we couldn\'t afford anything bigger, praying that it actually worked. Well it does, not only is it great for infants, you can wash them and have a free hand, it was perfect for my newborn. Since you can\'t wash them in water for the first few wk\'s. I used this to sit him in while I sponge bathed him. It was perfect.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: The SaferBather is soft and easy to clean. It dries easily and can be stored when not in use. I love it...the baby loves it...and that is what sells this product!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I got this for my son right before he was born 4 years ago thinking he would use it when he outgrew the plastic baby tub.  I used the big plastic tub I got from a shower once, and ditched it for this.  It was so much easier to bathe him using this because I knew that if he slipped he would have a soft landing. I couldn\'t get him to stay up in the plastic tub with out always having one hand on him.  I never had problems with it smelling like mildew, I would put it in the dryer for about 20 minutes on days where it didn\'t seem to dry all the way. I gave it to my sister when she had her son, and now I\'m wishing I kept for my second one that\'s due this spring!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I purchased one of these for our now 6 year old daughter and loved it. Naturally one of the first things on my "must have" list for our daughter this time around was a Safer Bather. Had I only known...Six years ago these were filled with the little tiny styrofoam beans like you would find in a bean bag chair which was great because it gave the bath pad a bit of "float" to it which helped keep the babys head elevated during her bath, and it drained like a charm when I hung it up to dry.Fast forward 6 years and I am totally disapointed. The one I recieved this time was filled with polyester batting which has started to turn lumpy after just 3 months of light use. It also weighs a ton when you try to pull it out of the water and hang it to dry. Even after hanging all night I have to squeeze the excess water from this thing in the morning to prevent mildew. The worst part is that this thing does not float at all. It simply sinks to the bottom of the bath tub and lately I have been finding that my very active 3 month old will turn her head and almost get water in her eyes despite there being maybe 3 inches of water in the tub and I always position her so that her head is at the opposite end of the drain. Luckily she is already sitting and is ready for a big girl bath seat so I can quite using this piece of junk.This thing is so bad it\'s going to be repurposed into a dog bed or something. I just wish they had not changed the great product that the "safer bather" used to be.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is by far the one of the best things I have bought for my son.  For my first son I used one of those yellow sponge things. YUCK! It ended up smelling and molding!  I found the safer bather searching on the internet, being I live overseas in Germany with the US Army.  My new little man just loves this.  He is all smiles and coos.  It is soft, doesn\'t slide around and isn\'t cold like those plastic tubs.  Now he is 3 mon. and it doesn\'t smell! The hook to hang it to dry is a PLUS no molding either! Love the cute little pattern too!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We used this product for my son\'s sponge baths when he was first brought home.  He loved these baths so much that we actually put off tub baths for quite a while.  It turns out he loves tub baths too!  We actually used this on our changing table (with waterproof lap pads over it, so as not to get it too dirty) for his early changings because while he loved sponge baths, he hated having his diaper changed.  This tactic definitely helped.  It\'s also very portable if you have to give baths over at Grandma\'s - it can be used in a sink!  Most people haven\'t heard of this product, so it makes a great and unique shower gift.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Unless you\'re dealing with a newborn, don\'t bother! Bought this for my four month old grandson\'s visit and he kept sliding off into the tub water.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My 5 month old starting squirming in baby bath & sliding down on the seat & leaning over the side.I wanted a safe soft alternative. SHe can\'t sit up yet, so she stays put now while bathing.It dried easily overnite by hanger. Its best if you have a towel rod in your tub though.I wish I just bought this in place of tub to begin with.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Typically I wouldn\'t take the time to write a review, but I feel very strongly about this product and recommend it to all new moms...also been there done that moms who are still a bit hesitant to give a wiggly baby a bath.  My son feels so secure in it, that he just sits back and enjoys his bath.  I don\'t have to worry about him slipping out of my hands, it holds him so I have my hands free to bath him.  An (inexpensive) wise investment.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: When my 9-month old granddaughter came to visit from Europe, she was already growing out of her plastic tub at home, so I didn\'t want another.  Then I read the reviews, and decided to try Safer Bather. We really liked it - the baby was relaxed and warm and didn\'t slip around.  It\'s a great product at a reasonable price.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought one of these bathers 3 1/2 years ago for my son...and still LOVE it!  My son used it till he could sit up and then my nephew used it and now my daughter is using it.  It definately holds up and I haven\'t had any problems with midew!  I really love the fact that I can take it any where we go!  Deffinately worth the money...!!!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: When I brought my daughter home from the hospital, the infant bath tub were too big and uncomfortable. I bought the safer bather and it was the best investment I have ever made. It made it easy to bath her. I recommend it for its safety especially with newborn. It is also easy to keep clean. This as a must have on your baby registry list or to buy for your baby. I have bought this for my girlfriends and they loved it.  You truly get a great use of this product.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This pillow is AWESOME!  We didn\'t know about this product until our girls were a couple months old.  They hated bathing in the hard plastic infant tub we had and when their necks weren\'t as strong, looked so uncomfortable.  Once we used the Safer Bather they LOVED bath time and still use it at 9 months. Wish we had this one from the start, especially for sponge bathing.  Dries well from hanging and machine washes too.  Nothing negative about this product.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We used this during each bath from when my daughter was born to when she was almost 6 months! It is so comfortable for her, and the times that we were away from home and used a baby bath without it, I couldn\'t believe how difficult it was for her and us (very slippery baby!) I would recommend this for anyone.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this thinking that I was getting a floating bath pad for my new baby.  This does NOT float. It just fills up with water and sinks in the tub.  Then it weighs about 20 lbs when you take it out.  Maybe this is what other customers wanted, but it was not the product I was expecting.  I\'ll keep looking for a floating bath mat like I used with my 3 year old son.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I can\'t believe how inexpensive this PERFECT tub is for my baby.  I fumbled around with all of the big plastic tubs with my 1st child but his one is a god send for my 2nd!  It\'s like one big sponge that I lay in the bathroom tub.  It absorbs the water and as soon as you pick it up, 95% of the water just falls out!  No need to worry about it molding or taking forever to dry.  It dries out completely in just a couple of hours (and is also machine washable).  You can store this just about anywhere unlike the big plastic space hogs.  Also, beware of the plastic tubs with the rubber linings (so called anti slip mats) which can rub the babies back the wrong way.  My daughter lost some skin on her back from squirming around in one of those and it was sore for days!  Buy this safer bather!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Love this!!!!!!!  I have a regular baby bath tub and I used it with my son for the first month or so and it was a real chore to bathe him.  You\'re so busy trying to keep them from sliding to one side or getting water in their ears.  You have to keep one hand on the baby at all times so trying to wash with only one hand is very difficult.  Then I saw this bather on Amazon.com and I read the reviews.  I decided to try it and I\'m so glad I did.  My son is 3 months old now and we use this bather for every bath.  Mostly, I just set it inside of the baby bath tub.  He fits right down inside and there is no more sliding around.  I am free to use two hands to wash him and he stays warm during the bath so no more screaming.  Other times I lay it in our bath tub and he just lays there staring up at me.  I have already told all my pregnant friends about this safer bather.  I just love it because it helps make his bath time a good bonding time...not something we\'re both dreading.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: Just like any new mother, I was petrified by the thought of bathing my newborn on my own. Due to the softness of a baby\'s skull, I knew I didn\'t want my baby\'s first tub to be a hard plastic tub, but rather one made of sponge. The Safer Bather was wonderful mainly because I didn\'t have to worry about my baby hitting her head on a hard surface. I placed it on our bathroom counter and bathed her with a mug using the water from the sink. The Safer Bather absorbed most of the water, and any remaining water drained from the counter into the sink. There wasn\'t much of a mess and clean up was easy. I made sure to wash it in the washing machine once every two weeks with baby detergent so that it would not develop mold. After washing it, I hung it to dry, which helped in not altering its original shape. When I have my next child, I will probably buy another Safer Bather because I\'m not comfortable using one that has been sitting around for so long, even after washing it. Nevertheless, I think it\'s a worthwhile investment for my baby\'s first few months. I used this tub until she was sitting up by herself, which is when I transitioned her to a hard plastic tub in which she could sit and play with her toys.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This item is really great- but I wish I wouldve gotten it sooner! :(  My son is 5 months and we dont really "need" this anymore- although I think it\'s more comfortable in the bath to have, since it\'s like a big comfy cushion!  It holds the warm water in so that baby stays warm too, which is nice.  It wouldve been nice to have when he was a newborn though!  :)  Oh well, I\'ll have it for next time! :)

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I just used this bather for the first time last night and I must say that I love it!!  My now 4 month old daughter has just outgrown her infant tub, and since she doesn\'t have her own bathroom yet, I wanted to get something that was easy to store.  This was our answer!  I just fill the tub of with warm water and let it lay in it, in order for it to absorb the water, while I undress her.  I lay her in it and wala, she doesn\'t move!!!  She can still splash her feet which is great!  After bathtime, just wring and hang on the shower rod.  How easy is that?!  Of course, since I\'ve only used it once I haven\'t had any problems with mold, but I plan on washing it everyweek, so I hope that helps.  If it becomes a problem, I will update this review!Update:Well I have been using this product for about two months now and it DOES have mildew! EW!! (Reduced to 3 stars) It is not stink however, but the mildew is very obvious! I have washed it weekly and dried it after every bath but still mildew! I do think that it was fine for the transitional period, but my now 6.5 month old daughter will be using an inflatable tub and this will be tossed!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This item made bath time easier & safer for my newborn, because it just cradled him. I also used it when we traveled abroad--I\'d sit in the tub w/my son on it and bathe him. Plus it doubled as a changing station when dry. It\'s important to try & get the excess water out while you dry it, because it takes longer to dry otherwise. I\'d put in the spin cycle for 10 seconds in the washer before hanging it to dry. The other item I couln\'t live without is the Fisher Price Swing that sways in both directions.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I used these for both of my guys.They laid nicely on the pillow, I didn\'t worry about them squirming off.  Their little legs would kick and kick in the water surrounding them!  As baby got bigger he\'d sit on the pillow, it would keep him from squirming around so much.When bathtime was over I\'d just hang the pillow up over the shower nozzle and it would be dry in a few hours.No nasty plastic tub to keep clean and store.(I had to buy a new one for second baby, first was lost in a move.  That\'s the mark of a good product, when you buy it again!)

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: This is a wonderful product for when your baby out grows their infant tub, but can\'t sit up yet in the big tub. My son loves laying on this during his bath - he loves having lots of room to kick his legs!  As long as you follow the drying instructions, you should have no problems with it. Love it!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I really like this bath pad. My little guy nestles nicely into it and I don\'t have to worry about him sliding around on it. It\'s also nice because I can spray it with warm water before I put him on it and it will retain the warmth so it\'s not a cold shocker on him. Has a nice plastic hanger on the top that is great for hanging it on the shower curtain rod to dry. You really do have to be diligent about drying it and letting all of the surfaces to be exposed to air otherwise it will mold but it can be thrown in the washing machine too.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I used this bathtub 5 years ago for my eldest kid after trying one another kind of tub.  This bath tub offers maximum safety from falls/skids and takes out the fear from bathing a infant, specially if you are new to doing it.  It is easy to clean but make sure you hang it up to drain the water within a couple of hours after using it. Leaving it in water several times for long periods will result in green mold.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I did not want one of those big, bulky, hard plastic bathtubs for my little girl, so when I saw the Safer Bather I immediatly registered for it.  My daughter has been bathing on it since we brought her home from the hospital and now that she is 3 months old she loves to splash in it! It is so simple to use - just hang it up to dry when your done.  I usually just leave it hanging in the bathtub until the next bath, but it can be easily stored anywhere.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I got this for my daughter and she absolutely loves it! I\'ve never had a problem bathing her. She loves taking a bath in this. Dont even waste your money on those hard plastic ones. This is the bath tub!!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this item several years ago and am still using it today.  I had read some reviews about mildew, but have obviously had no problems with mildew.  We wring it out and hang it up after each use and have had no problems.  We keep it hung in the shower/bathtub and it doesn\'t take up a lot of extra room like a plastic tub would.  I would highly recommend this product.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this when my son was born and it was great for positioning him for sponge baths, but when I started using it for regular baths it became funky. I realized I was trying to be so clean with his bottles and clothes and then bathing him with this smelly pillow. (I had tried soaking it) I used a wire frame with a mesh hammock that was handed down to me until he could sit up. Maybe my bathroom wasn\'t ventilated enough for it to dry properly?

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I ordered this Bath Pad when my daughter was born almost six years ago and used it for the first few months. It\'s an excellent product to use from birth onwards. I never had to worry about water going in her eyes or mouth as the pad keeps the head elevated. Now I bought another one for my second child and have been using it everyday. Highly Recommended!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: To tell you the truth, the this bather is only good when you are in the tub too. The reason is because the safe bather fills with water, and it sinks, therefore, it will get water in your baby\'s ears if you don\'t watch it. My husband and I found that it works only when you place the safe bather on your feet and have the water level really low. It doesn\'t float as I hoped it wood. Otherwise, if you like to bathe with your baby, you will enjoy it. We found it better than any plastic tub. Even though we bought one plastic tub, one that folds down to be really compact, we never use it because she sometime clunks her head to the plastic sides, NOT REALLY SAFE UNLESS YOU WANT A REALLY UPSET CRYING BABY. So the safe bather is really better than any plastic tub, BUT sinks!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I found this after searching the Web for something to cure my newborn of his hatred for baths. I wasn\'t too convinced anything would work but IT WORKED. He still hasn\'t worked his way up to smiling during bath time but he has completely stopped screaming during them. He even splashes around like I read in some of the other reviews. I don\'t really find that squeezing out the pillow is that difficult or time consuming. It takes all of 10 seconds.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I used this bath pillow for both my children, so for almost 6 years straight. It held up to the test of time and many baths, is easy to machine wash and dry, and hangs dry in your tub if you just install a hook. I never bothered to wring it out and would just let it drip above the drain. Never mildewed!  I love love love this bath pad. Great for the kitchen sink, baby tubs, and alone in the big tub as well.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I bought this after reading several of the reviews here.  I absolutely love it!!  I use it in our big tub for my little girl and have not had a moment\'s worry with her on it.  We have used this since she was 2 weeks old - she is now a year old - and still love it (she just sits or leans on it now).  I have not had any of the problems that others have listed here - I hang it up in the tub to drain overnight and have not seen any mildew at all.  Best of all, I can use it as a back cushion for myself in the tub!!  Overall, I highly recommend this for any parent who wants to avoid using a smaller tub or seat.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I was driving myself crazy researching all about different bath tubs for my newborn daughter. Finally, I just gave up and decided on this one because of the reviews and because of the price. It arrived and it was very large, big enough for baby, with extra padding and cushion all around cradling baby. I thought "eh, okay" and was a little skeptical. As soon as I gave my baby girl her first bath, I fell in love with this thing! I have been using it religiously for the past 6 months and she just loves it! She has always loved it! I have used it in the bath tub and in the sink. It is soft so you can kind of squish it into the sink depending how big your sink it. I would recommend that for an older baby though. But as a newborn, I would plop this in the tub, run the water, and bathe her. It never once even slipped or even budged. When wet this thing practically glues itself to the tub. It soaks up the water but it doesnt get soggy while giving a bath. There is plenty of cushion to hold and support baby. Great head/neck support for newborns. She is now 6 months and still fits perfectly. When done with the bath we just hang it up and the water drips out and it air dries. Its easy to clean. Its great on saving space. Its cute. Its soft. Its a great price! You really can not go wrong with this thing! Plus, its not that hard plastic like most of them are! Its like baby is laying on a pillow! Parents, especially newbies, look no further and get this for your little one! I highly recommend it.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I cannot speak highly enough about this baby product!  I love this bath pillow.  I used it when my 3 year old was a newborn and now I am using it for my new baby.  It perfectly cradles the baby during bath time...even the tiniest of babies.  We used it with my oldest son well past his first birthday.  Once he was sitting on his own we would simply have him sit on it.  We tried a bath seat at one point but it was a hard plastic and the edges were not very smooth.  He looked so uncomfortable in it (plus it was difficult to get him in and out of it).  We never had a problem with mildew or smells.  We always dried it out by hanging it in the shower after the bath.  We washed it a few different ways...sometimes in the washing machine and sometimes by simply adding Oxyclean to the bathtub and letting it sit in the solution.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: We have used this in our tub since my son\'s first bath. He is 6 months old now, and it is holding up great. We hang dry it after every bath, and we have had zero smell or mildew issues. We put it in the washing machine on occasion, but not as often as we might. Since my son started sitting, we fill the tub with more water and he sits on the pad. It keeps the baby warm and avoids the slippery baby problem.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: My little angel is only 7wks old, and loves her baths.  This product lets me keep her head out of the water and she doesn\'t slip when I\'m washing her.  It allows me to have a free hand.  All parents out there this is a definite must have....don\'t pass this by....worth every penny!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I haven\'t written reviews on any other products before but I\'m so happy with this purchase that I felt the need to let others know.  With my first born we tried the traditional plastic bathers and she hated every bath.  I gave up and got in the tub with her and bathed her by laying her on my legs until she could sit on her own.With this bather I put my 1 month old in the tub on it and she\'s happy.  I can wash my 4yo while she lays there nice and comfy (or vice versa).  She feels secure and it helps keep her warm.  Bathtime doesn\'t bring tears and is very enjoyable with this bather.  It\'s worth every penny!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I absolutely love this bather. It is soft enough and easy enough to use in the tub as soon as baby loses his umbilical cord. We never had to transition our 7 month old into the big tub. We went right from the sponge bath to this. It is soft and easy enough to use right away. I like the way it absorbs the water so my little one stays warm. Now that he is sitting up, he can pull up and still sit on the bather. It is also soft so that it he slips, he has a cushion. I like how this bather will be used for a long time, with no need to buy transitional bathers.

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: What a wonderful product!!  I have back trouble, so carrying those baby bath tubs in and out of our large tub was a real problem.  I found this and LOVE IT!!  For the first 3 months of my little girl\'s life, we bathed her using this in the kitchen sink.  When she outgrew the sink, we used it in our regular bathtub.  What a great product...it absorbs the warm water and cradles her with just enough support that she can really enjoy her bath...she\'s over a year old, and it still comes in handy when washing her hair.  I couldn\'t have lived without it and now buy it for all of my "expectant" friends!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: After attempting to bathe baby in sink and the bigger,hard, baby tubs, my newborn sounded like she was being tormented!  I tried this and it was wonderful!  She can lie with her head propped up and no trying to hold a wet baby.  I fill my tub with warm water just so it covers the mat and lay her on it.  She now loves her bathtime!

name: Leachco Safer Bather Infant Bath Pad, Blue Fish
review: I went through many different bathtubs for my baby girl. I had a safety first tub that folded, a wire frame tub with a cloth cover that made it more like a lawnchair, a non-folding tub by safety first and then I finally broke down and tried this tub.I hated how all the others allowed my daughter to slide around and even slip down and turn sideways while bathing. This bath sponge tub is great. She does not slip slide around, I can wash her entire body much easier, and when the tub is filled properly she is nice and warm.
