For me, it really comes down to either paying $5x for this one pillow, or $1x each for 5 standard pillows (which will probably cost just as much or more, will take up more room on the bed, and will require much re-arranging when shifting around during sleep).

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Had this since my 2nd trimester & I\'m sleeping like a baby! 5 more weeks to go :)

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Used it only a few times, sorry I wasted the money.  Even after a washing, the cover is rough and I like soft pillow cases.  It locks you into one position and it\'s a big deal to roll over with that big thing in a queen bed with your husband.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: It really useful and helping~ anyway , you just buy it ! My wife love it very much, so love me more...

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I have Piriformis Syndrome so my tailbone and schiatic nerve go crazy during pregnancy.  I ordered the Snoogle early in my second pregnancy - The Snoogle has given me so much relief at night and I don\'t hurt in the morning!  I wish I had it the first time around!  Would highly recommend to anyone that has back or hip issues.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I don\'t know how I would have slept during my pregnancy with out this pillow. It works great for for your hips and back pains. The only problem is that it is hard to put the pillow case back on after you wash it

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This made sleeping during pregnancy possible. If you can, get it early on and it will definitely be worth the price.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow last night, and already know that it was well worth the cost.  I am 5\'6", and this pillow was perfect, but it would work for any height.  After one night, my back pain was almost gone, after waking up for about a week with back pain.  I\'m 14 weeks, and I know the snoogle will only help me as I get bigger! I would recommend this to anyone, pregnant or not! It is a wonderful investment.  My only complaint was that it says it has a removable, washable cover, but it looked somewhat difficult to remove, so I just put a normal pillowcase on the curled part where you put your head, and it worked fine.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Got this for the MS who is 22 weeks along. She loves it however she has woken up fighting it from time to time.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: The best investment so far of my twin pregnancy! I can sleep so comfortably with this pillow! I get a great nights sleep EVERY NIGHT.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this pillow for my second baby. I found it helpful really for just naps. If you are a "flip flopper" when you sleep, it is very difficult to flip over with it. It is good though if you sleep in a double size bed. You don\'t have 8 million pillows to deal with. I had to stop using it when I got too big to flip easily.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I\'m pregnant and my hips don\'t hurt as much from sleeping on my side as they did before the snoogle--i\'m excited to cuddle with it as i\'m getting into bed.  It\'s great when i go on my back too b/c the bottom part elevates the legs perfectly.  Only con is i get hot w/ it about 3-4 am , throw it off the bed and go back to pillow btw legs, pillow to hold, and pillow for head.  TRICK--instead of buying a pillow case for it i put my regular case on the part where my head goes and it covers just where it needs to!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is a God-send for me.  I have had a horrible time sleeping during my pregnancy.  This pillow is so comfortable, keeps me surpported and in the right position all night long.  Only trouble is that when I get up to go the bathroom at night, I come back to find my husband curled up with it!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow on recommendation from a friend, who said it\'s great for pregnancy. The pillow is bigger than I expected. My husband was surprised by the size as well. That said, it does provide good support for knees and head. You won\'t want to lay your head on the pillow all night without some type of cover over it, because the fabric is not very soft.  I did use it after an abdominal surgery I had, and it kept me propped up better than regular pillow, which was nice. I was optimistic that the pillow may help me not roll on my back while sleeping, and I haven\'t been able to adjust it to keep me from rolling back. Alas, it\'s still a good pillow, and I think it will help with sleep through the rest of my pregnancy, and have good applications after.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I had this pillow when I was pregnant and then passed it on to a friend, This past year my dental assistant was pregnant and like so many dental professionals, once she had much of a tummy at all it caused her a lot of back pain and difficulty sleeping. I bought this pillow for her and her problems were immediately  solved. She is due next month and still using it every night. Thankfully she will be done with it in another month and will be passing it back to me for the next 7 months or so. Every pregnancy is easier with this awesome pillow!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was having a terrible time adjusting to the increasing size of my belly along with trying to sleep. My husband ordered this pillow for me in hopes that it would help. I am so glad that he found this product. I have been able to sleep ever since the snoogle pillow arrived. Pregnancy is exhausting enough without having trouble sleeping. I highly recommend this product to expectant moms.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Okay, I am very skeptical when it comes to things that are supposed to make me comfortable during pregnancy...I\'m not one of these "glowing, cute little basketball belly" kind of pregnant ladies.  I\'m more of the "gigantic, lethargic, miserable" kind.  :)  But I must say, this pillow has done more for my overall comfort during this pregnancy than any other product I\'ve ever used.  I really wish I had it during my first pregnancy!  I had severe hip and lower back pain and sciatica (sort of like a pinched nerve in your lower back that sends a shooting pain all the way down your leg) almost to the point where I couldn\'t walk in the mornings when I got out of bed.  I am very surprised to tell you that this pillow has done wonders to relieve all of these aches and pains.  It took me about 3 or 4 nights to really get used to it and figure out which way it works best for me...now, I couldn\'t imagine sleeping without it.  I will definitely continue to use it after the pregnancy.  This is by far the best $50 I ever spent.  I haven\'t had the pillow long enough to comment on the problems other people have had with the filling shifting, but I love this pillow so much that if I had to replace it in 6 months because of the filling problems, I would not hesitate.  I didn\'t see how it could really support your back that much, but it really does.  The weight of your head on one end and your leg on the other end really holds the back support in place so it doesn\'t just gradually get out of place during the course of the night like a regular pillow behind your back would do.  It is the perfect thickness for my head (I like a little thicker pillow, not a flat one), so my neck is quite comfortable.  I just put a pillow case over the end where my head goes...I didn\'t purchase the extra cover, but I probably will.  I use the pillow with the more curved end between my legs so that the tip of it comes around and goes right under the side of my belly to support it...which looks like it might be a little uncomfortable, but it\'s perfect!  What a great invention.  If I could give this pillow 6 stars I would.  The best $50 I ever spent.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Pillow was for my daughter-in-law and she loves it!!!!  she recommends it for any mother that is pregnant.  Helps with all of her pain!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was having the hardest time sleeping by about 8 weeks of pregnancy. This pillow helped out immensely. it also helps to make sure you are sleeping on your left side. I highly recommend.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this when I was 16 weeks pregnant (now 19 weeks) because I am a stomach sleeper and was finding it uncomfortable to find another position.  I\'m sooo glad I bought it when I did!  I hadn\'t realized how much being uncomfortable had affected my sleeping, but as soon as I bought this I started falling asleep right away at night, and sleeping very soundly through the night.  I feel much more rested.  I\'ve tried out a couple of positions with it (sleeping facing the long side, sleeping away from it) and both have been incredibly comfortable options.My only problem with this is that it makes getting up in the middle of the night to go to the bathroom trickier, you have to untangle from the pillow and sheets, etc, but it is totally worth it.  The best part about this is that my husband teased me mercilessly about how much I loved this pillow, so I let him try it out once and now he loves it more than me - he takes naps with it and steals in the morning if I leave before him (he also asks me every night if I am going to use it, just in case...).

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I think every pregnant woman should have one!!  It\'s the best, once my stomach started growing, I found it hard to find a comfortable sleep position.  I used to have to try to strategically place my regular pillows around my body so I can be comfortable, but with the snoogle pillow it\'s just one pillow and you could put the bottom of the pillow between your legs and have the rest of the pillow supporting your back!I absolutely LOVE this pillow, without it I think there would have been a lot of miserable, sleepless nights!!!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: The absolute best pillow I could have ever invested in. I am very frugal, and I always buy pillows from Big Lots or wal-mart, which do fine for me. However, with being pregnant, I didn\'t want to sacrifice comfort in any way. This is the greatest purchase I have made while pregnant. I don\'t have uncomfortable nights, I will wrap it around myself while sitting on the couch, and it give ridiculously amazing back support. I can\'t wait until baby comes, and I will also be able to use it as a nursing pillow! My husband was so jealous of how comfortable I was sleeping at night.... I bought him one too!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I cannot image my life was if I don\'t have this pillow during the pregancy.  it saved my life and I love it.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow for myself recently. I am currently 27 weeks pregnant with my fourth child. When I read reviews all over the internet, women spouted that *this* is the best pillow on the market. So I excitedly added it to cart and awaited the arrival of my new comfort. I was expecting something more, I suppose because what came out of the package was disappointing.Pros-Folds easily to  position yourself differently. nice to have for propping up in bed.The length is decent. Keep in mind, tall moms like me may find that it\'s a bit short.Cons -The width of the actual pillow part is very narrow. This makes for not much support area between knees or thighs. The pillow does fold, but it seems awkward to keep it like that.It is very squishy and gives just too much. The stuffing should be firmer and more supportive. This may not be a big deal to some, but it is for me. I was hoping for more support and comfort for my hips during sleep. No dice.The pillow is cumbersome and annoying to turn over during sleep. Let\'s just go ahead and acknowledge how uncomfortable pregnancy is for many women. Sleeping on one side is just not a reasonable expectation. I think in the future I will go for a pillow that is a full U shape.The covering it comes with is rough and likely needs to be washed and softened a bit. I found it scratchy on my skin. Maybe a pregnancy thing or it really is that scratchy. It\'s a woven material, feels very cheap to me.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I received my Snoogle during the fourth month of pregnancy. When most women in my Lamaze/child care classes began complaining about how their hips and back were aching, I was comfortable. I didn\'t realize how much I depended upon that pillow until I went on vacation about 6 weeks ago. After just one Snoogle-less night, I was really aching. I\'ve never been so happy to get back to a pillow before. It has also been a wonderful pillow to rest a heavy growing belly up against. Or if you lay the opposite way, it cradles your back. I\'m thinking I\'ll take it with me to the hospital when I deliver in a few weeks. Definitely one of the BEST pregnancy buys I made!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this pillow as I turned 7 months preganant and my back pain became so bad I started losing serious sleep.  The pillow immediately helped with the back pain but there are trade offs . . .#1) You will need to a seperate pillow case as the one that it comes with is not that soft (at $45 I expected better).#2) The pillow takes up some room and will squish your partner to the other side of the bed.#3) If you want to turn over in the middle of the night or need to get out of bed  to use the bathroom it can be a pain to turn, get in/out of bed and get the pillow situated again.  However, the pillow has made me quite a bit more comfortable that I don\'t toss and turn half of what I was before getting it.#4) It tends to trap body heat causing you to get warm by morning time.While all of that sounds very negative, I still like the pillow and am happy I bought it because it helped with my back pain when nothing else could.  Oh and it keeps me from sleeping on my back which I never used to do, but had noticed was happening more as I tossed and turned at night.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was having a very difficult time sleeping before buying this pillow! This pillow has made a huge difference in helping me sleep better and not be so sore in the morning. I am normally a back sleeper but since becoming pregnant for the second time not being able to sleep on my back has been very problematic. Starting at about 14-15 weeks pregnant I wasn\'t able to get a good night\'s sleep. I would commonly develop a headache at night and wake with one in the morning. Before purchasing and using this pillow I would toss and turn all night. I would sleep on one side and after an hour or so the whole side of my body I was sleeping on would be sore, tingle, and feel numb. I would then have to rotate from side to side all night and by morning I hadn\'t slept and was sore on both sides of my body. Since buying this product, I prop myself up with this pillow and neck pillows to sleep somewhat sitting up. The pillow makes this very comfortable. Then about halfway through the night I lay on on this pillow and rotate sides. Somehow the soreness has gone away since using this pillow. I love the back support it provides and cradling of my growing tummy. Of course curling the pillow in between my legs for additional support is crucial and very comfortable! The pillow is very large and bulky and takes up a lot of space in the bed but it is soooooooo worth it! My husband doesn\'t like it very much since it is like a wall between us in bed but my sleep has dramatically improved since using this pillow. I can\'t imagine making it through the last half of my pregnancy without it! I would recommend this pillow to anyone! It has so many uses as well that I can see using it even after my pregnancy. It folds around you in so many different positions. It comes with a hardcard that shows all the different positions and uses for the pillow. Great price and great buy!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Both my daughter slept better using this. Oh yes their husbands wanted one for them selfs. This is the perfect gift.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: The Shape is great and can be used different ways but too stiff for me very uncomfortable for my head.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My wife got this early on in her pregnancy and never slept without it. We would often fight over it in the middle of the night as it is great for people who like a pillow between their knees. We probably will keep this in the bed after her pregnancy. :)

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this for my wife because she\'s pregnant and she loves it! My only curiosity is if they make a pillowcase for this?

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is amazing even if your not pregnant. I suffer from low back, hip and neck pain and usually toss and turn all night. This pillow is very supportive and comfortable. It\'s not too thin or too bulky. I didn\'t even realize all the positions you can sit/sleep in with this pillow! It was a good buy for me!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I wish I would have gotten the pillow that wraps around both sides. Maybe I am just uncomfortable regardless, but this pillow seems too small.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: A large, comfortable, and versatile pillow. My wife has loved it for the second half of this pregnancy. It has remained nice and fluffy over the last 3 months, too.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this when I was 5 months thinking I could make it without. I do not know how I would have slept without it. It is so very comfortable and takes the pressure off of my ever growing belly. IT is beyond worth the money, I would reccomend this to anyone considering!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I\'m expecting my first child in June 2007 and was having trouble sleeping. I ordered this pillow and am SO glad that I did. It is large, and a bit ungainly, but the flexibility of positions makes it great! I can sleep on my left side now without tossing and turning. It is a bit tough to get out of bed around it, but for me, a good night\'s sleep and an end to back pain is well worth any inconvenience!Would highly recommend for pregnancy!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this pillow really early in my pregnancy, but I really did not need it until I was 26 weeks with twins, which is probably the size of closer to 30 weeks with a single (I measured the full 40cm/40weeks at only 29 weeks).  That being said, I have required the nightly use of the pillow from 28 weeks to now, at 36 weeks.  At this point, it is crucial that I fold the one end all the way around and slightly under the side of my belly.  I did not buy an extra cover and the cover that it comes with could be a better thread count; however I have put a t-shirt over the the head end to go longer between washings since it is really a chore to take the cover off and put it back on.  The pillow is holding up okay... the part that I put between my legs has definitely deflated more than I\'d like.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Somewhere around 18 weeks, I started becoming so uncomfortable at night.  I have always been a fan of sleeping with multiple pillows, but I was having to build a fortress to get remotely comfortable.  I had read positive reviews of the Snoogle and had seen it at Babies R Us.  I finally had enough and sent this link to my husband at work (BRU is a mile from his office,) and asked him to please bring it home.He came home, exclaiming, "This was $50!"  I assured him it was the best $50 he has ever spent.  Now, I only sleep with the Snoogle and one other pillow in the open part of the Snoogle.  It is, indeed, huge, so it\'s a good thing we have a king sized bed.  However, now that I\'m at 33 weeks, I can\'t imagine sleeping without it.  It really helps the back pain.I took off one star because I feel that for the money, the cover could be made of a nicer, softer fabric.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I\'m 16 weeks pregnant and this is my second pregnancy. I bought the Snoogle after suffering from neck pain, pins and needles in my arm (on the side I was sleeping) and due to a desire to stop rolling onto my back in the night. The reviews seemed helpful and the Snoogle was cheaper than the "J" shaped pregnancy pillow (also available through amazon online and got better reviews). I put my own pillow case over the head part, as one reviewer suggested. And I was set. But I had the worst night\'s sleep! I tried it for 3 nights and 3 naps. It did allow me to stay put and not roll onto my back because I was so cradled. But the head piece (and I switched the pillow around and tried both ends with similar results) was a little too hard and hurt my ear. When I rolled over, if I was facing the curve (didn\'t want to roll the pillow over in the night), I felt suffocated by the curve of the head piece. Plus, it really is too hot to sleep with. And it\'s too difficult to toss around the bed (it gets tangled and you need all the sleep you can get). I found it took up LESS room than the pillows I was using, but it cradled my head in such a way that I didn\'t sleep well at all. Instead, I purchased a new extra firm head pillow and used a regular pillow for between my legs. And had the best night\'s sleep in 3 nights or more (no neck pain or pins and needles). I\'m taking my pillow back ASAP.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was shocked when my wife could suddenly sleep through a night of her pregnancy with this thing.  Thank god.  If mama aint happy, aint nobody happy.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this while at babies-r-us last week. I was hesitant at first because of some of the reviews, but I wish I had purchased it sooner in my pregnancy. It is really great to curl around your neck and down your back to your knees, or to wrap around your tummy and sit up in bed with the neck part up around your shoulders. It also doesn\'t really take up much room in bed compared to the 4 to 6 pillows I was using to try to get comfortable with before this. We have a queen size bed and my hubby is still able to cuddle with me...when I am not grumpy!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this early on in my pregnancy based on several friends\' recomendations.  I find taht I can\'t sleep in hotel rooms now without having it.  I added a very soft conforming pillow to the head portion and then  usually sleep with it supporting my back since that is where I have the most pain.  I feel like I\'m in a little next and am very comfortable.  I often wake up to my husband hugging the other side of it.  Win win for both of us.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My wife used this until after she had the baby. She wrapped up in it, cuddled in it, leaned on it, breast fed with it... She also used it to divide the bed in half, seemingly to keep me away. Maybe she blamed me for her condition? I packed it in a vacuum bag first chance I got.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I purchased this pillow early in my pregnancy after reading reviews on the various pillows on the market.  It turned out to be extremely uncomfortable almost as soon as I got it and completely unusable later in the pregnancy. It was impossible to sleep on one side all night long without my arm or leg falling asleep. Trying to switch sides became a long process that inevitably woke up my husband and only frustrated me more.  Using it as a back support was not at all helpful.  I had better back support sleeping on my side on the couch.  I ended up using separate pillows to support my stomach and legs. In the end, it was a total waste of money.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This item was purchased on advice from my sister.  She said it is a must have for a pregnant woman.  I bought it as a surprise to my wife b/c she was tossing and turning all night.  She loves it now that she is in her 3rd Trimester and the belly is getting heavy.  Beyond tripping over it in the mornings...it has been a great purchase!  Plus when she is away for work, I get to snuggle with the Snoogle!!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is not comfortable its very hard I`m gonna have to spend more money now on buying a new one that is soft and comfortable.....

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Too big and cumbersome, part under head and neck very uncomfortable. Not worth the money. Have a king sized bed and am small at 5 foot 5 inches/120lbs, felt like the pillow and I took up more than half the bed. Would be better without curved ends. Gave to a friend to try, she also hated it.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: At around the 5 month mark in my pregnancy the aches and sleepless nights hit. That\'s when I went in search of a good pregnancy pillow and found the embarrassingly named, but effective Snoogle.  It took some getting used to - I\'m 6 feet tall and this thing still strikes me as big.  I can\'t imagine how a petite woman would sleep with it!  And sometimes it felt like the Snoogle was coming after me the way it could curl around and poke me in the back - but once I figured out some new comfortable sleep positions it really became a life saver, and I\'ve continued to use it many months after my baby was born.I\'ve found so many uses for this pillow beyond the traditional side sleeper with a portion tucked between my knees.  It\'s especially come in handy when using my laptop in bed - with the tightly curved portion as a neck pillow and the long side supporting my arm.  It\'s also easy to coil up and put under your legs for considerable height and support (I imagine it would be great for back problems or elevating a sprain) - plus the fact that it can twist around so easily makes it easy to fold up and store.The cover has worn well - and it\'s stayed clean and plush.  I\'d definitely recommend it if you\'re in need of heavy duty support.  Just make sure you have a big enough bed or a partner who\'s willing to share with your newest sleep buddy.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I have been using this for about three weeks now, and I love it! I was having hip pains at night, along with just being uncomfortable, and this pillow made it all better! I sleep like a baby with this thing because it is so comfortable. I definitely recommend it!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow saved me during pregnancy.  I am not a side sleeper and this pillow helped support me and make me comfortable.  Since I am 5\'2 I found that it was a little long for me but I made it work.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow has been an essential for me since I hit about 5 months pregnant.  Its soft, flexible, and has a great shape.  My only complaint is that I don\'t like the thickness of the pillow where it rests between my legs...I often wake up in discomfort in my hips.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow after recommendations on Amazon and from a friend who used it during pregnancy. At first (21 weeks pregnant) it seemed to help but now I am not really sure (25 weeks pregnant). As a back and stomach sleeper, it definitely helps me to stay on my side but I still wake up at night. I don\'t think I have been able to adjust to sleeping on my side, not sure if I ever will. In addition, I am a light sleeper and due to being pregnant, using the bathroom during the night. The Snoogle conforms to many different shapes so I have also been able to use it to prop myself up in bed to read.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: If someone was pregnant and they were having trouble sleeping due to comfort, I would recommend they try this pillow for sure! Didn\'t solve all of my preganancy comfort problems while sleeping, but it definitely helped!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: The item is as described.  However, the material inside is cheap and the head part is already squished to nothing.  Also, the cover is pilling and scratchy.  I have to wear long pants if I want to use this comfortably.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: OMG, if I could give this 10 stars, I would!!!I\'m so in love with this pillow. It has been a lifesaver during this last trimester.  It\'s made sleeping sooo much more comfortable.  I "assume the position" with this pillow and pass out.  I do not wake up at all and am usually in the same position when I wake up in the morning.  BEST THING EVER!!!!!!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I purchased the Snoogle after reading good reviews and hearing that it would definitely help for sleeping comfortably.  It didn\'t quite work that way for me.  I suppose if you stay in one position while you sleep, it\'s great, but I tend to flip from side to side throughout the night; and with having the Snoogle wrapped around me, it was very difficult to flip from one side to the other.  I got frustrated and just threw the thing off the bed and went back to using a regular bed pillow between my knees, which ended up being WAY more comfortable than the Snoogle.  I found that the Snoogle was not as plush as my regular pillows are and did not provide adequate spacing between my knees for good back support.  I should have just stuck with my regular bed pillows and saved myself [money].  The only reason I give it 2 stars is because my kids have gotten LOTS of use from it by using it to lay on while watching t.v. on the living room floor.  They love it.  So at least it will not go to total waste, but I definitely will not be reccommending this product to anyone I know.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this item when I was only 4 months pregnant. Now at 6 months pregnant I never go to sleep without it. It is so comfortable. And I am a small person so it raps around my whole body and I personally love it. I will use it when the baby comes as well for him to sit in and lay on. It is worth every penny.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My husband and I were worried we wasted fifty bucks on this pillow.  While I tried many-a-time to sleep with the pillow, it didn\'t make the cut. First of all. I prefer down pillows, I need lots of squish, the snoogle is really for those that prefer a firmer pillow, I share a queen bed, so the snoogle was also somewhat of a hazard.  My poor husband would have to shield himself in case one of the contorted ends came flying as I constantly repositioned myself.  It would be nice, on that note if the pillow was a bit more flexible or if one end was straight.  I fell asleep with it once and felt many awkward pains in my neck, shoulders and back.However, all was not lost, it turns out that it can be a wonderful bumper to put around your baby if she happens to fall asleep on your bed.  My husband and I immediately realized we hadn\'t bought the Snoogle in vain.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow for my girl, she loves it. It was a good buy, I\'m happy with it .....

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: At 32 weeks pregnant I hated going to bed! I created a pillow fortress in an attempt to get comfy, and had to rebuild the fortress every time I got up to pee. I was extremely frustrated, achey, and so tired that I couldn\'t think straight during the day.That\'s when my husband bought me the Snoogle. I hadn\'t wanted to spend the money because I figured it would be the same as using pillows. I was so wrong! He brought it home on a Saturday afternoon. I skeptically said I\'d lay on it for a minute or two, thinking that we\'d just return it to the store. Three hours later I woke up from the best sleep I\'d had in weeks!I LOVE love LOVE my Snoogle. I finally look forward to going to bed again!!!I sleep with the smaller curve under my head, the long portion along my belly, and the longer curve through my knees and tucked under my hip to keep my alignment right. It\'s wonderful! After getting up to pee (every 2 hours now that I\'m at 36 weeks!) I get back into position quickly and easily and fall back to sleep within minutes.If you\'re struggling with being comfortable in bed, try this pillow!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This body pillow is not nearly as comfortable as my past body pillow, which was the Comfort-U (which I highly recommend!).  It\'s too stiff, although I\'m sure it\'ll soften over time.  The stitching in the curves is too tight and therefore not flexible enough.  The fabric is a little rough too.  I was expecting a much more comfortable pillow and am now regretting I didn\'t stick with the Comfort-U, which is a little bigger and bulkier, but you feel surrounded by a cloud and it\'s so much more comfortable.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This is an absolute must have for any pregnancy. I\'ll probably keep using it after the baby is born. It really helped me sleep.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: After reading the raves on this and other websites, I was eager to try this pillow. I\'ve had horrible times sleeping during pregnancy and was hopeful this would help.  And it did, for about a month until the cheap materials showed it up. The portion of the pillow between my knees compressed into nothingness and was totally unsupportive thereafter.  It\'s tricky to roll over with (I always had to wake up to do it) and the fabric is really rough and scratchy. It also did not offer enough support for my neck. Get this pillow if you never want to cuddle your partner again, it\'s so cumbersome, you won\'t be able to--it\'s like the Great Wall.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This snoogle helps me sleep so much better.  You can use it for all sorts of things.  Even my dogs love it!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought one of these for my 6 month pregnant wife since she\'s been getting increasingly uncomfortable sleeping at night.The first night she had this, she slept through the whole night without moving AT ALL.  She looked so peaceful, I couldn\'t wait to ask her how she slept.  Sure enough, she said it was the best night\'s sleep she\'s had in months.Well worth the $50.00!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: So helpful to get comfortable at night! Must get for pregnant women! I hesitated to get one but not regretting the decision.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I looked at many different pregnancy pillows over the internet which was my first mistake. What I should have done was find a store to buy one so that I could see the pillow in real life before buying it. The reason I jumped at buying this particular pillow was due to all the great reviews I was reading and I really needed something to alleviate the hip pain I was having.I wrapped my legs around the bottom part for sleeping like it\'s suggested and by the time I woke up in the morning my knees were sore from having the pillow there due to the firmness of the pillow. If it was softer and flatter it might have worked. I also don\'t like the way the part where you put your head is so curved and awkward. Another negative aspect is the pillow doesn\'t support a baby bump at all because it is so firm and too tall to fit under my stomach. The pillow itself is also too long for me. I am 5\' 4" and weigh 120 so maybe it has something to do with smaller sized women since I read some other low star reviews where that seemed to be an issue so I wouldn\'t recommend it to anyone that is small nor to anyone else for that matter.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow when I was four months pregnant and I\'ve had it for a month now. I really love this pillow and it has made sleeping a lot more comfortable for me, and keeps me on my left side. The best thing about this pillow is that you can put it into different positions to accomodate you. Whether you want to sit up, lay down, or prop your feet up - this pillow works wonders! One reason why I did not give this 5 stars is because there is an inner crease/stiching where the head goes, and sometimes if you lay on that area unknowingly in your sleep, it will cause you some discomfort. Maybe wraping the stitched area with a blanket will help reduce the discomfort if you lay near that area. My husband and I share a queen sized bed, and we have no problem with the size of the pillow. He\'s also able to wrap his arms around me at night as well. Perfect pillow - must get for pregnant women...or none pregnant!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My husband ordered this pillow for me for Valentine\'s Day! I love it, it is so supportive and it keeps me from twisting and turning in the bed. I sleep with it everynight. I just wish they made covers for them that was easy to get off. That would have to be the only downfall.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Prior to getting this pillow (and my wife expecting), she always liked falling asleep resting across me in bed, on her side.  This pillow does a great job replicating that same type of position, with the top of the pillow replacing my chest and the bottom of the pillow replacing my legs.I don\'t really understand the reviews that this pillow is bad if you already sleep on your side?  So far, she loves it.  The only "drawback" is that sometimes in the middle of the night she tries to rearrange herself in bed and gets stuck in the pillow, but that\'s always good for a few laughs (from me, anyway)

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I have been so disappointed with this pillow. I bought it when I was around 4 months pregnant and didn\'t like it at that point. I found it uncomfortable.I thought maybe it would be more effective as my pregnancy progressed. But I can now say at 38 weeks pregnant, it hasn\'t become anymore comfortable.I\'m aware that lots of women find this to be a sleep saver, but I found it to be the opposite.Also note, that it doesn\'t come with a cover, which needs to be purchased separately.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This helped me sleep better for a while but didn\'t do much in the last two weeks of pregnancy. I\'m pretty sure there is nothing you can do at that point----but it really did help in weeks 25-35.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This is my absolutely favorite pregnancy buy. I sleep with it every night and am so uncomfortable without it. It\'s hard to explain why it\'s so good but basically your body just needs more support. It also helps with my pregnancy-related sciatica. Just so worth it.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Fantastic comfort pillow I bought to get me through my twin pregnancy & beyond! Will be assisting breast feeding also.  Great how you can just snuggle up with it & keep your knees apart whilst side sleeping. Haha great contraceptive too ;). Really helping me get some decent sleep.  Have recommended it to a client of mine that has a hip replacement & recurrent back issues.  Love it!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Pregnancy is well...uncomfortable. But this Snoogle pregnancy pillow made sure I got my much needed sleep. I used this pillow up until I went into labor. I used it in various positions dependent upon what I was needing at the time. I\'m petite and found that it supported me nicely. I don\'t really have many negatives to say other than it\'s HUGE (your husband will get over it hehe) and getting a cover on was tricky. I love you Snoogle - until next time!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: bought this pillow for my daughter, took her awhile to figure it out but said later it kept her body in alignment during her later months.was well made and seemed a fair price fromothers on line and in stores. Arrived in new condition just as vendor advertised.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is comfortable and I like all the different ways it can be used but I wish it was a little wider and softer.  I don\'t use it as much as I thought I would but that may change as I grow bigger!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Gentlemen, if you want to ensure tranquility both at night while you and your wife sleep, and then again the following day because you are both rested; this pillow is a pregnancy miracle.  My wife sleeps soundly through the night, subsequently so do I.  A must have during pregnancy and also saves money on other nursing pillows, because it is better in our opinion than the other nursing pillows we tried.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: the Snoogle pillow has defiitely improved my sleep quality during my second pregnancy.  it hasnt completely eliminated my back pain, but it has helped my shoulder pain from sleeping on my side.  product arrived extremely fast!  thank you!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I never used a body pillow before I was pregnant, but now I don\'t know if I could sleep well without my Snoogle! It supports the back, knees, and growing belly so that you never feel like you\'re sinking into your mattress. Firm but soft, the pillow retains its shape and doesn\'t need fluffing to maintain its supportive function. I also purchased a colored cover for my Snoogle, which washes well and makes it much softer to sleep with than the cover that comes on it. I have recommended the Snoogle to many of my friends. Worth every penny!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My back was killing me so my husband went out and bought this pillow for me! It is amazing! The pressure in my back is relieved when I go to bed with my Snoogle : ) It is large in the bed but worth it! The only thing I would like to see improved is the outside cover- it could be softer. I fixed this by putting a pillow case over the part I rest my head on.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This is my very first time ever writing a review for anything! I am very happy with purchasing this pillow. It not only makes me sleep like a baby every single night but it is so comfortable. I actually like it better than my Tempurpedic pillow. When I\'m not using it I always catch my fiance using it and he explains it as being the best thing ever made! I bought a few body pillows but its not the same.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I received it very promptly but I really have not had a chance to use it yet as my situation has changed. I hope to be able to use it very soon.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My wife loved this pillow during her pregnancy and got so used to sleeping with it that she still uses it today.  As a bonus, we use this as a "speed bump"/"wall" for the baby when he snoozes on our bed.  The pillow cover is easier to remove, wash, and put back on than it looks.  We recommend it to anyone who is preggers and would like a comfortable sleeping experience!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this pillow while I was in my first trimester and I am now in my third and still sleeping like a baby! Definitely a must have for the expecting mom!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is heaven for me in my pregnancy. Its narrowness gives room for my growing belly and it is plenty long so that I have pillow whatever position I sleep in. Highly recommended. It\'s not 5 stars because the case is so hard to put back on.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My wife loves her Snoogle!  She has been sleeping much more comfortably with it.  She is now 19 weeks and we have had it for about 4 weeks.  It was a great decision, we highly recommend it to others!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I know there\'s been many, many reviews about this pillow but I\'m adding mine anyway! I\'ve been debating on buying it for awhile since it\'s a substantial purchase for a pillow, but after having 2 babies already and dealing with the discomfort, I finally decided to splurge. I\'m about to enter my third trimester with my 3rd baby and have only recently been having lots of back and hip pain. I had no trouble getting comfortable at night, but would wake up exhausted, stiff, and sore from the ways I slept. I went and bought this pillow yesterday and while it took me a little while to get situated with it, once I did, I was in heaven. Several reviews I read complained about it being too big...well both my husband and I are larger people and we have a queen size bed and it didn\'t bother us at all. In fact, my husband kept commenting on how comfortable I looked :-) My ONLY 2 complaints are that the fabric is cheap feeling and itchy, and it is too long for me. I\'m 5\'3 and I kept having to shift it back up between my legs or shift it back down under my neck. I do normally move a lot at night, but I just took care of this by switching the side the pillow was on every time I got up to use the bathroom.Overall, after one night with this pillow, I\'m very satisfied. I only deducted a star because of the cost and quality.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: It has already helped her and will do more even so as it becomes more difficult to sleep during pregnancy

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I luv it. It\'s comfortable and pillow is a little stiff but I don\'t mind it. It does take a lot of space. I luv that it wraps around you perfect on your back and legs.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I\'ve slept with this pillow every night since I got it.  I\'m in my 2nd trimester, and it\'s so helpful and makes getting comfortable at night so easy.  It does take up a lot of room on the bed.  My husband and I have a queen size bed, and there\'s just enough room.  We\'re talking about taking a trip to visit family before the baby comes, and I\'m not sure how I\'ll manage to sleep without this pillow for a week while we\'re gone.  It\'s that awesome.  I highly recommend it.One nice bonus is that it comes with a diagram that shows you all the configurations you can make with the pillow.  You can use it for more than just sleeping, for example, using it as a prop to help make it more comfortable to sit up in bed, which I\'ve done several times.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: my husband and i had a hard time paying 50 dollars for a pillow, but i couldn\'t be more happier that we did.  i\'m able to sleep at night and the pillow is unbelievably comfortable.  before we bought it, i was using about 7 pillows at night just to get to sleep... now i use the snoogle along with one regular pillow and wow.  the only complaint that i did have was the cover started \'bumping\' up because of the material and it was becoming a problem on my skin... but then i found out that there are snoogle covers, and when i bought that all my problems with the pillow were gone.  the cover is 20 dollars.. so all in all you spend about 70 dollars for complete comfort... but to us it was just like giving up a couple nights out to eat away so that i could have some peaceful sleep.. i recommend this pillow to any pregnant woman.. and i\'ll probably continue using it after i have the babies.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My wife loves it. But make sure you buy a colored cover for it, because the white cover will get dirty fast and it wont look nice. The white cover is removable in case you want to wash it, but its not easy to remove it and put it back again.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was not sure about spending so much on a pillow but I am so glad I did. I use it every night and love it"!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I love this pillow. It\'s a little bit on the large size, but I can\'t sleep without it. I have spd and this pillow is the inky thing that allows me to sleep!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I absolutely love this pillow! I have only used it for one night, but I woke up this morning rested and best of all PAIN FREE!! I am 30 weeks pregnant and I have recently been experiencing a lot of hip and back pain. I was using a traditional body pillow with no relief. I love the fact that I can use this pillow in the bed for nursing. I remember with my daughter I had to use about six pillows and the Boppy to feed her comfortably. I feel confident with this pillow I can use it and maybe the Boppy to feed in the bed comfortably. The only complaint I have with this pillow is that I can\'t use my traditional pillow as well, but all in all that\'s not a deal breaker for me. I highly recommend this pillow for moms to be and for breastfeeding/co-sleeping moms.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I ordered the Snoogle at the beginning of my second trimester after fighting with pillows and bolsters for a few months.  I couldn\'t get comfortable and my neck hurt when I tried to sleep on my stomach, as I am a stomach sleeper.  It was very difficult for me to get used to sleeping on my side, but the Snoogle made this MUCH easier.  The pillow does a great job of keeping your spine and neck in line all night.  My husband and I have a queen sized bed and it doesn\'t take up as much room as I thought it would by reading other reviews.  I keep the full side on the outside of the bed, and the not enclosed side on the inside so I can still reach out for my hubby if I want to.  I love this pillow!  It makes side sleeping very comfortable, and it\'s easy to roll over too, as you just unhook your foot that\'s under the pillow, roll, and rehook the opposite foot so it\'s now under the pillow.  It took me a couple nights to get this down, but now I can do it without really waking up. I can also lay on my belly with this pillow, as the height of the pillow keeps my body up off the bed enough to give the belly some room...it\'s pretty great.  Not sure if this comfort will last as I get bigger (I\'m not very big yet, first baby), but for now, it\'s great!Another thing that I have to disagree with is the difficulty in taking off and putting back on the pillow cover.  I took mine off to wash it (no sweat) and put it back on in literally 2 minutes.  You just have to scrunch it up like a sock and work it onto the pillow a little at a time.  Have patience ladies, it really isn\'t difficult.  I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking to get a comfortable night sleep.  I\'m now 20 weeks pregnant, have had the pillow for over a month now, and it is as great as the first day I laid down on it.  I look forward to getting into bed at night.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I love this pillow.  I used it from my first trimester until my son was seven and just got another one.  I never wake with back pain; which I did prior to pregnancy.I also shaped it like a donut and put my baby in the "hole" when he was very little.  We shared a bed and it was ideal for nursing in bed.There are so many wonderful things about it - except the pillow case is hard to get on and off.  Other than that worth every penny!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I love this pillow. I am 5 months pregnancy and this is helping me with my lower back pain.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was in need of ANYTHING that would help my sleep.  I was a back sleeper, and knew that i needed to change my sleeping position.  It took me a couple weeks of trying out this body pillow, and I finally found my most comfy spot.  Now I don\'t know what I\'d do without it!  (my fav: i still use a normal pillow, so my shoulders actually lay on the top part of the body pillow)

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this for my daughter who was about 20 weeks pregnant, and she was finally able to sleep through the night.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: If it wasn\'t for this pillow I do not know how I would sleep. Highly recommended!!Thank you for saving me.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow last weekend, and it has been amazing! I\'m currently 28 weeks pregnant, and I was actually able to be comfortable and sleep through the night! The only reason why I rated 4 stars is because the fabric 1.is white (gets dirty easier and quicker) 2. Not really soft.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My pregnant girlfriend uses this every night and loves it! I haven\'t heard her complain about her back hurting since.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Nothing is going to make a pregnant woman feel comfortable when sleeping all the time, but this pillow has helped her most of the time. She even mentioned using it after her pregnancy. We even took this on vacation and yes it does take up a lot of suitcase space. It just works. Simply, this is a great gift and she will really appreciate it throughout the pregnancy. It might get you out of the so-called "push" present too!!!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I have been able to get my first night\'s COMFORTABLE sleep in MONTHS thanks to this pillow.  There are so many configurations, which is necessary depending on how the baby is positioned inside my belly, how big/swollen I am that day, and what aches I am experiencing.  I was hesitant to buy this pillow at first, but now that I have it, I would pay double if I had to do it all over again.  Love this pillow.  LOVE IT!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Wife loves it

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: the purchase and delivery went excellent.  it was a gift for my daughter-in-law and she loves it.  i really don\'t know that much about it being a 64 year old non pregnant male or i would have rated it higher.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I am 29 weeks pregnant and was having trouble getting comfortable in bed, on the couch etc.  This pillow is perfect for me!  I am 5\'0 and find that it wraps around my body perfectly!  It comes with a chart that shows you different ways of using it.  I have rib pains especially when lying down so this pillow really helps with the comfort level.  Highly recommend!!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Love this pillow! I just entered my 2nd trimester and haven\'t "popped" yet but was having a lot if restless nights. The first time I used this I slept the best I have since being pregnant and continue to do so. I strongly recommend this pillow. The filling seems to be pretty stif so it won\'t flatten out in between the knees were I need the most support to be comfortable. As for previous comments about the "rough" texture of the pillow case, I would have to disagree. Mine is pretty soft n I suspect it will get softer w more washes

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: No problems with the quality of the pillow or the pillow case.I haven\'t tried any other body pillows, so I can\'t compare, but it seems to help. Early in my first trimester, I started getting severe knee and hip pain at night. I still have some, but sleeping with the body pillow seems to help. I think the important thing in avoiding the hip pain is to keep my whole upper leg on the body pillow, so it isn\'t angling downward - at least I hope this will help.The pillow comes with a pillow case. Its a bit hard to get it on and off for washing, but I\'m not sure how it could be improved -  it\'s a snake shaped pillow - a zipper or snaps would make it easier to get on and off, but would probably be uncomfortable or wouldn\'t completely cover the pillow.Edit: I liked this pillow at first, but before the end of the second trimester it was very flat. Washing it didn\'t plump it up enough. I ended up using two normal pillows as body pillows - one between my knees and one to hug. Save your money

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: With many various aches and pains to put up with during pregnancy this pillow made a huge difference for me in being able to get comfortable and get some sleep. I would highly recommend it, although there are pros and cons. Pros: shaped pillow segment that fits between the knees really helps to relieve hip pressure and pelvic pain, leaning on back portion of the pillow provides some relief from sleeping on the sides while preventing you from being all the way on your back (especially helpful in 3rd trimester), pillow cover is machine washable. Cons: need to wake up and adjust the pillow every time switch sides, depending on pillow position in bed may need to move it out of the way (it\'s big!) when get up from the bed. Still totally worth having it though!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My husband surprised me with this pillow after several sleepless nights of my tossing and turning! I just couldn\'t get comfortable sleeping on my side and my lower back was killing me. Since sleeping with the Snoogle, I\'ve been MUCH happier!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Very comfy.. You should buy when u r expecting ... i bought it for my wife..She was having a lot of trouble getting comfortable and sleeping through the night about 20 weeks into my pregnancy. She tried everything, proping a pillow between my knees, one under my side, etc...I was so uncomfortable. I finally decided to break down and spend the money on this pillow and I can\'t begin to tell you how much it has helped. She love the fact that it wraps around my back and come between my legs and also under my head all at the same time. Yes, the reviews about the pillow flattening out are true but I just fluff mine back up. There were also complaints about when you want to flip over on your other side, it\'s hard to adjust the pillow. She just flip her body over and don\'t move the pillow. It\'s just as comfortable. It does take up a lot of room in the bed but She can\'t stress that a good night sleep is so worth it for a pregnant lady. I think this is a must have during pregnancy. It also helps when you have back pain...

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I love, love, love, this pillow! I was like a lot of other people on here that didn\'t want to spend the money for this pillow, but after reading so many people\'s great reviews, I gave in and bought it. I\'m so glad I did!! I wasn\'t sure about it after the first night, but I decided not to give up on it. After a couple nights of using it, my husband and I went out of town and I didn\'t take my pillow because I didn\'t want to deal with the hassle of traveling with it. Well, I regretted not taking it because I had 2 awful nights without it.When I came home to it last night, I snuggled right in it and I slept like a baby! I was a little skeptical at first, but now I\'m a believer and a lover of this awesome pillow!! :-) Great buy!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: She loves itI no longer get my ears worn out with how horrible it is to be pregnant and trying to sleep (I used to get this when I was trying to sleep too....)She\'s happy - My ears are happy - I\'m happyJust buy it for gods sake...:) ladies we love you all really

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow when I was 16 weeks pregnant because I was having a hard time getting comfortable at night. I loved it from day one and was always finding new ways to arrange it in order to get comfortable at night. I did not use it all the time but as my body changed throughout my pregnancy I would drag it back out and use it for as long as I needed it. There are an infinate number of positions you can use it in and I would encourage any user to experiment in order to get the support they need. I even took it to the hospital with me to use during the postpartum period. My husband loves it too and uses it any time that I don\'t.One of the best (and most long lasting uses) is for breastfeeding. I keep it on the couch and simply wrap it around my waist on which ever side I am going to feed on. I have a Boppy and a Breast Friend but this seems to be my favorite nursing pillow because I dont have to put the baby down to get it into position. I simply grab a free end and wrap it around either the front of me or the back, depending on how I am sitting. My son is only 2 1/2 months old and weighs 16 lbs so having this pillow be so large and supportive is a huge plus. It\'s even great for his occasional bottle feedings and also for times when we are just relaxing in bed and I need somewhere to prop him up on. He seems so comfy when laying against it.All in all, it was well worth the money it cost. You don\'t even have to invest in a pillow case for it if you dont want to because it comes with a removable, washable cover. I would def buy it again!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: A must have for sure!! Sleeping was getting extremely uncomfortable, but this has made sleeping much more enjoyable. I just wish it came in other colors. I had to order another pillow case for it because everything sticks and shows up on white!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My sister generously gave me this pillow as an early birthday present. Thank goodness! It alleviated both my back pain and leg cramps. I am now able to sleep through the night. There are several ways to use the pillow, so it is very accomodating to my tendency to change positions. Im sure it will also be helpful when nursing the baby. Though I agree with the other reviews that the price is high, its worth its weight in gold!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: It was definitely more comfortable sleeping with this pillow than without once I went into the 2nd trimester.  However, I still haven\'t quite mastered getting myself untangled from it when I have to get up in the middle of the night to use the restroom.  It\'s like a big snake wrapped around me.  Lol.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: The snoogle has really helped me stay on my left side at night during pregnancy.  It is huge, so your partner will have less room in bed than before.  Every night I have to wrestle my cat out of the loosely curved part of it so I can enjoy it also.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was very excited when the product arrived, and pleased that it came with a removable cover so I didn\'t have to buy one separate to wash.  The positioning of the pillow DOES make it more comfortable to sleep...some of the time.  I did like the "curl" around the top, and that I could position part of the pillow between my knees, the filling is really not all that comfortable though (I am used to sleeping on a memory foam pillow).  I went from using a blanket at night, to just covering myself with a sheet because I would heat up quickly with this pillow around me.  Whenever I wanted to roll to another side, it became quite a chore to move the entire pillow around my body while changing my position.  Some nights I would kick it out of bed before morning rather than struggle with moving it.It\'s great if you need extra heat and don\'t move a lot when you\'re sleeping.  I think the filling should be a little better quality for the price they\'re charging though.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This is a purchase I made at about 5 months in my pregnancy when I was having bad hip, pelvic and back pain, the pain only got worse as I got bigger and this pillow was a life saver.  I even turned it onto itself to make a great lumbar pillow for the car when we had to travel.  I would have rated it 5 out of 5 if it wasn\'t for the sandpaper like cover that is included, it is really cheap and even tore in one of the curves.  I have washed it a couple of times and just hang to dry, it goes right back on, but it is still stiff and scratchy.  Overall worth the fifty dollars.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was a little skeptical about purchasing this because it was almost $40.00, but I am sooo glad I did! I\'m about 6 months pregnant and sleeping is becoming very difficult. This pillow is awesome, it helped my back and leg aches so that i could get comfortable and sleep better. It is a little large, but it\'s worth it for the comfort level you get from it! The only complaint is that i wish it came in black, because the covers for it are so expensive, other than that...go ahead and splurge ladies, you won\'t regret it....I had to add to my last review I left in July. I had my baby in October, and this pillow has doubled as a breastfeeding pillow! I didn\'t have to buy a boppy like all my other friends did! I just wrap this around me when I\'m ready to feed my son. I can\'t say enough good things about this pillow, worth every single penny and then some!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: If I wasn\'t already happily married, I would be walking down the aisle for the fourth time with this beautiful pillow!  What else can I say. Love it, love it, love it!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I recently got this pillow and I cannot tell you how wonderful it is! I can finally sleep! I\'m 18 weeks, and I\'ve been using 4-5 pillows a night to try and get comfortable. I haven\'t been able to fall asleep on my left side like is recommended; I\'ve been sleeping sitting up and after the first bathroom wake-up I could sleep on my side. With this I was comfortable instantly and fell right asleep. I aslo fell back asleep after getting up to use the restroom right away (which is new!) It is incredibly comfortable, and easy to move around with if you like to flip over. It also comes with a sheet that shows you tons of different ways to use it (more than is shown online!) I adore it!!! Worth every penny! **I\'d like to add, now that my daughter is 7 months old, that I adored that pillow all through my pregnancy, it was a God-send!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I\'ve had this pillow 2 weeks now, that\'s at least a week longer than past pillows have lasted for me.  I have chronic lower back pain that is helped by putting a pillow between my knees.  Unfortunately it seems I squeeze their life out way before their time should be over, including medical grade foam.  But this pillow seems like it will last the long haul.  And when I imagine it will go flat in a year or so, it seems like it will be easy to reinvigorate with additional pillow fill :)  I\'d say well worth the month spent!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I like this pillow for the sole purpose that it is firm and fits between my knees and feet simultaneously.  The cons for me are that when it\'s under a blanket it\'s next to impossible to turn over, turn the pillow over with the two curls (on each end) without disrupting all the sheets and blankets and hubby in bed.  I am a restless sleeper and I switch side to side all night and this was just a pain.  I also have a problem with the curl at my head being too firm, I wake up and my ear is throbbing and numb.  It\'s too big and bulky there to have my own pillow under my head.  Overall the pillow is great quality.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow bc being pregnant, i was not able to get a comfortable night\'s rest especially since my body was changing drastically.  This pillow has many uses either for sleep or for lounging.  It shapes your body to a comfortable position and it rests your belly so you\'re not aching.I not only recommend it for pregnant woman but for those who need a body pillow.  THis is perfect.Cons:It\'s huge.  We have a queen size bed and it takes half the space.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I am the husband that night this crazy little pillow.  It has made all the difference in the world for my wife\'s comfort. Only problem. .. not much room to snuggle when the snoogle is there:(

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: The Leachco body pillow is okay although I cannot compare it to other body pillows. I say just okay b/c it really has not helped me to get comfortable in bed as I progress through my pregnancy. I wish it were fluffier and the cover that comes with it was not as "rough" as some reviewers put it. It is helpful to use when hanging out on the couch and when lying down on the couch as well otherwise, I would tell people to go to an actual store and try out pillows for comfort, ect. b/c when you order on line, you are taking a guess...

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I love it, love it, love it!  I roll up part of it behind my back and lay the other part across my belly and I use it to watch TV, play cards, get on the internet...etc.  I sleep with it at night to help alleviate leg and hip pain.  And, when I have my baby in a few months I will be able to breastfeed while laying down by placing the baby on the long part of the pillow and using the curled parts under my head and feet.  This pillow is so multi-purpose, it has become my new best-friend.Only complaint is taking the cover off.  The cover that comes with this pillow is very form fitted and feels nice and smooth against your skin, but it is devishly hard to peel off for cleaning.  Putting it back on is a lot easier though and I know there are other covers you can purchase that may be easier to use.  Otherwise, I am completely happy with this pillow and would recommend it to others (pregnant or not).

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I am usually a stomach sleeper and decided to order this at the beginning of my second trimester. The first night I used it, I slept on my side all night long  and didn\'t toss or turn. I\'m nearing the halfway point of my pregnancy and as my belly has gotten bigger, this pillow still has great support. I\'m so glad I got this pillow. It\'s allowed me to get much needed rest. It also has instructions on different ways to use the pillow which I am starting to do. I highly recommend it!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I really enjoy the pillow, though it does take up the whole bed...finally, a good night of sleep! Made my life better.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: THis pillow is an absolute life saver. Although big, I wouldn\'t trade it for any other pillow or pillows in the world. It can be used several different ways. It is so comfortable and I am so glad I still have mine for my second pregnancy. If not for this pillow, my first pregnancy would have been so miserable laying in bed. I reccomend this pillow to every pregnant woman.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was hesitant to use such an expensive pillow, but my husband bought it for me as a surprise. It is extremely comfortable and helps you lay in positions that are good for pregnancy. Doubles as a good pillow rest while reading in bed. I would definitely recommend this for pregnant women!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This is my first pregnancy, and I was having trouble keeping myself from rolling over on my back when I slept, and it was difficult to get comfortable on my side. The Snoogle has helped me so much, I sleep better, and more comfortable, and it isn\'t so big that my husband is on the couch. I love it!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I am so happy I ordered this product. I am not necessarily sleeping better, because I still have to get up and pee every two hours and am constantly getting beaten up from the inside by this little boy. But when I am in bed and do manage to catch some Zzzz\'s, I am so much more comfortable.I have two complaints, which aren\'t even really complaints because I know they can\'t be remedied:1) Because of the shape of the pillow, the cover is very difficult to get on and off for washing.2) It is hard to turn over from side to side because the pillow is so big and oddly shaped.Again, those are both pretty much unavoidable grievances, because what makes the pillow so great is the odd shape and size. So there you have it! Great for those who can\'t get comfortable in bed! I am SO happy I have mine--I don\'t know if I will go back to my regular pillow after this pregnancy is over!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this for my girlfriend, she was saying her back hurt so I thought this might help, it seems like my kids had more fun with it than she did, but thats mostly because her and I couldnt fit in bed with the pillow as well

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: The pillow is nice and my wife enjoys it, but I have noticed after only a month or two that it is already compressed in some areas. I thought it would have better quality foam. We\'ll be lucky if this pillow lasts through the entire pregnancy.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is locked on.  I got it at my wifes request.  She is 5 months pregnant and had been having trouble sleeping.  She can now get comfortable and stay comfortable allowing her to sleep through the night, besides bathroom trips.  After she left bed I tried it in the morning and was equally as pleased.  Now we arm wrestle for it at night.  We both sleep in a queen size bed and it really doesnt take up too much room.  The quality is good and so is the material.  Get one Devil Dog!  Oorah!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I love this pillow, I normally sleep on my back or my stomach, but my doctor wants me to sleep on my left side. In the begining I just could not get comfortable on my side and kept ending up on my back. At 6 months I bought this pillow from babies r us. I sleep with the long part supporting my back, since I\'m short I can pull the bottom between my legs and put it under my belly for support. I find it very comfortable, it stops me from rolling over, and supports me where I need it. I also must add that this pillow does have a case on it, its a little hard to figure out how to get it on and off but its definitely there, I wash it all the time. I am now 34 weeks pregnate, and could not sleep without this pillow!!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This is the best body pillow ever for pregnant women!  I haven\'t had any trouble sleeping througout my pregnancy, and I\'m convinced it\'s because of the Snoogle.  It provides just the right support.  It is pretty large and takes up quite a bit of bed space, so it may not work for those with a small bed.  It can also make it difficult to get out of bed if you place long side of the Snoogle against the outside edge of the bed.  But if you can spare the space and are willing to work a little harder to get out of the bed in exchange for hours of quality sleep, I\'d definitely recommend this pillow!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Great pillow and can be used/maneuvered into so many different ways.  Only problem is it does not come with a pillow cover.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I used 5 pillows before, 2 for my head to be elevated, below my bottom, between my legs to relieve SI related pain and last below my belly to prevent cramping of the abdominal muscles in sideline. Now I just use one and havent slept better. I have been using it for the past 2 weeks since week 20.PROSAble to use it in several different ways to:LYING DOWNWear it with Long side on my back in sideline and it supports my entire back and stabilises SI joint instability relieving related pain, the section goes between your legs and it helps with SI instability and pain, it curves under stomach and supports it relieving the cramps on my ab muscles.Roll with it between your legs and it is more comfortableI have tucked under my hip bones when lying on stomachHead is elevated enough to prevent refluxSITTING UPUse it on soft couches that cause SI instability and painDecrease seat depth in couches and helped me sit uprightCONSWhen you roll depending on where it works best for you, you have to reposition. Yes it woke me up but i went right back to sleep.It takes a couple of nights of playing around with it to figure what works best for you. My sheets would get tangled up, back position worked better for me during my second trimester etc But once you have got it down, its such a relief!I dont know if the cover is cotton, but it got a lil hot for me, i just cover the exposed potion with my sheet and im fine.I might have to stitch a spare cotton cover that goes over it that is less complicated to put on.It took me 2 days of interrupted sleep because of pain especially while rolling to invest in this. But its been worth the money. Sleep deprivation during pregnancy is just a trigger for everything else, its bad enough you have to wake up to pee. Havent slept better.I am 5\'4, my friend who is 6\'1 recommended it to me, so it works for different heights as well. Definitely give it a shot.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I had the misfortune of breaking my sternum at ~ 7 months pregnancy.  After the break I found that moving the one pillow I was using to support my leg when I layed on my side was too hard for me so I tried sleeping with 3 pillows but that too was too hard since the pillows moved and yanking them into place was hard.  So I bought this pillow and found how miraculous it is to have a pillow that is in place and only *I* have to move in its center.  I find it comfortable for supporting my legs and my top arm (that top arm being supported is critical for comfort with a broken sternum) when sleeping on my sides.  I also sometimes use it for modified back sleeping with the bottom loop under my knees and one side propped under one side of my back.  The one draw-back is that the head rest part is not always the right height but I don\'t know how they would/could fix that.  I think this pillow could be useful for non-pregnant patients with broken sternums as it helps make the 3 available sleeping positions (back and two sides) more comfortable.  Also note that this pillow comes with a white pillow case so you don\'t necessarily need another one.  I put a king-size cotton pillow case on it where my head rests and wash that part more frequently than the regular one.  (Plus the regular one seems to be polyster so it doesn\'t breathe as well as my cotton one.)

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is wonderful. I only gave 4 stars due to the horrible texture and design of the pillow cover. The pillow itself is great. I was worried that it would not work for me as I am almost 6 feet tall but it works perfectly. I am usually a tummy sleeper and I got this to help with side sleeping during pregnancy. It really cradles my entire body and I have no need for other pillows while sleeping. It is also great for sitting up in bed, it is a great investment. I am hesitant to buy replacement covers from the manufacture because the one it came with (white/cream cover) is truly not quality. The material is rough and cheap feeling.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Hubby bought this for me. I\'m 27 weeks pregnant and its the best thing he could have bought for me.. I use it almost daily, not to sleep at night though because I toss and turn way to much. But I use it to prop myself up during the day or when I take my naps. I haven\'t had any back aches since i stared using it and it also helps with my acid. All in all totally worth it!!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this for my first pregnancy and now I\'m using it for round 2.
