There are both pros and cons to this product.ProsProvides support between knees and under belly.Easy to figure out how to use.Full length back support.ConsPriceyBulky and cumbersome-we have a Queen sized bed and this thing takes up the space of an average(130-160lbs)person.The fabric feels a bit itchy-especially the portion of the pillow that wraps under the head and touches a persons face.Overall, I use a combination of this pillow and 2 regular bed pillows every night.  I\'m currently 31wks along and have suffered from pinched/herniated discs in my spine prior to pregnancy, so I deal with pain daily & nightly-just the pain level varies.  Some nights this pillow is the only way I can get any rest-other nights this pillow is too awkward to manipulate and use so I rely on my regular pillows.  If you\'re not getting sleep, it\'s worth a try but if you are sleeping ok save your money-this product had little use for me after I delivered my first child and I\'m assuming it will return to the back of the closet after this pregnancy too.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I notice my sleep quality is a lot better than regular pillows that I am able to sleep through the night because I have the long part of the pillow wedged against my back so I don\'t turn over in my sleep in the middle of hte night because I can\'t sleep on my back. I have a really bad back that if I do sleep on my side for a prolong period of time, it starts to ache but with the snoogle I can sleep on an angle so there is no pressure directly on my side! What a blessing this pillow has been which affect the quality of my day since I\'m getting better sleep

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: If you are pregnant, heck, even if you\'re not, I would recommend buying this pillow. It saved my back, my knees, and my hips during my entire pregnancy. I used it everyday and still do! SUPER HIGHLY recommended....

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My pregnant wife loves this pillow and when she\'s not using it so do I.  This was a great purchase.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I\'ve used this on my bed, sofa couch, and even on my hammock! It really supports the body. I hate flat pillows when I\'m lying down reading because I end up straining my neck but the Leachco somehow always seems to wrap me into a little cuddle position while supporting my neck, head, and even arms depending on how you position it. It\'s even good for slight foot elevation. My dad had back problems and we got it for him when he came to visit for a week and he actually walked out after a first night\'s sleep and told us how great this pillow was. I wish there was a way he could pack it in a suitcase with him instead of a carry on. It\'s huge. But that just means I get to keep it. (:

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Bought this pillow after fighting with 3-4 different pillows each night.  Had a hard time with the head piece.  It was too thick because I like a flat pillow.  But, I kept flattening it down. Loved the flexible bottom part. I\'m 5\'7" and had no trouble with the length.  It was perfect to fit under my stomach when I got bigger.  It takes up less space in the bed and my husband can cuddle up with me and the pillow from behind.  Wouled recommend looking at other sites to find the cheapest version. Got mine on sale for about $...  Make sure it comes with the pillow case!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was not sleeping for a couple of months in my pregnancy because I could not get comfortable. I ordered this pillow and it has made a world of difference! I am normally a back and stomach sleeper but as I quickly got large since I am carrying twins, I had to change positions sooner. I wish I woud have ordered this as soon as I found out I was pregnant. I love it and would recommend to anyone pregnant, especially those who normally sleep on stomachs and backs.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: After receiving the Snoogle, I have had the best sleep of my pregnancy. I recommend to anyone who is pregnant- or anyone looking to make a pregnant loved one happy. I use it in a U-shape- so that I have head and neck support, as well as leg support for sleeping on my sides. It is my favorite Valentine\'s Day present ever!!! I cannot imagine sleeping without it. You can use it in so many ways- and shapes for so many positions. I look forward to using with my newborn baby as well. When we have baby #2- I will use it again for sleeping. It is a great buy!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was a belly sleeper and this pillow has helped me get a good night\'s sleep.  It is so nice that you don\'t have to constantly adjust it through the night as you change position.  So great that I take it along when we travel if I can!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Got this as a prenatal gift for an expecting mom. This is similar to pillows we use at our massage spa as part of a prenatal massage session. They are super comfy and do a great job of supporting every part of your prego friend or wife! Makes for happy pregnant women, so a great buy!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow as a Christmas gift to myself when I was 2 months along, and I am ever so glad that I did.  An extra bonus for me (besides reducing my pillows from 5 to 2) was that it helped relieve my carpal tunnel syndrome in my hands.  When I slept with the opening to my back, it allowed me to keep my hand to forearm straight, thus preventing my hands from going to sleep.  This would wake me up, and every pregnant woman knows that anything allowing you to wake up at least one less time through the night is a godsend.My daughter is now 10 weeks old, and I still use this pillow with feedings and to relax with.  Therefore, although the price was a little high, I am determined to get my money\'s worth by using it as much as I can.The pillow cover was not quite as soft as it could be, and was a little difficult to put back on after washing.  However, this did not keep me from recommending this item to my pregnant friends. After 11 months of everyday use and several washings, my pillow is just as firm as when I first bought it.I feel the manufacturer would sell even more of these if they would use a higher thread count on the cover, and lower the price.  My obstetrician said she would recommend this to her other patients after I told her about it.  Most importantly, it does help you to sleep more comfortably, and the earlier in the pregnancy you get it, the better.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: A huge and supportive pregnancy pillow, supports the whole body, very soft, comes with a white removable and washable pillow cover

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Since undergoing numerous surgeries for breast cancer reconstruction, it becomes difficult to sleep only on my back.  Now, I can get a 45 degree angle against my back plus have the pillow under my knees...and it doesn\'t move like regular pillows!  Love it!  Now my 11 yr old want to use it to read!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Gave as a gift to a friend in my office who is 2 months pregnant.  She says she absolutely loves it!!  She has complimented it a few times to me. Says it is very comfortable and helps her sleep.  She used to have insomnia but between being pregnant and the pillow she now sleeps well.  To put it in her words:  IT\'S AWESOME!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I learned from our first pregnancy that my wife kept complaining about her sleep. So I decided to buy her this pillow. She loved it. We purchased it with the green cover. First couple of nights she said were uncomfortable,,,but now she wont sleep without it.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This worked well for my pregnancy and I didn\'t mind it breaking down over time.  Now that I am no longer pregnant I actually DO mind that it broke down.  So it is okay, and worth it while you are pregnant, but it isn\'t really for a daily use multi-year or multi-pregnancy pillow.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Really great pillow, I suffer from chronic back pain and sleeping was always a challenge, could never get comfortable.  But this pillow really helps, I should give it 5 stars but the pillow case is difficult to pull on and off...but how I sleep really makes up for that one annoying thing.I would recommend for people (even non-pregnant ones) that it does helps.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was so excited to receive this pillow, as I\'m 7 months pregnant and finally showing and not really able to sleep on my stomach anymore. It is comfy and full, and I didn\'t find the included pillow case itchy as many other reviews said, but I also don\'t see why it\'s SO fabulous. I like that it goes between my legs and I use the top part as a pillow, and yes, it\'s comfy, but seems quite large for something that basically only helps between my knees. I can\'t figure out how the long side could possibly provide back support. I\'ve tried re-positioning many ways, but after about 60 seconds it\'s no longer even touching my back, it\'s just a long large pillow which lies behind my back (or in front of me but not supporting my belly either and takes up sooo much room in the bed. Wondering if maybe a U-shaped pillow would provide more support? It\'s expensive to simply be a pillow between my knees and my head, as I have regular pillows for my head.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I was nervous to buy this pillow because it is large and a little pricey, but am very glad I did. It takes up a lot of room, but overall makes sleeping easier at 5 months pregnant and I imagine will make the next 4 months much easier. My only complaint is that the cover/case is difficult to remove and even more difficult to put back on. It took me 8 minutes to get back on and was pretty frustrating. Another reviewer made the suggestion of putting a regular pillowcase over the "head" of the pillow to avoid having to change the original case as often. I would definitely recommend this!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: It\'s the best thing ever. I have look for the right pillow for the past 18 years. Due to nerve damage in legs. And this one is perfect.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is a must for pregnancy.  It also can be positioned to use while sitting up among other positions.  Don\'t buy the basic one because the cover is scratchy.  I should\'ve paid more for the knit cover.  The basic works as long as you put a pillow case on both ends.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Like most pregnant women as my pregnancy progressed, I was experiencing issues with getting comfortable in the bed. A friend told me about the Snoogle pillow, so I decided to purchase the item to see if it really provides me with the comfort I need while in the bed. As described, the pillow provides the support I needed and now I can sleep through the night with the comfort needed for a restful sleep. The pillow is flexible. It allows you to put it into different a position which adds to the comfort level. I love the removable/washable pillow cover. Would highly recommend this pillow.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Not a side sleeper at all but had to make adjustments during pregnancy.  I really liked how this pillow can be used in multiple ways.  The only down side is how much room it takes up in the bed.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this for my girlfriend for Christmas. She is 22 weeks pregnant and wanted one. She loves it. Defiantly helps her sleep better at night.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Excellent product, I purchased this for my wife who\'s 3 months pregnant she absolutely loves it.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I am so glad I bought this early during my 1st trimester. This pillow is genius. I highly recommend it for all those expecting.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: It can be very comfortable, but it took me a minute to get used to using it, especially when it came to my back and head. Now my newborn sleeps on it. It is great as a body and boppy pillow, so it has a lot of different uses. I do not regret buying this product. It was delivered pretty quickly as well.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Worth every penny and better than using 5 pillows to get comfortable! Never thought I would buy something like this but it helps with back/hip pain.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This pillow is not really what I expected.  I\'m only 17 weeks so maybe I just have to wait until I\'m a little further along to really get any benefit out of it.  The part on the top left of the pillow, where the seam is, gets SO tight and cuts into my neck which is super uncomfortable.  I\'m a side sleeper anyway, so this really does me no good.  For now, it\'s in my closet.  Not worth the money I say, but to each their own.  Hopefully I\'ll be able to use it when my belly gets bigger.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: This has been a life saver during pregnancy. The pillow can be used several ways which is great. I like to fold it in half and use it to prop myself up a bit when sleeping because I have trouble with acid reflux.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I couldn\'t be happier with my Snoogle. I have been using it nightly for about three weeks, and I am not sure I could sleep without it now. It\'s great for supporting my head/neck, belly, and knees. I love that it is so compatible, and was surprised to see all the ways it could be used. My only complaint is the cover. If you are planning on purchasing, go ahead and buy the jersey full zip cover. Trying to remove the cover for washing is very tedious.. and putting it back on (even without drying) is even worse. The jersey cover washes great and goes on and off much easier.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I\'m not pregnant, but I have a beer gut that might as well be a fetus.  This pillow replaces all the other pillows I used to sleep with.  It works great, providing support for my beer gut while I sleep so my fat doesn\'t compress my lungs when I lay on my side.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I got this for my wife who is pregnant with twins and she loves this thing. And I borrow it from time to time too.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I am pregnant with twins and been having pretty bad back and hip pain (had a weak back before preg) every morning that I wake up, so we ordered the Snoogle pillow.  The first night that I slept with it, I think I slept through the whole night and woke up the next morning with absolutely no back or hip pain/soreness.  I was hesitant at first as to how a pillow could make me feel better but it absolutely did.  I would highly recommend this to anyone who is on the fence about which pillow to get.  I love my Snoogle!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: My fiance loves this pillow.  She won\'t even let me lay on it. lol.  She uses it in every position and it helps her sleep better at night since she has been pregnant.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: It\'s really big. For second trimester, I didn\'t find it very helpful. Now I am in my 3rd trimester, I got better use out of it to support my back and belly.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow for my daughter who is expecting her first child and was having trouble getting comfortable which caused sleep problems. After she started using this pillow, she sleeps comfortably and told me it was awesome and she sleeps so good now.  I would highly recommend this product to anybody who is pregnant. However, the company does also say it is good for people with other problems as well and it can be used after pregnancy too. Well worth the money!!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: the pillow cover\'s material is a bit on the rough side so we had to wash it well to soft it. before we washed it, it would irritate my wife\'s skin.

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: Description of this product states that it can support whole body front and back which I dont find to be true I still have to use another pillow to my back Having said that I do like this pillow as it does give me a head pillow stomach pillow and pillow btw legs and feet all in one which is alot better than fighting with 3 different pillows(4 if you count back pillow) all night

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I am a little smaller than 5 Feet tall, it looks a little long for me, but it fits perfectly.  I have friends that\'s 6 feet tall and they are satisfied as well, it is one size fits all!Very comfortable, I can see myself hugging it without the big belly too!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I am really enjoying the snoogle.  It has helped me get comfortable enough to sleep better.  When I am not fighting my kitties for it, I actually get a good night\'s rest.  I would just warn people that once they are comfortable in their snoogle, it makes it a hazard to get out of for all those night bathroom trips.  My only other suggestion would be that the stuffing be fuller.  After a while, the snoogle gets a little flattened, so you have to fluff it.  Otherwise, I love it!

name: Leachco Snoogle Total Body Pillow
review: I bought this pillow for my wife at the start of her fourth pregnancy. She had been sleeping with numerous standard pillows and tossed and turned all night. She tells me often that this pillow makes a world of difference and provides much better support.My kids love using it for watching movies, too! The large size of the pillow makes it perfect for lounging around.I highly recommend this pillow to anyone who currently uses or is looking at purchasing a body pillow.

name: Take-Out Baby Bibs - Cute As A.
review: best bibs hands down - the bug series is a bit "icky", but this is the very best bib

name: Take-Out Baby Bibs - Moo Baby
review: There is simply no better bib.  I don\'t understand what problem the other reviewer had; she didn\'t say.  She only advertised another brand...Bumkins are absolutely the best.  Soft, generously sized, non-staining, easy to clean and quick drying!

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Girls Styles
review: I\'ve had these bibs for about a month now and they have held up really well so far.  There is a good selection of color and designs in the set, and they have not stained like similar bibs have.  Also they are not hard like some of the plastic/vinyl bibs can be.  I\'ve been throwing them in both my washer and dryer and they have survived just fine, including the velcro which is sticking just as strong as it did the first day they arrived.  My only complaint is that they are a bit expensive for a pack of bibs.  They are very good bibs, but I still think they are a little overpriced.

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Boys Styles
review: my mother bought me these bibs, and now i buy them for everyone i know with a baby.  they have easy velcro attachments and a pocket to catch drippings.  but the best feature is that they wipe off easily.  i just wash them off while doing dishes.  they also last a long time and travel well.  i have not used ANY of the cloth bibs i had, since i have these now.  I ABSOLUTELY SWEAR BY THEM!

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Boys Styles
review: I love these bibs -- and they are PVC free, which is the primary reason I got them (PVC can cause cancer, and because kids chew on their bibs a lot, many countries have banned PVC in baby products -- I don\'t know if I am overly-concerned about this right now, but since it is just as easy to buy PVC free, why not?)I have seen these bibs in other places for much more money, so they are a bargain here at amazon.  They work very well, wash well, and look great.

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Boys Styles
review: My son is almost 2, and these bibs STILL look as good as new! While he doesn\'t wear them as often as he used to (he\'s getting neater) HE likes the fact that the pocket will catch his runaway peas and dropped peaches.  They are not at all stiff, wash beautifully in the washer and can be rinsed off easily in the sink. We store them on the bar on the back of his high chair, and they are easily in reach.Three of the patterns shown are different from what we have, so I will happily be buying more for baby #2, on soon on the way!

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Boys Styles
review: These bibs are great.  Not only are they cute, but they sure make clean up a lot faster!

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Boys Styles
review: I really like the designs on these bibs, but some of the velcro doesn\'t stay as well as it should for being new. My son can pull them right off.

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Boys Styles
review: We have all sorts of bibs for our 10 month old and these bibs are the most functional and durable ever.  We use both sides of the bibs; the outside, which is an awesome water proof surface that is durable and not stiff like other water proof bibs, and the inside, which has some absorbance if our son is practicing drinking from a cup and making a mess - we just flip the pocket inside out, too, to catch the overflow.  These bibs have been washed and dried them at least 100 times now and they have withstood the test!  Highly recommended.

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Boys Styles
review: My twins will soon be 10 months old (next wednsday, the 29th) and have been gradually making more messes, so we found ourselves in a pickle.First of all the bad about those "cloth, cute" bibs...* They are too small, even the larger ones are too small.* They dont have any pocket to "catch" runaway food.* They arent waterproof, but thin and absorb anything right through to the clothing on your baby!* They dont wash well, even in the machine they stain and become too annoying to use* And finnaly they are difficult for ME to remove (buttons on the back, usually)So along with 7 of these bibs, and the occasional package of bibsters (disposible bibs, which by the way are excellent for travel!) we have solved our problems.Now for all of the opposites that make this bib, better than the cloth ones...* They are large enough to cover up to my twins lap, so they will fit almost any baby-toddler that can feed themselves (meaning not for use with a soley nursing child) gaurenteed.* These bibs have a fairly large pocket to catch food, and occasionally the small drink spills... One note though, you should pull it open before using, we store ours in a cabinet, and afterwords the pocket is "closed", if you forget to open it up it wont catch much* The bibs are waterproof on the side with the pictures. They are easy to wipe up, and they makesure that the clothing underneath them doesnt get wet.* These bibs wash SO WELL in the machine, we use it with cold water, and even throw them in the machine! They dont fade, crack, or start getting "bubbles" under the "vinyl" (not sure of the material) as other bibs like it* I can easily remove the bibs thanks to a generous placement of velcro. The boys are yet to pull them off, since the part behind the neck means that the velcro attatches near the back of the shoulder instead of the back of the neck. I can take them off with the boys leaning back (dont have to manuver around their head) and if the boys tug it doesnt give way. Although the velcro will become "worn" after a few washings and become "fuzzy". This doesnt take away from their performace, but I dont know if they will last for more than two kids :)Well other than beating the cloth bibs in that aspect, heres a few other reasons why these bibs are the only way to go...* They are somewhat reversable. If I turn the around and flip the pocket so its exposed again, I am shown a side with a better "skid proof" material, and one that will slow down small spills and chunks of spagetti sauce.* They are PVC free (mentioned by the previous reviewer) and after my friend realised her plastic bibs HAD PVC, she imediatly threw them out and bought these bibs. Its hard to tell if a bib does contain PVC, so I am glad I am "safe" knowing that these bibs dont.* The patterns are really adorable, and I am always questioned at restaurants and being asked where I got them. My sons actually enjoy wearing them because they are so "cool", and I suppose eye-pleasing... which is a big surprize seeing that we can barely keep their diapers on anymore :)* The cloth bibs either have a design that peels off after a few uses, or is sewed on. The sewed on ones are usually very itchy if it touches a baby\'s skin, making it annoying while they are eating with all but a diaper, which my sons REALLY love to do, and which keeps them cleaner... But with these bibs the patter is just, on, cant come off, cant fade, and doesnt irritate them at all, no matter which side is used.* What I love about them is their durability. My sons can crinkle, chew, pull, and wave these around all they like, but they will still hold up. My friends plastic bibs (the one that had PVC) was easily crinkled, and I mean perminantly! Even if folded it would have that crease, even if she stacked DICTIONARYS ontop, not with theseI originally thought that a bib was just that, a bib. But if you want less hassel (EVERY mother/father needs less hassel!) than purchase these... They actually sell cheaper on Amazon than elsewhere, I am currently purchasing more, just to have around :)

name: Fun With Food 5 Pack Bib Set - Boys Styles
review: This bib catches food and juice in the plastic compartment at the bottom of the bib it\'s very colorful which all kids and parents love but its not thick and absorbent enough in my opinion once it gets wet you have to get another bib because no child likes something cold and wet on them.Of course all bibs need to be changed after a while but not soon as your child spits up or makes a mess. I would stick with this bib if it was a little thicker because the colors are great and the designs are exciting on the eye.

name: Munchkin Bottle Drying Rack - 1 ea
review: This is one great bottle rack.  I use the ventaire bottles, and the vent that goes in the bottom of the bottle fits perfectly in the rack on the bottom.  I was just drying the bottles on a towel on the counter, but having them up so the air can circulate helps them dry so much faster.  I also like that the rack has a closed bottom.  All of the water that drips stays in the tray, not on the counter!!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These hold up alright, but they do leak through sometimes overnight. They\'re also smaller than the disposables and don\'t always stay centered on the nipple (leaks). The thickness and lack of contour also makes them much more visible.I\'ve found that I can use a set of Lansinoh disposables day and night for even a full week, which means I\'m hardly ever using these ones anymore.Based on my research up-front I think these are the best washables, but don\'t waste your money on these when you could buy another pack of 60 disposables for the same cost.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: For years I\'ve never written a review on here but these were such a waste I HAD to! They serve their purpose for about an hour! I am about a size D - DD and these were fine size wise but they don\'t absorb much at all! Don\'t waste your money !

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Bought this after NUK ones. They are definitely better but not for use overnight. I recommend the bamboobies? I think they were called.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I wear these every day. They\'re thick and absorbent, and soft on my skin. I much prefer them over theNUK Reusable Nursing Pads, 6 Packwhich I bought at a local store to get me through until these came in. The NUK pads were too thin to be useful.If you care if they show and you wear form-fitting shirts these might show.Apparently I\'m a "heavy leaker." At night these pads are too small to stay in place as I toss and turn, though they are the standard size (a little over 3 inches in diameter). I ended up making myself some 5-inch x 5-inch square nursing pads to use at night.Nursing Pads Ekstra Style, Smalllook like they might be large enough, and LANAcare also has larger sizes. I can\'t use wool though.I ended up buying 3 sets of these, so I can wear a clean set partway through the day if necessary, a clean set at night, and not end up doing the wash every single day.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Producto de calidad, es excelente y el uso ha permitido validar la durabilidad del mismo. 100 % recomendable. es lo máximo

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I\'ve tried the Medela washable nursing pads, and found them to be really bulky.  When they come out of the wash, they\'re all distorted too, so I have to reshape them before using.  The AVENT nursing pads are great because they have a slimmer profile, and the lace covering on one side does provide some traction so it doesn\'t become displaced.  I love that they come out of the wash in perfect shape!  These are best for mild leakage, just enough to keep from staining your bra.  Also, for those interested in disposable nursing pads, I highly recommend Babies R Us\'s own brand of nursing pads.  The Medela disposable nursing pads says they offer better shape, but if you wear any bra with even the thinnest padding, you can\'t tell anyway.  The BRU brand pads absorb better than the Medela brand, provide better coverage, and are the least expensive I\'ve found, even cheaper than on Amazon or stores with coupons.  BRU will have them on sale sometimes for BOGO half off, so even better.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: i really liked them, but if you are producing a lot of milk like i was, you will need to double up. i LOVED the mesh bag!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: saving assistance, as they should not buy these again, I never noticed anything in the bra, or in the clothes

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These are great now that my milk has leveled out.  At first, they weren\'t absorbent enough for me to use if I was going to be out of the house and I still cannot use them at night.  But during the day, now that I don\'t leak nearly as much as I did for the first 2 months, they are great.  Easy to use and easy to clean.  Plus they are comfortable.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I never tried any other disposable or non-disposable brand, but generally opted to go for an environmental and long-term affordable alternative to the disposable kind. It\'s been four weeks, and so far I\'ve had generally a pretty good experience with the Philips AVENT washable ones. UPSIDES: one-time expense / reusable; easily washable in the sink instead of needing to wait for a full washload; absorb quite well - I\'ve not had any through-leakage as long as they are switched out daily (they can occasionally get "soaked," but switch them out in that case). DOWNSIDES: nipple stickage after leakage sometimes (this can be reduced by regularly applying RAFAEL\'s natural nipple care ointment); don\'t always stay exactly in place depending on your bra (esp. looser ones); visible through tighter clothes since they are a bit thick, although I\'m not sure how this compares to other brands.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Good alternative to disposable ones but could be thicker

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I purchased these pads thinking I would save money over the disposable. How wrong was I.  I was fully aware of the bulkiness (visable through clothing) prior to purchase, so that wasn\'t the issue with me. I planned to wear them indoors only.These things don\'t even stop a minimal leak. They do not contour properly around the breast & slide especially when lying down.  They also soak through onto my clothing. Maybe my minimal leaks are as someone else\'s moderate leaks.  In either case, they don\'t suit me.The disposable avent, though as bulky at least absorb.  I shouldn\'t have to change pads 6 times a day.For outside use, the Lansinoh brand disposable pads are MUCH better. They have greater surface area & can withstand actual leaks.If anyone can recommend a re-usable pad that acts like the disposable Lansinoh brand, please post.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Of all the options, these pads are the softest and most comfortable.  I use these exclusively. I do not leak much, but it absorbs when I do. My nipples are extremely tender and these have really helped with every outfit and activity. Highly recommended!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These reusable nursing pads aren\'t worth getting at all. They don\'t absorb quickly enough and they don\'t hold anything hardly at all. My baby is 3 months old, and so it\'s not like there is any type of engorgement (except morning), and they can\'t keep up with normal nursing. Honestly your better off stuffing a burp cloth down your shirt than using one of these. I think I\'d rather use disposables, because at least they work.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These pads are a great way of protecting the environment. They fit in the bra snugly and are easily washable.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I bought these because they are more environmentally friendly than disposables however they do not absorb much so I always end up changing my shirt because it leaks through. I don\'t consider myself a heavy-let-downer at all (ie. the disposables never got saturated) so I was very disappointed. They are also very flat. A little contour would be nice, and make more sense because really, who\'s breasts are totally flat? The only thing I like about these is that they seem to wash well and come with a mesh bag, which is convenient.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These leak when you have a lot of milk.  They worked better after my milk supply decreased. ok ok ok

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I purchased a couple different kinds of reusable nursing pads because I just couldn\'t bring myself to constantly line my bras with disposables which, to me, seem like jamming pantyliners into your bra. I like these the best because:1. They maintain their shape after washing. No strange edges/shapes after being in the dryer.2. Thickness - I found that the thin pads did nothing to contain my leaking. These pads absorbed well - even when I was soaking through everything else!As others have mentioned, you may see these through your shirt. But, I think that\'s the case with most pads if you REALLY need them. I have a heavy milk supply, and these have worked best for me.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: The lace details are pretty and all...but these pads did not absorb much.  I was very disappointed in the quality.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I bought these hoping to be environmentally friendly. I tried wearing these once and had a huge wet spot after just one feeding. They absorbed nothing and had a spot bigger than if I did not use anything.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: From the wife/mom: Disposable is always best, but to save money, the washable pads are always a good option. The Philips washable is definitely better than my Medela washable. It keeps its shape a lot better, and you don\'t see it through your clothes as much. I also like that there are 3 pairs (the Medela only had 2 pairs), so you don\'t feel super rushed to wash. Finally, the Philips feels a lot better on your skin as well.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These breast pads work great. The size and thickness was exactly what I needed. I would recommend these pads. I would definitely purchase them again.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I don\'t leak very much, so I find these useful.  Less wasteful and can be reused several times before washing.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I ended up getting a good deal on these as an add-on to an order, and luckily for me, it turned out to be a pretty nice product. They are comfortable to wear, and more importantly, they are discrete under clothing!  They are backed with lace, but I don\'t think it\'s a waterproof barrier.  The nicest part about this product was receiving the mesh bag to wash them in!  Then I can keep track of all of my pads after washing and drying.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: theses were bought for my two daughter who are expecting a few weeks apart. They are good quality and absorbancy. The girls said they were comfy (as liners could be, lol)

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Initially I thought they were comfortable, moderately thick, and the padding doesn\'t bunch up over multiple washings. I like not having to use disposables which seems wasteful since I\'d have to go though a lot of them over all the months that I\'m nursing.These nursing pads do have quite a bit to be desired. They leak frequently to the point where I\'d wake up in the middle of the night with milk soaked both through these nursing pads and my clothing. I\'m taking the time to update my review after having a different experience using this brand of nursing pads with my second child...I don\'t have trouble with my milk supply when nursing my second child. Unfortunately, I can\'t use these nursing pads anymore since they leak constantly even during the day. They are especially bad when I let down while nursing my child on the other side and I never wear these overnight.It worked ok most of the time for my first child when I wasn\'t nursing often and had limited milk supply when he was an older baby. However, if you are nursing a newborn or needing reliable protection steer clear of these nursing pads unless you\'re trying to win a wet t-shirt contest!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: While these are washable, they aren\'t very absorbent.  My wife loved these before our daughter was born; before she was nursing.  However, now they only last maybe an hour before they are soaking wet, and bleed through to clothing.  Disposables do a much better job once nursing actually begins.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Absorbency is ok and they do stick a bit to your nipple. The washing bag is convenient and the pads are pretty with the lace but you can see these through any shirt that is not really loose on the top.  I don\'t wear them during the day because they are so obvious. I wanted to switch from disposables but these didn\'t cut it.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I love the look and feel of these.  Very soft against the skin.  They have great absorbency.  (Note, I\'ve not worn them overnight)  I do have a hard time getting them to stay put in my sports bra.  They would probably be ok in a regular bra though.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: They leak!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: While these nursing pads are thick, they tend to leak through vs the other flannel pads I have used in the past.  I use these when my other ones are dirty & waiting on laundry day.  I would not buy this specific kind again.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I love how soft and thick this nursing pad is compared to the other cloth ones available! I also like that it doesn\'t show the typical "line" a lot of pads often show through your shirt. The only down side is, the pad doesn\'t always stay exactly put. In the month that I\'ve owned them, one has gravitated out of my nursing bra, and up my shirt 3 times.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: i read a lot of reviews on here...i didn\'t want to waste my money on a product that wouldn\'t work.  I started with disposables (got the linsonah on sale for $1 - so i thought i would try them) but didn\'t like the regular cost or the wastefulness.Got these from babies r us for the same price as amazon.  and overall, i\'m happy with them.  the diameter is a little smaller than that of the disposable, and sometimes they shift around in my bra and don\'t cover the nipple - but the same thing would happen with the disposable.i feel they absorb just as well, or better, than the disposable.  Either that or i\'m producing less milk than in the beginning (my baby is currently three weeks old), but i\'m not leaking through to my shirt nearly as often - maybe once every other day.I do change them frequently to avoid leakage.  I just use some soap in the bathroom sink, press between towel layers to soak up excess moisture and lay out to dry.  I have not "run out" with this method.For $7, i\'m happy with my purchase.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Absorbed a little, but then milk leaks out from below the pad. Horrible, do not waste your time or money

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I have tried a lot of different pads as I have a large over supply of milk and these are by far my favorite! They are soft on sore nipples and I have never had a problem leaking like I did with some other!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: The bamboobies pads I tried were always soaked but did not breathe so I developed thrush while using them. These Avent pads provided just enough material to contain leaks and are cute too. Similar to medela pads but these have a really pretty lace outer layer.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These do a good job keeping me dry during the day, but constantly move around at night, which is when I really need them.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These are not very absorbent even after multiple washings.  They get hard if I don\'t change them quickly enough after a leak, and they also make me fuzzy if I am not completely dry when I put them on...  Small things, but not things I really want to worry about all the time.  I would also prefer a slightly larger size.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I bought these pads because I was hoping to save money and because I like the brand Avent.  I have no complaints about any of their other products, but these pads could\'ve been made better.  First of all, at night they do not stay in place.  I\'ve woken up many times and have had to change my bra and clothes because they were soaking wet.  Second, when they do stay in place, they don\'t absorb much.  I can use them in the daytime when I don\'t leak much, but at night when there\'s long stretches where my daughter doesn\'t eat, they become filled and leak.  And lastly, they do stick to my nipples, so I have to be careful when I remove them.  I do like the convience of them, though, and they came with their own little laundry bag so they don\'t get lost in the washer or dryer, very helpful.  If your a heavy leaker, I would recommend getting a different brand.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: This is the worst nursing pad ever if you are the ones who leaks A LOOOOOOOOOOOT!!! they suck!! Don\'t buy them!!!!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These do a decent job absorbing, but my daughter was 3 months old when I bought these, so I haven\'t tested them during the worst leakage time (first month for me).  They\'re not contoured at all, so they don\'t stay put as well and aren\'t very big so they can move out of the critical position a little too easily (even for me, and I\'m not very busty).  Also, not being contoured, you have to wear pads over them for shape if you\'re going to wear a fitted shirt.  They do they job, but I\'m going to keep looking for something better.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I ordered these to replace the disposable pads that I had been using. The first night I wore them, I leaked through these to the point that I soaked my bra. Thinking it might have been a fluke, I wore a clean pair the next day and still soaked through. They are neither absorbent or slip-proof. I went back to the disposables the next day.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I\'m one of those heavy leakers and thought there was nothing out there that would be reusable.  These work well and are very comfortable.  The lace on the one side keeps the pad in place.  A little trick that may help you leak a little less is to flip your nipple up against the pad.  In other words, put a kink in the fire hose line.  (Not everyone\'s anatomy is apt for this, but it works for me.)  After nursing two of my boys, these have been the best to not show through clothing.  For those complaining about them showing through--Nursing pads work best with nursing bra\'s; I just find the normal bra\'s are to thin to cover up any pad.My favorite nursing bra for support and now showing through clothing:[...]If your looking for convenience then I suggest disposable, otherwise you\'re going to have to carry a ziplock baggie with you everywhere for the pads.  They need changing as often as you would a disposable.  Just like any other pad.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: The nursing pads are really soft. They are easier to use than the disposable sticky kind which end up sticking to your boob when you nurse. Am not sure about absorbancy as I don\'t leak much. My only gripe is that the cotton fibres on the pads comes off and sticks to your nipples

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I have been nursing for just a month now. Some days I leak more than others and when I do, I wake up in the morning (and middle of the night) with a wet shirt. The complaints I have are – 1: when my milk dries up, the pads stick to my nipples and it hurts when I try to pull it off (both lace side and the non-lace side). 2: I wish the pads were a bit curved and not flat. It leaves lumps through your bra. Overall, i think this product is OKAY.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: they are horrible!  they are bulky and don\'t stay in place.  they leaked right through my bra, shirts and my baby.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: From the first use, these pads have been really ineffective for me- and since disposables worked fine, I\'m inclined to think its the pads and not me. I literally changed shirts more times than my newborn changed clothes because the pad shifts and only absorbs a minimum amount of milk (for me, sometimes with an hour I had wet spots.) They\'re also visible through the bra since they\'re just a flat disc instead of curved or moldable. I\'m using disposables and trying new brands, but tossing these out.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These nursing pads wick moisture away from the skin.  Great right?  Unless you are wearing something over them; the moisture just gets wicked away to the more absorbent shirt (or bra) you happen to be wearing.  (I have never used fabric softener on these)The lace is pretty, and a nice detail, which is the reason I gave these a shot.  However, after washing, the cotton side shrunk a little and the lace did not, leaving me with stack of lopsided nursing pads.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: It does absorb but does not stay put. It needs another strip of adhesive besides just one to help it stay put while moving.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: there is only one down side and that is if kept on for too long, or the lady produces a lot of milk, then it might seep through. Philips should have considered put some kind of plastic lining to prevent seepage.  other than that, who is complaining when it saves me a bunch of money on buying disposables for my lady every month?

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I love these!  They\'re very comfortable and soft, and they work great!  I haven\'t had one embarrassing leaking accident!  LOVE them!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: If you leak a lot or have oversupply (before solids, especially if you\'re pumping also), these pads aren\'t good enough. I leaked right through them several times before I just decided to purchase some disposables with plastic backing. When my milk leaking slows down a little, I will start using them again.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: My niece loved these pads. She used them all the time and they are comfortable and don\'t show through your clothes. Because you wash and reuse them they are even better. If it had been me I\'d have wanted 2 packs but this was a first baby and you learn!

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: I just bought my second set of these they are great mine have never stuck to and I have never had a problem with them leaking

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: they defiantly come in handy and i will use them when i have more kids. they are a defiant need

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Bought these by chance to try and ended up loving them.  They don\'t lay the nicest in your bra, but save some serious dough by not having to use the disposable ones.  Would recommend washing before first use though :)  Highly recommended.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Wasn\'t impressed with the avent washable nursing pads for the following reasons:- material is non-absorbant- material is not as soft as other options available- pads stick to nipples- lace on the outside can be seen through bra/nursing tank- small circle creates a strange raised bump seen from outside

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Wife says they provide nice cover to keep nipples from showing.. But they don\'t stand up to leaks at all.  The leak is just funneled to the bottom of the bra instead.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: These are perfect for the job.  Highly absorbent and prevents "leak through."  Also better for the breast since some silicone pads just occlude the breast and have been linked with increased instances of mastitis.  Keeping is simple over here with these cotton nursing pads.

name: Philips AVENT Washable Nursing Pads, 6-Count
review: Loved these. they stood up to numerous washings (free in a regular wash cycle) and stayed put during wear better than any other brands. And they look almost brand new and ready for next time

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: Love this product.  This is all you need to put your baby essential needs.  Perfect organizer and it doesn\'t take a lot of space on top of my dresser.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: I bought this to try to get some organization for my diapers as I have two babies in them. But it doesnt hold a bag of diapers so Im constantly filling this up. Itd be so much easier if it held a bag. I would understand if it didnt hold the box of diapers but newborn size 1 diapers? really? It barely even holds one row! waste of money for me....

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: this was great easy to use n fits  on dresser or bathroom counter nicely  very hhandy n easy to clean

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: This is a must have accessory. We find it very very useful. Here is why:-Simple design for changing tables. We have converted our dresser chest into a changing table and this works best on it as it saves a lot of space-Having diapers and wipes right next to changing pad makes so much sense.-Two side compartments allow for storing rash cream, baby powder, misc stuff which you need from time to time.-Its very easy to clean

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: I want one for every room! A space for everything. Good price, great product. We have had for a year now.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: For our first daughter, we had the skip hop toolbox diaper caddy (which is $40-50).  It was such a pain and didn\'t hold everything we needed (in a compact space).  So for our 2nd baby, I searched for the right diaper organizer for our changing table.  I came across this one on amazon.  The price was good, it was gender neutral - so I decided to try it.  It is perfect!  It organizes everything you need for the changing table (easy access for diapers, creams, wipes) in a small compact space.  I should\'ve bought this one for our first baby!  What a great value!

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: I love this diaper organizer. I have the munchkin wipes warmer and it sits on top just fine. I don\'t have any problems with it sliding around or lifting up when I remove a wipe. I love that I can remove the side containers, I have both of mine sitting on one side because of the size of my changing table and it works great. Between the two side containers I have a large JJ lotion, a tube of aquafor, butt paste, thermometer, bulb syringe, nail clippers and a tiny container of Vaseline. The bulb syringe is kind of hanging out the top but other than that everything fits just fine.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: I ordered this when my son was born and 2 1/2 years later, we still use it! It keeps the diapers organized and at hand and provides a place for a box of wipes and all of his creams, lotions, hand sanitizer, and even a small distraction toy to be stored. When he was a newborn, I used it with the Prince Lionheart Wipes Warmer, which fits perfectly on the top and even has a place to latch on, so it doesn\'t get knocked off. A regular wipes box also fits just fine. I never realized how useful this was going to be, truly something that has made diaper changing easier and more organized! Great product!

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: I really like this changing station organizer- I didn\'t think to put it on my registry an saw it when I was shopping on Amazon for other items. I really like having everything out in reach, makes changing my little one in the middle of the night even easier when I\'m half asleep. It\'s a good size too- it doesn\'t take up too much room and fits the lionheart wipes warmer perfectly.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: Keeps everything handy which is necessary when you have those surprise newborn diaper explosions.  It hold everything that you will need for a successful diaper change.  I love the side compartments and store my baby\'s after-bath essentials such as his nail clippers, Q-Tips and brush.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: The product is worth the price and I actually like it , however I wasn\'t pleased receiving mines with a big crack on the part for the wipes

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: We use a dresser/changing table combo in my daughter\'s nursery. This fits perfectly on top. The compartments are great for diapers, wipes, lotions, ointments, and hair clips/bows.It is very useful and the low cost is a bonus. Well worth the money.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: I brought this because I was useing the crib as a changeing table, and had no room. this was a space saver

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: It is what it is. The depot keeps everything you need to primp your baby in one small space. This had been very convenient for us, as we much prefer everything at hands reach. We can keep anywhere from 12-14 Pampers swaddlers diapers stacked on one side, and two 64 packs of pampers sensitive wipes on the other. The wipe warmer stays stocked with warmed huggies thick wipes for wiping baby down when a bath isn\'t necessary. The side storage hold his aveeno wash&shampoo, powder, desitin, comb, etc. The depot is worth the buy!

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: I received this organizer two years ago for my baby shower and I love the convenience of having everything I need to care for my baby in one neat area at my fingertips as opposed to having to fish through baskets/drawers etc. So when we were expecting again and setting up another nursery, I purchased this product from Amazon. Little did I know that it would arrive broken and the return policy for this item expired 48 hours after it had arrived at my home. I didn\'t open the box right away as it contained holiday gifts as well- now I\'m out the money and I went and purchased another one from a retail store.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: The diaper depot is like having an extra set of hands when you are changing your little angel(s) diapers. This is a must have to be organized. This will be my go to when invited to baby showers from now on! Love it!!

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: We wanted something to keep everything for diaper changes organized. The Diaper Depot does just that, but ours arrived a little cracked. I think it cracked due to poor packaging by Prince Lionheart. I give it 4 stars because of the packaging and crack...

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: I just thought that this was a temporary solution for us, because i wanted the diaper stacker... This ended up working so much better! I can have diapers in it, plus powder lotion and a brush or other things in the sides! It\'s very convenient and fits perfectly on top of the dresser, this was a great purchase and for the price how can you beat it??

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: my girlfriend had one for her son & I knew when I found out I was pregnant that I needed one. keeps everything all in once place and organized! Still using it with my 2nd child. Love that the side compartments are removable so you can customize it to the space that you have.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: This helped turn the top of our bureau into a changing table. It holds the wipes, diapers, diaper cream, etc. and keeps everything organized and easy to access!

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: This is a handy little diaper holder. It holds wipes and diapers and the compartments on the sides hold miscellaneous items. I wish the side compartments (which are removable) were more sturdy, but other than that it\'s fine.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: It does a great job organizing all your diaper needs into a smaller compact station.  It comes with four attachable little rubber feet so that it stays put.  It will fit approximately a dozen diapers depending on size.  It\'s really useful to organize and it will go to good use over the years.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: It is still waiting for the baby to arrive, so I haven\'t used it yet....  but I do love the utility and design of it.

name: Prince Lionheart Dresser Top Diaper Depot
review: Very useful! I love it! It makes baby stuff like diapers and wipes organized. Aside from that, it is very affordable.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I absolutely hate this pump!  I went through 3 of these because I wasn\'t able to get my money back and could only exchange.  The motor broke twice and one time it suctioned in and never released.  Instead of exchanging it for a fourth time, I just threw the whole thing out.  The part that attaches to the motor/handle and the piece that allows milk through are impossible to clean.  Eventually, on all 3 that I went through, the milk builds up in the piece that attaches to the bottle (only takes a few pumps to fill this up) and you have to break suction for it to filter through.  It continues to do this for as long as you\'re pumping.  If you don\'t realize that the milk hasn\'t gone through, the built up milk gets into the motor/handle and leaks out through the suction power control.  The massage bubbles on the cup are uncomfortable and only irritate your breasts.  The suction dies down almost immediately making pumping take so much longer.  This pump is such a waste of money.  Buyer beware!

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: Because of budget constraints I bought this pump.  It worked great when I pumped if my son didn\'t nurse completly at some feedings.  When I started back to work and had to pump every 2-3 hours the suction started to fail. I broke down and bought a better pump.  This one gave a little pain at the beginning, but I got used to it.  It is also fairly noisy.  Not a good thing when I am having to pump at work.If you are going to be a frequent/exclusive pumper,  break down and get a better pump.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I borrowed this pump from a friend.  At first I was skeptical because it was one of the less expensive pumps on the market, however I am completely satisfied with the way it works.  I can get 4 ounces in a matter of about 8 minutes.  One thing to make sure is that all the pieces are connected correctly in order to get a good suction.  I also like that there are only a few pieces to wash.  I\'ve heard horror stories of women saying that their pumps left them sore and purple.  This pump does not do this.  It has a wheel that controls the suction.  As long as you do not start off at the highest setting you should not be in any pain at all.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I had used several manual pumps in the past and decided it was time to try an electric pump.  With my second child, I got this pump (after my Evenflo broke two times).  I love this pump.  I found it easy to use and clean.  I never had any troulbe with suction.  I was able to use it discretly at work.  The only time I had trouble expressing milk was when I was tense or dehydrated.  Remember, there are other factors that influence let down, other than the pump you are using.  I am due in a few months with my third child and have every intention of using this pump again.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I BOUGHT THIS PUMP AFTER TRYING A MANUAL EVENFLO & AN AUTOMATIC DOUBLE PUMP WHEN MY NIPPLES BECAME CRACKED & WERE BLEEDING (BABY IS AN AGRESSIVE NURSER) AND FOUND THIS ONE TO BE THE BEST. THE AUTOMATIC SUCTION RELEASE IS SO CONVENIENT. THE SHEILD IS PLIABLE AND FLEXIBLE MAKING A GOOD SEAL. I THINK THIS IS AN IDEAL PUMP FOR SMALLER BREASTED WOMEN BECAUSE OF THE PLIABLE SHIELD. I CAN PUMP +/- 4OZ FROM EACH BREAST IN ABOUT 15-20 MIN.  THE PUMP IS VERY COMFORTABLE.  WHY BUY A NAME (MEDELA) WHEN YOU CAN BUY A GREAT PRODUCT FROM A GREAT COMPANY AT A REASONABLE PRICE!

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I have to agree with those who say it is good for occasional use only. I first experienced problems with the pain I felt from the sheild, the bumps are left embedded on your breasts. But even that wasn\'t the worst. After only a few uses it began to clog in the small compartment and overflow, unless the suction was broken to release. Which causes the process to take longer. I am now back to work and am looking for a more agreeable pump.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I recieved this pump as a gift after the birth of my second daughter.  I figured, that once I returned to work, it would come in handy.  My daughter was born almost a month ago.  I have got to say this was the worst thing I ever recieved.  The first few times I used it, it worked great.  Actually better than the hospital grade one I rented with my first daughter.  But after a week of using it, it seems to get stuck on the nippple.  I have to literally pry my breast out of it.  The motor seems to just suck and not release.  I don\'t recommend this to anybody looking for a easier, but inexpensive pump.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: After my dauhter was born I found that I did not produce enough milk.  Two weeks after I bought an expensive electric pump the motor burnt out.  After that I purchased the Natural Comfort Electric Breastpump from the First Years and was able to produce more milk in less time.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I had originally purchased the Evenflo pump and was disappointed because it kept breaking and then the motor started to go after only 2 1/2 months, so I brought it back and decided to try this pump instead.  I put it all together and my first reaction was OUCH !!!  The automatic suction/release is a great idea but this also has small bumps in the shield that hurt when using it.  I also kept losing suction with the shield being so flexible it kept bending at the neck.  Needless to say, it took me 3 days to pump one 4oz. bottle, so I will be returning this product.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: IF you want to bleed and hurt, buy this pump. It took over thirty min to get one oz. Don\'t waste your money!!!

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I bought this pump for my second child, I wish I hadn\'t.  It is painful and difficult to use.  I got more milk expressing by hand. I never got more than an ounce in 20 mins.  I tried adjusting the settings but it never got better.  I gave up on this pump after 8 weeks of trying.  I wish I had bought a Medela instead.  Because of health dept regulations, the store cannot refund for it.  So now I have a pump I can\'t use, and still have to buy a new one.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: Got this pump for my first pregnancy. Worst product out there. It was very uncomfortable and hurt and began to not work when I became engorged. Best thing I did was rent a Medela Lactina SelectMedela Lactina Select Hospital Grade Breast Pump - BPA Free #016SC01, and bought a double pumping kit,Lactina Double Pump - System Kit ONLYwhich you can get from the hospital. Works wonders an is incredibly comfortable.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I am sorry but I have very bad experince with this pump. I\'ve received this pump as a gift and when I came from the hospital with my breast engorged I\'ve decide to give it a try. It worked fine for about 5 minutes than the milk stopped dripping into bottle and filled the top part of the pump and got into the motor. I called customer support for First Years (they are extremely nice and helpful) and they send me mailing label for free return. In five days I\'ve received new replacement pump. That one worked for two days and end up just the same way as the first one. I\'ve called again and they offered me replacement again. I\'ve asked if that is normal with those pumps and I\'ve been told that I am probably producing too much milk(thank God for that:) and this pump is not suitable for me. However they are still replacing it AGAIN! Frustrated enough I called Medela Dealer and I am enjoying my new Pump in Style advanced. If you are serious about breastfeeding for a while don\'t even bother with those cheap pumps. They are very frustrating. I know that over $ 200.00 may seem a lot but if you consider how much are you saving on formula it\'s a great investment.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: i bought this because the pricetag was appealing and i wasn\'t sure how much or how frequently i\'d use it.  it does the job i bought it to do.  however, it is not by any means discrete or quiet.  i have to turn up the TV or use subtitles when i\'m using it because it\'s so loud.  if i could do it all over again, i\'d buy a more quiet, double pump.

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I thought it was just me but when I lent my breast pump to a girfriend to let me know if it was all in my head, I was happy to hear that this breast pump had the same effect on her. An aweful stinging on the nipple that made it impossible to pump manually afterwards. This pump does not work for me. OUCH!!!

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: This is an easy to use, easy to clean pump, also it has very few parts to lose. I use mine twice a day to pump 4oz a go at work. I am a D size and have to use the nipple insert.<br /><br />When I first tried it I put the suction pump strength up too high and it hurt, the trick is to gradually increase the suction strength and to think of your baby. Do not always expect immediate let down especially if tense and try to pump at the same times each day as your body learns to supply at regular intervals.<br /><br />You do need to keep an eye on what you are pumping though, because if you do not clean the small filter well enough with soapy water then you can get the filter chamber backed up with milk, which is not good for the pump. If you see this happening shut the pump off, insert your little finger into the breast cup area and push it toward your nipple to break the vacumm seal, then unscrew the bottle a little to let the milk drain.... then clean the filter properly !

name: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review: I had manual Avent Isis pump and I hated it. It took forever (20 min) to get some milk, it hurt, and eventually it broke. It never sealed properly.I got this pump with my first baby and used it maybe 10 times without any problems. When I tried to use it again 2 years later it did not work - it was getting stuck on "suck" mode (did not release).I got a new one and it is awesome. It takes about 5 - 10 min to get 4oz of milk (depending on mother\'s supply as well). The adjustable strenght of suction was great at the beginning when the nipples are really sensitive and sore. Now I just use it at the highest setting to get the milk quickly but it does not hurt.The pump can be used with batteries which is great when you are traveling. The size is also plus because you can put it in your diaper bag and it does not take any space.  It is compatible with most bottles (except Avent and that "tri-flow" bottles". It is compatible with Playtex bottles even though Playtex claimes it is not. For the Playtex bottles you want to get the Starter pack with adjustment ring for breast pumps (it has smaller diameter which fits the First Years pump).So overall - it is the best option if you want it for occasional use and the speed of electric breast pump. If you are planning on using it every day, you should get some pump designed for it, such as Medela.By the way - my first First Years pump did not work properly when I bought it and First Years replaced the whole thing ( not just the malfunctioning part) within 2 weeks. So - GREAT customer serviceI am giving it only 4 stars because when I found out that my old First Years pump did not work, I called the company and asked how to get it repaired. There is NO WAY it can be repaired, not by First Years or anybody else. So if your pump breaks after the warranty expires you are out of luck.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: I am waiting for a response from the vendor, because maybe this was a legitimate mistake, but I did not receive an "original Apple" power adaptor, as stated in the title.  It\'s a third-party adaptor.  It is not the one in the photo and not the same length.  Hopefully, the vendor will find the one I actually ordered and mail it to me so I can then return this one and not be without a power cord for even one day.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: This monitor is awful. My husband & I did not realize the constant static was not "normal" until we purchased another monitor.  I agree with another review that says "the static will drive you crazy!".  I like to run on a treadmill while our baby naps & with this monitor, I did not feel comfortable doing this because the treadmill created even more static. Our new monitor works perfectly well while resting on the treadmill.  Also, when anyone walks in front of this monitor the static gets even worse.  DO NOT BUY this monitor.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: We registered for this monitor before reading the reviews. Bad idea... luckly we tried it out before the baby came , it makes a terrible noise every 3 seconds, continously. I will be returning this tomorrow!!

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: Awful!!  I registered for this monitor and received it as a gift and after using it for about 3 months replaced it.  This monitor will scream out with static out of nowhere and scare you half to death while also waking up the baby 2 rooms away!!  The static is THAT loud!!!  Not to mention I don\'t really need to hear what my neighbors are talking about on the phone!  Worried me that others would hear what all we were saying!!  We picked that one because it had 2 receivers, however we replaced it with the Sony Baby Call monitor, MUCH MUCH better!!!!!!  Save yourself the hassle and go with Sony.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: This monitor was AWFUL. So staticy and loud. I returned it and bought the Evenflo monitor which I LOVE. GO buy that one, it is clear and perfect.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: I loved the fact that this monitor came with 2 receivers, but I wish that I had read these reviews before putting it on my registry.  It picked up the sound of the baby very well, it also would pick up noises from our neighborhood and when our phone would ring the monitor would just go off by making loud, very obnoxious noises.  We had to shut it off to get it to stop.  The receiver had to be sitting just right to avoid tons of static, and that position wasn\'t always the same so we had to keep moving it.  It would go nuts with static if we even walked by it, not even touching it!  We had to replace it with a diffent brand.  Very disappointed - Peace of Mind is a very inappropriate name for this monitor - it gave us a lot of headaches.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: If you want this to help listen for your child to keep them safe, they will most likely die before you ever hear them with this pile of crap monitor.  My family bought this for our second child after our old monitor went out after 3 years of good service.  We were only able to hear two things with this death machine, static or complete silence, though I don\'t know if a person can hear complete silence.  Save your money and buy a different monitor, I recommend at least Fisher Price monitor that broadcast in the 900 or better range.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: We purchased this set of monitors and wished we hadn\'t.Pro\'s:* Comes with two monitoring unitsCon\'s:* Static is very annoying!  The background noise on these is ridiculous!  They seem to pick up every type of interference in the area which makes hearing baby very difficult.* Picks up cordless phone conversations all of the time (could be a benefit if you\'re into that type of thing...)* Even without static or noise, the sound quality on the listening units is average to poor.In a nutshell:  DON\'T BUY THIS MONITOR!  Purchase the Sony Baby Call model, it is very much worth the extra money.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: Don\'t waste your money with this monitor.  We selected it because of its wo receiver and battery/take along features.  However, within four months one of the receivers stopped working off the battery and then completely broke a couple of months later.  The other receiver\'s battery feature also stopped working.  Giving us only one receiver that did not function properly.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: I had read reviews of this monitor and was very skeptical.  I had a monitor by Fisher Price and it hummed constantly, not allowing us to hear our son when he cried. My husband and I decided to purchase this monitor, not having remembered the reviews it received.  I must say, we are pleased with the monitor.  It does make some static now and again, but this is normal for any type of radio transmitted device.  I simply turn the monitor off, then back on again and it resolves the problem.  What I have noticed is that when I have it on channel B in the babies room and on channel A in the bedroom or living room (easy to do accidentally), there is a lot of static but you can still hear the baby.  I would like to believe the previous poor reviews have been due to "operator error" but there are so many, it\'s hard to say.  The only downside I find with this monitor is that even when the volume is on the lowest setting, it is still quite sensitive to baby noises - but better to be safe than sorry!

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: I am a first time mom and I thought this would give me piece of mind and allow me to sleep better when my baby is in her room but I was very wrong!!! The static is constant throughout the night, although, other reviews state to plug in it and the static is better, that is not the case with mine. There is a constant popping sound every few seconds that is very annoying. I wish I had read the reviews before I bought it.Keep looking if you want to rest at night!!!!

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: This monitor may be peace of mind for the baby sleeping but not for the parents. The parent\'s monitors makes a continuous crackling noise and picks up a lot of interference because of the 900mhz. On several occasions it has picked up someone elses phone conversation. The constant noise drives me crazy and it only has two channels to switch back and forth from and I find that one channel is worse than the other.I am taking this back for one that will give me peace of mind.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: I should\'ve read the reviews too!!  The frist one went back b/c it kept making this awful loud noise and the second one is going back today b/c it makes a different noise.  Every time our phone, or the neighbors phone, rings, it has loud static.  Then it does it randomly in the middle of the night too!!  Don\'t waste you money!!

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: After having success with an older "First Years" monitor, we were in need of a new one.  Without doing my homework I immediately went and bought this "upgraded" First Years model.  What a mistake.  We cannot use it anymore since all we hear is annoying "flicking" static on one channel, and the second channel picks up the noise in my neighbors house.  I spoke to a company representative who suggested that I ask my neighbor to move her monitor further away from my home!!  Otherwise, that I should go buy another monitor that is a higher or lower mghz.  If this complaint is so common, the company should explore ways to correct.  I couldn\'t be more dissatisfied.

name: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review: I registered for this monitor because of the two receiver feature and because the 900 mHz technology was supposed to be the best.
