I highly recommend buying a boppy and several slipcovers, cause you\'ll be washing and changing it quite a bit.

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: I absolutely LOVE my Boppy Luxe.  I like the color (it helps that I have a daughter) and I not only used it when I was breastfeeding, but it also came in handy to put my daughter in (supervised of course) when I needed to do stuff in my room and didn\'t want to lug around the bouncer of the swing.Boppys are great.  I highly encourage new moms to get at least one.

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: It\'s a great product!  I fell asleep several times on the boppy.  I purchased it in 2002 to assist in nursing my newborn.  Being that the boppy was so comfortable, it was difficult turning it over to my daughter.  She gratually became more attached to the boppy.  Now, she won\'t go to sleep without it.  She\'s nearly three now and whenever she lies on the boppy, a big comfy smile spreads across her face.  Now, I\'m back to buy one for me and my one year old.  Everyone will have their own.  By the way, I love BOPPY!!!

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: I spend the first few months of my son\'s life using pillows to prop him during feedings. The result was a terrible back ache from leaning forward for too long. The Boppy, however, remedied that. It allowed my son to be at the right for nursing comfortably for both of us. I would recommend it for any breast feeding mom.

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: I recieved this as a shower gift and I wish I would have took it back.  I hated it for nursing and ended up buying the My Brest Friend pillow which gives much more support.  It may come in handy later when my baby is older when she is on her tummy or sitting up.

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: Nothing to say, but YOU MUST HAVE THIS PILLOW!  There are too many wonderful uses/conveniences to this pillow to name. I breastfed, but whether you nurse or bottle feed this pillow is a lifesaver! It enables you to position the baby perfectly for both feeding types, and my husband uses it when he gives our daughter a bottle. Now that she is sitting I position it around her while she sits to help her learn to balance herself and protect from hard falls backwards.  It is something EVERY new mom should have, this was the best reccomendation I got, and now I pass that along to someone else!

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: If you are nursing, this is the baby item that you, (or, at least I) "cannot live without!"  This pillow makes it SOOO much easier.  My baby is much more comfortable and seems to relax and nurse much more easily(compared to using another pillow or nothing at all).  I bring mine in the car on roadtrips, and recently, despite my husband\'s mystified look, even packed it in my suitcase for a weekend trip across the country (it took up most of my suitcase, but it was worth it!) I have both covers, the cotton and the deluxe.  I use the deluxe more, it is slightly more comfy, but both are good.

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: A must have for breast or bottle feeding moms!  Gives good arm support!

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: I bought the boppy primarily to help me nurse, but I find it very akward to use, it doesn\'t stay in place and I can\'t seem to find a comfortable position to nurse with it.  So I have given up using it for breastfeeding and am using a simple pillow which works much better.  The 3 stars are for baby, because she loves to be propped up and the bobby pillow is perfect for that; the way the pillow "hugs" her makes her feel secure and very comfortable.  She has not used it for tummy time yet so I cannot comment on that.

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: Nursing moms rave over the boppy, but I\'m telling you I bottle feed my daughter and this is a wonderful product! Baby is comfortable and supported and your arm won\'t get tired!  You can cuddle with her and rub her head and face with your free hand.I put her in this for support when she sits up and lies on her belly.  She really likes it a lot more than just setting her down on the floor.  And the luxe is so plush and pretty!  Highly recommended!  And to think I almost passed this one up!

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: This is an essential baby must!!  I don\'t know what I would do without a Boppy pillow!  My newborn and I love it. I use it with every feeding and it\'s fun to prop my baby up so she can see me. It provides a great snug feeling during feedings and gives my arms a nice rest.  It\'s a must have!!

name: Boppy Luxe Designer Pillow In Rosebud
review: I have this pink pattern in the Boppy, and I use it everytime I nurse my four month old.  It is wonderful!  My husband also uses it when we feed her from a bottle and to just prop her up on his lap.  My daughter would spit up on the boppy a lot and have diaper leaks on the boppy, so when this one was out of commission, I needed another one to use.  So I bought the yellow one with fireflies also.  I like that one much better because the stains do not show up like they do on the pink, and I don\'t have to soak that one to remove stains like I do the pink one.

name: Avent Bottle with 10 Disposable Liners (8-oz.)
review: I am a nursing mother of a 3 month old.  I find the Avent system is great.  My son is willing to take this nipple shape and does well with this disposable system when I have to be away.  Babies will get air in their feedings no matter what you do, even at the breast.  I find that my baby gets less air with this product.  I have found the advantage of this product is that I can express w/ the Isis pump right into the storage bag.  Since the bags are soft they take up less space than hard bottles, I have more room for additional bags in my Avent carry bag.  So with a little practice and patience, the Avent Isis pump works great.  With the disposable nurser attatched to the pump, there is less mess and less clean up.  This is a great addition to the Avent Isis back to work set and is descreet for the working and nursing mother.

name: Avent Bottle with 10 Disposable Liners (8-oz.)
review: I love avent products.  I can pump into the liners (using the adapter kit, I wasn\'t able to use the Isis pump)and then freeze it for my husband or daycare provider.  The nipple works great for my daughter, and she switches from bottle to breast with no problems.  My husband loved how easy it was for him - he\'d heat up the bag of milk, put the bag into the bottle, put on the nipple from a sterile travel pack, feed her, then toss the liner.  My daughter also loves the pacifiers, and they have a cap to keep them clean!

name: InSTEP 5K Single Premium Jogging Stroller
review: I only jog a little but I do alot of trail walking.  This stroller has held up to lots of different terrain.  I\'m sure a Bob or other big $$$ stroller would do better but for the cost, this stroller is wonderful.  We put my son in many strollers (including Schwinn, Bob, etc) and this was the best fit for him.  He was 5 months old at the time of purchase and now he\'s 11 mo.My only issues are the bars on the side.  They should be padded.  Also, the alignment is a bit off and I\'ll have to get that fixed.

name: InSTEP 5K Single Premium Jogging Stroller
review: This stroller is a great buy. My 11 month old son doesn\'t make a sound the whole ride. He\'s comfortable and the ride is smooth. The seat even reclines which is nice. Easy to assemble, too. The 16 inch front wheel is the only way to go if you are a runner/jogger and this one is designed well. Target had the best price I\'ve seen on this stroller and I did my research. It\'s crazy to pay hundreds of dollars for the high end brands and models unless you plan on training for lots of marathons. This one is perfect for the 5K or 10K runner in my opinion, or anyone who jogs or walks for exercise.

name: InSTEP 5K Single Premium Jogging Stroller
review: This is a great looking stroller and has a lot of places for my junk.  I like that.  But it is not good for walking on the pavement because is is too hard to turn because it is not the swivel wheel.  It is great on the dirt/stone path that I go jogging on.  The other thing was with the hand brake.  It took my husband a long time to figure out how to get it to work correctly.  It was not working when we first set up the stroller.

name: InSTEP 5K Single Premium Jogging Stroller
review: Granted, this isnt the GREATEST jogging stroller you could buy, but for the price its great! I dont jog much with it but i walk alot and it has been perfect! I walk on side roads and its really easy to meneuver even on a curvy road. I never had a problem when i did jog with it either. I like this stroller alot!

name: InSTEP 5K Single Premium Jogging Stroller
review: The price of this jogging stroller is a bargain. I researched several types as well as prices. The stroller is sturdy, very well made, the tires are excellent. I feel that my baby is very safe while in this stroller. The colors are also nice. And there is plenty of storage space and the cup holder and small compartment on the handle is nice, the closed compartment is perfect for house/car keys.

name: InSTEP 5K Single Premium Jogging Stroller
review: I looked at just about every jogging stroller on the market and decided on this one. I felt it was the best value for the money, I even like it better than most that are twice the money. I bought it today, it was pretty easy to assemble as my 11 year old son did it with very minimal help from his 15 year old brother. We went for a walk and I love the stroller. We live on a dirt road in Georgia so I bought this to go over sandy/clay roads and it works beautifully. The only downside I\'ve seen to this stroller so far is that there is NO cushion to the seat at all. I am not happy with that at all so I\'ll be buying a pad to go in it which will of course add to the cost of the stroller- keep that in mind when buying it.

name: InSTEP 5K Single Premium Jogging Stroller
review: Right price for this stoller. Lots of compartments. The only thing I didn\'t like is that the wheels are too big to fit into a small compact car. Wish the front tire turned too.But other than that... This jogger stroller is the cheapest, and very strong! Right price!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have been using this tub for almost four months now. Here are my thoughts...I love that the tub:1. material is very sturdy2. fits perfectly in my kitchen sink, which I think is standard size3. has foam padding where the baby is supposed to lie or sit4. has a drain plug5. has an arch design on the newborn side, which helps prevent water from spilling when the water is in motion6. comes with a sling7. has a hump that prevents the baby from slipping in too much when sitting1st Imperfection:While the mesh sling is helpful to protect babies from slipping/sliding too much, it\'s a hassle to keep it clean. I diligently hand washed ours with plenty of soap and water after each use yet it always smelled musty or molding once it was dry. Not too mention how annoying it was to line dry it in an apartment. The only way the sling would not have that horrible smell was when it was washed and dried in the machine, which I would not run after each bath. Luckily, my baby outgrew the sling after about a month so I didn\'t have to deal with it for too long.The company should make a silicon sling instead to resolve this issue.2nd Imperfection:The tub has two deep hollow spaces on the newborn side that accumulate dirt and get slimy. These are very hard to clean due to their small size. If I had to buy a tub again I would NOT purchase this one just for this one issue alone. I hate having to spend extra time cleaning those two holes.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I got this tub party because I thought I would use for my newborn and when he got older. It didn\'t exactly work out that way, but I am still glad I bought this tub. The best feature about it is the NEWBORN HAMMOCK. It clips on both ends of the tub and helps newborns to feel secure and helps parents to wash the baby easier. Since you know they are secure in the hammock, you don\'t have to worry about them slipping under water or slipping out of the tub. Now that my son is older (7 months) we have upgraded to a bath ring. Once he started sitting up, the tub seemed too confining. But if you have a child that is scared to be in the \'big tub\' this tub would be a good transition tool. The BEST tub for newborns and that to me makes it worth buying. Also the hammock can be put in the washing machine and the foam pads on the tub are mold resistant.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We originally bought this tub because it looked the safest with the infant cradle and we aggree that it is. My daughter loves to "hang out" in it with her feet off the sides in the water, and it allows me to use both hands to bathe her. Whether we use it in the tub or on the counter top, I feel that she is secure in the cradle and she LOVES taking baths. We have even used it in the tub with her 5year old sister! She is still too small to remove the cradle, but I am sure that we will continue to love it as she grows. It is a must have!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This bathtub is a dream!!  As a newborn, my son was very well-supported by the sling netting and bathing was so easy!  The sling is easy to clean and held up great through all the baths and washing.  I did stick the sling in the washing machine to give it a good cleaning now and again, and it was no worse for wear.My baby is now a year old and we still use this tub even though he is big enough to use the big bathtub.  This tub is just so easy to use still and makes my son Ryan feel secure.  I position him to lean back on the "recline" side when I wash his hair... then on the "upright" side to support his back when he is just sitting there.  He doesn\'t slip around.I\'m not sure if the hot-water indicator in the bottom of the tub works, but then I\'m not sure I ever got the water hot enough to test.  This bathtub was the best choice - I got lucky not knowing what to look for - and I recommend it to everyone.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This looked like a a great tub to purchase.  The sling was very appealing to me.  Initially I thought the tub was great.  It fit great over the kitchen sink, and my newborn cuddled nicely in the sling.  However once sponge bathing was over and I began to add water to the tub, my baby was slipping out of the sling.  No matter what adjustment I made to the sling, it was not working to keep my baby in place. I took the sling out and there was no improvement.  The shape of the tub is so awkward.  The water comes up high near the baby\'s mouth, and I am always concerned about water being swallowed.  I added a teddy bear sponge to the bath and that helped out minimally.  Maybe once my baby is sitting up on his own, the toddler side of the tub will work, but I am not waiting until then.  I am getting rid of it right now.  Bath time should be fun and right now bath time is just stressful.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I tried several other tubs before we landed on this one. The reclined infant seat is fantastic and allows baby to relax while he enjoys his bath.  There\'s plenty of room for him to splash and play.  I use the tub on my bathroom countertop next to the sink.  When we\'re finished with the bath, I just lift up one end and pour the water into the sink.  It\'s easier than using the drainage plug.  I\'ve given this tub as a gift to all the new Mommies I know!  I\'d definitely put it on my "must have" list for a new baby!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: The productThe First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Bluewas definitely something that I didn\'t find very useful. The tub is fairly small, and the baby can fit in there for (just) a couple of months. When he grew bigger that 22 inches there was not so much room for the water, which would eventually end on the floor. Another problem is the "seat" (a piece of plastic stuck in the middle of the tub that would serve as a baby-bottom holder); it makes the washing process extremely difficult, as there is not enough space to fit a hand behind the back of the baby. Last, the net depicted in the picture is nice, but never used, as the baby would probably never touch the water.Basically, it is not the tub that we wanted, and we had to find other solutions to wash the baby.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I really like this tub so far. My son is only two weeks old so I haven\'t been able to submerge him completely in water. The little sling has worked well for his quick lil baths. I had a hard time picking out a tub. This one caught my eye because of its depth and versatility. I also like the drain plug and tempature guard. I don\'t believe any bathtub or sling should free your hands but this one does secure the baby so it\'s not so hard on you to keep them in place. I would suggest this product to any new parent.I would like to add this tub fits on your sink so you can bathe baby right over the kitchen sink. This helps keep you from bending over so much. pretty neat idea!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this bath for my twins because they are secure and comfy in this tubBUY IT!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We used this for our infant granddaughter and it was perfect.  The mesh snaps in place that accompanies the tub and this helps to get you through that awkward phase when they are too tiny to adjust and hold comfortably while you try to bath their wet slippery skin after applying baby products.  It hugs them closely, and everyone enjoys bonding experience without stress and worry.  It also holds them in place so you get to increase water level to help baby enjoy bath-time until they are large enough to sit back in regular basin without them constantly sliding.  Your child grows into it and eventually grows out of it so you get your money\'s worth.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This fits perfectly in our double bay sink. I did not really like using the sling so I just put less water in it and had him sit in it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We have 1 month old twins and absolutly love this tub.  When I recieved it for our baby shower I didnt realize it came with a little net like thing that connects to the tub for an infant to lay in...it works so well and is so comfortable for them.  Our girls love bath time!  This is deffinetly worth buying!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I can\'t tell you how awesome this tub has been for my newborn.  The hammock feature is terrific for the first few months and when you are sponge bathing.  I am going to be giving this to all I know who are having children.This is about an important to me as having a boppie pillow!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We tried everything to get our baby to enjoy bath time, and this tub was the golden ticket! She feels very safe & secure in the little baby sling and for the first time ever actually enjoys bath time. Unfortunately it does not fit our sink, but I still give it 5 stars.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: After reading the great reviews I went with this tub. During the first use I was frustrated that my baby kept sliding down the sling. I quit using it for awhile and just used the foam turtle in the kitchen sink. Well now that he is bigger we started using the tub again. At 3 months he moves a lot. He is constantly sliding too far over to the side or his bottom lifts up on to the bump. I turned him to the infant/toddler side and he is not really ready for that. So basically this tub has been pretty worthless. I am going to purchase the Primo tub since the molding looks much more effective and safe.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Arrived quickly. Next day. Cant wait to use it. I had one of these before and loved it. The sling worked perfectly in the first few weeks so that is why i got this one this time. would tell everyone to get it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I bought the basic version of this tub a few years ago when my daughter was a baby and now am using it for my son.  It works well and the foam on the back keeps him from sliding around.  There are a few issues 1) It has a drain plug in the bottom, but not all the water will drain out of it using the plug, so be prepared to flip it over to empty it.  2) This tub is really only good as an infant tub.  By the time my daughter was ready to use the toddler side, she could brace her feet against the infant side and "bounce".  This meant that she would slip over the hump in the middle, so I just moved her to the big tub.  3) I had to bathe my babies with this tub in the big tub.  This tub does fit well in a double sink (the only place I have one is in the kitchen and it is too drafty to bathe my kids there).  But when I put the tub in the bathtub and fill it up with water, it was too heavy for me to get out again, expecially in the first 6 weeks when I wasn\'t supposed to be lifting.  This meant I got the joy of trying to get a slippery infant out of the big tub.All in all though, it\'s a good tub and I have no plans to buy a differnt one.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Our daughter is 8 weeks old and we have been using this tub since she was 2 weeks old.  She is still in the sling and I love that aspect of the tub.  She is cradled in the water and feels secure.  I haven\'t tried the tub with an older child, but LOVE it for our newborn!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I got this bathtub as a baby shower gift and began using it as soon as baby\'s cord fell off.  I loved the fact that I didn\'t have to hunch over the tub which hurts my back, knees, elbows and gets me all wet in the process.  The tub fit right over the sink and was so convient!!  The sling worked great and when baby got a little bigger we just used the reclining infant position.  Then at about 4 1/2 mo, I started disliking this tub.  My baby was finally mobile enough to enjoy the splashes she could make but, she would slide down the recline and I felt that the bump in the middle, which is supposed to be like a little "seat" to hold her place, was very uncomfortable on her back.  I was constantly either holding her in place (which the bump is supposed to do), or pushing her up so that her butt sat in the "seat."  The bump doesn\'t work  to keep the baby from slipping and sliding all over the tub, especially after the baby discovers the job of splashing.  I tried to use the toddler side of the tub, but, she looked so uncomfortable!  She couldn\'t quite sit up on her own so she would lean on either side of the tub.  On to another tub....Overall, I liked this tub enough in the first couple of months to recommend it.  After baby starts kicking/splashing in the tub though, I wouldn\'t recommend it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: my son was comfortable and secure from day one.  It has never leaked or anything.  Highly recommend this tub

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I listed this tub on my registry.  Frankly, I had no idea which tub to pick out and went with this one because of the ratings. We have been using this tub regularly for the past four months and arequite pleased.  Our daughter rests in the sling, and doesn\'t everslide down.  Moreover, it fits perfectly in our--two sink--kitchensink.  When she\'s a bit older, we will likely purchase a differentmodel, but this one has been great thus far.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: After reviewing many online reviews for tubs, I chose this one for my registry.  We have loved it since day 1!!!  Although I didn\'t really need the mesh part (for when you do sponge baths - it\'s just easier to do on a towel), we really enjoy this tub.  Ash used the reclining part until she was about 6 months old and able to sit pretty well straight up.  Now she uses the regular bath part and loves it.  It\'s a great size and easy to clean.  Highly recommend it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I agree with the reviewer who said this tub is a perfect shower gift. I received it as a gift and my friends who threw the shower used it as a punch bowl to serve punch from at the shower. I know it sounds weird, but it was adorable - even had a rubber ducky floating in it!But that\'s not why I love this tub. I love it because my 5 week old daughter loves it! She can be totally fussy, but when I put her in the tub right before bed, she calms right down. I know a lot of it has to do with being submerged in warm water, but I think the sling helps a lot too by cradling her and making her feel safe. I love the clean water area on the end, but I wish it were a little bigger. I use a plastic cup to get the clean water out to pour on her, but it\'s a little tight.Overall though I love this tub! I have recommended it to many friends.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We just had our first baby 2 1/2 months ago.  I researched many tub options and registered for this one.  I\'m very happy with it.  The "hammock" helped support my newborn, and he seemed very comfortable in it.  I just started using it without the hammock now that my son is a little bigger.  The non-slip back and hump in the middle keep him from sliding too much.  I also like the storage area on the side and the drain plug that changes colors if the water is too hot.  Bathtime is enjoyable because of this tub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We love the bathtub and so does our son!  He was born a month early and was a small 5 lbs when he came home.  He loves to lay in the tub and we love the way it keeps his head out of the water with his body in the water.  Makes bath time a lot easier and safer with a wet and wiggly baby!My sister-in-law saw pictures of our son in his tub and is buying one of her own for her third child.Totally would recommend this to anyone!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Our 1 month old loves taking bath in this. Quality of product is very good and its a very good product for your money.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a cute and Great tub. I love the features it has. Fits in sink perfect, love the drain plug and the soft insert for the infants.The toddler Area I\'ve yet to use, but it seems like it will come in handy!Angela

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this tub! I have to admit that this is the only tub I have used, but it has fullfilled everything I have needed it to. It is great because it has two sides, one for an infant which has a reclined back. and once the baby is old enough, there is a toddler side with a straight back. At first, I used it on my bathroom countertop. That worked very well. Once the baby started splashing (around 5 months) I place the tub in the bathroom tub and that works very well. It design allows the baby to sit up on his own, so I don\'t have to sit there holding him up. I can just sit next to the tub and watch him play and splash. I feel this is a very safe and efficient way of bathing my baby and I will be sad when he outgrows it (he is 7 months now and about 22 pounds and 28 inches). I highly recommend this tub. It is a must-have

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Good support which allows the baby to splash by herself without me holding her (stopped using the sling at 1.5 months).  I fit the tub across adult\'s tub which allows two adults to have access to the baby.  Had an opportunity to compare it with EuroBath which seemed too bulky and slippery.  Overall, this bath is a must have if you have small sinks or no help bathing the baby.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I loved this tub for my baby when she was newborn.  The hammock was perfect. It also fits on other baby tubs.  We gave it to my sister when her baby was born.  The biggest complaint I have is the "hump" in the middle of the tub.  My "little girl" is BIG (5 months).  She\'s tall and chunky.  She doesn\'t sit up well yet so we are still using the reclined side and she is so long that she scoots over the hump and gets very uncomfortable. Other than that it has been a wonderful tub, but I would reconsider if you have a big baby.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: After reading many good reviews, we registered for and received this product while expecting our first child. After she was born, however, it became apparent that it was a waste of money. She slid down the hammock constantly so we had to hold her up and keep her from having her head submerged, meanwhile, the hammock kept most of her body OUT of the water so she was cold. Perhaps some parents might be drawn to it because it will last them until their children are "toddlers." Good luck keeping a toddler in this thing! Perhaps if you have a shower only...but I think a bucket or deep try would work just as well and be a lot cheaper. After two or three baths I gave it away to a friend who was expecting and wanted to give it a try. We ended up using a towel on the bottom of the bathtub as a cushion until our daughter was old enough to sit up in the tub. When our second daughter was born we purchased a $6 infant bath sponge. It keeps her comfy, warm, and she loves it (and it dries a heck of a lot faster than the towel ever did). Skip this item all together.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We got this bathtub when my first child was born. Now, 7 1/2 years and 4 children later, we are still using this bathtub and absolutely loving it! It works so well for newborns and we are still using it now for our 12 month old twins (1 at a time of course).

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This was a gift for our great grandsson. I was pleased with the packaaging and the sheet AND OUR GRANDCHILDREN SEEMED TO LIKE IT.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is wonderful. At first I bought the 4-in-one bath system from Safety First and I hated it. The water leaked everywhere and the sling was useless, so I was very concerned about getting another tub.After looking at all of them, I decided on this tub. It is the best. I put my baby in the newborn side and bathe him so easily. It fits well on my sink and also is great for bathing on the table. He sits securely and doesn\'t slip down at all. Also, most importantly, the water stay in. I would highly recommend this tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We were given this tub from a friend and we were thankful because it was great. my lil guy loved being in the tub we would give him two baths a day but since hes gotten older, he is a very active lil stinker and he likes to push against the other backboard and gets his butt off the seat then slides in. even when im watching him hand and foot he does it and im scared that he will go under fully one of these times if im not fast enough. other than that it is very nice. just be careful if you have a hyper active boy like mine =)

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I had originally registered for another tub bit it was a major dissapointment. It leaked and it was not a good size for my little man.  I needed a tub that would be good for my very small son.  I decided on this tub and I have to say I am very happy.  This tub comes with a sling that can be used while they are newborn and thenyou can remove it and then use the tub in the other two positions that is made for.  Great tub and worth every penny  My son loves to take his baths in this since the sling makes him feel safe.  The other tub he cried like life as we know it was ending.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I hav\'nt had my son yet im only 5 months along but this is one of thwe many things I have waiting that I can not wait to try out. It is a lovely shade of blue and green both great baby colors for a boy/girl if you want to have the sex be a surprise. Good size for both newborn and toddler and the net is especially nice for newborn care while bath time. It has a flat surface so it will sit properly in the tub and has a plug which changes color to let you know if the water you have is too hot for your newborn. What more could you asak for.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub was a great purchase!! I wanted a simple tub that I didnt need a users manual to figure out how it works and didn\'t have mechanical parts that could get waterlogged and broken. This tub does not disappoint! The design is sleek and simple, fitting perfectly into the sink. My baby has always been long so would stick his spindly little legs out of the sling, but it definitely served its purpose until he got to big. Now he lounges in the tub itself and loves his tubby time! You still need to tip it over to get every last bit of water out but that\'s really no big deal. I also love the convenient place to put shampoo etc! Great little tub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I was given this tub as a shower gift.  I luv it!  I had registered on Babie\'s R Us\' website for a collapsable tub to make storage easier, and someone also gave that to me.  But in reading some reviews on it, some people said it leaked....well back to the store that went (unopened).  I kept this one because I liked the idea of the sling for a newborn and I liked the fact that it has the stopper that is supposed to change color if the water is too hot.  Well my daughter hated taking a bath in the sling.  Each time I put her in it, she looked terrified as if she was going to fall out of it.  Eventually, she started to hang a leg off the sling as if to brace herself (it was kinda funny to see her doing that :).  But I finally decided, enough is enough and started giving her baths without the sling and she now likes to take a bath.  I like the padding for her back and the contoured floor so she won\'t slip.  Now, I think she really looks forward to taking a bath.  Also, because of my odd shaped kitchen sink, the tub wouldn\'t fit into it, so I just set this tub up in her room on her changing table with a towel under it.  It works out really great.  I am very pleased with this tub and now, so is Anisa.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I am very satisfied with my purchase.My 2 months old really enjoy taking bath in it. its very comfortable for him and ease for me also.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I purchased this item for my second child, after having the First Years Four Stage Bath System.  I wanted a better quality tub that would comfortably support a newborn and then convert for toddler use (the Four Stage tub didn\'t support my first child as a newborn - she would slip and slide and she hated the tub - the tub also broke when I started using the upright toddler feature).  The Sure Comfort comes with a sling that is perfect for supporting newborns - they are comfortably cradled in the sling and they can be submerged in warm water, depending upon how you shorten or lengthen the straps on the sling.  My little guy is comfy, as he can sit in warm water and he doesn\'t flail around in the sling.  Since they can\'t slip in the sling, your hands are much freer for efficient bathing!  I had to keep one hand on my daughter at all times in the Four Stage tub when she was an infant because she would slide all over if I didn\'t.  The tub includes two different style seats molded in the plastic for both an older infant and a toddler.  I haven\'t used the older child seats yet, but they look like they will fit the bill nicely as my son grows.  My only comment is that the tub is on the larger side, but we just store it in our bathtub with the curtain closed during the day.  I highly recommend this tub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this tub and my baby loves this tub.  He used the sling as an infant and can easily sit on the inclined (infant) side of the tub now.  Pretty soon we will switch over to the toddler side of the tub.  It\'s great because I don\'t have to worry about him falling over and hitting his head on the actual tub or in the kitchen sink.The only problem that I had with it was the size, but I fixed that issue by drilling a small hole on the top of the inclined Infant seat and hung it on the wall to save floor space.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this tub. The sling makes giving my month old daughter a bath very easy. At first I filled it up full enough to touch her back but found that when she would slide herself down a little it would get to close to her mouth so I drained it a little and it works great. I love that is has the holder at the end as well. I put everything I need in it so I never forget anything.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I got this bathtub as a gift and I love how I can give my little baby girl a bath in the kitchen. This tub fits perfectly in my double sink. She is right at perfect height. My only complaint is the green back really doesn\'t prevent baby from sliding, I have to place a small hand towel behind her back for every bath, or else she is sliding all over.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Our 7 month old loves the bath! This tub is great when he was smaller we used the little sling with it and had him in our kitchen sink, but now that he sits up and loves to splash we put this tub in our big bath tub and let him splash all he wants. We use the recline side for his rubber duckie to slide into the tub with, he gets a kick out of it! Looks small but definitly has enouph arm and leg room for him.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I was not able to use the hammock feature in the beginning, because my daughter was almost 10lbs. The design is great, except for the sides where my baby\'s foot can get stuck. I was not happy about this at all. If I was not aware that her foot was in that position, I could have hurt her when taking her out of the bath. This tub was ok as a gift, but I would not recommend it due to the fact that it can seriously hurt the baby if you don\'t pay attention to his/her feet.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This was the third tub we bought for our little guy and it finally met all of our needs. We originally had a bath sling which was like a seat that you had to place in the regular tub. The downfall is that you had to fill your regular tub with 3-4 inches of water before the water would touch baby\'s skin. The sling that comes with this tub allows you to only have to fill the baby tub with a few inches of water and waste much less!The foamy green area that the older baby reclines on works great -- grips him so he is less likely to slip, and it is a soft cushioner from the hard plastic. The second tub we bought was an inflatable tub and this was my number one compaint. It was an import from Australia and plenty soft, but baby would continually slip until his head was in the water.Another great plus is that there are notches on the underside of the tub so it can set securley over your kitchen sink. A BIG plus to avoid hurting your back when bending over to wash baby. It\'s also nice that the drain plug doubles up as a water temperature tester. An easy visual check to make sure water isn\'t too hot. We love it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This worked out nicely at first.  Although I only gave it 4 stars, because my daughter seems to be comfortable in it for only 2-3 months.  The netting for the tub is very helpful(which you only use the first few weeks), and stress relieving for new parents with a slippery newborn.  It worked well, while it did.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: The sling on this tub is so helpful when bathing a newborn...perfect for nervous new parents!  My daughter is 9 months old now and still uses this tub.  Even though she has been able to sit by herself for quite some time now, it\'s reassuring to know that her back is well supported, and there is still enough room for her to play in the water.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: my son was never comfortable in this tub. even in the sling, he would slide past the little ledge made to keep him upright. he\'d end up with the plastic ledge halfway up his back. and then when he got a little bigger and we tried to use the seat...he\'d slip past the ledge even worse. i do NOT recommend that anyone get this tub...it\'s not worth the pain and trouble. for our next child i\'m going to get the safer bather...it has great reviews!!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I\'m a first time Mom and I was really worried when it was time to give my daughter her first bath. This tub made it so easy. The hammock craddled her perfectly. I never had to worry about her falling into the water while I washed her. As she grew the reclined tub was just great. My daughter loves bath time and I think it\'s in part because of this tub. Worth every penny.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We bought this tub to replace the tub to seat universal system, which was just a nightmare.  By the time we bought it, however, my daughter was too big to use the sling, but I fold it up and use it as a pillow for her head.  She had her first tearless bath recently, and I couldnt be happier! She stays in place even while kicking her feet, and I don\'t have to scoot her up constantly. The plug fits easily without leaking. Would definitely recommend.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Unquestionably the best bathtub to keep your little baby secure while you use both hands to bathe him.  I was so nervous to give my baby a bath by myself, but after we went and bought this tub, I\'ve never been more confident about it.  The hammock makes him feel very secure.  Great product!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We bought this bathtub for our 3 month old, who is too big for the cradle/hammock.  We placed him in the reclined seat side of the tub (for infants), and as soon as his head touched the back of the headrest he screamed - hard plastic is not comfortable for anyone, especially a little baby!  We were very disappointed and will dump this tub where it belongs - in the trash.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My little guy is only 6 weeks old, but so far I really like this tub.  I only used the sling until he was about 4 weeks old, but he was a 9 pounder.  Smaller babies should be able to use the sling longer.  His butt did seem to hit the plastic part in the middle while in the sling, but probably was due to his size, and it seemed to bother ME more than it did him!  Now I am using the infant reclining part, and it\'s working out well.  I use the tub on my bathroom sink counter, but he\'s already learning to splash, so will have to move it to the bathtub SOON!  Haven\'t used the toddler part yet, so can\'t comment.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I did not realize until it arrived that this can be used even after the baby is sitting up. I highly recommend this tub over the others I have seen in stores. This is sturdy, multi use and will last much longer.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We got this tub off our registry and we really like how versatile it is.  When we first brought our son home we would hold him in the football hold and just sponge bathe him but once he got a little older and stronger this tub was FANTASTIC.  You can use the sling when babies are very tiny and sponge them down there.  It easily fits into sinks and has a convenient spot to hold shampoos, soaps, etc.  Once our son was able to sit unsupported we transitioned this tub to our main bathtub.  It easily hold baby in place and has great back support too.  He\'s still using it at 10 months old.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is the best bathtub out there trust me! You don\'t even have to use the sling unless your child is very small. Our son can\'t hold his head up but he sits in it perfectly. The back cradles our son and his head perfectly. Don\'t waste your time and money on any other tub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: the best feature is the sling. it holds a newborn perfectly. my baby likes to hang one foot off the side and dip it in the warm water. there is a place that holds shampoo/baby wash. i\'ll be using this when my baby is a toddler too. another great feature is it has a groove in the back, where you can use it in a sink, or lean it against something to dry. it has a drain too. i don\'t use that though, because i put the tub on the floor. it\'s the best tub, and very affordable!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is the best tub out there. I have been using it ever since my son was born 4 1/2 months ago. He fits perfect in this tub and the no slide backing is great. Bath time has been easy and stress free with this tub. It has not leaked and it fits perfectly in the sink for easy access to my son. We will have to move this tub into our bath tub only because my son is starting to splah more and making a huge mess in the kitchen. But I plan on using this tub for a while since I can move my son over the the toddler side once he is sitting up better.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We had been using the Summer Infant fold away tub for the past few months, but while convenient and small, we\'ve found that our 3 month old is no longer comfortable in it.  So upon a few recommendations and reviews we bought the First Years Infant to Toddler tub.  Only thing though is that we give him baths on his changing table, since it\'s very hard on our backs to do in a bath tub and our sink is too small.  When I put water in the tub, there\'s a pretty bad leak that comes from the drain area underneath.  We returned it (purchased at Babies R Us) for another, thinking we had a defective one.  Second one had the same exact issue.  It\'s\' a shame since it doesn\'t seem that hard to make a tub with a drain that seals better (the fold-away we have is fine in that regard).  So while the little froggy drain is cute, it doesn\'t work.  So we\'re going to have return this one again and find a tub that is comfortable and can hold water properly.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: ...and we do too. We\'ve had this since our daughter was born and started using it around 3 weeks. The infant insert works absolutely great. We used it until she was 2 1/2 months old and around 9 1/2 pounds. Our LO is petite but very strong and at about 21 inches + she would arch her back and also push her feet  to the tub\'s edge when she was on the net, which was a little dangerous, so we decided to remove it and bathe her on the baby side since she cannot sit up on her own yet. She loves that side now! The water is deep enough to keep her warm and happy as she kicks her legs and arms, but not so deep as to reach over her belly. Still, someone needs to be there at all times. Needless to say the tub needs to be cleaned at least once a week. And a funny sorta funny note: If the water is warm your baby may poop while in it (she will definitely pee) so keep an eye on that too! I didn\'t give it 5 stars because it is kinda bulky and definitely does not fit under some (I would say many) tubs. For us that was not a problem, but I can see how others may consider this inconvenient

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this tub.  It was great for my daughter as a tiny newborn with the sling and great now as a seven month old.  She loves being able to sit by herself on the infant side.  All of the Grandparents have bought this tub for their houses also!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a great tub.  I bought it for my baby girl a couple of months ago.  I have only been using it with the sling which is great cos it keeps her from sliding into the tub and water.  The only thing that disappointed me is that the tub now comes in pink with a pink sling...so much cuter than this tub but it was not available at the time I had bought it.  Overall I would recommend this tub over others.  I had bought it because it was recommended my consumer reports as a good tub and I totally agree.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: When I received this item I was very pleased. It\'s sooo cute, the padding on the infant side is really soft and the material feels really durable. The blue was a bit darker than how it is in the picture but I love it just the same. The ONLY reason I didn\'t leave a 5 star rating is because my baby isn\'t due until October and I won\'t be using it until then. When I do I should be able to update my rating.I must say Amazon has left a really BIG smile on my face. I was not pleased with the way this item was packaged and when I contacted customer service their response was quick AND they compensated me! Great customer service and products will ALWAYS keep me coming back for more!!! On this note I give them 3 thumbs up!Thanks Amazon :-)

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have been using this bath tub for the past 4 months for my son. He is 5 months now. I just recently removed the mesh lining. This bath tub is really sturdy and has served its purpose well. However one of the bumps in the bath tub has bothered me. There is a high bump in the bath tub that would poke my little one in the tail bone when I had the mesh lining in and leave a red mark after I would get him out of the bath. Now that I have took the mesh lining out this bump seems to be a little too close only leaving him with a little space for him to sit on (if you look at the picture you can tell what I am talking about). So when I wash his bottom he has slipped right off it. Needless to say I have to be extra careful when I do this. Overall this bath tub is a decent product. I love that it adapts with the growth of your child.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This item was ordered because my son\'s wife had their second child and was in need of a new baby toddler bath tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is a lifesaver.  It allows you to bath your newborn without any help, thanks to the hammock feature.  It is also a great buy.  I would highly recommend this tub and no other.I would like to address some of the complaints I saw in some of the other reviews.  The size is fine.  You can\'t get a more "compact" tub.  After all, your baby does have to fit in it.  You should never trust the plug anyway.  Just use a good thermometer.  And all you have to do is turn the tub to get rid of any excess water after draining the majority of it by unplugging it.  So, there are no significant complaints with this product.  It does the job and well.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My newborn started using this tub at 10 pounds. He really likes it and it supports him well without the infant swing. It fits perfectly in the sink (I have a double sink). There is a nice drain, soap holder, and nonslip headrest. Don\'t get one of the ones that fold, just store this one in an extra bathroom tub or shower. Don\'t look any further!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I LOVE this tub.  It\'s the right size and fits right over my kitchen sink.  I simply position the tub over the sink, fill it, bathe my daughter, and drain the tub (has a drain plug in the bottom of the tub) all in one place.  My daughter is very comfortable in the newborn sling (she has used it since the day I brought her home from the hospital).  I highly recommend this tub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is great.  My son loves it.  It had that great net insert when they are newborn to keep them safe and allows plenty of room for splashing around when they get big!!!!The contoured bottom prevents wiggly babies from slipping in the water.  We love it!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This really is a great first tub! I have one for my daughter in pink and we just moved from the sling. She never had any issues with the sling. She never slipped out of it so that\'s great! She is sitting up just fine now without the sling and can still be bathed easily.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We\'re now on our second baby using this tub, so it has been a great investment. My older daughter used it until she was [....] because we didn\'t have a bathtub in our house, and she outgrew the kitchen sink (and she was 100th percentile for height, so there\'s plenty of room!). The sling is excellent to use before the umbilical cord falls out, then the incline is perfect for newborn until they can sit up. Plenty of room, a little shelf to hold your soap or rubber ducky, and a handy drain plug. Highly recommend this!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this product.  I originally received the 4 In One Bath Station that you can pull upward into a seated position for older babies.  This item is really only useful for newborns through 2-3 months.  My little one (8lbs-3ozs at birth) had out grown this tub by the time she was 21/2 months.  She would dangle her little leg over the edge, or get her toes wedged into the blue arm rest.  The suctions cups didn\'t always work. It holds very little water. It was a truggle to use.I brought the Sure Comfort Tub a few days ago, and it has change bath time for my little one.  Bath time is more enjoyable for her and far easier on me now. I love the snuggly net, and although she\'s too big for the net I still use the padded head rest. I love the safty feature that warns you if the water is too hot.  I love the fact that I can still use this tub as my daughter grows into her toddler years.  If I had it to do all over again this tub would have been my first and only choice.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My baby is now almost 11 months old and is probably too big to really bathe in this tub anymore; however I continue to use it because it\'s just so easy to pop it on top of the kitchen sink and fill it up. He sits up in it now and splashes and enjoys bath-time. We bought several other bath tubs and this one won out, hands down.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: What else can I say? I like it for these reasons: It is very cheap. When I went to buy it, I was expecting it to be a lot more, since it seemed to have so many great features. The bath cradle is a great idea, and the non-slip head (and butt!) rests just makes life easier when you have to bath the baby by yourself and don\'t have any help! Just a footnote: In my opinion, it is not too bulky like someone else was saying (you can\'t get much smaller if you want any room to put your baby in).

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I really just have two complaints about this tub.  First, it is bulky.  Fortunately, we have two bathrooms.  I just give the baby a bath in the guest bathroom and leave the baby tub inside the big bathtub to dry.  That way it is out of our way and we don\'t have to mess with it between baby\'s baths.  Second, it didn\'t fit in our kitchen sink when we lived in our apartment.  So, I just put the baby tub inside our bathtub and bathed her that way.  It\'s a little hard on the back and knees, but we will have to deal with that when she outgrows the baby tub, anyway.  Otherwise, I like it.  My daughter is ten months old, and we still use the baby tub.  It saves water, and it keeps her from crawling all over the place.  If I didn\'t have the baby tub, she would be crawling and walking all over during her bath, and who knows how many times she would have hurt herself!  Also, I haven\'t had the color-changing plug change colors on me, but my hubby said it worked for him once.  I can\'t say how this tub compares to others, but I have been happy with it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: When i recieved this tub i was so excited. The sling makes it so easy to wash a newborn without worring how slippery they can be. I have two hands free and it makes tubby time super easy and enjoyable. Now that my son is older and a little bit more wiggle i put the sling back on so to keep him where i want him! Its a must have for a newborn.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I used this tub for almost 18 months.  It\'s large but not too overized like other tubs I have seen. My only complaint is the hammock.  When my daughter was in it, her back would hit the ridge in the tub.  I only used the hammock for about a month.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I bought this when my son was born. It fits our single kitchen sink perfectly and he has enjoyed his bath since then. After he could sit up good, I bathed him in a tub but my mom likes it better than a tub because it would use less water and maybe easier for her to wash him that he wouldn\'t move around too much. (She watches him during day time). So when I bath my son now, he would always brings this tub to me because that\'s how he is bathed during the weekday so I\'m sure he still enjoys it too.I like this product has different bathing positions and an area to put soap/toys. We did use the sling few times when he was born, slightly over 7 lb but he out grew the sling so fast so mostly he was bathed without the sling.Oh, you have to be careful when pulling the plug. My nanny broke it after few use (she is not the most careful person in the world anyway) so it\'s not so easy to unplug it anymore. My mom just lives with it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: The infant mesh hammock is great for our baby girl. The size is also good. It is bulky to store, but she\'ll only be using it for a relatively short period of time, so it\'s a non issue. I really like this tub and highly recommend it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Perfect tub. I love that it can be used two ways for different ages.  I cannot wait to use it

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: One minor complaint--the little section for rinse water is MUCH too small.  I think it barely holds 2 cups of water!  I don\'t use it--I just put a big pitcher of water to the side of the tub and pour it over the baby\'s body in order to rinse him well.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I bought this for a friends baby shower. She uses it every day. Her and her baby love it! It\'s perfect for them. I just wish it would\'ve came in a more secure box.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My little one is 12 weeks.  I have not had any trouble using it in our sink at all.  She loves it and is very comfortable in it.  She still sits in the newborn section but without the hamock only because she\'s outgrown it, soon we will be able to sit her on the infant side.  It does not leak and fits conveniently in our laundry room.  I would recommend this tub to anyone, especially considering the fact that I never thought I would ever do so much research all for a baby tub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this tub....the sling is perfect for my newborn daughter....she absolutely loves taking a bath and does not fuss whatsoever. I do not have any other experience with baby tubs other than this one and i love love love it! the only thing i would want different is a draining hole on both sides instead of one side, but that is very minimal

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My son loves this tub and really enjoys bathtime.  That alone gets it five stars.We used the sling for maybe four weeks and it was very helpful.  Then used the infant side until about five months or so.  Our son loved to splash around and play with bath toys and still does now that we use the infant and the toddler sides.  He likes to sit all the way up in the tub on the toddler side too.  I would recommend this to anyone.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I just love this bath. We got it for my first son, and I enjoyed bathing him in it even few months beyond his first birthday. I used the infant side for the first few months then switched to the sitting side for the rest of the time.Sadly I didn\'t get to try the sling as we accidentally lost it even before he was born. But I believes it was Avery nice addition to it.I would have kept this tub for my second but I had to discard of it as we were moving coast to coast.We actually tried another one with my second but didn\'t like it as much although it was sold for a higher price.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is the best tub out there, we have 4 kids and have had several different tubs, this has been the best.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tube showed up with great packing and a good price.  I love the drain and my baby feels very secure in the tub during her bath.  Its actually the same bath they used at the hospital when my baby was born.  I don\'t use the sling ...

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub has been great since our son was brought home from the hospital. It came with a little mesh thing that goes over the top of it for newborns, and then when the baby is a little bigger they can sit right in the seat. I\'ve loved it because I\'ve always felt our son was very secure in the tub. He\'s always sat up pretty well in it and I haven\'t had to be overly fearful of him slipping out of position and falling into the water. We got this blow up duck tub that is supposed to be fun and safe, but my son kept slipping in the monstrousity of a tub, and I went right back to this. I want something to transition him into the adult tub, but this has been great for the past 7 months!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this tub!  The hammock was great for both of my preemie twins.  They are both almost 6 months old now and we just took out the hammock so they can splash a little bit more. Of course we have to be that much more attentive since it was easy to rely on the hammock keeping them up out of the water (although we never left their side).  Now they slide down a lot easier and we have to keep pushing their bums onto the little seat but they love the freedom.  The plug is nice too since it is heat sensitive so we don\'t make the water too hot.  We give them a bath every night as part of their bedtime routine and I am so glad that this is the tub that we have!!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We love this tub..the great accessory is the hammock that attaches for newborn use. Being new parents, it is a little overwhelming trying to hold a soapy slippery baby while trying to also bathe her. This hammock keeps the baby slightly submerged in the water, while keeping her nestled in the hammock. Truly makes bathing an infant a much easier task then if you were trying to hold them yourself. Fits right over the kitchen sink (we have double sink and it fits perfectly) Not sure about the accuracy of the water plug that is supposed to change colors if the water is too hot...better to just test the water yourself to be safe.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: As most of the other reviews said, this is a great tub.  Only thing I have to add is that you should also buy a tub thermometer.  The rubber stopper on the tub is supposed to change color if the water is too hot for baby-but the water has to be way too hot before it changes noticeably (it does change slightly, but you can\'t tell through the water).  Otherwise, this tub has been perfect for us.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: i used this with my daughter from day one till about 7 months. it was wonderful. the infant sling was the best. my plug never changed colors, but you shouldn\'t depend on the plug telling you if the water is too hot.  i never had a problem with my daughter floating like other people stated. she could have stayed in the tub longer but we switched her to the regular bathtub so she could have more room to play. i highly recomend this bath tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We bought this for my second child & it was MUCH better than the tub we had used with our first.  The detachable net made newborn bathing so much easier & allowed us to avoid getting the cord wet. My son is 10 months & still fits comfortably in the tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My newborn daughter still isn\'t too sure about bath time yet but she seems to like it. The newborn net has been extremely helpful in keeping my daughter from having too much water around her. I can\'t wait to keep using it for when she gets older...since it does grow w/her. I\'d recommend to anyone that has a small baby.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have used this tub for both of my sons.  The sling works beautifully especially for the first baths where you can\'t get the umbilical stump wet.  Once the umbilical stump fell off the sling is removed and there are two sides to the tub one where the baby reclines and the other side so the baby can sit.  The sling is adjustable to let the baby sit as high or as low as you want in the water.  There is a plug in the bottom that is good for easy draining..however I normally just dump it.  The plug also changes color if the water is too hot...however I never relied on this.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: By far the best baby bathtub out there! I highly recommend it especially at this price.  You won\'t regret it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We have used this tub since my son came home from the hospital.  I like the tub because it has the 2 sides to it, it has a non slip backing to it, it has a plug that changes colors when the water gets too warm.Get this tub for your newborn.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I changed my mind on which baby bathtub to register for several times before I decided on this one. It turned out to be a great choice for us!For the first month, we used the hammock-type newborn attachment. I was too nervous to put my son in the tub without it while I was still getting the hang of things. He never looked quite comfortable in it though; his chin was bent into his chest. I adjusted the hammock several times without much improvement. He didn\'t seem to mind, though, and the hammock was a great help.Once I moved him to the infant (reclined) side of the tub, he looked more comfortable. His bottom slips out of place sometimes when he arches his back, but never to the point where he\'d slide all the way down. (Of course, you should never leave your baby unattended in any type of tub.)I use this tub on my bathroom counter, but I can see how it would fit conveniently in the kitchen sink. However, bathtime at our house is after dinner, at which time our kitchen sink is usually full of dishes! I fill it from the bathroom sink using a large cup, and fill the sink itself with clean water to rinse. I put some baby wash in the small reservoir on the end of the tub and add warm water. I use this soapy water to wash the baby instead of putting the soap directly on the washcloth or on his skin. It wouldn\'t be very convenient to use this basin for rinse water because it doesn\'t hold much. I rinse with water from the sink using the same big cup I filled the tub with.The drain plug is very secure and we\'ve had no problem with leaks. When bathtime is over and baby is safe in his crib, I move the edge of the tub over the sink and pull the plug to let it drain. Then we store the tub in the regular bathtub!This is a good tub for a good price.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I ordered for a friend. She got it and said it was super cute. She has not said she has had any problems with it. So I guess its good.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a great tub.  My  3 month son loves it.  It\'s very comfortable and easy to use.  Highly recommended!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This product was highly recommend to me! Got it today and I can see why. It\'s sturdy and compact. Just the right size and the baby can use it from infant to toddler. The price was so worth it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a great tub for babies :) My son is 3 months old and he enjoys every bath and it is comfortable and safe.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I really love this tub. It fits well in my sink and my baby fits well in it. He\'s only 12 lbs. now, so I\'m not sure how he\'ll do when he gets bigger, but for now it\'s great.I tried using the sling the first time and he really hated it, though. I think it was the feeling of being in the air, maybe? Ayways, I just hold onto him and he does fine.It\'s a good price and very practical.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: The First Years Infant to Toddler tub with New Born Sling is just great.  I could not believe, looking at it at first whether it would be comfortable for our newborn, but the sling is just great, and baby loves the warm water and fits comfortably in the sling as mom enjoys bathing her.It is built to place on the middle post or section between a double sink and the tub is rather sturdy when placed on our double sink, although like bathing our newborn in a warmer environment than a kitchen.  The tub is also not too heavy if you are carting it with enough water for the baby to bathe in.  There is a plug at the bottom for easy draining.  There are basically three ways to seat a babe. The sling for the new born a more padded seat for an infant to recline in and a more sturdy seat for the toddler to sit up in if you wish to use it.When you think of it, for the money, this Infant to Toddler tub will save you in the long run until your little one is ready for the larger tub.  Great gift idea and should be on every moms registry.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I got the First Years 4 stage bathtub at my baby shower and I didn\'t really like it.  As soon as he could be submerged he would slide and wriggle all around the tub.  It didn\'t hold much water and he could splash most of it out anyway.  The adjustable leg broke after a few uses.  I just got this tub and used it for the first time today and Zach and I both LOVE IT!  It\'s sturdy, holds lots of water, has the handy butt bump to help him sit up and it\'s not at all slippery where his little back lies.  I HIGHLY recommend this to any new parent, I wish I had got it from the start![.]

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a fantastic baby bathtub. Fits perfectly in our kitchen sink, and can be plopped into the grownup tub, too. It gets baby through all stages, from infant to toddler. The sling/hammock that comes with it is particularly good for newborns/infants. The sling can be tossed in the washing machine. The tub has a nice holder on the end for bottles of soap and shampoo. Great tub. Can\'t imagine anything better.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: For my first child, I used a Safety 1st tub (which has its issues, too, but was for the most part pretty good).  We had to purchase a new one for our second child and this was the only brand available at the store where we did our baby shopping.I found the sling to be difficult to adjust, and it didn\'t seem to allow our baby to be in the water while being bathed - he was sort of suspended above it. Once he became too big for the sling, I moved him to the tub itself and found the shape of it to be completely useless.  I don\'t understand how the manufacturer could expect so many different sizes of babies to fit in that shape - he pushed up on the end of the tub with his feet, and it was difficult to keep a good grip on him while bathing him because the tub did nothing to help hold him up.  After a few attempts at using the tub, I threw it out and went straight to the store to get the Safety 1st tub.  Now I remember why I like it so much.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I received this tub as a baby shower gift when I had my first child (we now have 2 toddlers!).  This was a gift that I had actually registered for, thinking it would be very useful.  I was WRONG!!!!  Everytime I tried to use it, my baby slipped around and kept going under water!  For financial reasons I (UNFORTUNATELY) had to use it with both of my children, but I would absolutely never recommend this tub!!!  The slipping and floating around happened with both my babies, which made bathing them a 2 person job.  In my opinion this tub is a huge safety hazard and inconvenience!!!!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is great.  My 5 month old still fits in the adjustable sling.  I was very scared to abthe him at first, but when he was only a couple of weeks old the sling held him securely.  The narrow sides prevent him from wiggling out of it and the depth allows room for bathing.  The well in front is nice to keep clean rinse water.  You do need to turn the tub on its side (or upside down) after bathing to drain it completely, and I am amzed that they promote the sink-size on this--I can\'t imagine it fitting in the sink with my baby and the faucet.  Overall it is an excellent purchase--the best tub on the market.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I read a lot of reviews of other tubs before putting this tub on my registry and I am so glad that I ended up with this one.  The sling is wonderful for my newborn and she just loves taking a bath in it.  It fits perfectly in our kitchen sink and we keep the soap and a sponge in the space designated for such items.  Plus, the plug changes color if the water is too hot.  All in all, a great product for a reasonable price!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I received the tub in the specific time frame. Haven\'t been able to use it since baby isn\'t here yet but will revise my review if problems arise. Like the fact that it converts to toddler ages. But wish that it came in other gender neutral colors.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I understand the need for padding in these things, but geez, you\'d think someone could come up with a way to keep mold/mildew/icky smells from developing.  The spongy green pad has started to smell after a couple months of use.  Also, the pad in the newborn sling got smelly very quickly and I ditched it after about a month.  I love the size of the tub, as well as the drain and the extra little storage area at the end of the tub.  My 4-month old doesn\'t sit very well in the slanted part yet as his butt slides right off the bum-rest.  If that were a little bigger it would help.  As it is now I just keep readjusting him during his bath.  It won\'t be a problem when he gets bigger.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have had friends who said they wished they had just gone with this tub in the beginning, rather than trying several and finally settling on this tub.  We were happy with it from day one.  We used it in the bedroom with the newborn hammock for the first couple of weeks.  We have used it in several different kitchen sinks, and it fits really well.  It is definitely a back-saver -- we tried using it inside the big bathtub, and we nearly broke our backs trying to bathe him that way.  We continued to use it once my baby could sit in the toddler side, around 4 or 5 months.  I\'ve heard people say that their baby was "too big" for the tub, but my boy was always big and long for his age, and he never had any problems.  He was around 10 months old when we finally tried to find a bath seat for him to use in the big bathtub (see my other reviews), but we would gladly have continued to use the Sure Comfort.  The only real reason for switching is my son was getting way too active, and in our cramped kitchen we spent most of the bath prying our little monkey\'s hands off the faucet, etc., and hauling him back into the tub.  He was just ready for the big tub experience.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: my son loves his tub.  We\'re still using it and he\'s 15 months and 23 lbs, 33 inches tall.  I think he\'ll outgrow it soon, but it is safe and fun.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I got this for my first baby and I loved it up until he grew too big. The hammock was perfect for his first bath and it fit in my kitchen sink perfectly. I loved that you could use it in 3 different stages.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
