review: This bath was a good buy for the price. It is great for newborns. My only complain is that he has grown out of it already and now I need to buy something bigger. He is only 4 months old, but he is a large baby. I got my $17 worth out of it though!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: When it comes to baby tubs, you don\'t need a bunch of useless gadgets that are most likely going to break after a short use.  Fold up tubs leak, why bother?  I don\'t need one with the shower attachemnt since I have a spray hose on my sink. I love this tub.  It fits my sink, it has a good age range, the temp plug is a nice feature, and I didn\'t have to spend a lot of money.  Keep it simple, it\'s a bath tub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: this is a nice tub for the first 2 months of your baby\'s life. the green cushion is nice and soft, and there is no need for towel so that the baby does not slip. The big problem is that once the baby grows a little, the tub gets too small, and the baby is not covered in water. Only legs are covered. So they can\'t play, or splash. I recommend buying Eurotub instead - it is bigger, and also non-slippery, and has a better support, plus you can actually have enough water to cover your baby totally. Plus it might actually work into toddler years, but who knows...

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub was nice for the first 5 months. We used it in the kitchen sink and then in the bathtub. The mesh hammock was perfect for when she was newborn. The infant side was great after that. The \'toddler\' side I don\'t know about. After she was sitting up on her own it was hard to bath her in it on either side. We got a new tub-the big ducky inflateable one available at target. So it lasted for 5 months which is good for the price, but not beyond that

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: When my son was a newborn this item was great, we never really used the sling so that was kind of useless,but when he could sit up he didn\'t like being in the laydown tub..So I got him the safety first chair for the bath tub and he loves that! So yes I would recommend the tub for new borns, but not sure on infants who can sit up

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We have used this bath since the beginning with our son and we love it.  I love that I can put it in the tub or I can use it in the sink.  Mostly we use it in the tub and fill it with the shower hose.  I love the basin as I keep the clean non soapy towel in there in case we need to use it to get soap off him.  I love the lever on the bottom as he sits resting against it and I don\'t have to worry about him slipping and sliding under the water.  With this tub I am (and have from the beginning) very comfortable bathing my son by myself.  My son is almost 5 months old and has loved kicking and splashing (without sliding down)since he was 2 months old.  Once most of the water is drained, we just turn it over and let it air dry through the night and take it out in the morning so we can shower.  It is slim enough that it rests at it\'s tallest between the toilet and the shower.  I would recommend this piece to everyone.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I bought this bath because of the infant sling. It works wonderfully-- she doesn\'t get her face wet and I am able to wash her without supporting her head constantly.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I bought this tub because it was highly rated by consumer reports for safety.  It is very safe.  It is so safe that the baby has trouble getting comfortable.  The wedge in the bottom keeps the baby well above the water which means s/he won\'t drown but also can\'t get submerged in the water.  My baby keeps trying to scootch down in the water to get comfortable but can\'t quite manage.  I know that safety is paramount, but since I am standing with the baby the entire time, I feel like I could go with more comfort and still be perfectly safe.  I don\'t dislike this tub enough to replace it with a different one.  However, if I had it to do over again, I would pick a different tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have been using this tub for 9 months with my little girl. She loves it, but I noticed that on the newborn side, the corners that are meant to latch on to the sink fill with... something? I always drain and flip the tub right away but I can\'t seem to get into those two corners to clean because they are so deep. I am a little concerned about bacteria filling in those spots and I plan on switching to a blow up duck tub I also got for my shower.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: es perfecta porque tienes la opcion de utilizarla facilmente en un recien nacido,tambien tienes espacio para agua limpia,o lo que tu desees..y a medida que el bebe vaya creciendo tiene espacio suficiente para el.I love it !!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Great tub for newborns. The net makes the shower process easier and my baby feels safe. Great size and fits on top of small counters. I would recommend this item.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I loved this tub while my twin girls were small enough to use the mesh.However, when they grew too big for the mesh, they used the slant side, which was a problem because it\'s flat (vs concave) and the girls would slide from side to side since there was nothing to keep them in place.  I would have to roll up a towel to keep them from sliding to the side & having their head/shoulder wedged uncomfortably against the side.Also, if the water level is high enough to keep the babies warm, their butts tended to float up and over the seat area which makes them slide down into the water.  I had to keep a hand on their bottoms the whole time to keep them from sliding down.When they were old enough to use the sitting-up side, I loved this tub once more.  The notch on this side kept my babies safe & secure.  The babies loved sitting up & splashing in their tub.I just gave this tub away, since my girls can sit up in the big tub now.  I probably should have kept it for travel, but too late now.  Overall I am not quite happy with this tub for the above reasons.  I listed some other pros and cons below:Pros:This works well with our under-mount kitchen sink with a divider in the middle.  This tub has a notch on one side to accommodate sink dividers, which is nice because it keeps the tub stable and angles the tub toward the center of the sink which is key for not having tub overflow all over your kitchen counter.The plug changing color if the water is too hot is a nice feature, though kind of silly because 1) who wouldn\'t test the water with a hand? 2) it doesn\'t turn color until the water is already too hot for me, let alone a baby, and 3) it\'s way at the bottom, so if the tub was full you wouldn\'t be able to see the plug well at all.The mesh sling is nice, dries well, and is very easily adjustable and supportive of baby.Cons:(potential con) If you have a drop-in sink with a rim, such as our bathroom sink is, this tub will not sit over it.The inclined seat back is flat, rather than concave, so that baby can slide from side to side and get stuck with her head against the wall.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is the best tub ever! We bought this tub for our 3rd baby girl and it\'s great! The sling for the tub is awesome and we still use it and she\'s almost 3 months old. Its a nice, deep tub and perfect for an infant and then a toddler. Drains nicely, no mildew problems and has a little side area to put soap, wash cloths, etc..Very practical tub, no bells and whistles, but sometimes that\'s the best way to go!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My baby was 1 month early and didn\'t fit any of the tubs I previously tried.  I went to babies-r-us to try yet another tub and another shopper recommended that I try this one and I love it!  The hammock feature is the best part, my little one fits snuggly in the cushiony net and seems perfectly secure.  I also like having the extra space for soap and shampoo.  It\'s perfect!  You won\'t need another tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: A friend recommended this tub to me and I am so glad I bought it. My daughter is only 2 weeks old and I\'ve just started using this tub. Not only does she love bath time, but I find this tub to be more helpful to myself. The newborn net which is securely attached over the tub itself allows my daughter\'s bottom to stay warm in the water while her head is cradled well above the water level. Her positioning in the tub allows me the freedom to wash her while she lays safely in the net. I would recommend this tub to others who are shopping for bathtime essentials. I love it, my daughter loves it, and it makes bathtime safe and fun.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My husband and I love this tub for our baby.  The infant sling is very useful.  It is easy to empty out and wash as well.  We like the stopper that changes color if the water is too hot.  Overall, a great tub and I wouldn\'t use anything else!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I looked at several different tubs, including some more expensive ones, before purchasing this one.  Now I am very glad I did not buy one of the more pricey models.  I love this tub.  My daughter was only 5 pounds when she was born, and I was afraid she might be too small for a tub, but this one worked really well.  In fact, mine did not come with the cradle attachment, and it still worked well.I did not have any trouble with the plug not changing colors.  Mine always changes if the water is too hot.I also love that the tub can be used anywhere.  I use it on a small vanity in the baby\'s bathroom and have plenty of room.  I would definitely recommed this product.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: A friend passed her tub on to me after I complained about my tub-- the First Years convertible tub/seat which is AWFUL! It\'s so shallow that there\'s barely enough water to get the baby\'s butt wet! this was much better and had two positions -- newborn and infant. Now my 6 month old can sit and splash and not freeze because he\'s in two inches of water. Wish this had a suction cup on the bottom to keep it from sliding on smooth, wet surfaces.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I really love this tub!  My daughter is 5 months old now and will be able to use this tub for a long time still.  It doesn\'t show it in the picture, but it comes with a newborn net that snaps on to the tub.  The net is machine washable and very easy to use.  I highly recommend this tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have to agree with the others that said this tub is not very comfortable. I\'m not sure what kind of baby fits well in this, but ours hasn\'t since the day he was born and he\'s 4 months now. We have been using the sling and it keeps most of his body out of the water, so he gets cold so we have to keep a washcloth over his body and keep pouring warm water over it just to keep him warm during his bath. This make bathtime a 2 person job.The hump that\'s supposed to keep them from sliding down when you\'re NOT using the sling is positioned directly in the middle of his back so it pokes at his back the entire time.Last week we figured he was finally big enough not to use the sling, but it was worse. He kept sliding down and we had to put it back on despite my complaints from above.I do not recommend this tub at all and am very disappointed. I don\'t know why it has such high reviews.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this tub. My son took his first bath in this tub and we are still using it 10 months later. It fit on the counter next to the sink, in the kitchen sink and now we use it in the bathtub. It is really a great tub and affordable. Don\'t waste your money on the tubs with all the fancy gadgets all you need  is this, a rubber ducky and a cup to rinse off the soap.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I like this tub for the same reasons other moms like it; the infant sling worked great!  We received two tubs at my shower, so we keep one at home and one at my mother-in-law\'s home.  She has this one, and I noticed that it was easier than the one I have at home because she has support from both sides.  We have to put not too much water since she has started to splash all over the place. So we started to give her baths in the bathroom  tub.  My daughter seems to enjoy it, so I would recommend it to others out there.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I like this particular tub but I found one fatal flaw-whoever designed it put the drain on the bottom of the tub flush with the tub or sink.  To drain out excess water or drain period you end up spilling or having to bail out the water with a cup.  I find the tubs with the drains on the sides work much better with less mess.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: For a small price you are getting a great product. Our son loves the tub. He is taking his bath nearly every day.It is very easy and secure to give him a bath with this. You have two hands instead of one and you both will have more fun at bath time :)

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a great bathtub for a newborn and an older baby (but not a toddler).  It fits nicely in most standard kitchen sinks, so you can bathe your baby comfortably.  There is non-slip padding on the newborn (recline) side, so the newborn doesn\'t slide to the side.  There is also a raised thing in the middle of the tub that keeps the baby sitting in place and prevents him from slipping.But to call it a "toddler" tub is laughable!  Sure, the toddler can fit in there, but he\'ll be sitting in a little puddle of water.  We used this tub for my daughter until she was about 8 months old.  Then the tub started looking and feeling too small for her - not much room for her bath toys and not much water to splash. After that, we got a bigger tub called "Euro Bath".

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Can\'t find nothing wrong with this tub.  It\'s a nice size, it\'s well made and perfect design to help me bath my baby boy.  Great tub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub works great!  My baby loves being in it, and it is the perfect size and angle for him to lay back in.  I haven\'t used the toddler side yet.  I just put the tub on my kitchen counter and fill it using the pull-out sprayer from my kitchen faucet.  I have had no trouble with the plug leaking or any other problems.  I highly recommend it!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I registered for this tub and from what I read it was one of the better ones. However, the tub does not fit in my sink and it is a double sink. We have to angle it and so it does not sit level. We tried every possible way but the tub is just too big for our sink.Also, the hammock while it is a good idea seems a huge disappointment. Our baby kept sliding down in it and it literally takes two people to bath baby. One person has to hold him up, otherwise he slides all the way down to be laying with the water level and the second person has to wash him. Also, the hammock gets ICE cold when wet. Since the hammock doesn\'t sit directly in the water, except in the center, the padded head cushion gets wet and gets very cold. I was very shocked after the first time we used it.Even though we have used it twice now and baby is only 14 days old I am not happy at all with this tub to date. It is too big for our sink, the hammock gets cold, and baby slides down into the water.Also, I have never noticed the plug to change color... we have always used the rubber duckie with the word HOT on it.... that has indicated water being too hot while the tub plug never changed.Would I get this tub again? Seeing that this has the highest ratings out there probably, but I would not put high expectations on it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Gave this to my friend as a gift and she loves it. Says that it is a great tub for her little one. It\'s great because it also allows some room for your child to grow into it, which allows more use.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: She loves her bath in this tub.  I can wash her hair and she feels secure and wants to play.  I like the stopper so I can let the water out when I am finished.  I can sit it in the regualr bathtub or over the kitchen sink.  This works just great.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is the ONLY tub to buy..... My son used it to 10 months but loved the bath time so much he wanted the reg tub to move around.... He loved the security of the hammock and so did I for my own piece of mind... the more expensive ones are gimmicks.. You don\'t need them... this gets you by just fine!!!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I bought this back in 2009 when I had my first baby. It fit perfectly in the kitchen sink and worked well for it\'s purpose. Didn\'t use the sling long, but that worked perfectly, too. If I have another anklebiter, I\'ll use it again and then pass it on.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I received two bathtubs at my shower.  We tried this one over the other simply because it would fit over a kitchen sink well.  This turned out to be so great that we returned the other fancier tub.  I loved the hammock for newborns!  I loved the temperature colored drain spout.  I have a temperature duck also, but liked having the back up built in to the tub in case I misplaced the duck.  Now our daughter is in the sitting up stage for bathing and this tub still works out great!  Highly recommend it!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This thing is great and works really well...except with newborns. Newborns tend to slide down into the middle until they\'re laying almost flat which really defeats the purpose. After about three or four months though, it works great, and I like how it grows with them.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Received this as a shower gift and it is great.  It fits on the edges of our kitchen sink (not IN the sink) and the sling was fantastic until my daughter was about 2.5 months (she is long at 24"); kept her from sliding down into the water too much.  Has a drain if you need it (so you don\'t have to pick up the tub when it\'s full of water) and has a little spot for soap bottles and a washcloth to keep them handy during bathtime.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a great tub.  The newborn sling feature is key!  We are still using the sling with our 12-lb 3-month-old.  It\'s nice because you can then use both hands to bathe the baby instead of having to hold him up.  The other great feature is that it is designed to fit over half of a double kitchen sink, so you can stand up while bathing the baby instead of kneeling over your bathtub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I love this tub. My 1 month old loves taking a bath in it. The sling is perfect for small bodies. She does slide down in it throughout the bath but she fits so snuggly into it that it makes it ok.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My son is seven months old and still loves his baby tub.  Although he outgrew the newborn sling within a few months, he felt comfortable in the tub, and continues to enjoy his nightly baths.  I recommend this tub to new moms and dads everywhere.  It\'s such a great price for the quality.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I looked and looked for a tub for my daughter-in-law to bathe our new grandson.  One that fit on the kitchen sink.  I finally ordered this one and our newborn loves it.  He hated his bath until we tried this.  Now he is cozy and comfortable.  Great product and much better than the ones we had when I was raising babies!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I actually like the tub fine in terms of functionality. My problem with it is that, even though every night after bath time, I turn it around and let the sling and the tub air dry, MOLD is forming in the foamy part of the sling!!!Its just so dangerous and unhealthy. I imagine a different material would be helpful. Maybe all just the mesh?Anyone else have this problem?

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Everytime I give my son a bath the rough sides of this tub rub the skin off of his little toes causing them to bleed terribly bad. And since you cant keep a baby from kicking his feet I would suggest a different tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My friends suggested this tub for my baby.  I bought it and thought that it was a great price.  My baby lays really well in the little hammock that comes with it.  Great price, great product...you should get it!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: The infant sling allows you to keep your tiny newborn from being submerged in the water and allows them a relaxed bath time (mommy and daddy felt less stress too about potential slippage).  He is now 5 months old and gets excited when he sees the blue tub coming out of the closet.  The only downside of this tub is the storage issue.  It is pretty big and bulky, but our house has become a baby toy box anyway, what\'s one more bathtub?

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: When I was looking for a bathtub, I wanted something nice and fancy... big mistake!! I tried 3 different bathtubs, expensive ones, I decided to give this one a try (besides, I didn\'t want to spend more money on bathtubs)  I\'m glad I bought this one...What I like about this bathtub:*Size is perfect with enough space even for a big baby*Foam on back and seat*Perfect reclining angle*Back support for sitting babies*Water level reaches your baby\'s ribs with a small amount of water (I love to take care of my environment)*Compartment for bathing articles.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a really nice tub for my 3 month old baby.  Only thing that we didnt like is the net/sling thing for newborns doesn\'t really work well, it was easier to give her sponge baths.  Otherwise we love it!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My 6 week old loves her tub time! The thing that first attracted me to this particular tub was the infant cradle/sling.  It is a machine washable netting complete with headrest that extends the length of the tub.  It is great for those beginning sponge baths and continues to be useful as your little one learns to completely control their head and neck.  No more bathing with one hand as you try to keep the baby upright with the other hand. This tub also has an added safety feature, a drain that begins to turn white as the water gets hotter.  This makes it so much easier to gage wether the temperature is too hot for your precious baby.  There is also a spot on the front of the tub where you can sit baby bath, washcloths, etc.  I am so happy with our decision. This is a wonderful tub and I would recommend it to anyone.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I registered and recieved the Safer Bather from Leachco because I did not want a bulky tub taking up precious space in my house.  While I like the safer bather, I was breaking my back bending over the tub so I decided to get this.  It fits perfectly over my sink, holds my 4 month old securely and has space for items I don\'t want to get (too) wet!  One of the reviewers said her drain plug didn\'t change color when the water was too hot, hers must have been defective because mine does change to white.  I actually filled it with hot water one day because I realized I had never seen it change and wanted to test it.  It passed the test!  Buy this tub, it\'s worth double the selling price.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This was good for about a month. We have a VERY large baby. He was born 9 lbs 3 ozs and 21 inches; now is 6 months and 27.5 lbs and 30.5 inches. We used the newborn sling for the first month or so and it was great. Once he outgrew the sling, he was already too big for the "infant" side and didn\'t sit up well enough for the "toddler" side. So, if you are expecting a bigger baby, I wouldn\'t recommend this tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is a really great tub!  My sone has already grown out of the sling...but the tub is even better without it!  We would never choose another tub!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We bought this little baby tub when my daughter was just born and used the sling for the first 2 months - it\'s been so perfect! My husband has a bad back and it will be very difficult for him to lean over the regular tub when she outgrows this, so we will be using it as long as possible.  My daughter was 8lbs 6 oz at birth and fit perfectly into the sling.  It dries quickly and is a no muss no fuss operation.  She\'s 7 months now and loves her baths - splashes and kicks and has a ball in the tub.  I just put a towel down on the floor by the kitchen sink - no mess to clean up.  The  spongey stick on no-slip decals where she sits and leans back are great - she doesn\'t slip and slide all over the place.  Just rinse the tub out and air dry, it\'s ready for her next bath in minutes.  We had a single basin sink - extra big - and now have a double sink  and this little tub fit them both great. Highly recommend this tub, it will save your back and arms and make bathtime a fun experience rather than a chore!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub was fantastic for a newborn since the sling attachment was so handy. And now my son is 16 mos old and he STILL uses this tub every night! It\'s great b/c he feels so secure and filling it doesn\'t waste a ton of hot water. He loves it!! Worth every penny.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We had another hand-me-down tub that we didn\'t like (baby kept slipping, heavy, water-filled warming section)- but used this one when we went to visit family (and bought it as soon as we got back!)-- it is the best! The design of it makes it so my son can sit up, on his own ( at 8 weeks old) and kick and splash to his delight. It supports him perfectly. The non-skid material is smooth and really works. The place to hold soap and washcloths is logically placed. We didn\'t use the newborn sling, and we haven\'t gotten to the toddler stadge yet - but for the early months, I can tell you tub really does the job well!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I really like the tub and have used it since my daughter was a week old; the only problem that I have recently discovered is the sides.  My 2 month old is a very very active baby and she likes to move both her legs and arms at all times.  But the sides of the tubs are hard and I am worried that she may hurt herself by accidently hitting the sides to hard.  Other than that I find the tub perfect, I used the sling until she was 2 months old and now she\'s fine using the slant.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Great tub. Simple. We did not use the net insert because our son sinks down in it too much. So for those first couple of baths it was just easier to do a sponge bath on the counter.Once his unbilical stump fell off we used the tub. It fits well in our kitch sink.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We really like this tub, especially the infant sling. It makes bath time so easy, which is great for us first timers. There were no tears from my 2 week old son (in fact it calmed him down)and I felt confident using the tub. I would definitely recommend it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is so great.  I have been using it since my son\'s unbilical cord fell off and the design of it is really perfect for bathing young babies.  I never used the hammock feature as I found it was just easier for me to not use it, but it is good for those who would like to use it.Great buy!!!!!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I highly recommend this tub.  I have used it placed within our bathtub--I sit low to the baby and do not strain my back.  The sling was excellent to use when our son was a newborn--made bathing him a delight.  He is now 6 mos. old and sitting up--the infant side helps him to sit up without falling forward (like babies first learning to sit up tend to do), since it provides an upward slant under his legs.  As soon as he sits better, I\'ll move him to other side, which has the back support.  At first, I thought as a little boy, sitting on the infant side was uncomfortable (looked that way to me!) but he  loves bathtime so he must be ok.  I do not fill the tub up too much so as to make him float--and he\'s just fine with that--he\'s too busy trying to use his hands and pick up his rubber ducky.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Great tub. I wish it had a temperature strip on it though. I love the infant sling that comes with it!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My friend has this one, I have the Eurotub.  My baby is 6 mo old and relatively small 14 lbs.  He has no room to kick and splash in this tub.  From the time he was 2 wks old we\'ve used the Eurotub and it is wonderful.  Good support for a newborn and tons of room for an "older" baby to have lots of fun.  The Sure Comfort is probably great for the first couple of months, but you should check out the Eurotub!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I got this tub for my cousins new baby and she has mentioned-how great it is. The size which makes it last for a bit longer to use.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We got this as a baby gift before the baby was born. We used the sling until he was about 2-3 months old. It was wonderful, the baby never slid around, he was very secure. Then we switched him to the infant side. We had to watch his head because sometimes he would slouch from one side to the other, but that was really only because he was still kind of small. Once he could sit up, we switched him to the toddler side. He is now turning one and still loves the bath tub. All his toys can float in the tub with him, and even at a year old, he still has room to kick and splash. We are going to be moving him to a bath seat, but only because we have another on the way, and want to use the sling for the newborn!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Buy this one! It is the best! I tried 2 other tubs before I got this one. And it is awesome. Comfortable for mother and baby. It goes on your sink, so you don\'t have to bend down to bathe your baby. The sling feature is wonderful for when your little one is still a little one. But you can still use the tub without the sling when they get bigger. I used mine up to when my son was 10 months. I can\'t be more passionate about this tub. Buy this one!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I got this tub as a gift before my son was due; I loved the sling that came with it. The sling makes it so much easier to wash a newborn, I took it off when my son reached 3 months. The tub is pretty easy to clean I just rinse it off after a bath then flip it over and let it dry out in the tub. My son loves playing in the water and I love that I don\'t have to worry about him slipping because the little \'seat\' inside that keeps him in place. The only problem I had was the smaller pad has fallen off. Another feature that great is the built in water basin I can hold his soap, shampoo, and toys in there when not in use. I\'ve had this tub for over 5 months now and no problems so far.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Great bathtub, I love the cloth part to hang the babies on. My only complaints are there are some nooks and crannies that don\'t drain (why they would do that I seriously have no idea) so you have to make sure to clean them out or it\'ll stink, and the padding started to come off after only a couple months of use, I\'m sure I could fix it easily with some super glue though

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My 4 Month old LOVES this tub. After trying 3 other tubs we are sure this is the best. The "sling" holds a tiny newborn securely, then, as the baby grows you can use the tub in the reclining position and finally in the sitting up position for your toddler. This is a terrific product.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Not a happy camper w/ baths. 1st time parents MUCH more comfortable w/ baby in this tub. Way easier on their backs & baby loves that the h2o fm faucet comes right down in a trickle. *Fits in a standard sized kitchen sink.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is great.  The sling was very useful for a couple of weeks before our baby\'s cord fell off and allowed us to give him a nice sponge bath keeping the cord dry while still having his bottom submerged a bit.  Once his cord fell off, the sling was no longer necessary - he can sit in the tub just fine without additional support (although he still likes to hold my hand!)  We are using it on our bathroom counter but the fact that it would fit in a double sink would be handy if we wanted to use it in the kitchen, I suppose.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Great tub!! This tub was great for spong baths because it comes with a sling so the first baths are a lot easier then having to hold a wet squrimy baby. Once we could give her a real bath the tub held her great. Bath time is one of her favorite times, she just loves splashing around in it!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I registered for this tub after doing online and in-store research.  We loved using the sling and did so well past the time that our son\'s umbilical cord fell off, as it helped hold our tiny boy while we juggled the soap and washcloths.  However, as he got bigger and stronger, we found that he slipped considerably in the newborn side.  He would squirm and raise his bottom right over the ridge built into the tub\'s base, causing him to slip potentially under water.  Since he is now 6 months old and strong enough to hold his head up, the incline on the newborn side is too gradual and he fights to push himself up.  However, the toddler side is a bit *too* upright for him and he\'s still not ready to move beyond a baby tub.  I ended up borrowing an older model Fisher-Price tub from my sister-in-law that has a higher ridge and steeper seat.  My son loves this other one and it doesn\'t take two people to give a bath, now!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I had only checked one store and this had such great reviews so I purchased it.  After a trip to target I found it cheaper there.  The tub is great the sling is great and it works very well I would just recommend shopping around if you are cheap like me.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have purchased this tub 4 times for 4 different births. Everyone loves it so much that it is my now standard present for anyone expecting.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I used this tub for my two boys, and I will be using it for the next one.  It is fantastic.  The sling is wonderful for newborns, and the tub is great for when they get older.  The shape prevents the baby from slipping and it is easy to keep clean. I have used many tubs, and this is by far the best one.  What a great deal, too!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Unfortunately this was one of the items we "just purchased" without doing much research.  My wife and I figured a infant tub is an infant tub right?  Well, not exactly.  The sling was easy to install and seems to serve its function just fine.  The baby is suspended and with the right adjustment gets the baby in the water, but keeps the head out of the water.  However, our baby is only a little over a month old and I can already tell after we remove the swing the tub will be difficult to use because of the shape of the plastic.More importantly we purchased this for the "temperature sensitive" plug.  When we went to give our baby his first bath I turned on the water to the hottest temperature and let it run on the plug for over 10 minutes.  The plug never changed color and the water was hot enough I wouldn\'t have felt comfortable bathing in it much less put a baby in it.  We had to purchase another temperature sensor to feel comfortable bathing our baby.  Considering they list this as a feature and it clearly doesn\'t work I can\'t recommend this product to anyone.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: The three level settings made this tub last for a whole first year for our baby. I have a small tub and it fits well in that. The sling was little difficult to attach but once we attached it, it never slipped. My new born was very comfortable in the sling. we graduated to the actual tub when she was 2 months old. over all its a good product.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I purchased this tub because of the high rating. I hate it!Here are some pros...First, the sling works really well for the new born. It\'s very easy to bathe the new born. The problem starts when we removed the sling. Second, the hump at the bottom works very well. It helps my 2.5 month old baby sit while bathing.Here are the cons:1. The plug. I put this tub in the adult. Since the plug is at the bottom the dirty water does not flow out once I unplug it. It\'s block tightly against the big bathtub. I have to lift my baby up while my husband pick up the tub to dump the water out. He is wiggling in my arm, wet while my husband fill the tub again with right temperature water. It\'s definitely a two men job. This doesn\'t happen if you bathe your baby in the kitchen sink.2. The tub is too short. My baby start to kick against the plastic wall at the end of the tub. Everytime he kick it, he lifted him self and his back ends up on the hump. Again, my baby is very wiggly.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub has worked well for us.  We have not experienced any problems with the plug changing colors.  It seems to change appropriately, and is not nearly as sensitive as the duckie, which often shows hot when the water is perfect.  The tubs cleans well and so far, no mold. My son is very comfortable in the tub and it fits well in our double sink.  I am not a big fan of the hammock feature....it was just easier to sponge the baby clean until he was big enough for the tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We\'ve had this tub since we brought our son home.  We\'re still using it for him at 8 months.  It fits perfectly in the kitchen sind so you\'re not breaking your back to bathe the baby.  The baby can sit straight up or reclined.  We\'ve found that our son likes to recline even though he sits fine.If you\'re looking for a infant tub, get this one.  The price is right and you\'ll be able to use it for a long time.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We used this tub for our newborn, until he was old enough start pulling himself up to standing, around 8 months old.  At that point, we ditched the infant tub and put him in the regular tub with some toys.We liked this infant tub because it fit nicely in the big tub OR on top of the kitchen sink.  The newborn sling was only useful for those first few baths, until the umbilical cord fell off.I don\'t think I\'d use this for an older infant or a toddler, as it\'s easy for them to stand up in it because of the sloped bottom, which puts their feet below the level of their butt, and they could lose their balance or tip over the tub.  (Obviously supervision is always a must during baths.)

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is perfect for bathing your baby for the first few months.  I loved the hammock for when my baby was first born.  The tub is also very convenient b/c it can be used on the table, counter top or sink.  The only reason I didn\'t give this tub 5 stars is I don\'t really think it is big enough for a toddler.  My daughter is 16 lbs at 4 months so she is pretty big and she outgrew it already.  But for the reasonable price, it\'s great even if you only use it for the first few months.  I would recommend it!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have had a good-news/ bad-news experience with this tub. I bought it because of the hammock feature, which my daughter promptly decided she couldn\'t stand. So she\'s been down in the water pretty much from day one. I don\'t know that that\'s actually a problem with the tub, though- just be warned that some newborns may find the feeling of being suspended over the water pretty frightening!Also, the drain plug has never changed color for me. Ever. It has always just been green and stayed green. I used the ducky that everyone has to check the water- that and my elbow.Other than those two really minor issues, this was a great tub. I started with it on the sink, then moved to using in inside the tub when my little angel discovered the joy of splashing. (She found the big tub a bit overwhelming at first.) She\'s since moved on to just bathing in the big tub, but I\'m hanging onto this and plan to use it with baby #2. (Another point in it\'s favor- a year of use, and it\'s still in good shape!)

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: i was given this item for at our shower and put it up when jordan got 6 months now that i see bigger children using this tub and it say toddlers on it i will be pulling it back out

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is perfect for newborns and infants. Our son has been using it since two weeks of age,and now at 4 months it proves to be more convenient than ever. The special curves in the bottom of the tub keep him sitting in an upright position... we can use it anywhere from inside our tub to the kitchen floor.... and it stores nicely right under his crib. I highly recomend this tub to any parent!!!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: As long as we used the newborn sling our son was very cozy in this tub and loved bath time. When he got to be 6-7 months, we tried removing the sling and it didn\'t go well. The plastic molding intended to keep baby sitting in place is just too slippery and anytime our son kicked his legs he slid his butt forward over the hump and we had to catch him before he got water in his ears. Needless to say this frightened him and he started crying, which meant bathtime was over. I\'m going to get a tub ring for him to sit in next, but this tub worked great for the first 6 months.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We used this for the first time today for our son\'s first bath.  What a great little tub.Pros:1. It was very easy to attach the sling to the tub.2. The sling made bathing a newborn much easier for one person.3. Neat compartment on the tub to hold your washcloth soap and shampoo.Cons:1. NONE!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I agree with many of the other reviews ... there is no need for a pricey bathtub, this one works fantastic!  The 3 stages of this tub (newborn, infant and toddler) will make it a useful item for a long time.  The sling feature is perfect for newborns.  The non skid pads in the infant side are a great feature, and the high angled back is very supportive.  The tub is a great size -- not too large to store and fits in most standard sinks (I have a 1 1/2 size sink).  We\'ve moved into the upstairs bathtub, and I just place this inside the tub while our little guy kicks and splashes.  At 26 inches he still fits nicely in the infant side -- we have not yet moved to the deeper seated end for toddlers yet.  We may just move to a tub seat when he can sit well enough.  This is a great tub and a great value for the price.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This has been one of the best gifts I have been given as a new mom!  My daughter loves getting her baths in it.  The sling is great for newborns.  It fits perfectly in our kitchen sink.  I would definately recommend it.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I have been using this tub with my boy since he was about 2 months old (and had grown out of the Puj). The design of this tub is perfect - my son is now 8 months old (and almost 23lbs, 30+ inches in height), and sits comfortably while playing in the water. When I need to wash his hair, I make him recline on the other side (with the recline) - washing his hair this way helps keep the water/ soap out of his face. I had attempted to use this with the hammock when he was younger, but somehow I couldn\'t figure out how to use it - for example, I didn\'t know how to clean his back while he lay on his back. Also, the clips came off a couple of times while I was scrubbing him, and that scared me, so I stuck with the Puj till he grew out of it. However, my friend has a baby now and is comfortably using this same tub with the hammock for her new born, so it may have been an issue only for me. Highly recommend it. It\'s also much cheaper than some of the other tubs, and better designed. The little humps in the base help keep the baby\'s butt from sliding when they sit reclined, if you know what I mean. I suspect when you use the hammock, at some point the baby\'s butt may start hitting against these. Overall, great tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: It has been a couple of months that I have used the tub. I used the sling for a day or two, it was not very comfortable using the sling. Baby ended up slouching on the sling and hard to move around.  Without the sling, bath time was a two man\'s job since one person had to support the baby\'s body and head while the other person bathed the baby. Now that the baby is older and is able to control her head, it has been a lot more easier using the tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I used this tub from when my son was new born till 5 months.  It is very durable, I will be able to save it for the next one easily.  Once my son was able to sit up and really move around it was not that usuable.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I enjoy using this bathtub for my daughter; the sling was great when she was a newborn and now she fits well in the infant side. I like the area for fresh water, shampoo bottles, or toys. The only detracting feature is the plug, since it leaks. That means the tub has to be very specifically balanced over our large kitchen sink, or it leaks all over the counter. (A surprising lesson to learn. ha) I\'d recommend this for parents who have back problems and don\'t do well leaning over a regular bathtub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub was great while my baby was very little and I was using the net.  But now that she is 4 months old and is in the reclining part of the tub, she slips and slides and her bottom ends up on TOP of the bump that is in the middle of the tub.  I truly do not feel this is a very safe tub as it does not keep the baby in a safe position.  Also, the reclining section seems to be designed too small.  My baby is on the bigger side (16 pounds at 4 months) and does not fit the reclining section any more.  But she is not sitting up yet, so I cannot place her on the sitting-up side.  I have had to go out and buy another tub that fits her better and is safer for her.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This has worked well for us so far in these first 8 weeks, and we like that it is adaptable as the baby grows.  Sling is adjustable, but when babies are bigger, they sit in a different way and don\'t need the sling at all so it is removable.  Easy to clean off too--just spray in the shower, and tip upside down to dry in the bathtub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This is an excellent tub. The hammock is a life-saver. Our little girl just loves to take a bath in this. The water reserve is great for "clean" water - to use as rinse water when soap or other "liquids" end up in the main section.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub is the BEST.  It was good from newborn until she was one years old.  It\'s perfert.  Would not recommend another tub.  The newborn basket is ideal for those small slippery newborns.  Then once they have outgrown that, the sitting up portion is great.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub was really great until my son reached about 3 months.  Stage 1- The little hammock that came was great when he was really little.  Stage 2- Then once he got too big for that I sat him on the infant side where there was a little incline for him to rest & there was a little hump to keep him from sliding.  Stage 3- Except now he is moving all over the place and the hump isn\'t big enough and some how he gets over it and slides down to the water & to the sides & it is hard to keep water from getting in his ears etc. & he isn\'t big enough to sit on the toddler side which is straight up (stage 4).  This tub was very frustrating.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub has worked out very well for us so far. I used the included sling up until yesterday even though my daughter is 2 months old. I put her in it when we were way passed the sponge bath stage just to hold her better. Now she reclines on the infant side of the tub and it is so easy for me to give her a bath by myself.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: One of the best baby products out there...my baby loves it.  Easy to use and easy to clean. Highly recommended !

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I received this tub as a gift for my baby shower. I have four children total, and I have tried many different tubs. This is by far one of the best tubs that I have used for any of my children. With the sling you can easily bathe a newborn. Once my daughter was able to hold her head up, I took the sling off and she now sits comfortably in the reclining position.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: Great for baby- Our little one likes to poop in the tub and the netting bed allows for easy clean up during the bath and after (the cloth is washable).  I especially like the simple design.  It is great to wash and go.  The only drawback is it is large and bulky- bad for trying to store in little bathrooms/space.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We tested three tubs and this was the least expensive, but it was by far the best tub.  No middle bar to hurt little guys, not too much room that you have a floating baby, and it grows with baby and toddler.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I had a blue one of these for my first few kids years ago. Just bought this one to replace it for my daughter who will be born soon. It\'s the same one...different color. I didn\'t care to try the pricey ones with all kinds of features. This one worked just fine and I was happy with it. I\'m sure I will be again. One side is perfect for babies, the other for toddlers. Easy to keep clean. Cheap and works great. Couldn\'t ask for more from a baby tub.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: After getting the fisher price whale tub I realized the sling comes in very handy for infants who can\'t yet hold their head up! I returned the whale tub and got this one. It\'s perfect. First of all my daughter didn\'t like just being put into the whale tub. I guess she feels secure in the sling and never cried. It saves our ears the screams of our little one and now she actually looks forward towards bath time. All smiles from our little girl with this tub. Buy It. Save your Ears! Save her Tears!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: With the sling feature, I could fill the tub to my baby\'s ears and she\'d stay warm and comfortable.  A friend bought a different tub and her child hates baths because she has always been cold.  When my daughter started to sit, she sat in the sling and played.  Fanatastic tub, I tell all my friends to get only this one.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My baby girl and I just love this tub.  The "hammock" like insert safely cradled her when she was a newborn, making her feel safe and secure.  She loved taking a bath from day one.  When she grew out of the hammock, the recline side of the tub allowed for a comfortable transition to "sitting" in the tub.  Now that she\'s a very busy 9 month old the sitting upright side allows her to safely sit up on her own and play and splash without her little bum slipping out from underneath her.  She\'s 21 pounds and still fits well in this tub and will probably use it until she\'s one year old.  Both of my sisters had this tub with their babies, and we all loved it.  It was one of the first baby items we all went out and bought.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: We had to purchase a tub while "living" in a hotel during our move to a new home so that I had a safe place to bathe our daughter.  I wish I had found this sooner!!!!!!  With all of the support it offers it definately out does those mesh bath slings which I found to be too slippery and dangerous!  It fits perfectly in the sink and we use the sink sprayer to rinse her which she loves and it\'s easy for us!  I recommend or buy this for all of my friends who are expecting!

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: When our babies were newborns, the mesh hammock was great - it kept them in place and they never slid too deep.  As they got older we never had any problems with the infant side of the tub and they didn\'t slide like some others report.  <br /><br />Once they were able to sit up independently we began using the toddler side for a few months (until about 9-10 months old) then we used a bathmat in the bottom of our double sink because we could bathe two babies at the same time.  <br /><br />My husband still preferred to use the tub until the boys were 13 months or so.  It was great for us and it\'s affordable.  We\'re buying it today as a baby gift for a friend.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I got this as a baby shower gift from my friend. I really liked it when my daughter was a newborn. This item was great for a little while. I never really used the sling with her so that was kind of pointless. However, when she learn to sit up she no longer like being in the laydown tub. She enjoyed in a bath tub more when she could play and move around in the water . So I decided to get her a safety first chair for the bath tub and she loves it! So yea, this might be good for newborns but not for more grown babies

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This tub has worked great for my son since he was a newborn.  We\'re still using it 5 months later.  Your baby can grow with this tub.  The way the tub contours with the baby\'s body is great.  I never felt my baby can slip or be harmed by the tub (of course, I never leave my sight from him when he\'s in the tub).  I\'ve used another tub while visiting in-laws and didn\'t like it as much.  So far, this is the best tub for us.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: It\'s so beautiful. I love it. And I recommended it to my friends. I think my girl will love it, too.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: I just loved this tub. I received it as a shower gift, and it\'s been fantastic. When my son was a newborn, the sling feature was perfect, and the tub fit nicely on my countertop. Now that he\'s bigger, we put it in our bigger tub so he can splash around. I\'m not sure it\'s big enough for a toddler, as my son seems to have outgrown this at 7 months. Then again, my son is huge! So I\'m guessing the average sized baby would fit into this tub for a long time.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: My son by 3 months was wiggling and splashing so much and the molded plastic did not fit him. We had to search out a new tub. Fantastic for the newborn stage.

name: The First Year\'s Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling, Blue
review: This baby tub is the greatest!  It fits securely in the sink, saving me from spending every bath-time hunched over the bathroom tub.  The hammock works wonderfully!  I kept my little guy in that hammock until he ran out of room, then I moved him to the reclined side until he once again ran out of room.  Once he started splashing, I put the baby tub into the normal tub.  I still pull it out when even I want my baby to sit still long enough to get his toes clean (he\'s too big for it now, but it still works!)  Unlike most baby tubs, this one is deep enough that it holds enough water to actually stay warm through his entire bath (and he takes long baths!)  The tub I used when my daughter was born was absolutely hideous, but this one is a dream!  BUY IT!

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: We have been using this toilet for over a year now.  We have it in the car (we don\'t use it in the house - we use the baby bjorn potty seat over the regular toilet) and it gets used at least once a week.  So far, no problems.  It\'s comfortable.  It is a little big, though, compared to others like the Baby Bjorn, but if you have the space (we have a mini van) this is probably the best.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: This potty by far is the best.  We potty trained my son on this same potty 4 years ago and had such great success that we now have one for our daughter who is almost 2 years old.  This potty just arrived and our daughter was so excited.  She kept saying "My potty", and we went to the bathroom and she went.  We didn\'t even have the potty for 5 minutes and she was already using it. We tried another potty and the seat was way to small and then we tried the potty seat for the toilet and she\'s way to young for that.  I found this potty on line and bought it right away.  It was easy to train our son on it and we are finding the same success with our daughter.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: I love this potty seat. It is actually has an opening similar to a real toilet and a nice padded seat. I have tried many potty seats for my daughter and this is my favorite. Unfortunately, Graco has stopped making them.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: I had originally purchased the Baby Bjorn potty because of the great reviews.  For whatever reason, my daughter HATED IT.  She said it was too hard (it IS hard plastic) and hurt her bum.  The few times she was willing to sit on it for awhile, it would leave red marks.Finally, she demanded a "comfy, cozy potty", so we picked the Graco Doft Seat.After it arrived, she sat on it, had a huge smile, and 1 week later, was completely trained!  We are thrilled and would have bought it much sooner.Pros: Very soft and cozy seatGreat size for larger toddlersEmptying pan is extra large - impossible to have spills or missesEmptying pan has pourable sides for much easier clean-up"Little Boy" sheils is removable for girlsThe seat can be used on the "Big Potty"Cons: None (unless you need bells and whistles)

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: My son is two and has not used the toliet yet but we have it out just in case.  He does use it as a step stool.  Looks like a great product and was just what I was looking for.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: I like this potty chair because the opening is much bigger than others we tried, and now that my son is a little older, he can use the very comfortable ring on the regular toilet. However, the guard comes off very easily and that is very annoying. We also use it as a stepstool and I did notice the lid does snap off, but its easy enough to fix. Overall, I\'d recommend it but the guard is sort of a pain!

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: My husband and I bought one of these Graco potties at a store months ago for our 2 year old boy.  We have used it without the splash guard (as many "experts" recommend) for his comfort and safety--just teaching him to "tuck it" down.  The chair is comfortable for him (the seat isn\'t cold to sit on), and it\'s easy to clean.  But when I went to buy a second one for our second bathroom, I couldn\'t find it in stores, so I bought another one that I thought would work okay.  I took that one home to find that even though boys are pictured "using" it, the seat hole was so small, when my son sat on the potty, his private parts weren\'t even over the hole.  I took it back for a potty with a more oval shaped seat--still too small.  So, I realized we would just have to wait for this appropriately "sized for boy\'s parts" Graco potty to ship from amazon.  And even though amazon said it would take at least 4 weeks to ship, we got it within a week.  So we\'re happy.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: I bought two of these to get the training started. My daughter is 20 months old and we bought them when she was 18 months. She\'s been sitting on it with her diaper on and imitating us as far as wiping and closing the lid and washing her hands. We\'re not forcing her to sit on it diaperless unless she willing and ready. She\'s a little afraid of falling in but we\'re taking things slow and at her pace. Since I have a girl, I don\'t need to worry about the splash guard. It seems all products have a hard time keeping it on since the little guy has to straddle it just to sit on the potty. My friend has a little boy and she super glued the splash guard on and it\'s working just fine. I like the fact that the seat is removable and can go on the big potty. The one problem I had is that when putting the foam pads on the bottom of the seat it made it a little wobbly front to back on the little potty, so I took the scrap foam and cut out two more little pieces to stick on the front of the bottom side of the seat to stop it from wobbling. It worked. Can\'t beat the price for the options it has.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: This chair is great. Our daughter is only 20 months but is interested in the potty and has been having success once in a while. I love the fact that the bowl is bigger - it looks more like a real potty. The seat is comfy for her. We move the chair from one bathroom to another as needed.Recommended!!!!!! Worth every cent.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: Ok, I couldn\'t resist that title! :)  This product works great. One recomendation. Go to costco or other big box warehouse store and buy a gajillion 10 gallon plastic bags. Line it with one before using. Then close the bag and place it in a 2nd bag (insurance policy). Drop it in a trash barrel at your convenience.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: This potty seat is great for big kids, 4+. Not all kids are fully trained by the time they are 3 years old. This requires a larger seat and bowl. Most other seats will only accommodate a child to the age of 3 or so. I have twin boys. Training takes longer, much longer. As long as one will not potty, the other will not potty. This potty seat at least gives you the extra time you need to accommodate the larger bottoms involved. The only draw back is that urine gets caught between the cushioned seat and the seat base. You have to clean it after every use if your children (boys) are not good at hitting the mark. I also keep one of these seats in the back of my van. The wider base makes it very sturdy, no tipping over no matter how rough the drive is. A tip for potty training parents: Don\'t buy expensive liners. Use your left over regular diapers to line your potty seat in your car/van. The diaper soaks all urine up and there is nothing to spill. Just discard the diaper as you did when your child was wearing them. I keep a gallon zipper bag in the van for that purpose.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: we are really pleased with this product; it\'s just the right size, easily opens and closes for cleaning, and best of all our son loves the comfortable cushioned seat. we found the "attachment for boys" a little irritating and dispensed with the product, I suppose it is useful for more squeemish parents but it wasn\'t for us. didn\'t detract from the product itself.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: We\'ve had this for three years.  We tried not to use it as a potty for too long simply because going in a real toilet is easier/cleaner - though this was easy to clean, as far as such potties go. We used it as a step stool for well over two years and still use it as a seat ring (daily for > 27mths).  It\'s the best seat ring - it\'s comfy, ours hasn\'t ripped at all, and it\'s much easier to keep clean than the standard $12 Dora/SpongeBob/etc rings, which I find I have to replace (for our other bathrooms) about twice/year otherwise they get simply disgusting. And it has handles so you don\'t have to put your hand inside the ring when moving it on/off the pot.  I will say, the hinge on the potty lid did break, which is why we had to stop using it as a stepstool... but I still find it to be the best potty out there, by far.  It\'s a potty, a stepstool, and a ring to use for years to come - well worth the money.

name: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review: We have had this potty for a couple of months and my son seems to love it. The seat is soft and it\'s also great for removing from the training potty and putting on the regular toilet too.The only reason I didn\'t give it four stars is because we have had a problem with the splash guard popping off very easily. It has fallen down inside the potty numerous times while my son has been using the bathroom.

name: Prince Lionheart Hot and Cold Gel Pak
review: The product I received would no way keep my casserole hot or cold. They were only about 4 x 6 in. in size. Very disappointed in them especially for the price. Buyer beware!

name: Prince Lionheart Hot and Cold Gel Pak
review: Perfect size for me, but gel freezes up, which it should have. But for the price, I\'m fine with it.

name: Prince Lionheart Hot and Cold Gel Pak
review: I read a lot of reviews giving this item a thumbs down and that is probably because people not buying for its intended use.  These ice packs are great for keeping baby bottles or sippy cups cool.  I send my kids to daycare and their milk cups stay nice and cold all day long.  Prince Lionheart manufacturers baby/kid supplies.  I am not sure why people are purchasing for a Pyrex replacement.  They are great for their intended use - kid\'s lunch boxes!

name: Prince Lionheart Hot and Cold Gel Pak
review: This is a hard item to find to replace the original.  Through Amazon we were able to get the exact replacement we were searching for. Helpful to take hot or cold dishes to family dinners where you have travel time to your destination.

name: Prince Lionheart Hot and Cold Gel Pak
review: What I thought I ordered were inserts for the pyrex to go carriers. I needed a new hot and cold pack set and based on the photos, that\'s what I thoguht I ordered. What I received were tiny ice/heat medical packs which are not what I wanted. No point in trying to do a return. Very unsatisfied that they couldn\'t fulfill the order properly.

name: Prince Lionheart Hot and Cold Gel Pak
review: I purchased these to replace the hot pack from my pyrex portable.  You get two packs in a set that can either be frozen or heated.  I heated both to replace one pyrex portable hot pack.I returned these to Amazon because they leaked.  When I heated them in the microwave (following the instructions) they expanded and the plastic seam separated allowing the gel to leak out the side.

name: Prince Lionheart Hot and Cold Gel Pak
review: I use these for my kids lunch boxes there are a small enough size to fit properly. I use them not only for cold but mostly for keeping things warm in there lunch box. There are thin so I can even fold if needed ans only take a few seconds to heat in the microwave.  I have had them bust on me but I use almost daily and all in all they hold up pretty good for being roughly handled by the kids.  I bought them last i will by them again for this year and they are fairly inexpensive so when they don\'t come home from school I\'m out tons of money.  Read your reviews and realize that these are not for re-placing the pyrex ones and move on.

name: Prince Lionheart Stroller Shield Popup, Navy Blue
review: This fits all my strollers and is a plus to have if you live in a rainy area.

name: Dr. Brown\'s Natural Flow Y-Cut Wide Neck Nipple, 3 Pack
review: Great product for babies on the prethickened formulas.  My son is 2 months and was put on the prethickened formula (by his doctor) for his reflux problems and this is the only nipple he could drink from.  GREAT product!  As for the one stars this product has received they were not reviewing the product just giving their opinion.  Which does not do this product justice.

name: Prince Lionheart Stroller Shade, Black
review: I like the look of the shade and how easy it is to put on the stroller. Unfortunately, it doesn\'t properly fit  my type of stroller (Summer Fuze.) I am debating on whether to return it or pass it on to a friend.

name: Dr. Brown\'s 4 oz. Natural Flow Wide Neck Baby Bottle
review: Unbelievable leaks and spills. In spite of adhering  to the directions "DO NOT FILL BEYOND THIS LINE", bottle constantly leaks and spills. Particularly when you warm the bottle. If you don\'t mind frequent dripping then purchase, if you don\'t have time to change your baby due to being drenched by leaks don\'t buy them. They are horrible portable bottles as well.

name: Sassy Perfect Size Snack Cups, Colors May Vary
review: I bought these to send snacks to school for my son, they are a bit \'young\' looking but they were all I could find BPA Free - which is very important to me. The smaller one also does not seal well/ lid stays on, otherwise I am pleased with them

name: Prince Lionheart Pacifier Rinser
review: Two stars cause of the idea wich I think is good, but mine came broken where the spray goes mine is plastic and broken (wich in this pic shows metal) so the cap does not stay put causing it to leak, so is going back

name: Prince Lionheart Pacifier Rinser
review: This is a product that I think every mom should have. I loved it so much, I bought two!

name: Prince Lionheart Pacifier Rinser
review: It\'s work good. Good for traveling, I even use it ad night in my house. the best product for cleanse.

name: Refill Pack For #607 (Rub a Dub Paint in the Tub)
review: soap has a consistancy that makes it difficult to work with.  gooey and clumpy.  I will not buy this item again.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: We bought this after searching in vain for something with similar functionality but with a more neutral contemporary look.  Everything in this category is country, traditional, "baby"-looking, or over the top cartoon stuff.  Looks aside, this thing works!  Sticks well to the table, cleans easy, catches food and fits well with our Phil and Teds Me too chair (which is our baby\'s primary daily chair). Our son is able to pry it off the table, but not all the way -- not a problem.  Main thing was to get some help keeping food off the floor.  The food catcher was the primary design feature we needed.  It helps to make up for the deficiency in this area with the Phil and Ted chair.  We\'re glad this product is on the market.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: I use these mats with my 2 1/2 yr. old twins at my dining room table. They keep the mess off wood and are easy to clean. You can also travel easily with them.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: I think this thing is great!  Suction cups stick to the table - keeps things relatively close in and the tray catches a lot which our 14 month old actually will sometimes scoop up and finish off.  Cleans pretty easily but does have a bit of stain from spaghetti sauce but what in our house doesn\'t have some kind of stain on it with a toddler?!?!

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: This was given to us as a gift, and its been very helpful when we eat out. It provides a clean surface for our son to eat off of, and makes cleanup much easier when our meal is done. Suction cups worked fine for us, we occasionally had problems with our son pulling up the mat, but for the most part he was more interested in the food.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: I\'m not sure that I saw anywhere on this product mention of the little suction cups that keep it in place.  I wasn\'t sure that it would be practical or of use, but I definitely like it.  Easy to clean, easy to store. Also, wide enough to fit over the Regalo portable highchair arms that attach to table. Big enough that food smeared and pushed around by little reaching arms  generally doesn\'t reach the table.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: Not sure why they\'re still selling this as Kiddopotamus when the products are all branded Summer Infant now - and have been since 2008 according to their not-so-friendly Customer Service when I emailed them to inquire. Like another reviewer pointed out, this color is a much much brighter green than the soothing sage pictured here. And it really is impossible to make the fold lines go away so it\'s hard to lay flat. Suction is so-so - my 6 month old is able to flip it over easily, and off goes his food... Am giving this 3 stars cos it\'s waterproof and reusable, and the "drain" portion at the bottom does a decent job of catching stray food bits - when the mat is staying in its place, that is.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: I like the idea of this but it doens\'t stay unrolled and my daughter still can move it around on the table.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: This is a definite must-have for anyone with a child.  After dinner at a restaurant, the mess rolls right up and it can be tossed in the washing machine (yes, the clothes washing machine) for quick and easy clean-up.  Love this thing.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: Love this for my toddler while eating out. Perfect size to accommodate a variety of foods. I took a star off because the suctions don\'t always stick. Otherwise its a great product.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: I can\'t believe we didn\'t have this product SOONER!  Instead - my husband and I would wipe down the entire table at a restaurant with disinfectant wipes from home.  We must have looked NUTS!  This sticks well to most surfaces, is very pliable (easy to roll-up and stash in the diaper/baby bag) and easy to wash.  We have 2 now:  one for home - and one for going out.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: We bought this placemat for my, now 19 month old. We take it with us to restaurants along with a highchair cover. It works well for the first half hour, until my son gets bored and rips it off of the table. It\'s a good idea to not put it on the table until food is actually served to prevent baby from tossing it before. Once the food is there, my son leaves it alone until he\'s done eating.The placemat washes up well in the sink, but every piece of lint or pet hair sticks to it because it\'s made of rubber. I just sprinkle a little baby powder on it to get things off of it.I would recommend this product because there isn\'t anything else out there that I have found that actually covers a table and almost stays in place. It could be improved, but it\'s all we have for now, and it\'s better than a dirty, germy table.

name: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Yellow
review: I have a 24 month old daughter, and 11 month old twin sons. We dont use highchairs, but instead use the Chicco Travel seat (funny, it has hippos on it too!)This item is either you love it, or you hate it kind of thing, not really anything in between. But whats funny is its all based on the child, if your child flings it off, you hate it, and find other reasons to hate it. If your child lets it be, you love it, and find other reasons to love it.This has been our "highchair tray". Its easy to stick onto any surfaces with re-usable suction cups (although I was able to purchase more at home-depot when they start loosing their stick) which is much better than adhesive, which could ruin a wooden tables finish. The mat is also very easy to take off (for us at least) and our daughter has managed to do it once, but it had proved to be difficult, and not worth the effort at every meal, THANK GOD! We actually didn\'t get yellow, we bought them (not seeing the color through the box) and got 2 purples and a green, we actually love these colors more... so if you order it online maybe it will come in another color. The mat is great for a barrier to keep your table protected from sharp utensils, or those rings left by cups (how many toddlers do you know who use coasters?) It also keeps baby and your floor safe. There\'s a "mote" to keep small spills off of baby (at least for a few seconds until you are able to react to the spill and wipe it up) and keeps babies food on the mat.
