I  wish we\'d had it from the start.We\'ve been using it for over 3 months now and I haven\'t got a single complaint.It\'s ridiculously easy to clean and there\'s nowhere for food to hide.I haven\'t had any problems with stability and sturdiness.My son is pretty mellow and tends to sit calmly during meals howeverso I can\'t say how it would hold up to roughness.That said, I highly recommend it.

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: My wife and I purchased this monitor a little over two years ago.  After good service for about two years the rechargeable battery finally started to go.  I then began the search for a replacement battery and after reading info on the web (including here at Amazon) I was at a loss.  The only helpful hint came on Amazon about contacting BatteryWorld, but they were out of the parts (connectors) for making this battery and they didn\'t know if they\'d ever be able to find more.Finally I was able to find a battery which appears to fit the bill.  I purchased it at Circuit City for about $11.  It is a GE TL26145 -- Cordless Phone Battery with Universal Plug.  It is 400mAh and 3.6V as was the original battery and the Universal connectors did fit the monitor.The item is listed on the circuitcity.com web site as a 300mAh battery.  I can\'t explain this, since the battery I purchased in the store is definitely 400mAh and I have entered the model number straight from the packaging.After a couple of days of use it seems to be doing the job.I hope that this helps.

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: I have had absolutely no problem with this monitor. We have twins and bought a cheaper model for the second child. The static and reception was no match. I highly recommend this model only!

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: We have a small house, so the only reason we needed a monitor was to hear the baby at night.  We keep all of the doors closed because we have a cat that likes to crawl in bed w/you if you leave your door open.  We initially purchase a First Years monitor that had the Good Housekeeping review sticker (now appears to be discontinued), and the folks at BRU recommended.  We took it home and it went crazy in the middle of the night, so we exchanged for the same model thinking it was defective.  We were again awaken by it going crazy.  We took it back and exchanged it for the Fisher-Price.  We have had this one for over 9 months and NEVER had any problems.  It has an awesome range, and the vibration feature is great when you are doing yard work.  We use the monitor more than we ever thought we would!

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: We have had this monitor for almost three years now.  We used it for about 1 1/2 years and then put it away until our third child came along.  The monitor doesn\'t hold its charge, and we cannot hear anything unless the volume dial is turned up high.  It also emits crackling and static when the dial is touched.  We probably will have to buy another monitor because it drives me crazy every time I try to adjust it.

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: I just wanted to recap what the "toy enthusiast from MA" said below:"I did however find a company that actually made me a new rechargable battery. The company is called Battery World ([...]) The battery was about $13.00 US and it worked great. So for all you Moms who love this monitor but need a battery here is your solution. "We also own the original version of this monitor, the battery died after about 2 years of use, and we have ordered the replacement battery from Battery World - $15 US. Keep up the good work Battery World!

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: At first I loved this monitor. I was able to take it outside with me when I had my morning coffe, and it worked great at night, I could hear her breathing even. The dissapointment came about 7 months later. Everytime I touch the volume button it makes a horrible static sound that is so loud I think it could wake the baby in the next room. It\'s so bad that I finaly took it back to babies r us and got a new one. But since I did love it so much in the beging, I did get the exact same one and I figure I can always take it back again if I need to.

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: I registered for this baby monitor and received it as a shower gift.  I had another monitor given to me (Fisher Price) which has recently quit working (that one wasn\'t much to speak of either).  I tried to use this monitor last night and all I got was this HORRIBLE feedback and the static is awful too.  I am returning it to the store and hopefully finding one that I can turn the volume up and actually hear my daughter.

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: We bought this over a year ago and it still works great!  It works so well that when I dropped our first one in the toilet while cleaning I bought another one to replace it and didn\'t even have to think twice about which one to get. It\'s definitly the best monitor out there.  i love the cordless options, it has vibrator mode and lights which are a must when you don\'t want to hear the noise of your baby but still want to know if he is crying (like 2 am or during movies). Some people have complained about the recharge-ablility but I think the company must have wised up because everytime you plug it into the wall it will now recharge the battery - NO STATIC (unless you drop it the toilet that is!)

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: Original review written December 2003 (after 15 months of use):This was the third monitor that I have purchased. The first few (First Years and a different Fisher Price model) interfered with the wireless computer network we have set up in the house. I have been VERY happy with this monitor\'s performance. I do not get any interference (static or clicking noises) and can go up to two houses away without a problem. I especially like the vibrating feature because this allows us to mow the lawn or snowblow without fear of not hearing our daughter. We highly recommend this model. We use it pretty much all day. It is plugged in most of the time (except when we are outside) and have not had any battery problems to speak of yet. Again, we are extremely happy with its performance compared with the other three monitors that we have tried. And you can\'t beat the price! It doesn\'t pay to buy the more expensive ones out there.Addendum added 12/22/04: We have just started having some MINOR problems that don\'t affect it\'s performance in the least. We have now had this monitor for over 2 years and when we adjust the volume we get a bit of static but it still works great. It has basically been powered on since we bought it so you have to expect some wear and tear. We actually just bought another one for a second child. One is on channel A and the other on B. There was some interferece until we found the right placement for each one (not right next to each other). Again, this is stil the best monitor we have found (like dummies we tried a couple other ones for the second child and ended up going right back the this one!) Hope this helps!

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: Like other people here, I had this when the first version came out.  I loved it!  Especially the vibrating feature b/c you could use it while mowing the lawn, in loud groups of people...After I damaged my first one, I bought a replacement.  As others have said, the battery pack was changed in the new model.  The old one was rechargable and this one does not have the rechargeable option.  I replace batteries about every 3 weeks now.  It is terrible.  I called Fisher Price and they basically told me that they downgraded the battery option.  Hmmm... that doesn\'t make too much sense!!  I would NOT suggest getting it!!

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: I am thinking maybe the monitor has been improved over the ones that are just a year or 2 old. We love that we can hear the baby breathe with out the volume on max. The vibrate works great when the dishwasher is running or I am doing another chore that is noisy. We live in a close neighborhood with apartments very close by and nothing has interfered with the monitor. This unit does not have the recharable batteries but the hearing portion does come with an adapter that could be plugged in. Really being able to plug the unit in, I have only changed the batteries once in 6 months. I like this unit and would purchase it again.

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: I have a home daycare and I LOVE this monitor.  I have had many in the past and this one is by far the best.  I like that it doesn\'t have a long antenna and it is rechargeable.  The range is more than I expected.

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: I love this monitor!  If you have a two-story home, or a larger house, this monitor works great.  There is NO STATIC!!!  I registered for a different monitor, received it, and now I don\'t use it because the static was so bad.  This one is great because it is 900 mHz.  I only hear my son.  I can sleep with the monitor on and I don\'t hear any static.  This monitor can pick up a lot, so you don\'t have to even have the volume up.  This is a great monitor and at a great price, I just wish it came with 2 receivers!

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: The main feature that made me purchase this monitor was the vibration. It gives you the flexibility to things that you might not do if you were constantly having to listen to something (ie mow the lawn, vacuum etc). I do not have the one where it comes with or uses re-chargeable batteries. I just replace the 3 AAA batteries about once a month or every other month. I feel that the quality of the sound is excellent & the LONG range is great. My brother\'s family lives a few houses down and it works great at his house too. This monitor has even fallen off of our 8ft. fence onto concrete and we opened up the inside and reconnected the wiring and it works great again. I would buy this monitor over & over again. Also would recomend it to all the parents I know. When it fell off the fence & didn\'t work at first I re-searched other ones thinking of buying a different one and found this one to be the BEST in all options. The price is great too.

name: Long-Range Vibrating Baby Monitor
review: This monitor worked really well for about six months. I could hear my daughter breathing, I could hear traffic go by outside her window, and I could hear the echo of my husband and I laughing from our living room! It was great because it made me feel really safe - but after about siz months, I was unable to unplug it. If I wanted to take it to another room with me, as soon as I would unplug it, it would stop working. if you slammed it with the palm of your hand, the sound would come in and out... Now it doesn\'t even do that. If I dont\' have this thing plugged it, it does not work. So, I am not able to leave the room that I am plugged into. Which pretty much defeats the whole purpose of having a baby monitor with such a wide range and rechargeable batteries. This thing is pretty much worthless to me now. I\'m shopping around for a new one that will allow me to actually walk around my house. I\'m very disappointed because I can\'t get my money back on this junk.

name: Evenflo Smart System Add-On Panel Clear
review: very happy with this.  installation was reasonable and it looks good - like it was supposed to be there, instead of looking like a tacky addon.  And it works great in keeping my 2 labradors out of the living room.

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: The gate is wonderful--once you get it in right. The instructions don\'t give you clear enough directions and I ended up putting the latching piece on upside down the first time. The pictures were pretty useless, but once you figure out the right way to install it goes in in a snap. To make it more stable you can keep the gate locked to swing only one direction which makes it extra stable against kids puching on it.We had to move our once our kitchen remodel was done and it came down simple and went up in a new door way really easy.The latch itself on ours has to be pushed down as it will not latch into place by itself now but it is a very solid gate. And for being over 2 years old it has held up great. The latch handle can\'t be opened by anyone with small hands as you have to squeeze both sides so anyone with kids under 2-3 who can open it have installed it wrong. Make sure the latch is hooked to the wall properly.

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: I had no problem with this gate ... we have an odd shape area to use it in, and it was perfect!  My twins stayed well contained, even when my very physical son grew old enough to try to climb over it!  We had absolutely no problems with it\'s sturdiness, screws, or anything - I bought it used, and now that I don\'t need it anymore with my toddlers, it\'s still in such great condition I plan on passing it on to another family.

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: This gate is absolutely worthless.  If I could give it zero stars, I would.  It was difficult to install and is very flimsy. I have it at the top of the stairs and I don\'t trust that it will hold at all. I hate that I spent so much on the gate and now I have to purchase another one.

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: I wish I would have had a chance to read all the reviews before I placed my order for this gate and the extensions.  I would not buy this gate again.  It is not stable and the gate is not really very easy to open.  My husbands exact comment was "I am just going to step over it".  I would go with the majority on this one and say it is not worth the money, invest in something else.

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: This is a well-built gate, but the latch can be defeated by pulling the gate straight out from the wall.  So if gate set-up has any curve in it any toddler can pop the latch free with a vigorous shaking.  A hook and eye can hold it closed but it can still be twisted enough to make an opening.I kept the extension panels and replaced the gate with an Evenflo Swing Gate (the one for stairs).  This has a good latch that\'s holding up nicely.  But I wound up tossing out most of the $40 Swing-wide kit.

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: My husband installed this gate into a high traffic area to keep our dogs our and our baby in, it took at least an hour to install.  While it looks nice enough, our 10 month old daughter easily pushes the gate open and has fallen onto the hardwood floor plenty of times.  We are not happy with the baby gate.

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: This has to be the worst gate on the market!  My 13 month old son opens it by leaning on it.  He pulled on the gate yesterday and broke it off the hinges.DO NOT BUY!!!!!

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: I bought the Wide Spaces Swing Gate about 3 months ago when my son was just starting to walk to keep him away from the kitchen, computer, hallways, and other potentially hazardous places in our home.  It was the only swinging gate I could find to fit our wide doorway.  It took us hours of cursing and screaming to install, and then went downhill from there. My 13 month old son has now figured out how to move the gate in order for him to open it, however, houseguests can\'t even figure out the latch.What sent me over the top was when the "stationary" wall mount came unglued and my son pinched his fingers in between the pieces of wood.  I bought this hoping it would be a wonderful step to take in keeping my son safe, three months later we are flushing [item price] down the toilet because it has started to be more of a home hazard than a safety precaution.  DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!PS I wouldn\'t even give it one star!

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: I have now had this gate for 2 months. I would like to recommend the gate but I have frustrations with it.  When installing the gate I recommend that you screw the plastic platform to the floor, otherwise it will not be very secure.  Also if you are going through the gate alot you will find that the plastic latch that you open it with will wear out and break.  One of the main reason I thought I would purchase more of an expensive gate was I thought it would last longer.  I was wrong.  I like the gate I wish it would last longer.

name: Wide Spaces Swing Gate
review: The problems I had with this gate:1. The instructions for using the template to install the hinges, for the fixed gate, was not easy to understand. I finally gave up and I improvised. Doing so, the installation went more smoothly.2. The gate is not sturdy. If anyone were to bump into it, I\'m pretty sure it would break.3. The mechanism to click/unclick the lock is more difficult than it should be. Fortunately, the people who will using it, have a strong enough grip to get it to work.Despite these flaws, however, this gate does serve its purpose, in my case. I bought this gate to keep my dogs confined to a room --- which it does. They don\'t go near the gate, so fortunately, I don\'t have to worry about them leaning on, or jumping on, it. As for the locking mechanism, it\'s annoying, and I\'m just hoping it doesn\'t get any worse.This gate would not be safe for kids!

name: EuroRider
review: I was having a difficult time with the price of the Bjorn carrier and not knowing if my baby or I would even like it.  So I borrowed a Oshgosh carrier from a friend.  My baby loved being in it, but I didn\'t like the straps that held him in.  (They cut into his neck.)  So I decided to try this carrier after reading other people\'s review, and I have to say that I love it.  My son has no complaints either.  Plus this carrier is SOOOO easy to get him in and out of, and I don\'t even need the help of another person!  The only problem I have is that he rides facing forward and it seems to come up to his chin, making him hold his head a little cocked back.  But I realize he\'s only 2 months old right now and will grow more and it will fit better.  That\'s why I can\'t give it 5 stars.  And with this carrier even now my husband (who is a LARGE man) can use it!

name: EuroRider
review: I used this carrier for my daughter from birth to about 15lbs.  I found it to be suitable yet not perfect.  With baby facing forward, it does not stay folded down.  Also the snaps that adjust how close baby is to your body always seem to come undone.  We got by with this carrier and my daughter did seem to enjoy being carried in it.

name: First Years Instant Ear Thermometer
review: This is the only thermometer we use at our house, my husband and I included.  It is so easy.  Just be sure to hold the top of the ear straight up then insert the probe, this should give you the right angle.  As for the probe covers, you can use any generic cover.  I bought a package of Walgreens brand covers and they work just as well.  They are not the exact same and do look different, but looks and functionality are two separate things.  Get over the cover issue and go to Walgreens or any drug store.  Please don\'t let the other reviews scare you.  This is a great product.

name: First Years Instant Ear Thermometer
review: Not only are probe covers unavailable in retail locations or over Internet, it seems that First Years has discontinued the product. At least the product is not listed or mentioned on their website. We searched for model 4290 - the number imprinted on the bottom of the thermometer. Apparently, they don\'t see any value in telling customers the product was discontinued. Furthermore, the site is full of broken image links.The thermometer works well but without probe covers, it\'s not a good investment. You can find equivalent products with readily available probe covers. If the store you\'re buying the thermometer at doesn\'t have covers there, find another product with covers available.

name: Kidco Wood Center Gateway Beechwood
review: We have four of these gates and they have been used daily for almost five years.  They are as solid as the day they were purchased.We went with the Kidco wood gate initially because we have an old house that we spent lots of time restoring and felt that the wood look went with the house better than new "space age" looking gates.  Five years later, we are happy that we made the decision because the gates look great in the house, and they have stood up to all of the use and abuse our three kids could dish out.Other reviewers have noted that there is a bar that goes along the base of the gate that is easy to trip over.  It takes a couple of days to get used to this, but hasn\'t been a problem for us.Also, another reviewer questioned the longevity of the gates due to the constant opening and closing of the handles.  Honestly, these gates have held up to constant use and we haven\'t had ANY problems with them whatsoever.The best part about them is that they truly child proof.  We have "Houdini" nephews that haven\'t been able to get through them in all this time.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: Like the others, I am so disappointed in this product. I live in an apartment and was really anxious to have something so compact (since my home has been taken over by baby items) but I can\'t use it. As soon as I put my baby in the sling, the foot snap comes undone and folds up on my baby. This can\'t be safe!! And how are you supposed to hold this down and wash an infant at the same time?? We had to go buy a regular tub because I just couldn\'t use this product for my little one. Don\'t waste your money!!

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I love this product.  It makes it so easy to give my little boy a bath.  I hated the tubs, they are too big and take up too much room.  This seat fits perfectly in the sink and when baby gets bigger I can use it in our bathtub.  I\'m big on products that you can use longer than 3 months!

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: This seat worked well the first 2 months when my son fit in the sink and I could just use the sprayer on him.  Once I had to use it in the bathtub he was cold immediately because he barely had any water touching him and the seat was wet during the entire bath.  He\'s now 6 months old, sitting on his own and was squirming out of it tonight and nearly gave me a heart attack.  Imagine trying to hold onto a squirmy, soapy baby!  I\'m getting a regular seat for him tomorrow like I had for our daughter.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: we have advanced from a little portable tub for the sink, to this product and it is really nice. It sits up so you don\'t have to bend over as far, and supports my baby. It allows him to kick an move around. The only drawback is the amount of water you have to put in the tub, about 2-3 inches. They won\'t roll off of it, like other bath chairs and it doesn\'t move around in the tub. we love it!

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: For our newborn daughter, we tried hard plastic tubs and giant yellow sponges without success. Then we found this product. We love this chair. It folds flat to fit into a closet. Opens and stays open without a problem when clicked into place properly. And holds baby very nicely. I use it in the tub at our house and in the sink at Grandma\'s house ( she has a single large sink). I would stronly recommend this product. I\'m getting it for freinds who are pregnant.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: We too have a small house with no storage so we thought this product would be great.  It seems they have fixed the foot rest problem, so that was a plus.  Yet it would not fit in any of our sinks, so we were bent over the bathtub.  Plus it sits so high that we had to put a great deal of water in the tub just to reach his bottom.  There are no straps so when he learned to move that was that.  While he was still little we ended up bathing him on a hand towel in the tub with just about an inch of water then we switched to a bathtub seat.  I think this product seems like a great idea, but it still needs work.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I LOVE this!!  It makes it so easy to bathe my toddler and my infant at the same time in the tub!!  I don\'t understand the problem in some of the other reviews that the footrest comes unsnapped... I have never had this problem, maybe it was corrected?  Anyhow... I love this bather and could NOT do without it!  It saves time and space (very compact and flat when folded up) and is holding up great.  (I\'ve had it for about two months now.)  I would definately recommend this!

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: My newborn hated being in his regular tub.  When I registered for this I figured I would only use it when we traveled.  After trying to bath my son in his tub and fighting him as he squirmed all over I decided to try this one.  My son loves laying in it and I have never had a problem with the foot rest coming undone.  It fits right in our kitchen sink and is so easy to use compared to the larger tubs.  I wish this would come in a larger size so as he gets older I would have one to grow with him.  Great product in our eyes.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I LOVE this bather!  I had origianlly gotten a regular tub and found after one bathtime it was too bulky and worthless.  However, this bather was given to me as a gift and I ended up using until my daughter was able to sit up on her own!  It was a life saver!  I used it in the kitchen sink to begin with.  Later I moved it into the bathtub.  It folds up so I could put it away or travel with it.  However, most of the time I left it set up in the tub so I could set her down when I needed to be in the restroom.  It was a life saver!

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I just purchased this bather and came here to see what others thought of it.  They must have fixed the defect in the foot because I had no problems getting it to stay. It did take a little muscle to get it there, but once I did it was very secure.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I bought this because we had a small house and didn\'t have enough counter space for the huge tub, yet alone enough room for it. So i got this seat. I LOVE IT ! I couldn\'t ask for a better product. I have used it since the day his belly button fell off and he weighed about 7 lbs at the time. He loves it because he can sit in the warm water and i have never had problems with him falling over, you just have to supervise the baby otherwise when they push up on the lower half of it, they can move themselves and possibly go off of it. But my son loves it and so do i. Even now what we are in a big house, he still loves it. And so do i !

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: if your plan is to bathe your child in the sink this product is great!! particularly if you plan touse one of those removable faucet hoses, its like a shower.  My son loves it, even though he does slide down in it.  i highly recommend, but not so sure its a good bather for the tub - the larger version of this is.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I wish I would have taken into greater consideration the bad review this product had recieved.  It does not fit in my sink and when used in the bath tub, requires way too much water for a newborn.  I intially bought the product because I liked the storage aspect, well now it gets to be permanetly stored under my bathroom sink.  I purchased the old fashion tub today with a teddy bear sponge for comfort.  My little girl and I are much happier with our new purchase.  Don\'t waste your money on this product.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I love this bather.  It is nice and soft for baby.  I found the plastic models with the non slip surface to be rough and awkward.  When I finally did switch, bathtime began to be much more for enjoyable for my daughter.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I loved the concept of this seat, and it fits well in my sink, also the amount of water was not an issue.  The issue I had/have with it is the leg section keeps folding up while in use so it makes it awkward for my son to lay in it.  I was imagining it would be like a bouncy seat and almost conform to my son.  I found it to be very stiff.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I got this as a gift for my 4th child and only wish I had it for the other 3.  My first son had a big tub that I used once because the suction hose never worked.  After that all of them were bathed in the sink where you master the art of bathing with one hand - not much fun.  This allows you to have your hands free.  The two positions make it convenient as the baby gets older.  The mesh allows it to air out with no smell of mildew.  It folds up so we just keep it in our bathroom - just throw it in the tub if company\'s coming.I bought it as a gift for my cousin because I recommend it that much.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: What a great product.  Very useful.  I used it both in our kitchen sink and in the bathtub.  Baby was always safe and secure and seemed to be comfortable.  The bather folds up and hangs conveniently on the inside of the shower door.  I HIGHLY recommend this product.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: the design is like a bouncy seat, which is good.  the seat could use a safety harness because my daughter always slid down in the seat.  my main complaint with this seat is that it really started to stink after a few uses.  the mesh liner comes off and can go in the wash, but the white foam that is attached to the poles do not come off and those were the things that started to smell really bad.

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: We have been using this Bather since our daughter was born(now 6 months)and she loves it. Once baby is old enough to "soak" you can just fill your bathtub and set the Bather inside. We have not had one single problem or complaint with this porduct! We don\'t know what we are going to do when our daughter grows out of it!

name: Mother\'s Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review: I\'ve started using it with my newborn and found it very easy to "shower" him by simply pouring water over him. Because it doesn\'t fit in my sink, I use it in the bath tub. This seat eliminates the whole "sitting in unclean water" thing. Plus the fact that it folds compactly is great. It can be used at home or when you are away. It fits neatly in any suitcase and dries quickly.

name: Koala Baby Wallborders - Locomotion
review: We purchased the Locomotion bedding for our baby who is due in 8 weeks and we love it. The only complaint that I had about the border was that it didn\'t always line up exactly when we put it on the wall...it could be cut better. It isn\'t really noticable but my husband got aggravated while trying to get it to match exactly, but his room has many corners and edges...

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: This is a great keepsake, or a WONDERFUL gift to give to first-time parents. I would have loved to get my daughter\'s first foot print but I discovered it too late. I had to settle for a 1-yr handprint (and with a struggle) but it is a great way to remember how little they were and how fast they grow-up!

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: The"clay" they gave me was so sticky that I couldn\'t get it out of the package without having to scrape it off of the wrapper. I tried to knead it, but it stuck to my hands. When I tried to roll it out, it got stuck to the wooden rolling pin. I have used 3 other Pearhead kits in the past and have NEVER had this problem before. I am VERY disappointed with this product and will have to go out and use Model Magic to make my daughter\'s footprint.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: I cant wait to get my pictures printed and use this frame! Great memory keepsake! I think it would be good as a gift to someone else too!

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: This product was great.  The footprint kit was so easy, and it just has to dry for a good day, and then its ready to frame.  definatly reccomend this product.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: First the frame is broken in the back. Second, the wood roller stick to the "clay". Third, after multiple tries with my crafty mum, no impression on the clay. Waste of money and time. Poor quality.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: The putty they use to capture a hand/foot print is way too sticky and pliable.  It took us three times to get a decent hand print for our six month old because he kept digging into the material.  Another issue after that is avoiding getting your own prints on the putty because it is just too soft.  We made it work eventually and it looks nice in the frame.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: For my first child i received a product similar to this from BabyArt which i loved. So for my second i wanted the same keepsake. Because i could not find the BabyArt frame that was under $40 i went with Pearhead. I followed the instructions exactly: I tried it out today with my baby and upon initial contact with the roller, the entire mass of clay wrapped and adhered itself to it. Epic fail. I tried to pull it off and it was like melted marshmellow. It took me several minutes to detach a decent chunk of clay off to start again. I proceeded to hand-mash the clay (since the roller was no longer functioning, with tacky clay permenantly embedded into the grains). I then proceed 4 times to imprint my baby\'s foot- every single time my baby\'s foot would not come off the clay, and became attached to her sole or her toes. 5th time i was getting frustrated, and my husbnad then suggested to put the clay in the fridge for 5 minutes so maybe it will be less tacky. that worked so i proceeded again to imprint the foot. I still had problems pulling my baby\'s foot off the clay without it sticking. I then i had to put the clay back in the fridge for a longer period of time. So, just to let you know, it finally worked (after more than 10 tries and over 30 min. no joke) of putting this clay in the fridge for a long period of time, and then lathering my baby\'s foot (and the clay surface) in baby powder so it would not stick. Felt like i was baking! It was still very hard to cut a decent edge around that imprint afterwards because the clay was so tacky. Let me tell you this, i am not craft-challenged. I found this product (clay) very hard to work with. Overall experience was poor. Will not buy again or give it to anybody else as a gift. i give it two stars because it\'s a decent keepsake, and the instructions, packaging and presentation was great. Maybe they company should re-work the clay so it\'s not so temper mental?

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: The first one we bought was great and I love seeing my son\'s little foot and his picture.  When our second was born we bought another one.  It never worked and we had to just throw it away (the molding stuff was like soup and never got hard or set).  It was a big waste of money!

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: Since I read good reviews here, I bought 3 frames for myself and 2 sets for the grandparents. When my baby was one month old I wanted to celebrate it by making the foot print. I opened all 3 clays and they were hard as rock. I was really disappointed and sad that I could not make them at that special date. Contacted customer service by email (which I got from Amazon reviews) and they said they were sending me a replacement. A month later, nothing. I contacted them twice again and no response! They could at least tell me they could not help, so I would not wait until my baby is so much older! DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY, go to an arts shop and get your own old clay, at least you know it is going to work when you want it.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: The frame is lovely but the clay was very difficult to get an impression from, and now it won\'t stick to the backing--not with the tape that came with it, not with 3m picture hanger, not with Gorilla Glue tape! Nothing will stick to the back to hold it up. We had a different frame for our first child, and the clay was much easier to work with. Unfortunately this is our only imprint of our younger son\'s foot and hand (however shallow and faint it may be), and yet we have no way to hang it. I\'ve been pleased with Pearhead products in the past, but this one is disappointing.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: We have one of these for both of our sons.  Its a terrific keepsake and very easy to assemble.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: Item arrived in a super, over-sized box with no cushioning at all.  Item has terrible "bruises" when received with chipped corners and damaged paint.  It\'s now still sitting in some corner of my house unused and about to be dumped as I wouldn\'t put up such a damaged item up for display (I mean, would you?).  Furthermore, it\'s in white, making all the damages all the more obvious.  Utterly disappointing experience!

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: Since I bought one of these kits for my 1st grandchild, I wanted one for my 2nd granchild, but couldn\'t find it except online.  I was very dissapointed with this!  The background matte was missing.  The medium for the handprint was gooey and unusable.  I\'ve been waiting weeks for a replacement.  I would NOT RECOMMEND this product, from this company.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: This product is worthless! I had to try and "lightly press" my daughters foot into the plaster no less than 9 times and each time it barely made an indentation.  We tried everything, from rolling the plaster a little thicker for more cushion while pushing, pressing her foot a little harder and nothing worked.  We could have thrown our $30 for this product out the car window and gotten more satisfaction and a better memory than this piece of junk will provide.  We ended up with a very faint, almost unreconizable imprint that will most likely be replaced with an ink impression if we can find it soon enough.  Save your money and buy something else if you really want a true memory of your child\'s foot or hand.**UPDATE: I emailed the manufacturer Pearhead, after receiving this product.  They sent another plaster packet out and we tried it again.  We followed the directions as noted and it still did not work.  We again were left with a horrible, barely there print.  This product truley is a waste of money.  We ended up ordering the Inkless print kit from another company for much cheaper, worked great and we got the keepsake this product/company could not deliver on.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: I bought this as a gift for my mom and she really likes it.It\'s pretty easy to get a footprint of the baby ( the instructions included helps a lot).

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: When I got the first one it had already been opened and damaged so it was replaced and the second one was in good shape.  Just waiting for the granddaughter to arrive so I can get her foot print.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: This kit is fantastic!  I bought one previously in another store (light wood frame color) to use myself and loved it so much I bought this one for a friend who\'s due in a couple months. The imprint material is easy to work with, not at all messy and if you mess up, you can roll it out again and do it over. Note, you do have to PUSH your child\'s foot into the material fairly firmly, it\'s not a stamp and you can\'t simply touch it on the surface.  We did it while our baby was sleeping (less wiggling) and he didn\'t even wake up. The imprint material is actually a lightweight foam modeling material similar to stuff Crayola used to sell. The frame and matting are of good quality and all together, the kit makes a beautiful finished product that will be enjoyed for years to come.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: I ordered this product, of course, to make a keepsake of my daughter\'s footprint. When I took the impression material out of the package, it stuck to the package and I had to work to get most of it to come loose. And then I tried to start rolling...and it stuck to everything! The wooden roller, an aluminum can (as suggested on the package), and even my hands. As I was trying, for about 15 minutes, to find a solution online, I assume the material had time to dry out a bit, and when I went back to roll it, it worked beautifully! The impression looks really cute. Just remember to wait after you take it out of the package before trying to roll. It seems that many of the reviewers found it too sticky to work with, and this just might make it much easier.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: It will keep your babies mold but it really doesn\'t get harder like plaster does.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: This was supposed to be my husband\'s 1st Father\'s day gift. Instead, I now have to run around, find a last minute father\'s day gift with a full time job and a 9 month old.So, it\'s a nice idea and it looks great. When I received the product today (4 days before Father\'s Day, I was relieved that I finally got it so shortly before Father\'s Day. I opened it tonight after he went to work and the baby was asleep and wanted to cry: The wood of the frame was chipped in multiple places and I thought I maybe could use glue and some sharpie to repair it. Well, not only is the wood chipped but the glass of the frame has a scratch. I am so disappointed. $30+ down the drain. And no Father\'s Day gift. I would rate it 0 stars if I could. I don\'t know if it got damaged in transit or if they make cheap products. I don\'t care, I just wish I had received the item earlier so I could replace it. Or not order that item at all.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: Impression material does not work. Would not keep the impression, it springs back. The frame is nice but not worth it if can\'t get an impression.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: Bought this two years ago for my first son and it worked great. This time, the clay to keep the impression was awful. Not sure how to describe it, but it wouldn\'t allow for a visible footprint. Sent it back and got a new one. Same problem. Must be an error in the current production. Do not buy. I ended up using an online recipe to make my own with salt and flour.

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: I needed it like the instructions say to went to roll it out and it stuck to EVERYTHINH my hands the rolling pin it gave tried to do the impression stuck to  my babies foot so I waited fir about 15,20min and it worked beautifully m fairways favorite thin about this product is it gives you plenty of leftovers I still have the one I did fire my first 4.5 years ago and the an extra hand print fire both of them as well :-)

name: Pearhead Babyprints Desk Frame, Mahogany
review: The Babyprints Desktop Frame is a great gift for when you want to spend under $50 on a new baby gift. Any new parent will love this gift as it truly is unique and a keepsake that can be cherished forever.

name: Wamsutta - Cable Baby Blanket - Blue Chenille
review: This blanket would be perfect if you didn\'t have to wash it. It is my 2 year old son\'s favorite, by a landslide (and I have tried replacing it several times). It is cuddly and soft and is a good size - but you just can\'t wash it without causing noticable damage. I have replaced it twice now and am past due for a new one. You will have to decide if you want filthy blanket or a tattered blanket which is threadbare and holey. My son would rate it 5 stars if there were a review site for toddlers but since this is a site for mothers, wamsutta chenille gets a disappointed thumbs down. Too bad....

name: Wamsutta - Cable Baby Blanket - Blue Chenille
review: My son received this blanket shortly after birth. He is nearly 2 years old now and it has been far and away the best blanket we have. It\'s soft, warm, and big enough still to cover him completely at bedtime. Not only that, all stains seem to wash right out (it\'s off-white). I\'m expecting again and was actually online to order a 2nd one for the new baby. You won\'t be disappointed with this product!

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I love this car seat!!  The snug fit, keeps my little girl safe and cozy. She easily falls asleep in this car seat. The straps are easy to adjust. The fabric is well made; it doesn\'t look cheap like some of the other seats. Consumer Reports also rated this car seat as one of the safest.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I have never written a review but always read them when purchasing a baby product so felt the urge to share my experience with this product. I will admit I bought this car seat because of the look and the brand name. I now wish I had not been such a label snob. I see other babies in their Gracos, etc and they look so comfortable and my poor 3 1/2 month old looks stuffed in his car seat. This car seat is very narrow. My baby is only 14 pounds and I do not see him fitting in this much longer. Also, I was starting to think my baby sweat a lot until I read other reviews. It seems that other parents have had the same problem with the fabric. When I take my baby out the area where his head was is often wet with sweat. Also, warning label has frayed off. The look of this car seat is great I will admit but it is not worth it.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I don\'t know why everyone is complaning that their child will outgrow this carseat.  This carseat is the same size as all the carseats out there for infants.  I know this carseat is a bit pricey but who cares..It\'s rated 5 starss for safety, and everyone complains about how heavy it is, I\'d rather have a heavy carseat knowing the it will not fling around during a crash or when driving like the other cheap carseats out there by Graco etc.  The only reason people complain about this is because the price even if this carseat was cheap your kid will still outgrow it, maybe you should look into a car booster seat then.  My son loves this carseat and falls asleeps for hours during a car ride.  I have no complaints regarding this carrier because its worth the money and its durable, and will o utlast any other brands.. I even bought the Pliko 3 in sable so all inall I spent about close to $500- well worth the money for the safety and style, and its not maid in mexico or in china.. Italian fabric is excellent.. SO, if your looking for quality, style and durability go ahead buy this one you\'ll be the envy of all.. the stroller and carseat together is the cadillac of all strollers and carseats out there...

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I am getting ready to fly and just found out that this seat has to have the base attached.  I am soooooo disappointed that I bought this seat.  Yes, it is the highest rated seat, but has none of the features that the Graco or Britax has.  1) needs a base, but 2) the canopy is not big enough.  I have to unhook the back and have the sun hit slightly on my son\'s head in order to cover his full face and/or legs.  This makes my walks horrible!!! I have to move the canopy multiple times and cannot enjoy a brisk walk.  Even though my friends recommended this seat as the best, I would never buy it again and will be asking Babies R Us to do an exchange.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I bought this infant seat with very high hopes. My Mother had Peg Perego for me when I was young.  I bought the black sable infant seat along with the stroller.  The seat is very attractive and very well made.  However, it\'s extremely uncomfortable for my Son.  When he was born he weighed 6lbs 4oz and it was alittle too big for him.  When he blossomed to 11lbs 8oz it was too snug for him. It\'s very narrow and another thing is its very HOT.  My Son would come out of it sweating no matter what I tried. Coat, no Coat. Air conditioning, no air conditioning.  It was terrible.  Very disappointed for the amount of $$ it cost.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: My daughter is 11 weeks today and we are already looking for a new car seat.  At 2 months, she was 11 lbs 5 oz and 22.75 inches.  She is not a fussy baby, but has not been comfortable in this seat for about 2 months now.We live in Florida where it is quite warm year round.  If I\'m out for any amount of time with her in the seat, she begins to get VERY uncomfortable.  She gets very sweaty.  I do not ever leave the car seat in the car because I know it will cook in the sun.  When in the car, I always have the A/C on high to try to prevent the inevitable.  In spite of my efforts, the seat remains extremely hot and I\'m in for quite a crying fit if I don\'t get home quickly.This seat is EXTREMELY heavy!!  I\'ve been active my entire life and went to school on a tennis scholarship.  I can hold onto the seat when it\'s hanging down, but when I\'m walking with it or need to lift it into our SUV to attach to the base, it\'s next to impossible.  I have to put down my purse, the diaper bag and use both hands just to get it up to seat level.  We drive a Santa Fe, so it\'s not high enough to constitute these types of issues.The last issue is that this seat is small. I realize that car seats are to be fitted for a reason, however, this is a bit excessive.  I like knowing my baby won\'t be tossed around (and this IS the #1 priority), but even the guy at Babies R Us agreed with us when we were car seat hunting last weekend---he said it\'s one of the smaller seats.  Our daughter isn\'t big enough to cause us to need to shop for a new seat already.  Consequently, we began to worry about this seat when in Babies R Us.  A woman saw our daughter in this seat and said she used to own the seat, but had to buy a new one when her daughter was only 3 months old and was still quite small.Save some money and don\'t buy this seat.  Buy "Baby Bargains" (book) to find out which are the best seats.  I wish we\'d bought this book before spending as much as we did on Peg Perego\'s car seat.  Now, we have to buy a new car seat that will not snap into our Peg Perego stroller (which we love).I give this 3 stars because it IS very safe and while that is our top priority, I believe we can find the same safety ratings without breaking my back, having a sweaty miserable child, and needing to buy a more roomy car seat after just 11 weeks of use.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I researched this seat quite extensively before buying.  My first choice was the Britax companion, but at the time it was brand new on the market and STILL no one in our area carries it. I wanted something that I could look at.  I do agree that my daughter gets too hot in it.  I love the leveling base.  You can unscrew it, get the seat belt as tight as possible, and then rescrew the base to get an awsome fit for those of us that don\'t have new cars.  The shade takes a learning curve.  All you have to do is push the plastic part toward the seat to unlock it.  It would be nice if it were bigger.  The major reason I went with this seat is that it actually has styrofome in it... like the Britax to absorb an impact.  Almost all the infant seats have nothing to protect the baby in an accident except a seatbelt and a piece of plastic.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: The base of this car seat has a metal levelling ball encased in plastic that rattles and rolls around while driving which is very annoying (more to the driver than the baby). We\'ve taped a heavy duty magnetic in place to stop the noise.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: My baby loved this carseat. When she was about 5 weeks old we put her in to sleep at night and she immediately started sleeping through the night. She slept in this carseat, all buckled in, for many weeks (she did finally move to the crib). She thought it was very comfortable!I bought it because of its excellent safety record. I also really liked the colors. The fabric is wonderful- it washes very well and shows no wear. It is very easy to get in and out of the car. It is also easy to rock it on the floor- important for soothing a fussy baby (especially one who sleeps in her carseat at night). I highly recommend this!

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: We have been using this seat for a year now (baby just turned one year) and its finally time to move him to a infant/toddler car seat.  We have been very lucky with our baby to get such use out of this seat.  He is actually still within the weight limit.  From the start this seat has been the best.  This is our third child so we been through quite a few and were never happy with them. Bringing him home from the hospital was actually pretty easy in this seat.  I felt he was very safe on the ride home and felt that he was also very comfortable. It was also very easy to get him situated in the seat and to hook in in our truck.  Our baby has really loved his seat from the start.  He would actually be sleeping in this seat before we even put him in the car. That made those short few newborn months alot easier on all of us in the car. The seat is also made out of a very nice material and is charcoal and light gray.  We have the matching perego atlantico stroller and the venezia carriage stroller and this fits in both strollers perfect.  Just take the seat out of the car and right into the stroller.  The baby stays asleep and the family can get some shopping done.  I have also taken the cover off about every 2 to 3 weeks to wash it and it still looks new. The seat also fits great in shopping carts!  That is very important because some seats give you trouble. Overall, We feel this is the safest and nicest looking seat out there and will miss using it.  We look forward to purchasing this seat again for our next baby!  I hope this helped with your decision .  You and your baby will love it..... And Peg Perego Thank you, for another safe beautiful baby product!!!!

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: Like many others, I bought this system b/c of the high safety reviews.  And to be fair, safety is the most important thing.  I hate the synthetic fabric, however.  Even though my baby was born in Nov. (in cold Chicago!), all winter her little head has been drenched in sweat when I take her out of the seat.  :(  Also, the seat is quite heavy and awfully small.  My daughter is in the 95th percentile in weight, and I know I will not be able to use this seat much longer (she is now 4 months).  Also, some problems with the stroller:  closure latch and cup holder broke in my first week of using it!

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I am extremely disappointed in my Peg Perego carseat and stroller.  I find them extremely difficult to use and poorly designed.  The carseat is also very heavy - much heavier than many other models - so you really don\'t want to have to lug it around without the stroller (which can be a monster to unfold by yourself).  I am so disappointed because I love the way these look - they are so sporty and stylish looking.  And they\'re also fairly expensive for this particular product so you would hope they\'d be better than all the rest.  My daughter is only a month old and I am already researching bigger kid carseats and strollers for when she outgrows this one.  I\'ll continue to use this one and I will probably use it with any subsequent children because despite being a beast and a pain in the a**, it is also high quality and will likely last quite a long time.  Plus, like I said, I really like the way it looks.  I get so tired of the sea of navy blue stroller and carseat sets out there.  At any rate, the fact that my daughter will outgrow this in five months does not bother me - it\'s the fact that I have to suffer with it until then (but that is of course my choice!).  Next time around I\'ll be looking at Britax and McLaren - they seem to be the way to go.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: This car seat is very wonderful. It supports my daughter\'s head so it stays in place when she falls asleep. I used to have the Graco snug ride and it was horrible. This car seat is made a lot better and well worth the extra money.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I have read several of the reviews and the negative reviews talk about the amount of money spent versus the amount of time a child is in the seat.  I have one thing to say about this...money should not be an issue when you are purchasing a safe ride for your child.  The seat is expensive but in my opinion it is well worth the money spent.  I purchased this seat for my son two years ago and I am now using the same seat for my daughter.  I was tempted to get a new seat for my daughter (something more feminine) so I checked out the Graco Snugride....it didn\'t fit into my back seat very well and therefore moved around a lot.  The Peg Perego seat is much easier to secure into my vehicle than the Graco seat.  Both of my children are so snug when they are properly fastened into the seat that I don\'t worry about their safety.  I hope I never have to find out first hand of course but I have great confidence in this seat.  Aside from the safety, I also have noticed that both children seem to be very comfortable in the seat.  They sleep well in the seat even on long trips.Once your child outgrows the Peg Perego seat I highly recommend the Britax Roundabout or Marathon car seat (depending on the size of your vehicle would determine which one to purchase).  The roundabout works for children 5 to 40 lbs. and the Marathon is designed for 5 to about 65 lbs.  They are both great seats but the Marathon is rather large.  Either seat is a great investment in your child\'s safety.Last tidbit...never be afraid to go to the store and ask to try different car seats in your vehicle.  Even if Consumer Reports determines that a car seat is the best on the market, remember that every back seat is different and that same seat may not fit in your car.  At Babies R Us, an associate will accompany you to your car with different seats and allow you to try them before you purchase.  Not every seat is designed to be the safest in your car so you have to check and see how each seat fits into your car.  The tighter you can get the base seat belted into your car the safer it will be in the unfortunate event of an accident.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review: I have this car seat in the Metalica (Red) color.  I was most impressed with the safety of this car seat, that I could coordinate it with my Peg Perego Aria stroller (I love this stroller) and the fact that it didn\'t have a really childish print fabric.I disagree that the car seat is too small and needs to be replaced after a few months.  The straps are adjustable and grow with the baby\'s height so they aren\'t squished in the car seat.  However, I do agree that in the summertime (we live in California), the fabric gets unbearably hot, and my poor little girl sweats and suffers so much in this car seat.The car seat shade is an absolute joke and doesn\'t shade her from the sun at all.  Also, I found that moving the handle back and forth is also a difficult task, and requires all of my energy.  It is a very heavy car seat, and I have to use both hands to climb into my SUV to place the car seat in the base.Most disappointingly, the fabric has worn SO MUCH from only using the car seat a couple of months.  The warning label has completely unraveled (how safe is that?) and the slats where the harness comes through the car seat cover are completely frayed.  Though Peg Perego customer service has been responsive in ordering me a new harness and car seat cover at no cost, I\'ve been waiting for the red cover for the past 3 months as it is on backorder.  By the time I actually get it in the mail, my daughter will have already outgrown this car seat, so that is frustrating.  So here we have spent $170 on a car seat that looks completely sloppy.  After 6 weeks, it looked like I was using a hand-me-down car seat from 5 years ago, and I take pride in taking care of the stuff I own.Needless to say, I think with baby #2, I might reconsider buying another Peg Perego.

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: I just rec\'d this the 16 Oct. 2003.  I am so pleased with the quality of this product.  I purchased my last baby bedding set from Potty Barn and it reminds me of that type of bedding.  I am very pleased with this as my husband is also.  This is our 2nd child and we are excited to pick out something for a boy this time as last time we did the girl stuff.  This is perfect for a baby boy and it seems to be a pretty sturdy product.  I can\'t wait until my son gets here and can sleep in this comfortable bedding set.  The blanket is so soft and really baby friendly.  I will recommend this to anyone who is expecting a little boy.

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: I used all of the locamotion bedding and accessories to decorate my baby boy\'s room.  We topped it off with matching blue and green paint and the room turned out beautiful.  This bedding set is so classy looking, that many people thought it came from somewhere like Pottery Barn.  I even got the compliment that the room looks like it should be in a magazine.  The locomotion set is very well made.  This set is beautiful for a baby boy and will still look good as he grows older.  I am super happy with this product.

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: This set looks great in my baby boys first room.But I must comment that the craftmanship of the stiching is poor.After I washed the quilt I had to sew back on half of the patches.I just hope that the valance and dust ruffle don\'t do the same.Other than that I think that this set will be able to grow with my son through the years.

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: I love everything about this bedding set. There are so many colors and designs in the fabric that it is so easy to find things to match it from wall color to different styles of curtains, little accent pictures, knobs for the dresser and other stuff to decorate my son\'s room. This is by far my favorite bedding set!

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: My husband and I are expecting a boy in May we wanted something to match the color of the office, which is now the baby\'s room the walls are a dark red and my husband really did not want to paint over that dark red I found this and fell in love with it the blue and navy blue and green really make the room bright and the red kind of mellows out, we also loved that it was a six piece set the room was put together the second it arrived in the mail and washed nicely. I would buy this for any little boys room its so cute and has all the trains, cars, and airplanes and even a sailboat so you can mix and match with different items to help decrote the room which we also love.We plan on useing this for his toddler bed also we love it!

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: If you have a boy this is defenitly the bedding set for you... The quality of the entire collection is fabulous... It\'s classy and at a very reasonable price... I bought the entire collection for my son and he loves it... He\'s a year and a half and he still loves it... He can\'t take his eyes off of it... It\'s great for your baby\'s developing eyes... What\'s also great is that it comes with a toddler set for his big bed so you don\'t have to spend more money decorating it in another style... I recommend it to anybody with a boy...

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: I just received this bedding set for my pending baby boy.  It is absolutely beautiful!  The workmanship is wonderful.  The color and details are more than I had expected from the pictures I had seen.  I put it on my gift registry without ever seeing it in person, and trust me, it has exceeded every expectation!A wonderful product and value for all that you get in the set!

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: It is always a gamble to order something like this online... you never know if the colors will look the same or if the material will end up cheap looking, etc.  This crib bedding is perhaps even more adorable than it looks on the computer.  I am 100% pleased with it and can\'t imagine having any other bedding.  It is perfect for a little boy, yet not TOO masculine.  I was trying to avoid any dark colors and anything sports related.  This is just perfect.  I highly recommend!

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: Received the set as a gift from a dear friend and absolutely love it. Very well made, super soft fabrics, fun design and everyone who sees it thinks it\'s some pricey high end set from some fancy store - ha! My son, who is 5 months old now, loves to reach for the little boats, trucks and planes surrounding him - I think he\'ll really like this set as he gets older too. Koala Baby makes some wonderful things... I especially like their clothing basics too. Great products for great prices!

name: Koala Baby 6 Piece Crib Set - Locomotion
review: We just bought this bedding set and got it all set up in our babies room today. It is so cute and I was really impressed that it came with the diaper stacker and the valance in the set.  We had originally picked out another set that was [more expensive] plus you had to buy those two items seperate for an additional [fee]... I love this set so much better than the other one too.  I plan to go back and ge the throw pillows and the musical mobile. I always wanted planes and trains for my sons room!!  Thank you Koala Baby!!

name: Wamsutta - Ecru Cable Baby Blanket - Chenille
review: My 20 month old has had this blanket since she was born. She can\'t go anywhere without it. We are on blanket number 2. I like to switch them out to be able to wash them. They have both been equally worn out.  I bought one for my 4 year old when she was born and the quality has defintately changed over the past 4 years. My older daughters blanket still seems to be in good shape. It\'s a little thin, but the baby\'s blanket is really thin.  I like that if the baby covers her face while sleeping, she will not suffocate with this blanket.

name: Evenflo Snugli Porte BeBe Soft Carrier
review: I purchased this carrier a little skeptically, since there weren\'t many reviews to go by. I figured I could always return it if I wasn\'t happy with it. Turns out that won\'t be necessary. I find it to be comparable with the Bjorn in quality and comfort (I borrowed one from a friend to compare before buying this one). Perhaps mine is a slightly different model, but mine snaps under the armpits like the Bjorn does, so I don\'t have the problem the other reviewer stated about restricted arm movement. I find this carrier easy to put on and take off. I also had no problem getting the baby in and out of the carrier, unlike the carrier I had with my first which was nearly impossible. Overall, I find this one to be worth the extra money over the entry-level carriers (like the regular snugli), but a better value than the high-end carriers which don\'t offer any extra features or higher quality in my opinion. You can\'t go wrong with this one.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Love this for my car. Has caught alot of crumbs and such. Very pressed with it. Would highly recommend

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We bought this based on other reviews and everyone was spot on. If you want to protect your car seat this is a must buy!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We just had our first child and saw this item at the store. Absolutely love it since we have leather seats and it keeps them intact! Our car seat is installed correctly (had it checked professionally)so we don\'t know where that review came from. The quality is great and the color matches our leather seats perfectly. We are definately satisfied and recommend it to anyone who does not want their car seats ruined.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I read A LOT of reviews before I bought this.  This was the only one where people said that the color didn\'t bleed onto the seats and it didn\'t leave permanent impressions in my leather seats.  We have only had these for a couple months but so far have found that to be true.  And we live in Florida, so if the heat here doesn\'t make the color bleed, then I can\'t imagine it would do so anywhere else.  A great product - very durable at a great price...that never happens!  I highly recommend this product.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This works great - protects seat from the snow dripping off the kids\' shoes just like I wanted all while protecting my seat from indentations

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Great product. Keep my leather seats protected. Fast shipping.  For the price I paid I highly recommend this product.-Happy Yay

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: With three kids under the age of four, these seatsavers have literally saved our leather seats in our new mini-van.  I would highly recommend using these under all car seats!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I have three of these seat protectors and they work great.  It works great with older kids as well as young babies.  I feel great knowing my seats will look good once the kids are out of the car seats.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Love these! They protect my leather seats and catch crumbs and liquid! Highly recommended! Also, if my husband is really dirty from work, he will use our extra set to sit on to keep the seats clean. Very easy to clean and install!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We bought this before our first since we had leather seats in the car at the time. We wanted to protect the leather from getting permanant dent marks from the car seats.  This thing catches everything!!! We even had a few barfing accidents when he was almost a year old when the car seat didnt catch the mess, the seat protector did which in turn saved us from cleaning formula and gung from in between the back seats!  This is also great for those runaway cracker crumbs and cheerios!  We now have a different car without leather seats but we still using it to keep the seats a little neater from spills!  Great product!By the way, when we sold the car with the leather interior, you never would have known there was a baby car seat back there!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I got a little over-anxious about our new arrival when I ordered these so I think I paid way too much.  They do the job, but they\'re really not that special and seem to be over-priced in my opinion.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: good value for the price, used in our 2007 jetta to save the seats. works great and car seat does not slip.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We just bought a new SUV with leather seats and so this keeps us from having a huge dent in the seats.  Thanks for inventing this product, Lionheart!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I recently got a new car and didn\'t want to mess up my seats with my girl\'s car seats.  In the past I had just used a towel to try to keep my seats looking nice.  These are SO MUCH BETTER!!  They are easy to install and really help cover my seats.  I like the "lip" edge on them that keeps snacks from getting everywhere.  Such a great purchase I\'ll be buying 2 more for my husband\'s new truck!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Love this seat protector.  Using Stage 1 right now, although it is a bit wide for the middle of a back seat (since the edges are curled, anyone sitting on either side of the infant seat has to somewhat sit on seat saver.  This will truly be useful once my son is old enough and we move from an infant carrier with base to a convertible car seat.  The width will then make sense.  Highly recco.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Not sure what car is in the picture shown, but this cover doesn\'t come nearly to headrest in my Fusion. Other than that, the material is thick and this should prevent carseat from making indentions in leather like we were getting with the cheaper vinyl protector.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This has saved my seats many times. It stays in place and catches all the crumbs and spills from my daughter. Cleaning it is a breeze.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: After using multiple covers these are the best we have found.  They leave the least amount of indentions in the seats as others do.  The only draw back is they separate easy when the are getting installed due to the velcro.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Does a good job protecting leather seats from the imprint of car seat that is tightly strapped in.  I wish the back was about two inches taller but overall I\'m very pleased.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Granted,  I just installed this product 5 minutes ago (two of them, one for each child), but so far - I love it.  Even though both my daughters only use a booster seat, I opted to connect the back rest portion.  With the thought that my seats in my new Audi A4 will just be protected that much more.  I originally bought two "Babies R Us Exclusive" covers for $15 ea.  Those seem like they would do the trick as far as protecting the seats from dirt & spillage, but not be so great for protecting the leather seats from indentations.  So I then ordered these Prince Lionheart protectors.  They are still soft, but hard enough to protect my leather seats (completely different than the Babies R Us exclusives).  The seats in my car are black so these Lionheart seat protectors match perfectly.  BTW - I opted for the completely free shipping and it took one day to show up at my house (we live in NJ and looks like they got shipped from a warehouse in PA) - so Im glad I didnt pick "next day" shipping or anything else that would have cost $$$.I\'ll give an update after we\'ve had & used this product longer.  But so far - WAY BETTER than what I bought two days ago at Babies R Us.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I just purchased a new SUV with leather seats and wanted to make sure the booster and the full car seat wouldn\'t damage the back set.  After installing these, the leather seats won\'t get damaged but more importantly, my children are safe as well.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I bought this seat protector after getting a new van. The product fits well and covers the entire surface area of the seat. It is thick and well made and I especially like the flap that covers the front edge of the seat.  Excellent quality product.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Product is great for protecting leather seats. I have a 2011 Camaro & my baby\'s car seat was ruining my leather. I came across this product while searching for a solution. This product has saved my back seat!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We have been using this seat protector for over 2 months and it fulfilled our expectations.1- It is pretty well made2- it will not slide over leather seats3- The back protector is tall enough for SUVs4- Carseats will not leave marks leather seats

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Grandma was not ready to give up leather seating in her car and wanted something to protect the leather from damage when a booster seat was installed.  The Prince Lionheart Two Stage Seat Saver seemed to be what I was looking for.  Not only was it somewhat more rigid than other seat protectors, but it came in tan so that it matched my car\'s interior.  Additionally, since I live in south Texas, the lighter color is more desirable for purposes of keeping the vehicle\'s interior from getting so hot.  There should be no issue with the seat saver staining the lighter leather black as, based on reviewers\' comments, some other brands do.The Prince Lionheart Two Stage Seat Saver was easy to install.  The base filled one of the back "bucket" seats; the seat saver\'s back needed to have been about 4" longer to completely protect the booster seat back from coming in contact with the vehicle\'s seat.  Further, it would have been helpful if each side of the Prince Lionheart Two Stage Seat Saver had tabs that extended over the seat back.  That would have prevented the booster seat straps from digging into the vehicle\'s seat when the booster seat was correctly installed.  Because of the vehicle\'s seat depth, the Prince Lionheart Two Stage Seat Saver\'s front flap does not "bend" at the marked area, but still provides a bit of protection to the seat edge.  Having a little one who likes to "drum" his feet makes me appreciate this feature; I do wish the flap had been a bit longer and had multiple grooves for bending.There was no sliding of the Britax Frontier 85 SICT Booster Seat which was installed on this seat saver; the booster seat held firmly in place.  The backing on the Prince Lionheart Two Stage Seat Saver is a rubber-like mesh, similar to the material used to keep floor rugs from sliding.  Since I have not yet had the seat in place during one of our very hot Texas summers, I do not know whether there will be a sticking problem.  I will probably remove the booster seat during the summer unless our little one is visiting so that I can avoid this potential problem.I would have rated the Prince Lionheart Two Stage Seat Saver a 4.5, if that rating had been available.  With the exception of the suggested changes, I am very pleased with this product.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: It is an indispensable equipment to protect the seat of my carit conceals very well and makes it perfectly jueco with chairI highly recommend it to all mothers often avoid washing the seat

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I have a two year old and what a mess he makes in the car.  The nice thing about this is that it doesn\'t harm the leather seat as if you would have without it.  It does make some indent, but not as bad.  I would recommend this to anyone.
