name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I ordered these to protect the leather in my new Ford Flex, after returing a black Eddie Bauer set with no back piece to Target.  The gray looks so much better than all the other options I considered.  They worked great for both my rear-facing and front-facing car seats on the second row bucket seats.  Both car seats fit very tight and secure... no slippage or wiggle room.  You\'re supposed to use only the bottom piece for the rear-facing, but I used the whole set anyway.  I will mention, however, the front-facing car seat was still a bit too tall for the seat saver.  I had to add a gray, folded over hand towel to protect the headrest from the top of the car seat.  I don\'t think there\'s anything the manufacturers could do to solve this problem though.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Nice product. Material seems very durable. Pad is a liitle too wide for my toyota highlander seat but its ok. Thanks!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Love it! Very good quality, and great protection! Every parent should have one or two! I definitely would recommend this product!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Just purchased this for our newborn\'s car seat so it wouldn\'t ruin our leather and so far so good! Great Purchase!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I had to buy a new car when I got pregnant. It had brand new tan leather so I bought this to protect the seats. They first of all, work great at the protecting...however, they blend in so well they are hardly noticeable. Works so good I bought another one for my second baby\'s car seat.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I\'ve purchased these based on a suggestion from my neighbor.  We\'ve purchased 3 of them because we are so happy with the quality.  The material is sturdy and thick and it stays put.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This has been a good buy for me, has saved my vehicles seats on numerous occasions, only issue is that liquid can still flow out the back, so if something is spilled act quickly. Would have been better if top and bottom where all one piece. Also it is very good at keeping car seat wear away from vehicle seat fabric.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This is great.  Unlike other car seat protectors this is heavy duty and won\'t cause the car seat to leave marks on your seats through the protector

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I now have had this product in my car for 1 month. Tried using it with a booster seat with the back portion removed and it did not stay in place. I returned it. Too frustrating for my child to try and connect her seat belt.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: These have been great in our car under the car seats for our 2 grandchildren! Seat saver indeed! Easy to clean!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: These are working wonderfully on my new car. We\'ve had them for 4 months now, they were easy to install a car seat on top of and are holding up well so far.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Protects my car upholsery & catches small crumbs that fall when my kids eat stuff...I put a black towel on top of this seat protector to prevent the car seat from slipping.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I do recommend this product to anyone who has young children and of whom you would like to keep your vehicle nice and clean.  I have a 51/2 yr old boy, a 4 yr old boy and a newborn.  The boys are wild enough and dirty that the protective seat cover is great.  With the dirty shoes resting on the leather seats(just below the car seat), and the booster car seats themselves moving around when they try to get in that the seat protectors work wonders. Then, with the infant car carrier that would normally leave an indention and rub marks on the seat the protective cover does not allow for that to happen. Again, I do recommend this product to anyone who wants to keep most of there vehicle looking nice.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Very nice but they are square and do not fit well in a contoured back seat.  For instance there should be an indent  on both back corners for seatbelts.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Seat savers are very attractive in my car\'s leather interior.  I bought it mainly to help with slippage of the booster seats.  I do wish that the backing on the bottom of the seatsaver had an even better gripping finish to prevent slippage in case of sudden stops.  It is better than not having anything but I wish it gripped even better.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I didn\'t like this product at all.  It gets 2 stars instead of 1 because some of what I don\'t like is personal preferance.In order to package it, they fold up the base which puts a crease across the whole thing that doesn\'t seem like it will ever go away.  It is too large, IMO.  And, it has a strong odor that didn\'t go away after letting it air out for quite awhile.  And, the tan color was not the shade that I was expecting.  I returned mine for a Sunshine Kids Ultra Mat, which I love.  It works great, looks great, and doesn\'t smell.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: The bottom part worked great with out seats. I just wish the two parts were attached and for the top part to be bigger. I tried to use it but it\'s just hanging there by itself, hopefully the seat harness holds it in place.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I think this product is a good $14 investment when you consider the mess that sometimes children make as well as how your seat will look like after having a tightly installed car seat for years.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I have now purchased five of these for all of our various car seats. I\'ve been using them for almost three years. I love that you can use the top and the bottom separately. With the rear facing baby seats it\'s nice not to use the seat back part. The seatsaver is unobtrusive in the cars and has done a good job protecting our seats. I have never noticed any denting or damage to our seats when I take the car seats out once in a while.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: The product does what it says.Our Subaru is equipped with the LATCH system and the cover works just fine with our infant car seat.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Perfect for leather seats! I have two babies now and bought a 2nd because the 1st one has protected my car from all the liquids & foods & stickiness that the first baby has put my back seat through! Sturdy material, easy to vacuum & wipe up! Definitely worthy of 5 stars!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: i like the look and thickness/material of this seat saver, but it\'s too wide (atleast 4 inches) for the center position of my 2001 mercedes SL350 and it does not have any seat belt slots to compensate. :(

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This product seems like it would work very well at keeping car seats from denting up a vehicle\'s seat, it also has a non slip gripper on the bottom that held it firmly in place, but it was too wide for the seats of my Ford Fusion and I was not able to access the buckle, so I had to return it.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I love this!  I have it tan and black.  I use them as seat protectors.  They are comfortable and easy to clean and look good in the car!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We bought these to prevent food stains as well as dents on the seats of our Expedition. SO far we like the product. A nice hard surface to prevent dents as well as the curved edges to keep food from going onto the seats. Our onlly complaint is that the seat savers are very wide and we couldn\'t fit two next to eachother, even in our large expedition. The side is folded up where the seat belt buckles in.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Excellent product, it really protects leather seats, finally, we had bought another car seat protector, it was terrible

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: If you have kids and a nice car, buy this.  That\'s pretty much all I can say about it.  It\'s amazing.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I have a few different car seat savers and this is the best one I have ever owned.  Simple, easy to install and at a great price point. I use this in my 2013 Prius and it is perfect.  Does exactly as it is described and advertised to do.  Get it.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: The product itself seemed to be very good quality, but the non-slip gripping material on the bottom would have ruined our leather seats in the hot south Texas climate. If the fact that the product was non-slip was in the description, I did not see it. Product was returned (I found out that returns are VERY easy with Amazon - UPS picked up at my door).

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We bought two of these seat protectors for our twins 2 1/2 years ago.  We just replaced their car seats and were fully expecting to have to buy a new set of seat protectors.  After over two years of spills and stickiness the mats were a mess (but the seats underneath them were in perfect condition).  Just to see, we tried washing off the Prince Lionheart Seat Saver and to our great surprise it looked brand new!  Every bit of muck came off.  We put them back under the new car seats!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I bought two of these seat savers for my Honda Odyssey to accommodate Britax Marathon carseats.  Yes, the bases are wide, but isn\'t that the point?  The non-slip surface on the underside grips the leather very well and my car seats have no slip and slide when latched in and secured.  The front flap is great for keeping melting snow and ice and general muck from my kid\'s shoes off the front of the seat.  I wished I\'d bought a third for the infant car seat!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: They deffinitely dont slide around and keep the seats where I want them, the design is excellent! ! ! ! !

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Now that my son is kicking his feet and winter is here this seat protector is all sorts of a mess.  I got this originally to keep food he eats in the car from grinding it the seat or staining it, and to prevent the Car Seat Impression from setting into the fabric.The best part of this I see now is the front flap that covers the area an adults knees bend at has saved my seat from wet feet dripping salt and mud onto the fabric.  I can\'t even describe how gross that area has become from his shoes after walking outside this winter.  This is a MUST HAVE if you care about your fabric IMHO.I don\'t have this for my other kid who is still in the baby carrier seat, but once she is in a full out Car seat I will be getting more of these. The price seems high until you see how much it protects.Install was not hard, but a little annoying. The item has "folds" from shipping and it does not layout nice, so you have to place it in the area and then put the seat on it and move things around until its right.  Only takes a few minutes though, over all not bad.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Have used these in a Subaru Outback and a Toyota Sienna.  They fit well in the seats and protect the leather.  They have not worn out yet after over two years of use.  Still in great shape.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Great item, color looks great on my new 2013 Town and Country in grey.  They have to be situated just right to buckle in when using a booster,  as they get bumped and moved as kids get in and out so need to be adjusted often.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This is a great idea and I can see how it would be convient to protect your seats but it doesnt work well if your seats in your car do not have a gap to slide the back of this into between the top and bottom part of the cars seat.  Otherwise good, my car seat base doesnt seem as solid with this under it.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Nice product, i went ahead and purchase three more.  especially good protection for leather seats but still left marks on the seats

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I purchase these and they are as described. They are thicker than most brands. Therefore so far i think they will do the job

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: These are doing a good job protecting my car form indentations and crumbs.  Likely to buy some for dh\'s car too.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We tried to install his under our car seat, but it didn\'t fit easily under the seat base in our small car, and seemed to make installation more difficult.  Rather than risk it, we haven\'t used it.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: The Lionheart seat saver does an excellent job in keeping your car upholstery like new.  I was able to get a tight fit by "getting in" my child\'s seat while installing.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Pros: Using this for the past six years. Good strong material, ensures that the car seats do not damage the surface, in addition the depression in the base seat acts as a collector of wastes. My kids did not like the feel at the backs when they switched to boosters and the two stage feature allows for the back portion to be removed.Cons: NoneRecommend: Yes

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I have 4 of these, they really protect the leather seats in my cars, the base is quite thick and stiff so resists indenting the seat that it is placed on. Also they catch most of the debris the children throw about. I think this is the best type of the ones I have seen.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I absolutely love these seat savers. They stay installed in our Volvo XC 90\'s seats permanently under our twins infant seats. These are stiff and provide good protection to the supple seat leather. On one or two occassions that I took the infant seat off, I noticed that there were no noticable marks left by the seat bases on the car seats. Highly recommended !EDIT: Just to put minds to rest : I took my car for safety inspection after installing the infant seats with these and the safety officer after testing them passed these with flying colors. So for anyone who says that these are a safety hazard has either not installed them correctly or their car seats are not designed to accept these. One has to make sure that the car seat (or car seat base) is installed extremely tightly and does not have any play when shaken.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I wish we would have found these earlier as I\'ve had a flimsy little Eddie Bauer seat for over three years that pretty much does nothing. Since then we had another baby and a new car so I was on the search for two seat protectors.I have a Mercedes S550 and the blue-gray color looks great inside but more importantly these have enough resistance to them that they actually work. They are almost stiff but still a little flexible and the material is firm enough to distribute the pressure caused from the Britax frame so that there are none of those indentions left behind.Would I buy again? Absolutely. I have two and will be buying two more.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This works really well, and looks good, too. The belt for the LATCH system on my car makes the back buckle a bit, but the velcro problem of the earlier models has definitely been fixed. There is no separation between the two pieces at all, even after I belted the car seat in tightly.They make this in two colors, black and a light gray. The black color stained my light color seats, so I\'ve since switched to the light gray, which does not seem to have this problem. Unless your seats are a very dark color, go with the gray color instead.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This product doesn\'t fit with the base for the Britax companion car seat.  We are going to save it for when we move out of the infant seat to see if it will work.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Nice light color, goes well with the interior of our car.  While it doesn\'t completely keep seats from being crushed by the carseat, it does help the cushions somewhat.  Also, food is no longer ground into the seat and the seatsaver wipes off nicely.Con:  Would be nice if the back was higher for the humongous carseats they make now (Graco Nautilus).

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I bought these years ago and finally gave them away this year because I no longer have any car seats. Very durable and saved my seats in the car from all the pressure a child"s car  seat can make plus the dirt and spills. Cleans easily. I even used the top portion for some other protection. A very good purchase to protect your seats.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: What a great product! It goes in very easy. Catches 99% of the mess my kids drop or spill (impossible to catch it all) as well as protecting the leather. I ordered 2 and use for both a front and rear facing car seat. I

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I purchased these seat protectors to protect the cloth seats in my new Toyota Hylander. I have two small grand-children who tend to be messy.  The side ridges are great for holding in spilled snacks or liquids.  The front of the seat flap covers the front portion of the seat also.....which is great.  They are a little pricey.....but you get what you pay for!I purchased the light gray and they match my seats perfectly.  I would recommend purchasing these seat savers.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We brought this to the Toronto Police both times for our Graco Snugride 35 (infant carseat) and our Diono (used to be Sunshine Kids) big kid seat.  We had both of them installed with these seatsavers into a Nissan Altima and a Nissan Rogue SUV as we had two of each car seat.  All seatsavers took some time to properly secure as we have leather in both vehicles, but it was well worth it.  Kept our vehicles clean too.  They are extremely snug and if the Toronto Police approve, that\'s good enough for me

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Awesome- bought one for each vehicle, they shipped immediately and work great, worth the price!!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: Keeps from having the car seats leave those deep marks in the seat. Although I wish the top half was a bit longer/taller. Other than that it does that it\'s supposed to, and a great price!

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I have leather seats in my car and truck and this is a true life saver.  I have another brand that I had purchased when my son was born and it did the job, but after buying one of these for a baby shower gift and one for myself, this one is 1st choice.  You won\'t regret spending the $20 for this protector.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: We bought this and another seat saver to do a comparison and this protector won.  We needed it for a heavy carseat that we use for our granddaughter that is 3 years old.  While this is a stiff product that is exactly what we were looking for.  No permanent indents with this protector!!  We have already recommended this to our son for his newest addition.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: I originally was told by an \'expert\' to use the rubber contact paper to line the bottom of my car seats.  After purchasing a new car I had to remove both of the car seats and underneath it was filthy, there were parts where the rubber from the contact paper had ruined the leather and the pressure from the seats left a permanent indentation in the leather...not happy.  So i decided to get these to cover my new car\'s leather.1) Sturdy and well built, i think that this will hold up to the pressure of the car seats on the leather and will protect it from leaving any indentations.2) Lots of coverage, it has coverage all around the car seat to allow it to catch EVERYTHING that falls, liquids even.  It also has a separated top portion that you can take off for infant seats, i actually just left it on for rear facing protection and it works fine.  IF you look at other seatsavers, it doesn\'t seem to have as much coverage as this one.3) Non slip underside, almost similar to the rubber contact that I had used originally.Although it can get pricey - I bought 4, two for each car, but definitely worth it after I saw how badly the car seat and food droppings can ruin your leather.

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: worth every penny you need this if you have a baby seat installed in your car

name: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver, Black
review: This review is partly a comparison to Brica\'s seat protector which I also got.  Prince\'s version is flimsy compared to Brica\'s so seat indents aren\'t as readily protected against.  Prince\'s version is also smaller in depth, so it didn\'t fit as nicely as the Brica.  Also, due to the flimsiness, it doesn\'t hold the tray shape at the bottom as well.  So the trough at the bottom to catch things is deformed after installing the car seat.  As a result it looks like it will not work as well as advertised.  The foot flap doesn\'t really fold down due to the lack of depth.  This all depends on your back seat depth, but this was a problem for an 07 Accord.The worst part is the grippy material used on the Prince version.  It\'s same material as the non-glue grip pads you can buy in stores for lining shelves, etc.  This material slowly exudes a chemical of some sort that will get absorbed by any porous material.  As other reviewers have noted, this may likely stain your leather seats.  Not sure how this will do on cloth seats.If I had to do it again, I\'d spend the little extra money to get the Brica product.  It\'s sturdier, fits better (car dependent), and reviewers have noted that it will not stain leather seats in the long wrong.  I\'ve owned both products too short a time to tell if the staining portion will be avoided on the cloth seats and if the Brica will not stain leather seats.

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: I bought this bag because I thought it looked like I could use it as a purse but it was also my diaper bag.  Unfortunately on the 3 occasions that I\'ve tried to use it I\'ve found that will not hold everything that I need for it to hold and it doesn\'t hold Avent bottles very well.  It\'s cute but I think I\'m better off with the free bag that I got from the hospital!  I will be selling it on Ebay!

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: I have been using this diaper bag for my daughter, and it works wonderfully for us.What I like:-  I no longer carry a purse, so this is the only bag I need.  No more lugging around different bags.-  Changing pad is fine, and is not connected to the bag so it is easy to pull out.-  Our bottles fit in the side pockets-  I prefer the roomy inside rather than a ton of divided pockets.  I can fit a change of clothes, receiving blanket, spare bottle & formula, breastpump (for trips), 5 or 6 diapers, changing pad, wipes, toys, snacks for me, and still have room left!-  Vinyl/"leather" is easy to wipe off, unlike some fabrics.  We have already had to wash our Eddie Bauer bag (my husband\'s) when our daughter had an blowout on the changing table that hit the bag as it was sitting on the floor.  It was not easy to clean, but this bag would have been.-  Love the cell phone holder - this is what makes it easy for me to use as a purse also.  No digging around inside when the phone rings.-  Great style!The only change I would make to the bag is for one of the outer pockets to have a zipper.  Since I use this bag as my purse, it would be nice if the pocket where I put my wallet and keys had a zipper.  Since the pockets are deep, it still works ok, but would make me feel more secure if I could zip it closed.

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: I just bought this bag and being particularly picky about my bags, I pretty much like this one. For the moms (or dads) who don\'t like the baby-themed bags, this is great. Looks like real leather, the white stitching looks nice, not cheap. The bag is roomy on the inside, which was one of my main concerns. I have a toddler and a baby and need enough room for diapers, wipes, clothes for both toys, etc. and this bag can fit it all. The straps are long enough to get all the way up on your shoulder without falling down. The only thing I do NOT like about it is the zipper does not close the bag entirely. There is a one inch or so opening on either side of the zipper, so potentially a small item could fall out if the bag got flipped upside down. Otherwise I would have given it a 5/5.

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: I bought this diaper bag when I had my daughter 9 months ago.  I wanted something that looked more like a purse and that had enough room that I could put all my things in as well so I wouldn\'t need to carry two bags.  I give this bag no special treatment, it\'s been stepped on, spilled on, thrown around, taken to the beach, etc. and has stood up to it all.  I still get comments by mothers about how stylish it is.  The only thing that I would change is to be able to somehow close the outside pockets (zipper, snap, magnet), though I have never had a problem with anything falling out, I put my keys in an outside pocket and I would prefer that it shut.  Other then that I LOVE this diaper bag and would recomend it.

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: This was a great diaper bag...except that the routine my husband and I developed was that I always ended up carrying the baby and he always carried the diaper bag. He didn\'t mind carting it around once in a while, but after a while he began to protest that he was always carrying a purse around. :) We ended up getting a more unisex looking model that both of us liked.(Also, this doesn\'t have a refrigerated compartment, which is important if you\'re carrying stored breastmilk).

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: The bag is a pretty good value for the money. However, I was disappointed that there wasn\'t a zippered pocket on the outside of the bag. I was hoping to use this for a purse and diaper bag but I haven\'t been able to use it that way without a zippered pocket to hold my keys, billfold, etc. Also, I was also diappointed with the changing pad. It is small and has velcro on both sides so it tends to catch things when you are using it.

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: This bag is great!  I can carry it out in public and no one gives me that "EEEEWWW - a parent!" look.  Also, the changing mat is perfect (now that baby is bigger only her diaper fits on it, but also not too big to carry in bag).  It also has plenty of pockets for me to carry my stuff in it without a purse. Although the cell phone holder is way too big for my phone, I do use it to carry other items (formula packets, diaper ointment, favorite baby toys).  I love that there is a pocket built in for those clothes you had to change baby out of while out, and the interior mesh pockets are the perfect size for a small box of wipes and about 7 diapers.This is the best diaper bag!  The only thing it lacks to make it absolutely perfect is a smaller bag that is easily removable to carry when you "pop in" somewhere for a minute.

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: I bought this as a gift for my sister who had her 2nd baby 14 years after her first. I wanted it to be perfect for her.  SHE LOVED IT.  So did all the other mothers.  My sister liked the convenience of the outside pockets, the length of sholder straps, and all the room on the inside. It is a very multi-functional bag. She also liked that it didn\'t look like your typical "diaper bag". She plans on using it as a purse once the baby out grows the need for a diaper bag.

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: i just have a question. i have 2 babies 13 months apart a 9 month and a 1 1/2 year old little girl. i have been in search of a diaper bag since i still am using the winnie pooh one i got for her shower. i can fit 4 bottles each on the outside of the diaper bag. i like being able to fit the bottles on the outside of the diaper bag because i had another diaper bag and i had a bottle spill and everything was ruined and i had to throw my bag out. this looks like what i am looking for. I HOPE SO

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: This is a great bag.  It looks great, and it has held up very well for me.  A few more pockets / compartments would be nice, but most of all I wish it had an insulated bottle compartment.  If you get the bag - and I DO recommend the bag - make sure you buy an insulated bottle holder as well, because this bag doesn\'t have one.

name: Mid City Tote - Diaper Bag
review: I loved this bag!  I am not the baby so I did not want to carry around a baby print bag.  Unfortunately this bag did not hold up...  The strap litterally just pulled out on one side.  There was no unusual wear and tear on this bag, in fact we had another diaper bag we used as well so this one wasn\'t even used everyday.  I am dissapointed that this bag barely made it past my little one\'s 6 mos bday...

name: Knit Double Headrest - Chambray Denim
review: I am a pediatric nurse and carseat technician.  I would encourage parents to check with manufacturers of their carseats before using aftermarket products such as the ones shown above.  Headrest that come with carseats are designed to not interfere with harness function.  Most after market products change harness fit.But most important-ATTEND A CARSEAT CLASS AND HAVE A CERTIFIED TECHNICIAN ASSIST YOU IN INSTALLING YOUR SEAT IN YOUR CAR AND TEACHING YOU HOW TO SECURE YOUR CHILD IN THE SEAT. Please visit [...] for information on carseat safety and TECHNICIAN LOCATIONS.  Carseat angle (to protect infant airway) and correct use and installation for each ride is so important.

name: Knit Double Headrest - Chambray Denim
review: I took a baby safety course from a local police department before my son was born.  I was cautioned about using these types of products because your babies head should be directly against the car seat.  I was told to cut the backing out, which I did because I had already discarded the receipt.  Save your self money, and use rolled up recieving blankets.  Even after cutting the backs out, these did not work as well as rolled up recieving blankets.

name: Knit Double Headrest - Navy
review: we were worried on how our son\'s hand was when he was in his carseat because you know how babies are as infants when they sleep they can support their own head so it cocks off to the side and looks very unsafe and uncomfortable so we got him one of the knit double headrest and now we don\'t worry as much because it helps keep his head in place. So I myself highly recommend it if you are worried about your baby\'s head in the carseat off to the side.

name: Knit Double Headrest - Navy
review: This really is a "must have" item for a new Mom.  You can use it in car seats, in bouncy chairs, in baby swings etc.  I use mine in a bouncy chair that my newborn would not be able to sit in otherwise.  A great purchase for the price.  Definitely worthwhile to have on hand for whatever baby item needs extra head and neck support.

name: Knit Double Headrest - Navy
review: after my son turned 1 month his head kept falling to the outside of the headrest just about to his knees! it was very scary looking from the rear veiw mirror while trying to drive once we took it out he was just fine.

name: Knit Double Headrest - Navy
review: I am unsure if every new mom and dad need this item. We got one, thinking it was a must have. Our son used it for one month. The car seat that we got(graco sugride) came with a headrest that would have been fine. He has outgrown the smaller part of this headrest it at 8lbs and 21 inches. It might be nice to get, then see the size of your newborn. That way, you could return it if your child does not need it. I can see where it would be a must have for a preemie.

name: Knit Double Headrest - Navy
review: I started using this when my daughter was born (over 5 months ago). It is great. We first used it with both headrests and now that she is bigger, we just use the larger one. It keeps her head from moving side to side in her car seat. We actually have 3 of these - for her car seat, her swing and her high chair (ours reclines so we could use it immediately).It does not have directions, but then it is very easy to figure out how to "install" it - you just place it where you want it.I\'ve washed this and have had no problems (I let it air dry).

name: Knit Double Headrest - Navy
review: Its a great head rest and comes in two sizes that can be used together or alone. It provides a bit more support to newborns neck and head than many of the headrests that come included with the car seat and stroller sets. I did not know i needed this item as a first time mother until my sister (already a mom) told me to put this on my registry. I am glad I did.

name: Knit Double Headrest - Navy
review: I purchased this product after my daughter was born.The installation took me a while to figure out.Slide the top of the carseat strap into the slit of the headrest (it should have about the same width as the slit), open the velcro and hook it around the loop then fasten it back.The strap stays in the slit and the headrest doesn\'t fall out of the carseat when you lift the baby out.I gave this product 3 stars because even though I like its fit around the baby\'s head and its softness, I wish it had more support on the sides and kept its shape better.It works well in the swing or bouncer seat though.

name: Knit Double Headrest - Ecru
review: This product worked for me and my extremely fussy 2 month old baby who rather be all bent over than have a headrest. The infant seat that they gave me for my son did not com with a headrest.  I had bought to others form different makers and he hated it. I even tried the rolled up blanket and he would move his head and arms until he was able to drop them. In my case I used the larger headrest for the car seat.  He is still able to move his head which is what he likes with out letting him bend over into a ball.If you have a fussy baby and you have tried everything try this and see if it works for you.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Awesome! My daughter loves loading it up with dirt. Rolls really well on hard flooring.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I purchased this for me because I had a sound machine but it broke after 7 years of use. When I plugged it in and turned it on, the sounds where nice. I enjoyed the mode that lets me combine 2 sounds. It makes it sound more natural. I know this is for a baby, but It works great for anyone looking for a sound machine. The only con I had with this is that the sounds should be of a higher quality, and it should be able to be turned up louder then it can. Otherwise, I love it.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This is a good machine, but the sound level could be a lot louder. I bought this to drown out the noise we make when traviling and staying in a hotel room for which we all have to sleep in the same room. My 1 year old is a light sleeper and wakes at every little sound. This helped a little. We put it right by her play pin and had it as aloud as it could go, but she would still hear us. I have used one of the other more expensive machines from my sister with just the white noise. The level of that machine was much louder and my daughter never woke when we were all sleeping in the same room. I wuld say this is a good machine, but if you have a light sleeper as I do, go with the more expensive white noise machine.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Our newborn was not a great sleeper. He would wake several times a night. After we bought this and used the womb sounds, he slept longer and deeper. When he got a little older, the ocean sounds became essential for naptime. Get this with Happiest Baby On the Block (the book...the DVD is not as good) if you really want to get some sleep at night. These two items are the reason why we got any sleep during the newborn phase of our son\'s life, and why he sleeps so soundly throughout the night now at 6 months (since 2 1/2 months).

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I purchased this item and was very disappointed with its performance. The white noise sounds are not very loud. The secondary sounds include sea gulls, buoys, and thunder. These sounds are not calming as a sound sleeper product title suggests. Complete waste of money.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This is one of the best sound machines out there. It is loud enough without being obnoxious, and on our baby monitor we can still hear my daughter over the sounds. so we can use it elsewhere when our daughter gets older.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I returned this product after using it for 1 night in my 2-year old\'s room. I agree with the other reviewers who complained about the volume. I had it on the highest volume and I needed it to go up 1 or 2 more notches. If you want something that can block outdoor noises such as loud birds or trash trucks in the morning, or indoor noises such as siblings in the same room, then I don\'t recommend purchasing this product. On the plus side, the product is very light, would be easy to travel with, and has a large selection of sounds, if those features are important to you.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This is good for the price. Its a decent white noise machine for a baby. My daughter has slept much better since we got it. I keep it on all night as well at during her naps. Satisfactory product. Might get one for my sons room.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I like the variations of sounds and that you can combine them.  Most, however, have, as someone else said, distractingly short loops.  I actually like "Rain," but many others keep me up at night through his monitor.  My son would play with it for an hour if I let him.  But it is very quiet and not good for covering other noises, which is kind of the purpose as far as we\'re concerned.  Also, the volume control buttons are annoying slow to adjust.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This was way too quiet, even on it\'s loudest setting. My infant didn\'t benefit from it at all. The sounds are fine, and not too repetative as with some machines, but even in a small room (really small) I found it too quiet to be effective.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Disappointed and will be returning product tomorrow. The description states in runs on 4 batteries and we were intending to use it in our trailer for our baby when we go camping. Well, it does not work with batteries except on demo mode. What a ridiculous design. Wish the description had been accurate so we wouldn\'t have wasted our time.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We used this machine for over 2 years in the kids\' nursery and never had any issues with it.  I liked that you could combine the sounds to have two at one time.  Also appreciated that you could set it to stay on or set it to shut off after a while.  We usually kept it on and found ourselves growing used to hearing it through the baby monitor.Whether or not the white noise actually helps the kids sleep - I have no idea.  It seemed to help and if anything they associated the noise with quieting down and bed time.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: My two month old used to wake up every two hours all night long.  However,  since I started using the Sound Sleeper, he has been sleeping through the night!  I use the "rain" mode because I noticed he liked the sound of the shower and it is similar to that. The volume seems just fine to me.  I put it on a chair right next to his crib and it is plenty loud!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Bought this for my boys who share a room. They take turns on which settings they will sleep to each night.  We even take it with us on vacation as it provides a feeling of home when sleeping in a hotel room.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This wouldn\'t go loud enough to actually drown out noises outside our daughter\'s room which was the entire point of getting her a white noise machine. I\'m returning it.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I read every review and thought I would give it a try. The sounds are fine but the volume does not go up very high at all. We don\'t have any other kids, so our home is quiet for the most part. I think the baby will be able to hear it, if its close to him but I don\'t expect it to drown out any other noises in the house. It\'s too bad because I think some of the sounds are pretty good, some however are kind of weird just white noise. Its okay for the money. I am probably just going to deal with it rather than return it.UPDATE---- 4-21-2010Well I have been using this sound machine for almost 2 years. I was skeptical at first, obviously by my first post. But now I have to say I love it. I have basically had it turned on 24/7 for 2 years and it\'s still working and working great. Yea its not super loud but it works. My son wakes up to really loud noises but sleeps through everything else. In fact we just had our second child and I just bought another one for her room too! I think for the price its a good buy.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I didn\'t find this until my daughter was almost a year old. I had my in-laws get it for her first birthday. It is amazing! We used to have the fan on our furnace/ac run from the time my daughter goes to bed until we go to bed... just to drown out our noise. With this machine, we can finally stop using the fan. I turn on the ocean sound, and turn it up as loud as it goes (and it\'s pretty loud!). This drowns out my cleaning (banging pots and pans) and the TV. When we go to bed, I keep it on, just turn it down a bit for her. I wish we would have found this sooner!!! I recommend it to everyone!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This is a MUST HAVE not only does it help my baby sleep but her 8yr old sister likes it as well.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I bought this to replace the one I have -  my buttons were completely worn out... In fact I ordered two - as to have a spare ..  It does work.... but IT DOES NOT work with batteries... YOU MUST plug it in at all times... Very disappointing for what I needed it for!!  Will not really say I recommend this to anyone!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We have used this for our son for several years, and we really love it - there a dual sounds that can be combined and it works very well.  We have taken this on trips to hotels also.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Got this product to help my 2 month old sleep better in a house full of noisy siblings, it was so so quiet, I could barely hear it!!! This is useless unless it helps to drown out other noises to help someone sleep! What a poor poor product, very disappointed!!!!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I\'ll give this product an average rating.  The sound options are great, the ability to run the product on either batteries or electricity is great (esp. if you travel), but the maximum volume is not so good.  It\'s not loud enough for what we would like.  We have a humidifier that does the job better, but don\'t want or need to run it all the time.  So, while this product has some nice features, it doesn\'t block out some/many of the sounds between one room and the next.  It\'s merely an additional noise to whatever else is going on rather than something that muffles or puts into the background all the other sounds.  But, perhaps that\'s all the manufacturer intended!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: The sound machine has great user-friendly settings and is very reliable.  We have had several that have lasted years.  It is also great that it comes with a battery power option so it can be portable!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This machines is way too quite, you can barely hear it at its loudest volumes. It is so bad I think my machine maybe a maulfunction. Either way for the price I would recommend another products.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I purchased two of these for my two children and decided to send them back. I think that when people buy sound machines, they are buying for one of two reasons (or perhaps both). Some people buy sound machines to soothe their little one, and some buy sound machines to block other noises out. I was looking for a sound machine that would block other noises out. Though the children are in separate rooms, they were waking one another up.The reviews on the volume of this sound machine were mixed, but we decided to give it a try. This sound machine was NOT loud enough to block out noises from another room. And I am not talking about screaming; I am talking about baby whimpering/TV/etc. We kept the machines for a few days and the children were still waking each other up. If you are looking for a sound machine to help soothe your baby or to keep him/her to sleep, I think this is probably a great sound machine. For the price, it has many options and comes with a lifetime warranty. The lifetime warranty is what drew us to buy this sound machine in the first place because we have gone through so many other sound machines that stopped working.However, if you are looking for something loud enough to block noises from another room, I\'m afraid this sound machine would not work for you. I would like to say that Amazon promptly refunded my money, and I didn\'t want to give this sound machine a bad rating because for certain people, I think this would be a great option.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We got this as a baby shower gift and are really enjoying it.  I used it while I pregnant to help me relax and go to sleep, we used it in the delivery room the same way, and we have used it to calm our son and help him sleep literally since day one when we were still in the hospital.  He loves it, and it is a dream at nap time!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: this is a great product. i love the thunderstorm sounds. its not for a child, but the only thing is the volume dont get as high as i liked, so i attached computer speakers to it, works great now.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I read other reviews complaining about the low volume and poor sound but thought I\'d give it a shot anyway since I don\'t consider myself "that picky".  Evidently I am because I\'m returning this.Problem #1 was that it really didn\'t turn up loud enough to drown out the household noise for my baby.  I\'ve got two young kids and they have a way of making quite a ruckus on the wood floors whenever the baby goes does down.  That in and of itself was not a huge deal-breaker, though.Problem #2 was that I just didn\'t like ANY of the sound recordings.  If there was just one decent one I would have been happy I think.  But the tone of the recordings is just a little too high and tinny, just a little \'off\', like the pitch is wrong.  I don\'t know, I can\'t put my finger on it...it just was not something I would consider soothing.  Clearly it doesn\'t bother everyone because a lot of people have rated this really highly and enjoy it a lot.  I slept for years with a HoMedics brand sleep machine so that is the standard against which I am judging this machine.  I liked the ocean, white noise, rain, and summer night settings on that one and it worked well for my first two babies.  After it finally gave up the ghost we put a box fan in the hallway while sleeping.  I had high hopes that this would be able to replace the fan but I think I\'ll just have to try HoMedic\'s newer model that replaced the one I had.  I would suspect that it would be able to beat this one for recording quality and it is in the same price range.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We love the dex baby sound machine. We have given it as a gift to friends and have bought more than one. They are perfect for sensitive sleepers.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Works great, I have a friend with a two year old little boy that has never slept through the night without waking up two to four times, every little sound would have him up. She started using the Sound Sleeper one week ago and since then he will wake up once for a bottle and the sounds that use to wake him do not wake him any more. Greta product, does what we hoped it would.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I bought this sound machine for my grandson.  He is 2 yrs. old and has always needed background noise to sleep.  He loves the rain and the fact that he can push the buttons.  I consider it a great buy!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Bought this to help my son sleep and night and we love it. He loves to pick the sounds each night before going to sleep. I was worried about the volume, due to some of the reviews, but i don\'t have any issues at all. The volume is perfect, and can get very loud...so no problems here.  Would recommend.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Fine product but it needs to go MUCH louder to be an effective sound machine. Other reviews are right. The reason I bought it is because I\'m having trouble finding a sound machine with a variety of sounds that dosen\'t have a timer on it so that it can go all night.  Will be returning this product.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: the sound sleeper is a good investment.  it cost much less than the same type product marketed for adults and it really works...on me!  i have had it over a month and it has not helped my 6 month old to fall asleep in her crib

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We have been using this sound machine in my daughter\'s room for about a year and a half now.  I\'ll list a few pros and cons:Pros:1.  Several different sounds to choose from, although we\'ve only ever used the ocean waves sound.  I believe you can also combine 2 sounds.2.  You can set this to go off automatically (I think it\'s set to go off in 20 minutes?), but we always keep it on the whole night.Cons:1.  It\'s not very loud.  I always put it on the highest volume, but even that isn\'t very loud.  Oh well.2.  When you turn it on it\'s automatically set to the lowest volume, so every time you turn it on you have to increase the volume to where you want it.  It\'s kind of annoying because if anyone other than me puts my daughter to bed I have to explain to them that they need to increase the volume on the sound machine.3.  When you turn it on, in order to keep it on all night you have to move the button up one notch.  If you move it up all the way then it will go off in 20 minutes.  I\'ve also found this difficult to explain to people if, for example, a babysitter puts my daughter to bed.I think this product would be great if you could set it to what you want (sound, volume) and when you turn it on it\'s already set to where you want it.  Overall, it\'s a good sound machine and we haven\'t had any problems with it malfunctioning in any way.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I had read the reviews for this noisemaker, and had heard that somepeople had complained the volume was too soft - however, there seemed to be enough reviews to the contrary to give me the confidence to buy this.I can not stress this enough.  This. product. is. barely. audible.On it\'s highest volume, it\'s practically useless.I will be returning this immediately.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We bought this for our daughter when she was 2 months old (she\'s now 4 months) because she was taking 45 minutes to an hour to go to sleep, even though we could tell she was SOOO sleepy.  I bought it because it had the "womb sound" option and I had read that that sound helps little baby\'s go to sleep easier; however that particular noise didn\'t seem to help her. What really works for us is the Ocean sound, though there are many other sounds that would probably work with your child. For every nap and at night we "turn on the ocean" and she conks right out.Positives:1) Timer setting turns off the sounds after 1 hour2) Batteries last (at least with the timer setting) since we bought it batteries have been repaced once (4 AA)3) Transportable! Easily fits into the diaper bag when you go on an overnight trip4) Many different sound options. If one doesn\'t calm down baby, another will.5) Price, it\'s only $20!Negitive:The only bad thing I can think of about this product is that the volume doesn\'t get very loud, if you need to block out a loud noise, this probably won\'t do it.  We just keep it in the corner of her crib though and have never had to turn the volume up very high.I absolutly love this little thing and have had no problems with it at all.  As a matter of fact I\'m here now to buy another for a co-worker who just had a baby.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This white noise machine is great! there are not that many that run all night long.  my whole house is addicted to white noise so we have 2 of these!  it runs either non-stop or on a 60 minute timer...

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Sounds a little tinny, buttons either a little touchy or I\'m heavy handed. Still good for the price

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Unit has a good selection of features, but the logic on my unit failed within a week, and could not be resurected (no cause I can guess at either).  And the way the unit is built, it cannot (or would be very hard) to take apart to poke at the guts and check for anything loose.  So it gets a "1".

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This product was great for the first six weeks I had it but now it doesn\'t work....so I think either I have a defective one or they need to work some bugs out.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We received this DEX Sound Machine as a gift when my 6 year old son was a baby. At first, I thought it was too quiet as we had been using a radio station turned to static turned up loud as our white noise source. As he got a bit older (5 - 6 months), we started using the DEX set to ocean waves. Worked great. Never had any issues with malfunctioning. Have always used the power cord so I cannot comment on it\'s battery operated ability. We\'ve had it on nearly every night since that 6 month mark (nearly 5.5 years) and it has worked fine. Purchased a second DEX for the new baby\'s room and it has also performed well. Haven\'t noticed a decline in workmanship over the last 5 years.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I got this as a white noise machine for my baby.  We used the Conair Infant Sound Machine- SU7 and clock radio for our older child and were happy with it, but she still uses it at age 3.  (I would recommend that over this - in addition to working better as a sound machine, it is cheaper and has more features).Here are the main problems with this device:- it\'s WAY too quiet and it seems like the womb sounds are the quietest of all- it doesn\'t "remember" the last volume setting it was at and always starts at the quietest setting when turned on- the volume controls are annoying - just two buttons for up and down so you don\'t really know whether you are at the loudest setting (which you will want to be if you want it to have any effect at all), so you find yourself repeatedly pushing the up button just to make sure- the sound combos so highly featured are not as great as they sound - there are only 4 sounds that you can combine with the others (and those 4 you would never use on their own), you can\'t just combine any 2 of the 10 sound options, like I had hoped.Other comments:- I personally find the timer feature annoying because it is easy to accidentally switch it to this and the noise will go off after 1 hour, waking the baby.- Some of the sounds are in fact very soothing (just too quiet!)

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I\'m a psychotherapist and bought the Dex Sound Sleeper to use to diffuse noise in my waiting room so that clients can\'t hear conversations taking place in my office.  I\'ve used other systems in the past with great success.  The two biggest complaints would be that the volume can\'t be turned up very high and that the sounds aren\'t real crisp.  The brook and the rain settings don\'t exactly sound like the real thing.  There other systems that sound better.  The nice thing this system has is that you can have two sounds play at the same time.  If you aren\'t real picky the system is fine for the price.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Overview:I bought one of these about a year ago and it\'s fine.  It included batteries and it really helped out when we needed to travel.  The current version is worse in many ways, and I do not recommend it.PROS:> It\'s a nice size, and easy to use.> It does what it says> It\'s fine if you have an outlet and your power never goes out.CONS:> The power cord is now PERMANENTLY attached and cannot be unplugged.> The battery compartment CANNOT BE USED.  That\'s right, YOU CANNOT USE BATTERIES WITH THIS UNIT.  If you want to travel, or if the power goes out, this machine is useless.  On the older version of this machine, if you unplug the power cord, the batteries can be used.  However, if the power goes out the batteries do NOT take over automatically.> This is noticeably quieter than our old version of this machine.  While the volume buttons both goes up the same number of times, our old sound machine feels like it has 2-3 louder levels.  This new machine stops getting loud at about half the volume of our old unit.  As a result, it is barely loud enough to drown out background noises in a house.> One oddity: There is a "demo" switch on the bottom, and when traveling it often gets hit, which causes this unit to turn off after a few minutes.  It\'s not a big deal, but it\'s a hassle.WOULD I BUY THIS AGAIN?> No, I would not recommend this item.----------------For what it\'s worth, the serial number on our old machine is 0409 and the new one is 1412.  Otherwise they appear identical.  I am disappointed that the new one falls short in so many ways.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I like that it has so many settings and that it has the option to stay on all night instead of just shutting off after 60 minutes, but the sound quality on the Summer Night setting is fuzzy, and the over-all maximum volume is petty quiet in my opinion. I gave it a 3 star rating because I\'ve had worse sound-makers, but this one is definitely not the best I\'ve had, and I wouldn\'t really recommend it.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: nice clear sounding device.  Hopefully it will help with sleep for the baby!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I am very pleased with this product.  My 4-month old has only been taking 20 minute cat-naps and I needed some way to encourage longer sleep during the day.  I thought maybe a background noise would help.  I did a TON of research and review-reading before making this purchase.  I was concerned after reading the reviews about the lack of volume that has been claimed for this product, but have not found this to be an issue at all.  The volume levels are not too soft at all.  In fact, I often worry about it being too loud.  It has a great volume control to fit your needs.  We use the ocean sound, and at first I was worried because one wave sound is louder than the rest, but turning the volume down one notch solved this so it wasn\'t overbearing.The sounds are fantastic.  My husband likes to play with the blending of various sounds.  There is no break in the repeat of the noises and you cannot tell when the sound is starting its cycle over again, as I have read on so many other sound sleepers.  There is a HUGE variety of sounds as well.  I was impressed.  It has something that should match anyone\'s needs.It\'s a huge advantage to have the sound sleeper be battery operated or able to plug into a wall.  It\'s been a piece of cake to quickly unplug and use it on battery power when my son has fallen asleep in our bedroom or another location.  I love this feature.  We live overseas with the military, and when we vacation we can still take it with us to use on the batteries, since we can\'t use the plugs here without an adapter/transformer.We love the timer that is on the sound sleeper as well.  We usually let it run on "on" until my husband and I go to bed.  Then, when I am going into my son\'s room to check on him for the last time in the evening, I simply flip the button to timer and an hour later it goes off when we\'re all asleep.  Love the timer feature.Overall, I\'d give this product more than 5 stars if the ratings were higher.  It was a fantastic purchase for very little spent.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Perfect sound machine for a baby or kid\'s room. We have one in each of our boys\' rooms. We love that you can change the sound or volume.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I was very disappointed with this sound machine and ended up exchanging it for the Marpac sound conditioner for my infant\'s room and my toddler\'s room in order to drown out each other\'s nightly disturbances.  The DEX does have a lot of selections, but my husband and I thought only 3 of them were soothing--the white noise, the ocean and the wind.  But the volume of the ocean sound was not constant and we thought it might actually wake our baby instead of drowning out household noises. The sound of the gulls, thunderstorm and some of the others were just plain annoying, not soothing at all. We tried combining some of the sounds, as it suggests, but it would just switch turns with two different sounds rather than playing them both simultaneously. Also, it\'s not loud enough and this is ultimately why we returned it. We are very satisfied with the Marpac, which sounds like a mixture between white noise and a fan blowing.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This item was great for about 60 days. Did everything I expected out of it. The baby liked it so I was happy. Then it would only turn on for about 5 seconds and shut off. The return on this was easy, got a new one in 2 days. We\'ll see how long this one lasts.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: The unit I got was useless. Its volume would not go above a whisper, even when I upped the volume control to the max. I attibute this to a defect in the unit. From the variation of reviews here, it seems some of these things are fine volume-wise, while others, like mine, are unusable. If this is the case, it\'s a toss of the dice whether the one you get will work. I now have to go to the hassle of sending mine back. And by the way, it looks as if it was used before and then repacked. I"m sorry but I can\'t recommend a substitute. I\'ve got to go back to square one in my research for an economical but effective noise generator.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Several of my friends own this machine and I decided to try it when I was moving our baby into his crib in his room out of our room. It is great, we turn this on to the "ocean" sound and he sleeps so much more peacefully. Noises don\'t wake him up as easily when we use this. Highly Recommend for little ones!!!! We turn it on and close the curtains and he knows that it is time to sleep.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I purchased this item and was very disappointed in the volume control.  Turned up to the highest possible volume, it was way too soft.  Even having it placed right next to my head on the pillow, it was not loud enough.  I returned it.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I had it about a week when loud crackling noises started sputtering from the speaker. This was to help my newborn sleep. Waste of money.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: The sounds sound cheap, not really clear. I only use the ocean sound because who would want to go to sleep to the sound of seagulls??!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This is the 2nd time I have bought this product. I love the ocean sound it makes, it\'s size and that you can do a timer or just let it run. I thought the 1st one was defective (it was a gift) and loved it enough to re-buy it again. Literally the second night I used it a periodic strange screeching noise would come and go(which is what the previous one did as well). It wakes you up with a start and is very very annoying! I am returning this one and just bought the Conair Infant SU7, which got great reviews (here and on target.com). I hope that it is as good as they say.....

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I bought this unit for my adult son, who suffers from tinitis (ringing in ears) and has difficulty falling asleep. He used to keep a fan running in his room all year round, just for the white noise effect, but this has eliminated the need for that. It has lots of sounds to choose from and he has been very satisfied with it.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I guess I got what I paid for...not much. Scratchy, static... The only sound that didn\'t seem mechanical was the brook.  Even that started making weird noises after 10 minutes.  Spend more and be pleased with your purchase.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I ordered this for my husband, he was having a hard time sleeping.  The first few nights it was great but after awhile you can tell when the sound loops.  If you pick up on that sort of thing, don\'t order this.  But if you don\'t care about the repetition it\'s a great product for the price!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: got it elsewhere, but I love this! It even lures me to sleep. Not a fan of the Womb sound, but the others are great.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Evidently the description of this product needs updating.  It will not work on batteries.  The instructions with the machine state "The demo mode and batteries are intended for display and shipping purposes only." I\'ve tried several times and have not been able to get it to work with batteries.  Guess this is one reason the settings will not hold when you turn it off.  Have to set your preferences and volume each time you turn it on. Probably would not have purchased if I had known this.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I chose to purchase this sound maker for my kids, 3 & 1, because it was one of the best rated and still within my budget. It works great for the kids and while visiting my mom she used it over night and decided she was going to get one too. There are two things I wish it did, play music and gradually quiet before turning off. The more expensive brands did that but I didn\'t want to pay $70 for them. So, for the money, it works great!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: There are actually far more functions on this product than I am sure we will ever use. But that just adds to it\'s versatility I suppose. I purchased this product because it doesn\'t automatically shut off after a certain time period. The sound options are great, and you have a decent range of volume options. We use this in my 2 year old daughter\'s room every night and she has slept soundly ever since!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Doesn\'t get very loud, even if the volume is up all the way. You also have to turn the volume up again every time you turn it on, because it resets to the lowest setting.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Bought an used Ipod touch instead.  Downloaded whitenoise app.  Worked better.  this was not loud enough.  Was not impressed at all.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We received this sound machine as a gift upon the arrival of our newborn.  It is simply fantastic and we use it for every nap and all night to this day (baby is 9 months old).  At first we used the womb sounds, but switched to the ocean sound (which is very soothing - we slept with baby in our room for his first six months).  I now buy this for all my expectant friends.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This is the only sound machine we use for our son. It\'s got multiple choices and you can combine them to make a custom white noise for your baby! It stays on ALL NIGHT too, which we needed.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I bought the Sound Sleeper for my 6 month old daughter after weeks of trying to get her to fall asleep on her own for her daily naps.  The first time I used it she was asleep within 10 minutes, usually she would cry for at least an hour and then sleep only 30 minutes.  Now she sleeps between 1 and 2 hours and is much less grumpy.  I, too, was afraid the volume would be too low, because she can really scream.  Sometimes she still screams, but now only for a couple minutes before she starts winding down.  The Sound Sleeper is also weaning her off her pacifier. I absolutely love the Sound Sleeper and would recommend it to anyone and everyone!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: We used these with both our kids - one is 5 and still uses this daily.  We could not live without it.  I bring one whenever we visit my parents house, where it is loud at bedtime - both the kids\' bedtimes, and ours.  I find that its the only thing that drowns out the sounds of my parents doing dishes and speaking loudly (especially if my elderly dad doesn\'t have his hearing aid in!!) and allows ME (much less the kids) to fall asleep easily.  It also helps my daughter if we are awake earlier than her - it helps her get the sleep she needs.  I disagree with folks who say it doesn\'t get loud enough - I simply strategically place the machine either close to the door or the bed (or both) so it is loud enough.  We hear it from her room to ours at night too.  Again, my machines are both at least 5 years old, and have traveled cross country many times.  The one that is used daily still is just now getting a little iffy function-wise, and its not the machine, its the cord that is \'sensitive\'.  I\'m buying one for my sister-in-law, who is expecting her first, right now!!  I highly recommend!!!!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: The idea is there... BUT the sounds just sound so fake! I tried to sleep to this last night and i wanted to throw it out the window. I don\'t expect my infant to like it. Horrible noises. The volume goes pretty loud for a quiet infants room, but when you turn it up the horrible fake noises sound even worse! This is going back tomorrow. I guess i will continue my search!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I love the on off switch.  I had a different one for my babies, and I love the fact that this one stays on all night.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Although this white noise machine takes batteries, the power cord is NOT removable. Not only that, the power adapter is 120v only, so it cannot be used overseas.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Works as expected, like the sound combination options too.  A very good deal for the price.  Only limitation I guess is that the option to have it turn off after a set period of time is not adjustable.  I always leave it on continuous anyway.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This is a great product. We love how it can stay on all night and not just time out (though it has that option too). Its so easy to take with us when we travel, it makes the not home environment sound like home for my son.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I love having a fan on in the room when I am sleeping, but bringing home a preemie in January meant I had to turn off the fan for a while.  So I bought this, and it\'s OK.  I use it, but I wish I had a different one.My biggest gripe is that I have to constantly set it to the settings I want, each night.  I use the same settings every time, the same noise, volume, etc, and yet I have to reset those every night.  I wish it would start on the last settings you had.  It only takes a couple seconds, but it\'s annoying!I use the wind sound for white noise, it works OK.In all, I could have bought a simpler one, but there are so many out there, I finally just picked one.  Now that it\'s warmer, I\'m going back to the fan!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I purchased this item for my newborn who will be born soon.I decided to try it out since i have personally been having a hard time falling asleep 38 weeks pregnant and all.So I have been using it for a week now.I must say I have been sleeping like a baby ,hee hee I guess thats exactly what I needed it for in the first place so it works great.I usually have to wear ear plugs to block out outside noise that keep me awake all night.When i go to sleep with this nifty machine on I dont need the ear plugs.It just sort of blocks out all the other stuff.It lets you select one sound,you can mix sounds and also put the system on timer (it will shut down after a while,next time you wake up its off).You can either turn it back on or just leave it off.I love it,i hope the baby sleeps as good as I have been :).I would recommend to friends.I was going to get the little fury lamb that makes the sounds but got this instead because it can be plugged into the wall.Can use the extra savings on batteries although you can put batteries in this unit and use unplugged.I hipe someone will give us the little lamby plush toy sound maker but if not I will be happy with this unit because it lets you put batteries for travel.Great for moms,dads, and babies

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: My son was a preemie and on a great 3 hour schedule in the NICU.  He would sleep soundly, waking only for feedings.  When I brought him home, I was happy that he was on such a great routine.  Yet the first 2 nights he didn\'t sleep so nicely.  The third night, grandma stayed over, and she needs to sleep with a TV on.  Well, the lil\' guy slept well each night she was there.  I thought he just needed the first 2 nights to get adjusted.  Well, I was wrong, cause once Grandma left, he was awake again at night.  He\'d sleep soundly during the day.  Convinced he had his days & nights confused, I prepared myself for a rough time.  But, then I tried to think what was different on the nights my mom-in-law was there.  Then I realized, it was just TOO QUIET in our house at night for our son to sleep.  The more I thought about it the more sense it made.  How noisy is it in the womb, then in the NICU??  I desperately looked for a white nooise machine and found that Babies \'R\' Us sold this one, as well as 2 other choices.  I went with this one because of the various sound features, the ac adaptor, and the lower price.  Well, I am so relieved that I found this!  My son sleeps so well with this on throughout the night.  I keep it close to him at the highest volume on the womb setting.  I thought for sure it would keep me awake at night, but it actually is soothing for me too.  I like the other sounds, but haven\'t switched it up on him since the womb sounds are working well for him.  It is convenient to take along on overnight trips too!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I have had one of these sound machines for over 10 years and LOVE IT!. It\'s not for a baby, it\'s for me. I cannot sleep without it. I live in a condo complex and the street and my neighbors driveway is right below my master bedroom window. This is the only way I can block out the street noise. It has been shutting off occasionally though(after 10+ years) and I was afraid I would not find another and would never get a sound nights sleep again.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I ignored the fact that many of the reviewers said that this noise machine does not get loud enough because many of the other reviewers contested that. I now kick myself everytime I put my baby to bed. If you want a soothing sound for your non-crying baby or child to listen to as they fall asleep, this might be for you. If you want a white noise machine that will block out the sounds of the household, or one that your baby can hear over his or her crying, DO NOT buy this one. It does not get loud enough!!!The other flaw to this product is the volume control. There are two buttons to control the volume (up and down), but there is no visual indicator of where in the range of volume you are. It is difficult to tell, when pressing the volume button, that the volume is changing at all, so I can\'t tell when I have turned it all the way up. This wouldn\'t matter too much, except that the volume resets to the middle everytime you turn the machine off. This is very irritating. When I am trying to get my baby to sleep, the last thing I want to do is mess with a difficult volume control!This seemed like a great product by the description, but it is really quite flawed.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: After two months of little sleep and many failed attemps to get my colicky baby to stop crying I bought the DEX Sound Sleeper.  I didn\'t think that it would work, since nothing else had.  But to my surprise (and my husband\'s) it did.  I can now lay her down for naps and bedtime in her bassinnet with the "womb" setting on and she sleeps.  It has really helped to get her on a schedule.  My 18 month old was an easy baby, so this has been tough to deal with, but not now.  My newborn is awake a lot more and not crying as much when she is.  During the day, I can set her in her vibrating bouncy seat, womb sound playing and she\'s a happy camper and I can play with her sister or even get some house work done.  Plus, I\'m getting sleep at night, which makes Mommy happy.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This Unit is OK, it works, just OK... does not go loud enough, apologies to those who say it does... maybe for an infant, but beyond that, it does not...Other issue, does not remember volume setting, every time you turn it on, have to turn the volume up, but pushing a button, always is at low when turning it on..The sound is nice, if those two issues were different, this would be a great unit... If you can find a better one, do so... For such a big unit, those two issues really should not be...

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This product is great.  We have 3 of them, one for each bedroom.  It\'s small, relatively inexpensive, and plugs in so no batteries are required.  It has many sound options and different volumes.
