I originally bought it for my baby, but then got one for our room (so I can\'t hear the neighbors dog barking at 6am!) and for my daughters room too.  Highly recommend!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I give this product 2 stars rather than one because I really did like the selection of sounds and the option to combine them.  The unit itself was small and lightweight enough to travel with.  However, the sound quality was terrible.  I almost wonder if I got a defective product, or if they are really just that bad.  The timer/on/off switch made a static noise whenever I moved it, almost like it had a short.  The highest volume setting was surprisingly quiet. For a product that is all about making sound, the quality of the sound was pathetic.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: The sound machine seemed great at first but after using it for just a few nights, a weird buzzing noise started coming from the ac adapter itself.  Even if the unit was off, the adapter buzzed.  It kind of worried me that it might be a fire hazard.  So we returned it.  But I must say that Amazon has the BEST customer service I\'ve ever dealt with!  I was able to handle the return online, print a shipping label, receive an instant refund, and send the product back at no cost.  I\'m so glad I do a majority of my shopping through Amazon.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Ok, perhaps you can\'t hear a pin drop, but the highest volume on this machine is still pretty quiet. On second thought, that may be a good thing since the sound choices on this unit are all pretty unpleasant - very mechanical sounding at best, and the "womb" choice sounds like the background to an alien invasion movie or something. I am totally disapointed with this cheap looking, low quality item.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Pros: you have the option of On, Off or a 60 minute timerThere are a lot of sound options and you can combine 2 sounds (such as Rain with Thunder)Battery OptionHeadphone jack... for traveling?Cons: Doesnt get very loud, I had to place this on the floor by the crib as putting it on the cribside table did not seem to be drowning out ambient noises sufficientlyIt is hard to tell if the switch is set to "on" or "timer"the volume starts on the lowest setting each timeI dont want to go through the effort of returning it since it seems to be doing an alright job, but I would prefer something with a higher max volume.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Our 2nd one. The first one lasted nearly 4 years of use every night!  Would absolutely buy this one again.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I am actually really mad that I wasted money on this item. We have been running a CD player with rain sounds in our son\'s nursery for months now. We were getting worried that the CD player might just die, so we thought this white noise machine would do. I was worried about the volume when I ordered it, but other reviews made me think it would be loud enough. NOT TRUE. This thing won\'t block out ANY NOISE. The puny little speaker is just not big enough. We\'ll just buy another CD player I guess. The rain sound is also very disappointing and just sounds like crackling sounds. Extremely disappointed.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: From the moment our son arrived, we used this product.  It is on almost all day and throughout the entire night.  I have only used the "ocean sounds", even though there are so many nice options.  Ocean sounds is the most soothing for my son and I don\'t want to throw in another sound just yet, since he\'s enjoying this one so much (as am I!).  I registered for this product as a fluke and had no idea how essential it would become.  I am so happy with it.  I don\'t think that it needs to get any louder, but we live in a smaller house and I don\'t even turn it all the way up.  Overall, super product and all babies would benefit from it.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I really like this product, my only complaint is I wish it was louder. Other then that I use it on my 12 week old son, who LOVES the sound of white noise. This machine doesn\'t actually play "white noise" but he uses it on the "wind" setting. He sleeps better then ever! For 20 bucks its the best around! If you have the money though, use this White Noise Machine Sleep Mate Sound Screen Dual Speed Sound Conditioner Marpac 980-A Latest Modelits better!!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I used this with my second baby and decided to use it again with my third little girl.  We all sleep better with it on.  I actually have to buy another one for my two older kids because they love it too.  I think the sound level is fine, it\'s plenty loud enough.  We usually use the rain and thunder or ocean and I like the qualty of those sounds, although the other sound good as well.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I\'m a light sleeper so having some background noise is always helpful. If you\'re looking for the distinguished "white noise," it\'s not included on this machine. There are other "sounds" that I will probably never use until I have children, but the ocean, brook and stream sounds are good enough for now. The volume is adequate for a small machine...just don\'t drop it on a hard surface or you\'ll be ordering a new one. Overall, for the price, a good deal.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I\'ve been missing out on valuable sleep for a few months (my sound machine finally gave up the ghost), and found this one on amazon.com.Lo and behold!  I think my insomnia will be cured!  This little and easy-to-use machine works great (for me, I would have liked the volume to go a bit higher - but this IS for infants).There are enough sounds that continue to loop without interruption so you KNOW you\'ll find the perfect one for you.  There is also the option to combine sounds for a really unique blend.I\'m very happy with this purchase - and it arrived days earlier than I expected!

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I bought one of these two years ago when my fifth child turned out to be a very light sleeper.  We have used it daily ever since and it has been wonderful. We always take it with us when we travel, too. The adjustable volume is very helpful as well. It masks enough noise to help our young ones fall asleep and stay asleep. I also enjoy that you can set it to go constantly, or turn off after one hour. We had our sixth child four months ago and immediately purchased a second sound machine. Once again it works like a charm. I highly recommend this product.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I bought this for my wife who can\'t sleep without some white noise in the background. Some reviewers have mentioned that the volume is lacking. It is not super loud and will not overcome loud noises in the background; however, we\'ve found it to be more than adequate for providing a sleep environment. We particularly like the small size. This will make it possible for us to take it on trips for use in hotels. It also runs on batteries so you could take it on camping trips.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I love this sound machine. We bought it for our 6 months old daughter a year ago and she\'s been using it every day for her night sleep and day naps. We recently bought another one for her grandma\'s where she stays overnight sometimes.I like that this sleep machine has an option of unlimited play, we leave ours on all night. Also the feature of working on bataries is usefull for staying at the campsites. We used ours like that this summer leaving it on for 1 h. Bataries lasted for 3 nights that we needed.We don\'t have any problems with the maximum level of sound volume but we don\'t use it to block the sounds out completely. The sound is loud enough to muffle the street noise during the day. And after a year of use, our daughter just needs to hear something familiar on the background regardless of how loud, as lond as its there. She slept through the reno on the outside of our building for 2 months with this sound machine, I just needed to move it closer to her crib.Totally recommend this machine.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: This sound machine bummed me out at first because it was so low.  Once I started pushing super hard on the up volume it went to the desired level.  It\'s weird though because I will turn it off and on and it goes down again even without touching the volume keys.  I\'m happy with it though because as long as I set it to the desired volume at night before bed it works great.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I was using a vaporizor for 18 months to keep out noise from my daughters room. Even in the balmy summer. This is a much better compact system that has the same "running water humming sound"

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I was disappointed with the product. First it doesn\'t have white noise and its not very loud at all. If you are buying to help block out other noise for your baby to sleep I would not recommend this. If its for an older child to have some smoothing sounds to sleep with than its fine.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I bought this item because it was cheaper than the mommy bear and it plays the womb sound, plus it plays so many more sounds. You can either use batteries or plug it in. I have this sitting on my changing table and turn it on everytime I change my sons diaper and he will spit his pacifier out and just listen. It also has a timer mode that will play for an hour and cut off, which I love because that gives baby plenty of time to fall asleep. The volume adjustment is great too, it is loud enough on the lowest setting but can get much louder if baby is fussy and you really need to get his attention. Great investment for the price

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: I bought this after seeing it in use at daycare where 5-6 toddlers (1-2) sleep contentedly in a room together. It helped my newborn sleep a little better with the white noise.  I like it better than the sleep sheep which turns off after a preset amount of time. It plugs into the wall so no batteries needed.  Good quality.

name: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review: Another update - 5/7/2013. We\'ve now lost all tracks to clicking and screeching and can no longer use this machine. Will not buy from this maker again.Another update - 1/23/2013. We\'ve now lost 3 tracks to horrible screeching and/or crackling sounds so I knocked another star off. Again.I originally posted 5 stars for this sound machine but I\'ve changed my mind. We\'ve been using it for just 4 months. It was great in the beginning but a couple of weeks ago the sound we were using started to make screeching noises in the middle of the night. We switched to another sound and it stopped but we can\'t use our favorite anymore. Hopefully, just the one digital track is damaged.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I think I have owned just about every brand of bottle on the market (Avent, Ansa, Luv \'n Care, Gerber, Gerber New Traditions, First Years, Playtex Precision Flo, Playtex Premium, Playtex Nurder, Playtex VentAire, etc.).When I first found this one, I compared it to my other Playtex bottles. It was like a hard plastic version of the Playtex Nurser, only you fon\'t have the option of original or decorated.The plastic is thinner than the Playtex Original Nurser, but hard like the decorated nurser.  I didn\'t have any problems with leaking, and the mixing disc that mine came with seemed to help with mixing powdered formula.Unfortunately, I dropped this bottle when I was washing it and it broke, leaving a sharp edge that Baby could get cut on.  I saved the cap, nipple ring and nipple the bottle came with.When Baby begins crawling or walking, this is not the bottle to use.  One drop on the bottom of the bottle, and you might as well throw it away.  However, for a newborn or small baby, these are great.I also like how all of the parts: liners, nipple rings, nipples, caps are interchangeable and can be used on the Playtex Original or Decorated Nursers.  The nipples are a little different between the two, but they still work great, with no leaks.Another reviewer mentioned that Playtex liners are expensive, and I would have to agree, they are.  I usually get the off brand, unless the Playtex ones are on sale.  I can easily save some money that way and still don\'t have to deal with leaks.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: These are the best nipples yet and satisfied my strictly breastmilk daughter for one year while I worked.  I tried avent and was very dissatisfied at how stiff the silicone is and the shape was not nearly as close to breast as playtex.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: After doing our pre-baby research, we registered for and received this set. We started using it with no problems, and then my daughter started having problems with gas. Naturally, we blamed it on the bottles. Many bottles and wasted dollars later, we returned to the Premium Nursers and have never looked back. In fact, the more I watch other moms with other bottles, the happier I am.Sure, you spend a few extra bucks on liners. But the time and energy and dishwasher costs you save are well worth it. We have 4 bottle shells that we use and about 10 nipples. The shells rarely get dirty and so rarely have to be washed. Likewise for the rings and caps. We usually run a load of nipples with the dishwasher every day and that\'s it. Empty liners pop out with no mess and are recyclable to boot.When we go out, I pack 1 pre-assembled bottle, and an extra liner and nipple/ring/cap setup. It weighs nothing and takes up way less space than multiple bottles. On the fly I can just pop out the dirty liner, throw it away, pop in the new one and screw on the new top.As an added bonus - I think my husband may actually have invented this ingenius use for the Premium Nurser. Note: this can only be done with the Playtex brand liners, not generics. When my daughter was struggling with swallowing too much air, my husband figured out that we could fill the liner with the desired amount of milk, screw on the nipple, and then squeeze all of the air out of the liner, collapsing it down until it was vacuum-tight with only milk in it. Keeping a finger over the nipple hole, pop on the airtight cap. Voila - a completely air-free meal for baby. This really helped cut back on her air swallowing. Generic liners work fine for all other purposes.Last but not least, we like so many other parents, felt that many brands were drowning our daughter in milk. The Playtex slow- flow nipples worked great for her. She is still using them at 4 months.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: My husband and I have tried many different bottle types and brands and have decided that these are the best. My 6 week old daughter adjusted well to them. The original brown nipples wear out very quickly but, the silicone ones are much nicer and will last longer. These bottles are very easy to use and clean. My husband prefers the soft bottle liners over the preformed dropins. The soft ones haven\'t leaked on us once but the formed ones have slipped out from under the ring a couple of times spilling formula everywhere. The formed ones also make it harder to screw the lid on tight enough causing leaks. The soft liners might take a little bit longer to put on the bottle and deal with, but in the long run it takes less time because you don\'t have to go change your clothes every time the preformed ones leak. They are worth every penny I spent on them. Even though they may cost more than standard bottles because of having to buy the liners, they help prevent gas and colic. THey are absolutely wonderful!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I used both the Avent bottles and these Playtex.  Based on my experience the Playtex bottles are the best.  Of all the nipples on the market these ones are most like the breast so it\'s easier to do both.  I didn\'t use these with my first child and she spit up after every single feeding, with this baby she hardly ever spits up. I believe it\'s because of the bottle, it seems to go down easier and because there is not air she\'s not spitting up.  The avent bottles leak when you don\'t put them together right, you have to be careful not to overtighten.  Also with the avent bottles, even the slowest nipple seems to come out too fast, she always seems like she\'s gulping it down.  My only suggestion with these bottles, which again comes from experience, is to spend the extra money and buy the drop in liners.  The bag liners always seemed to leak no matter how I assembled them and also it was harder to measure the formula into the liners.  Because I was so afraid of them leaking I would pull the liner down further and therefore wouldn\'t get the full amount the bottle would take.  I have had no problems with the drop in liners leaking or breaking, no matter how much abuse I put them through!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I was given a set of these for my daughter\'s baby shower. I liked them fine, as they did not pose any problems with gas for her and she took well to the nipple shape. I discovered it was easier to use these particular bottles when we were going out and needed to have several pumped bottles for a baby sitter. These were also great for pumping directly into a liner and keeping it as a stand alone supply in the refrigerator. I would reccomend checking into the ventaire bottles by Playtex as I discovered seemed more natural for my daughter.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: These are nice bottles and I love the fact that you put in a fresh liner.  I actually used my liners more than once before I was done with them and they lasted perfectly!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: The one thing that I would say this bottle has an advantage over the Avent bottles is warming breastmilk - (because you are not supposed to microwave breastmilk because it loses a lot of nutrients).  All you have to do is pour the milk in the bottle and cap it and stick it in a cup of hot tap water.  The milk warm in minutes!  My son does great with this bottle when I\'m away and can\'t nurse him (although to him there is nothing like the real thing).

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: At first I bought the Avent bottles after resding all of the reviews of how the bottle was grest for brestfeeding moms.  Well the nipple is way to long and hard that it choked my baby.  My brest is not shaped like that.  After trying every type of bottle, the only one he would take was this one.  He latched on perfectly.  Plus the bonus of buying this starter set, is the atttchment it comes with that will attatch to your breast pump and you can pump and then freeze directly into the liners.  I recommended this bottle to everyone of my friends that were switching from breast to bottle or were supplementing and everyone of them said that their babies took this bottle immeadiately.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: The Premium design helps to prevent leaking when the bottle is shaken before serving.  This system also allows you to store the bottles in the refriderator with the nipple which makes it quick and easy to prepare your bottles. They come out of the refridgerator and into our bottle warmer.  (The one on this site that is 9.99)

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: My daughter has no trouble switching between these bottles and the breast.  I tried the Avent ones with her and the milk came out too fast.  These are perfect, easy to clean, and reasonably priced.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: When my sister had her son ( over 35 years ago) she used the playtex nurser system. In 1983 when I had my son I used the playtex nurser system and in October of 2003 (yes 20 years later) when I had my daughter I again am using the playtex system. There was nothing better then and is nothing better now. They are easy to clean, easy for baby to hold, convenient and most of all we have never had a problem with gassey babys. When it comes to your baby don\'t go for fad bottles these are by far the best and have stood the test of time.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: These bottles are better than all of the rest that I have tried for my newborn. Due to the fact that one can literally squeeze out all of the air, my newborn has hardly ever spit up and barely needs to burp. Although buying the drop-ins all the time gets annoying, these bottles are still a great deal!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I love this system because it\'s so easy. Rather that washing the bottle you can just change the liner and wash the nipple. I use store brand non-drop-ins because theyre cheaper and the regular "bag" liner colapses easier.I agree with other reveiwers, the slow flow nipples that come with the bottle are worthless. My 1 month old gets frusterated that nothing is coming out. We tried the tri-cut and again he got frusterated so i ripped the cut a little bigger and that works so I went and got the fast flow.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I have been pumping and storing my breast milk for my daughter for several months.  When it was time for her to take the bottle, she took it was ease.  It is also very convenient to store, freeze and feed her with the bottles and liners.It is the only bottles I use!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: i love these bottles, my son never had gas  with playtex. i think they are the best and i tried avent, dr brown and munckins bottles, they are not as good.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I decided when my son was born that I wanted to nurse my baby but after a few weeks it was so time consuming I bought a pump to give myself a break once in awhile.  I bought the playtex starter kit with the 4 different nipples and my son just loved the newborn nursers so I have been to the store twice to buy more.  They seem to really go along with breast feeding and reduce the gas. I would recommend these bottles to everyone!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I do not have the set but I have the two smaller bottels and 2 bigger bottels. I love them no need to wash just pop in a new liner. I have not had a problem with leaks and my daughter takes in less air. Once a week I put them in the dish washer and they are clean and ready for another week.  hope this helps

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I love these bottles(so does my daughter!)I breast fed her for the first month and relized that it was to difficult to breast feed when I was going out all the time, so now I had to buy a bottle,so I bought the playtex nursers(the regular ones) and realized she hated the nipple and she was getting mad cause she couldnt get anything!!!(If you ask me they are nothing like the breast like they say they are!!!) so now I had a big problem, I bought 11 bottles and she didnt like them!!! So I noticed the Premium Nurser and I bought only 1(cause I already made the mistake of buying to many before trying them!!!)Well needless to say she LOVED them!!! So all I did now was buy the Premium Nipples SLOW FLOW and they worked on all the regular nursers!!! The other thing that I noticed too was that its not at all messy on the baby and really easy to clean!!!! Any one whos not sure how long they are going to breast feed or need to pump their milk into a bottle(special breast pump attachment included) this is the system for you!!!!!!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: Easy to use, clean, store, warm quickly, and travel with.  The nipples come in slow or fast and are so much like the breast my daughter went back and forth without a problem.  the darker nipples are a little more pliable and my daughter much preferred them over the clear ones.  works with generic pre-formed bottle liners from target, wal-greeens, and wal-mart.  good investment

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: All I can say is if this bottle doesn\'t work for you, than maybe what you are feeding the baby isn\'t the best for them, or maybe no matter what system you use, the baby has tummy problems.  I have used this system among other samples of other types of bottles thru all 3 of my children. THEY ARE THE BEST, especially for those moms who will be breastfeeding and bottle feeding. I have never, ever had a problem and have used both breast milk and formula in these bottles. I am due for my fourth in August and have no other plans but to use Playtex. Love that I can push the air out and the clean-up is wonderful. I also love that mom can express milk right into the bag to be used for the baby, wonderful system, highly recommended. And they are also not as expensive as some of those other &amp;quot;fancy&amp;quot; systems, which is an added plus!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: these bottles are great for a few reasons;natural latch nipples-perfect for going back and forth with breastfeedingdisposable/recyclable/very sanitary inserts for milk/formulaso easy to use and cleanwe have avent, dr. browns, gerber, playtex vent air, etc. but these bottles are the best and all we ever need!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I bought these bottles for my newborn. They worked out perfect at first. As he became bigger and needed larger amounts of formula at a time these bottles became a problem. They are advertised to hold 8oz. however that is only if you use liquid and still then you must fill them to the rim. This bottle does not hold 8oz. of the powder formula unless you pre-mix them which does not work for everyone. I have since bought Avent bottles and LOVE them.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I am a baby nurse and work with lots of preemies, multiples, and babies with reflux and gas/colic issues.  In my years of experience, Playtex Premium is by far a superior bottle!  They are comfortable to hold (more comfy than Playtex original) and easy to clean, especially when you have multiples! And speaking of multiples, you can feed 2 babies at once with these bottles because you can use your fingers to hold them from the bottom.  Also, you can assign one color to each baby, thus making it easier to remember whose bottle is whose!  The drop-in liners are easy to use. I have a lot of moms who breastfeed AND bottle feed, and my babies have no problem with nipple confusion with the NaturaLatch nipples.  My reflux babies have so much less spitting up and tummy troubles with these bottles that I INISIST on using them at every job!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: FYI: the best thing about this system is that it offers liners that do NOT contain bisphenol-A, a chemical that may leach from polycarbonate plastic into breast milk or baby formula when a bottle containing those fluids is overheated. Liners and glass bottles are currently the only two options for avoiding bisphenol-A.Initially I selected this system for the convenience, then after I read up on bisphenol-A, I was very relieved that I\'d inadvertently made the right choice, and thought I\'d share that with others. Best wishes!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I\'m the mother of a 3 1/2 month old baby girl. I had intended to only breastfeed for the first year, but it turned out that my daughter had a very difficult time at first with latching on. So much so that she ended up taking in very little milk and her weight dropped nearly a whole pound from her birth weight in the first week. The pediatrician told us we would have to supplement with formula to bring her weight up. I chose the Premium Nurser bottles because they said they were good for switching between breast and bottle feeding. My daughter took well to the bottles, and even started latching on better when I did breast feed. I\'m continuing to use formula along with breastfeeding with no nipple confusion problems whatsoever. When people ask me if I breastfeed or bottlefeed my baby, I say "both", and they tell me how lucky I am! These bottles are a life-saver! They\'re easy to clean (I use the top rack of the dishwasher), and my baby hasn\'t had any problems with colic. I like the convenience of the disposable bags, too. And my daughter is now starting to "help" hold on to the bottle while I feed her. These are the best!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I know some breastfed babies never take to a bottle but I feel this one greatly increases your chances! It was recommended to me by a lactation consultant and now I have become quite the spokesperson them. The nipple is softer like mom and with the design and the slow flow nipple they work like mommy too giving baby consistancy and mom and break. And sometimes they aren\'t rejecting the brand of bottle/nipple they are rejecting the container- they want the original container- as my husband said "she doesn\'t want take out- she wants some home cookin\'". I know my daughter started off with these bottles and was doing fabulous- then poof she went thru a spell where she wanted mommy to feed her and no one else- which even though I\'m working part time -- it was still stressful to think she was hungry and not eating while I was away from her- we kept trying and just as I was about to loose hope- she starting taking the bottle like a champ again- her caregivers all found ways for her to take the bottle from them- it was just different positioning! ie: My husband uses the boppy pillow on his lap and she half sits lays in it facing him- I think she associated the other position with me. hope this helps

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I originally got the Avents, and they were awful...leaked, nipples were terrible, etc.  I got the Playtex Nursers and my daughter loves them.  She prefers the latex nipples, though.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I originally bought the four ounce versions, and quikly found out that pushing the liner up was difficult after a burbing. When my baby started taking more than 4 oz, I switched to the Easy Feeder bottles, also from Playtex. These have a a slider that pushes the air out and is pretty easy to use. I tried all the nipples, but found the silicon ones the best for my baby. You can also buy store brand liners at a much reduced priced. I have found these to be just as good as the Playtex ones. In short I love the disposable ystemut would recommend the Easy Feeder bottles. As for traveling with your bottles, use a cooler a bag and an ice pack.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I am a first-time mother of a 2 month old baby girl who I have breastfed since birth, but her dad wanted to help with feedings, so I began pumping.  After trying several different bottle brands and nipples, including Gerber and Avent, our aunt sent us this gift set.  It\'s perfect!  The baby has had no difficulty with this nipple and the attachment for the breastpump allows me to pump directly into the liners.  Her dad has inisisted that this be the only bottle she uses while breastfeeding, so I went out and bought 4 more 4 oz. bottles for her.  Now, the whole family is happy with the system!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: Heres why I believe this product is better than the rest.*It takes much less time to prepare formula. (I keep hot water ready in a \'thermos\'.) No need to run under a hot tap etc;*The liners are durable enough that you can reuse after a good wash.*Excellent to travel with. Simply take extra liners and a few nipples.*My baby is two months old and uses both medium flow and fast flow nipples( I add a teaspoon of cereal at night)without any problems.Overall a great product and I\'ll be a customer for a while to come.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I purchased the Playtex Nurser bottles based on recommendation that it helps decrease the amount of air babies swallow. I was able to stay home with my second child and would have more time to be able to mess with the bags etc. To my surprise these bottles are easier to use then standard bottles! I love the pre-formed drop-ins and because of the bags they warm up in half the time. In fact I tried them in a bottle warmer & it became way to hot in only 1 minute. Instead I simply warm them in a cup of hot water for a few minutes. My daughter hardly ever suffers from gas and it is so convenient being able to toss the bags in the trash. No more bottle crud! These bottles are convenient & great for babies tummy! I highly recommend them.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I made the same mistake most new moms make and that is to go out and buy every new (expensive) bottle on the market and pray they work well. Well, unfortunately that never works for me. These are hands down the best. Not alot of effort and not alot of money, what else could you ask for ;)?

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: Pros:1. My son took to these bottles immediately, no nipple confusion between breasfeeding and bottle feeding.2. Easy and convenient way to feed since there is little clean up needed.3. Absolutely no bubbles in the formula when feeding and therefore no gas issues.Cons:1. There is the constant expense of purchasing liners, however you can find affordable comparable liners at your supercenter stores.2. You can\'t trust the measurement on the liner so you need to measure your formula in another utensil.  (Kind of negates the fact that there is less clean up with this bottle).3. The 4oz and 8oz liners actually hold a little more than 3oz and 6oz respectively.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: My son was only a week or two early and the only noticable difference was a weak suck. For the first few weeks I had to pump and then give Max a bottle until he could learn how it all worked. I bought these bottles as a cheaper alternative to the Avent bottles recomended by my lactation consultant. Trying to push and keep the air out is rediculous. You spend too much time doing this and your child will be hysterical. He still is unable to completely drain the bottle and his suck is back on track according to the pediatrician. If you are feeding your child breast milk... aka liquid gold... you don\'t want to waste one drop. My son did not like the nipples at all... they are suppose to be designed to be the most like breast... I\'ve checked with friends and we know no one with nipples like these. We finally bought Avent bottles and he loves them and had no confussion from breast to bottle and back again. It\'s worth the extra buck or two for the better bottles.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: I loved these bottles when my daughter was a newborn, they\'re super convenient and easy to keep clean. The nipples are a perfect shape to help your baby maintain the correct latch when switching between bottle and breast. The problem came about as my daughter got older: the 8 oz liners don\'t hold 8 oz of water and the appropriate amount of powdered formula. If you don\'t use ready-to-feed formula or a liquid concentrate, or if you don\'t want to make all of your formula in a separate container and transfer it in when it\'s feeding time, these may not be the bottles for you. When I contacted customer service about it I was told that I should "mix in a seperate container and then add the leftovers in after my baby clears some space." This from a woman who\'s obviously never tried to take a bottle from a hungry baby.

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: After using the Avent system for 6 weeks My son was not a happy baby due to cramps, gas and huge burps. After switching to the Playtex system I noticed a huge difference in his actions. His cramps and gas had stopped. He ended up being a very happy baby that cried a lot less. His burping was not excessive and never burped a period of time after feeding like he did with the Avent bottles. He turned out to be a happy baby.. Happey baby = a happy mommy... A++++ on this system

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: My son, 7 months, has got the be the pickiest there is!!! He will NOT drink from ANY OTHER BOTTLE! He doesn\'t even like the brown nipples. THey HAVE to be the clear ones!! I love these bottles, I even used them when I was a baby. Shows you just how great they are! They are great on reducing gas. My baby, hasn\'t has much at all and I breastfeed!!!It\'s not the pushing the air out that\'s important, it\'s the fact that the liner collapes with the suction that is important.I highly reccommend these to all first time parents to try!

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: Well I am in the process of registering for bottles and these are the ones my mom had said to get-she actually used the originals with my sister (18 years ago!)  I was just wondering about pumping...Do you have to pump into something else and then poor into the liners?  And if for some reason we have to switch to formula do these do well with mixing formula?  Just wondering-everyone else I know uses the Avent-but they seem to leak a lot-let me know!thanks

name: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set
review: CUANDO MI BEBE NACIO LAS PRIMERAS BOTELLAS QUE COMPRE FUERON VENT AIR..... LAS CUALES LE DIERON COLICOS 24 HR AL DIA 7 DIAS A LA SEMANA..SIENDO MADRE PRIMERIZA POR POCO Y ME VUELVO LOCA....PERO GRACIAS A DIOS UNA AMIGA ME HABLO DE LAS PLATEX Y FUERON UNA BENDICION.... APESAR QUE LLEGAN A SER UN POCO COSTOSOS (LINERS)AL TIEMPO, NO LAS CAMBIO POR NADA.... TIP: LOS LINERS PUEDES COMPRARLOS MARCA PARENT CHOICE ..ES LO MISMO PERO MENOS COSTOSOS.

name: Tiny Love On The Go Musical Mobile
review: My son loves this mobile.  He likes to pull on the bugs and they are secure enough not to come off and they have crinkle sounds when he touches them.  It helps keep him occupied in the car and it keeps him and myself happy since he no longer crys while in his car seat.

name: Knit Crib Sheet - Sage
review: I am so surprised to read so many negative comments about these sheets. I absolutely love them, and just went out and replaced all of our old crib sheets with the Koala Knit Crib sheets. The colors are beautiful and the fabric is so soft, not the crunchy crinkly fabric you find with most crib sheets. They fit a standard crib mattress beautifully waterproof mattress pad and all, which I have had problems with other crib sheets doing so. I have had absolutely no problems with shrinking at all, and have had my sheets for 6+ months. I wash on cold, and regular tumble dry. My daughter also seems to appreciate these sheets as they are just sooo soft! Buy them, you won\'t be disappointed.

name: Knit Crib Sheet - Sage
review: I received these sheets as a shower gift and was a little hesitant to use them after reading a poor review.  I have them in sage and in yellow.  I have to say these are my favorite sheets.  As a first time mom, I had no idea how many sheets we would go through (sometimes multiple sheets in one night).  We have other brands as well (Gerber, Carters)and they just don\'t fit as well as the Koala Baby sheets.  I think Koala Baby sheets seem to stretch better and fit the mattress well, even with the waterproof mattress pad underneath.  I love the fabric too - nice soft cotton - even after multiple washings (and dryings)I liked them so much, I went and bought the cradle sheet size for our co-sleeper.  Those are a little big, but they work ok.

name: Knit Crib Sheet - Sage
review: I am very disappointed with this product.  After a couple of times in the wash, it shrunk terribly.  It was so hard to get on and while trying, both sets of sheets ripped!

name: Knit Crib Sheet - Sage
review: I have this sheet in sage, and I think it\'s a great sheet. I\'ve had absolutely no problems with shrinkage and have washed it multiple times in warm water. I like this sheet a lot. It\'s very soft, and it\'s not as cold to the touch as regular sheets are, which is nice for baby.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: I\'ve read a lot negative reviews about this item.  First and most common, "my 6 month old out grew this" well duh!  It and along with 95% of ALL infant carriers is only intended for infants up to 27 inches, normally around 6 months of age.  Don\'t be a dumb parent and keep shoving your baby into a carrier if they\'re over 27 inches, guess what you get into an auto accident and the insurance won\'t cover any injury to your baby or cover the cost for a new seat.  They have height restrictions for a reason so follow them!!!!! It does have a lot of extra padding that most car seats don\'t have so it is snug on the shoulder area BUT it\'s SO much safer than GRACO car seats since it does have extra padding and a 5 point safety harness. We got into a car accident with this car seat and I credit the 5 point harness for no injury.  Those crappy GRACO over the head straps would have resulted in my child being thrown from the carrier into the back of the seat.  Another common complaint is that it doesn\'t fit into carts. I\'ve yet to come across a cart that it doesn\'t fit into!  You slide the metal cart back into the deep slot in the car seat pull the car seat forward until the slot that locks is over the metal bar above the cart handle.  It\'s easy to get in and out of the car and also into the Peg stroller.  A word on the stroller, it\'s heavy for a reason!  It\'s built so much better that\'s why, we have an SUV and I just keep it together in the back instead of folding it up.  This is such a great car seat, it\'s pricey for only getting 6 months use of it, I\'m pregnant with baby #2 now so this has a lot of use ahead.  It can be tricky to remove the cover but if you read the directions it\'s not hard.  Overall a MUCH BETTER SEAT THAN ANY OTHER INFANT CARRIER!

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: I bought the Atlantico travel system while still pregnant on a great sale, and it came with the Primo Viaggio car seat(not the latch version though!). I love the stroller, but cannot say the same about the car seat. It is heavier than some other cheaper and just as safe brands on the market, and the plastic attachment that secure both straps together is not very practical - you have to pull both straps together to fasten it, which bothers my baby very much. I had my baby in the fall, so I cannot say a word about tha fabric being too warm. Even knowing he is only 6 weeks old, I can already say he will outgrow this car seat pretty fast. Another downside: we will be flying internationally in 2 months and I just found out I cannot attach the car seat to the airplane seat without the  base. It will be a hassle to carry the stroller+car seat+base on our trip!!! The Graco one can be attached safelly without the bulky base.On the good side, my son seems to enjoy his car seat for now, and the fabric is beautiful.If I had known then what I know now, I would have bought the Graco car seat and the universal car seat attachment to attach it to the Atlantico stroller.Just one remark about the Atlantico stroller: I read in one of the reviews a complain about the stroller\'s plastic attachment - first of all it is not suppose to stay attached to the stroller with your child in it - it\'s only purpose is to keep the 5 point harness still while you fasten your child to it, then you are suppose to pull it out. It\'s on the instructions though.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: We recieved the Pliko travel system, including the Primo Viaggio, as a gift. We were very surprised to find that our son hated his car seat from the beginning. The head rest was flimsy and the seat was very confining.We also felt that the seat itself sat more upright making it hard to sleep in it.  The quality was excellent. We love the Pliko stroller that goes along with it.  The bottom line is that he didn\'t like it and we were not happy in a travel situation.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: For starters the instructions are vague. It is very difficult to remove and install outer cover to wash. Difficult to get in and out of the car. Doesn\'t fit in our stroller or shopping carts. Is uncomfortable for the child. The straps constantly get twisted. My daughter is now about 16 lbs. that combined with the need to wear cold weather clothes will not fit.  I would have returned it except it was given to us as a gift from a close friend.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: but the hood for shade doesn\'t stay down to block out the sun.  the seat is very well padded therefore, gives bigger babies less room to move...my son is not real happy about that.  once i was able to remove the head support i was surprised how much more room he has.  i would highly recommend this car seat as it it has very high safety ratings and to me that is the most important.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: I bought this infant seat because it matched the travel system for my Pliko stroller (which, by the way, I love).  The seat itself is fine but we encountered a few frustrations with it after a while.  First, the seat is unusually heavy to carry (and since we used our Britax Roundabout as our primary carseat - we were really only using the Primo Viaggio as a carrier); second, the seat is a bit frustrating to get in and out of the base and the stroller; third, our daughter grew out of it after 4 months; and, fourth, the handle is very cumbersome and has no grip - this seat is not nearly as easy to carry as the Graco SnugRide.  I really like the look of this seat and I wouldn\'t trade my Pliko stroller for the world, but Peg Perego has some room for improvement on this one!

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: Cozy fit, reliable.  Baby sweat in the seat often, though.  I\'d still buy it again.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: My son is almost 7 weeks old. He weighed 8lbs 14ozs at birth. I had a C-section and of course couldn\'t carry him in it. But my husband did. He is a big strong guy and he even commented how heavy it was with our son in it. I haven\'t been out to the stores yet by myself with my son but I know that I will have a difficult time getting him in and out of the car with this carrier. It\'s ashame because I love the look of it. We also have the Peg Perego Vennzia stroller and we LOVE that. It closes easily and it\'s light weight. And I love the way it rides.Just check out the weight of this before you purchase it. If you find it heavy before the baby is in it. Just imagine what it will be like with your baby in it.By the way my son sleeps in the carrier attached to the stroller every night. It\'s the only way he\'ll sleep for long periods if time.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: I bought this carseat because of the high safety rating, but I was severely disappointed with it.  To begin with, my baby was born in the summer and she would get so hot in this seat if she was in it for very long.  Now that it is winter, she gets overheated when she just has a sweater on, so I don\'t even want to know what it would be like if she had on a big thick snowsuit.  Second, she has never been very comfortable in it.  More times than not, my otherwise laidback content child will wake up crying if she has fallen asleep in the seat.  There is not alot of room, it is very narrow, so when she is in it, her little arms get stuck almost underneath her.  It is definitely too narrow compared to others I have seen.  Her little feet have started to hang over the front and she is under 27 inches, but for safety reasons we have to buy her a bigger seat.  Lastly, we traveled with this carseat and were disheartened to know we had to bring the base to use the carseat on the airplane.  Even then, my husband had to force the seat into the base because the buckle was in the way of the latch.  Don\'t let the ratings fool you - this carseat is not worth the money.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: I purchased the Peg Perego car seat after being encouraged to do so by my mother. She is a big fan of Peg Perego products and used them for me when I was younger.The seat is a little heavier than other models but we love it. My husband prefers the design of this base system when we compared it to the Graco models. I am very happy and highly recommend this car seat.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: No question this is a great car seat for us.  With a child that has always hated the process of getting strapped in it is a lifesaver not having to complete the task with each stop.  I truely don\'t find it heavy even with my little one reaching 15 lbs.  I welcome the workout.  We have the venezia stroller as well and are certainly getting our monies worth.  I absolutely love the system and dread the day we can no longer use it.  Even if it is only for 6 months at least it was a pleasant 6 months.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: My worst decision was not buying a new car seat.  The second worst decision was buying this one to begin with.  Trying to buy only the best for my son, and knowing that Peg Perego products are highly rated, we opted for this seat.We could never get him comfortable in it. He cried and screamed every time he was in it.  It was painful to take him anywhere.  The straps were impossible to adjust.  He was always hot and he outgrew it before he was 4 months old (and way before the 20 lb, 26 inch limit).  Once we got him into his Britax Roundabout convertible, I was able to go out of the house again.  He actually laughed during the first trip.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: This carrier is wonderful!!!  We bought this car seat because we wanted something to carry our daughter around in.  It has been terrific.  It\'s easy to put in the car and the LATCH system makes it so easy to remove the base as well as install it.The seat itself is so easy to install and remove from the car.

name: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review: I chose Peg Perego because I wanted the best for my first baby. Plus it was the only brand that had descent colors. I didn\'t want navy plaid. What a waste of money. The seat is very heavy and the base is very difficult to install. If tightening the baby in while the seats already in the car the plastic around the release button pops off every time. I bought the Atlantico, Peg Perego stroller to go with the carseat, also very disappointing. The way the straps are designed with a piece of plastic that hooks them to the back of the stroller seat is a total design flaw. Now that my baby is 3 months old and can sit up the plastic stabs her in the back of the head. All Peg Perego strollers have the same strap design. I would get rid of the stroller and buy some other kind if I didn\'t pain nearly $$$ for it!!!

name: Peg Perego Prima Pappa Multi-Position Leatherette High Chair - Tan
review: Three words for you if you\'re considering this high chair...SPEND THE MONEY!!!  It\'s only a little more than the others, but wow, what a difference in QUALITY!  And SO COOL looking!  I love that it looks like a piece of furniture in our house, not another silly looking baby toy with bears on it...not that there\'s anything wrong with bears... but this high chair is the bomb!  Comfortable for little baby "bumpers" to park on, easy as pie to use, easy breezy clean-up, and rolls effortlessly from room to room with us, adjusting to whatever heights you need, whether you\'re on the couch or at the kitchen table...wouldn\'t recommend any other!  I noticed some other reviewer commented on it being "wide" or something at the bottom, but I truly don\'t know what that\'s about...it\'s the most compact one I\'ve seen on the market!  Apparently that person hasn\'t seen the other high chairs in stores... You\'ll love this one, trust me!  No other chair compares to the Prima Pappa!

name: Peg Perego Prima Pappa Multi-Position Leatherette High Chair - Tan
review: I was cheap at first and bought an inexpensive highchair thinking that would be the more reasonable thing to do considering it\'s just for eating...after I got it home, putting it together was just the beginning, it was a nightmare to say the least to operate. Thats when I decided to go the most expensive route and buy this, everyone made it sound so great, i\'m glad i listened (had to order it elsewhere, cause they didn\'t have the color I wanted) but it\'s an absolute dream! It comes already assembled, which was a blessing and worth the money right off the bat for a 9 month pregnant lady with a husband that has NO patience for putting things together. The chair is so simple to use and looks great too, it\'s easy to set up, take down, wipe clean, etc... I think the $200 was well spent. Just remember,,,you get what you pay for, and it\'s totally true with highchairs. My nightmare brand was "evenflo" and seems that a lot of other women felt the same way, peg perego really proved their selves with this chair!!

name: Peg Perego Prima Pappa Multi-Position Leatherette High Chair - Tan
review: My husband and I love this Highchair!  When we registered for this highchair I love the fact that it is so well made, looked comfortable and is compact.  Our darling Victoria at 9 months loves her hight chair too!  Besides eating in her chair she loves to sit in her high chair to look out the window to see what\'s going on.  Sure when it get\'s dirty from food and it gets into all the tiny crevices.  However, the straps come off easy to properly clean them in the sink.  The leatherette seat cover comes off and is easy to clean as well.  We received it from my co-workers as a gift!James and Mary

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: The reading is perfect, I compared it to a traditional thermometer. The only bad thing about it is that it gives the reading in fehrenheit only.

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: this thermometer beeps when it is done taking the temperature and works fine under the arm or orally. but, for some reason, when done rectally, it has never beeped to let me know the temp taking is complete - it just shuts itself off after 10-15 seconds. very frustrating as i\'m trying to get newborn\'s temp to know if i need to take her in or not and i\'m never assured that i\'m getting an accurate reading. for oral or underarm it is fine.

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: The 10 seconds that it runs for doesn\'t give accurate results.  I have had to run it several times to get the correct reading back.

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: I really want to like this product. I want to be able to use it. They take the baby\'s temperature under the armpit at the hospital, which is why I bought this one- there are hardly any of them out there. My baby is 5 weeks old and caught my husband\'s cold. She\'s coughing, sneezing, and sounds really congested. When I called the doctor, she told me to keep taking her temperature. As long as she can breathe and doesn\'t have a fever, then she told me not to worry. So I pulled out my thermometer and have tried it all day long. I get the exact same reading every single time. Even when I try it on me or my husband. I find it scientifically impossible that all 3 of us are the exact same temp down to the tenth of a degree. It keeps saying 97.5. Annoying.

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: I tried using this thermometer under the arm of my 3 month old son, then orally on myself and him, and finally rectally on my son, and it was not at all accurate with any of these methods.  I called the number on the back of the package, and the company sent me a new one which I promptly took back to the store with my original receipt.  I then bought the Braun Thermoscan ear thermometer which I like for myself but find unreliable for my young son.  It doesn\'t hurt to try and save time, but for my household, I\'ve found that a simple, B-D digital thermometer with disposable covers used rectally is the most accurate method (and therefore easiest in my opinion) for infants.  Maybe they\'ve had some bad batches of thermometers in this production line (noticed some good reviews amongst the bad), because I generally like products manufactured by Safety 1st.

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: Makes it very easy to take temperatures rectally which is the most accurate way! Love how it folds and is always accurate.

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: I normally do not write reivews but this one is worth it.  This is the best thermometer hands down.  Our local Toys R Us no longer carries them so I was thankful to find them on amazon.  It is so quick, you don\'t have to fight your little ones to check their temp.  I have 4 kids, ages four and under tand this is only thermometer I use and trust when they feel warm.  Worth the money!!

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: I\'m so grateful for several features on this thermometer: the small line on the tip that shows you how far to insert it, the flexible end, the light up display and the FAST reading. Taking a rectal temp on a squirmy baby is no walk in the park, and even 4 seconds can feel like a lifetime! The fold up feature is actually quite handy - it\'s not much more "compact" than the unfolded thermometer, but when your baby gets his hands on the thing you\'ve been sticking up his butt, you\'ll be sure glad the "business" end is tucked away (even if you do sanitize it every time - moms, you know what I mean)!As for accuracy, I have no complaints. Every parent has to learn what he/she is comfortable with regarding their child\'s health. I\'ve never had a time when the thermometer has seemed off enough to bother me.

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: I use it on my goat herd and my dog pack.  Quick and reliable. It really does take less than 8 seconds to get up to 102 degrees (proper for dogs).

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: I misplaced this one on a family vacation.  Tried other and they are no as good.  This is the best one there is.  Perfect for wiggly kiddos.  Love the 8 second feature.

name: Safety 1st Hospital\'s Choice 8 Second Digital Thermometer
review: Love love love love love this thermometer.  It is super fast, and our daughter hardly notices it.  Takes about 6 seconds rectal (which is so much better than anything else!).  Very accurate.  Easy to handle, and case swivels shut so that it is easy to store.  Love it!

name: Volo Stroller Accessory Pack - Pebble \'03 with Hood
review: We\'ve traveled for the last 8 months with the Volo stroller & accessory pack. (our son is now 15 mo.). For Ease of use, lightweight & durability this is as good as it gets. Yes, it\'s pricey but well worth it. The stroller (with pad) has been checked on many planes & is still undamaged. The accessory bag with hood & rainhood fit neatly ito a suitcase on top of clothes. We also have a heavyduty stroller which we use at home, but I like the Volo & accessories better - so much smoother to use so lightweight (stroller drives & folds up like a charm too)

name: First Years Premium Double Pump
review: I don\'t really have anything to go by, but I think this pump is great. Once you get the hang of it, it doesn\'t hurt, it does a thorough job and it was a decent price. The only problem I have with it is that the arms sometimes move while I am pumping and I lose suction because the cup gets moved. The manufacturer should of had a locking mechanism for them. Otherwise it\'s a lot faster than doing it by hand!! That\'s for sure!I would buy this product again if I had to!

name: First Years Premium Double Pump
review: This pump worked fine for 2 mo., then suddenly quick working from the wall plug.  It still took the 4 D batteries (and drained them quickly) as a power supply for a while longer then died all together.  I think the problem was condensation in the hose (as another reviewer complained), but the real flaw is in the design that would make it so easy to ruin the motor.  BabiesRUs was wonderful to take mine back and I bought the medela equivalent. I have been absolutely sold on the medela line and would urge everyone to shell out the extra bucks for a quality pump that will last.

name: First Years Premium Double Pump
review: I have used my pump five days a week for 2 months now.  I love it and it has enabled me to continue breastfeeding after returning to work.  I get 7-10ozs in ten minutes.  It is easy to clean and the bag makes it easy to carry to work and back. I do not have any problems with the bottles leaking; I store them upright in the fridge at work. I could not be happier and I am very glad that I made the purchase.

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: I bought this pump to save money and the lactation consultant at the hospital told me to return it.  Stubbornly I kept it.  It would only pump a few drops of milk and was very painful.  They should take these off the market- it\'s that bad, pay the extra and get a medela.  Especially if you pump at least once a day, even a medela hand pump is more effective and comfortable.  With my medela pump I can get 4-8 ounces in a few minute comfortably, also you can attach Dr Brown bottles to their pump.  First years pump will make you cry, especially bad if you are just learning how to breastfeed etc.

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: I purchased this pump after doing alot of research...I rented a Medela pump with my first child who is now 4 yrs old, but I decided to purchase one for my second child who is only 2 weeks old...Comparing it to the Medela pump, there is really not a difference..Yes the pump is a little loud but for the difference in money it\'s not that loud...you can adjust the suction setting just as you can on the Medela pump.  I am very pleased with this pump and would highly recommend it....

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: Save yourselfe the hassle i bought this and after three months of only pumping once a day the thing broke so I went and bought an ameeda purly yours and I love it! it is quiet and small this thing was massive! anyway spend the extra 100.00 and buy a good pump!

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: I GOT A MEDELA SINGLE PUMP FOR MY SHOWER AND DECIDED TO RETURN IT AND USE THE EXTRA MONEY THAT I WOULD SAVE BY BUYING THIS PUMP FOR SOME OF THE OTHER THINGS ON MY REGISTRY.  BIG MISTAKE.  TOTALLY UNABLE TO USE THIS PUMP AS THE BREAST SHIELDS ARE WAY TO SMALL FOR MY NIPPLES, AND IT IS EXTREMELY PAINFUL.  I CALLED THE NUMBER FOR THE SHIELDS THAT AREN\'T TEXTURED AND THEY SENT ME OUT THE TEXTURED ONES RIGHT AWAY SO NEEDLESS TO SAY I AM NOT IMPRESSED.  WENT OUT AND BOUGHT ANOTHER PRODUCT BY FIRST YEARS THAT I HAD USED WITH PREVIOUS CHILDREN AND THE QUALITY HAD GONE DOWN ON THOSE AS WELL.  SO NOW I HAVE TO RENT A MEDELA LACTINA IN ORDER TO PUMP EFFECTIVELY.  I FEEL LIKE FIRST YEARS OWES ME SOMETHING BUT NOBODY THERE WANTS TO HELP ME!!!!

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY. I bought this pump since it seemed to have good reviews and the price was right. I should of spent the extra money and bought a Medula. When I first used it I loved the pump. Then after only 3 weeks the pump lost suction, I called the company they told me to boil the breast shield and it should work, it did for that day. The next day I boiled the shield and it did not make a difference I still had no suction and the motor was working fine. Of course it was a saturday and the customer service office was closed. Since I soley express and bottle feed I had to go buy another pump because they dont sell replacement shields in the store. Called the 1/800 number on Monday, they said they would ship new breast shield out immediatly, that was two weeks ago. I have called three times inquiring about the replacement shield and all they tell me is that i should receive it any day. After buying two pumps I could have bought the Medula.

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: I don\'t know how long and how well I can breastfeed when I was shopping for baby stuff before my boy is born. I don\'t want to spend 2-3 hundred dollars on electric pump.  This is the best pump I could find for my budget, I also purchased extended warranty (3 mths from manufacturer and 1 year for extended one) for $9 from Babiesrus and have a peace of mind if anything happens.  There\'s a leak at the hose after the manufacturer\'s warranty ended but the manufacturer is very helpful to resend me a replacement with no hassle.  Consider this if you don\'t want to rent or get a used one from friends.  I\'m very happy with my purchase.

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: I own 3 different pumps, 2 electric and one manual.  This pump has allot of power for the price.  I find that I get more milk out of my pumping session.  The carrying bag is very handy and well organized.  I also own a Ameda Purley Yours.  I find I only use one attachment at a time anyway.  Easy Comfort is a much louder motor than the Ameda - your baby will not sleep through you using this machine.  But to take it to work, it gets the job done.

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: I have been using this pump for a week now, and have had no problems.  It has great suction and is very comfortable.  The only word of advice I would give is if you are going to boil the parts to sterilize, make sure you take off the plastic valve because it will lose its shape, affecting its performance.

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: if i had to do it all over again..i would spend the money on the pump in style or purley yours.  the First years works.  It works slowly and loudly,it leaks, and the shield (and assorted parts) need to be boiled regularly because it gets "out of shape" and won\'t suction.  if you are going to pump "once in a while" this is ok...otherwise spend the money!!

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: I purchased this pump last october and I tried using it unsuccessfully the first week - it had no suction. Then I realized I did not place the small round knobby looking filter in place. Once i did the correct setup the sky was my limit. My son needs 520mls of breast milk a day. He is exclusively breastfed and 5 months old. I pump once a day when my breasts are engorged (between 11AM and 3pm). Why wait for engorgement - the milk flows like a tap and I get the most milk quantity for the least amount of time. With this pump I am able to produce the 520mls daily without hassle and under 30 minutes while at work (not very noisy and in a nice bag). Typically after pumping, my breasts are emptied and then i let the baby suckle at night. Only disadvantage is that you cannot do 2 breasts at the same time but people, what is the hurry when you are pumping under 30 minutes? I have read some of the other reviews and I do not advice you to depend solely on the pump to keep your supply going. No pump can mimic the baby\'s mouth and suction. Have your baby suckle on weekends and whenever you are at home. Aside from keeping the milk supply going you are bonding with your baby and they love to "kiss your chest" every now and then. They feel secure. Irrespective of price, this machine is great.

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: This is the best pump.  I bought a manual pump, a battery operated pump, and this.  This pump is by far the easiest one.  I\'ve taken it on vacation, to my parents, and even camping!  The only glitch I gad was that my son is a fast nurser and the pumping action is slower.  The sound was easily muffled by a blanket or a coat, etc.This is the pump to get!!!!

name: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review: I bought this breast pump right at the birth of my son, and used it twice a day for 7 weeks.  All of a sudden, the suction no longer worked on the "flex-shield" attachment.  So, we took it back to BabiesRUs.  They replaced it, no charge.  The 2nd machine\'s "flex-shield" only lasted TWO DAYS before losing its suction!  I am extremely frustrated - "The First Years" said that they would send me another attachment for correct suction, but I\'m not excited about continuing to use this machine.  We will probably return it this weekend, and get a refund.

name: DEX Products Mommy Bear Baby Bear MBBB-01
review: This has been a must-have for us since the beginning. My son is now 7 months old, and we\'re still using it. It\'s great because the music or heartbeat will play for about 45 minutes, much longer than our mobile (5 minutes). The sounds are very peaceful and relaxing. Highly recommended!

name: DEX Products Mommy Bear Baby Bear MBBB-01
review: This is not only a cute product, but it works well to calm a fussy baby!  The wooshing sound of the womb really does help sooth the baby to sleep!I like that there is a volume button. I found that the loudest setting is good for the first few weeks that the baby is home and eventually you can start to lower the volume. There is also a switch to play soothing music, but we have found that the baby enjoys the womb sounds much more.Each bear has a velcro strip so that it can fasten onto the crib.  My only problem is that there is only one sound box for both bears.  The box can be switched from the mommy bear to the baby bear, but I wish that each bear had it\'s own box so that one bear could always stay attached to the crib and the other could go downstairs with us during the day.  It\'s really not that big of a deal as it\'s easy to switch the sound boxes, but it would be nice to have 2.You\'ll be glad that you bought this!

name: DEX Products Mommy Bear Baby Bear MBBB-01
review: I bought this for my two week old who was very, very fussy and I did not get the results I had hoped for. It did not put him to sleep, the batteries did not last that long. What I did find was that when he was almost to sleep it worked to help keep him a sleep or in the car(baby bear) worked great for the car ride and when out and about he loved the music not the heartbeat. His cheap little alarm clock that plays nature sounds works a lot better.

name: Simplicity 3-In-1 Bedside Bassinet
review: The only reason I didn\'t give it five stars it because I haven\'t used this bassinet yet - but I am delighted with it for the price.  It is taller than others, its options are very nice, and seems very sturdy.. a concern for us having a curious 3 yr old boy.  The pattern is hard to discern online, but the fabric is identical to the beige plaid sheets that Target sells to go w/the Waverly Vintage Rose bedding collection, which we happen to have, so I was very happy about that.  I have already purchased extra sheets by calling the customer service number on the instructions, they are $5-$6 each plus shipping.  Anyone with concerns about space might want to look at an identical Graco model at a baby store, this bassinet is larger than \'conventional\' bassinets and is wide at the legs, but they are very nice because they have wheels that can lock and completely fold up when you want the bassinet to rock.  I would recommend this unit, especially for the competitive price.

name: Simplicity 3-In-1 Bedside Bassinet
review: I am extremely satisfied with this bassinet.  It\'s ability to change from a traditional bassinet, bedside sleeper, and changing table was more than worth the money. I contacted the manufacturer to purchase additional sheets and they accomodated my request and were very friendly and helpful.  I recommend this product to anyone looking to purchase a bassinet for themselves or as a gift.

name: Simplicity 3-In-1 Bedside Bassinet
review: I am about to have my 3rd son and this is my first bassinet.  After reading all the reviews on it, I went ahead and ordered it along with an extra bassinet pad.  I absolutely LOVE it!  It\'s a beige color with soft green trim.  Perfect for unisex.  I agree the only downfall is the original pad is paper thin.  We ordered an extra one and put it under the original one.  The bassinet is a little bigger then your avg bassinet so the pad is a little bit small, but with a small blanket around the sides as an added bumper, it adds that extra bit of sturdy, even cusion without having to worry about your baby suffocating from having a bunch of blankets under the pad.  My husband had no problem assembling the bassinet.  The wheels are a little squeaky, but that\'s an easy fix with some WD40 or something.  The mobile animals are not all the same.  Ours were little white sheep, but from what I understand there are different mobiles.  It\'s just luck of the draw.  The bassinet also has 5 different height settings.  The tallest one is actually quite high, perfect for dads who don\'t want to bend down to try and change the little one, or for parents who have tall beds.  We are expecting our baby any time now and I can\'t wait to use it!  My two year old is already fascinated with it!  I definitely recommend this for any parent (new or experienced).  But definitely get an extra pad for it.  I have seen many different places sell this particular bassinet, so if you can\'t get it here, look around.  JCPenney sells it for sure (and they will ship it).  Enjoy!

name: Lamaze Bright Friends: Trotter the Pony
review: We just had a grandaughter born in Sept and a granson born in Oct and are expecting another grandson in April. I bought the turtle, the monkey and trotter for them for Christmas. The 2 babies that are already here love theirs and so do I. These are the cutest toys for young babies and are so colorful and easy for young hands to hold. In fact, I\'m so pleased that I purchased Celeste, the frog and the butterfly for them as Easter gifts. Also purchased the puppy, trotter and the fishbowl for my house. Wish they had toys like this when I was raising my babies.

name: Lamaze Bright Friends: Trotter the Pony
review: This was my son\'s first toy that my husband and I bought him.  We hooked it onto his bassinet and he loved staring at the hooves.  He is now 9 weeks old and he still loves it.  Trotter now hangs off a rail in his crib and he likes staring at it. Now he also tries to kick the hooves to hear the sounds. We take it with us on long trips so that he feels like he is at home.  We now look for the other Lamaze toys of this collection since he has responded so wonderfully to this one.

name: Lamaze Bright Friends: Trotter the Pony
review: My baby girl is 4 months old and Trotter is her favorite toy right now.  When she was around 2 months old she noticed it hanging on the side of her crib.  Since then, she loves to stare at it...chew the legs, pull the legs..pull the rings.  He is definitely a must get toy for the babies.  Highly recommend.

name: Lamaze Bright Friends: Trotter the Pony
review: These toys are cute, and seem to have a lot to offer a baby.  My baby was kind of ho-hum about it.  I still have it attached to her car seat, and every once in a while I can hear her touching it back there, but otherwise, we haven\'t gotten much use out of it.  I guess I did have fun playing with it when she was really small (a couple of months).

name: Lamaze Bright Friends: Trotter the Pony
review: My daughter is now about 3 months old and this is the only toy that will hold her attention.  She will gaze intently at TTP (trotter) and make the cutest little inquiring faces.  She grabs at his rings and bats at his legs.  It is just the cutest thing.  I definately would recommend this toy.

name: Lamaze Bright Friends: Trotter the Pony
review: We could not go anywhere without this toy.  The legs are floppy fun, the toy makes different cruncy, etc. noises and it\'s washable.  We have hooked it onto the stroller, the carseat, etc.

name: Madison Avenue Baby Wall Dcor
review: Like most of the Koala Baby items, this isn\'t the best of quality.  We tried to tear the tags off one of the hangings and it came apart.  They als just feel kind of cheap.  However they do look cute when they serve their purpose on the nursery wall.  We have the whole Moonbeam nursery going on, so they really fit in.

name: Madison Avenue Baby Wall Dcor
review: Love these!!!...so easy to hang & look so cute. I thought they would look a little cheap-ish due to some of the comments here, but they dont look cheap at all to me. Just be careful cutting the tags off...I just love them!  A total MUST HAVE if you go with the kaola moonbeam collection I believe! (See my pic above)

name: Koala Baby - Moonbeam 6 Piece Bedding Set
review: I bought this set and it does look quite adorable. Although, I do feel the way the ties are sewn on the crib bumper pad makes it tough to attach all of them to the crib rails. They are all strectched to meet the rails and I had pulled one so far, it riped out of the bumper. I made do until I finally removed the entire thing due to my son stepping on top of it to leave the crib.

name: Koala Baby - Moonbeam 6 Piece Bedding Set
review: Adorable!  The bedding is gorgeous and can be used for a boy or a girl. The bedding also has a lot of accessories for the nursery.  We have the lamp, wall hangings and pillow. The colors are great and the bedding is very soft.  I originally did not like the bedding when I viewed it online, but when I saw it in the store I knew that this was it!

name: Koala Baby - Moonbeam 6 Piece Bedding Set
review: I love it. . .I don\'t know if I\'m having a boy or a girl, and this is the one set that I found to be perfect for either.

name: Koala Baby - Moonbeam 6 Piece Bedding Set
review: This would be a perfect bedding set for either a boy or girl. The colors are very soft, and the accessories are just adorable!

name: Koala Baby - Moonbeam 6 Piece Bedding Set
review: We bought this set because we didn\'t find out the sex of our baby until birth and needed something that could be for either sex! We absolutely love it! We are not using the bumper right now because it didn\'t seem to fit right on our crib. (We have a wooden convertible crib and in the mattresses highest position, the bumper wouln\'t attach properly.) Once we move the mattress to a lower position, the bumper will attach fine. The pattern is so cute for either a boy or a girl!

name: Koala Baby - Moonbeam 6 Piece Bedding Set
review: We bought this for our baby boy that we\'re expecting in a couple weeks and it is absolutely wonderful.
