I was scared about washing it for the first time in fear that it would fade or shrink, but luckily, it looked good as new and we can\'t wait for our baby to sleep in it.  One thing to be cautious about is buying the valance.  The bedding is mostly blue with hints of yellow and green, but the valance strangely is more of the green color and it just didn\'t seem to "match" the bedding as well because that green just stood out more than I wanted.  We couldn\'t return it because it came as part of the package.

name: Koala Baby - Moonbeam 6 Piece Bedding Set
review: I looked at many different bedding sets for my son before deciding on this one. I am so glad that I held out and found it!!  The colors are absolutely gorgeous, not too loud or to suttle, and the different textures are very soft.  The 6 pieces included are perfect to complete the look of the nursery!! Very pleased!!!

name: Lambs & Ivy Madison Avenue Baby Window Valance
review: It\'s a really nice little valance--a little pricy for what it is but it matches a carters crib set I already have. I couldn\'t find curtains or a valance anywhere to match --so I was happy to locate this.

name: Lambs & Ivy Madison Avenue Baby Blanket
review: The blanket is exactly as pictured and incredibly soft. I bought it as a quick way to ensure the colors of the Madison Avenue crib bedding were as they appeared on line. The pink is very soft and has some very soft cream swirls to the pattern. Can\'t wait for our baby girl to enjoy the softness of this blanket.

name: Madison Avenue Baby Musical Mobile
review: I decorated my daughter\'s room in Koala Baby sun/moon/stars theme but didn\'t like the mobile that came with it.  So I chose this one.  It has a very quiet motor and the lullaby is great. It took about 15 minutes to assemble (canopy is hardest b/c of small openings).

name: Madison Avenue Baby Musical Mobile
review: This was the first object that my baby girl really took notice to when we first brought her home. I have it set up on her changing table right now and she smiles when she sees it and moves her legs in anticipation of the music! When she was newborn and not smiling yet, she would look at it during her change and the music relaxed her. We could tell she prefered that changing area over other places in the house because of the mobile. The colors are also really soft, but still the shapes really catch her attention.

name: Nursery Basket 2-Pack: Natural with Navy Gingham Liner
review: I ordered these baskets and there exactly what I wanted... love the color.. there the right size to store anything you want in them.

name: Badger Basket Bassinet w/Toy Box Base
review: My daughter was born in February of 2000 and was 5lbs. This bassinet was ideal. I loved it then and still do. I had her in the bassinet until she was about 3 to 4 months old then i turned it into a toy box for her.  I was able to take the bassinet off the stand and take anywhere I went from all over inside the house to uotside and to visit family and friends.  I would recommend anyone to get a bassinet for their baby especially this model.  Very sturdy and you do not have to worry about the baby.  To this day I still have the bassinet and the stand is still as a toy box.

name: Badger Basket Bassinet w/Toy Box Base
review: Very poor quality. The bottom collapsed and the bassinet fell to the floor. I\'m so glad my daughter wasn\'t in it at the time. She could have been seriously hurt. My daughter hated this bassinet.  It might as well have been a carboard box with a thin piece of foam. The mattress was terrible. She would fall asleep on my bed no problem, so it wasn\'t a sleeping issue. I had to buy a new mattress to get my daughter to sleep in it. I managed to salvage the bottom half to use as the toy box, but I just keep it in the corner of the room to hold stuffed animals.

name: Badger Basket Bassinet w/Toy Box Base
review: A horrible bassinet that is not worth the money.  Bassinet basket is made of cardboard.  The mattress is very thin and cheap looking.  The white Batiste bedding is cheap and is starting to shred after a few washes.  The basket has broken off its secure snap latch after two uses.

name: Badger Basket Company Portable Bassinet \'N Cradle with Toybox Base, Sage Waffle Pleated
review: I bought these bassinets for my daughter and my newly grand daughters (twins) and both boxes came with missing pieces, I bought both of these bassinets at $39.95 and the next day they went up to $119.95 which is $80.00 more, are they crazy. I would not put my cat in these death traps that are missing peices and parts. I refuss to make it work or rigg it and then putting my grand children in it. Maybe the company should do what is expected and send you a complete order and supply you with any missing parts and not have to send the whole order back after you have tried to put it together and have it half way done, that is stupid. I am not happy at all and the money was and is not the issue, it is the crap that a company will sell you then you can sit and spin!

name: Good Night - Bear Mobile
review: We had received several mobiles as gifts but my son was not very enthused with them. When I spotted this one in the store, I couldn\'t resist.  I am a huge fan of Boyd\'s Bears and the critters on this mobile are absolutely adorable!  My son is 10 weeks old and for the past month or so has been squealing in delight whenever I wind this up!  Even in the morning when he wakes up he is cooing and "chatting" with his "friends" on this mobile!  It was worth every penny to see the smile this item has put on my little guy\'s face!

name: Good Night - Bear Mobile
review: My baby is now 6 months old and she still loves this mobile.  Especially from age 1-4 months, they were her first friends.  She cooed to them when she was happy, she complained to them if I walked away for a minute.  She loves the music.  I used to be able to wind it up 2-3 rounds and she was happy watching them.  Now she\'s content just hanging out with herself or else she just wants out of the crib.  I liked them because they were pastel and classic looking (not modern).  My daughters room has antique distressed furniture in it and all pastel colors, less modern stuff.  I hope this review was helpful.

name: Good Night - Bear Mobile
review: This mobile is very nice looking, we have the 5 piece bedding set as well and it goes perfectly with that. We are still 6 weeks away from our daughter\'s due date, but it seems like she should really enjoy the teddy bears and nice music. Big bonus: the music has an on/off switch! I got it up and on the crib in under 10 minutes I\'d say, and that was even with changing my mind on which side I wanted to put it on :D.

name: Good Night - Bear Mobile
review: I received this as a shower gift and loved it. However, after cranking it up once a night every night, it quit when my daughter was ten months old. The crank won\'t work, and the music won\'t play, and numerous calls to the manufacturer have not yielded any results. For a thirty dollar mobile you would hope it would last more than a few months.UPDATE................I must admit that after contacting the company, Dolly, they very quickly sent a replacement music box for the one that had broken. They were very friendly to deal with and the shipment was prompt, I\'m so thankful.

name: Good Night Bear - 5 Piece Bedding Set
review: This set is absolutely adorable and very reasonably priced!  I love how gender neutral the set is and how perfect it is for a baby and not geared towards a toddler like some of the other sets are.  My husband and I just got the matching border and lamp and they are the pefect accessories for our nursery!

name: Good Night Bear - 5 Piece Bedding Set
review: I had initially registered for this set online, the price seemed right (I believe that crib bedding is outrageously expensive considering) and it had such great reviews. I am so glad I actually went to a BRU and looked at it. The bumper was flimsy - it bunched around the sides of the crib, you would have to sew or velcro more ties to keep it in place and I would still be afraid the baby could get caught if it bunched over their face. The comforter (which I would just use when she was on the floor not actually in the crib) was thin and the material scratchy feeling. If cost is an issue I would suggest not buying the crib sets, and sticking to the seperates.

name: Good Night Bear - 5 Piece Bedding Set
review: I\'ve been searching for a perfect bedding set for my daughter\'s room.  I don\'t want anything that is too girly.  Most of the bedding that I like are very expensive.  I\'m so excited when I found this one.  The price is excellent and it\'s perfect for her.  It\'s cute and not too girly.  She loves playing with the interactive headboard.  Overall it\'s a good product. I only gave 4 stars because the color is a little dull.  It would be nicer if the color is a little bit brighter.

name: Good Night Bear - 5 Piece Bedding Set
review: I too have checked the stores and the website for the accessories and have found nothing. When I inquired at the store they did not seem to know anything about it. I have been a Boyds fan for years and love the comforter set. I was just hoping that the accessories would come before my son who is due anyday. Please post if you have found them anywhere. Thanks!

name: Good Night Bear - 5 Piece Bedding Set
review: My husband and I are expecting our first baby in July.  We don\'t know the sex, so trying to find a suitable bedding set was very difficult.  We looked at other sets that were double the price and really didn\'t offer much more.  After going to BRU to see it in person we bought it on the spot. It is absolutely beautiful! At our BRU they had the lamps and mobiles.  Decorating the nursery has been fun and easy so far. We are very pleased with this product and look forward to adding the other pieces soon.

name: The First Years - Easy Comfort Manual Breast Pump
review: A friend recommended this one to me.  It took me a few minutes to get the hang of it but once I did, I really liked it.  It is the only pump I use now.  It extracts milk just as quickly as the electric pump (maybe even better).  My hand doesn\'t get tired and I am not tied down- I can walk around and do other things.

name: The First Years - Easy Comfort Manual Breast Pump
review: I like this pump!!  I used it for the first time last night and it  felt comfortable.  It did not make me feel uncomfortable or hurt while I was pumping.  I would recommend it for anyone to use on a daily basis who has a good, flowing supply of milk.  For the price it does a wonderful job.

name: The First Years - Easy Comfort Manual Breast Pump
review: I\'ve been using this pump almost daily for over 2 months and I love it. I fill the pump in a matter of a few minutes, It doesn\'t hurt the nipples or the hands and the handle easily maneuvers to a position that works for you. I haven\'t had any problems with it at all and if I did it\'s cheap enough that I\'d just go out and buy a new one...LOVE IT!!!

name: The First Years - Easy Comfort Manual Breast Pump
review: I had this pump with my first baby born 2 years ago. I thought that it would be a better deal than Avent and boy was I wrong. I got it home and cleaned it and started using it and it made my already sore breasts hurt even more (cracking and bleeding) and made my problems even worse. The first time I used it came apart during use. And the 5 times I used it after that too. I called customer service and the lady was extremely rude to me, interupting me while I was trying to explain my problem to her and all she did was explain how to put it back together. I took it to my lactation consultant and she said that she hates that brand/model and that she had 5 other mothers have the same complaints about it. The store I bought it from has since stopped stocking this model. Yeah it has a design similar to Avent but trust me there is a reason why this product only costs $20 its junk. The breast funnel is hard plastic and very uncomfortable might as well use a kitchen funnel, This time I went with a hospital grade pump Playtex Embrace and I love it

name: The First Years - Easy Comfort Manual Breast Pump
review: Same problems as everyone else. I bought this as an "easy" way to pump. I originally bought an Ameda electric pump. I love it, but wound up not using it very often, as it has a lot of pieces to wash and put back together. As I got more and more used to breastfeeding, I just stopped pumping. Well, I\'m going to be out of the house a little more often and decided I should start pumping and storing and just wanted to do a little pumping at night before bed.  I figured a manual pump would be a little easier to use than hooking up the electric pump.  This pump is HORRIBLE. It fell apart, and I pumped and pumped and I got less than 1/2 ounce.

name: The First Years - Easy Comfort Manual Breast Pump
review: It couldn\'t even suck a small bug inside it! To make matters worse the handle falls off easily also...I absolutely got NO milk in the bottle! If you have money to throw away go ahead and buy this...

name: The First Years - Easy Comfort Manual Breast Pump
review: I bought this pump today because my pump-in-style advanced won\'t be here until next week and I have to go back to school thursday. I used it as soon as I got it home. I does the job, and for 19$ you can\'t beat it. I looked all over for a low cost pump and it was hard to find! If you only need to pump every once and awhile go ahead and get this one... but if you are going to pump full time I would go with an electric.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This cotton wearable blanket is perfect to keep baby safe and warm (enough) and covered while sleeping.  I had trouble figuring out what size to get.  The medium size fit my daughter from approx. 8-12 months.  I originally ordered the large size and it was huge on her.  I returned it and bought size medium and have been pleased.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My daughter (6 months old) keeps kicking the regular blankets off when she sleeps.  So I\'ve been looking for something for her.  And I want it in cotton b/c she has eczema and is sensitive to non-cotton material.  I bought an XL so that my daughter can use it for a while.  Overall it\'s a good product.  Now I don\'t have to worry about her catching a cold or anything.  The only drawback is it\'s too thin.  I don\'t think it\'ll be enough at all for Chicago winters.  I\'ll have to look for something else.  Even now I still cover her with a blanket just in case.  But at least I don\'t have to keep thinking about it.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Love these!! It\'s the best way to keep baby warm, comfortable and safe and that puts moms mind to rest!  I have three so that I know there is always a clean one available at bedtime!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My grandchild has used one of these since birth.  It was time for a larger size.  It works great.  Seems to keep the child from climbing out of the crib.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My guy love\'s his sleepsacks. I was excited to find that they make bigger sizes so my man can keep using these. The fabric is so soft on this one. I really like the subtle design and unique color.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Halo is the first baby clothes thing I have seen that seems to be size accurate!  I swear the rest of the clothes are sized by people on crack they are so random.  So my little one is 7 months, 18 lbs, and 28 inches long.  I crossed my fingers and got him the large.  I would not put it on a baby any smaller either in length or height, but he managed to squeak in without worrying about it falling off.  If you are not quite so financially strapped I would recommend getting the size accurate to your baby :-)The sack is soft, nice weight, and I love the open arms so that I can put any variety of short-sleeve, long-sleeve onesies or even pajamas underneath.  The extra layer is not too much for heat, but just enough protection so that those early morning leaks in the full diaper from 12 hours of sleep don\'t go through onto the sheet.  Yay!  I also love the bottom zipper and the amount of room to grow.  Even if I had purchased the correct (medium) size for mine he would have had space.  He is perfectly happy sleeping in it and I will be buying more!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I love these Halo Sleepsacks! They\'re perfect for our seven month old daughter. It\'s lightweight and a perfect replacement for a loose blanket. Our daughter is long for her age and this size (Medium) fits her well with lots of extra room to grow. The cupcake print is adorable too. The Sleepsacks are perfect too to keep little legs from getting caught in between the slats on the crib.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My daughter loves this sleepsack and I feel better everytime she uses it instead of a blanket. Size, fit was perfect for her.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My daughter loves her sleepsack.  She\'s been sleeping in one since she stated turning over on her stomach and could not be swaddled anymore.  We put her in a onesie underneath, when cooler will put something warmer on underneath.  We\'ve got 2 so there\'s always one clean.  Worth the money!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: it is too thin for the winter time. Could be fine for the summer.not worth the money to buy it.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Love the HALO Sleep Sacks.  Have two of them after my son out grew his swaddle.  He has plenty of room to move, roll, even sits up while wearing it & does not get tangled.  Feel better that he has an additional layer on at night, without using actual blankets in the crib.  It is also a great buy on here...most sleep sacks run closer to 23.00+ in the stores.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We love this sleepsack for our daughter! She wears it every night to bed. We feel comfortable that she has something on that is like a blanket but safe. The only problem I have with it is that she grew to long for it. The only size recommendation is by weight only. According to the tag she should still fit because of her weight but she is actually too long for it now. Maybe they should switch their sizing to the same weight and length recommendations as many clothing items have.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Should suit for the baby in coming 6 months. And the color looks like so cuite, I just like it.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My daughter is 21 months old and we are just now starting to phase out of the sleep sacks.  Up until now she has always slept in one.  Putting it on was an important part of her sleep routine and signaled to her it was time to get snuggly and go to bed.  they were great when she was really tiny cause you didn\'t have to worry about her getting tangled up in it or having it wrapped around her face/head.  she moves a lot in her sleep so you always knew the blanket would stay on, didn\'t have to worry about her getting cold, having to sneak in to cover her up again, etc.  We got them in both the heavier fleece and the lighter cotton . . . pairing them with either lighter or heavier pajamas underneath gave us plenty of options to fit whatever the weather was outside (obviously in the summer we only used lightweight cotton, sometimes with just a diaper underneath).  I\'m a big fan of the sleep sacks.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We have liked Halo\'s fleece style sleepsacks for fall & winter. They hold up well with daily use and frequent washing... For warmer weather we bought this 100% cotton blanket version....It is well-made, soft, and breathable. Just be aware that it may shrink. In our case, after the first washing, the X-Large size shrunk to the equivalent of a Large in the Halo fleece style.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We use it all the time. Don\'t need to bother with socks that come off or blankets. It is made out of cotton and is breathable. We are in the next size now, and still very happy. Definitely recommend.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I want one!! A soft sleeping bag that makes the little one sleepy & happy. You can\'t ask for more!!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My baby has been wearing SleepSack since he came out of the swaddle so we just keep buying the bigger size.  The cotton is soft and it has washed/worn well.  We will soon buy the next size up.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: In this day and age of SIDS awareness, the Halo Sleepsack is a great product for babies who hate being swaddled.  From day 1, our baby hated her arms being pinned and would wiggle and force her arms out from her swaddling.  So the sleep sack has been a great alternative, warm and snuggly.  I only wish that it had arms for those colder nights and that they weren\'t as expensive as they are.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I love the Halo sleepsacks and this one is super cute.  The little ruffle at the top is just adorable.  I like that they size at the bottom and they are very roomy at the legs. The material is just fine for either winter or summer.  Love these and I will definitely buy more.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Halo Sleepsacks are genius. I love that I never have to worry about my 8 month old daughter getting too cold when she sleeps. She has two of these sleep sacks in the medium size and she\'ll probably be able to wear them for at least a couple more months. They\'re roomy and allow her to move around as much as she likes. They zip up from the bottom, so nighttime changes are as easy, and they\'re actually made really well. I\'ve washed these things so many times and they still look brand new. I\'m more of a fan of the cotton knit sleepsacks than the fleece ones. They seem to be more durable and breathable.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: They are super cute and my son is sure to love his since he asked for it specifically but you can get these at Disney store for $8, at Toys R Us for $6 so why on earth they\'re selling for this much is beyond me.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Fits my long 5 month old well with plenty of room to grow. It\'s soft, made well, and washes well too. I

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I buying these wearable blankets for my daughter since it\'s safe, since small kids could suffocate with regular blankets. Also I usually buy just cotton or combination of cotton with syntetic materials, since it\'s more breathable and comfortable for the child. Highly recommend this product.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We ordered this SleepSack for our two-month old (who\'s over 10 lbs) and found it quite large, although it appeared smaller after washing it. But it is soft, comfortable, easy to put on/remove and does a good job at keeping her warm at night.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Bought this for our son, who has the habit of kicking away his blanket with surprising precision - a problem when temperature falls in the house during this time of the year.While it is, of course, entirely random whether a child will accept a sleeping bag (or wearable blanket), we lucked out and he did not reject it. In fact, he likes it and gets unhappy when you remove it in the morning.The product 100% cotton as advertised, easily washable and doesn\'t get too hot. The zippers work without getting stuck.Short: Product works. Baby happy, Parents happy.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: my 16mo son has been using halo sleep sacks since birth and we are big fans.  he\'s now walking so i thought about getting the kind with the foot holes but didn\'t like the fabric options that style comes in.  i decided to go with the puppy print as i thought my son would like it (and therefore be less inclined to fight going to bed, which has worked out for us a couple of times!).  other reviewers have commented on the sizing running large -- i love that the sleepsack is so roomy.  the x-large is meant for 18-24mos but i feel like it\'s the perfect size for my 32-33" son so that his legs don\'t get cramped in the bottom of the sack.  we were previously using a large which he still fit into but it just looked too cramped to be comfortable.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Love this sleepsack. Started off with the fleece one, but now that it\'s summer, we need something lighter. The cotton sleepsack is very soft, but as other reviews stated, you should get a larger size--one or even two sizes larger with the cotton b/c it shrinks quite a bit after wash/dry. I got the 18-24months sack for my 10 month old who is average size and after the wash it fits fine.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We love this halo sleep sack for our little guy.  This is the second child that we used the halo sleep sacks on and they have been great for us.  I love that he uses it as a sleep que, when we get this thing out and put it on him he starts rubbing his eyes and yawning.  It keeps him at the perfect temperature and comfortable. He has also learned to stand up in the sleep sack in the morning in his crib without problems.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Love the Halo sleep sacks; they are  a huge hit in our house. Great for babies and toddlers after they outgrown swaddling and before blankets. My son loves sleeping in these still at 14 months.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Love their products.  Our son\'s been in halo sleepsacks since he was 1 month old.  Back then he used the swaddlers, then transitioned over at about 4 months to a newborn sleep sack, then to a small.  And now we\'re onto the medium sizes.  Crazy how they grow.This is a really cute print.  I love the light turqoise-ish color with cute little owls on it.  This sleep sack has served us well.  Durable, breathable and best of all, safe.  I think my son\'s so used to having a sleep sack on, I don\'t know what he\'ll do when we eventually switch to a blanket!We however, live in CA and get 100+ degree weather here during the summers and I just wish that halo also makes a thinner muslin version of this sleep sack for the really hot weather places.  Make a muslin version to compete with aden and anis please!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This is a wearable blanket that is 100% cotton. It is not much thicker than a receiving blanket so it is better for warmer weather. There is a different fleece option from Halo that we have too for when the bedroom is a little chilly. I have used this with both my boys when they no longer want to be swaddled but you still want a little more warmth. You can layer it with a onesie t-shirt or full body pajamas. I would definately recommend this for bedtime as you can use it for multiple sizes for example 6-12 months rather than getting several different sizes of blanket sleeper pajamas. Which is especially nice when they are growing so fast and moving up through those sizes.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I purchased the sleep sack when my baby boy was about 3 months old. The weather was getting warmer and he had pretty much outgrown all the sleep gowns we had been using. After moving him out of the bassinet to his crib, it became apparent just how active he was too. The sleep sack helps keep him from getting his legs stuck in the sides of the crib, yet still allows him to roll around and play. It\'s not too warm, but gives him some coverage in an air-conditioned house. I definitely plan to look at a fleece version for the winter months too. I can\'t believe I never used these with my first son!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I like the design of this sleepsack and it is cotton. but I have to agree one of reviews: this sleepsack is too light-weight, it defeats the purpose of keeping your baby warm---which is why you purchase a sleepsack.I would not recommend this cotton blankets to others..unless you wish to use it in summer.a friend recommend BABY IN A BAG sleepsack, it has summer and winter models. I did not purchase it yet, but like to provide a link here in case you want a sleepsack situable in winter and made of cotton.[...]

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: When my daughter was a couple months old I would swaddle her in a blanket for nighttime sleeping.  One night I heard a muffled sound coming from the monitor and went to check on her.  She had kicked her fuzzy fleece blanket up over her face, and was starting to breath quickly to try and get enough oxygen.  I don\'t even want to think about what could have happened if I hadn\'t heard that sound! The next day I bought a HALO sleepsack, and I\'ve been a big fan ever since.  My daughter slept in them (the fleece, flannel, or cotton - depending on the time of year) until she outgrew the large, and I have recommended them to all my friends.  Now I have a new baby and he has slept in them from 1 week old (he liked the tightness of a swaddled blanket when he was first born, and wasn\'t strong enough to kick off the blanket.)  With all the info out there on SIDS, and especially with my own scary experience, it helps my peace of mind so much!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Our son sleeps 13 hours a night with this on !! HE cant kick off the blankets, and I know he is safe from blankets over his face.  He sleeps so well all warm and cozy.  You MUST GET THIS!!!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: One reviewer suggested ordering one size up so I took that advice and went with it. When it arrived, I was shocked. I probably could have snipped the bottom and worn it as a tank top!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Perfect for summer! Good gender neutral color, and works great for my long baby. These are so handy, but maybe a little overpriced.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: These are great you can\'t go wrong! I used halo sleep sacks for over a year w both my kids!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: The SleepSack does what I need it to do:  keep my daughter warm as she sleeps.  She tends to move a lot while sleeping at night throwing off blankets in the process, and we bought this to make sure she stayed covered.  It was thinner than I anticipated, but it still does the job.The zipper is well-designed too, zipping from top down (or unzipping from bottom up).  This allows you to change diapers quickly while the SleepSack stays on the baby.This does what I need it to do; I\'m glad to have bought it.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: The size chart on Halo\'s website seems to be accurate to this product.  We got the large even though she is just now 6 months old.  She is nearly 30" in length and probably a little more than 20 lbs.  It\'s a bit big even with a wash a dry, but I don\'t feel there is a danger of her head or arms coming out of the holes.  And she\'s getting bigger at such a fast rate she\'ll probably outgrow it in another few months.  Not sure how warm it\'ll be in winter, but I can always put her in thicker pyjamas.  She loves cotton and hates fleece which is why we went with this sack.  We haven\'t swaddled her since she was 1 week old, it\'s actually better not to swaddle, so we went for the arms free sack.  Love the color, good for a boy as well.I definitely sleep better knowing she\'s not going to smother herself especially since she\'s now a pro at rolling over to her tummy.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This is a must have for my 7 month old.  She sleeps in these sleep sacks every night and will not go to sleep without it. This one is a great sleep sack for the summer months.  She has been wearing the small 0-6 month size but now at 7.5 months the length is just about too short so I will be re ordering in the medium size.  Love this product.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Our baby was swaddled for sleep up until she was 6-months-old and started rolling over onto her stomach while swaddled.  We tried putting her in footie pajamas for sleep, but she seemed a bit restless during the night.  It was too drastic of a change from the swaddle she\'d become comfortable with.  We tried this Halo SleepSack (on top of the pajamas), and she settled right down to sleep.  The SleepSack gives her the cosy comfort of a swaddle with the freedom to roll over without any safety issues.  Now we use a SleepSack every night.  We prefer the standard fabric (rather than the fleece variety).  Living in Houston, the Halo fleece fabric is too heavy and warm, even in winter.This particular design of dots is not our favorite Halo design, but it works just the same as the cuter designs.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Another great product from Halo brand.  Really love that this is cotton, the perfect weight for summer months (as I find the micro-fleece ones too warm in summer). The zipper is easy to close and well made so there is no chance of it getting caught on baby\'s sensitive skin.  Highly recommended.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I bought this for my 11 month old daughter to keep her warm at night. She does not keep the blanket on her.Unfortunately it didn\'t work out for her.She would keep falling down when she would stand (once she woke from her nap).I think she wasn\'t used to it. After her nap, she likes to furniture walk in her crib and it just didn\'t work out for us.I tried temperature sensitive heaters and the works to keep her warm. I didn\'t want to put sleepers on her b/c it\'s too warm . I settled with putting vests on her (I cut the arms off of her sweaters that she grew out of and put those on her at night) and it seems to be working. she doesn\'t have the sniffles in the morning anymore.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I bought a X-large one and it\'s 100% cotton... but after one single wash, it became a medium size... Do they have XXXL size? probably not..

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: i love this product lets face it blankets,bumper pads,pillows and all deco in babys crib is NOT safe ilove the fact i can dress my baby in something that she loves and is SAFE and cozy she loves this when i put it on her she knows it is bed time and she starts rubbing her eyes and preparing to sleep please dont use blankets in babys crib its just NOT safe buy these they are GREAT!!!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: In the warm summer months, when the temperature drops only a few degrees at night, we need something to go over our son\'s pajamas to keep him comfortable but not too hot. The Halo cotton sleep sack is the perfect solution. It is light-weight, breathable, and never bunches up around his face. It zips up from the bottom in case we need to do a quick diaper change and don\'t want to totally undress him. Sleep sacks are recommended instead of blankets to prevent SIDS, so it gives us peace of mind too. Be sure to order the right size for your baby - the sizes go by weight. They might look huge at first but your baby will grow into them (and out) faster than you think!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Our son has had a sleep sack since he was born and he loves it! When we zip him up he knows it\'s time for sleep. I worry less knowing that he won\'t suffocate under a blanket when he rolls around at night.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My 10 months old baby has now been using this one every night for the past 2 months, and probably still will for a while :)Very practical, it still allows her to roll over and sit easily in her crib. We live in Florida so even though we have the A/C we just needed a light blanket and we loved the HALO swaddle bags but needed something bigger.We bought a cute one at IKEA that did not last long (the zipper broke), very disappointing, so got back with HALO. Do not regret it at all. Cotton is very soft of great quality even after weekly wash/dry. Zipper is still fully functioning. Like new after 2+ months!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This sleep sack is a great one for a nice light layer while sleeping.  I seems true to size and is made very well.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I love these! These are the safest way to keep your baby warm, without having the risk of loose blankets in the crib.  These work great, are well made, hold up to many washes, and even open at the bottom for easier diaper changes.  I own several of these in different sizes for my little one and definitely recommend them.  I also like how the material is breathable cotton so that they keep my baby warm without the risk of overheating.  I also like how they come in neutral colors so that they will be able to be used by any future kids as well.  I would definitely recommend buying several of these.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I gave this sleep sack 3 starts for two reasons, 1.) HALO totally takes advantage of parents by pricing their sleep sacks waaay too high! and 2.) While very nice to have for Newborns and young Infants, 90% of SIDS cases are under 6 months old. The advice from my pediatrician and father of 8 was "once your baby learns to roll from front to back and back to front, the risk for SIDS drops dramatically. In fact more Babies and Toddlers die from being forward faced in thier car seats too early yet the emphasis on SIDS is astounding!" With that advice I personally don\'t feel the need to use these over priced sleep sacks past 6 months of age.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We still did not have our baby ... we expecting her within 3 months and liked to have everything ready, we got this and looks amazing ... liked it and can\'t say its perfect yet ... but happy to have it

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: The Halo sleepsack is the only brand I have found that makes a sleepsack in cotton.  If I knew of another, I would buy that instead.  In general, it\'s a great idea versus using a baby blanket as the baby can\'t kick it off or get it caught up in her face.  But the Halo sleepsack has a zipper that you have to attach at the top and zip down.  This makes it seriously difficult to put it on her when she\'s already sleeping.  I\'ve twice knocked her in the face trying to either attach the zipper or unzipping and detaching it.  It would make more sense to have the zipper already attached at the bottom and zip it up.  I have another one in fleece by a different maker that does this and I can easily get it on her even if she\'s sleeping and in the dark.  But I wanted one in cotton for summer.  I\'m going to take the Halo\'s I have to a seamstress to change the zipper.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I bought this sleep sack for my 10 month old son, and I couldn\'t be happier.  This is my second purchase of a sleep sack - one for my daughter a year and a half ago.  The cotton jersey material is very soft and I love that the zipper starts at the top and zips down towards his feet.  There are no rough parts of the zipper at all to irritate his skin.  I\'m also impressed that the arm openings aren\'t too large, such that there is no danger of him wriggling his arms out of the sleep sack.  I highly recommend the sleep sack!!!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I\'m a fan of the HALO sleepsacks and their functionality. It could be a positive or negative thing but this 100% Cotton HALO is made of very light and thin cotton material which is a lot different than the fleece HALO sleepsacks that I\'m used to buying. However, when the weather gets really hot during the summer, I think this will be the perfect solution so I bought a larger size for my son to grow into it to use it during the warmer months.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: When I put it on my little girl in the summer night, I don\'t have to look at her during the night time.  I know she won\'t feel cold.  Good for mom.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I love the sleepsacks. We keep our airconditioning cool at nights, so the sack ensures me my son is keeping warm . . . but not too warm.  Cotton, non-fleece material is perfect for summer, working like a sheet would.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I love these sleep sacks.  I have 2 in each size (one cotton, one fleece) and swear by them.  I like knowing my kids will stay warm and not kick off their blankets in the middle of the night.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I bought the size that corresponded with my daughters weight and height and it was huge. She hated sleeping in it

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: A must have for babies! We use ours every night. The cotton is great for warmer weather, either alone or with a onesie. Love the cute pattern on this one too.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This product is a life saver for a new mom. I was so worried about SIDS and my son getting wrapped up in a blanket. This solved my all of my worries. It is made very well and comes in a variety of sizes, so they can grow with your little one. Now that I have another on the way, I am stocking up on some new ones. I always give these as gifts to my new-mom friends.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Snuggly soft, gives me peace of mind that she stays covered all night.  We\'ve used this brand of sack since she got out of the arm-wrap swaddle type, and it was now time for the next size up.  It\'s as awesome as I expected.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Here\'s why I prefer HALO over SwaddleMe...SwaddleMe= I picked one up at Marshall\'s on clearance for $5.  I was excited how cheap it was.  It, of course, did its job.  The zipper zips up like any normal zipper, and has a material flap to tuck the zipper in below the baby\'s chin.  I found that the zipper came out though and was afraid with my baby\'s squirming and rolling on his side during the night that the zipper would poke him.I therefore bought this HALO Sleepsack. More expensive, yes, but will buy another one, if needed.HALO= why does HALO win over SwaddleMe?  For the mere reason that the zippering runs opposite and therefore starts at the top and ends at the baby\'s feet.  I am no longer afraid for the zipper to poke him.  I also like that this has a zipper versus Velcro like many SwaddleMe ones have because the undoing of the Velcro startled my baby in the middle of the night during diaper changes.Spend the extra money, you\'ll be happy you did since you\'ll be worry-free.I bought this particular pattern because it was the cheapest of the ones offered.  It\'s cute and I would recommend it.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Our son is 1 year old and during the 1st 6 months we used a blanket that was underneath hime that would wrap around him so his weight would keep him from pulling it over/to his face.  But,I was always a little uncomfortable with that and purchased this sleep blanket and love it.  I put him in is PJ\'s and the put him in the blanket.  No more waking up because he is cold because he has wiggled out of his blanket.  Where ever he goes in the crib this wearable blanket stays with him.  I love it and recommend it.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I bought this for my 14 month old who likes to swing a leg over the crib rail like she\'s trying to get out. I hope this keeps her from being able to climb out for a while. Also, it gives her extra warmth without having to worry about keeping a blanket on top of her.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Have these sleep sacks in every size!  My baby won\'t  sleep without them.  Love them!  They long enough and just the right weight to keep baby warm and comfortable without over heating.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We have a Halo fleece sleepsack and have really liked it.  I bought the cotton sleepsack for the warmer weather.  Our daughter moves around a lot and it gets wrapped around her legs so she can\'t stretch out.  The material is very soft and seems comfortable though.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: It is great! Not to thick, my son Loves it :) Would suggest it to anyone. The animal print is also super cute!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My daughter has been in sleep sacks since birth and Halo is by far the best brand.  This is a great summer weight sleep sack that is very very soft.  They hold up very well to weekly washings.I had a long debate whether or not to get the early walker one for my 15 mo who has been walking for 5 months.  I\'m glad I didnt - I don\'t have to worry about her wearing socks and most of the time she isn\'t walking in it ( and even the few times she had she is fine).  My daughter is a bigger than the average 15 mo but the 12-18 mo fits great and she should be able to wear it for another 4-6 months.  I would say they run a tad large.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We used this sleep sack a ton!  The cotton was especially nice for early spring when we wanted some extra warmth, but fleece would have been too much.  It was also great to pair the cotton sleep sack with a fleece sleeper.  We also used the cotton sleep sack with a cotton onsie during the summer.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I\'ve had the HALO sleepsacks before, and this one lived up to my expectations.  HALO makes a great sleepsack.  The product is good quality and very soft.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I don\'t know how parents function without these.  Blankets are impossible with little ones who thrash around and crawl around the crib at night.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Love it! Must have!It is ok for summer but not ok for cold winter days. you have to buy another for winter.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Great sleep sack, cotton is lightweight for summer, and washes well.  no shrinkage after a couple washings, which should last us for awhile.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We have used this since we quit swaddling him as a newborn. We use the cotton one year around and it is the perfect weight here in Texas. We only use the fleece one when it becomes really cold. He is 15 months old and he associates the sleepsack with sleepytime. I never have to worry about him being cold or kicking off his blankets-totally recommend!!!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I love these halo sleep sacks. We\'ve been using them since he was a couple weeks old (when we used the swaddle ones). They are the perfect weight and a great alternative to blankets. They are large. My guy is 10 months and 21 lbs and we probably should still be using a medium but ordered the wrong size. The large isn\'t too big (it doesn\'t fall off) and will last us longer.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My son can roll around all he wants & it doesn\'t get tangled. The first sleep sack I bought the zipper did break but awesome amazon sent me another within 2 days PLUS a prepaid return lable so all I had to do was drop it off at UPS.Now that its getting colder ill be ordering another in the micro fleece. Love these!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My daughter wears this almost every night. The sleep sacks are super durable, soft and you can wash them many times before they ever show wear. I\'ve used one of these through two babies.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: just a side note, the small fit my son up until he was about 7 months 1 week old. we bought the medium hoping it would be good and it wasnt... it is GREAT! there is plenty of room for him to grow in it and its long. if you live in a colder climate i would suggest at least a long sleeve onsie on under it like we use. our baby is a heat machine so he gets too warm in these with pjs on under it but too cold with just a onsie or pjs. great alternative to a blanket and much safer

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: What a pain. Ordered a large and received a small. Not only that they didn\'t carry a Large. (???) They need to better update their product availability.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This little sleep sack is so cute with all the ruffles.  I bought it for my Grandaughter and can\'t wait to see her in it.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I love these sleepsacks. I\'ve had my son in them since he was 12 months. He won\'t sleep without his on. We live in northern california and it gets cool at night so I am assured he\'s snug in his sleepsack versus blanket that falls off. Additionally, now that he\'s 2 1/2 almost, it gives me piece of mind in that he can\'t climb out of the crib. Without the sleepsack on, he tries to climb out and with it on, he doesn\'t bother and sleeps soundly. Good quality.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I could not find XLs anywhere!  my child has used these since he was a newborn, after swaddling ended - he sleeps well in these, and he does not get caught up in them, or knotted up.  We found our first one 2nd hand in a mothers club rummage sale and thought "hey this would work!"  My son knows he cannot walk in it (18 months), and doesn\'t walk across the crib, though he can stand to complain about being in the crib.  I wish it had arms on the fuzzy ones, but we dress my child in a onesie and long sleeved pjs so he\'s warm enough - and we heat the room to 66 so he\'s really fine.Love this product.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I tried this out for my 4 month old and it\'s just ok I found the baby dee sack to be alot better.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: fast shipment, great product, will recommend to my friends. I just wish they coast less so I can buy more of them.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I absolutely love this sleep sack. After using heavier-weight sacks with my baby, I decided it was time to purchase a lighter-weight item to get ready for warmer weather. This one is perfect. It\'s 100% cotton and feels like a soft t-shirt, and it\'s 0.5 tog. I agree with other reviewers\' suggestions of buying one size larger than you think you need. My daughter is petite at 10 months, weighing just over 18.5 pounds and about 28.5 inches long, but I opted for size large and I\'m glad I did.I don\'t think I saw exact size info posted, so thought I\'d share this right from the product\'s packaging:Newborn: Height 19" to 23" and 6-12 poundsSmall: Height 23" to 26" and 10-18 poundsMedium: Height 26" to 30" and 16-24 poundsLarge: Height 30" to 35" and 22-28 poundsX-Large: Height 35" to 40" and 26-36 pounds

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We own the newborn swaddling type, the cotton and the microfleece and love them all.  Very much like not having to bundle baby in blankets they can kick or wiggle out of!  We keep our home cool (62-65) year-round and these help keep babies comfy and safe all night long.  One of our new mommy diaper bags with all the promo stuff in it had one of these in a microfleece style!  From newborn thru crawling, these are great and now they make them with feet for older kids.  Kudos Halo!!  We tell everyone about these and give them as baby shower gifts.  Have seen other brands but we\'ve stuck with Halo as they\'ve held up through multiple washings w/o fail!!  Baby #2 is wearing baby #1\'s Halo\'s and they are still going strong and will be donated to a Goodwill as they still look that good!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My grandson already had a couple of HALO SleepSacks for winter.  This 100% cotton one is perfect for warmer weather.  My daughter doesn\'t have to worry about her little guy kicking off his cover.  This is a great idea!!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: It looks like good, not too small even I ordered small one, hopefully can use till 6 months.Strongly recommand.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I bought this for my baby granddaughter for Christmas.  Her mom likes it because it keeps her baby warm without using a blanket.  Nice product.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We use sleep sacks every night and during all daytime naps for our 8-month-old.  This cotton one is perfect for nights and daytimes when it is not as cold.  We put it on him over a short or long-sleeved onesie and he sleeps great.  The cotton is soft and I love that the zippers go from top to bottom.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I\'m sure that this isn\'t true for all babies, but my little boy (5 months) loves this.  When we\'re putting him in his crib he\'ll start to cry a little, but once we put him in this he\'ll start giggling.  I\'m not sure why he likes it so much, but it sure is cute!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: LOVE this sleepsack.  It\'s only one layer of cotton fabric and quite large.  I went from using a 0-6 month one (of another brand) to a medium Halo Sleepsack.  It\'s perfect.  My 7 month old has quite a bit of room to grow.  I do expect to buy another one until he\'s at least 12 months old.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: When I first started using a sleep sack I really liked it because my child loved to be rapped up. Now I will never use one again. Don\'t be fooled, your baby can still suffocate wearing one of these. Yesterday I bought the medium sleep sack do to the fact that my child out grew his small one. While he was sleeping he somehow got the sleepsack up over his nose. If I hanldnt woken up, he very easily could have suffocated. I will never use any type of sleep sack again. The risk is to much. Just because sleepsack fight SIDS, doesn\'t mean it isn\'t the cause in some cases. Be very careful using a sleepsack! They most definitely are not risk free!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Purchased for my granddaughter to keep her warm at night in her crib. It does a nice job and takes the place of a blanket which people these days say is unsafe. I don\'t know about that but my daughter trusts it so oh well.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My baby has really sensitive skin and this was the only thing we found that we could use to keep her warm and not cause any rash.  100% cotton goodness!  We love this!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Our son was swaddled since he was young and as he started growing we wanted to find something more comfortable for him. At 6 months, we ordered 1 size big as we knew he would outgrow them quickly. They fit him very well and I still continue to use them (even at 12 months).

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: The official description of this item provided by amazon.com does not include the length measurements, only weight.  However, when this sack arrived in the mail, the packaging said clearly that the large was for up to 35 inches long.  It really puzzles me why such helpful sizing information was left off the website.  My experience is that kids get too long for the sleep sacks way before they get too wide.  My kid is on the low end of the weight range for the large, but she is about to get too long for it.Otherwise, I like the weight and softness of the fabric.  The extra layers of fabric around the zipper do take extra time to dry completely (it takes an extra whirl in the dryer). I of course like that the zipper is "upside down", so that the zipper pull is down near her feet when it is on her.  However, I wish it had a little pocket at the top to hide the zipper\'s end (sort of a small metal grommet thing).  Once she nearly chewed the little metal base to the zipper off on a similar sleep sack.Finally, I consider turquoise to be a unisex color, but when this arrived, it was totally light blue.  Shouted boy pretty loud.  As she only wears it asleep in her crib, it doesn\'t matter that much.  I tend to consign her stuff when she is done with it though, and if I get unisex items, they are twice as likely to sell.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: The only reason I didn\'t give this 5 stars was because the seam near the top of the zipper is loosening after about 2 months or use.  Other than that, soft material, baby loves it - happy with purchase.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: What is not to love about this?  Perfect for baby!  Since you cant use blankets in the crib, this is a perfect solution!  Soft, comfortable, and a thoughtful backwards zipper!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: What more can I say, the product speaks for itself great product that my son seems to feel very comfortable in.  getting chilly here and he\'s been sleeping right on through the night

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: We live in the High Desert in California and it gets really hot here in summer time. The Halo Innovations SleepSack Wearable Cotton Blanket is the only one of its kind that I have been able to find that is thin enough so our son does not get too hot but still keeps him covered during the night. He is almost 2 now but does not want to give up his sleep sack at all. I just ordered and received the XL size and are pleased with it. It will fit him until the end of this summer. The only thing with the Halo sleep sacks is that the size and weight indication is a little off. They are bigger than you think. But their quality is really good and I just love them!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: So happy we decided to get this sleep sack. Even though I read the reviews about these running big I still went with an large and even ordered an XL to have has a backup for when our little one gets bigger. My almost 6 month old began to roll over in his sleep and this sleep sack gives me peace of mind. No worries about him getting wrapped up in a blanket. The cotton is soft & adds the perfect amount of warmth to his footie pj\'s.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I love the Halo sleeper sacks. They wash up nice, they fit great on my kids, and of course they are cute. I would recommend anyone with small children buy these for their children. It keeps them covered without the risk of blankets...and if your kids are anything like mine...they move so much that a blanket would stay on them anyway.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This is perfect for the spring/summer months because it\'s not too hot.  I intend on getting a thicker one for the winter months!  I love the fact that I don\'t have to worry about extra blankets in the crib and my baby really seems to be comfortable at night.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Adorable Sleepsack, cute as a button and very well made. I would recommend this product. Makes a great baby shower gift for mommy to be.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I ordered the x large as it was for 18-24 months.  It looked like it was for a 5 year old.  Way, way too big for a little 31 inch tall baby to wear.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Halo sleepsacks are quality and the zipper has never come apart during the night (which I can\'t way for our Aden and Anais ones, even though I love the fabric of those). The cotton ones are great for warmer nights and daytime naps. We use the fleece ones for cooler nights.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I have both the Halo fleece sleep sack and this cotton one. The cotton one is very flimsy and doesn\'t compare in quality to the fleece one - if you want a cotton sleep sack - why not just put the baby in a nightgown? The fleece one, however, is aweseom (even though I like the LullaBag slightly better than the Halo fleece sleep sack)

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: this is the third one of these we have had.  Our daughter is 19 months old and we will be sorry when she out grows this product.  It keeps her warm and cozy and can\'t come off during the night.  She seems to really like it too!

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: Love that these are 100% cotton. They are durable and well-made. I highly recommend these for new babies too young for real blankets.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This sleep sack is awesome. It\'s quality fabric and it\'s very soft. I wanted something for my LO to wear over her jammies that would be a little extra something that would keep her warm without her overheating and this is perfect.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I use it over a onesie in summer, and over fleece footed jammies in winter. They are good quality and last forever through a bizillion washes. No worries about baby suffocating, as they fit great.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: My boys are snug and secure in these sleepsacks and we have used them since birth. At 2 they are not ready for their big boy beds and these keeps them and me happy through the night.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: This is by far the best item I have ever purchased for my baby.  Its made of a light cotton material.  Its thicker than plain sheets.  My son has almost outgrown it but the next stage is not made of the same material.  It is big and will last a while.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: It\'s soft and easy to wear. My daughter like it. If there\'s newborn size, that\'s will be much better. But small size is suitable, too.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: I feel my baby is safer wearing this convenient sleepsack than wearing a blanket. And it stays on when my baby started rolling over in her sleep.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: our 16-month old kicks and moves a lot when he sleeps so this sack keeps him warm throughout the night. It is the second one we buy of this kind (had a smaller size) and we are all very happy. It is lightweight that he won\'t overheat yet thick enough that it keeps him warm. good quality, holds up pretty well with frequent washing at high temp. My son was swaddled for 4 months then transitioned to sleep sacks and I plan on using them for a while.

name: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Soft Pink, Small
review: When we transitioned our son from swaddling to a sleep sack we went with the HALO brand since, let\'s face it, they sell them EVERYWHERE. The price point is great but it wasn\'t long before I found out why I dislike them so much.Aside from only coming in sizes that last just a few months (I guess so you can keep buying ones that fit), the zipper down the front causes the fabric to bunch up, making a convenient little hump that he grabs and chews at, which in turn makes it a very unfriendly thing for an infant with incoming teeth. Hearing him bite at the hump with the zipper was an unnerving experience with the sound of teeth pulling against metal, not to mention that in some cases you can still buy versions with the hole in the zipper pull which has pulled teeth in some cases.We looked for a better solution and found it in the Woolino sleepsack, and although it does cost more, we\'ve found it to be a much better sleep solution. Firstly the zipper is located along the edge so it doesn\'t create a hump that he can grab and bite at. It\'s also easier to put him into since it has snaps on the shoulder, which in conjunction with the zipper around the side allows it to completely open up. It comes in 2 sizes which allows him to use it for a longer duration and I actually like the material better since it\'s slightly heavier wool instead of cotton.If you have a mouthy infant like ours, you might want to consider looking at other options before investing in the HALO sleepsack.

name: Sealy Stain Protection Crib Mattress Pad
review: I love this mattress pad. I\'ve had others in the past not nearly as comfortable as this one. The padding is very comfy for my daughter and it\'s water proof just as it says. My son had an accident and it did not leak through to the crib mattress. That was a first. I would reccomend it.

name: Sealy Stain Protection Crib Mattress Pad
review: My daughter slept through the night more peacefully with this mattress. I highly recommand it!

name: Sealy Stain Protection Crib Mattress Pad
review: This kept the Crib Mattress we bought completely stain free. We would make this purchase again if ever needed. A worthwhile investment. Seller was a fast shipper.

name: Sealy Stain Protection Crib Mattress Pad
review: I have owned several mattress pads for my kids over the years and this is by far the best.  I was amazed that this pad was so soft, plush and yet works so well.  All you feel is super soft, bouyant cotton and it doesn\'t have any strange "plasticy" smell or crunchy sound like so many waterproof pads have.  It seems to have the best absorbancy yet and the fit is superb!  It is easy to apply to the mattress and yet never seems to shift or bag at the edges.  This is the first waterproof mattress pad that I have been able to put into the dryer for ONE cycle and have it come out DRY!  I know, amazing concept, isn\'t it?  I wash these pads on hot and dry them on medium and I have not had any shrinking or problems with wear.  I wash them weekly or more often if needed.I really recommend these pads to anyone with babies or small children.  It\'s always good to have 2 per child....one is always ready when the other becomes soiled (due to an accident or sickness)....and as most parents know, children tend to get sick about the same time as their siblings.  This can at least make YOUR part a little easier to manage.  Hope this was helpful.

name: Sealy Stain Protection Crib Mattress Pad
review: I accidentally bought this mattress pad, thinking it was the same as the one I already had, when I went to buy a second.  It\'s not very good quality. Every time I go to put it on the mattress it feels like my fingers are going to poke through the cheap stretchy sides.  And it only barely covers the mattress; it\'s pretty much holding on for dear life at the corners.  I have a Sealy mattress from Babies R Us and it\'s not extra thick, so there\'s no reason this shouldn\'t fit.  For the same price, you\'re much better off going with the UltraSoft Quilted Mattress Pad by Continental Quilting.  I have one of those and it is *great*. It fits the mattress really well, with no chance of it popping off.  I wash it all the time and it hasn\'t shrunk a bit.

name: Sealy Stain Protection Crib Mattress Pad
review: We were given a Carter\'s mattress pad as a gift, but I wanted to buy "the best" so I got the Sealy.  I washed/dried it and tried to put it on the mattress.  It says right on the tag on the pad that the cover must wrap under the mattress at least 2" on all sides to prevent entanglement (a suffocation hazard).  Well, it didn\'t even cover the sides of the mattress, let alone 2" underneath.  We have a standard size crib mattress so it obviously shrank even though it says it is preshrunk.  I had to use the Carter\'s pad which fits fine and doesn\'t pose a suffocation hazard.  Both have the same dimensions on the package too--28 X 52.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: Keeps wipes handy and much more comfortable for baby.  We had an older version of the wipee-warmer with our older child.  We have really loved this one.  The wipes stay much fresher (no browning) and don\'t dry out.  It is kind of a pain to wash/replace the pillows, but definitely worth the effort.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: Okay when I had my first set of b/g twins 3 years ago, I was certain that I didnt need alot of the ridiculous baby products on the market. Well I will tell you that my twins SCREAMED every time we changed them, and we could not figure it out, I think the nieghbors even thought that someone was being murdered, SERIOUSLY! We honestly didnt know what was wrong until they were 2 and we heard someone else had the same problem, but our twins were almost potty trained, so we didnt get a wipes warmer. But with our second set of twins b/b, we registered for ALL of the "ridiculous" baby products, AND THIS IS ONE OF THE BEST! We wet the sponge very frequently, and we have never had a brown or dried out wipe. We replace the sponge about every 2-3 weeks or so. Unlike some other wipes warmers, this keeps the wipes warm long enought to actually wipe a babies bottom. We love them, our boys love them and we even had to buy a portable wipes wrmer! I am telling you that this product WILL save you many headaches. (we keep ours in the den by the PNP\'s(thats the most frequent changing station) and keep the travel one in the babies nursery) and in the diaper bag)***** UPDATEWell I just found the perfect wipe, as one of the next reviewers said, PAMPERS. They pop up nicely, and they never get dry. But if you are more interested in very moist, comfortable wipes, I think huggies are better. Or if you just want to save some money and dont care if the wipes dont pop up and get a little drier, get LUVS. But I think I would recomend Pampers, they are nice, just not as "fluffy" as Huggies. But when my boys have diaper rash I tend to use Huggies!

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: Ofcouse this products warms up the wipes but pop ups lid doesn\'t close after 3/4 weeks. I exchanged one after the lid go bad, second one same problem. I\'m using a duck tape to keep it close. If the lid doesn\'t stay close wipes will dry out.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: It makes changing my daughter\'s diapers easier and she\'s happier with warm wipes... I like the product and would recommend it, however you have to remember to saturate the sponge on the inside and it would be nice if there was a device to warn you when the pad begins to dry out, otherwise you end up with cold wipes again...

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: The warmer comes with the Ever Fresh Pad ($7.99 for 2).."necessary to prevent browning and to keep the unit sanitary" but the bottom layers of wipes go brown anyway so at the end I had to throw away many wipes. Off course I try keeping a lot of water in the bottom but then when I got to the bottom wipes they were drenched, and I had to squeeze each wipe in order to use them.One more thing, each time you open the lid to check the pad, or because the "pop up" feature doesn\'t work (it just works with Pampers Wipes), water will spill out and you\'ll think the pad is still wet when it\'s really not.  If you buy it, be sure to check the botton at least twice a week, if not I\'m sure the pad will be dry and the wipes brown.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: I found this to be a must have, especially for those late night changings where the last thing you want to do is startle your baby...My only suggestion is if you have a 2 story, is to have one on each floor.  It will save you the time from having to run up and down the stairs and keep your baby happy.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: No matter what time of the year the baby is born, nobody wants a cold washcloth on warm skin! The secret is to fill it a little more than halfway. I leave a wet washcloth in the top to retain moisture and serve as a face & finger wipe during the day! I recommend Huggies Newborn wipes. They are thicker and stay moist longer. This is my second one however, the first one (older model) cracked and began leaking. I do wish Prince Lionheart would modify the lid. It falls down on the back of my hand and the pop up part doesn\'t stay closed. I\'ve had to tape it down. (I don\'t use pop up wipes anyway)

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: I received the wipes warmer for my shower, and now that Julia is here, I am so glad I have it.  It works great, and my little girl is calm and happy when I use the warmed up wipes on her.  I am going to buy a travel warmer, too, because she cries when I use the cold wipes.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: I like this product, but sometimes the lid pops up when I get the wipe out, so I have to use two hands. And the part where the wipes come out kept popping off, so I just took it off completely. I do like the warmer, though, and so does my son. If I were a picky person, I would have returned it!

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: Newborns hate to be cold . . . this thing is worth it. After 4 months or so, my baby started to enjoy a refreshing cold wipe, but I\'d use the warmer for a newborn.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: This wipes warmer is pretty good when it comes to warming wipes, but the major problem is the funky lid. There\'s a button to open the lid and it pops open and has this squeaky "haunted house" door sound when it opens. The thing won\'t stay closed, so wipes will dry out. The first time the lid snapped open with that creepy squeaky sound, I was asleep and it just about scared the bejeezus out of me! Hubby also couldn\'t stand it anymore so we bought a Munchkin warmer instead. The Prince Lionheart does have the antimicrobial inside which is great, but the part where you pull out the wipes is tricky and we ended up having wipes get stuck and they\'d rip when we went to pull them out.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: I purchased this item thinking it would be perfect for those late night diaper changes.  I still think wipes warmers are a good idea, just not this one! This warmer heats from the bottom. I quickly noticed the wipes at the bottom were warmer than the ones at the top. I also noticed that the wipes at the top were a bit dried out and soapy feeling. I returned the warmer and found the PERFECT warmer at a TARGET store.  The target warmer heats from the top to the bottom, which keeps the top wipes moist and warm, just as they should be.  It was a little cheaper in price and it has a lid lock that the other didn\'t have.  All around it is a better purchase!

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: Works well. I don\'t use it for baby wipes but rather for keeping photographic mirrors warm to prevent fogging. Does the trick!

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: When I did my registry I never thought I would need or use a wipe warmer, once I had the baby night time changings made me realize my little guy did not want to feel anything cold on him while he was half asleep.  This is a great product, make sure to rewet the sponge every few days though or the wipes will dry out and the sponge turns brown and gets stuck to the bottom.  I would recommend this product to everyone ecspecially those with a boy!!  haha!!

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: I liked the idea of warm wipes from the moment I\'d heard of it. I just couldn\'t imagine putting a cold wet cloth on my baby\'s tushy in the dead of winter.  Second to an electric bottle warmer, this is much needed and I know she appreciates me using it :-).  One downside to this is if you don\'t keep the sponge fairly moistened with water, it will brown and harden.  But overall, this is a really great invention.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: This does what it is supposed to. Nothing to fancy but it gets the job done. The only thing I have to say is they recommend replacing the pad but honestly I just re-wet the same one that came with it and it has done just fine for 5 months now.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: I bought this baby wipe warmer in hopes that it was compatible with german housing. Well it wasnt. I should have read more into it. It basically just serves as a very expensive wipes holder. I dont really know how well it warmes up as I haven\'t been able to use it.

name: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer
review: I had this for less than a month before it broke. It\'s really easy to use and they did the job, but it broke so quick and I have no idea why.
