The straps that go around the baby may appear to be tight, but the Bundle Me may actually bunched up under the straps and therefore the restraints aren\'t as tight as they should be.  Then God-forbid there was an accident, the force could cause the Bundle Me to shift-- loosening the restraints and baby could come lose.  Kinda defeats the purpose of a car seat if you ask me.  When there are so many safe covers (the ones that are elastic and go over the car seat, but not under the baby-- for example the Eddie Bauer Carrier Cover, which is what we ended up with), why take the chance?  I\'d rather error on the side of safety.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: The product is fine and holds up nicely, but it is not neccessary unless you plan on taking your baby for long walks in the extreme cold.  I found that my son got REALLY hot in the BundleMe - as we ran errands and in and out of places.  I prefer to use a couple of blankets and layer him so he doesn\'t get too cold or too hot. This item is not neccessary unless you live in Alaska.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Its a must have for winter time! Its soft, worm & easy to clean, i have 2, for my toddler & newborn!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: The bundle me is ideal for cold weathering! provides a comfortable warm haven for baby! It unzips so that you may remove the top layer if you please leaving a warm padding for baby to sit on which at times is just enough!We chose to go with a darker shade for cleanliness although washing is a cinch!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: We actually didn\'t buy our bundle me until February so we won\'t get as much use out of it as we could have if he\'d been born in the fall.  But we got sick of putting him in a snowsuit or covering him with 3 or 4 blankets.  This is a great product.  It kept him warm (sometimes too warm) and was easy to get him in and out of.  Once it got too warm for his carseat I put it in his Graco Quattro Tour and he loves it.  He stays all nice and warm.  But unfortunately I think we are now done with it unless we have a new baby or maybe for the fall in the stroller.  But he is growing very fast and may be too long then.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I was very pleased with the recent baby item I purchased from you.  IT was delivered quickly, in good shape and was all together a good experience.  Thanks. K

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Being a new mom, I had been using blankets and worrying whether my baby was warm when we went out.  I observed other moms with this and went to Babies R Us and found it.  It is so easy to use and functional.  I live in a very cold area and this garment keeps my daughter very warm.  Sometimes when it is snowing I tuck a blanket around her as an extra precaution.  Regardless of whether I use the extra blanket her toes and fingers stay warm and she sleeps very soundly.  I highly recommend it.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Absolutely LOVE this product!!  Wish I had had one for my other 3 children.  We live in cold and windy North Dakota and this is just so easy to use.  There have been times my little one has gotten too hot when I over bundle him in it.  I recommend this to any one expecting a little one in the winter months.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: We bought the bundle me for our daughter in Novermber.  She loved it and we had no problems with it.  I even washed it a couple of times with no problems.  In February, one side of the zipper broke.  We weren\'t sure what had happened.  I contacted the customer service at JJ Cole and received a prompt reply.  After explaining what happened, they gave me an RA# and I sent the bundle me back and received a new one the following week.  Actually, this was some of the best customer service I have received in a long time.  Great company, good product.  I would definitely recommend!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I bought this product for my infant and when I went to the fire station to have the seat installed (with the bundle me in it) the fireman told me that this product should not be used!  He explained that it interferred with the harness and if we were in a crash the baby could come flying out or have serious injuries!!  I wouldn\'t recommend it but I would recommend the shower-cap style covers that don\'t go behind the baby but just over the outside of the infant seat.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Our daughter was in the NICU and before we left, she had to have a car seat challenge. When we brought in her car seat, we had the bundleme in it and we had to take it out as it was a safety hazard. These are not safe for any child as they are made post manufacturing of your car seat, and therefore have not been safety tested with your car seat. Many infant carriers/car seat warranties will be voided if you are in a wreck and using a bundleme or other type of infant \'blanket\' that goes between your child and the car seat.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: These will keep your child warm BUT are NOT APPROVED for use with most car seats.  You should not put anything between the baby and the seat.  These are so padded that your child could be ejected from their car seat in a collision (caused by materials compressing -- same reasoning why children should never have a puffy winter coat on their child when they are strapped into the car seat.  There is a way to modify this item -- cutting out the back piece -- to make it safely usable in car seats.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Let me just say that my husband and I really, really like this product a lot.  We have four kids and we just bought it for our fourth child.  With the other kids we always just used blankets piled on top of the carseat to keep them warm.  Our last two kids were born at the end of the summer, so I could not have another tiny baby subjected to freezing cold weather while he\'s still so small. We live in New England where the winters really do get very cold.  So, we bought this and have been so happy.  It keeps the baby nice and warm without having him overheat in the car once you get the heat going.  I like that it has zippers on both sides that can let this open easily so that the baby can get a little breather until it\'s time to go back outside and bundle back up again.  I also like that because of the way this is designed the material stays out of the baby\'s face so I never have to worry about this covering the baby\'s nose and mouth while I am driving.  The only thing that made me give this four stars is this:  I have only washed this two times.  I think that only washing it two times all winter is great considering all of the baby messes that this has stood up too.  It always looks nice and really does not appear dirty.  But the second time I washed it the zipper pull fell off and fell into my dryer\'s lint screen.  I followed the directions and machine washed it and dried it in the dryer on the tumble dry "low" setting.  I was really disappointed to see this happen so easily.  So I felt that this should have held up better since it is made for babies and does have a lot of potential to become dirty and need to be washed frequently enough.  Little tip- I would let this air dry instead of putting it in the dryer, even though the directions say you can put it in the dryer.  Since I bought this in October, I don\'t think that Amazon will accept a return.  I called JJ Cole but all of their reps were busy and I did not leave a message.  I will be calling them again and hope that they will stand by their product.  I will update when I speak with them.  Edited to update and add:  **I called customer service and they were really great.  They said that they guarantee all of the parts on this for 2 years from the date of purchase. They said to send it back and I could choose any style or color for my replacement.  If there is a difference in price (if I were to choose a pricier option) I would just have to pay the difference.  I am so pleased with customer service - they really stand behind their products.**

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I first purchased mine two years ago when my first son was two weeks old.  I had seen this product and thought it was too pricy; however, after two weeks of stuffing my little man into a snow suit I decided to try it.  I was sold immediately.  I know some people feel the baby still needs a jacket but I don\'t.  I live in NY where it can get quite cold and I only used the bundleme with a winter hat, never a coat.  If I was talking a walk with the baby which only happen a few times given the temperature outside, I put a blanket in the bundleme for some extra protection.  But if you are going from house to car, car to store, the Bundleme paired with a nice warm winter hat, is all that is needed.  I was sold the first time I used it.  Two months ago my second son was born and I am using the same Bundleme for him.  It has held up perfectly, even after being washed regularly.  I would never use a snowsuit on an infant again!!!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I bought this Bundle Me for my newest grandchild. The first Bundle Me I bought was for my granddaughter who is 2 1/2 now. My daughter-in-law absolutely loved it. When the weather  started warming up I then bought the Bundle Me Lite. These are such soft and warm covers for your babies. They wash wonderful also. Just try one and you will be sold on it.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I have to start by saying that I really love this item!  It does the job-keeps my newborn nice and cozy, without having to bundle her up in a snowsuit everytime I leave the house!  My only complaint is the zipper.  I\'ve had problems with it separating while it\'s still zipped up.  Then, when I had it unzipped, the zipper pull completely broke off.  I don\'t know if the company will help me out with this, but I\'m going to contact them for suggestions.  The winter is not over yet and I need at least a few more months use out of this!Other than that, I\'m completely happy.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: love it...started using it as soon as my daughter was born...she hated heavy clothing/sweaters and like... and this worked like a charm...

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I love my bundle me, received it as a shower gift and it is one of my favorites.  Never had to wake my baby up putting on or taking off a snowsuit, plus she hates being dressed so it made my life so much easier.  Also covers more than a snowsuit, on windy days it kept her face covered from the house to car and vice versa.It is also very high quality and easy to wash.  I read some reviews that said otherwise.  I believe they bought the much cheaper copy sold at baby depot that is very low quality and not made by the same company.As for the unsafe reviews, I find it unfortunate that people write reviews for products they do not have, nor even bothered to read the manufacturers comments on."In line with JJ Cole\'s commitment to child safety, the Bundle Me has been tested to FMVSS (Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard) 213 requirements. All tests passed on the child restraint system, indicating that the Bundle Me product appeared to have little to no effect on the performance of the child restraint system"If you think about it, installed properly, it is no different than wearing a heavy coat.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I bought this original bundle me in Graphite and I love it. It really matches the Stroller. It is so warm and soft that our son is comfortable. It is alot better than lots of blankets that your child eventually will kick it off.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: This is by far one of my favorite items I own as a new mom. I live is a cold climate , and it is an item I suggest any new parent to get. It is a so much more convienent than trying to put the baby in a bunting outfit, or trying to stuff blankets over the baby when they are in a carseat or stroller

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Our son has been fussy since he was 2 weeks old and having the Bunde Me in his infant carrier has been wonderful. The minute we get him into the seat he calms down with the warmth of the Bundle Me around him. We\'ve even put him in it at home just to calm him down!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Edited to add ~ I came across one of these (they\'re actually made in my state ~ I put it (Bundle Me Big) in my daughter\'s Britax seat and I didn\'t like how it pinched the shoulder harness and pulled them out wider than they should be.  So I cut out a section of the back so there\'s nothing behind her back and we\'re good to go ~ I\'ll try posting a foto of what I did)I\'d give this item 0 stars if I could ~ Why???  Because this item like any other puffy item (including thick coats and buntings) behind baby in a car seat would "compress" in a wreck and the harness would then be loose on baby causing possible ejection from the seat/car.  Please don\'t use this ~ car seat covers that just go over the seat are fine.Shannon ~A concerned parent and car seat geek!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Fits perfectly in newborn car seat. Don\'t have to worry about 2 day old grand son catching a chill outside or till the car warms up

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: Anyone who has ever tried to put a baby in a snowsuit knows what a hassle it is.  Until the child is old enough to actually walk in the cold weather snowsuits are a waste of time and money.  This item is awesome!  It fits right onto any car seat (there are slits to fit the belts through) and totally zips around the seat to keep your child toasty warm.  It is well made and machine washable.  My son and daughter-in-law absolutely love it.  Some warm clothing and a cute little hat is all you need with this great bundleme.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I use this with my Chicco stroller and it does wonders! It\'s great since I live in San Francisco and it gets chilly especially during the evenings. My daughter is kept warm and the Bundle Me easily attaches to the stroller\'s 5-pt harness for safety. I would recommend this to parents! I\'ve received so many compliments on this product.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I absolutely LOVED the Bundle Me for my daughter who was born last November.  It is a great layering piece and keeps the baby nice and cozy.  I didn\'t like the winter covers that laid over the baby\'s face....this covers them all the way up to their chin, put a hat on and your ready to go.  For the extremely cold winter days I just put a fleece snuggle suit on for the extra layer. When the baby is sleeping and you get the infant seat inside, you can easily adjust the covering so they don\'t overheat.  I\'m planning on getting the next size up for this winter-

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: This is a great buy for a colder climate.  We live up North and this definitely keeps our baby warm.  It is safe to use in the car...you can even detach the top part if you are on a longer trip and your baby gets to warm.  It is so much better than if you are just putting something over the car seat.  This lays right against your baby and we have been using it for over a month and he always feels nice and toasty warm in it.  All we will be using this winter is this and a hat for him...it has been working great.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: when we put our baby in his infant carrier to leave the hospital, we had the bundle me in place as it was January.  They would not let us leave the hospital with the bundle me because they said it was unsafe as it could compress in an accident, making the straps effectively looser on the baby.  They recommended putting blankets on top of the baby.  Save your money--plain old blankets work just fine and then can be used at whatever location you are taking your baby to.  We kept ours for the stroller and find that useful, but it is so bulky up top that it seems to be always either in his face, or folded down in such a way that it looks like his chest will get cold.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: This is perfect for a new baby.  It\'s soft and warm and you completely zip off the top if it\'s too warm outside for it.  I love the graphite color - -we weren\'t sure if we were having a boy or girl so it would work well for either.  I haven\'t washed it yet but it appears it would clean up nice as well.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I bought this for my twin girls and i love it. I had them in September and they fit it in all winter. It was so much easier to get the girls out to the car then using winter suits and trying to get twins to wear them or even put them on without screaming. Using this i was able to just dress them in something less constricting and put them in their car seats before they gave me any hassle. Once you\'re in the car and warm enough, all you have to do is unzip the sides and there\'s no fuss!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: We went to Babies R Us, where we bought our stroller, and used the floor model to test out the Bundle me and other infant carseat liners in the store.  The Bundle me was the best.  Once installed it didn\'t move, like some of the others did and the straps on the carseat fit perfectly through precut slots so we didn\'t have to struggle to find them when strapping our daughter in.  The zipper around the outside made it easy to "bundle" her up on the cold winter days we had this year and it was comforting to know that our newborn was nice and warm.  Overall, this is a great product and is really worth the money.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundle Me, Graphite
review: I can\'t really speak badly about this item but I was a first time mother and thought this was a necessity but think about it unless you are outside for long periods in the winter it is not worth the money.  I think I used it 3 or 4 times and it was very expensive.  Not worth the money in my opinion.  Just one more thing I gave away.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: Ok, once its on and done, I love it. My baby feels secure, its the ultimate in custom adjustibility and size is not a factor. It has a lot of variances in ways to carry and the pocket on the outside is extremely handy.However, when you live in the south and have this on over anything, it\'s very HOT. It takes a while to get it on, wrapped, and cinched where its comfortable, so slinging it on and off is not only not an option, you tend to dread the idea.Another point I will add is I used this right after having my baby, so I still had that 6 month pregnant-looking belly. With this sling, you get this lovely effect where the belt part goes below the belly and the crossover cinches itself to your chest after any length of wear. For those largely pregnant, just find yourself the tiniest halter top, crop top, or babydoll tee you can and put it on (if you can), then take a long sash and cinch it up under your belly... that\'s what you\'re going to look like in this thing. sexy, huh?

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: First of all, I have never written a review before, but this product is so horrible that I feel the need to warn people about it! Here are my reasons:1. It is so long that when you try and put it on it is almost  impossible to keep it from touching the floor, so then it gets dirty and you don\'t want it to touch your baby.2. It is a fur magnet. We have a husky, and fur sticks to it (especially if it accidentally touches the ground while putting it on), and even after washing it there is still fur on it.3. It will make you sweat! I live in Arizona, and there is no way that I could where it out in the summer. I had to crank the AC down in my house to use it.4. It\'s hard to tell if it is on evenly...you don\'t find out until your baby is in it and falling to one side, and then you have to take her out, set her down, and start all over again.5. It doesn\'t look as good on as it does in the picture provided! My husband laughs when I wear it because he says I look like a Jedi Knight, and he refuses to wear it himself.6. I have a beefy baby, so even at 8 weeks old and 12 lbs, it doesn\'t hold her well enough to use it for nursing or as a sling...I feel like she is going to fall out.The only thing that I liked about this carrier is that it scrunches up nicely into a small sac that they provide you with for easy portability!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: My baby is 6 weeks and I\'ve been using this for 2-1/2 weeks.  It\'s been such a savior since my baby likes to be held ALL of the time.  My baby loves it and finds it very easy to fall asleep in it.  We even go out on long walks with our dog.  I\'ve not had any problems with it sagging or stretching...but you do need to make sure you secure it properly and tight enough.  I\'ll admit the first couple of times I put it on I was ready to throw it across the room....but practice a few times with various "tensions" and "tighnesses" and you\'ll find the proper one for your baby.  It is very comfortable and does not bind or hurt your back.  Just this week my baby is starting to really discover the world around her and she loves to ride in it facing outward.  When she\'s sleepy she\'ll face inward.  When she\'s cranky, I swaddle her and wear it cradle style.  Every mother should own one of these!!!!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I also bought into the glowing reviews on amazon and the concept, and while the wrap worked OK for the first few weeks of my daughter\'s life, she kept sliding down my chest in it - in order to prevent this, I had to tighten it so much that it was no longer very comfortable to wear.  Not to mention it\'s a pain to wrap it around you every time, especially if you\'re not on a clean floor (the wrap ends will often drape on the floor/ground and get dirty while you tie it around you).  It\'s so much easier to have a baby bjorn or other carrier to slip over you in an instant.Another bad thing is - if baby falls asleep in it, I could never remove her from it without waking her.And as the other lady on this site commented - it is unusable in the summertime: your baby will overheat from the many layers and your own body heat if the temperate rises to 75F+.And all this for "only" $40.  Spend the extra money, buy yourself a Baby Bjorn or get a cheaper sling - you will never look back.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: This was the most useful purchase I made for my baby girl! At first I was hesitant to use it, because my husband was nervous about me "spoiling" our daughter by carrying her around all the time. But after the first week and a half of her life I got tired of trying to get things done with one hand and/or listening to her scream because she wanted to be held. She spent the next 6 weeks in this thing almost exclusively. I would put it on in the morning, and leave it on all day long. It is very easy to put on once you\'re used to it, and it is very comfortable to wear. I never had any back or shoulder strain while using it. Most importantly, my daughter loved it! She would fall asleep within 1 minute of being put in it for the first few weeks, then as she got older, she really enjoyed being able to see the world and feel me at the same time. It was especially useful when we went to the store, because she could sleep peacefully while I shopped - even in bright, noisy stores. Another plus was that (after some practice), I was able to nurse her while wearing it with no worries for privacy...the sling covered us both completely.The only complaints I have probably can\'t be helped, due to the nature of the sling: the very comfortable jersey knit material tends to stretch as you wear it. So I did have to adjust the fit throughout the day so it wasn\'t too loose to carry my baby. It had a tendency to bunch a bit also, but with practice I got better at putting it on properly so it didn\'t bunch too much. It also isn\'t exactly stylish, so unless my baby was actually in it, I would get some strange looks from people. Lastly, I did buy it with the intention of using it into my daughter\'s toddler years, but as she got older and started walking, her constant up/down requests made it impractical to continue to try to use it.Overall, the versatility of this sling is far superior to any other carrier I have seen or used. The comfort both for the parent and (especially) the baby is well worth the unconventional design. I very highly recommend this sling, and give it as a gift to all my expectant friends!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I bought this infant carrier because of the rave reviews it got. What a mistake. After attempting to get the thing strapped on me tightly about 20 times and putting my baby in then out then in again then out again...my baby was still in no way properly supported by this stretchy piece of fabric. I had to hold my baby the entire time she was in it because it felt like she was going to fall right out. Not only that, but in the picture, it looks like a classy and neat navy sling. In reality, it is a faded blue that, when wrapped around you, looks sloppy and bulgy. It\'s still sitting in my house since I never used it at all.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: The picture does not show the true nature of this item. It is a body wrap difficult to put on

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I can\'t believe what a wonderful product this is! It\'s reasonably priced and I believe it\'s better than the most expensive Baby Bjorn or the comparably priced Snugli(both of which I returned). I want every new mom to have this as it will give the freedom to use her hands while carrying her little precious baby close and secure. My daughter was a big baby and weighs 18 lbs at only 3 months of age. My arms were killing me. Now, she is able to be carried without any fatigue. She feels weightless to me now! Oh, by the way, it\'s washable and very portable. I LOVE this product!!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I love the Baby Wrap, and so does my 2 month old.  He did not like the sling.  It is easy to use.  No snaps or latches.  No ajustments when dad wants to use it.  The baby seems very comforable in it as it is comfortable to wear.  It is compact when not in use and travels easily in the diaper bag.  The only down fall I can see is that the material streches so it seems after about an hour of wearing the baby is lower than we started and I feel the need to reajust.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I\'m a first time mom and my baby is 6 weeks old and we both absolutely love this thing!  I read some other reviews stating it was hard to use, but I didn\'t find that to be true at all!  It comes with an instructional video but it was so simple the written directions were all I needed!  I can see that trying to put it on in a parking lot or some other place that is less than sanitary may pose a problem as the material is quite long.  If I know I\'m going to use it as soon as I get out of the car, I just put it on at home.  I\'ve also found that it works well to just sit in the car and put it on.  Anyway, I love this item because sometimes I need to be hands free to do the dishes or go to the grocery store and the Ultimate Baby Wrap is the perfect solution!  I find that it is very comfortable and feels very snug and secure.  I also like this item because it can be used up to 35 pounds!  Well, this item gets 5 stars from a very pleased mom! I honestly couldn\'t be happier with this product!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: Come on, MOMS! This wrap is softer, more flexible, more comfortable and logical than ANY OTHER wrap available (at least in the U.S. market). My wife and I have tried two well-advertised others, and could never get them "to work". We were delighted to discover this one. Yes, it circles you a few times, and yes, it takes a bit of practice to feel safe, and move child around inside, and take them out if they fell asleep, but - again - there is no better, more cuddly, smart design out there. Forget Baby Bjorn and other carriers: those are COMPLETELY different, in their design, intent and functionality. Yes, Bjorn is better than the Disney crap and many others brands, but comparing a wrap to a carrier shows lack of carrier understanding and ignorance of a wrap\'s history. Trust a heavyset, easily sweating father (and my scientist wife agreed): this is the only and the best to get! Enjoy.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: Recieved this as a gift, yesterday, will be returning it today. Comes with a video, because to actually USE it is so convoluted, not to mention, time-consuming. If you have a crying baby, spending 10 minutes trying to wrap this GIGANTIC piece of heavy cloth around yourself isn\'t going to work.Not to mention, I used the directions twice to wrap the thing, and both times, the stuffed animal I placed in it FELL OUT. It is also VERY thick cloth and is extrememly hot.SO, if you are in a hurry and make a small miscalulation with the tension of the wrap, you will eather drop the child out of the bottom, OR smother the baby. NO THANKS, Ill go for a Baby Bjorn.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I paid extra shipping to receive this item.  I couldn\'t wait for it\'s arrival - even after reading some reviews that it was cumbersome.  I didn\'t measure, but imagine approximately 20 feet of material that you must wrap around your body. That is what you must do to use this item.  Is it "difficult"?  No.  But it is quite a pain.  What\'s worse is that because it is stretchy material, it stretches the longer you wear it.  I do not trust it to support my baby -- and there is definitely no head support for little ones when inward facing.  The sling causes other issues.  Once it\'s tight enough to hold baby somewhere *above* your waist, there\'s no room for baby to be comfortable.This item freed up one hand -- at best.  I could have managed the cumbersome "application," but the end result isn\'t even satisfactory.  I am very disappointed in this product -- no wonder I couldn\'t find it in stores.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I have tried several carriers and slings (snuggly,maya sling, maya wrap pouch, premaxx) and so far this is the most comfortable and useful sling that I have found.  The other slings were either too bulky, lacked the capacity to adjust to my height (5\' 1"), too difficult to learn to use or just plain uncomfortable.  I tried my first carrier when he just when he was just three weeks old and was not pleased. He was not comfortable and would fuss or cry in them.  I love the idea of  carrying my baby close to me, but feel that I have lost some time as far as that goes trying to find the right wrap. My son is now 4 months old and we finally found this sling which is comfortable for both of us.  Other reviewers have commented on the comfort of this one and they are correct...no pressure points, no cutting and digging into the muscles of the shoulders and no tight edges to cut into the baby\'s tender little legs. In this wrap he does not fuss at all and enjoys being close to me. Because he is now longer a newborn, I can\'t rate it\'s efficiency with newborns.  The wrap is very easy to learn to use.  It comes with a video, but I haven\'t even looked at it yet; the simple illustrated instruction sheet is very easy to understand.  I only have  minor complaints about this product and they won\'t apply to everyone\'s situation..1. Breastfeeding for a child my son\'s age (4 mos., and likes to face out and look around)is difficult when worn as illustrated for that position.2. It\'s not complimentary to my wardrobe, and you can\'t just toss it on and off easily. I think the perfect wrap would be one with this comfort level, that could be easily put on and taken off.I really thing that not one wrap will meet all the needs of a parent that will be using a carrier alot. I do like this carrier very, very much and am happy to finally find one that is comfortable, versatile, and easy to use, and is nearly perfect.  I think that carrier is pretty safe, however all safety precautions must be taken when carrying a baby in any wrap.......no carrier or wrap is ever failsafe.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I love this thing!! The thing I like best is that it distributes baby\'s weight evenly and is easy on the back( I also have the baby bjorn but after a while it makes my back hurt).  I also hava a rambunctious 4 year old so I am wearing the wrap ALL THE TIME!! The only reason I did not give it 5 stars was because it is a bit cumbersome to put on, but once you do it a couple times it is soooo easy!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: To be fair we didn\'t have this for long. We tried the carrier on 16 month old (at that time) and it took to look to put on and immediately began to sag. I wanted mainly for a sling, so that in public I could nurse without attracting to much attention, but it was too long and too much of a hassle to put it on so we returned it. I have yet to fine one that will fit and still be a reasonable price.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I specifically purchased this wrap to travel over seas by my self with my 19 pound four month old! I needed something that would be practical and easy to use by my self. I purchase many carriers and the only one that worked was the snugly however I couldn\'t take the baby in and out of the snugly alone (especially in an airport). This wrap is a bit of a shock because when I got it, it was a LONG PIECE OF FACRIC (about like 12 feet long) with an instructional VIDEO! My first impression was that it would work. Surprisingly is VERY easy to use! Is great for the baby because it holds him in all the necessary places! And it\'s not hot! If you are traveling alone with baby, BUY IT!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: OK- I\'ve never written a review before but I felt compelled to when I came online to purchase this for a friend\'s baby shower gift and saw the last review. I used this carrier for both of my children, now ages, 3 and 1 and I have to say that this is, by far, the safest carrier I\'ve ever used. If you use it the right way, it\'s literally impossible for a baby to fall out. Not only is it safe but it is SOOOOOO much more comfortable for me and my kids than any of the others I\'d tried before finding this one. It\'s soft and cozy for me and my kids and I NEVER had any neck or back ache at all!!! The wrap comes with instructions for use and if you follow them, you will NEVER run in to a problem with this carrier!!!!! If I could give it more stars I would!! Clearly, the woman using it wrong wasn\'t following the directions- but don\'t let that deter you from the wrap. Take if from someone who\'s used it for 3 years, You will never find anything better!!!!!!!!!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: The first day I got it - I was cooking mac & cheese while nursing my infant!!! This is the best baby sling - period. Once you get the hang of it - it\'s a breeze to put on - but it will take a few tries to get it routine. But between the verstility - carry front, back, foward facing, inward facing, on the hop, lying down - it\'s amazing. It\'s the ohly baby sling that holds the baby tight - close to you, so it is truly hands free - youdon\'t have to worry about baby slipping or falling out. I have 3 herniated discs in my back, and I can wear this baby sling all day long with no pain.  It\'s simply wonderful!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: Despite that fact that two friends returned the Ultimate Baby Wrap, we thought we\'d give it a try. The video was interesting, but difficult to emulate. The wrap never quite looked like the pictures. Our baby was not adequately supported either. The wrap just squished him up. The wrap went back to the store.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: I bought this wrap for our fourth child, because I knew I would need to have my hands free to take care of the others when we came home from the hospital.  When I first got it I put it on immediately, just by following the instructions on the side of the box.  It was not difficult to put on, and it fit me, even though I was 9 months pregnant at the time.  I put my 2 1/2 year old in it in the front carry position, she weighs about 35 pounds, and both she and and I were comfortable.  The straps are soft and you can make them wide over the shoulders so they distribute the weight.  When we came home from the hospital with our new son, I put him in it the second day and carried him around in it for about 4 hours, we have used it on outings as well.  It keeps him close to me and warm, and it protects him from curious onlookers who might otherwise be hanging over him spreading germs.  He is very happy and comfortable as long as he is in the carrier.  I highly recommend this carrier.  It is awsome!!!

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: this carrier is not so great.  I bought it for the versatile carrying positon but is stuck in the front carrier position only.  The wrap is way to long when you take it off so i cut a few inches off mine.  I can never do the back carrying postion I want to do because my husband don\'t know how to put the baby on.  When wearing it even in the winter I was very hot.  Then my 10 month old was as well.  its okay i would rather have something else.

name: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review: With a new baby its hard to ever have both hands free at the same time.  I am someone that likes to take my baby places and am constantly busy around the house.  When I\'m out, sometimes the stroller is to big to push around and the carseat is to heavy to carry for long periods of time.  I have always wanted a carrier that would keep my baby close and my arms free.  I have searched through the parenting magazines, the internet and have randomly asked other mothers what they would use for carriers.  I find that buckled carriers have too many staps to attach and are a nusense when trying to calm a crying baby that just wants to be held.  When I saw other women using hammock-like carrier\'s both the mothers and baby\'s looked so content that I had to find one for myself.  I stumbled upon The Ultimate Baby wrap and thought sure, the pictures looked cute but I needed to find out if it was really useful.  I read through all the reviews and found that it was a toss up between loving it and hating hit.  So I figured it looked promising and if it failed it could always be returned!  When my husband brought it home I was intimated by one long piece of fabric but I was still excitied.  I did follow advice on the reviews and I popped in the DVD. After watching the very short video ( when you have a baby we all know time is everything) I practiced putting it on a couple of times.  I think that if you can tie your shoe you can tie the wrap.  Like when you first learned to tie your shoe, it takes a couple of trys to get the hang of it.  As soon as I put the baby in she was quiet(FYI we have a colicky baby too!)and fell asleep.  I decided to test it out the next day at a women\'s expo to see if it would really work.  Not only was it easy to put on the next day but she stayed in it the entire time with no fussing!  Women were asking me left and right where I got that great device!  I felt no back pain or soreness while wearing it and my baby was very secure and snug inside!  All you need to do is be open minded and give it a chance!  You will not be disapointed!  After only one day of owning it I was putting it on like a pro!  I highly recommend it to all mothers but make sure you watch the video because a picture on the box doesn\'t do justice!

name: Home Story Wall Plaque in Green
review: This sign was exactly what I expected...lovely craftsmanship and a sturdy method of hanging. It makes a wonderful addition to our home.

name: Home Story Wall Plaque in Green
review: I love this sign and can\'t wait to hang it up.  It also comes with a little peg that lets you stand it up on a shelf/mantle if desired.  I agree with the other review that the green "HOME" is not quite as it looks online.  It has a little more yellow in it than a typical sage green would have.

name: Home Story Wall Plaque in Green
review: Such a nice detail to add to your home.  It\'s off white, and the black lettering is very crisp.  The word HOME is a light green, closer to a celery color than a sage green.  It has a slight glaze and sanded edges to give it an aged look.  In our house we have it on an entry wall surrounded by black & white family photos in black frames.

name: Summer Infant Fold-Up Infant Seat
review: Good quality seat. Much less expensive than most out there. Folds up really flat- great for tossing in the car and easy to manage- even with a bulky car seat and a diaper bag in tow! The little sun & moon toys are a bit annoying- they are attached to a pocket in the front of the seat and they get under the baby\'s feet and bug the heck out of him. I will probably just snip them off with scissors, so no big deal. This seat is totally worth the money!!

name: Summer Infant Fold-Up Infant Seat
review: This is a great tool for moms who travel a lot. I used a standard bouncer with my first son and it was great. We used it for feeding and short-term entertainment - but mostly for feeding. My problem was the bouncer was really big and hard to take anywhere. I ended up using the infant car seat for everything when we went places.This chair is smaller than standard bouncers, folds up and fits in a travel bad (included) and works great for feeding! Now, when i go over to my family\'s house or go out to eat, I can carry this in on my shoulder, and set it up quickly.It doesn\'t "bounce" very hard like some of them do - but for me that\'s OK. It cost about 1/2 - 1/3 what other bouncers cost. I LOVE IT!!!

name: Summer Infant Fold-Up Infant Seat
review: This portable bouncy seat is great.  It folds up so easily and in a convenient carrying case to bring with you anywhere.  So far, I\'ve mainly just used it around the house.  It also has a pretty good vibration for being so small.  We have a 4 week old and use it almost daily.

name: Crayola Floating Art Desk
review: I was looking for something for my darling 1 year old daughter to enjoy in the bathtub.  She loves this toy and helps her with developing her gross and fine motor skills.  The only down side is that the crayons get a bit "mushy" after a bit of time in the water.  But it the Baby Einstein crayons are a good replacement...which are inexpensive as well.  I look forward to many "Van Gogh"s from her.

name: Crayola Floating Art Desk
review: We\'ve had our bathtub "art desk" for two years now and my now 4-year-old still likes it.  It does float but we usually leave it suction-cupped to the wall.  The surface cleans easily with just a washcloth and water.  My only complaint is that the two doors - hidden under the outside purple and red "crayons" are somewhat hard to open.  Not too hard though, just a little frustrating to tired little fingers at bath time.We have given these as gifts and would happily buy another if something ever happened to ours.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I was given a gift certificate to use toward a Baby Bjorn, but I decided to save some money and get a Snugli. By the time I figured out the straps (it took two people!), my son was quite annoyed. Once we put him in it, he looked awkward and uncomfortable in it, like the back was too high and flappy. I felt like I needed to hold my baby up. I thought it would save time when going to the mall, but by the time I got it on, I was frustrated and ready to go home.My advice: Try on both the Snugli and Baby Bjorn BEFORE you buy. The Snugli was a bad fit for both me and my son. The Bjorn was a much better fit for us. I you want a Bjorn, try EBay. I got a like-new Baby Bjorn for $40.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: We hike and snowshoe a lot, so I knew a good front carrier was going to be key. I used the Bjorn for the first 6 weeks. It was nice and secure and easy to use but my shoulders really suffered - and it killed my husband\'s lower back when he used it. When I saw the hip belt on the Snugli carrier I decided to give it a try (I had a coupon for $8 off so I figured what the heck - for 22 bucks, it\'s worth a shot). I\'m so glad I did! This carrier is so much easier on my body.It takes some time to get it all figured out the first time you use it - but don\'t be discouraged! Once you get all the straps adjusted to fit you, it\'s pretty easy to get baby in and out of.I keep the Bjorn in the car and use it if I know it\'s going to be a quick shopping trip. But for anything longer than 15 minutes, it\'s gotta be the Snugli.p.s. I know Bjorn has a version of their carrier with lumbar support, so maybe that\'s the way to go... but it\'s 100 something dollars!

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: This product seems to be getting mixed reviews, but I like it.  My husband adjusted the straps to fit me the first night I got it.  It\'s easy to put on, although I find it easier to load the baby from the top than to lay her on my lap and slide the sides into place like the directions say.I had a cheaper Snugli with my first daughter that didn\'t even compare with this one.  I haven\'t used a Bjorn so I can\'t compare them, but this one is more than adequate for my needs and much cheaper.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I had purchased the old Snugli back in Dec of 2001 and hated it. It was very uncomfortable so I was hesitant to purchase this new one but I did and I LOVE it! I dont use it everyday but I do use it when we go to our neighborhood waterpark/pool. Its very comfortable and lets me carry her around, even in the water, safely, without feeling like Im going to drop her. I find it very easy to get her in and out of.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: We registerd for the Snugli as an alternative to the more expensive Baby Bjorn carrier and I love it, once I figured out how to use all the straps. They are there for a reason, and they hold the Snugli with the baby in place very well, but it is very hard to buckle the strap that goes across your back, you have to be somewhat of a contortionist !Also, on mine the padding under the left shoulder strap kept moving out of place, which is more annoying than uncomfortable, because it feels as if the whole strap will slide of my shoulder.The other thing is that you cannot fold down the front. My daughter is now old enough to face forward, and she loves to check everything out, but since the front does not fold down I  have to tape it down. The Baby Bjorn folds down in the front.For all the reasons above I\'m giving it 3 Stars. It is very, very handy, once my daughter was big enough she spent all day in the Snugli! But I wish I had registered for the Baby Bjorn !

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I originally had another carrier when I had my son, I hated it. I was a pain to put on and it gave me a back ache, when I was pregnant with my second child I bought this one and I love it!! I wair it every time that I go grocery shopping and it is wonderful. I can safely take my daughter in and out and carry her around without feeling like I\'m going to drop her. Since it adjusts in severel different places I can adjust it correctly and I don\'t get a back ache. It\'s a must have for any mother who wants to hold her baby and still be hands free!!

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: This is the best buy in baby carriers!  We live in Japan, where it\'s really hard to take strollers.  This carrier has taken our little monkey EVERYWHERE!!  We tried many other kinds, including other snuggli\'s and baby bjorns, and this one is by far the best for EVERYONE.  Our son loves it, he spent many 8+ hour days in it in Kyoto and Matsumoto and still loves it.  Many people have used it to carry him, from mom (5\'3") to friends (6\'3") and it\'s comfortable for everyone.  REALLY!  Way better than the other kinds and SO MUCH CHEAPER!  Great baby gift!!! :)

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: This is my first carrier, well first child for that fact.I tried on many of the carries in the store with my lil baby, at the time she was about 2 months, I needed something that let me keep her close while getting the day to day things done since she\'s so attached, and plus what parent isnt?Out of all of them even the bjorn this one was the best for its price, I mean 30 bucks? It has alot of the same features the higher end ones have and some are even better then the other more expensive ones.She faced in for a short time, but now she loves it facing out, she sits in it no problem, and falls asleep in it everytime, finally I can go grocery shopping without the car seat sitting on top of the cart, which for my 5\'4 self that makes it impossible to see over, and I end up running over countless people and displays. The one thing that is a down fall is that my back starts hurting after a little while, I\'m also very busty and get back aches from that alone, but still this is a must have for any parent, so far she is about 15 pounds or a little under and I still carry her in it, I love how her little feet are at my hand level so I can touch those cute toes the whole time :)The only thing horrible to happen in it was when I was chewing gum and talking and my gum fell out and into her little hairs, well good thing she\'s bald lol.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: This item was one of those purchases we went back and forth on...do we buy it or a sling style instead? Is this just another 2-in-1 gimmick? Isn\'t Bjorn better? We finally settled on trying this one and used it from the first month up until now--now being our daughter\'s 16th month where she is just now nearing the weight max. for backpack style carrying with this particular item...and Mommy\'s weight carrying threshhold too with this item! The heavier she has gotten now the more the straps seem to not fit my 6\'1" husband especially. But, he and I both found it easy to adjust back and forth depending on who was carrying her (front/back style) and it gave us some added freedom and our family much enjoyment, as we have used it many times instead of just a stroller at: amusement parks, trail hiking, long walks to and from our local sports stadiums, afternoons at the park or mall when she\'d fall asleep but only by being held, and the best---when she was still in her first few months, it allowed a cabin-fevered mommy to: go outside and get the mail or garden, vacuum, wash dishes, put on makeup, or simply comfort a fussy baby without arms or back getting tired. THIS IS A MUST HAVE!!! NO GIMMICKY 2-for-1 HERE!!! AND DON\'T WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THE BABY BJORN JUST BECAUSE EVERYONE ELSE IS OR BECAUSE THEY CLAIM TO BE THE BEST!!! This was so versitile and had nice airflow vents, padding, easy adjustments, and BONUS: pocket for your keys or money or that spare binkie!!!

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: Bought this elsewhere and am now browsing for alternatives.  Was looking for the next step up from my soft newborn carrier.  This one seemed very sturdy and stylish, and the color was great for one who hates all of the cutesy and/or navy blue baby stuff from which we are normally forced to choose.  However, I was heartbroken to find it tough to use with my six month old - hard to believe that she would already be too big to make doing up the side closures practical, but that seemed to be the case (despite what Snugli\'s specs claimed), so hated to waste the money.  I\'m thinking of getting someone to custom design me one!

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I love this Snuggli.  I use it about everyday.  My daughter is now 3 months, and she absolutely loves it.  I find that it is the most useful when I go to the grocery store, or Target -- some place that I have a cart and can but the diaper bag in it.  My daughter just falls asleep. I think it is very comfortable. The only negative is that is has a lot of straps; I did not want to use it at first because I felt that it was such a hastle, but I have gotten used to it, and now love it.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: This carrier is just fantastic! The lower strap that goes around your hips really helps to prevent any back/shoulder strain from using this carrier. It is designed much the same way that hiking backpacks are and is really comfortable. My baby loves riding in it, and the straps for holding her head are easily adjustable so that while she is facing inwards I can losen them while she\'s awake and wants to look around and tighten them when she falls asleep to keep her head from rolling around, all whithout waking her up. I like the fact that unlike the Bjorn carrier the straps have clips. It\'s a small thing but it\'s faster and more convinent for me not to struggle with threading straps. This carrier does have a lot of straps to adjust however! It\'s all for the sake of making the carrier customizeable for each adult but this can be confusing at first so be warned. You want to take this carrier out of the box and familiarize yourself with all the straps and adjustments you can make before you need to use it for the first time. You can easily adjust while wearing once you are familiar with the carrier, however. All and all I\'d say that this carrier is simply wonderfull, and the price (half of the Bjorn carrier\'s price) makes it even better.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: When I registered for baby items, it didn\'t know if I would use something like this.  I always thought it looked strange when people walked around with thier little ones strapped to themselves.  Once my son was born, I realised how great a carrier could be, and I was thankful that someone bought this off my registry.I tried so hard to like this product.  The problem is, you have to try very hard to make it work for you.  If you can borrow someone\'s Baby Bjorn, do so.  Once you can compare the two brands you will see why the extra money is worth it.The snugli was very cumbersome.  The straps just do not make sense.  Again, I liked this product fine, until I borrowed a Baby Bjorn for two days.My husband, being a new Daddy, wanted to use it too.  Well, that meant I had to keep adjusting the staps, which TAKES A LONG TIME.  Plus, you can not put the baby in easily.  You would have to lay him/ her down, or have someone help you.  I think this defeats the whole purpose of using a device to keep your hands free.Plus, my son kept sweating; the fabric isn\'t very breathable.  I found  he slumped down into the snugli all the time.  Once we switched, we didn\'t have these problems.It\'s a great idea, but you get what you pay for.  I recommend registering for this item, then return it to Babies R Us for a Baby Bjorn.  I\'m soooooo gald I did.  I still use our B B, and my son is nearly 8 months old.  I would have stopped using the Snugli a long time ago.  It takes 15 second to put on and strap the baby into the Baby Bjorn (I timed it for a friend).  It took much longer to use the snugli; that\'s a big difference when you\'re in a store and your baby begins to wail...

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: easy to use,comfortable.I would recommend it to others,and would purchase again.when my daughter gets fussy i strap her on my back or chest."she loves it"

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I never understood why people pay 100 bucks or more for carriers. I used a snugli with both my children and it was excellent. Light weight and secure. Plus children love the closeness it provides to mommie or daddy. This is the absolute best carrier out there and if you don\'t want to break bank on one then this is the item to purchase.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: Let me start by saying the quality of this product is great. When our son was in the carrier, I felt he was safe, secure, and reasonably comfortable. I also found that wearing the carrier was comfortable for both front and rear carry for extended periods of time. The hardware and straps are strong and adequately padded. On the flip side, our son is not what would be called a "big" kid. In fact he\'s on the medium to small side, after 6 months, he could not fit in the carrier anymore. The seating area is quite small, as are the leg openings. It\'s extremely difficult to secure the child in the seat due to the twist, slide, and pull up latching system. It helps if you put the child in first, but sliding the harness on is difficult when using the rear facing mode. The other problem is that although the box illustration shows a forward facing infant/toddler smiling happily, it\'s not the same in real life. There is a half moon shaped portion on the front of the carrier that must me folded and tucked in so that your infant can see what\'s in front of them.I would only recommend this for newborns.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I had used this snugli a few times when my daughter was first born. It was okay, especially when I needed to walk the dog too. I didn\'t think it was the easiest to get her into and out of, and if you plan to walk for a mile or more, it does hurt your back after a while.  Anyway, that was fine with me to deal with until this past weekend when I tried to use it again! My daughter is now 16 pounds and I put her in the front position, following the directions the thing came with.  I came back to discover my baby\'s legs were turned a bright blue!!  I was terrified and couldn\'t get her out of there quick enough! When I finally did I saw where the carrier was cutting her little leg\'s circulation off due to the positioning, which was correct according to their instructions!  She was fine and unaware of what had happpened, but I have never been so scared in my life- or furious as a mother!  I thought maybe it was just me, but have heard from another mother I work with that this happened to her too!  I will never try to use this again and wish I could get some sort of refund, but it might be too late now!  Figured the least I could do was warn other people!!

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: We absolutely LOVE our Snugli!  The best features are the 3 positions (baby can face in, out or be on your back) and that you can get a sleeping baby out of it without waking him.  I can also get my son in and out, still asleep, by myself.I bought an old carrier at a thrift shop to see if by baby would like it.  It was a total waste of a dollar.  It hurt my back and I couldn\'t get my son out when he was asleep.  All problems were resolved with the Snugli.My husband (6\'3") and I (5\'9")both wear it, and it\'s super easy and quick to adjust.We bought it just before we went on our then 2 month old baby\'s first airplane trip.  We didn\'t have room to haul the stroller on our trip, so we put our son in the Snugli and carried him around the airport in it.  He loved it, too.  He was facing us back then.  A few weeks later we went to Arches NP, he had really good head control and he wanted to look around, so we turned him around.  Since then, we have taken him on MANY hikes. We don\'t have any back pain until after about 2 hours of hiking with a 15 pound baby strapped to our chest!  He loves it so much he even sleeps on hikes.Now my son is 5 months old and is just able to sit up by himself.  When he gets fussy, I strap him on my back and he rides around while I get things done.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I am very happy with this baby sling.  It\'s a little intimidating at first because of all the straps, and I had to have my husband help me adjust it to fit.  But all the straps make for a very secure fit.My newborn is very comfortable in this sling.  She gets to lay close to me.  We tested this out by going to the mall.  The whole time baby slept comfortably and not once did my back start hurting.  I was very comfortable the entire time and both baby and I felt secure.For me the sling is less trouble than a stroller at this point and has been a nice option.I would recommend this sling.  Just be sure to have someone help the first time adjusting it to your body.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: The Snugli works, you just have to have patience...which I don\'t have a lot of.  If you are the only one using it, you can customize it to your size and it\'s easy to use after that; however, my husband and I both wanted to use it and having to readjust all the straps is a pain in the neck.  There are so many straps!  It\'s hard to figure out where they all go unless you\'ve done it 10 or so times.  I looked at the Baby Bjorn and it seems to be easier, but it is three times more expensive.  I\'ve looked at trying a sling instead.  The Snugli is not terrible.  If you can figure it out the baby seems to like it.  When our son was a newborn, though, he would sink down into our chest and we\'d have to hold the side of the Snugli down for him to breathe.  However, now that we can turn him around and he\'s facing outward he really does like it a lot and it\'s a great idea.  Just not for impatient people like me.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I received the Snugli as a shower gift and it is a wonderful product.  I like that it is versatile and I will be able to use it not only for my newborn but as she gets older.  My baby likes to be snuggled so this is ideal. I carry her around and can get things done in the home.

name: Snugli Front and Backpack Carrier
review: I purchased this carrier when my daughter was about 3 months old.  I couldn\'t even get through the trying on process with her.  I found it very difficult to manuver the plastic slide latches on the side.  I think that it is very hard to slide it together with a moving baby.  And my daughter hated the very small and cramped arm holes.  I ended up with the "6 Position" chest carrier made by Infantino.  Babies\'R\'Us doesn\'t carry this brand, but I got mine at Walmart.  It was very soft, and has many different options.  And there is plenty of room for little arms.

name: New Kushies Newborn Baby Assorted 6 pc. Diaper Set
review: Loved using these as burp cloths!  They are most absorbant after being washed a few times, which is the same as most cloth diapers.  I am tempted to use them as inserts for my pocket diapers, but I think I will save them for burp clothes to use again with #2!

name: 4 Piece Kimono Gift Set in Pastel
Planets & Supernova
review: While this came in great condition, it does not stay on the ceiling very well. Product comes loose and drops to the floor. For the price I don\'t think it was worth the cost.Needs to come up with a better way to put them up and keep them there.

name: Planets & Supernova
review: Our son has been very happy with his glow in the dark planets and stars.  Thank you for coming thru for us on behalf of Santa.  We had been dropped in the dirt by another provider.

name: Wamsutta Striped Shawl Blanket
review: I ordered 2 of these: 1 for the baby-on-the-way, and one for my 9 month old. I was very pleased with the quality! They aren\'t as thin as I was scared they would be. They\'re thick, and sturdy. The first thing my 9 month old did was yank on the fringe strings, and not one came loose, so that\'s a plus for me! Most of her blankets have snags and runs in them from her pulling the threads! And the photos don\'t do these justice, they are just gorgeous! They have pastel pink, yellow, blue, and mint green stripes spaced nicely throughout. I didn\'t have a problem with shipping like the other lady did, though. They came within 5 days...

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: Honestly I can\'t recommend this mobile more highly.  It\'s very odd, but even the youngest baby is captivated by it.  The first time I bought one, I thought - "what\'s the big deal, it\'s a little plastic hanging thing...."  Now I know.  I have three daughters and they have all LOVED it.  I now buy it as my standard "newborn gift".  But it with confidence!

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: 4 mo old is fascinated with this mobile, I am very pleased. I would give it four stars because is it\'s got TOO MANY options, but I can\'t knock it for that no matter how big of a bother it is. When the mobile arrived disassembled, I spent most of my time putting it together trying to pick which disks I wanted! I know that sounds ridiculous but it just means something else (a lot else) to be stored and taken care of. The mobile doesn\'t move which somehow I failed to put together, but the thing is so beautiful. Nice, sleek design, I just don\'t need so many options. I also have their car seat mobile and I am so in love with that too.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: It\'s a stimulating piece of junk. Baby\'s interested for sure, but how disappointing when it breaks upon assembling! One of the arches snapped in two trying to get it inserted. Plus, those flimsy plastic graphic cards don\'t fit into each other nicely, nor can you put them onto the arches easily. My fingers are still raw typing this a few minutes later. Anyway and finally, the clamp did not fit on our changing table. Talk about three strikes.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: We bought this mobile to hang over our 2 month old baby\'s changing table.  The minute we placed it above his head, he was mesmerized by it.  He LOVES it and now his changing table is his favorite place in he entire world.  He\'ll be crying his head off, we\'ll set him on the changing table, he looks up and immediately calms down.  Every morning when he wakes up, we move him to the changing table and he starts laughing and talking to his little friends on the mobile.  It really is quite remarkable.  We\'ve bought another one for his crib now that he\'s sleeping there.  I\'ll try to post a video of him "talking" to his friends on his mobile... so cute!!!  One word of warning, the way these pieces fit together is not very elegant, but you know what?  My baby loves it and doesn\'t care that the pieces don\'t fit quite right.  Don\'t listen to the negative reviews unless you\'re buying it as a gift.  And even if you are, if the gift recipient gives it a chance, I\'m sure their baby will fall in love with it just like my little boy has.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: Seriously, as soon as we put this over my son\'s changing table his eyes lit up and his feet started kicking so furiously it was obvious how much he loved it! We\'ve had it for about 3 weeks now and every single time I put him on the changing table he gets just as excited and smiles at it!Be forewarned, it does not turn so the only movement it gets is from my son kicking which rocks it a bit but that has not taken from his love of this toy! Yes, it is a little cheaply made and if you were motivated enough and had the time on your hands you could make something similar yourself, but I\'m very happy with it overall and my son just adores this mobile!

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: my son can be crying, and when i put him in his bassinet with this mobile and he opens his eyes, it\'s like he sees an angel. he can watch it for literally 30 minutes at a time, talking to it...and the mobile hardly moves or does anything.i have an older son for whom we got an electric mobile in his infancy, and he hated it.  i thought i\'d try this one under the premise that it\'s best not to overstimulate a newborn who was used to being in a womb...and i think it\'s right on.  it boggles my mind how much he loves this but he absolutely does!

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: I just received the Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim mobile.  After much research this was my choice and I am more than pleased with quality and the variety of discs included.Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: We initially got a colorful, big, animal themed mobile, but our baby didn\'t seem to care for it too much. I think it was a bit too much for a newborn. Then I got this one and my 6 week old loves it. He loves the simple, contrasting colors and shapes and can stare at it for about 10 minutes at a time - pretty good for a baby:)

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: I looked everywhere for a mobile that incorporated the black, white, and red colors that are easiest for newborns to see. When I came upon this option, I was instantly intrigued. A few of the reviews hinted at poor quality or disappointment. However, after having this mobile for 4 months, I am completely satisfied! Initially, it took me a few minutes to figure out how to arrange the cards on the mobile. But once I did it, it was easy to do. For months, our daughter has enjoyed looking up at the different designs. As she falls asleep and when she awakes, I often catch her checking out the interesting patterns and pictures. It comes with enough cards to change them out as you wish. Based on developmental info that I read about, I found it ideal to use the cards with simpler black, white, and red designs early on. As our daughter got a bit older, we switched to the cards with more detailed and colorful designs. We have been able to easily detach and reattach the mobile to our pack \'n play (Graco Suite Solutions) and regular crib. It travels easily so we can take it with us and the pack \'n play to Grandma\'s house. I recommend this mobile to anyone looking for a mobile that will interest your young baby! What baby wants to look at the bottom of the feet of tiny stuffed animals on a mobile?

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: Aesthetically this mobile is awesome. It has bright primary colors and my newborn seems interested in it. I\'m not sure it was worth the headache it took to put it together though. It comes completely pieced out and is extremely awkward to handle. I had to be very cautious to be extra gentle when putting the cards on. They are very flimsy and seem like they would break easily. Whoever invented this mobile surely didn\'t have the sleep-deprived parent in mind. I was ready for a nap afterwards. Having said that, I would have been completely satisfied had it come already assembled.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: I love thie mobile. My 3 month old daughter really likes it.She always laughs when she looks at the mobile.But the part to connect mobile to crib looks cheap and weak.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: I bought this for my 7 week old baby boy.  I was skeptical, since it looked so cheap and didn\'t "match" any of the decor in the nursery.  But my baby loves it and will stare and smile at it for extended periods of time!  I love the fact that it comes with interchangeable pieces so I can change it up every week. It doesn\'t rotate or have music, but I actually like that I don\'t have to think about turning it on or keeping it going.  There is usually other music playing in the background anyway.  This has turned out to be one of my best baby purchases.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: We hung this mobile over our baby\'s changing table and he just loves it.  He will go from crying to smiling just by looking up at the mobile.  We change the cards out regularly for a new view.  The cards are a little difficult to change out sometimes, but other than that we love it.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: My 2 month old baby absolutely adores this mobile.  Whenever we put her under it (it\'s attached to her crib, but she still sleeps in a cradle), she stares up at it with great interest.  Even better, it often elicits smiles and laughs!Many reviewers are disappointed that the mobile doesn\'t move, but, personally, I don\'t think that\'s a problem.  Sometimes I move the mobile for her, but it doesn\'t seem necessary.  She\'s perfectly content when it\'s stationary.Here are some of the downsides:1) It didn\'t come with all of the pictures shown :/  We got two sets of the same pictures.  I\'m not sure if this was a mistake or if this is what everyone gets.2) Switching out the pictures is not easy--the holes are small and the cards are not flexible.3) The mounting arm, a huge chunk of plastic, is rather unattractive. It was, initially, kinda painful to install this in my daughter\'s otherwise adorable (and nearly plastic free) nursery. But. . . she does love it, so I\'m over it.It\'s not a perfect mobile, but I\'d still highly recommend it.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: To buy this, I made 2 orders.1st order the product arrived with missing plastic parts so I can\'t put it together.2nd order the product arrived seems opened/used with extra graphic cards in it, which I decides to keep. So that is so so quality control.The plastics feels very cheap, it arrived with curved plastic hanger curved the wrong way, so I had to bent it back hoping I won\'t break it in half, and the graphic cards are just put together cheaply. It works for what it is, but I\'m sure there can be better excution than this.So material wise, the $20 is definetely a ripoff...But it does work as intended for what it is, our 1 month old looks at it with great interest and concentration, so looks like it works as advertised.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: This mobile works wonderfully. Our child is fascinated with it and it keeps him engaged for a reasonable amount of time. However, the plastic feels cheap and flimsy. It\'s quite frustrating to swap the cards on the mobile as well as flipping them.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: my 2 month old son LOVES this mobile.  he used to hate being changed, now with this mobile above his changing table he loves it.  he\'ll start smiling and laughing as soon as we lay him down, and he won\'t take his eyes off of the pictures.  it doesnt move or have sound, but it doesnt matter, this is the best mobile ever.  all you have to do is give it a little push when you lay the baby down and it\'ll sway back and forth for a while.  even when its not moving my son still stares at it.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: I bought this for my son at Christmas when he was 2 months old.  He has really loved looking at it, especially when we make it move.  Unfortunately, it does not move on its own.  Therefore, we had to keep moving it to keep our son interested.  We found that using the extensions enabled us to move it more easily, but we still had to do it ourselves.Some reviewers have found that the cards fall off easily.  Mine was just the opposite.  When I wanted to change the cards around to give my son a different view, I almost had to rip the thing apart in order to get the cards off.  Thus, I decided to leave the rest of the cards alone.We initially used the mobile with the extenders that were supplied with the product.  (The extenders were like links of a necklace that we could clip on between the main arch and the arches that held the cards.)  As our son grew and could reach the cards, we just kept removing the extending links so he could keep enjoying the mobile.  We eventually had to take it down when my son learned to unscrew the knob that kept the mobile anchored to the bed.  (He couldn\'t reach them, so he found another way to get them.)Here is a final list of this products good points and bad points.  For the good: My son liked looking at it, especially while it was in motion.  It was a good distraction when he was crying or doing something we didn\'t want him to do.  I liked the fact that there were cards facing my son as he was laying down in the crib.  (Most mobiles have objects that only face the parents standing by the crib.  What good is that?)  There were extender links that enabled us to bring the cards closer to my son when he was smaller and raise the cards out of his reach as he got bigger.  The cards did not fall off so my son could not hurt himself on them.For the bad:  The cards only move when a parent moves them.  (That was the part of the toy that my son liked best--when the cards moved.)  Motion is severly limited unless you use the extender links.  I found the cards to be difficult to change without ripping up the toy.I hope this has been helpful.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: This is the best thing I got for my child! I received it as a gift and have given it to all my new mom friends as well. It is extremely stimulating and love how engaging it is.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: Our baby has been fascinated by this mobile from the time we brought him home from the hospital. He is absolutely captivated by it.  It was especially interesting to watch him look at it as it spun around and see which images he was most attracted to.  I like that you have the ability to switch out different images so that the baby doesn\'t get bored.  It is a fairly simple mobile, but has a wonderful educational impact that is lost on most other mobiles.One downside is the mobile\'s durability and ease of use.  It can sometimes be hard to attach and reattach the plastic discs, which don\'t really have a mechanism for attachment other than a slit/crack area.  This doesn\'t interfere with the function of the mobile, however.  As with any mobile, once baby can sit up (or reach it), it should be removed from the crib.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: Like many other people in the reviews for this mobile, ours arrived with cracks in most of the plastic cards.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: My wife convinced me to buy this mobile for our baby.  I did and was pleased at first because it comes with a lot of cards for the mobile and seemed simple enough to install.  Unfortunatly the wood on our babie\'s crib is too thick for the hardward to fit through.  The hardware needs a wood a crib that has less than a 3" slat running across the top.  My crib has about 5-6" slats.  Because of this I got a wood router bit and drilled my way to success. I also am not impressed at the quality of the plasic, it seems rather cheapish.  It should work and for the price I really can\'t complain, but I would rather pay a little bit more and get a more quality product.

name: Wimmer-Ferguson Infant Stim-Mobile
review: Along with the LOOK,LOOK! book, this item is a must for all infants. Placed in the bassinet from birth, it can help your child\'s brain and eyes develop normally. Items such as this helped create a miracle in my child\'s vision, in that she was supposed to be blind. I did not know this at the time, and later learned of her visual defects (nostagmus nerve blockage syndrome and weak eye muscles). I had visual stimulation for her as a newborn like this mobile, as well as intervention from many health professionals, all which helped her to develop her retinas and "rewire" her brain.
