Overall, the chair appeared comfortable for my granddaughter, useful and practical when we needed a hook on chair.I am saving mine for her next visit, as she will get a few more years use out of it when she comes and sees her grandma in Napa, California.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: This chair came without instructions and I couldn\'t figure it out.  I wound up giving it away to someone who can hopefully figure it out for themselves.  Even for the the price this was not worth it.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I work in a restaurant, and a customer brought one of these chairs in, instead of using our typical high chairs! We could seat them at any table, since it was no longer a fire hazard and just looked so comfortable! When my sister had her first kid I bought her one, expecting her to use it when she and her husband went out, but she attached it to her counter top at home and uses it every single day! She sends me pictures of Gavin sitting in it all the time, and she absolutely loves it! She says it\'s the best present anyone\'s bought them for him, which makes me feel good because it seems like i never get her the right thing!! (silly sisters!) This is an amazing buy for something that\'s so necessary! The quality is amazing and it\'s so incredibly convenient!!

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I can\'t believe how cheap this product is and yet so functional! It arrived flat packed and was so easy to assemble but came with instructions all the same. Very clever design - the brackets have little protective covers on the end and then you slide them into each other. There is even a little pocket on the back of the chair to store the carry bag, instructions and covers. This is the only hook on high chair I could find that would make it over the lip of my table (3") meaning you can use this just about anywhere. It is easy to clean with a Velcro insert.  The only issue is that my 8 month old is so small I have to put a hand towel under his butt to elevate his elbows above the bench but not an issue for older/bigger bubs.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: While this didn\'t fit on our kitchen table (it was too wide) it works at most restaurants! And lets face it, putting your baby in one of those is just a sticky, germ infested, accident waiting to happen. We use this everywhere we go!

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I bought 1 for 3 different people and it only fits on 1 table! It\'s hard to get on and off also. If your table has any sort of lip on the edge, it likely won\'t fit. It also won\'t fit tables more than 2" thick. It is more flimsy than I expected also. I have a hard seated one that is much better.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: This was an affordable and practical purchase. My daughter fits great in it, and it was easy to install. I can take it off easily too. Messes are great to clean up as well

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: This chair is fairly simple to attach and remove from a table.  However, I put my 9 month old 20 lb infant in the seat and he was visibly uncomfortable.  There is virtually no support in the seat or back of the chair, so he sinks down in it and has trouble moving his upper body around.  He sinks into the chair, and ends up hunched forward.  I might try using this chair again when my son is older and taller.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I like the portability of the Regalo baby high chairs.  I purchased these for my twin granddaughters.They were able to enjoy Christmas dinner at the table with us!

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: The back bar hit right at the back of my daughter\'s head and the seat-belt fell apart the second use when I was buckling my perfectly still sitting baby. It\'s a mess and it doesn\'t travel easy. I went out and purchased a Fisher Price booster after about 2 weeks of having this seat. Haven\'t looked back since.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: We bought this to use at home instead of a bulky high chair.  we have a pretty thick table 2" , and it attached with no problem.  it is very easy to clean.  It is very portable , and comes with a little sleeve to put it in.  We also like it because then it is like our little guy is sitting at the table with us, not aside from us in a high chair.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I bought this to replace my greco high chair because it took up a lot of space. I knew I was going to use it mainly at the house and when we stay with relatives so the 2" max was fine. My baby was 5 months old when we first started using it but I would recommend using it on a baby who can fully sit up (maybe 6 or 7 months) because there is no support. My baby is pretty average size and the chair puts his face just at the ledge of the table. He hasn\'t hit his face yet but it is probably going to happen. I just make sure not to put him in it when he\'s sleepy or mad. I don\'t think it is cheaply made or ugly, it\'s a high chair for under $20, it does what it is supposed to.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: This is an incredible good deal. It\'s pretty safe.The only reason I don\'t give it 5 starts it\'s because it is kind of a pain to take it of of the table and put it back in the carry bag, but other that that, it works great!!

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: The description didn\'t show that the chair only clips on a flat table, not a table with a lip. It didn\'t fit my dining room table which caused me more headaches, shopping and waiting. Frustrating!

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: My husband and I are pretty smart people, but it took us a good frustrating hour or so to figure out how to put this thing together.Works ok, but if it gets twisted around the frame, it\'s not easy to re-arrange.  We keep it open at all times so we don\'t have to deal with it getting twisted.  Works well once it\'s together properly.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: This baby seat was very disappointing.  I was not expecting it to be so complicated and time consuming to attach to the table.  I bought it to take out to eat.  It would be very difficult to handle if you were holding a baby and a diaper bag.  It can only be attached to a table that doesn\'t have a wood piece attached to the table top.  It has be be screwed on to the table also.  I gave it two stars only because the material was sturdy.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I wanted some type of personal highchair to use when dining in a restaurant.Bringing baby in car seat is heavy and takes up too much space. Using a restaurant highchair??? NO WAY!! I shopped for some time before deciding to order one of the less expensive models just in case it might not work out. Well, I am convinced that I got a really great product regardless of price! I have tried it on every type of table and it always attaches safely. Baby loves it because she is at the table with everyone.Now, taking baby out to eat is a pleasure for all of us! I think that this dining seat would be a terrific and useful  gift .

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: Works fine, very reasonably priced.  We only needed this for restaurants and traveling, so we didn\'t see the need to spend morew.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: The seat was difficult to attach to the table, was hard to clean and was messy for the child to feed himself without a tray. It does fold up nicely into the bag to keep at the Grandparents\' house. I would not buy it again.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I highly recommend this chair. You can take it anywhere and it\'s SO strong! I practically stood on it and it wouldn\'t budge. I would get a second one to keep in the car but this thing is so easy to take off and put on that I can just grab it and go out.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: This is awesome, I finally master it after about 5x using it! My son is quite messy and the clean up is so easy, just wipe and air dry! Definitely have recommended to all my mommy friends! :D

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: this seat is great. my 1 year old loves it. she is at the table with us and it is convienient to use. easy set up and take down we use it as our every day high chair and have retired our trusty big exspensive one. the liner pulls out easy for daily washing and i just found out the whole chair can be taken apart and hung in the shower for a good washing in minuts!!!!!perfect product for a germ a phob like me!!!!!

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: You get what you pay. Practical, okay quality, steady, safe, affordable. There are other hook-on chairs out there that are more expensive, but probably better quality. This chair however is perfect for us. Just what I was looking for. I was looking for something practical and affordable to use only for a few months while we are away from home. We have one chair similar to this back at home but of a better quality. I wanted something similar but I didn\'t want to pay too much. I am happy with the product. My baby likes it too! We can all sit and have dinner together around the table.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: It fit the purpose we needed it to fill and will use it often for our little one. Very convenient

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: We take this everywhere!  It\'s super easy to hook onto your common restaurant table.Our table at home has a ledge so we can\'t use the hooks, but the chair isn\'t going anywhere.Has a handy little compartment in the back for bibs.We love it so much, my mother-in-law bought one for her house too - it\'s cheap enough!

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I would go so far to say I love this chair.  It\'s light, making it very portable and easy to take to restaurants, etc.  My problem with this chair is that we have now gone through 2 of them and I\'m not sure we are buying a third (I\'ve found they last about 4 months at our house each time). The latch that allows the chair to break down (and lock back into place) keeps breaking, and I am not that hard on this chair.  I guess you get what you pay for, though.  When it\'s not broken, it\'s awesome.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I have bought numerous baby products and this is the first one I felt strong enough about to review.  We just got home from a restaurant where we used the chair.  Not only is it extremely light, but putting it together and attaching to the table was very easy.  My 7 and a half month hold (who is big for her age) had plenty of room.  The material is very nice and seems very comfortable.  For the money, you really can\'t beat this chair!!!

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: It is a pretty darn good chair. Our boys love getting in there chairs to eat. The only problem I have is the inner liner does not protect enough of the seat so food and dirty paws get on the rest of the chair.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I bought this chair for my 10 month old to use at daycare. Less than 6 months later the stabilizing bar broke. Do not waste your time with this one... go with the similar chair from Chicco.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: Does not fit any of our tables and not many reataurant ones either.  When it does fit it works great but make sure the lip on your table is very small or none at all.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: We bought one of these from BB&B; about a year and a half ago when my now 2-year-old was about 7 months and too wiggly to be fed in her bouncy chair any longer.  We have plenty of room for a high chair, but they\'re just so unattractive and huge that I started looking for other options.  Debated between this and a booster-style chair that sits in your existing chairs and I must say for young kids, this is the way to go!  It sat attached to our island pretty much nonstop until recently when I\'ve decided to move her to a regular chair...now it sits waiting for our 4-month-old to be big enough to use it.  After so much use, the pad is a bit worn but otherwise still looks great.My only complaints are:*It is a PAIN to keep clean - the handles can get filthy since they are right there next to the food, the front strap gets a lot of spills on it, and most of the seat is fabric so it takes a little more than a quick wipe down.  I\'ve thrown the pad in the washer a number of times though, just the straps are pretty much impossible to get completely clean since they are attached to the frame.*It doesn\'t fit on my dining table with a 4" skirt and a 3" lip - I knew that was pretty likely though so I wasn\'t too disappointed, but it would have been nice to eat at our table rather than the island bar.  But I think it would attach to *most* tables.Now that my daughter is older, I\'m worried she is going to dive out of it one of these days (have had a few close calls now that she can undo the straps) & being that it is so high off the ground where we have it, we\'ve moved her to a a regular chair with a booster.  But for older babies/young toddlers, it is awesome & just as nice as the much more expensive ones.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: My neice had a new baby and when she started eating from the table, she remembered as a child that she had a chair that hooked onto the table...we looked and we found one on Amazon.  Great Seller. A+

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I purchased this chair after seeing something similar in a restaurant. My son was about 7 months when we purchased it, and although he was sitting up well he was too short and small for normal wooden or plastic high chairs. This chair puts him up high more even with the table so I can put finger foods and toys for him to play with while we\'re ordering or eating. This chair is also very secure with a shoulder strap harness as opposed to just a lap belt. This chair would also be great for camping with an infant or travelling. The only downside is that it is a little cumbersome to fold up and put back into the travel bag. The material is also somewhat cheap - the same material that collapsible camping chairs are made out of. But for the price this has been a great high chair for us.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: We vist family alot out of town so we needed something that was easy to snap on and go. This does the trick but here\'s the down side- It\'s bulky to travel with. It doesn\'t fold back up into the carying case :(- It\'s not stable on all tables. If your at a table with a wiered ledge it wont click in just right.- Baby can easily bounce around in the seat which just makes me nervous!I find myslef sitting with one knee under him just in case.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I should have taken advise from the reviews that said "It doesn\'t fit most table tops."  First of all, it\'s  NOT sturdy enough to dangle a baby off the side of a table. Secondly, the ONLY table in my house that it would work on was my glass breakfast table, and I for sure wasn\'t going to put my grandson hooked on a glass table top. So ,if you want to save yourself a trip to the post office or wasting your time sending out a review on how this doesn\'t work, please trust me, you DON\'T want to buy this hook on chair.  Lastly, when it arrived it was scratched as if I got a return from some other person who returned it.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: nice little high chair when she was real little but when she got a little bigger and was more figity we stord it and bought a real high chair.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: We use it as a spare baby seat and hang it on our kitchen island so that the baby can sit with us during breakfast. Also used it on our overseas trip. Only thing i don\'t like is that the back cushion doesn\'t stay put and pulls off while putting the baby in the seat.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: My mother in-law has been using this for my son for almost a year now.  It folds up nice and small so it doesn\'t clutter her house but it\'s VERY sturdy on the table.  We use a different product for daily use, but for occasional use I highly suggest this product.

name: Regalo Easy Diner Portable Hook-On High Chair
review: I bought this chair second-hand for my six month old son, and he loves it (whereas he hated the hard wooden restaurant high chairs).  It\'s a great size, easy to use, good color for hiding stains, and comfortable for him to sit in.  Best of all, because it folds up so easily and comes with a carry bag, we can be sure that he doesn\'t get exposed to the germs of every other little kid who frequents the restaurants where we eat!This is an excellent product, and well worth the money.

name: Trend Lab Pique Diaper Stacker  in White
review: This works fine but cannot be washed due to the bottom made of cardboard. Also if you put too many diapers, it does not close well.

name: Trend Lab Pique Diaper Stacker  in White
review: Looks great in my daughters room and it hold so many diapers. Looks exactly as pictured and I recieved it in a great time frame

name: Trend Lab Pique Diaper Stacker  in White
review: Cute diaper stacker for us to tie on the end of our changing table.  It has 2 ties at the top and not just one.  But we are happy with it.

If you\'re searching for an elegant, inexpensive, and virtually instant storage solution for your baby\'s room, look no further.Although the product description clearly states that this toy bag is part of the ABDC bedding collection, I thought that the color of the bag looked sage and that there was no pattern to it.  What I saw in the picture wasn\'t exactly what I got.  The bag has a checked green and white pattern, and the green is a bit darker than the picture looks.  It is hard to see that kind of detail in the image even when it is enlarged.  The product description lacks any mention of the color or pattern.  It also states that the bag features cars and trucks, which is clearly inaccurate.Despite a rather misleading online experience, the bag is still neutral enough to fit into the decor of my baby\'s room, it\'s large enough to hold several stuffed animals that would otherwise take up valuable closet/floor space, and it\'s made well.

This item looks very good and I was going to order it until I looked at the description which says it measures 1" by 1" inch.  this is obviously an error and needs to be corrected if it is going to sell.  I would order it if I need the accurate dimensions.

Bought this item for my child\'s crib but found that it just seemed huge. I decided to return it and search for something smaller in which to place a few toys to keep her occupied during naptimes and in the mornings.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: This is the BEST product for keeping your child warm when strolling around in cold weather.  It\'s like wrapping him/her up in a cozy sleeping bag.  Our son loves it and so do we.It\'s been wonderful for our little boy (bought at 8mo) however he\'s a very tall infant (28" at the time, 30" now at 9.5mo).  I question whether this product will work for him as a toddler since he\'s already in 18mo-old clothing.  This is why we skipped the infant size.Also, don\'t purchase this product thinking it will completely cover your child.  It comes up to their upper chest.  The child will still need to wear a coat/hat/mittens.  The flap does come higher, however our son doesn\'t like to have it pulled up and fights it.All-in-all, this product does what we purchased it for.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: If you need to keep your child warm on those cold days, this product is for you.  It is well worth it.  It is easy to install and very easy to use. Absolutely no complaints.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: We love to be outside and this is the best invention ever. Easy to use, to take in and out of the stroller, and our 15 month old son loves being in it. It is comfortable and warm. We still have him dressed for the outside underneath, just one layer less. The zippers go high on both sides so his arms can stay tucked in and his neck stays protected.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: We love the Bundle Me! Our daughter just grew out of the infant size and we purchased the toddler. We like it for the fact that it doesn\'t completely smother her and zip up to her face! She never liked her arms being swaddled as a new born and this is perfect because it still keeps her body, legs and feet warm, but she can keep her arms out and move them. If it\'s really cold out then we put on a jacket. If it\'s not very cold, then we don\'t have to! Perfect =)

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: I actually bought two of these in the diva urban style.  I have two girls 11 months and 29 months.  It wasn\'t big enough for the two year old it only went half way up her chest.  She is not that big either--- weighs 29lbs.  I really liked the way it looked and the material but for the cost I couldn\'t see keeping it. I don\'t think it would have lasted through the winter.  I wish they would make them bigger.  So I ended up purchasing the Kiddopotomus brand "Go Cozy".  It is not as pretty and it secures with velcro but it is much larger and it goes up to 4years.  It is also much less expensive.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: I have used this for a few weeks now and my 7 month old son is warm and cozy in it while we are walking.  It fit fine on my older Britax stroller and there is definitely room for my son to grow.  I gave it 4 stars due to the obviously somewhat cheap zipper (as mentioned in other reviews) but I have had no problems with it, it just could have been sturdier.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: Love the quality, size, color and ease of use. I was initially concerned that it might not have much room for my baby to grow into and therefore we might only get to use it for 1 season, but it\'s way big! He\'ll fit into it when he\'s 2 years old, and maybe beyond.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: This is the perfect item to keep my toddler warm while on our walks in the winter/fall. I love how she\'s tucked in and cant squirm like with her blankets. I think its a great thickness, however, I live in Southern California, so not sure this would be the only thing you need if you lived anywhere that actually got cold. :)Would highly recommend!

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: This product was recently purchased for my 5 1/2 month old son\'s stroller by my mother-in-law & I love it. I had an older hand-me-down version for his infant carrier but the new ones are better. I love the fact that the new version has velcro so you can easily move it from car seat to stroller or from one stroller to another.I only wish it came in more colors & color combinations.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: I don\'t know how I lived without one before now!  It is so easy to go from car seat to stroller.  Lots of openings in the back for different uses, and is so warm, I won\'t need a snowsuit this winter.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: The JJ Cole Toddler Bundle Me is a great purchase.  My son is 7 month old and just about ready to transition from his infant carrier into the convertible car seat.  The toddler size is a little big for his infant carrier but it fits.  The interior fabric is very soft and keeps my little guy warm on those cold New England days.  I can\'t wait to use it with his stroller for outings on cold days.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: I love this product.  I bought it for my 8 month old grandson it is so cuddlely and warm.  My daughter had been taking him out in a winter jacket and then having to take it off in the car because he was too uncomfortable with the jacket and seat belt.  She would then have to blast the heater to keep him warm.  Now she puts a hoodie on him, wraps him in a blaket to get out to the car and slips him in his bundle me.  It can easliy be transfered into his stooler if going to the mall or any other place you have to stroll the baby.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: This is great- Use it in place of a blanket or heavy pants. This keeps your toddler nice and warm on a cold day.

name: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundleme, Graphite, Toddler
review: I have an orbit toddler stroller and it fits perfectly. Washes easily in the washer. Its great that it zips around so no more blankets dragging on the floor.I had the infant one too for the orbit infant stroller fit great, i loved it.Great for cold winters.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Navy
review: I recently took my car seat to be installed at an inspection site and was told not to use any of these that go inside the car seat between the baby and the seat. They compromise safety. I will be returning the one I got as a shower gift and buying one that goes on the outside.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Navy
review: Has worked well for me.  Still need a hat during cold weather, but otherwise works for basic back and forth travel.  Not really good for extended trips outside in cold weather w/o coat and hat.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Navy
review: I just purchased this for my 2 month old.  What a great investment!  My baby is so comfy in it that he stays asleep for a long time. I no longer have to deal w/blankets like I did w/my 1st baby 2 years ago.  We lost or dirtied her blankets that fell onto the ground.P.S. Don\'t forget to bring an extra blanket for nursing.  I know I did a couple of times.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Navy
review: When picking items out for our twins we came across the Bundle Me It felt so warm and cozy inside almost like a big blanket! So we reg for both a pink for our girl and blue for our son. Im so happy we did. It getting cold here in WI and sooner the snow will be flying. This is already coming in handy. Since me and my husband LOVE to walk on weekends or nights after work we have used this now a few times when its chilly. No need for blankets or jackets. And now with winter right around the corner this will come in great! We take them out everyday to their grandparents home. This will keep them warm and out of the wind. We have the Graco infant carseats, the Eddie Bauer infant carseats and their grandparents also have Graco seats. They fit so easily in all of them. And mornings when i take the babies over i just take them right out of the carseat right in the bundle me. Its just like a big fuzzy jacket, that they can use when they go out with gampa/grama. Its alot easier than trying to get 2 jackets, mittens hats,etc on 2 6 month olds. All around this is GREAT product and im so happy i have them!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Navy
review: This is just a great thing to have when you live in a very cold area (Breckenridge, CO). You do need a winter jacket, but it\'s still easier than wrestling a snow suit on and bundling it up w/ a blanket. I just use a winter jacket and slip my baby into the carseat w/ the bundle me. So easy! He stays warm and I am happy.Living up in the mountains, I haven\'t had any problems when it rains. When it does, I just put it in a dryer. If it gets dirty, I just throw it in the washer. I usually just wash the top part. If I need to wash the whole thing, it\'s easy to take off and put back on.I have just order the bundle me toddler version and hope that it will work as well as when my baby was an infant!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Navy
review: This was by far the best thing I received for my son.  He was born right before Christmas in NYC, where winters can be pretty cold.  All I needed was a I hat on him and he was good to go!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Navy
review: Worked out nice for the baby. But it\'s to bad how fast they grow. Unable to use it very long because the baby got to big for it really fast. Made a great gift though. Thank you.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Navy
review: We purchaced our second Infant size BundleMe because our first one, lent to a friend and was thought to be returned, somehow never showed up again!  We received one for a gift for our first son.  We loved it and used it for the whole winter in his infant carrier and when he out grew that carrier, we used it in his Convertible seat.  The second one purchased for our second son was wonderful for our second son\'s infant carrier because he couldn\'t kick it off and we didn\'t have to add bulky clothes under his seat straps.  But when we moved him to his rear-facing convertible seat, the BundleMe didn\'t allow the straps to move as they tightened and loosened.  The velcro holes twisted the straps so we\'ve quit using it for now.  We loved it for the infant seat though.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Snow
review: Ever since we got the Bundleme there has always been one less blanket to cart around.  The only reason to bring one is if you need to take the baby out of the car seat where it\'s cold enough to need a blanket.  It has kept my daughter nice and warm wherever we have gone this winter, and I will continue to use it for the rest of the winter.One thing to consider, however, as the baby gets a little older, he/she might free his/her arms from the Bundleme, so a sweater might be advisable when the baby is old enough to figure out how to do this.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Snow
review: I was delighted to receive the bundle me for a baby gift but was quickly disappointed when I realized the car seat straps thread through the "fleece."  This can potentially cause problems with getting a snug fit and can increase compressibility in an accident. There should be nothing between your baby and the car seat except for a layer of clothing.  I liked the idea of having a built in blanket but did not want to compromise the safety of my child.After examining the Bundle Me I decided to "cut out" the back panel where the straps thread through.  This allowed me to place the cover in the seat without worrying about having to thread the straps through the thick fleece  Now, my baby is positioned directly on the carseat but is surrounded by the Bundle Me.  It truly is a perfect fit, the straps are not hindered by the bulky fleece and I am no longer concerned about compressiblity.It was an easy enough modification and I wish the manufacturer would adopt this change.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Snow
review: This product was just what my great niece needed.  She was born with spina bifida and snow suits just won\'t work for her.  This was the perfect solution to keep her warm and snuggly.  She loves the feel of it too.

name: Boppy Denim Nursing Pillow for Breast Feeding - "Open Box Return"
review: This is the best product ever... My baby was really chunky since she was born, what it means HEAVY.....While Im feeding my baby I can rest my arms on it....Even works when I need to use my hands in something else (like the phone or something), knowing that my daughters feeding were normally 1 hour or more, and then again 2 hours later!!... Besides it has pockets so you could put the bottle while your burping!!...So, don\'t listen to the people that says that they didn\'t like it... Just buy it, and try it yourself!!!UPDATE ---> Adding to my review, I have to say that my daughter is 25 months old already and I\'m waiting for the time that she would forget about this boppy.  As you can imagine she doesn\'t fit on it since long time ago, but she love it so much that everytime she wants to tell us that she wants milk she goes, get the boppy and sits on it!! She can\'t leave without it!!

name: Care Bear Pillow Case
review: The product washes very well but should have been made of a softer fabric for children.

name: NoJo Baby Cover-Up- Navy Patch
review: Now that my son is bigger this works fine.  At first the hole for his face was too high, his face was in the zipper part.  I couldn\'t use it until he was about 2.5 months old and he is a big baby.  Also the straps on the side don\'t really fit my car seat well.  I had to improvise.  I have a Graco car seat.  But now that his head is higher it works great.  However because the straps don\'t work well for my car seat I think cold air can get in the sides.  What I like is that it doesn\'t take up room inside of the car seat, like others do.  The problem with those, is that the straps in the car seat can get too tight for your baby with all of the cushion inside.

name: NoJo Baby Cover-Up- Navy Patch
review: I never got to use this for my daughter even though she was 3-6 months through the winter.  Every time I tried to use this it tickled the sides of her face and made her want to nurse.  This may not be a problem for a taller baby or a bottle fed baby (I don\'t know) but it never worked for us.

name: Especially For Baby Ear Thermometer
review: I got this product based on the 5 star rating (I didn\'t look far enough to see that it was just 1 person who had rated it!), but this is not a good thermometer at all!  My husband and I both tried it over and over on ourselves, and every reading was different, and way, way off.  The readings ranged from way under, to slightly under, normal temperature.  Very disappointing!  Not accurate at all.

name: Especially For Baby Ear Thermometer
review: I also bought this for my newborn.  It doesn\'t matter how many times I take his temp, it comes out different every time.  NOT WORTH THE MONEY.

name: Especially For Baby Ear Thermometer
review: Absolutely necessary for babies and little ones, it can work on adults too, but it is perfectly sized to fit in those little ears, and you get to know the temp in one second.  It is accurate in comparison to the larger adult ones used on children.  If there is barely a fever, it may not show up on this, but if it is bad, you will know it, when you need to know it!  Great shower/new baby gift.

name: Learning Curve Lamaze - Bright Friends Dolphin
review: My son had this toy its a great cute toy.. very cute too... we loved it so much when justin got to old for it we passed it along to my nephew!

name: Learning Curve Lamaze - Bright Friends Dolphin
review: I have Trotter the Pony for my 9 month old daughter (We got it when she was about 5 months) and since she loved it so much, we recently purchased this dolphin Lamaze toy.  I think the whole product line is great! They are interesting to look at and for such a small object, offer tons of entertainment. They make sounds, have different, colorful patterns all over, have plenty of parts for baby to chew on and all come with a easy hook on feature. I always keep one clipped to my diaper bag and/or my stroller toy bar.  My daughter still squeals with delight when she sees her old friends... can\'t wait to buy Celeste and the others too!

name: Peg Perego Pliko P-3 Classico Stroller - Black Sable
review: This stroller is terrific -- it\'s lightweight, folds easily and compactly . . . yet feel solid and very smooth.  (Much smoother than the Graco Metrolite and much more solid than the Peg Perego Aria).  Definitely worth it.

name: Peg Perego Pliko P-3 Classico Stroller - Black Sable
review: as a new mom i took my time out looking for a stroller that would be the most convinient.i purchased other strollers and had to return then for one reason or another. when i finally tested this stroller out in the store i loved it but wasent sure if it was worth the price. thank god i purchased it, its a light stroller,easy to fold, easy to carry and has great handling. i live in a third floor of a house and its not as difficult to go up the steps with my daughter in the carrier and the stroller. as a new mom i wanted the best and this stroller is top in my list i reallly love it. and since im only 19 i wanted somthing stylish this stroller gets lots of compliments when i go shopping. so overall it was an execelent purchase

name: QUACK PULL A LONG by Applepie Toys
review: Is there any toy out there that doesn\'t require tweeking or repairs either before using it or just after using for the first time?  I had to install new dowels and reglue two of the ducklings so my grandson could use the toy. Cute, but a waste really.  Since kids pull it less than gently, it topples over onto it\'s side and they drag it around the yard.  Better off having the kids pull tin cans on cord around the yard.

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: Well designed, holds all bottle parts without issues.  Variety of 3 baskets fits in both of our dishwashers in various spots, no problems.  Baskets are flimsy but have yet to break and I think is because the plastic is very flexible.

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: I don\'t use the round thing (I guess it\'s for sippy cups), but I use the other two for Dr Brown bottles and Medela pumping supplies.  No complaints so far, it just does what it should!

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: Holds the bottle stuff pretty well, but not everything always gets clean because of the way you have to put things in.

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: We purchased this basket because the one we had with my first child finally bit the dust, but was never quite exaxtly what I needed.  This comes as a combo set of 3 baskets which have suggested uses, but what I really like is that of all of the dishwasher baskets I looked at, I had trouble finding a basket that accomodated everything (breastpump parts, bottle accessories, sippy cups, etc).  While these baskets aren\'t perfect, they offer a lot of versitility.  I can fit Breastflow bottle parts and pumping accessories in these without any trouble.  Most of the previous baskets I\'ve encountered only fit standard sized bottle parts or parts from specific brands.The only feature I wish is contained was a better place to store the straws from the Take and Toss style cups.  These are thin enought that they can fall through the holes unless you have other items in the basket.

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: These things annoy me pretty frequently because of how flimsy they are.  Maybe it\'s by design, but its just weird getting things to snap back together.  Its just cheap feeling... very cheap feeling..Also, one of the containers have this compartment that folds out from the bottom... which is also annoying.  Its made worse because you\'re doing all of this snapping and swinging with wet parts spilling all over the place.  It\'s messy and awkward.The round thing seems to waste a whole bunch of space, I assume its the perfect design for something specific, but I have not figured out what that is just yet.We bought this item to help with Dr Brown\'s bottles, and it does very little to help.. nothing fits anywhere and I\'m always just rigging stuff in there.Save your money..

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: These baskets are great for misc items that we have for our newborn son.  We use for his pacifiers and bottle and pumping accessories.  I would recommend to any mother with small children.

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: As an expectant mother, I have been cleaning all of my new baby products.  I quickly realized that I needed something to put pacifiers and smaller items in, so I could just throw them in the dishwasher.  These baskets are perfect for this.  I bought this product with a drying tree, so I could just put the bottles and products on the drying tree after they come out of the dishwasher, and then I can relax!  These are the kinds of things you never think to register for, but is essential to daily life!

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: maybe the best thing about them is  that there is no metal!  the  last one we had was metal and peeled and made the dishwasher drain a real mess to clean out.  we wash all kinds of things in them

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: I love the bottom compartment of the smaller basket, it fits pacifiers and bottle nipples and they come out super clean! The plastic the baskets are made of is a heavy material, not cheap. Thanks for a great product!

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: I don\'t really like these dishwasher baskets. I also have the munchkin brand, and it is much sturdier. The Lion baskets are not as sturdy, they are flimsy and don\'t close easily due to the flimsy quality. I don\'t even use these anymore because the munchkin is so much better.

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: Good quality and perfect for baby items. Great to be able to wash small items in the dishwasher and not by hand anymore.

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: I like the idea of using this in my dishwasher to keep the baby\'s things separate, but to be honest, I usually on use the bigger basket..

name: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review: So, after a while you get over hand-washing all the kids stuff. This set is excellent, it has three baskets. One small for valves and the such, and it has an apparatus to attach to the rack, to keep it from rolling away. A smaller basket has an under catch for nipples and the such. The big basket has lots of room. Holding up very well, no issues. Made in the USA! Love it.

name: Seat 2 Go Safari Stroller Attachment
review: This does not attach well to my Graco stroller.  I paid $100 for it, was ignored by the seller when I tried to return it, and now I\'m stuck with a product I can\'t use.

name: Seat 2 Go Safari Stroller Attachment
review: I bought this and would like it except it won\'t work on my stroller (Kolcraft Contours Double).  The 3rd stabilization bar that is absolutely important for the standing position, will not attach because the distance is too great and wouldn\'t sit parallel to the ground if I could get it on.  The seat is about 3-4 inches too high for my daughter\'s head to keep from hitting the parent tray.  It\'s a bit of a pain to attach, but not impossible and doesn\'t require tools.  This would be best on a stroller with 2 handles instead of a bar handrest.

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: Works great with our Eddie Bauer travel system! Couldn\'t find an additional base in the stores! Was nice to buy it online with free shipping!

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: This base is not exactly like the one that came with my Safety 1st Designer22 car seat.  The fit is not as good.  I have to really push to get it to latch in.  The plan it to move it to the car we do not use as often.

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: does its job for my daughters travel system the Eddie Bauer Adventurer Sport Travel System, Michelle. It\'s a little hard to snap on but it\'s not because of this base it\'s because of the baby carrier seat because that same issue occures with the one already included in my sport travel system.

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: We own two cars, so it was the smart thing to do to purchase a second base.  It just makes things easier since baby carrier snaps on and its released quickly. (Be sure to purchase the same base or at least one that is compatible with your carrier).

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: Fits my Eddie Bauer infant carrier perfectly. Makes switching between vehicles much easier.  I would recommend to those debating whether it is worth it to purchase an additional base to do so. Much easier!

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: This is a great car seat base that fits a lot of models. I put this one in my husbands car and our carseat fits perfectly. Definitely recommend.

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: I agree with "michfind" (Oceanside, CA United States) 100%!! I also have the Eddie Bauer Travel System in Manchester print and this has worked wonderfully. I had a base in my vehicle and the extra base in my mom\'s car (she watches my daughter) and never had any problems what-so-ever. It was easy to get it in the vehicles nice and tight so you never worried if your kiddo was in properly or not. And it was much easier than having to fasten and unfasten the seat belt each time. This was such a lifesaver for me. My daughter has been in her convertible seat for a few months but I would recommend this base to everyone that has a new little one!! It\'s just so handy!!

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: Love this base tried finding it at the stores no one had or it was discontinued it fit my carrier I had from my other car

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: We have a Safety 1st Designer series car seat, not sure of the model number but it is light blue and gray plaid with hippos by the head rest.  I really like this base. It is so convenient to have one in each vehicle rather than having to constantly move it back and forth.  I actually like this one better than the one that came with the car seat because the LATCH straps are longer. Well worth the money.

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: Don\'t be fooled, this base will not work with any Eddie Bauer car seat. I have the trailmaker travel system and this base didn\'t fit the infant car seat.

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: I was exhausting with switching car seat bases and this seat perfectly fits for the Safety 1st travel system  that I purchased at Target. I received it quickly and it snapped in perfectly for my husband\'s truck. This is a great buy!!

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: It\'s what I expected. My daughter recently had a baby and has an infant seat. Instead of putting her base into my car, buying the extra base was perfect.  Saves alot of time.

name: Safety 1st Designer Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review: My wife an I were looking for another base for our second car. Our son\'s car seat came with only one base. After adding this base it made out lives MUCH easier....we no longer had to rely on one car/person to pick up our son.This base was perfect and exactly what were looking for.

name: Sassy Firefly And Friends Bug Jar
review: It\'s difficult to purchase toys for a baby since they\'re frequently only interested in the box in which the toy arrives!  This toy is reasonable and my daughter does enjoy the "bugs".  She\'s probably a little too young (9 mos) to appreciate putting the bugs into the bucket via the slots in the lid and she really doesn\'t "catch" the bugs using the included net.  But the bugs are a great size and fun shapes for little hands and mouths.  I like that they all have different textures and sounds (rattles).  The firefly is a nice addition, but it is sometimes difficult to get the light to come on (more strength needed than a baby has to whack it against something to trigger the light).Overall it was a decent purchase, but I think more toys should have just a half-step up in quality so that I wouldn\'t worry about the seams/rattly bits when washing them for baby.

name: Sassy Firefly And Friends Bug Jar
review: I was a bit disappointed with this toy because it had great potential but was lucking in certain areas.  The good side is that it is cute and everything can be easily stored in the box.  It can also be used in the bath (if you take out the firefly bug that lights up).  My daughter (15 mo old) generally likes it.  But there are a couple of issues with it:  the handle is not long enough to be of any use; it didn\'t have the blue shovel shown in the picture; the firefly bug works only sometimes, when it hits the bottom really hard.  ALso, I was expecting the top slots to discriminate bugs by size or shape, but that is not the case.  Any bug can fit in any hole, so it misses a good oportunity for extra fun.  Overall, I kept this toy because my daughter liked it a bit and she can use it in her bath, but I don\'t think it will keep her attention for very long.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: This product is an excellent item to place the baby when you must do something else, but my son never lasted too long in it, even after he FINALLY figured out how to jump in it. Now that he knows how to "jump" in the jumpster, he is so heavy (Um...19 lbs?) that he almost touches the floor with his bottom side after the slightest jump. We live in a new house with standard 9 foot doorways. He has to jump in the closet or bathroom doorway! I don\'t recommend this if you have a heavy child, but they say not to put babies in these kinds of jumpers until they have excellent neck control anyway, by which time easily your child is close to 19 lbs...well maybe.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: my daughter loves her jumper, we started using it around 4.5 months. we use it in our tv room which has a double opening so we dont have any trouble with smashed fingers. she is short but chunky, 25" and 17lbs. and we have no trouble with adjustments.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: This is such a great product.  At first I wished it didn\'t have the tray around it, but we connected some linking toys across the tray to the straps for them to play with and chew on and it\'s fantastic.Our twin boys are only 3.5 months - you aren\'t supposed to use this until they are 6 months.  But we tuck blankets around them to steady them in it, and it does wonders for building their neck strength, leg strength and balance.  I DON\'T RECOMMEND LEAVING THE ROOM WITH THEM IN IT.My only complaint is I feel the device which grabs the door should have sturdy rubber bumpers and a stronger spring, so it pinches the wall above the door, more than simply pinching and resting on the door jam.  GREAT PRODUCT - WE\'RE BUYING A SECOND ONE - so both of our boys can jump at the same time.* One reviewer had troubles installing the seat, I did the same thing until I realized what I was doing wrong and it went on in about 45 seconds.  You just need to look closely at the instructions and you\'ll see that you start with the seat part inside out to install it.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: i love this jumper! my daughter is 2 months old and she just love to dangle in it. calms her down from crying right away. i put a little blankwets to help sapport her a little bit.. with the bouncer i got it was very easy to adjust, i dont have to fiddle with it, it just slides up or down. she loves to use her legs. the only trouble i had was it was a little difficult to get the seating attached to the bumper.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: My son loves this jumper.  I wish I had purchased it sooner as he is 7 months old and big for his age.  He stays in it for long periods of time.  I can get all my chores done and he is still happy.  I bought the jumperoo first.  He might have stayed in it for 20 minutes, but didn\'t look exactly happy about it.  I liked the fact that you didn\'t need a doorway for the jumperoo, but it was way too bulky and took up way too much space.  I returned it and bought this jumper instead.  I cannot believe how happy he is now.  He spins and jumps and just has a lot more fun. This is a really great product but it does have one downside.  It\'s hard to adjust to the proper height and get it to stay that way. All in all, I would definately recommend this.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: We got this item as a gift and were excited for our baby to try it. We\'ve known other kids who loved theirs, and parents who gave it high marks. We never got far enough to put our baby in the jumper. The spring-loaded clamp that holds the jumper off the floor is made for doors with very small (and narrow) moldings. We live in a slightly older house with tall moldings, and the clamp would only fit over part of the door frame. Had there been some indication of this on the outside of the box, I wouldn\'t have bothered to waste my time putting it together and would have returned it immediately for a jumper that works. The upside is, having now read the reviews on Amazon, looking for others with this same problem and possible solutions, I\'m convinced not to put my baby in a jumper at all... Too many injuries -- broken legs, concussions, bad falls, etc. I see that most kids love this item without any problems, but I don\'t want my baby to be among the few who get seriously injured.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: Summary:-Good for active babies age 5 to 8 months +-Calmer, more shy babies might be afraid of it-Height adjustment is limited; no seat adjustment-Won\'t work on short doorways-A great way keep your baby healthy and happyMy daughter is 7 months old and has been using this doorway jumper since she was 5 months old.  She\'s a very energetic baby and has been kicking her legs around constantly since BEFORE she was born-- Ouch!  It has been hard to find a way to help her get all her energy out, since she can\'t yet crawl or walk.  In addition, she has suffered from constipation, and the doctor recommended a jumper as a way to help her move her bowels.  This jumper is great.  Her eyes light up when we put her in it, and she\'ll usually spend about 45 minutes jumping around before she gets bored.  That\'s enough time for me and my husband to have dinner together while we watch her bounce!Good features:  A tray that prevents banging into the door frame, easy height adjustment, good solid construction that seems sturdy, very little squeaking/noise, no dangerous small parts.  The fabric pattern is fairly good-looking and won\'t look totally tacky in your home.Problems (Why it doesn\'t get 5 stars):  The only problems I see are (1) it\'s not made for short doorways-- she is getting tall enough that it\'s becoming a problem and (2) the seat is rather roomy, not adjustable, and until recently we had been putting a small pillow behind her back, to prevent her from jostling around.Important:  This jumper is definitely not intended for babies who are not yet good at holding their heads and bodies upright.  If you try to use it with a very young infant (1-4 months), you will both become very discouraged!Not all children will love it:  My sister-in-law\'s daughter has a different personality from my daughter (more calm and reserved), and didn\'t like her jumper at all. She cried every time they tried it.  You\'ll have to be the judge of your own child\'s likelihood to want to jump-jump-jump!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: Wow, we received this as a shower gift and never dreamed how much our baby would love it.  He loves to hop and jump and dance in this thing and can make it turn in whatever direction he needs. So cute! He also likes the fact that it gives him better access to the dog!We love this product!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: Wow. Our baby just loves this doorway jumper. I was a little bit unsure about owning one (worried about it falling off the door frame, etc), but I no longer worry about it\'s safety. Our baby just loves this activity. The tray is a big bonus and I wouldn\'t want to own one without a tray. The fabric seat is cuter in real life than on this picture. Definately a must have for busy bouncing babies!!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: I love the jumper - but there are two things I would change:1. Putting this thing together was a real job!  Simple, yes.  But you\'d better have a steel grip to get those seat rings into place ("no tools required").2. The spring loaded clamp could fit more snugly onto the wall at the top.  (no it\'s not hanging on a narrow wall - standard size)  In other words, it could be *more* spring loaded.Otherwise, great toy.  My son has super strong legs and at almost 4 months, he\'s been ready for this jumper for a month at least - he\'s going to love it!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: This jumper is great for my 5 month old as it has good support and a tray for leaning on (maybe eventually she will want toys on it).  My only criticism is that is difficult to adjust the height and she is already at the shortest length (ie to make the cord short enough that there is not too much weight on her legs).  At just 5 months I am concerned that she will not get much use out of it as she grows taller.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: I bought this to take with us on our trip.  My son loves his Jumperoo, but too big to take with us.  So I tried it out for the first time today and he had huge smiles the whole time, he was up and down SO high, he likes it better than the jumperoo!  He also loves to spin around in it.  He couldn\'t get enough.  But best on an empty stomach-- he spit up 3 times :).  What a great price too!!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: Our son enjoys being in this jumper because he loves to bounce.  I like it because he\'s very mobile and it keeps him out from under foot while I\'m working in the kitchen, etc.  I just move it to where I need to be.  I\'ve read several reviews that were unhappy with the height adjustmant.  Once you figure out how to adjust the strap, it\'s a snap - you just can\'t do it while baby\'s in it.  Now that our son is bigger (10 mos.) the strap does slip as he jumps because he\'s more vigorous in his actions.  I adjust it before I put him in and when it\'s slipped to the point where he\'s too low I figure it\'s time to take him out.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: This is worth it. I haven\'t seen a baby who didn\'t love this. This will buy you enough time to take a shower (hang it in the doorway so you can supervise) or dinner with your family. Alternate this with an exersaucer for a nice change of pace.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: I bought two of these for my 6 month old twins and they both love them.  Attaching the Jumpster is very easy and can be easily detached and put away while not in use.  Initial assembly and adjustments for length are very easy.  I would recommend this product to anyone that has babies that are old enough to hold their heads stable.  It is fun for the babies and fun for the parents to watch them jump.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: Great product, but (even after reading the directions) can not seem to adjust the height for my 8 month old...any advice??

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: Even though I loved this toy as a baby, we too almost returned it because of the not-so-obvious way to shorten the elastic jumper part which is suppose to accomodate taller/shorter babies.  (Our 5-month old baby is taller than most at her age).  So make sure to READ THE DIRECTIONS.Secondly, it is tough getting your child in and out of the seat, but that I feel that is a good/bad feature because at least you know its safe and that your child won\'t be jumping out of the seat themselves!Our little girl has not hurt herself (yet) by pinching her fingers against the doorway, although we have ours set up in a larger "through-way" rather than a regular doorway.I like it better than the stationary "Jumperoo" because it gives her more freedom to turn around and see everything, its much more portable and smaller in size (so you can it bring it to Grammys house), and its slightly less expensive. And most importantly, she loves it! So overall I would recommend this toy even with the two drawbacks mentioned.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: I love this jumper! Both of my kids got a lot of use out of it, enjoyed it immensely, but also got there fingers slammed on more than one occassion between the large, hard tray and the door jam.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: This product is absolutely amazing and I\'ve only owned it since this morning! But it has already kept my son completely occupied and happy...Granted hes 4 months old and anytime he can kick his legs he is happy.  He actually cried when his daddy took him out to change his diaper.  It is so entertaining to see him have so much fun with a huge smile on his face.  Its a must have!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: We can tell that this product gives my daughter a sense of indenpendence. She is able to move 360 degree with it, and jumps when she wants. My husband and I jump with her too. It adds some more fun our family time.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: This item is SO frustrating.  What would seem to be a very easy toy to put together cost me over an hour of wasted time.  The seat was not made correctly and I could not get it to fit on the frame.  I spent a half hour trying to get it on and then a half hour driving it back to Babies R Us.  I am going to see if the store has another one and put it together before I leave the store!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: I have this jumper, just in a different pattern. My son is going to be four months old soon and is VERY tiny. But he is a very active little boy and I knew he needed something fun to do. I didnt want to introduce an exersaucer until about 5 months because its too overstimulating. This jumper is very very nice. I keep his favorite blankets around him and he loves it. He cant bounce too well but he loves the position and if you bounce it for him. It fits in any doorway with a molding over head. It is very very easy to install (took about 25 minutes) and it is very easy to move. Even though it is easy to move, it is very stable. It will not fall and it can withstand even my 2 1/2 year old standing on the seat and "swinging". It is actually very easy to adjust (my friends daughter is 4 1/2 months and a BIG GIRL). My son loves to be in this and it was the perfect solution to my problem. I am also happy that when he does get an exersaucer, we will be able to "rotate" him from jumper to saucer. I cant see anything more you would want in a doorway bouncer, and it is much safer, more comfortable, LESS room, and more fun than the jumparoo!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: this was a good investment my daughter loves it and so do I hours of bouncing and laughter I am satisfied with the purchase recieved it when I was emailed it will come no complaints.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: This Jumpster was a wonderful addition to our baby registry.  We used this with our daughter everyday from the time she was about 5 months until she was too heavy for it.  I always felt she was very safe in it. It was a great alternative to the Jumparoo because it doesn\'t take up any floor space.  I will say that our door trim needed to be painted after we stopped using this due to the fact that the Jumpster would occasionally bump it when our daughter was jumping.  It didn\'t cause any damage though, just needed a little touch-up.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: I dont know why but the same exact jumper can be found at toysrus(the actual store) for $19.99.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: My daughter loves this jumper!  I can\'t believe I waited till she was 6 months old to buy this.  She can spend hours in it if I let her!  It is a really great product and really nicely made.  Must buy for your baby:)  You won\'t regret it at all, trust me!!!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: I was very very leery of jumpers.  Terrified infact.  However, my son was jumping so much in his saucer that I figured I\'d give it a go.  I am so happy I did.  It really does seem very well constructed and my son LOVES it! He is so very funny in it.  He is eight months old and I wish I had tried it sooner. He actually sleeps better since we bought it.I still have to say I don\'t trust it and I am supervising very closely when he is in it.  I am just scared of the thing coming down on top of him because it is so heavy.  I practically hung on it myself with full body weight though and it didn\'t budge, so I do think it is safe.  I do have an old victorian with very big doorway molding though, so I don\'t know about newer homes with small molding.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: This item was a live saver for me.  I put my son in his when he was 5 months old.  He didn\'t get the hang of it until he was 6 months old, but after that... well, he LOVED it!!!  He would stay in it for an hour and a half to two hours sometimes.  He didn\'t walk until he was 14 months old and he stayed in it till then.  As he got closer to walking, obviously he didn\'t want to be in it as much. This product allowed me to have some time to clean, cook, or read a book, all things that are harder to do once the little one arrives.  I give this present, or one similiar, to pratically every new Mom-to-Be I know.  We didn\'t have any casing that we could put this on except for in the back of the house, so my husband put up a temporary board on either side of an opening between the living room and dining room.  This worked great.  My son never had any pinched finger.  As for some of the other comments as to the safety of this product (or similiar ones)... my son would lean back all of the time and he never hit anything or almost fell over.All in all, this is a wonderful product and I plan to use it again if we have another child in the future.

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: My daughter loves this -- and like alot of other reviewers I couldn\'t get it to shorten as my daughter got taller. It\'s very simple and in the instruction manual. If you\'ve lost yours or the product is a hand me down -- go to Gracobaby.com and download the manual. Once I read the instruction, it took all of 30 secs to get it the right height -- and she\'s back to jumping!

name: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review: By the time my son could hold himself up in the seat and actually bounce he was too tall for this!  What a waste of money.  Do yourself a favor and get a freestanding bouncing seat.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: this is a great bottle, as long as you don\'t screw the top on too tight. when i first started using them,i couldn\'t figue out why it kept leaking. so i took a ride to bru and talked to a person reguarding the leak and she said you can\'t put the cover on too tight..you have to put the cover on top of the white piece and nipple and screw them on together...but not too tight..after you learn that, it is a great bottle. we have had no problems since. definitely recommend this product....

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: My son is now 8mos old and has only used the Avent bottles. He was breast fed until he was 4mos old but would sometimes get the breast milk from the bottle. He never had a problem sucking on them. The only complaint I have is the the avent bottles are not a "standard size", meaning most American nipples can be put on a gerber juce container so they can drink straight from the container instead of dirtying a bottle, or you can put the "standard" nipples in a nipple rack for the sich washer with the nipple rings still on the nipple. With Avent bottles you can use a nipple rack but you have to use every other opening in the nipple rack intead of using every hole in the rack because Avent nipples are much bigger that the "standard" nipple. You also have to take the rings off before putting the nipples in the rack. Other than that, my son has never been a spitup baby nor has he ever been colicy. (Of course, I can\'t say if that has anything to do with the bottle or not but you can take it how ever you see fit.)

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I bought these bottles after reading reviews on them and have been pretty happy with them. They have never leaked with me BUT I have never screwed the lid on too tightly. You HAVE to remember that. When you overtighten the lid, the nipple gets distorted and the seal is broken. My husband and others in the family have had this problem. It is probably always helpful to test for leaks (when you test the temp of the milk) BEFORE you give it to the baby, just to make sure.I like the plastic they use. It has always felt extremely sturdy. They are easily to hold (thanks to the curve) and I really like the wide mouth of the bottles which make them easy to clean....and you are pretty sure they are clean!!I bought the newborn starter set and the infant set and together they are all I require for bottles and a breastmilk storage set!! I really like dthat you get the brush, pacifier and two sizes of bottle in the newborn set. Made my life easy.All in all I think they were a great buy and worth it. I would use them all over again and would use avent with my next baby too.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I think these bottles work great.  I did breastfeed for the first four months, but my son always got one bottle a day and he didn\'t have problems going back and forth.  Please note that they do make different nipple sizes which I didn\'t figure out until 4 months and he was much happier when I went with the 3m+ and 6m+ sizes since the milk came out faster.  I\'ve never had any problems with gas either.  Once he was weaned, we started using powdered formula and found that if you get any of the powder on the screw part of the bottle, it would leak, so now we just check that it is clean before we screw the lid on and it works fine.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I am not an idiot and I know how to read instructions but no matter what I did the bottles would often leak and spill all over my son. I think that any bottle that requires that much effort to ensure it works properly is not worth the money.  Not only that but as my son was drinking I would hear the air bubbles which meant that he had to be burped quite frequently.  I threw all of the Advent bottles out and bought the old fashioned Playtex system.  These are by far the best bottles and are the only way to ensure that excess air is not being swallowed by the baby.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I originally bought these bottles b/c they were recommended by almost every breastfeeding person that I asked and since I was planning on breastfeeding I decided to go w/ this starter kit.  I appreciated the variety of things the kit had to offer.  My baby was born prematurely and never really took to breastfeeding but I decided to pump breastmilk and feed it to her via bottle.  I tried several other brands, but none worked as well as these did for her.  I always found myself buying a few more of these.  I have fed my child 6-8 bottles a day using Avent bottles since the day she came home from the hospital and only had 1 incident of leakage and I recognized what I had done wrong and was able to correct the problem w/o further error.  I also use these for storage from time to time w/ the addition of a sealing disc.  It would have been nice to have a couple of sealing discs included in this pack.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I also had trouble with the bottles leaking. It may just be a matter of not having the nipple perfectly centered or the threads on the cap perfectly aligned, but what new mom needs to be bothered with that in the middle of the night?This was my third child and the first time I\'ve used Avent. My baby is 4 months old and I finally just gave up and bought a pack of cheap bottles. The Avent ones are just too much trouble and I didn\'t see any reduction in gas, etc. as advertised.On the plus side the wide mouth bottle is much easier to clean than the other brands.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: In order for these bottles to work the way they are supposed to, you can\'t overtighten them and you have to know that bubbles in an Avent are GOOD!The nipple ring is designed to let air back into the bottle so your baby doesn\'t work against a vaccum, so if you see little bubbles going up the bottle, ITS A GOOD THING!The nipples are hard, but so are mommy\'s!  They are designed to make breastfed babies breastfeed longer! No wimpy babies here!

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: OTHERS HAVE WRITTEN THIS BUT THE KEY TO NO LEAKS (TOOK US 8 ANNOYING MONTHS TO FIGURE OUT)**** DO NOT OVER TIGHTEN CAPS, ONLY SCREW ON UNTIL THEY STOP...DO NOT CRANK THEM FURTHER ********I ALMOST THREW IN THE TOWEL ON THESE...THEY LEAK ALOT IF YOU HAVEN\'T FIGURED THIS OUT. NOW I LIKE THEM AND WILL USE THEM AGAIN.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I used the same bottles for both my boys now and I have never had a leak issue.  I bought new nipples for my second son and have never had a problem.  Yes they are pricy, but I hate the gerber bottle nipples.  The yellow small nipples get all yuchy and wear out easily.  The Avent nipples are great, the only thing is I dont buy all the flows.  I skip the medium flow nipples.  You really only need the slow flow and fast flow.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: We have been using the Avent bottles for our son, and have never encountered the leaking problems that others refer to.  We have been extremely happy with them.  The best way to put the tops on is mentioned right in the instructions.  Put the cap on and tighten only as much as you can by turning the cap.  Don\'t tighten the whole top.  I would recommend them.  Good Luck!

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I am not impressed by these bottles. Yeah they work and I guess get the job done. However, they DO leak and are not breastfed baby compatible no moatter how they are advertised. My son will drink from them when he HAS too but never is happy afterwards due to the gas it causes in him. I am not looking for a better option. I am glad they were a gift and I did not spend any money on them.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: DON\'T WAIST YOUR MONEY.  THE BOTTLES LEAK!!!  I CALLED THE COMPANY AND THEY SAID IT WAS MY FAULT.  THEY SAID I PUT THE TOP ON TOO TIGHT.  THEY TOLD ME TO SELL MY BOTTLES TO A COMPANY CALLED "ONCE UPON A CHILD" WEB SIGHT.  I WENT TO PLAYTEX AND I HAVE NOT HAD ONE LEAK.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I used Playtex bottles with my first child with no problems.  I bought into all the Avent hype with my second and bought them.  We hated them.  They were such a huge hassle.  We assembled them correctly and still had leaks.  Over the past two years I have talked with many other moms who had the same complaint and swear never to use Avent bottles again because of leaks.  Wish I had know that two years ago!  We are now expecting our third child and I will go back to Playtex bottles.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I give this 4-star ratings as I don\'t quite like the cleaning brush.  I think the brush could be improved and also include a smaller brush to clean the silicon teats.Overall, Avent is good brand and it\'s \'Made in England\' so quality is better.  It\'s easy to hold, easy to wash.  My baby\'s on it since a few days old as my milkflow came on the 5th day, so we had to supplement her with some formula first (Malaysia is a hot country, so I need to keep the baby hydrated) I find that my baby is able to switch from bottle  without problems, and there was almost no confusion at all.  NO COLIC at all. Most importantly is that there are only a few parts to wash for Avent bottles!!Dr.Brown has got 6 different small parts to wash after each usage, so life can be a havoc if you\'re a busy working mom.  Dr.Brown is \'Made in China\'.  And so is \'Tommee Tippee\' bottles.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I have a 2 mo old son and was so excited when I saw these...no bags and a wide nipple. I am BF but have to supplement w/formula. These bottles leak everytime I have to use one! And It\'s not just me...my mom and my husband have made bottles and they leak for them also. I\'m doing research on which bottles to try now but I will be so glad when I can throw these in the trash..they have been such a waste of money....and formula!

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: We have not had any trouble with these bottles leaking.  Thank goodness as these are the only bottles that my daughter seems to like.  Because of the larger nipples she was easily able to go from bottle to breast with no problem.  I have tried others and not found anything comparable in price or quality.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I debated over which bottles to use for a long time and decided to give Avent a try. I have no regrets. My son is now 9 months old and still using the same bottles I started with. I have had no problems with leaking whatsoever. I\'m just careful not to tighten them too tight, as previous posts suggest and have never had a bottle leak on me. They wash well in the dishwasher, although I prefer to wash them by hand. They\'re so easy to wash by hand - no intricate parts to remove or scrub. I only sterilize them once in a while in boiling water, it\'s not really necessary to buy the steamer that\'s recommended. I use the Avent pacifiers as well and have never had any problems or complaints with them.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I\'ve been reading some of the comments on this page, particularly the ones that state that the bottles leak.  You need to make sure you are using the correct nipple - the nipples for the disposable and the reusable bottles are not interchangeable!  If you have the reusable ones, you need to use the clear nipples, not the blue tinted ones.  If you use the blue ones, the nipple will colapse and milk will spill everywhere.  The instructions state that very clearly.I\'ve had experience using these bottles with 3 nieces and my goddaughter and have never had any problems, nor have their mothers expressed any problems with them.  Avent bottles are the only bottles I plan to use when my baby comes in August.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
review: I was amazed at reading some of the poor reviews for the Avent bottles.  I purchased the Avent bottles for my first child because they attached so nicely with the breast pump and the bottles were good for storing in the freezer.  I was extremely pleased with them.  I never had a problem with leaking or gas.I did hear that some of the other nipples (size 2 and up) can give a faster flow of milk,  so I just stayed with the newborn size and never had any issues.Leaking was never a problem and to be honest,  I never even read the directions,  I just used common sense in assembling the top.

name: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set
