I decided to forego paying over a hundred dollars for a "real" high chair and see if Liam could use this one.  I\'m glad I did...this fit perfectly at our kitchen table, Liam is comfortable and safe, and he will be able to use it as just a booster as he gets older.  I can take it wherever we go.  It\'s the cleanest of any high chair I\'ve ever seen...you just wipe it clean.  One time Liam was sick and made a huge mess, so I just pulled the entire thing off the chair and scrubbed it in the sink - try doing that with a standing chair!!!! I could even use the sink\'s sprayer to clean the straps out really well...those are impossible to clean in a conventional chair.  All my friends with kids have chairs that are completely gross...food stuck in the seats that you can\'t pull out and wash, etc.  This seat, to me, is the most brilliant high chair ever!  I honestly can\'t even think of anything negative about it.We are expecting again, and since we think Liam will be using this as a booster seat for awhile, we are planning to buy another of these as soon as the new baby is old enough to start eating solid foods.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Tray is too small, hard plastic, my littl girl didn\'t act comfortable in it, pretty flimsy as well, over all, a waste of my money.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: As our daughter got older, we started having issues finding a good way to seat her at the table at restaurants.  She was getting uncomfortable in high chairs, so we tried going to restaurant booster seats.  However, most booster seats at restaurants don\'t come with any kind of strap, and she would always try to wriggle out of them or stand up.  Our neighbors had one of these Fisher-Price booster seats and they loaned it to us for a while.  We liked it so much we bought our own.  I don\'t know a lot about other booster seats out there, but this one has a lot of great features.Pros:1. The height is adjustable so we can raise or lower the seat to fit the table.2. It has two sets of straps to attach the seat to a chair (around the back and underneath).3. It has straps to secure our daughter into the seat.  The straps seem pretty nice to me -- there\'s plenty of room for adjustment, and we can get a comfortable fit for our daughter (at least I THINK she\'s comfortable).4. The size of the seat is small enough that it\'s easy to carry it into a restaurant.  All we have to do is ask for a table that has chairs, and the seat is very quick and easy to install.5. There is a tray that comes with it (we aren\'t using it), but it appears to be easy to wipe off.Cons:1. We\'ve tried this seat a few times in booths and had mixed results.  Since you can\'t secure the seat to the booth, it can feel a little unstable, especially if the booth seat is sloped as it goes under the table.  We only tried it 2-3 times, and usually it seemed fine.  However, one time the booster seat was too close to the edge of the booth seat and it started to slide for a second.  Nothing really came of that, but it made us think we might want to stick with chairs.  I think the issue is that you want to move the seat close enough to the table for your child to reach, but then that\'s the area where some booth seats start to curve downward.2. The straps are just made out of the typical material (I\'m not sure what it is) that\'s found on all kinds of baby gear.  They seem durable, but it can be hard to wipe all the food off of them if it\'s dried.  We aren\'t sticklers for that kind of thing, so it hasn\'t been an issue.In case you\'re wondering, I think we used this seat with our daughter starting around 10-11 months.  I\'m sure it would have been useful before then, but we didn\'t know about it.  She\'s 16 months now, and the seat still works for us.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We bought this for my niece (24 lbs, 23 months old -- yes, she\'s tiny) who was visiting us for a few days. It strapped easily to a normal chair. It was easy to assemble and use. The trays fit nicely in the dishwasher (bottom rack, which had the hotter heating element and did not warp during 4 runnings of the dishwaher).

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We love this booster seat!  Our daughter is 8 months old, and we\'ve been using it since her first experience with food around 4 months.  It\'s very convenient and easy to clean by tossing the tray in the dishwasher.  It\'s very secure when attached to our dining room chair, and if we have people over and need to use the chair for an adult it\'s easy to remove the seat and store it somewhere else.  We have also removed the seat and simply put it on the ground if we\'re eating in a different room of the house or someone else\'s house and it\'s a very safe way to keep her secure while she\'s eating.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: It is a good product, sturdy and convenient to bring everywhere.  It went on every chair we tried it on.  I just want to point out a few things about the tray that I am not happy with.  The blue tray is supposed to snap onto one of three sets of little buttons on the chair and the white tray goes on top of it and then the green lid (which is supposed to be a nice idea) on top of white tray.  First of all the blue tray does not go on easy. I have to really make sure I am getting the exact pair of buttons or it either won\'t snap in or will get stuck, this means if the space in front of the chair is not open -- yes there is the table -- you have to hover over your child and really see the other side of the chair when you put it on.  The white tray does not stay securely on top of blue tray and my 9 month old yank it off every time so we have to skip the white tray and use the blue one all the time, which is fine except that the green lid has to go on the white tray. So when we go out we either have to bring the useless white tray in order to take advantage of the lid or just cover the blue tray with food wrap -- that\'s what we do now.  So both the white tray and lid are useless to us.Again this is a good product and I do recommend it.  But it can be better.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I was searching for a booster for our table that would be suitable for a two year old. This one is perfect!! He loves it and it seems to be very comfortable for him. There are 3 height settings which is great for different tables. Easy to clean and they extra tray is nice!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We were lucky enough to have friends who were able to lend us a high chair for the first few months my son began eating solid food. I learned a lot from having a real high chair. First, I learned what a PITA it is to fit a real high chair (of the stand alone, reclinable, padded variety) into a small space and try to maneuver around it. Second, I learned how incredibly annoying it is to clean crusted and dried carrot puree from the grooves in said high chair\'s seat, legs, and tray.Enter the Fisher Price Booster Seat. I\'m docking a star because you might as well forget about the dishwasher safe tray. I was never able to use it without having it end up on the floor - it simply doesn\'t snap in firmly enough. However, for a simple to use, easy to clean, no fuss seat, this is a winner. After a meal, I take a couple baby wipes and clean off the little guy\'s hands and mouth. Then I snap off the tray, pop him on the floor, take another wipe and wipe off the seat. Brush/wipe off the tray, and you\'re done! No more lugging your huge, folding high chair outside to hose it down. No more digging around the grooves of collapsing legs for crumbs.The booster seat is also convenient enough for us to take with us to restaurants that don\'t have their own high chairs. Set up in seconds. And since the back and tray are both removable, I\'ll be using it for years to come! Truly a great product.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This little seat is great. It fits nicely into the kitchen chair and he seems comfortable in it. I only have two complaints, the tray is easily removed and contents flipped out by the baby, and he turns and sticks his arm throught the hole in the back and gets his arm stuck. Otherwise, it is the best chair of the three that I have had.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I own two of these seats and highly recommend them to any other parents.  We use one with our two-year-old without the tray - just pulled up to our table. The other we use with our 7-month old.  The only reason I didn\'t give this five stars is because the chair doesn\'t recline - so your baby needs to be able to sit up in the chair to use - which was around 6 months with my son. I still often roll a small burp cloth behind him to cushion him.With our first child, I made the mistake of buying a high chair. BIG mistake! It took up so much space and was such a pain to clean. With our second, I used a bouncer or our BUMBO chair to feed him for that short period of time before he was ready to sit in the Healthy Care seat.***WARNING - The orange/yellow version of this chair is NOT height adjustable like the blue/green one.  (That\'s why it\'s cheaper.) The NON-adjustable seat was too high and didn\'t fit under our table.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Works great! Easy to clean, easy to use and easy to take along. I take it with us to church potlucks and my son can eat right with everyone. When he\'s done we just snap the lid on and clean it at home :)

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: i have 5mo old twins and they love sitting in their seats and watching their parents do house work and eat and the big table.  a little low compared to a high chair, but wonderful all the same.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: With our first child we had an expensive highchair that took up too much room. We ended up getting rid of it for this seat in blue. Our son loves it and he can sit at the table with us. With out second we just used her bouncy seat or bumbo until we bought another one. This seat is portable and sturdy when attached to the right kind of chair. The top tray is handy but both of my babies learned it came off pretty quickly. The bottom tray is really easy to wipe down so that isn\'t a big deal to me. I love that I can push the dining room chairs in and the kids chairs don\'t take up any extra room in our tiny dining room. And the pink one is super cute. I love anything pink and girly for my daughter and without being over done this seat is cute, pink and simple.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Thank you Fisher-Price.Good: 1. I can just wipe anything spilled off! (and it comes off without any scrubbing)2. 2 trays just in case one\'s dirty!3. Straps wonderfully to my chairs!4. Turns into a normal booster seat5. Can adjust to different hights6. perfect size for travel (although mine stay home)7. Cheap price!8. They can get in them by themselvesI love it! Thank you.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I originally bought the Safety 1st All-In-One Reclining Booster Seat and used it for almost a year. It was both bulky and very difficult to keep clean. Food was always getting trapped in the crevices, and I couldn\'t always get it out. Disgusted, I decided to purchase this booster seat because it looked easier to maintain. Is it ever! It only takes a few minutes to clean the seat, and the trays fit right in the sink. It also fits easily under the table, allowing my almost 2 year old to eat right at the table with us if we decide not to use the trays. After meal time, I can just push in the chair with the seat on it. It saves a lot of space. We are expecting our second child in a few months, and I plan on skipping the big high chair all together. He will use this seat, or we will get another one if our daughter is still using it. Two can fit in our small kitchen, at our tiny table! It\'s great!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I purchased this chair after reading all of the great reviews about it. We wanted a chair for our 6 month old that would sit in our existing dining chairs and not take up any extra room.I was so disappointed when I got this chair. It\'s very uncomfortable for our baby because its entirely made out of plastic and the back does not have padding. Yes its easy to clean but our baby was fussy as soon as we put him in it.We returned this and got a fisher price space saver chair instead. We are thrilled with the space saver. It\'s so comfortable and alot larger than this chair. The tray is bigger and he loves to sit in it at the dining table with us.I would pass on this chair and if you are looking for a chair for home get the spacesaver if you are looking for a travel chair get a hook on chair.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Good product but it is small. I think my grand son will outgrow it soon and he just turned one.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: It was a shower gift so I don\'t know the quality of the product.  It was on a gift registry.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We bought this booster seat when my daughter turned 1 and we love it.  It\'s very practical and portable.  It\'s also easy to clean.  I wish I would\'ve bought this earlier instead of the big bulky highchair we got.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: What a great replacement for bulky hard to move high chairs! Top two tray parts are dishwasher safe and entire seat can easily be cleaned rapidly.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: It was exactly what I was looking for and would recommend to anyone needed a booster chair. It was clearly a good chair at a good price.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: My daughter owns two of these seats -- one for home and the other for travel -- and I bought one for my home.Having raised my two girls with Fisher-Price, the company has been high on my list of wonderful. The only negative I had about any of their products was their McDonald\'s play/town/set (it was a hand-me-down from a friend). I couldn\'t imagine why anyone would buy a toy that advertises/promotes fast food.  Other than that, I never would have envisioned a negative thought related to any of their products.At 7 months my granddaughter figured out how to remove the dishwasher safe, removable feeding tray from her F-P Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat -- and is wildly excited and happy when she is given the opportunity to again experience the thrill of detachment. So, at this point, that feature of the product is useless.I would highly recommend these seats, but you may want to keep a roll of painting or duct tape close at hand!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This seat fits and can be secured to almost any chair, and its height is adjustable.  It is inexpensive, safe, easily wiped clean, and has a strap for carrying.  It folds up neatly for storage.  It would make a great gift - baby shower, etc. or for an expecting grandmother.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I don\'t write reviews although I have been very happy with most of my purchases as a first time mom.  But I felt especially eager to write one about this booster seat since I have been through every one imaginable, opened up the boxes and knew from the get go that they wouldn\'t work and just kept returning every one.  Until I bought this Fisher Price booster.  It securely locks on to any type of chair, my son at 6 months old sits straight up in this one, unlike slumping to the sides in the others.  He loves the big tray because all of his toys fit on it and I love that you can adjust the tray to three positions considering my son is a very healthy 21 pound big boy at such a young age.  And to boot it folds up so quickly and has a strap for you to take it any where with you, not like the others that are in 2 or 3 pieces.  I would HIGHLY recommend this booster to first time moms who do not have the time to go back and forth to stores returning 5 other ones (like I did).  I\'ll save you the time so you can spend those precious moments with your son or daughter.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Our dining table is custom built at a height between standard and bar table height, which made choosing a traditional high chair difficult.  This Fisher-Price chair was a fantastic compromise.  It sits at whatever height your dining chair is and, what\'s even better, it doesn\'t take up extra dining room space as a stand alone traditional chair.  My daughter loves it and it growing in to it with ease!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I was a bit skeptical because of the number of choices but bought this one because it adjusted. We are very happy with it because it allows our granddaughter to sit at the table with us, at the right height and to be safely buckled without having to store a high chair or other large piece when she is not here. It is easy to clean and transport. I would buy it again and do recommend it.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Its easy to use and clean. Compact for a small space or for traveling. Stable on any chair. Shipped in no time.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This booster is supposed to be good for kids up to 45 pounds.  Every day for the past couple days, every time my son (who is only 31 pounds) leans back on this booster the back of the chair pops off.  Not only has it been scaring him when this happens, yesterday it popped off and came back and injured my son\'s back leaving a big red mark.  This chair is dangerous.  We just ordered another booster. We\'ve had the booster for a while, but now my son just started leaning back and this chair IS NOT secure.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We got this for grandma\'s house. It\'s a great price for a booster that can attach to a chair and has a tray. Easy to install/connect to a basic dining chair. We have it on the lowest setting of three, and like that it\'s customizable to table height. We\'ve only used the bottom blue tray, but the white one looks good for an older baby. My concern before buying was whether my baby with chunky thighs would fit, but that wasn\'t an issue. I would give 5 stars if it weren\'t for the fact that one of the back straps came out of the slot really easily as I was putting my baby in it. I wouldn\'t ever leave him unattended - as the directions state - but if it can come out that easily I\'d also recommend keeping a really close eye on - and hand near - baby at all times.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I originally had this sent to my parents\' house to keep and use there. It\'s really easy to set up, the two tray covers are dishwasher safe, it\'s generally easy to clean, and it folds down pretty small. But, it was so great that I ended up throwing it in my suitcase and bringing it home so that I could have it when we traveled elsewhere! Also - for the price??? How can you beat that?The one reason that I docked a star is that I wouldn\'t want to use it as our main highchair - there isn\'t a "crotch bar" (I\'m pretty sure that\'s *not* the technical term) attached to the base of the seat, it\'s just kind of molded up, so it wouldn\'t help at all if your child was lunging around before you could get him/her buckled in. Which brings me to my next note - it isn\'t a 5-point harness. For us, for a few weeks a year, these things aren\'t a huge deal, especially for just a few weeks a year. But, for any poor soul who has given life to a houdini, this might not be the seat for you.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I love this chair. It\'s so portable, light, easy to use and convienent. I love that the straps hold everything together for transport plus a shoulder strap to keep your hands free. The adjustable height is great for resturants too. I will definatly be getting another for my 6 month old soon. My toddler likes the fact that I can put it in the living room floor and he can color and watch TV at the same time and I dont have to worry about him coloring on furniture.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I purchased two of these boosters, one for my 2 yr. old, the other for my 1 yr. old., just so I could get rid of a VERY used high chair. Even though both boys are at different stages (and are different sizes), the seats work. It\'s also nice to have them both sitting at the table with my husband and me instead to the side in a high chair, which was taking up too much room. I took the tray off of my 2 yr. old\'s seat so he eats right at the table, and left my 1 yr. old\'s on since he isn\'t as tall. The seats attach securely to my dining chairs, so I\'ve never worried about them falling out when I walk away. Having the option of removing the upper tray to throw it in the dishwasher is great, too. It would be nice if they were just a tad larger and had a higher back. But even so, they don\'t take up much space on the rare occasion I remove them from the dining chairs and place the boys in them on the floor when we have company over. You can\'t beat these booster seats for the price -- I highly recommend them for parents, grandparents\' homes, travel or other times you might want to have an extra (CLEAN) eating place on hand for your baby. I haven\'t had a reason to use the tray lid, but I\'m sure when we travel, that feature will come in handy. By the way, the snap-on tray and straps will even keep a fidgity 2 yr. old in place.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this seat for my daughter 4 years ago, when she was an infant.  She had a high chair, and I thought I wouldn\'t be able to use this til she was older.  I tried it out when she was 6 months old.  It was much, much, much more conveinent than the high chair and it worked just as well.  We still use it today and she\'s four!  When my son was born 2 years ago I bought the same one for him instead of a high chair.  They both use it to this day, and it is one of the best buys I\'ve got so far.  I paid [...] for the last one I bought.  Worth every penny!  Oh and it\'s super portable, we take it to families houses on holiday\'s too!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We were going on a 7 hour trip to see my sister graduate from college when my son was 6 months old, and I almost didn\'t buy this.  He couldn\'t really sit up by himself yet, but with a blanket stuck down beside him he was fine; the pieces on both the seat and tray that go between the baby\'s legs helped keep him upright.  This was by far the best item I have bought; we keep it in the car nearly all the time and have received so many compliments on how useful and compact it is, I HIGHLY recommend this for parents who don\'t want to feel confined to their house around feeding times; now that my son is 8 months and can sit up alone, he can play with toys and eat snacks while we are visiting people, and we don\'t feel we have to hold him all the time.  This is a must have!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this for my 6-month-old son. He is of average size compared to other kids his age, but when I put him in it the tray must be on its last setting or he will not fit. I bought it for the office to feed him lunch, so it does fit nicely and strap to an office chair, but I\'m not going to be able to get a lot of mileage out of it since he barely fits in it.Also, the plastic trays don\'t fit very securely. A 6-month-old baby can very easily pull off the top and spill food all over the place. The white snap on tray is basically useless and all the food has to be placed directly on the larger blue tray portion. Don\'t say I didn\'t warn you!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I have had enough kids in my life to know (now) that buying all kinds of furniture and baby stuff just makes you regret the money you spent/wasted later.  They grow so fast. They\'re using something one day and their done with it the next.  This is a very inexpensive high chair that you can take anywhere easily, clean every inch of (parts go in the dishwasher) and get years and years of use out of.  You have to have room or make room for a regular high chair. This one straps to whatever chair you have. And when they\'re toddlers, remove the tray altogether and it\'s a traveling booster seat!  Cheap price, easy to clean, and years of use!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This amazing booster/high chair lives in our trunk.  When other parents are struggling with their toddlers at a restaurant, ours is happily playing and eating in her high chair, strapped in, with her own tray.  She loves it.  It also serves as a 2nd high chair when friends with kids come to visit.  I give this chair at all baby showers now!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We love this seat.  It is wonderful for eating out or visiting friends.  Easy to clean, carry and set up.  People ask about it all the time when we are out.  You won\'t regret buying it.  Also, my Mom bought a similar seat made by a different brand and although it was cheaper it was much worse... Buy this one!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Used for all three grandsons so far.  Durable, washed nicely, easy to use tray.  Would recommend for anyone to use for feedings and short-term playtime fun.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Love, love, love it!  I have been using my FP Healty Care Booster Seat for about 1 1/2 years now...daughter just turned 2.  Got this for my second child particularly because I LOVED the idea of being able to easily wipe it clean.  It works great!  Easy to clean, easy to use.  I used a very expensive high chair for my first child and it was very hard to keep clean and a pain to use.  Was a bit skeptical that I would be able to use the FP booster through toddlerhood but it\'s worked out great.  Also love that I can slap it on one of my regular chairs at my table...no need for a bulky high chair to take up all that space.  Can\'t beat the price of the FP Healthy Care Booster either!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this booster chair instead of a highchair to save on space, and it has worked out great!  She can use this for years, and the trays wash in the dishwasher, and it was alot less money than a highchair would cost.  I have since bought three more-- one we keep in the car for when we go out to eat, and one for each of the grandparents houses.  It\'s a big help when eating out, as she can sit in it securely, and can play with toys or eat cheerios off of the tray.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Loved this for my grandson. Has height adjustment so you can make is lower as the child grows. Trays come off when using the table instead. Fold easily to transport from place to place

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I LOVE this for my almost 7 month old daughter!  Thank God I didn\'t buy a similar booster product at WalMart for more than double the price!Pros:1. The whole thing is hard plastic.  It\'s ridiculously easy to clean.2. There is a piece on the tray that snaps off and goes right in the dishwasher.  Easy!3. The whole thing is very portable.  We take this to restaurants everywhere.  We have one of those chairs that clips onto the table and this is by FAR a superior product in every way.4. Has 3 height adjustments so this seat will last from first solid (providing you\'re starting at the recommended 6 months.  Probably not good for a 4 month old.) until your child is ready to sit without a booster.Cons:1. The only thing I would change is that the straps to secure baby in are a little scary until you put the tray on.  I\'d really like the waist tethers to be anchored to the back of the seat instead of the bottom.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Love this chair!  My daughter is 1 so the basic high chair is a total mess to deal with. This chair is so easy to clean and she loves sitting with everyone else at the table.  It\'s a great price and easy to travel with if need be.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: It\'s sturdy if you follow the directions it is easy to secure to a chair. My daughter has adjusted well, she seems comfortable and that\'s what matters the most to me.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Like that it\'s all plastic and washable, doesn\'t seem to scratch our chairs.  Wish the blue tray was dishwasher safe, but i think the new vesrion (red and yellow) is.  we dont\' use the green lid or the white tray, just the blue one.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I love this portable high chair. It packs up easily and is very sturdy. It works for having picnics on the living room floor or for eating at any restaurant. Great buy.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this for a holiday trip and had it sent to my mother in laws house. They had it attached to a chair when we got there. My daughter sat in it for every meal. It is easy to use. The white tray does come off too easily, my daughter kept taking it off herself but we just used the blue one mostly. Overall I\'d say it\'s a good buy.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: While on holidays my daughter would never eat that well. As she would often be sitting on someone\'s lap.  Now with this booster seat she is able to have her own tray and eats so much better. It is fantastic to have a lid on it as it keeps the tray clean. It fits on all chairs I have tried that have a back.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I love this portable booster chair.  It\'s so easy to use and wash.  I love that you can fit the tray\'s right in the sink.  Also, love the lid, because we like to take it to our favorite restaurant that doesn\'t have high chairs.  The lid keeps the tray clean when we throw the folded up chair in the car and it keeps the car clean after the tray was used.  Hope that makes sense.  GET IT!  You\'ll be glad you did.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Excellent product. Easy to use. Easy to clean. Durable, expect this chair to last a long time.  Highly recommend this chair, small enough to take with you when needed.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I got this for grandchildren.  I only used the blue tray.  Both the grandkids pulled the white tray off immediately. The blue tray never came off. The seat adjusts to three heights which is great as they grow.  The webbing loops around the front and sides of a chair VERY securely.  I put it on a large kitchen chair that my grandson rocked himself in and he was not able to tip in it. I was even able to put a pillow between the back of the seat and chair.  He loved that. The back comes off too if you want.  I also put it in a large backed barstool that had arms on  and pushed it up to the bar. It is easy to wash.  My 5 year old granddaughter still sits in it to the table to eat and play.  It is perfect for a small kitchen,  It has a 3 point harness seat and you can put a little towel or cushion for small child and I would recommend this in place of a high chair for anyone who wants to save some money.  This has gone through 3 kids with no wear and tear.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Like it got it for my grandson it comes in handy when he here for a day or more days

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We bought two of these for our infant twins, based off of all the positive reviews.  We love them.  They\'re perfect.  Can be easily thrown into the sink or dishwasher.  Even the straps can come out easily to be washed.  They\'re light and we\'d be able to cart them around easily if needed.  I don\'t understand why someone would buy a more cumbersome, expensive highchair?!?

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I did a ton of research before ultimately deciding on this booster and I\'m so happy with it.  I looked at several of the clip on styles but the reviews were so mixed and it seemed like they wouldn\'t work a lot of the time.  If you don\'t know what the table setup is ahead of time you could arrive at your destination and be unable to use your chair.  This booster seat works everywhere, in booths and on all chairs.  It\'s also so much more comfortable and supportive for your little one while still being very portable.  I love that this one has a tray so I know my son has a clean surface to eat off of and I don\'t need to worry about him grabbing things off the table.  It\'s also great for containing food and makes it easier for younger ones who use the lip to pull food against.  Make sure you get the deluxe model if you want the adjustable height feature.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We don\'t have room to keep a traditional high chair "sitting" around, so chose a booster option. Have been very happy with this seat so far (been using it about a month). Like that the tray has a cover and a removable top with "second" tray underneath. For me, this is like having two trays. If I don\'t get the top one cleaned immediately, I have bottom tray for next meal. We put shelf-grip liner under seat b/c this booster is on a wooden chair; works great! As with any baby, our son seems to get food everwhere on this seat. It washes easily, even the straps, as long as you wash as you go and don\'t let "days" worth build up. Again, like this booster very much.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: My son loves this seat! It is easy to clean and install. Definately worth every penny, now my son can eat at the table like a big boy!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I LOVE this chair. We never bought a high chair, just used this all the way. My daughter is now 1.5 years old and still loves it. I don\'t use the other two extra trays since the brown tray is so easy to clean anyways. I take this chair everywhere since my daughter climbs out of high chairs. She stays put in this one. I suggest using this as early as possible so your baby is use to sitting in this seat. This way your baby will enjoy it more and will seat in it longer. I love how my daughter is comfortable in it so she is also comfortable at restaurants. It\'s so easy to clean too! It is definitely one of the best gifts we got. I\'ve seriously considered buying two and putting one in the car so I don\'t go crazy when I forget to bring it out.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I love this chair.. we use it at nanny and poppys all the time as we do not have room for a high chair.. i used it to sit him in at 4mths when he got sick on being on the floor.. i think it has helped him sit up so well at only 5 mths.. i have taken it to friends, and used it on a 6hr train trip.. it was a saviour.. he sits, eats and plays.. well worth having...

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Love this. Low profile enough to easily slide under our table, convenient fold and go feature, cleans easily. Baby likes that he can actually sit at the table next to me while I study or eat, not just in a high chair next to the table. If I want to use it like a traditional high-chair I still can though. Just snap on the tray and use it on its own.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Nice chair for a good price. Colors are neutral and do not clash with my decor. Dishwasher tray is a nice option.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is much better than the first booster high chair I bought.  Attached to my dining room chair with ease, is sturdy and will be useful as just a booster seat when my Grandson is older.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This chair is perfect for grandparents or anyone who has a little one who visits and is eating solid food.The chair is sturdy, fits on a chair easily and is easy to clean. I like it because it doesn\'t take up a lot of room,yet supports my grandson during feeding time. Tray and height are adjustable.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We love this seat, It is compact enough to take to restaurants or anywhere you may need it. Our daughter just loves sitting in it. The tray is really nice and the cover is a great option. I would definately reccommend this seat.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Two words:  BUY THIS!  I have a one-year-old daughter who has been using this booster for MONTHS.  I purchased this and loved it, but we forgot to take it on vacation with us and had to buy a different brand.  I knew we loved this booster, but I REALLY knew it after trying another brand!  In fact, we\'ve purchased one for each car and one for use at home!  We use it instead of a high chair at home, because our daughter seems to like it more, AND it\'s easier to clean!  When we\'re in restaurants, I know she\'s eating from a clean surface, instead of the tabletop, and it\'s so easy to transport.  I take her out to lunch with friends a couple of times a week, and I have no trouble carrying the baby, the baby bag and the seat.  In addition, I have a friend who has a younger baby, and when they came to visit, she felt like her life had changed, because her baby seemed so much more content in this booster than in a high chair.  She bought one immediately!  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: 3 stars for mobility or ease of taking it wherever.Size wise it says up to 50 pound child. My boy isn\'t quite 30 pounds yet and I\'m not sure how long he can use this he is also tall too so it\'s on the last notch for the tray holder spots. Not very big or much room on tray for bowls/plate or cup

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This really is perfect for home and travel to gram\'s house.  We take it everywhere.  Many restaurant\'s high chairs are not always clean enough.  It is easy to adjust the height and adjust the straps for any chair and table.  We haven\'t had one situation where we could use it.  Seat back folds down and has a handle and you can secure the seat table with the straps and everything stays tight during travel.  If you are limited on space, get this over a free standing child high chair.  We don\'t have a child high chair only this and don\'t regret it.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: My grandson, 14 months, uses this chair daily. He is comfortable and safe in it. The cleanup is a breeze. The only problem we have had is that he learned within a week to lift the white insert out and watch the food fly everywhere. Now we only use the blue tray for feeding. Hopefully as he ages, this will cease to be a game and we can use the insert again. I especially like the idea of the of the lid to keep it clean or packed with snacks on a trip so it is restaurant ready.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is great for the price!  My 10 month old uses it at my parents house when he is there...however the removable tray we don\'t use because within 1 use he figured out how to take it off.  Like how it folds up for easy storage/travel too!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We had a big high chair which was great, but we were finding bubby getting too hot sitting in there. We went on holiday and hired one of these booster seats and were amazed at how easy and practical they were. Very easy to clean. Now we have one the old high chair sits in the corner. Our bubby loves being able to sit closer to the table and it will be perfect as he grows. It\'s very portable so great to take away with us on holiday next time!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this because it seemed like every time I took my son to someone\'s house or to a family function I had no where to put him when it was time to feed him.  I was also frustrated every time I took my son to a restaurant and the crouch strap was missing from their chair and he kept sliding out.  I shopped around trying to find a protable high chair and checked many web sites.  I read all of the reviews on the different portable high chairs and this was the only one who had a 5 star rating so I decided to purchase it.  My son loves this chair and so do I!  I take it every where we go including restaurants.  I have not found a chair yet that I can\'t strap this down to.  I love the fact that I can also use it as a booster seat when he is too big to have the trays on it.  It is very light and easy to carry.  I can carry my 10 month son while having a diaper bag strap and and the chair strap on my shoulder.  The only thing is that my son has figured out how to take the tray and cover off and as soon as you put it on he takes it right back off....but it seems to keep him entertained for very long periods of time and he gets a kick out of doing it.  I love this so much and it is such a great price that I have bought it for 4 baby showers since I purchased mine.  They all love it too!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this as a high chair/booster seat for my mom\'s house since I didn\'t want to get a full high chair that took extra space. My mother loves it. My son now sits still and stays put when she is trying to feed him his meals. (She just started watching him full time.) I should have gotten this a long time ago. I like that there are no grooves for food to fall into, unlike the one I purchased for my house. Easy to clean, easy to attach to a chair. Love it!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I purchased this for when my grand daughter comes over and that is regularly. I read the previous reviews and was concerned about the straps coming out. When I received the item I checked the straps and found they are T straps , they could have had a wider tab , but I made sure they where properly seated and strapped her in. I have had no problems at all  this is a great seat that is easy to clean and she sits comfortably in it. We have had this for awhile now and her parents liked it so much they got the same one for home.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: It\'s lightweight and portable. Didn\'t even have to read the instructions to figure out how to adjust anything. The best part about it is the three-piece tray. I love how it can be removed for cleaning and has a snap-on lid to make snacks/meals portable and easy to serve after baby is in the booster.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I used to have a nice Peg Perego high chair for my son. It took up so much space and was so hard to clean that it was a relief to move my son to the table in this booster and pass the PP on to a friend.I\'ve only used the tray once or twice, as my son was bigger when I got this (over 1 yr). But it put him at the perfect height to eat at the table with me every night. Just the tradition I wanted to start early. It straps easily onto a chair and doesn\'t move. Even when he climbs up on it himself, I never have to worry about tipping.Unlike the high chair, food doesn\'t have anywhere to go and hide. It wipes down quickly and if you\'re on the go, it folds up.There\'s nothing I\'d change -- except that I\'d buy it sooner and skip the full-sized high chair.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I love this seat! I took it on vacation with us where I knew we would not be able to have a highchair. The seat attached to a chair at our beach condo and was fabulous. I was not sure how my son would like it since he was just starting to sit up on his own, but turns out he loved it! He was 6 months old when we had to use it and I am thinking about getting rid of my highchair at home because this takes up absolutely no space. I would recommend to anyone! Folds up nice and you can carry it around with the convenient strap. I take it out to dinner with us so my son doesn\'t have to use the dirty highchairs that the restaurants supply. 5 stars easy!!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: this is the perfect little seat.  very compact and portable.  clips onto chairs with two easy clicks.  it slides right under the table like the rest of the chairs if the tray is removed.  my only small complaint is the white tray comes off so easily, my daughter takes it off when she\'s done eating and throws it on the floor.  i\'ve stopped using it altogether until she gets a little older.  i just put her food on the blue part so there\'s no mess on the floor to clean up when she\'s done!  there are a few scratches left on the white part from cutting her food on it so i would advise against that.  but all in all this was a great purchase and i highly recommend it!  it\'s so much easier to clean than the high chair.  just a quick rinse off and wipe down when she\'s done and we\'re good to go.  even took it with us today to get her hair cut.  it was a perfect booster and so easy to grab it and go.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This product is great! It is great for taking to a friend or relative\'s house when there isn\'t a highchair available. It will attach to most any kitchen or dining room chair w/ a back! It sits upright very well and holds the baby in place good, it is very tight and secure if you tighten the straps right. It\'s great for taking on vacation or to a restaurant and it\'s dishwasher safe! The fact that you can fold it up and carry it w/ the strap is great too! Overall I gave it five stars for it\'s saftey, ease of use, comfort to baby, and it looks good too!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this because I needed a high chair for my 6 month old son. I have two older kids and know that those big bulky chairs end up more in the way than anything, so I knew I wanted something like this. I love it. It sits up to the table with the rest of our family, so my son feels engaged with the rest of us. It attaches so easily to the chair and clean up is such a breeze! Great product. Highly recommend to anyone.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this on a whim and wasn\'t sure how often I would use it but this is a new MUST have baby item in my book. I love this thing. The tray with lid is brilliant. I actually keep it in the back of my car and Always bring it in when we eat out or at a family members house. I keep a clean bib inside the tray so it\'s a one stop shop. I have a 1 year old and she loves it.Reasons:1) Super portable and easy to set-up2) The tray piece is awesome and has a lid. You can feed your baby then put the lid on and remove the food part leaving a nice clean tray for them to read/play on. Then if they want to snack again just put back on the food part and pull off the lid.  Then when its all over put nasty bib inside, close lid and bring home to wash.Also for plane travel we have a bag that we ship the carseat in. I just throw this in on top of the carseat.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This product is very easy to put together and my little man loves his new big boy chair. It is very easy to clean and I have already taken it along with me to grandma\'s house!My one complaint is the little dinner tray that attaches to the main tray. I attached it and put my little one\'s food and drink down. Turned around and he took the tray right off and dumped his food everywhere. It only latches on one side (at least mine does, not sure if this is a defect) and my son is able to pull the tray right off. This might be okay for bigger children, but not for my 13 month old. So, as of now, I don\'t even use this tray even if I wish I could.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I absolutely love this highchair!  It fits perfectly on our chairs and you can still push the chair underneath the table.  There are no crevices where food can get stuck into and it is dishwashable.  Only complaint I have is that after it is dishwashed the white part doesnt attach as snug as it did in the beginning!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This chair is a must-have! All of the reviews I read on this chair before purchasing were correct, very easy to clean, portable, lightweight, a great price!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this for my second daughter who was 15 months old at the time.  She is now 2.5 and still using this seat. This is so much better then what we were using prior to this which was one of those high chairs/boosters that hook onto the table. I wish I would have found this when my first daughter was a baby. This booster is so easy to clean.  My husband is notorious for not wiping off the booster after feeding our daughter and I can come along the next day and wipe the dried on food right off this seat. Even crayon has come off easily (with a magic eraser.)  I love how my daughter can be right up at the table with us. I also love the adjustable height on this and it secured to our kitchen chair very well.  All the straps are easy to adjust as well.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: In late June, I ordered this for my visiting grandchild, a six month old boy of slightly above average height and weight for an infant his age.  He is certainly not as big as any one year old  The dinner tray had to be placed on the second of three settings for distance from the back of the seat to comfortably seat him.  The space added by moving the tray away only allows perhaps one inch increments of space.  Since the baby couldn\'t sit up two months ago, and I presume he will continue to grow, this seat will likely need to be replaced by Christmas.  Size aside, the product is well made., light weight, very portable, and mostly easy to clean. The "mostly" refers to the webbing for safety belt, anchoring and carrying straps; which aren\'t removable.  I read another reviewer\'s comment about this and wisely chose a seat with colored webbing rather than white (at least juice and veggie stains will be less obvious).-For other Grandparents;  this is light weight and easy to travel with, How much easier to stow away when the babies aren\'t around than the standard highchair. My only reservation is the size.  When my grandson doesn\'t fit anymore, I will be keeping it for my Grandparents\' loaner network. Ooh, maybe more grand babies?!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I have another one of these we bought a couple of years ago.  We decided to buy another one when our twin boys were fighting over the seats to sit in.  It was slightly different, which they did recognized at first, but at least the no longer fight over which chair to sit in. Helps with the sanity of raising kids C ;

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We looked at many high chairs and finally settled for this feeding chair. My 9 months daughter really loves having her meals sitting on it. Also it has made my wife\'s life easy. It\'s easy to clean, can place it on the floor or tie to a chair. Infact we also take it along with us to restaurants. We highly recommend this. Not expensive and looks good.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is a great booster seat that my infant will use into toddlerhood. She needed a rolled-up blanket to keep from slipping to the side when she first started using the chair at 4 and a half months old. There is definitely room to grow. The chair is easy to clean, attractive and stores away quickly. Sitting on a relatively low chair or couch is better for feeding the baby, but this is a small tradeoff. We take off the separate feeding tray and attach toys to the base tray. My daughter doesn\'t mind hanging out before and after meals. Perfect solution for a small apartment instead of buying a high chair and booster seat later.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Can\'t say enough good about this product - best thing I ever bought!  Easy to take to relatives or a restaurant.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: It\'s great that it cleans easily (no covers to wash), it stays snug on our dining chair and stays out of the way when not in use (won\'t slide under our table with the  tray on but it stays flush with the table enough that it\'s out of the way (unlike a stand alone high chair). It\'s sturdy and my 6 month old sits well on it.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This seat is pretty good for a booster seat.  My only real complaint is no harness so it\'s a little too easy for my wriggling 10 month old to move around.  I also don\'t see it lasting too much longer for her because at the biggest opening its already pretty tight, but she is a big girl for her age (95% for height, 75% for weight).  The removable tray is easy to clean though.  We got this one for Grandma\'s house and its great for that. The other one we have is the Safety 1st version [...] and is not as good.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Traveling to nana and papas house is now wayyyyy easier. No more scary full car full of baby things on the long journey. My daughter really likes this too, she can sit with mom and dad at the pub height table now

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: My sister has two of these and insisted I register for one when my daughter was born.  Soooooo glad she did.  This thing is wonderful.  We\'ve used it since my daughter was able to hold her head up with adequate trunk support.  She is now 16 months old, and VERY tall for her age.  She still fits perfectly in it and will for some time.  My sister still uses the seat portion for her 3 1/2 year old and two year old.  I love having a tray when we go out to eat somewhere so she doesn\'t have to eat off the restaurant table and drop everything onto the floor/seat.  Plus, it has a lap belt which holds her in and prevents her from being able to squirm out and run all over the place....which has happened in the restaurant-provided high chairs.  It\'s super easy to clean and attaches securely to chairs.  I will buy one for my next child as well.  Worth every penny and then some!!!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I was sick of cleaning my adorably vintage, but annoyingly spindly, high chair, I decided to purchase one that was easier to clean and move around. I spent a lot of time researching options of traditional high chairs, and then came upon this little seat. I was immediately drawn to the fact that it wouldn\'t add another large piece of furniture to my house, and that it was smooth, easy-to-wipe plastic. Add in the fact that it is travel-friendly, and it was perfect.I love the fact that the height is adjustable, that it fastens easily and tightly to my dining chair, and that the tray is dishwasher-safe. I do not love that after one use, the safety straps were stained with food. The entire thing is very easy to wash, aside from the straps, which are now green-brown-disgusting. I did purchase Oxyclean per another user\'s suggestion and plan to use it to get them back into shape.Overall, I am very happy with this purchase. My 9-month-old daughter fits in it comfortably, but with lots of room to spare. I envision using this for many years until she is big enough to sit in a regular dining seat, and I would highly recommend this booster to anyone who is looking for an alternative to bulky high chairs.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Really like this booster seat, it fits my daughter perfectly. This booster seat she will be able to use for a while.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is probably one of the best purchases we\'ve ever made.  My 9 month old son fits comfortably in the seat, it is incredibly easy to clean, and it is very secure and safe for him.  We love this!!!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is a great purchase as we have used it so many times traveling to new places and also using it at friend\'s homes who don\'t have kids. It is easy to clean and works as a nice second high chair when babies visit us!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We love this for the grandbaby\'s visits.  We looked at many different seats and liked this one the best with the removable tray and ability to fold up and put away.  The price was comparable to other seats.  It attaches easily to the chair and was very secure.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I love this booster seat i actually purchased 2 of them one for myself to always keep in my car for family visits and one for at my kids grandmothers. I like the fact it is easy to clean with the smooth surfaces and snap off trays. It has height adjustments and takes little to no space. It works well to secure the child in to the seat to a normal kitchen chair you will find in most homes. I highly recomend it and use this as my go to baby shower gift also.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Should have bought this months ago. My 20 month old daughter loves to sit in it, she feels like she is part of the table conversation now, and it is helping her with her table manners. I love how small and compact it is. Easy to clean, wish I\'d never started with a high chair. Love it. Would definitely buy again. Baby 2 is due in 4 weeks, not sure if he\'ll use the high chair or I\'ll just buy another chair!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Small, compact and easy to carry when traveling. Easy to take to restaurants. Easy to strap onto almost any chair. We have definitely gotten our use out of it and we\'re not finished yet. Very happy that I bought it for my grandson.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: As a mom of 4, this is by far the BEST booster highchair!!!! As I start my daycare, I\'ll be purchasing a few of these to have on hand. It grows with the kids to suit their needs.... and yours!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: My baby loves his litle chair. when it\'s time for food, he climbs into it and wait patiently. It\'s secure and sturdy, a well built chair. I\'ll recommend it to other viewers.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Love these.... have one for each baby! Easy set up and clean up.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this because, after two children and two big highchairs, I realized that I rarely used the highchair anyway, so what was the point of having this huge thing taking up half the space in my kitchen? I almost bought the fisher price healthy care high chair, when I saw this at the store. I figured that if I didnt like it, I could always use it for trips to grandmas house. Well, I LOVE it!! It stays on our chair VERY securely, the dishwasher safe tray(s) are great, and I can fold down the seat so that you dont even see it under the table! I put both trays on the bottom rack of my dishwasher with no problems (our water doesnt get to a burning point like some though). It is soooo easy to wipe up after she eats. I also got one of those temperpedic pillow things and cut it down so that it fits on the seat and then made a cover for it out of PUL (water proof but soft). She didnt really seem uncomfortable but I like my babies comfy! I dont think I will even buy a new high chair when the next one comes! I would recommend this to anyone. Oh and my 4 year old DS fits in it perfectly too!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: it secures to the chair. It is easy and convenient to carry anywhere. I love the trays (2). The cover (green) has never been used.I really like that it has levels to put it higher.My baby feels comfortable in it and it is very secure. So that\'s enough for me.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is perfect for my son to now sit at the dinner table like the rest of the family.The tray fits in the dishwasher, plus I can take it with me and not have to use the dirty restaurant ones.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Worked great for our granddaughter.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Great product that works just for my needs. It\'s even low enough that I can still mostly push the chair under the table when not in use.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Love this booster seat. It fits secure to a chair with adjustable straps on the bottom and back, once tightened it doesn\'t move at all. It\'s easy to adjust the height of the seat, it has three heights.  The tray is also has 3 size adjustments giving more seating room as they grow.  The tray is recessed to keep little cheerios from falling off, it also has another tray that snaps on that can be used as they grow, then the blue cover...not sure what that is for.  The chair is easy to wipe clean and the tray can go in the dish washer if it gets real messy.  My darling is a small 6 months and she fit just fine.  This is just so much better then a bulky high chair that just takes up kitchen space!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I took my 13 month old to BabiesRus to see if he liked this booster.  They were nice enough to take one out of the box so that he could actually sit in it in the store.  Good thing they did.  At his one year doctor\'s appointment he weighed almost 24 lbs and was almost 32 inches long.  He took up most of this chair.  The clerk and I both agreed that in a couple of months he would outgrow this thing.  Too bad.  It is probably very nice, as so many of the reviews state, but if you child tends to be big, you might want to try before you buy just to make sure you can use this seat for a while.  We went with another booster in the store and so far we are very pleased.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We bought this product for our first born, then gave it to some friends, who passed it on to their friends when their kid outgrew it. Now we have another baby, and we bought this seat again.It is light weight, hence easy to carry along when travelling. It is sturdy, and very easy to manage.Good Buy at a Good Price..

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is a great chair once baby is able to sit up, it doesn\'t recline at all so I don\'t recommend it for babies who aren\'t sitting yet.This booster is exactly what I was looking for to save space in my eat-in kitchen and to have for outings to restaurants since I\'m not a fan of those wood high chairs most places have with the broken seat belts.  This booster folds into a nice compact square for transporting.  The chair secures to most common dining chairs (not ideal for booths).  There is also the option of raising or lower the legs beneath to help get the right height for the table so baby is part of the family.  You can adjust it so baby is sitting right up to the table with no trays at all just using the lap belt but our baby likes to kick and I bet he could kick against the table and knock the whole chair over if he tried so we don\'t use it that way, when he is older we will most likely use it in this manner as more of a traditional booster.The three trays you see in the pictures really are nice.  The white tray insert fits snuggly and can be removed and placed right into the dishwasher so I use it with the insert most of the time.  The blue tray is harder to fit in the dishwasher but is great for cheerios or playing with toys especially when I am trying to cook and the baby really wants to be able to see me, I just pop him in and place some cheerios on the tray and he keeps himself entertained trying to get them. The green tray cover is great for keeping trays sterile while transporting the chair to a restaurant when eating out and for keeping the mess contained on the way home so you don\'t end up with sweet potatoes all over your car.A final bonus of this chair is that there are no real nooks for food to sneak into.  This is a hard plastic without a lot of seams allowing for easy clean up with a damp cloth.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I love this seat, it is easy to use, the height is adjustable, and it\'s easy to take anywhere.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Easy to operate.  Lightweight.  Easy to clean. Sits on the ditchen counter (secured to a post, of course). Makes baby happy while he learns to self-feed.  What else does it need to be perfect?  Nothing!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I love this product--has three settings for the tray, so will allow for older children to use the tray; very sturdy; the removable tray means you don\'t have to clean the entire tray apparatus after each meal.  The cover works great especially since I have a long-haired large dog, so I put the cover on between visits so I don\'t have to clean off hair before she sits in it.  Great product--would recommend for all ages.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: DID have a high chair. We gave it to our grandson\'s mother. This chair takes up far less room than the traditional high chair.  As grandparents, we had our day of big bulky furniture.  This is great.  It\'s attaches to your typical chair and fits under our kitchen table when we are through with it. Easy to clean too. We highly recommend this product.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: When I started looking for a booster seat for my 1 year old, nothing even compared with this seat.  It is wonderful.  It cleans up so easily!  Even spaghetti sauce doesn\'t stain it!  Although we bought it for home use, it is very easy to transport and we take it to restaurants everytime we go.  No worrying about having to use the dirty, germy ones at the restaurant!  :)  It is so compact it fits at a table or a booth nicely!My daughter is 20 months old now and really likes this seat!  She still uses the tray and fits into it just fine at 25 pounds.I highly recommend this seat.  You will like how easily it cleans up and how portable it is!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I got this a a space saver high chair and the tray is just too small. I use it as a booster for my 2 year old and now it\'s perfect for us.Pros:Easy to wipe cleanNice boosterAdjustable heightCons:The tray cover pops off easily and kids figure it out quicklyThe tray is so small it\'s better for babies or without the tray

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I received this as a gift before my daughter was eating solids. Many of my friends raved about it. I was about to purchase the Fisher-Price Rainforest Healthy Care High Chair for our home (which is also highly rated and seems awesome) and use this chair for when we went out. I\'m glad I read the reviews on Amazon before purchasing that high chair.This booster seat is awesome and you really have no need for a high chair if you want to save the space. With all the baby stuff we have, we didn\'t need anything else to clutter up our place. It folds up compactly so you can easily take this with you wherever you go. My baby seems very comfortable. It is super easy to clean too.It\'s just great. Even if you just get it for when you go out, it\'s a must have. You seriously don\'t want your baby sitting in one of those dirty restaurant high chairs (and the covers for those chairs usually cost twice as much as this chair anyway). And your child will always have a place to sit when you visit someone for dinner, as I\'m sure it safely and securely straps on to most regular chairs. Great buy, great price!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this booster chair for Grandma\'s house, and she loves it! My mother-in-law takes care of our 17 month old while we work and she said it has been wonderful! She puts our daughter in it to color, play with blocks, and feed her snacks and meals. The different trays are helpful and easy to use for someone with rheumatoid arthritis...so amazing! I\'m thinking about buying another one for our house as well!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Easy and versatile, these are great to carry with you and set up in pretty much any chair.  They are easy to wipe down after use and are bright and attractive elements, you won\'t mind keeping out in the open in your eating area.  They seem to be made well and don\'t take up the room a regular high chair does so in all honesty, you can do without one if you have one of these.  With this, any chair can be pulled up by you or at the table and function as a high chair.  My grandson runs to push this over to the table when he eats here - as the chair I attach it to is pretty light as well as the plastic seat so pushing it is a piece of cake for him!  Personally you probably won\'t use the white plastic tray sandwiched between the green cover and the blue tray top. However this piece does have a cup holder built in, but it is not difficult for toddlers to pull the white tray off the blue one (where it has to be attached) while eating and you will have a mess on the floor!  So I never use the white tray. Other than that, this is a handy, travel worthy piece of equipment if you have young children and are on the go frequently.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This seat is great, especially for the price. We didnt want to spend a lot of money on a highchair, and we decided to go with this because it will work as a booster seat at the table without the tray. It isnt as comfortable or easy to use as the 3x the price highchairs, which is what you are paying for. I figure, we seat on wood seats all the time, so he shouldnt mind, and he doesnt.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Good for my 2 year old. Wish to buy it earlier. space-saving boster, better than high-chair at this point.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We\'ve been using this seat for about a month and it is working out fine.  The smaller tray fits in the sink so I can wash or rinse it easily.  We haven\'t traveled with it yet but it is easy to fold up and light weight.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We needed a seat for our grandson when he comes to eat.  This works very well and will adjust as he grows.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I LOVE this booster seat,which I use in place of a high chair because I have such a small house. It is portable, light, and easy to clean. It fits on any chair, and is tight and secure. I would definately recommend!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: My 6 month old daughter loves this chair.  This chair is very practical and perfect for our small apartment.  Its one less baby furniture to move out of the way. Its very easy to clean and we can take it with us when we go out to eat.  Again perfect.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: We have a 6 month old and use this as our high chair. It has been great so far--very easy to use and clean. I haven\'t tried to travel with it yet, and our daughter is still using the tray so I haven\'t tried to push it under the table yet. I think it\'s a great value for the price.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This high chair is wonderful! The tray and chair back fold in to make it easy to take for a trip. The adjustable seat height is nice so that it will work with your table. AND, the best part, it is so easy to clean. In our dining room chairs it is a little low so our dogs get a little closer to his food than I\'d like but that\'s b/c of our chairs and not b/c of this chair. It\'s the perfect seat! And he can continue to use it when he only needs a booster seat.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Everything is so easy!  There are instructions but you won\'t need them!  Each part of the tray snaps on and off easily and intuitively.  The mechanism to extend the legs is also super easy and intuitive.Easy to wipe down.  Minimal crevices for food to get stuck in.This thing is awesome.  I store the trays in my kitchen and just snap the green chair back down after my daughter eats.  This way the chair still fits right under the table like my other chairs.I love it.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I\'ve been using the seat for my 7-month-old baby for 1 month, and I\'m very happy with it.  I love the colors.  It\'s nice see colors rather than pink and blue for a baby product.  It\'s easy to clean.  Everything works well.  So I give 5 stars for design and construction.  I have to take 1 star because 1)I haven\'t used it long enough and 2)it\'s different from the picture on Amazon - the lumbar part of the seat doesn\'t have a hole.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Our home is small and we wanted something that wouldn\'t take up a lot of space.  Our son is 6 months old and he cannot sit up on his own yet, but sits in this seat great!  He is very happy to play in it as well.  This is a wonderful seat, you will be very happy with it!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I am very glad to have bought this product. My baby does not want to sit at highchair since 1 years old, and she was sitting on my lap during all meals. After buying this prodcut, she liked it and she always sits there for the meals. You can wash the upper tray in the dishwasher, which is very convenient.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I bought this chair to replace the clip on chair we had for our first born and reused for our second until the grunge factor kicked in to the point where I couldn\'t stand it anymore.  This is easy to clean (we do not use the tray) and holds him firmly in his chair.  I\'m happy with the purchase and where he is 16 mos old, we will get a lot of use from this.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I\'ve had this seat for a few weeks now and love it.  I\'m so glad it doesn\'t have any material or padding because it\'s so easy to wipe clean as it is and nothing needs to be washed.  Very happy with this booster seat.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: My wife and I have used this seat for our 15 month old son on several trips and have found it to be a solid product.  Setup is a snap and easily adapts to a variety of chairs.  The removable tray allows for easy clean up and the snap-on base tray holds securely when in use.  It folds into a relatively small size that easily fits on the floor in our back seat.  An overall solid product that seems like it will hold up to the use by multiple kids.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: As grandparents, we bought this for use at our home for our 12 month old grandson who we see almost daily. It is very simple to put together and is very secure. It seats him at just the right height and the adjustments avaIlable will enable use for well into the future. We strap it to a chair which is dedicated for his use and can even use it to seat him at the piano to tinkle the keys as well as to cut his hair. Well made, portable and excellent value for money.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I absolutely love this booster!  It works great for traveling, going to friends, or restaurants!!  Very convient, safe, clean and adaptable for different children sizes!  My son loves it!!  Definitely worth the money!

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Instead of purchasing a traditional highchair, we wanted a more cost-effective, space-saving, portable option.  The Fisher Price Healthy Care Booster Seat turned out to be perfect for us!  Our son was able to sit-up supported in this booster seat at 4 months old (a couple months before he could sit on his own).  I was worried that the seat might not be comfortable enough because it has no padding, but our son loves to sit up and join us as we dine without ever showing a sign of discomfort.  The entire seat is plastic, so it\'s easy to clean.  It comes with 2 trays (one dishwasher safe), so there are no worries if you don\'t get one clean by the next meal.  It fits on smaller chairs than theFisher-Price Space Saver High Chair(which is also a good option).  The Healthy Care Booster Seat also weighs next-to-nothing and the backrest folds down- perfect for throwing in the car to take to a restaurant or traveling with on an airplane.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is a great size and must be very comfortable.  My baby girl will not sit still anywhere to eat.  She will run around the room, and come back to the table when she wants another bite.  But when we set up this seat so she\'s sitting about the same height as her mother and I, she sits still with us.  She also loves the tray that we can put her food on so it\'s easily in reach and she can feed herself (and we love that it\'s dishwasher safe).  We don\'t use it as a travel seat (at least not as of yet), but it does fold up fairly small for storage.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This is my best online purchase to date.  My baby loves sitting in his booster.  He knows its meal time when I put him in and I love feeding him in it. It is easy to clean.  It is the best.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: This seat is great.  My son is 8 months and I take this everywhere-restaurants, visiting friends and relatives.  He loves it.  Its lightweight for me and folds easily.  Also cleans very well.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Love it because it is easy to clean, fits on your existing chair so doesn\'t take up more space, portable...basically awesome. And great price, too. I have two of them, one for each baby, and love them.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: Very good, portable, easy to clean and sturdy booster seat. Our little boy is big for his age and felt instantly secure and comfy and I feel will have room to grow in this chair still. We bought this instead of a regular high chair so we could take it where ever we need and not spend quite so much money on something he won\'t use forever. The only reason I didn\'t give it 5 stars is there is a very sharp lip in the back side of the seat area near the child\'s feet. The outer edge is fine, but baby got the back of his heel caught under the lip of the seat and sliced once. We filed it down, but just an FYI. Otherwise it\'s awesome, love the trays and the portability. I would buy it again for sure.

name: Fisher-Price Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review: I\'ve been waiting to write this review until my grandson got to try this out. We\'ll folks, he loves it! The first thing he did was remove the opaque cover and look at us through it. Granted that isn\'t what the cover is intended for, but hey whatever makes the little ones happy while you\'re preparing their food, right?The quality appears to be sturdy and assembly was very easy.
