I really wanted one, but none were in our area intially, but I luckily found one at Walmart (so I didn\'t need the shipping charge).NOTE: It is a little difficult to take off the material, but I recommend washing it after you buy it because the stores don\'t appear to cover them, and they smell a little yucky intially.The 2 stars for educational, is just because all they learn to do is pull open or close the sofa - not that big of a deal to me.Our daughter loves the sofa, and she even pulls it out to lay down.  When we have company, all the children fight over the sofa.  I bought this one because it was asexual.  GOOD BUY!

name: Winnie the Pooh Flip Out Sofa
review: I was reluctant to buy this because it seemed flimsy and overpriced, but the concept was good.  My 2 year old son loved it immediately, but within a few days, the back part of the cushion became detached from the arms and it never folded easily or correctly again.  However, we really did get good use out of it for naps etc.  He finally figured out that the cushions could be taken out and that was pretty much the end of it.

name: Winnie the Pooh Flip Out Sofa
review: My daughter got this for her first birthday.  She is now 2 1/2 and uses it all the time.  I wash the cover weekly and it holds up.  It is just very difficult to get back together but I have to wash it so often with a two year old and a dog.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I just watched this thing fall down our stairs for the 10th time, and it tried to take my wife with it.  In the mounted position, the gate is so wobbly that even the slightest touch by our daughter will cause the side bolts holding in place to cave in and fall down the steps, rendering the gate useless.  The latch mechanism also stopped working after just a few days.  I admit that the opening we have is an unusual size (slightly wider than a standard door opening, but not big enough for the extension provided), but clearly falls within the advertised range.  Unless you are using this with a standard door opening or one with the precise dimension of the extension, not recommended.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: Got this to help block off an area for my 1 yr old to play in. Put it up rather quickly, pressure mounted on the walls, using both extensions and it\'s working like a charm. Initially I had a hard time opening it with one hand because you have to pull the latch and pull up on the gate, but now I have it though I prefer using both hands. It swings shut after you\'ve walked through which is great but when I don\'t want it to close behind me, I just gently stop the gate with my feet. I really like this and for the price it\'s great, the right size and decent craftsmanship.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: It was hard to find a reasonably priced gate that\'s pressure mounted with a door that would also fit our wide hallway. This was just what we needed. It was easy to set up and has withstood our 1 year old son shaking it and hanging on it. He has gotten his arm/legs stuck in it but he does that in his crib too so I would not mark that as something wrong with the gate. Our 5 year old cannot get this open either so it works for older kids as well.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: We bought this extra tall gate for the doorway to our daughters bedroom. We have two major problems with this:(A). If we tighten the sides enough then the gate won\'t close smoothly and if we loosen the sides enough that the gate closes smoothly then she can easily knock it down.(B). My daughter learned right away that if she pushes in the latch with her finger it will get stuck and my wife won\'t be able to close the gate until I get home, take it apart and release the latch.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: This gate works great! We plan on buying another! Although it is pricy compared to those others out there- you get what you pay for- a grand gate that is true to it\'s name- very tall and very secure! I love it. It was easy to install and I love that you can use it either as a pressurized gate or install it as a permanent gate. We have it installed permanently to our nursery\'s doorway and plan on getting another to use as a pressurized gate to move it to other areas as needed in elsewhere in our house. It also comes with the extension parts if you have large doorway (others I learned you had to purchase separately!).We also have LARGE dog- 90 lb Lab. Our other pressurized gate was shorter and did little to hold her weight when she would stand on it with her front legs. I can\'t remember the brand but it was about $30.00 with a plastic grill and center arm that extended. The Sure&Secure; gate holds the weight of our dog and is too tall for her jump over.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: We bought this gate from Babies R\' US a few years ago and loved how sturdy and effective it was. With another baby in the family, I decided I would pull out the gate from my garage to prevent accidents (the gate is still as good as new even though we used it for three kids for two years in a heavily trafficked area, that is the kitchen entryway). Since we are a military family, we must move frequently and unfortunately in one of our moves two bolts were lost from my gate. I wrote an email to the company and explained our situation. I received a prompt reply from a customer service representative telling me that my problem had been resolved. He had already mailed me two bolts at the company\'s expense (i.e. gratis) and was sending me a message to let me know. I was already happy with my gate and now I am an even more satisfied customer, having received excellent customer service. Thank you Summer Infant. I like your products and appreciate your assistance.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: You can pull the gate open while it is latched.  Don\'t was your money on this item, buy another gate.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: Just like in the store at 30% off!!!! This was a great find for the price! We installed it the same day and love it! Keeps baby out of trouble!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: This is really easy to install gate that is also very user friendly for the entire family. I have bought a couple of other gates, and decided to stick with this one. Highly recommend it!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: My only complain is that it is supposed to swing closed by itself, and it doesn\'t exactly do that it will shut some but not all the way so you have to keep an eye on it.  On the plus side once you get the hang of it it is very easy to open with one hand! A very necessary feature!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: This gate was purchased to keep our new puppy out of certain areas of the house.  The height is a definite asset and the self closing mechanism is great.  Other than the initial adjusting, I would rate this a 5 out of 5.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: Bought this because infant gates are cheeper then Dog.  It works great and keeps my two big boys out of my bedroom while I still have easy access.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I currently use this to keep my dogs in one room in the house.  It works very well and is constructed well.I recommend this to pet owners and new parents.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: We bought this gate for are wide opening in our living room, it is nicely made, I love that you dont have to drill holes in your walls. It is super high, it keeps my 22 month old and 4 year old in the room.A great gate for the price I highly reccomend it. I like the way it closes behind you, nice feature.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: we have 2 new puppies and wanted to contain them. the gate is tall and our dogs are small, so thought it might be a waste, but since it was one of the few that fit our door of 28" and the price was good, we ordered. Loved the free shipping and no sales tax! gate is excellent quality and easy to install, plus if we want to move it to a wider door, it came w/extensions. It is white and matches our woodwork, so looks fine. highly recommended!Brenda HallOKC, OK

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: Been using this Gate for a very short time and the plastic hinge is already broken, not happy with it at all!!!!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: We installed this and less than 2 months later both the top and the bottom hinge broke.  Complete waste of money!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I bought this to keep a medium sized dog in a room without having to shut the door. It\'s strong enough to hold his 60 pounds when he stands on it to see what\'s going on in the other room, and the gravity powered auto-shutting gate works flawlessly. The only issue that keeps me from giving it 5 stars is that it\'s secured to the wall with adjustable legs (padded, so they do not leave a mark on the wall), but because of the gate opening, the legs can\'t be adjusted tight enough to make the gate 100% unmoveable. It\'s almost 100% secure, but tightening the legs too much prevents the gate from shutting. I would not use it for a child near stairs, but as I said, it holds up under the weight of a 60 pound dog so it works for me.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: The good news is that the gate arrived undamaged and was in its intended position in about 15 minutes. It is simple to install and while others seemed to struggle with it, I didn\'t find it very challenging. For openings of 29-31, 34-36, 39-41 and 44-46, this gate should work pretty well. Beyond those ranges, the gate pretty much operates at the end range of the tension bolts and perhaps that is why previous reviewers have voiced some concerns about it not fitting snugly for their door. When square, the door closes easily. I\'m using a bungee cord to keep it open. It is sturdy.The bad news is that the company has no pride in their product. Mine, like other reviewers have noted, was dirty AND rusty. Had I bought this at Target, it would have gone back in an instant as it is inexcusable. The black dust covering it came off with a wet sponge. I couldn\'t find anything to take out the rust. And I\'m not just talking about a little rust. There are at least 20 splotches of rust on this gate. Unfortunately, I bought it through Amazon so I would have to cart my behind to UPS, pay for shipping and then buy something else and perhaps pay for that shipping, too. As my dogs are old and I\'m not likely going to use it very long, I\'m just going to keep it and be done with it. That being said, I\'d buy something else if I could do it over again. I only bought this one b/c I had a $50 gift certificate and it only cost me another $10 out of pocket.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: The gate does not swing back, does not close by itself and only the bottom lock works

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: First, From day one it has never latched closed on its own.  Sure, there are ways to do it, but no matter what trouble shooting you do it just doesn\'t work.  Second, The lever to open it has either never connected, or if you screw it in enough to make it work, the pin that is supposed to move in order to do so doesn\'t move so you can close the wretched thing.  On top of it, then only way to get it installed so it kind of works is to rig it so it opens and closed when you lift and swing, which is great unless you have a 3 year old, if you do you may as well not have a gate because they\'ll figure it out in 3.2 seconds.I mean, I guess it\'s great if you want a gate you can\'t open, can\'t close, and is not child proof.  If so, this is the useless gate for you.Garbage.  Thankfully this was a gift.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I have three Sure and Secure Extra Tall gates and a twin that can climb up almost anything (fortunately her brother is more sedentary).  These are the highest gates I\'ve seen and the extra four inches make an enormous difference.  They mean that my spiderbaby can\'t lay waste to the kitchen.  Though I agree with other reviewers that the gates make a little noise (I simply wedge the gates open when not in use), I disagree that they are dislocated from the wall rather easily.  If you install them properly they won\'t.  There are also some permanent fixtures (which I haven\'t used) that come with the gate that you can screw into the wall that make dislocation impossible. I also love these gates because they are elegant and beautiful.  All the other gates you can buy have these revolting grey/blue/peach plastic foot pads or handles that will make your hallways look cheap.  I don\'t want to look at ugly plastic in my hallways--plastic fixtures that were designed by comittees with no aesthetic sense whatsoever.  These gates are lovely and they do what they are supposed to do.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: we purchased this gate to use to keep our puppies out of the other room, and it works great.  it was easy to install, we didn\'t have to put any holes in the wall to secure it (so far).  the only thing, is that it does not close automatically, but that actually works out better for us, as it is then easier to swing open, and we snap the gate in place when we really need it.  one of the bars is not sraight, but it is working fine.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: Manufacturer information states this gate can be "pressure or hardware mounted".  Well, the gate comes as pressure mounted.  There is a notice in the package informing purchaser that to hardware mount you must purchase the hardware separately at their site.  Also, the supposed hardware is only an edged circle that gets screwed into wall and then the pressure mounted circle gets pressure mounted into that.  I thought I was purchasing a gate that could not be removed but that is not the case with this gate.  If that\'s what you want, purchase a different gate.  I\'m returning mine.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I bought two of these to exclude our disabled cat from going up or down a flight of steps while leaving off the solid door.  They work generally well, but the return mechanism broke and now the gates hang open unless you manually stop and pull them shut to latch them.  This is a dangerous situation, because we are frequently carrying things up and down the steps with no hand free to close the door, and the cat wants to follow us.I contacted the manufacturer with my problem and worked back and forth with them through a series of emails and days waiting between.  They had me provide pictures of the unit\'s serial number which required my time to remove the unit and turn it upside down to photograph.  They also asked me to send them a photo of the broken spring so I had to disassemble the hinge and remove it.After I did all these things over the course of a couple weeks, they sent me a short email that they would not provide the springs, would not sell me the springs, and there is nothing they would do further to support my issue.What\'s worse then not supporting the product is making me do all sorts of work and leading me on as if they were going to do something for me, then shutting me down in a short, impolite email.Buyer beware - While this seems like a sturdy product, you are looking at something quite disposable due to some design weakness and lack of customer support.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I don\'t usually write reviews, but I\'m really upset we spend $65 dollars on a gate that fell apart, after the eligible date to return it.  I bought this last June, when my daughter was 6 months, and I didn\'t install it until January.  I\'ve been using it for less than 3 months, and the door broke.  Initially I was really pleased with the products, but don\'t waste your money.  The hinge just snapped off when my husband tried to open it.  For less than 3 months of use that is really unexceptable.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: It is as advertised, with the extensions it worked for us pretty good, it is baby proof. It is tall and when properly installed it is very secured. This is our second gate as the first one did not work, so far it is great!!It was delivered efficiently even though it was Christmas it came after 3 days, thank you!!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: i bought this gate for my puppy boxer, kiefer, so that he could come to work with me. it does the job, the only thing i would have to say is that it wasn\'t wide enough for the walk way we had to adjust it by using a 2x4, the walk way is not that wide so the gate should have been useful on its own this is with extensions.it keeps kiefer where he needs to be and thats all that matters!!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I have 7 dogs (not by my choice, but by inheritance). They are a Maltipoo, a Maltese, Dachshund mix, 45 lb. Lab mix, 75 lb. Pit/Lab mix and two Shepherd mix pups that are taller than any of the others. One of the pups seems to think the Maltese is a rabbit. Needless to say I have to keep them separated. This gate is the first one that I have found that is tall enough that they don\'t jump it. It is strong enough that they can\'t chew through it or push it over. I have also used it with our grandchildren. I can\'t begin to describe the security it brings. It\'s a life saver!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I am using this as a gate for my outside deck. Works great with the thru gate.  WHen I originally ordered, it did state that it had the option to be wall mounted with screws, but it mounts only with the tension knobs, which work great.  It does look like it will rust a bit, but a little white Rustoleum takes care of that.  Not bad since this is meant for indoor use anywayRecommended

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I purchased one of these gates a year ago (2013) and it worked well. We decided to buy two gates this year. Every piece of metal is is thinner (not as strong). All the plastic expansion ends and spinner nuts are much smaller - not as strong and not as easy to use. This is an example of taking a good product and making it as cheaply as possible. Go to your local baby supply store and view this product and the competitors as the quality definitely went down hill for the 2014 model.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I\'ve had my gate at the top of the stairs for a year and a half or so and the safety latch that prevents the door from swinging both ways just snapped off.  I thought this would be an easy piece to replace as it only has two screws on it to remove in order to take it off and could be easily switched out; however, summer infant does not sell a replacement part for this item.  They want you to buy the whole gate in order to replace a small piece of plastic.  Unfortunately, I tried a few other gates at the top of my stairs and this was the only one that fit.  Please keep this in mind before purchasing this gate.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I\'ve had the older model of this at the top of my stairs for my first kiddo and am incredibly pleased with its durability.  So, when we needed another one for the foot of the stairs to keep my super crawler second kiddo from going up the stairs and it works great.  Super sturdy, adjusted to space well, and the auto close is a great feature to make sure baby stays safe.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: We have this gate in a walkway, to divide the kitchen and office areas from the rest of our place. The placement and pressure-mounted spots of the gate take a bit of time wiggling and aligning perfectly, but once it\'s in the sweet spot, you can easily mark the "feet" with a marker.The latches are all plastic on this gate - its fatal flaw. Our 35lb. stepping on the bottom edge of the open gate to try and retrieve a toy was all it took to break the top edge of the gate. I\'d imagine a toddler would break it even more quickly. We super glued and gaff taped the top back together, and 3 months later, the bottom edge completely shattered.This gate might work if it\'s always closed, and perfectly aligned, but if you open/close it on a regular basis, or if there\'s any potential for your child to climb, shake, or try to defeat it, it\'s going to come apart pretty quickly.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I got this gate to keep the dogs in one section of the apartment. I picked it because it was tall & you don\'t have to screw anything into the wall. Another reason I picked it was because it had the auto-lock but that only worked the 1st day. It locks & is very easy to open with 1 hand which I need because I have a newborn but I need to lock it myself, it doesn\'t lock on it\'s own as described.****I\'m happy with this gate but if you\'re buying it mainly because of the auto lock feature, don\'t! That doesn\'t work.****

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: We purchased this at another store, but I wanted to make sure people knew the issues surrounding this gate. We did a hard install on the bottom step of the stairs. Initially this gate seemed perfect and easy for me to use. I wanted Mini-Me to be able to open this without issue and after a few minutes of showing her and practice she mastered it.Less than two weeks later we were having issues. The gate secures at the bottom and top- and the top clasp does not secure itself even when you try to help it. I wish I hadn\'t purchased this gate.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I\'ve gone through several gates. I love this one it is durable, definitely the best gate I\'ve used and could find.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: We have two of these gates at the top and bottom of our stairs (but not positioned directly across the stairs).  My husband wanted something that was not hardware mounted, so we bought this because it was tall and pressure mounted.  The top and bottom adjust individually to accomodate baseboards and in our case, banisters as well. Once you have it in place, it holds well.  You just have to make double sure that you hear the latch click into place.  Our 21 month old is very active.  A couple of times I have not paid full attention when closing and apparently have not entirely closed and latched the gate...the little munchkin was able to pull it back open and take off up the stairs.  So if you are looking for a reliable pressure mounted gate you would do well to purchase this one.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: The gate does it\'s intended job and, most of all, was very easy to install. I\'d recommend to anyone who wants to \'contain\' a toddler.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I\'m very happy with this gate. I liked it so much I bought a second one. It\'s very easy to open (if you know how to--visitors have a hard time with it). I don\'t think the bar at the bottom is a hazard at all. It does clang if you let it slam shut, but it\'s not a big deal to close it gently. If you let it slam all the time, it will eventually get a little out of alignment and won\'t close correctly, but it\'s very easy to fix, and if you use the optional wall mounts you won\'t have that problem at all. It\'s tall enough that my dogs can\'t jump over it, but I can still easily lift bulky things (like laundry) over it. The gate fits in my doorways without using the extensions.I bought this gate at Babies R Us, and it had been opened and returned and was missing the mounting caps and wrench. I was able to install it without these things, but I still wanted to have them, just in case. I called Summer Infant and they sent me a new set of hardware right away. I had it in 3 days. The customer service on the phone was excellent.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: We bought this gate to use across our mudroom doorway to keep our dog out of the kitchen when needed.  It started out working fine and was a good solution.  However after only 4 months of use the plastic hinge on the top of the gate broke.  I tried Gorilla Glue to fix it but this did not hold.  Then I tried using duct tape but this only lasted a few days.  So we are looking again to find another gate that is better constructed and will last when used in a doorway.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I have been using this gate for over two years now and it still works great. At some point the auto-close feature stopped working, but I actually prefer it this way as before it would slam closed noisily if you didn\'t catch it first. It was important to me to have a tall gate as my son has always been 95%+ for height. I\'ve never needed to use the extensions, but I appreciate that it comes with them. My only con is that the bar on the bottom is tall enough that everyone in my family has almost tripped/tripped over it at least once.I\'m a little surprised by so many bad reviews as we\'ve never had any problems despite my son being very rough with it at times. He is 4 now and we still use this gate on our bathroom and he hasn\'t figured out how to open it yet. For comparison, we went through 3 or 4 fridge locks before finding one that he didn\'t figure out how to open the same day. Maybe we just lucked out..This was the first/only gate I got with a door so I\'m not sure how it compares to others, but there are some great reviews that do make comparisons. I don\'t know how I got through that first year+ stepping over gates all the time, definitely worth the extra $$ to get one with a door.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: This gate is difficult for one person to install.  And no matter what I do. I can\'t get it to close automatically.  Not a problem for me - I have gotten into the habit of latching it when I go through it, but my wife can\'t seem to develop the habit, and so, it is left open half the time.  We use it to keep our dog in one room, so it\'s not a safety issue.  But whenever my wife goes out of the room, the dog gets out because she leaves it open.  On the plus side, it opens in both directions.  I just wish I could find a gate that really closes automatically AND opens in both directions.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I used this gate for baby proofing and is easy in and out. I would recommend this product to anyone.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I will say that this gate is the only swinging gate I have found that is secure but my older children can still open it to get through. It also doesnt look as junky as alot of the other ones.However- the actual walk through opening is rather annoying as its very narrow. About 20 inches maybe. My laundry basket doesnt fit through and because of the bottom bar that sits on the floor, it is also harder to get your vacuum etc in to where you want to go. If you are used to moving a pack n play or exersaucer or the like through the doorway, that will be very difficult as well.The height of this gate is 36 inches which makes that even harder since you have a higher gate to lift your things over.That said, the one I just purchased is sitting here- and Im not quite sure wether to keep it yet.You would think that by now some manufacturer could have made a perfect gate.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I thought this gate would be perfect for us.  Unfortunately, I was completely wrong.  The cup mounts (so that it could be screwed into the wall) were not included.  It can\'t be used in a doorway that has moulding along the bottom.  It is extremely difficult to install correctly, and equally difficult to open and close when it is correctly installed.  I certainly can\'t open it one handed, and wouldn\'t recommend it to anyone with kids of varying ages.  It might be fine if you have a dog, as long as it isn\'t a big heavy dog that likes to jump up.  It might also work if you need it in a low traffic location.  However, for us, it was a complete bust!  Thumbs down!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: For the money this baby gate is fine.  It isn\'t the strongest when you add the extensions but it does the job.  I ended up buying a second one.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I love mine and bought a 2nd one. It is durable and has held up over time and easy to move and adjust.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: This gate would be wonderful if it wouldn\'t have come with one of the poles bowed out.  The purpose of the gate is to keep children (and pets) from getting stuck between the poles, but this one may not do that.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: This gate is impossible to install!! My husband installed it and the bottom would not auto latch. You would manually have to put the pin the the hole every time. So he uninstalled and reinstalled it. Five hours later, he is still trying to get it to work. Now it is bowing at the extension!! We are taking this back. Impossible to install!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: Good. Sturdy. Does the job. Works perfect with Y brackets for spindle banisters. Only negative is pulling the door closed after you walk through.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: THe doorway I used it for was either too narrow for all extensions or too wide for one extension.  It did not hold.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: My wife and I have twin boys, 2 dogs, and a lot of traffic with family and friends. We desparately needed a gate that was safe and reliable. We originally had a wooden gate with a pressure arm across it that we would jump over, and it wasn\'t until we both nearly tripped and fell with with a baby in had that we decided to go with a new gate.What made this one stand out was that it was pressure mounted, all metal, no places where a child or a dog could climb. (yes, our dogs could climb the gate.) It was also easy as pie to install, and was adjustable for how much pressure to put on the latch.We moved across country, and I simply firgure that any doorway would be the same in our new apartment. I was dead wrong, and had to order new extensions, because being the genius that I am, I let the extensions go into long term storage. So I called up the company, an they first told me they could only sell me 1 10 inch extender because otherwise it was a safety hazard. When I explained the situation, the nice lady on the phone agreed to sell me 2 extensions, at he least, and even helped me ot by making it shi 2-day air. That is service! Now, that is a company I can trust.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I have two of these gates - used to keep dogs in or out of certain areas. They are fabulous under normal circumstances. However, if a squirrel is spied, all bets are off for the gate staying in the door frame! The gate is flattened, the dogs are off and mom gets to pick up the gate and redo the normally good tension bolts. I really do love them and that is why I bought two of them. I do think they would work better if I had poodles, or chihuahuas - who would not jump them at the slightest squirrel sound, or push them down at the first inkling of squirrel in a neighbour\'s tree. (Of course the little dears, (squirrels, not dogs) know they are not welcome in our garden, so they stay just out of reach to simply  tease the dogs.) If I keep the squirrels really quiet (sure... easy to do!!), the gates are wonderful in keeping my Ridgebacks out of trouble. I am glad I have them and I have since had several dog friends (with better trained dogs) buy them too. Great product!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I highly recommend this gate and have actually have purchased 3 of them, 2 online and 1 in the store. Very versatile with the different width sections which can be added. Really like the extra height as they are being used for a puppy who can really jump!! Also like the ability to swing gate in either direction.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: Gosh, I bought this years ago and I\'m still using it.  Getting ready to move and plan to use it outdoors under an awning.  The extra width will fit there.  Works great!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I\'m very happy with my purchase the gate works exceptionally. I would recommend this gate to a friend if needed.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I got this gate for my grandchildren & also my yorkie that had surgery & is not allowed to use the steps.  This gate worked out great for both uses.  There are two things that could be changed is the opening could be wider & also the latch that sticks out where your purse or pants could get caught.  You just have to be very careful & not in a hurry when you pass through it.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: The top hinge broke after 60 days of use.  Hinges should not be made of plastic.  The company has a 12 month warranty if the gate is "defective in workmanship or materials".  You will need your receipt and will have to pay shipping to mail the gate to the company.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: After pouring through Amazon reviews and scrutinizing the stock at Babies R Us, I finally picked this gate because it seemed to be the only one that truly did not need any fancy installation. It is great. It fits right in the bedroom doorway of our \'50s house. We can open it with one hand, and it swings like a gate. All I had to do was take it out of the box, position it in the doorway, and turn the large screw type knobs with my hand until it was tightened in the doorway. Sort of like giant screw type earrings....Very easy and fast. They enclose a tool/wrench type thing you could use, but I used my hands and it worked out fine. I am going back to buy another for the other bedroom door. It opens like a gate, either way you swing it. You have to step over the bottom bar, but it is only a couple of inches and no problem, even for a klutz like me. I would highly recommend it!

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I did a lot of looking around before buying baby gates; our house has multiple wide openings that most gates do not fit.  However, this one worked well, without leaving marks on the wall/posts.  I love the tall height as well, since my daughter is over the 100 percentile for her height, and want something that she can\'t see over and figure out how to open.  Very easy to open for parents...the only downfall being a small part of the gate at the bottom you have to step over when going through, so you have to be careful not to trip.  Without spending tons of money, this is the most economical while serving it\'s purpose - safety.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: This fits the bill for my 3 month old Golden Retriever, Jack.  I wanted a tall gate cause he\'s gonna be a big dog.  A great feature this gate has is a locking walk-thru gate.  I didn\'t want one you\'d have to step over or take down every time you wanted to get into the area.  You have the option of screws to mount it or tension setting.  The tension setting works just fine.  I would recommend this product.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: could not get gate to stay put - popped out of tension when trying to open ittried on several door entrances and gave up after 2 hours

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I finally got smart with the 3rd child and bought these gates (3 of them) instead of those kind that you push down to lock into place and they fall over, these gates are so secure and really tall, my cats have a hard time jumping over them.  My friend has this gate also and has an 80 pound dog and he hasn\'t been able to budge it.  We have a really big doorway from our hall to living room and we were able to use 2 of the bigger 10" extenders and it fit perfectly.  Each gate comes with a 5" and a 10" extender.I would highly recommend these gates.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: It\'s ok. We have had several of these gates. The ones that get the most traffic wear out quickly and the hinge has broken several times. You can not order replacement parts, you have to order a whole new gate.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I\'m going mad trying to find out how tall this gate actually is!  Why would a company advertise a product as extra tall and NEVER (unless I\'ve already lost it) tell a consumer the actual height?  I\'ve looked at a dozen websites, as well as The First Year\'s own website.  Nothing.  Zip.  Ziltch.  No mention of the height.  I\'m also surprised to see no reviewers happened to mention the height.Can anyone help me out?

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: Great gate--have an earlier version by the same manufacturer as well. However, in less than two minutes my Jack Russell terrier figured out how to open the new gate and get out. I\'ve nicknamed her Hannah Houdini.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: I had to purchase 2 of these gates and yes they were costly, but at least it came with two extensions already included in the price.  I originally purchased 2 of the hands free gate, but after I realized I would have to buy 4 extensions, I quickly returned them and got the sure and tall gates which saved me $40 in the end.

name: Summer Infant  Multi Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, White
review: This gate is perfect for what I was looking for- a sturdy pressure gate with larger width and heighth to keep our 60-lb dog in our front yard. One thing to note, when opening the gate, you need to pull up on the door enough to release the top & bottom "latches".  Once you explain it to others, we\'ve found that its not an issue. It should definitely work to keep smaller children in, as releasing the door takes more coordination than younger ages might have. Make sure everyone steps over the 1" rise when walking through the door-- or you might be readjusting the gate to get it back into place.  Overall, I am very satisfied with this purchase.  I like the sturdiness and the look of this metal gate.  My 7 and 9 year old children have no problems using it-- and our dog is happy to be able to join us in the front yard.

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: I needed to down-size my diaper bag, but needed quick convenience, too. I have 3 toddlers, and I can fit everything I need. It\'s also quite comfortable to wear. I wore it around a museum for hours, and forgot I even had it on. Great cell phone and "parent pockets" too!

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: I have tried MANY diaper bags over the course of my son\'s first year.  He is almost 14 months now and this diaper bag is absolutely perfect for him.  However, imagining having this bag during his first few months would be difficult.  In the beginning I carried A LOT!  Now his daily needs have downgraded to just a few items and this bag has worked best.  The bag is perfect for my toddlers needs and I also have room for my keys, wallet, lipstick, etc.  The cell phone carrier on the strap is a super great idea because I usually don\'t have time to dig for it in the bag while on the run.  It\'s a comfortable bag to wear for me, although it does get a little heavy when I\'ve worn it for long periods of time.  My husband loves it also and he doesn\'t find the weight to be bothersome, even when I\'ve jam packed it with all of our needs.  I bought this bag anticipating it will be well used on our upcoming trip to Disney World.  I believe I have made a wise purchase!

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: love this bag for everyday use. it doesnt hold enough for a weekend but it holds everything i need for for going out during the day. i like the two external pockets for my wallet/keys and the pocket on the strap for my cell phone. it rides comfortably across my body and is easy to carry when i\'ve also got the baby to hold. i haven\'t had any wear issues or breakage issues either. i love that it doesn\'t look like a diaper bag.

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: I am a first time Mom and live by these reviews!  I received three diaper bags at my shower and this is the one I decided to keep.  Initially I thought it was going to be too small, but when I packed it it held a lot more than I thought it would (outfits, diapers, blankets, wipes, etc.).  I breastfeed and don\'t have to carry formula or bottles, that would probably take up more room.  It\'s not meant to be a suitcase, so if you were going on a trip you would definitely have to take another bag, but for grocery shopping and outings, the bag is fabulous.  I put my son in the cart and keep the sling on me the entire time and my hands are completely free.  It is also incredibly comfortable, most of the time I forget I even have it on!  As everyone else has said, my husband is very "secure" carrying it, it looks just like a backpack.

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: I registered for this bag because I know my husband would feel comfortable carrying a backpack/sling rather than a traditional diaper bag. We use this bag everytime we go out, whether it be just to the store or a day trip to San Francisco. The bag is pretty spacious! Our son is now 8 months old so in the main compartment I usually keep 2 changes of clothes, 2 bibs, a light weight blanket and an empty 4 oz. bottle. The main compartment also has 2 inside pockets and in the top one I always have a disposable camera because you never know when you\'re going to take a picture! The bottom inside pocket I keep a jar of baby food, spoon, small container of cherrio\'s and some crackers. What\'s great about this bag is the outside pockets! There are 2 pockets on the outside front. One pocket holds a tube of Desitin, small bottle of baby lotion, infant tylenol, a few bandaids and first aid cream just in case. The other pocket holds my small wallet, keys and cell phone. In the side mesh pocket we always put a bottle of water and the insulated pocket holds another 9 oz. Avent bottle and small can of powdered formula. Wait, there\'s still 2 more pockets! The bottom zippered pocket holds 4 diapers and a small case of baby wipes and the back mesh pocket holds the changing pad! We love this bag because it\'s easy to carry around and keeps us organized. And depending on where we go, we don\'t always have so much clothes in the bag.So far we haven\'t had any problems with the zippers or strap as other people said they did in their reviews. My only suggestion for improvement would be if there was a way to switch the straps so that you can comfortable carry it over your left shoulder and across the chest. The sling is made to comfortably carry over the right shoulder across your chest, but sometimes it gets tiring carrying it over the right shoulder.

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: Initially I really liked this bag.  I like the style and it seemed to hold everything I needed for on the go. However, after just a month one of the inner pockets tore. And @ 3 months the main strap is starting to come apart. I am now looking for another diaper bag.

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: I have a 3 yr old (mostly potty trained but still has accidents), and a 1 yr old.  This bag has been great.  I have been on the search for a "perfect" diaper bag since my first was born and was beginning to think there wasn\'t one, until I found this bag.  It is so easy to carry and doesn\'t fall off your shoulder.  It holds everything you need (for me two kids), but isn\'t big and bulky like some bags.  My husband doesn\'t mind carrying it at all.  It\'s just a great bag.  I highly recommend it.  We just recently travled with it and it was perfect for our trip.  (In the past I would have taken more than one bag for different situations). I really can\'t say enough good things about it.

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: This bag had all the features that i was looking for. insulated bottle holder, side pocket big enough for a sippy cup, place for my wallet, keys and cell phone, convenient place for diapers and wipes (easily accessible). This bag was perfect except for the defective zippers. They get stuck and that is really annoying when you are trying to change a baby or do whatever else with one hand and the baby in the other. My grandmother suggested rubbing candle wax on them so that they will slide easier, i tried this trick and they still got stuck so i bought a new bag.

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: With our two young children, ages 11 months and 22 months, getting out of the house was pretty difficult.  One constant source of aggravation was trying to carry the baby, hold the toddler\'s hand, and juggle my purse and diaper bag which were always falling off my shoulder.This bag has so many wonderful features.  Here\'s what we love:1. Love that it slings across my back.  No more diaper bag falling off my shoulder.2. Great that my hands are free!3. Distrubutes the weight so that I don\'t even feel it at all.4. Love, Love, Love the insulated bottle holder on the side.  Awesome feature!5. The changing pad has it\'s own little pocket on the back of the bag- easily accessible but out of the way.6. Many compartments!  We use the very bottom compartment to hold a case of wipes, four diapers and a tube of diaper cream.  The middle size front compartment is the perfect size for my wallet, lipstick, pen and check book.  The small front compartment holds my cough drops and has room for plenty more.  The large side compartment has two small inner compartments and then a really large space.  We pack snacks, toys, change of clothes, etc. in there.  And, after all this, there is still room to spare.  Outer mesh pocket on the side is perfect for toddler\'s sippy cup or a bottle of water for me.7. Great having the cell phone on the outer strap.  At first I thought this was kind of goofy, but it really is very convenient.Overall, this bag is wonderful.  This is the 8th or 9th diaper bag that I\'ve tried and the only one that I haven\'t returned.  I wish I had found it sooner.  For a smaller bag, it has all the space and convience of a larger bag without the weight.  I can\'t recommend it highly enough!

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: I got this from our registry and had to return it because there was not enough room for all the stuff that babies needs.  It also only has one compartment to fit one very small bottle. This would be great for a quick outting to the super market but definitely not good for a long day out with the baby.  It also didn\'t feel as comfortable as what other reviewers wrote about.  I\'m 5\'4" and about 125 pounds and it just kept slipping to the side and didn\'t hold still.

name: Black Diaper Bag
review: I registered for this bag online and never saw it in person. Well, it just arrived as a gift yesterday and boy am I impressed! It\'s extremely sturdy and well made. It has  so many zippered compartments including an insulated one for a bottle. The changing  pad even has zippered  bags to hold messy baby stuff. I also love the over the shoulder strap. It\'s padded  and very  comfortable and adjusts easily so hubby can carry it too. And by the way, I have a very picky hubby who\'s into high quality gear and he just loves this bag too! I swore to him when I got pregnant I would  never make him carry a dorky diaper bag- I lived up to my promise :)

name: 900mhz Attachable Monitor
review: First the pros:1.  The range on this monitor is fabulous.  We can pick up the sound from five houses away, down a city block.  All I really wanted to do was get a good signal deep in the backyard; this monitor has made it possible to take my toddler outside while the baby sleeps in his crib.2. I really like the graduated lights - green, yellow and red.  If there is some background noise in your room and you\'re not sure what you heard, the progressive lights help to confirm activity.3. I LOVE the portability! When packing up baby to go to a friends\' house, there is no need to bring any power supplies!4. The manufacturer has great service.Now the bad:  It\'s true...this monitor stinks, mechanically.1. Upon opening the box, the parent unit picked up no sound, and the charging stand for the child unit did not light up, giving me no assurance that the child unit was being powered by the power supply.  A call to the manufacturer resulted in no-fuss delivery of new parts.2. Now, 6 months later, one of the child unit channels has gone defunct.  There are two channels, and we\'re using the only remaining channel.  Not comforting.  I will call the manufacturer again, not sure what the warranty is.Even if they do replace the latest part that has malfunctioned, it\'s hard for me to recommend this monitor despite the pluses. However, I hope they keep sending me replacement parts, because I really like the features of this monitor!

name: 900mhz Attachable Monitor
review: I have had my monitor for 8 months now and I love it!! I have had no probelms with it what-so-ever! The best feature is the portable baby unit that attaches to her crib. I don\'t know what you\'d do without that! So conveinent! I keep it on the charger durring the day, and attach it to her crib at night. It lasts all night, and the few times I\'ve forgotten to turn it off and put it back in the morning, it\'s still working off the charger that next night! I do wish the parent unit was like this too, however, I haven\'t found it necessary...only for my own forgetful conveinence!I leave the parent unit plugged in by my bedside, but the few times I\'ve used the battery and walked with it clipped to me, it was very easy, well heard, never cut in and out, and lasted a long time.I like the light gaging system too. As she is getting older, she has fussed more in her sleep without it being a true wake. Therefore, I can turn the monitor down low enough that the sleeping noises she makes do not keep me up all night, but if she truly wakes, I can hear it and look up to see I\'m not dreaming! (which I have done quite a few times!) It\'s also nice if you are entertaining and purhaps, watching a movie. Being able to monitor the baby with the lights, without the interuptions of a noisy monitor is very nice. However, if you want to turn it up and hear every breath, it is very sensitive, and works this way attached to the crib rail no problem!I am very happy with this monitor and only hope it lasts for all the children I plan to have. I reccomend it to all my friends!

name: 900mhz Attachable Monitor
review: I love this monitor. I can even hear the baby breathe if I put it close enough. And it gives me the freedom to put it in the bassinet, the bed or where ever he ends up sleeping. It just work great. No negative things to say about this monitor.

name: 900mhz Attachable Monitor
review: As a electrical engineer and pround new father of a baby girl, I am more than disappointed with this product. It did not work out of the box.  With a 10 hour fully charged battery in the baby unit and brand new 4 AAAs in the parent unit the range was 1 foot (with or without the AC adapter plugged into it), on both A and B channels.  If you buy this brand & model and have good luck that is great but why take the chance?  For me it is back to the store to exchange this for something better, but first I will read the opinions, something I should have done in the first place.  Best fo luck to you.

name: 900mhz Attachable Monitor
review: Unless you are listening for static instead of a crying baby, I suggest passing on this product!!! It worked great for the first few months but after that you could only hear static

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: I received this basket as a gift and I am thankful for it.  My baby is very comfortable in it and sleeps in it as he does in his crib.  It is great to use during the day when you want to have you baby near you and when you go into another room you can take the baby with you without waking him up.  The only drawback is that the handles are decorative only and get in the way.  The handles tend to flop down on the baby, so I tucked them under the bedding rather than cutting them off completely.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: Got this as a shower gift from my mom.  I\'d picked it out based on the info I derived from the internet, and returned it as soon as it came in the mail.  Shoddy craftsmanship all around, from the flimsy material the basket itself is made from to the ill-fitting "fitted" sheet and the loose material and shoddy sewing on the bumper.  In addition, I guess it\'s buyer beware for things that aren\'t spelled out explicitly--this Moses basket comes with a warning NOT to use the handles or even move the basket while the baby is inside.  That\'s specifically WHY I wanted a moses basket to begin with--so that I could carry the basket from room to room without having to wake the baby up.  Save yourself the hassle and skip this cheaply made basket.  I was wondering why it was priced significantly lower than the other baskets--now I know.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: money well spent and will feel secure with placing my g-son in this quality product.  recommend to purchase two or more sheets available when purchasing

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: Not the sturdiest of products, but perfect for a safe place to lay baby down for a little while.  Much smaller and cozier than a playpen.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: I was pleasently surprised by the great quality of this basket.It is well made and very beautiful. Wonderful price too !

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: The Basket is fine, but the small matress liner inside is too small which makes the basket unusable. We order the baskets to be used at a later time, so we can\'t return them now.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: Well, I didn\'t have super-high expectation for this basket, but it met my expectations.Yes, the hood is attached with velcro, butit stays there well, and I liked it with it.Yes, the little sheet gets dirty (with a newborn), and then it doesn\'t look so good after you wash.Yes, the ribbons holding the lining around are flimsy, but if you want to make the thing look good, you take the time to tie them again.Yes, you\'re not supposed to carry the basket with your baby inside...But:The basket really did the job I wanted it to do, which is a place for the baby to be wherever I am: next to my bed in the night, with me in the living room during the day. My son loved his little basket bed, and was happy in it. By 3mo, he grew too big for it, and was transfered full-time to his crib for sleeping periods (he was doing only naps in it before). I was actually sad not to use the basket anymore, the baby was so cute in it. I hope to have another baby to use the basket with in the future.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: Pretty good for the price the quality of the basket its allright the only thing i didnt like about this moses is that the handle doesnt stay up but besides that i like it because is pretty huge and very comfortable for my lil man...the delivery service was excellent thank you amazon!!

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: Ordered this for my son\'s new baby and it is a nice basket.  The only thingI don\'t like is how the hood fits on but I see why it has to do that.  Itjust doesn\'t look "finished" with it being on with velcro.  It\'s a showergift for them, so I hope they like it!

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: This was so handy to carry our little one around in.  He sleeps in it supervised during the day too. He is 3 months old now and we still use it. Deffinitly recommended for a new mom.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: This is great.  A little flimsy with the velcro attaching hood thing but otherwise really good.  We put it inside the co-sleeper and this seems to be a great infant sleeping arrangement.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: I bought this for a friend as a baby shower gift.  It is very cute, however, I would NOT recommend leaving a newborn in this.  The basket, hood, and handle was not sturdy and the padding on the bottom didn\'t seem safe and was very thin.  I rated this 4 stars because I think it would be great for a baby 3 or 4 months old.... SUPERVISED.  Basically an older baby that can support himself better.  It is also very cute!  And you cant beat the price!  I would recommend something more sturdy and better quality if you plan on using this a lot and when your baby is very young.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: I ordered this for my daughter with hopes that she would use it while visiting friends.  As it turns out, she has slept in it every night for three months.  It fits well in her crib and has given her a smaller, newborn size place to sleep.  I can also move it to where I want in the house and bring it on trips, and she sleeps equally well because she feels "at home".  At three months, I regret she only has a few more weeks in it...but it has been worth every penny.  And that velcro top didn\'t bother us at all.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: We only used it during the day but we could move it easily through out the house. She out grew it so quickly any more expensive would be a waste. It will make a great hand-me-down, so cute.

name: Badger Basket Natural Moses Basket with Hood, Pink Waffle Bedding
review: This  was a perfect solution for my Great-Grandson who was born 2 mos. early at 3 lbs., 5 oz.  When he came home in 3 weeks,, it was the perfect size to give him a confined sleeping space..  Very attractive and well constructed.  Great buy for newborn.

name: Eddie Bauer 2-Step Stool Birch
review: We have had this step stool for about a week and 1/2 now.  We bought it for our three year old to use at bedtime.  Our entire family has borrowed it from her room and use it for other purposes. It is sturdy, nice to look at, and easy to carry around the house when needed.  Well worth the price.

name: Eddie Bauer 2-Step Stool Birch
review: I was very pleased with this product.  It\'s nice and sturdy and has a good weight to it so it won\'t risk tipping over.  I liked the idea of the bottom pull out step, but my 2 year old dosen\'t get the concept of using that part.  He just steps right up to the top step.  So, I\'m not sure if the pull out step is even neccessary, but it\'s a nice touch anyway.  It would be nice if the pull out step was removable somehow.  The only reason I gave if four stars instead of five is because I wish it was a few inches taller, but all in all, I recommend this product.

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: Have this unit in out house, we have the one with one base unit and two mobile units.A few things to note. The ones we had do not offer rechargeable batteries. It uses alkaline only, or if you have your own charger you could use rechargeable but would be nicer if it recharged while plugged in.We live in NYC, Queens to be exact. We hear taxi cab radio chatter over this at times, especially at night. Also if unit is close to base unit static is not too bad but still annoying in bedroom, BUT if you have it one floor away, forget it. Unless child is screaming all you hear is static. on both units.Only has two channels A & B which are set manually at both base and hand held units. So if you have a bad signal in middle of night, you have to go into child\'s room and change channel. Just don\'t wake the baby! Ouch!Also missing a pager and a "walkie talkie" feature. They would be very nice. Not a deal breaker if they don\'t have it BUT it can be handy especially if your two floors up with baby with a full diaper and Spouse is in basement and you need more diapers from Garage.I am about to have a second child, and I am replacing this unit with a better one, I am looking at one of the new digital units that have the noise/static reduction. Consumer Reports gave some of them their top marks. They are however way more pricey than these, some are near $200 and only one receiver. But they all have charging bases and most importantly they are static free with AUTO channel switching!

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: I started researching a new baby monitor a year or two ago after our other one would work ok, but then start screaming static when ever it felt like it.  The old one was ok for a couple of years, but then became very tempermental.I found a lot of reviews on Amazon, and this was the best out of all the others I was finding at that time.  The others had pretty consistant bad reviews.  But these were great.  I went down to Walmart and bought it.It has been very reliable for a long time now.  We use it every night while we are sleeping downstairs, it picks up EVERYTHING upstairs.  Clocks ticking if you turn it up.As far as static goes, I suppose there is static.  After reading some of these reviews about horrible static, I just don\'t agree, but maybe I sleep better with more background noise.  Our old monitor had horrible static, this is nothing compared to that thing.  There is a steady stream of *Shhhhh* noise that comes when you turn it on, but when you turn the monitor up, that noise stays the same quiet *shhhh*.  If you have it turned up to medium you can hear every little turn the kids make in their bed.  I usually have it turned down low so I can just hear if they start crying.I read a review about sucking up battery power, but frankly, I hardly use it with batteries because I can\'t afford them.  If I go outside to garden, I plug it into my outside outlet and turn it up all the way, it works great.  I can hear it a long way away. (I live on a quiet street mind you.)  Having battery back up is a bonus if you need it just in case (like if they are sleeping in the car, you can put the receiver in there.)I suppose there may be some out there that have absolutley no background noise, but I have not had the need to go and spend more time and money on searching for ultimate prefection.  This little guy has proven itself worthy after this long.  Even if it broke tomorrow I would be fine to get another for $20 knowing that it lasted this long.

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: I put this monitor on my gift registry and it was the worst.  It did work for all of two weeks than all you could hear was static no matter what I did it did not change.

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: Baby monitors use a range that gets a lot of interference and therefore you can get a lot of static.  I\'ve used  this system at four different places as we have been visiting my family.  At every place it worked well but at every place it took a fair amount of adjusting to get a clear signal.  This was especially true at my brother\'s who lives in an apartment complex; all those wireless phones and TVs really can cause problems.  But with a little experimentation we got it working.  It\'s a great product for the price.

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: My husband and I placed this on our registry and ultimately received it as a gift.  Although I like the dual monitors, belt clip and light features, I cannot stand the ANNOYING static!!  I\'ve tried everything to lessen the static and nothing seems to work.  I\'ve researched other monitors and will be returning this one in the hopes that I can find something with better clarity.

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: This monitor is great if you use both the transmitter and receiver in the baby\'s room. You know, like if you need to turn away from your baby in the crib and get a onesie from the dresser on the other side of the room, but you still want to hear what your baby would sound like if it was on the space shuttle... well, then I suppose this crappy monitor might be ok. However, if you actually need a monitor that is useful, this is definitely not the product. Spend 50 bucks and get a real monitor!

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: Well you get what you pay for. I havent  had any major complaints. The two things that spring to mind about this moniter are:It eats up the batterys pretty fast. In about a week and a half I find myself replacing the batterys and when its pluged in the wall it has to much static to stand if your a light sleeper.Also another thing I noticed is it picks up everything , backround noise and everything. I put the moniter near the window and I can hear people talking outside.Overall I have to say for 20 bucks it works great. If your looking for something that will not pick up backround noise and has all the bells and whistles look for a moniter 40.00 and up.

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: It works very well.  I\'ve had it for over one year and I have not had any problems with it.  It gets no interferance.  I can even hear my baby breath when he is in his room (on second floor) and I\'m working outside in my yard.

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: This baby monitor has worked impeccably for us since the day we plugged it in. After reading reviews til my eyes blurred, I decided this was the place to start and, if need be, through trial and error, I\'d find what best suited our home. Well, one trial is all it took. This monitor has provided us with crystal clear reception for four months now ... I can hear our baby\'s swooshing on his sheets as he moves about in his sleep!

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: Este producto es muy útil y de buena calidad,  en países como Colombia, en algunos lugares presenta interferencias de señal por la mala calidad del energía electrica,  pero se puede solucionar con un buen cortapicos o estabilizador de voltaje

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: The big plus on this is the dual monitors so I can keep one upstairs and one downstairs without having to worry about unplugging it to move it.The reception on this is great! I could even hear my baby moving and breathing! I had some problems with the humming/static at first, but found that fiddling with the channels and the location of the receiver fixed that problem. Great product! I highly recommend it!

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: This monitor is terrible!  I was not sure if I wanted to buy another one since our old one worked okay.  But, it sucked up 9 volts like you wouldn\'t believe.  I finally decided to buy another and bought this one.  It\'s going back tomorrow and I will buy more 9 volts.The static is UNREAL! We can\'t even hear the baby!

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: Even though I\'m convinced that all monitors work differently in different locations, this model has treated us well.  We got this monitor (with dual receivers) for my first daughter 3 1/2 years ago and it was always clear & crisp.  Reception was perfect in the basement, in the frontyard, in the backyard...even at the neighbor\'s house.  One of the receivers konked out after about 2 years but we survived with only one.  The second receiver finally stopped working last week & after doing waaaaayyyy too much internet research, I decided to go with the same, trusty, inexpensive monitor and it works great!  I\'ve never slept with a monitor in our room (because our babies stay with us for a long time) so I don\'t know about nighttime quirks.  I keep the monitor in our kitchen area to listen for the little one waking up from naps....and to spy on the girls when they play upstairs without me. :)  Baby #3 is on the way & I\'m sure this monitor will last another 3 years until we don\'t need it anymore.  So, $40 over the course of 3 children isn\'t bad!

name: Fisher-Price: 49 MHz Sounds \'n Lights Monitor
review: We have had this monitor now for 8 months, and it works great. We had some problems with static untill we moved a battery charger for another device out into the garage. Now we can hear everything our son does in his bed even over the air purifier we have running in his room!

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: I registered for this monitor and received it for my baby shower about 7 months ago.  After reading some of the reviews here, I began to 2nd-guess my choice and was worried that it wasn\'t what I wanted afterall.  However, after 7 1/2 months of use, I think this is an outstanding monitor for an excellent price.I love the lights on the receiver as I can take it downstairs for movie night and turn the volume entirely down (so as not to disturb the movie) and still see if my baby is  moving around or crying.Probably what I love most about it is how hypersensitive it is to sound.  What I mean by this is that if I become concerned about my baby in the middle of the night (SIDS), I can turn the volume up on the receiver and actually hear him breathing!!!  I can\'t tell you how many trips from my bed to his crib it saves me at night.I\'ve read some negative reviews on here about static and the like - and I have experienced *some* static - but I\'ve found that if I move it away from other electrical devices (like the phone, for instance), I have virtually no feedback.  And, too, changing the channel  makes a big difference.Definitely worth buying!

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: This monitor I received as a baby shower gift and I hate it! It has horrible static. If you walk around it or get too close it gets worse. If the phone rings same thing. I didn\'t expect to much from it, but I must say I can hear my son pretty well, and I like the fact that I can see the red lights. They help me to determine if he is just groaning and searching for his thumb, or if he is actually in distress. Great concept, needs some work.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: After reading the VERY mixed reviews on Baby Monitors, we decided that a test drive was in order before the arrival of baby.This was our first choice because of the price and because of the lights.  The lights are appealing to us because of the additional activity monitoring they provide.I began the test some after receiving the units.  I plugged in the transmitter in the soon to be baby room setting it to Channel A.  I plugged in one receiver one floor up and the other receiver one floor down also all set to channel A.The initial test was a success and the receivers were clean with minimal background noise.  I decided to leave everything running during the evening and monitor it.  I turned if off before bed without detecting any issues.I powered the system back up after coming home on night #2. The upstairs receiver immedialy began howling at me.  I turned down the volume and let it run.  I came back after an hour to the same grating static.I switched everything over to channel B.  No Improvement.I looked for noise sources in the house ( i.e. motors, flourescent lights, cordless phones in use etc . . . ).  Nothing seemed to change it so I have to suspect external sources of the interference.This system is on it\'s way back to the store.  Not sure what system I will pick to test next.  I like the flexibilty of cordless, but I may have to hard-wire something if interference continues to be an issue.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: We put our baby in the nursery at three weeks old so I started using this monitor from the beginning.  I almost took it back then and didn\'t...wish I had because now I have to go purchase another one anyway.  We also had static.  When I tried changing to the other channel it was worse.  I was so tired I guess I just got used to it.  Now, only a few months later, we are picking up some crazy radio station on both channels.  Perhaps I should have read these reviews earlier!  The one thing that I really do like about this is that I can put batteries in the reciever, clip it to my waist and walk around the house getting things done.  Very convenient.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: I have owned this monitor for four months.  It is a great value for the price, but it is not perfect.  I like that it has lights so I can SEE every sound my baby makes. This is very helpful when I have the receiver in a room with a TV or washing machine on and I can\'t hear well.  It is very sensitive to sound, even picking up noise that is made in another room.  Dual receivers are a must, I keep one downstairs and have the other in the kitchen or bedroom as needed.The reason I gave this product only 3 stars is the static.  There is barely any static when it is used cordless with batteries, however the batteries don\'t last for that long so I prefer to have it plugged in.  Once I plug the receiver in to run off of electricity the static starts.  The receiver is at it\'s worst when it is near electronic equipment (like my TV).  I have come to find this to be EXTREMELY ANNOYING.  I actually had to walk around the room plugging it in to different outlets trying to find the area with the least static.  In it\'s defense, it is my understanding that most baby monitors on the market today do have problems with static/interference, so if you don\'t mind working around this issue it is a good buy.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: If you don\'t like to hear a constant buzz while you are trying to sleep, then don\'t buy this product. Yes, this product has a constant buzz when it is turned "on". Very annoying. My husband hates it and I just deal with it. The buzz is there even when the volume is turned all the way down. I\'m getting ready to shop for a video monitor to replace this thing.I do need to address the static. I did not get static when it was new and but I have experienced it. I\'ve had it for 18 months and I noticed that I get static when it\'s windy outside. The static can be so bad that you wonder if someone has shut it off to cause it to static. Otherwise I hear BUZZZZZZZZZ all night long.Hope this helps someone. Perhaps look at the reviews for a different brand.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: I was very pleased with my old Sounds \'n Lights monitor with one receiver, and was excited to receive this one for a gift.  It was going to be much more useful with the dual receivers.  There was way too much interference and always a buzzing noise.  I couldn\'t even hear my son crying over the buzzing noise.  I tried switching channels and turing the volume up and down, but it didn\'t help.  I will be taking this monitor back today to get a different brand.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: This monitor was recommended to us by a friend and I purchased it for the dual listening monitors and the fact that it had AC and battery power options. The big visual display also seemed like a plus.However, when we tried to use the monitor all we heard was interference. We tried switching channels and adjusting the volume and still only heard static or feedback. We have a lot of wireless equipment in our house and my husband thought that might have something to do with it not working. I ended up returning the monitor to the store. Since then I purchased a Graco monitor and have had no problems with static.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: We got this monitor as gift at baby shower. It works so well we end up with buying another one - one for baby\'s bedroom and one for the living room. It is very clear so we keep the receiver\'s volume low all the time and it is loud enough when baby cries. It is very sensitive we can hear any noice baby makes, no static at all. When baby is sleeping I carry a receiver out side doing yardwork, still can hear my baby crystal clear!Since I use two transmiters at different spots. The only time I got static is when I put a receiver at the channel which corresponding transmiter is not on. That\'s how it suppose to work: if you try to receive somthing, you need to transmit it first.I love this product, I bought one for my friend too.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: We like the Sound N Lights Monitor.  We don\'t have problems with static like others have had.  It\'s really great to have dual receivers, one for upstairs one for downstairs.  And it\'s nice to have the option to run the receiver off of batteries if you need to be mobile while the baby is sleeping.  The price is right and the quality has been great for us!

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: Although many reviews have been bad for this monitor, we got this as a shower gift and have found it to work perfectly.  There is zero static and it picks up my baby\'s every little sound.  I was actually amazed at how well it picked up his sounds.  However we live in a rural area, so maybe that has something to do with a clear signal/no static.  I would definitely recommend it for the price.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review: I got this monitor after reading reviews in several forums and have been very happy with it. I was afraid it wouldn\'t work well because I live in a condo and we have 4 cordless phones, but we haven\'t had a single problem with reception.I\'ve dropped the base several times (from a table onto carpet) and it\'s held up fine. The system also has good sensitivity - I stopped using it in my bedroom, which is right next to the nursery, b/c I was hearing everything and it was making me edgy.

name: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
