If the price is keeping you away, check out the Cross Country, which is exactly the same, except it has fewer pockets and somewhat less padding. We splurged on this one for the brighter color and the extra pockets.Plus side: The main advantages of this backpack over our prior compact are it\'s enlarged storage spaces, better padding on all the straps, fully adjustable (and easy to adjust) straps all around. Since we do a lot of walking at dusk, the built in reflective strips and lighter color (Gray) were selling points as well. The kid straddles the lower pack; they can\'t stand up or launch themselves out of it (which is why we upgraded), and they can\'t kick you or ride with their knees in your back. Also, there are plenty of pockets, even a cell-phone and water-bottle holder.Minus side: The main drawbacks are: the price (~2x a compact), though cheaper than most high-end hiking packs. The pack is also heavier than our prior compact, but not prohibitively so. Finally, the "landing gear" that holds it upright on the ground doesn\'t have a hard lock when deployed (unlike some brands), so you have to be careful when setting it down with the kid onboard.Niggling minus points (engineers take note): the reflective strips are nice, but smaller than I had hoped. The pockets are numerous, but it seems like they went overboard. The sun visor is hard to attach, but not that hard. I consider these all minor.Whatever pack you buy, make sure it fits before you get it. Put the kid in and do some shopping. Get someone to show you how to adjust it properly.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: This is a great toy. My son started to put the balls in when he was about 7mths. Since then he plays with it every day. He also quickly learnt that he could achieve the same sounds by sticking his hand in and pressing the button at the bottom.I think its a very versatile toy.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: I got this for my twins when they were 11 months old.  For the first 10 minutes, after I showed them how to put the balls in the funnel, they had great fun.  Now, 2 months later, they have more fun with the individual parts than with the toy as a whole.  They have fun with the rings; two of them have velcro feet/hands and they enjoy putting them together and taking them apart.  They also enjoy playing with the balls, which have beads inside that rattle.  They try to put other things in the base, like pacifiers, and will reach in to push in the button to make lights and sounds come on.  So, I would give the whole toy only 2 stars since it didn\'t keep their interest, but the individual parts would get 4 stars.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: My daughter, 8 months old, loves this toy and has for a few months. I love it, too.  It\'s not only a stacking toy but several toys in one, each providing development benefits:* The removable "elephant head" serves as a funnel into which you drop balls.  The head itself is fun since the ears crinkle and the "hair" is little knots that provide tactile sensation.  My daughter loves to grab it and wave it around.* Each stackable ring is soft and easy for my daughter to grab and wave around, which she loves to do.  Two of the rings, the "elephant feet" have Velcro joining the feet that my daughter can separate and rejoin.* The 4 different colored balls rattle and each has a different patter pressed on it.  My daughter loves to shake the balls, which fit perfectly into her hands - but not her mouth, and she also loves to feel the patterns on the balls.* When you drop the balls into the funnel/chute, it plays a song (which you can disable).  The balls then roll out the door (which can be closed).  Great for teaching cause-and-effect as well as object-permanence.  My daughter leaned that there a balls behind the door and loves to open it to get them out.This is a well-thought-out toy that fosters her development, and my daughter loves it.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: My 1 yo loves this stacking elephant.  The rings come off easily and she loves putting them back on.  The toy comes with four balls that jingle.  The only thing is the bottom opening stays open so the balls come out immediately upon placing them down the tube.  I would have liked to seen them having to open the hatch to get the ball.  Overall great toy.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: I bought this for a friend as a first birthday present.  I opened it up to put in the batteries for her, and played with it a bit.  I can see why people may complain about it not lighting up every time, as the ball needs to hit a button in the center of the cone to create the light and sound reward.  I really like the idea of this toy, and found it to be fairly high quality from what I can tell.  The one thing that surprised me was that although the rings are soft and the cone head of the elephant has some padding the whole thing has a hard plastic interior.  I was thinking that this would be squishy and a little huggable, but that\'s not really the design of it.  It is more designed to be an interactive toy for the balls and stacking hoops.  But it seems well made and is a creative approach to a stacking toy.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: I purchased this for my five month old and she is really enjoying picking up the balls. She hasn\'t yet got the control to get them into the elephant\'s head without help, but she definately enjoys chasing the balls around and pulling all the soft rings off, as well as watching the lights go on when we help her put the balls inside.  It appears pretty well made and is not too loud when in use.  I really like Tiny Love. The other item I purchased from them malfunctioned after about 2 months of daily use. I call the Tiny Love service rep (they print this number right on the tag on the product), who returned my message within an hour. She sent out (and it arrived two days later) a complete replacement without my having to even provide any proof of purchase beyond reading a number off the box.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: It looks like a very simple toy but our baby loves the little sounds the balls make. He also loves the texture the balls and the hoops have. He can play with it for a while every single day and hasnt gotten bored with it yet, (and he has played with it for months now). He has also started throwing the balls inside the yellow container and he also loves exploring the little hair and ears of the elephant. All in all, its a great toy that engages him with textures, sounds and lights. I really recommend it and have given it as a gift to other friend\'s babies as well.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: This toy is the most versatile gift our little girl has received!  There are plush links and rings, balls that rattle when shaken, music that plays when the balls are dropped into the "bong" (as my husband calls it), and so many different uses for all of these components.  Our daughter, who just turned one, has been playing with this since she was five months old.  Then, she really only was able to pick up the links and rings and shake the balls.  Later, she started using the links and rings as hats with her Grammy, pulling them off of Grammy\'s head and later attempting to put a "hat" on herself.  She has since banged the balls together, holding one in each hand, figured out how to carry the rings on her wrists, taught herself how to open the Velcro on the links, and now she\'s dropping the balls into the bong all by herself.  This was sent by one of my husband\'s friends- unmarried and without children- and I applaud him or whomever gave him the recommendation to purchase this wonderful learning tool for our little girl.  Go get one for your little one!

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: This turned out to be my grandson\'s favorite Christmas gift.  He received a large number of other toys, but he chose to play with this one almost continuously. He is 18 months old.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: I prefer educational toys to "just" toys - this one seems to be fun and gives your child plenty of new experiences to learn from: new sounds, shapes, colors ... plus it is really cute.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: This was a gift that was greatly liked.  Thank you so much for the quick delivery.  A pleasure dealing with you.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: This has to be the grisliest toy I\'ve ever seen.  I\'m not sure which is worse: looking into the gaping hole where this creature\'s brain used to be, or having those awful vacant eyes follow me across the store.  Whenever I encounter this thing, I always feel as though I\'ve stumbled across the scene of a horrible crime.Somehow, when I consider the messages I\'m sending with the toys I provide for my son, the last thing I want to do is have him drop little balls into something\'s sawed-off head.  If I gave him a toy saw, after all, I wouldn\'t want him sawing heads with it.  I find it hard to believe this wouldn\'t give the little guy nightmares.  Heck, it gives me nightmares.But, hey!  What a conversation piece!  Five stars!

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: I bought this for my daughter for Christmas when she was 8 months old and she really liked it. She loves playing with the little balls even now that she\'s 20 months old. The toy makes music when you drop the balls through the top - now she tries to see how fast she can drop them in. She didn\'t play with the rings as much at first, but now she likes to put them on her arms and play with the velcro. We\'ve gotten our money out of this one!

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: My 6 months old love this, he likes the ball, grabbing the elephant nose and rings. At this moment I\'m trying to teach him how to drop the ball in.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: My son can\'t pass by this toy without giggling and squealing in delight! He is 7months old now but has loved it since the day we bought it when he was only 3months old.

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: This is such a great toy! My son is 8 months old now and he\'s been playing with it everyday for a month now. He loves to throw the balls inside or just rattling them. The music is cute and a nice reward although the toy needs to stay flat for the ball to hit the button that plays the music he doesnt seem to mind and throws other little toys inside too. He also  loves the little window in the bottom through which the balls come out. He can\'t stack the rings yet but he enjoys taking them off. Overall it\'s a wonderful toy that provides many possible ways to play. So happy I got it for him!

name: Tiny Love Musical Stack and Ball Game, Orange Elephant
review: We use this so many ways! She loves to play with the elephant sometimes, the balls on her high chair tray, the rings. Just great. She can play with it as intended all together or use all the parts other ways.Well thought out. Highly recommended.

name: Comfort Care 1-Second Ear Thermometer
review: People who complain that the thermometer consistently measures 96 to 97 degrees instead of 98.6 are mistaken in how the body works.  Not everyone measures 98.6.  However, that being said, this thermometer is still consistently inaccurate.  When I try it on my daughter it consistently comes up 92 to 93 degrees, and I know for a fact that is NOT normal.  I am going to look into another brand to see if I can find one that is much more reliable.

name: Hopping Sports Ball (SOCCER)
review: I was very dissapointed in the Soccer hop ball.  My daughter had it for a total of 2 days and it popped.  She was very upset after waiting for it to come in the mail.  The shipping also took longer than 5 - 7 days that we were promised.

name: Carters 8 Piece Washcloth Set
review: These washcloths are o.k., but not the greatest on the market. I will warn you, however, that I expect towels to be plush and soft...particularly when it comes to a baby\'s skin!

name: Carters 8 Piece Washcloth Set
review: I love this item.  It\'s simple, inexpensive, cute and useful.  The washclothes are soft and have held up nicely in the wash.  And the toy duck is a great bath toy.  A definite must.  It\'s only $9.99 but you can buy it cheaper at other places.  This site also says available online only but its not.  Check Sears, JCPenny and of course any Carter\'s Stores.  You might end up saving a couple dollars.

name: Elite Supreme Low Vision Playing Cards - Large Print
review: We loved the product, but we were overcharged for the postage.Elite Supreme Low Vision Playing Cards - Large Print

name: Elite Supreme Low Vision Playing Cards - Large Print
review: When playing with these cards the large numbers are not visible. The small numbers in the corner are useless for a sight impaired person. Go to Walgreens and get cards with large corner numbers for less money.

name: Lambs & Ivy Hello Kitty Musical Mobile
review: Cute mobile, not too difficult to put together. Looks great with the rest of the Hello Kitty crib collection.

name: Tiny Love Fruity Pals, Anna Banana
review: These toys are great for baby exploration and the like but they have a big flaw(in my opinion):they all pick a  LOT of lint and I have to continuously get it off of the toys. I do not like that but my son seems not to care about it.

name: Tiny Love Fruity Pals, Anna Banana
review: I bought this for my granddaughter when she was about 6 mos old.  She loves it!  I don\'t know if it\'s the colors or the softness or the fact that she can open it and see things she didn\'t know were there but she screeches in excitement when playing with it.

name: Tiny Love Fruity Pals, Anna Banana
Paper Dolls 6 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review: I am so pleased with this set. Originally I bought the Gossamer Wings set. But when I got home with it I encountered 3 major problems and took it back to the store. We exchanged it for this set.This is our first baby  and we wanted to make her room look like a little princess sleeps there. This is a wonderful buy. And we bought everything that goes with it. The set looks best with a white crib which we also purchased at babies r us. The colors are soothing and not out there or outdated. the design is perfect.

name: Paper Dolls 6 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review: My husband and I wanted something pretty and girly without being too frilly and pink.  We spent a lot of time looking at several bedding sets, and when we saw this one, we fell in love with it.  It was the only one my husband got excited about, so I knew it was "the one".  He just knew our little girl had to have it!  Everyone who has seen it thinks it is so cute.  I love that it doesn\'t have gaudy characters or loud colors.  The dresses are so feminine without being annoying, and the pretty pastels look beautiful in our white crib.  Plus, as someone else mentioned, the various colors give you many decorating options.  If you have the chance to see it in the store, do so.  The pictures online are okay, but it is much prettier in real life than the pictures show.  You can\'t go wrong with this bedding set!

name: Paper Dolls 6 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review: i was registered for this item and i\'m sooo excited to have received it! i have the ENTIRE set and i\'m sooo glad i chose this one. ever since i found out that i was having a girl, i knew that there would be a lot of pink involved. i love the color pink, but not too much of it. and this set worked out perfectly. the room was already painted pink. and so the colors of the set worked and blended in perfectly. and with that said, there\'s alot you can add as well. i think she would even be able to grow into it. and i think it goes best with a white crib! absolutely beautiful!

name: Paper Dolls 6 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review: AFTER HAVING TWO BOYS AND A LITTLE GIRL ON THE WAY, WE WANTED TO MAKE IT AS FEMININE AS WE COULD.  AFTER SEEING THIS WE KNEW THIS WAS THE ONE.  THIS IS A GREAT CHOICE FOR A LITTLE GIRL.

name: Paper Dolls 6 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review: This bedding set is so perfect you won\'t want anything else for your baby girl.  There is no color restriction with this set, you can pretty much use any color with this set.  Not only is it not to over powering for the baby, it\'s so perfectly contrasted.  This set will last my daughter through toddler hood and it is well made and durable in the washer, no fading or anything.  I truly recommend buying this bedding set and all the accessories.  If I could show you a picture of my baby girls room you would ohhh and ahhh over how this set is so awesome.  I love not being restricted to just your average pink and purple colors and so will you.  I highly recommend!!!!!

name: Paper Dolls 6 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review: After much deliberation I picked out this set for my registry for my first baby. At my shower I recieved the set & my friends had it all set out so everyone could see it. Everyone was oohing and aahhing at it asking where it was from, etc. It\'s great quality and can go with a variety of colors. It\'s very feminine without being just pink or purple as in so many cases. It can also grow with the baby. I plan on getting a toddler bed so she can use it til she\'s at least 3. I don\'t think I\'ll ever get tired of it. I also have cherry furniture and it looks great with it and I think because of all the colors you could put it with any furniture finish. Couldn\'t be happier!

name: Paper Dolls 6 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review: It so cute!  Very feminine, without going into a lot of pink.  I think it would work for any girl under the age or 7 or 8.  It\'s also pretty durable.  I haven\'t seen any of the pieces fall apart & my daughter is going on 9 months!  I recommend this set.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: When my daughter was first born, she hated her bassinet. I would hold her on my chest all night so that she could sleep. This cosleeper helped solve our problems. The nightlight feature helped me to check on her, and I would also use it while nursing. This cosleeper is not small. We have a California King bed, and we still had room, but this would make

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: Overall, I\'m really happy with this cosleeper. My husband and I felt it was the best way for us to feel comfortable with having our infant sleep in our bed for the first four weeks.Here\'s what I liked:All fabric is machine washable.Cosleeper is secured to bed via a fabric panel that fits between mattress and box spring.Walls of cosleeper were breathable, so no worries of suffocation.No chemical or plastic smell.Here\'s what I HATED:Every single time I washed the fabric the cheap, flimsy plastic zipper popped off  when I went to zip the tight-fitting fabric piece around the inner hard plastic frame. No matter how careful I was, it always popped off. I always managed to reattach the zipper, but it took 15 to 20 minutes to do so. Annoying! I would have rated this product 5 stars had it not been for the terrible zipper.Some things to consider:This took up a lot of room in our king size bed. If you have a smaller bed, I would definitely measure before ordering.It isn\'t terribly long. My baby was 23 inches long at 2.5 weeks and by the time he was a month old, he was too long for the cosleeper. This was fine with us as we weren\'t planning on using it for more than a month.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We purchased this co-sleeper for our daughter, who was 4 or 5 weeks old at the time and decided to fuss all night long sleeping in her pack-n-play but would fall right asleep as soon as I brought her to bed with me.  We were concerned about her sleeping in bed with us for the obvious reasons, so I bought this and it has been great!  I read the reviews about babies outgrowing it quickly.  I figured she wouldn\'t last in it too long but I was willing to try anything to get her to sleep at night.  It\'s true that it is not long enough to use for a long time, but you don\'t want it to be too long otherwise that poses other risks to the child.  After using it in our bed for a couple of weeks we put it in her pack-n-play and she sleeps in it in there now.  She\'s 11.5 weeks old, and quite long for her age and she still fits in but barely.  Another week or two and we won\'t be able to use it I\'m sure.  She sleeps with her legs flopped like a frog so that helps to keep using it a little longer.  We used it in our queen size bed and it was a tight squeeze, especially since my husband is a fairly large guy, but it worked just fine.  The peace of mind of knowing she was safe sleeping in our bed was definitely worth the lack of room and the money.  Will use this from the get go with the next baby.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We\'ve used this only 3 nights now and love it. The light is quite helpful with early breast feeding (our son\'s only a week old) to ensure proper latch and position, etc. It takes up just the same amount of space that our toddler does when she occasionally crawls into bed, so it\'s not too big (we have a queen). The only draw back can be easily resolved. It simply needs to be aired out before use. We used it right away and it had that plastic type smell. I would have preferred to air it out for a day or 2 before using it if I hadn\'t been so desperate.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: Its an great item for a new born baby.If you have not bought a crib or want your baby to share the bed this is a fantastic item. Its light and portable. You can move it around the house easily and lay it down where ever.The only complaint i have is that the leg portion is fixed(yellow piece) and  the length is only 24". My daughter outgrew this in 5 weeks. So consider this before you buy.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I used this item for about 4 weeks.  It was very nice to have baby so close.  My husband and I have a king sized bed and it worked fine.  If you have a queen sized bed, you may be a little cramped.  And if you have a full bed---forget it--one of the parents will be sleeping elsewhere!  I liked the product, hope you do too.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We bought this thinking that it was a great safe answer to co-sleeping.  Our son hated it.  He would scoot down and end up hanging out of the mesh side on the bottom.  He ended up just sleeping on the bed between our pillows most of the time.  One great thing about the product is the night light, I used it constantly.  This product might work well if you have a baby that isn\'t very active; we have no complaints on the quality of construction.  We bought it for a friend who had a very relaxed little girl and she liked it pretty well, although more for naps downstairs on the couch.  Overall we would not purchase it again.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I got this as a hand-me-down and so far it has been one of our most-used baby items. We don\'t have it in bed with us since it feels a little cramped in our queen-size bed with it there. However we keep it on a nightstand next to the bed at night, so I can see how my little guy is doing without needing to move a muscle. During the day it moves to my desk, or the dining table, or the coffee table -- wherever is conveniently nearby. This has been great for always having baby near me so that I don\'t have to keep running to the crib to check on him. It is also very compact and portable -- we always take it with us when we\'re vising friends or family so that baby always has a comfortable place to sleep.Big caveat though: my baby is only 1 month old and already takes up almost the entire length of the sleeper, so I don\'t think we\'ll be able to use it for much longer. However, even for just the first month this has been so helpful to have. He makes a lot of noise at night even when he is asleep and I would have to constantly be hopping out of bed to check on him if we didn\'t have this cosleeper next to the bed.I did have to sew an extra sheet for it though, since the one it comes with will inevitably get dirty. The mattress itself is a good softness and is wipeable. The velcro on the sheets is unnecessary since there is nowhere for the mattress to slide anyhow.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: All of our babies have slept with us.  We tried something new with each one and feel like we finally got it right!  The hard sides are extremely uncomfortable to lay on so it would be nearly impossible to roll over onto a baby.  The nightlight is wonderful.  It is so easy to check on the baby without having to turn on the bedroom lights and I\'m able to see well enough to nurse in bed.  I\'ve had friends complain about their sleepers because their baby has slid out of the bottom of it and under their covers.  Not with this one.  The four sides keep the baby in one location.  This is one of the best purchases we have made!!!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We wanted baby to be close but didn\'t want her "in" the bed.  This way she can be in our bed without have the fear of rolling over her or smuthering her with the pillows.  She loves this little bed.  Plus it is easy to pack when we go places.<br /><br />I do reccommend a king size bed!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: It has sturdy sides to keep mom and dad off of it but enough mesh to allow air flow. I definitely recommend this to keep your baby close while you sleep.  It folds up and is easy to transport for a nap away from home, too.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I never actually got to use this, my baby is very long for his age so I just shipped it right back.  I did open it and I really like the design.  I wish I could have put my baby in it back then, would have allowed me to get more rest.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: My husband and I bought this because I was co-sleeping and we were both scared of something happening to our son.  Unfortunately this product didn\'t not help us sleep any better.  The velcro doesn\'t match up on it and it\'s really soft so our son kept rolling over into us.  The bottom half of it has no support at all.  It\'s just a soft peace of material.  I would say spend more and get something firm

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I absolutely loved this little sleeper.  With our newborn, it made it possible to have her sleep in our bed without worrying about rolling over on her.  Also, we could use it when we needed her to sleep in the living room.  Friends bought another brand that was open at the feet and they woke up to find their little one had wiggled out of the box.  They found him under the covers.  We used ours until about 2 months.  At that point, her sleeping pattern seemed to changed and we weren\'t putting her to bed in the same way.  So, she stopped using it before she outgrew it (and she was 95% percentile in length).  Also, by that time I was more comfortable having her sleep in ghte bed without some extra protection.  With swaddling, cluster feeding during the day and having her sleep in our bed with this sleeper, she was sleeping a good 6-8 hours starting with Day 3.  All in all I really loved it and will certainly use it if we are fortunate enough to have another child.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: First let me say one caveat, order this product from walmart.com, for $36. This price is insane. But this product is so fabulous, I had to write a review. Could it be longer? yes, that would be lovely... But this product enabled us to move our son into his own room by 5 weeks and he sleeps from 11-5 or 6 at 7 weeks, and then from that time again until 9. We used this in our bed with him in the beginning (we also swaddled him), then we used it with him in a co-sleeper beside our bed for three weeks (you could also use it in a pack and play), then we used it in his crib in his own room, and that\'s how we use it now. I recommend this product and swaddle mes if you are into getting a decent night\'s sleep as soon as possible.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This item has worked out great for us.  My baby is a preemie and it appears that it will be a while before he outgrows it.  I like it because I can carry it (even when he\'s asleep inside it) to the room I\'m in and have him close by.  I put a bassinet sheet on it and it works great.  I love the light.  I know if we travel anywhere we\'ll be taking this along.  I highly recommend this item.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: In an effort to make a stable and sturdy sleeper they forgot to make it comfortable for the baby.  We loved it for the stability  and size, but it was not comfortable for our baby and she has refused to stay asleep in it.  Not comfortable for her.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I had this when my daughter was a baby.  It was perfect.  It\'s soft, sturdy, easy to clean, and had great features.  I loved the part at the bottom.  I breastfed and this made my life so much easier.  It made cosleeping safer.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We LOVED this item.  We were concerned about rolling over on our daughter while we had her sleeping in our bed, so this item avoided that problem.  We could check on her during the night and feed her without getting out of bed.  We used it for the first nearly 4 months, until she actually got so big that we cut the end off (obviously, not recommended) so she could stretch her legs for the last few weeks (she was unusually tall at 4 months, at 27").  I can see using this only with a king-sized bed.  One would be too cramped in a queen-sized bed.  Note that each parent will have to use separate top blankets and sheets on either side of the sleeper.  The only downsides were (1) the nightlight, which I found useless because the light points up and so did not illuminate her face.  However, the light is removable, so I suppose one could use it by taking it out.  And (2), the manufacturer did not make extra fitted sheets last time I checked.  The sheet has velcro which keeps the little mattress in place (although it does not move much), and loose sheets are not recommended for reasons of safety.  Therefore, if the sheet gets soiled in the middle of the night, then good luck.  The mattress did flatten a little where her head was by the end of 4 months.  I have seen comments that the mattress is not soft, but it\'s really softer than our crib mattress.  The entire unit is machine washable (once certain parts are removed, which is easy), and we dried the whole thing in the dryer.  We would have brought the sleeper with us on a trip we took after she turned 4 months if she hadn\'t grown out of it so early.  The item was perfect until we transitioned her to her crib at 4 months.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I had a cheaper co-sleeper that would shift when my husband or I moved or if only 1 of us was in bed and the baby would roll to the side.  This one has a nice flap that goes under the adult bed\'s mattress and helps keep it from doing that.  I used the 1st years positioner in it for the first 2 months.  I do wish it were longer as my son is 12 weeks now and at 25 inches is longer then the mattress but he sleeps with his legs folded a bit so he still fits, I may cut the bottom foot rest as I read some people have done to get a little more life out of it.  I plan to use it again if we have more kids.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I first bought an expensive Munire\'s crib for the baby room.  After a few days..... we realized that we want the baby to be near us so we can check up on her and not rely on the baby monitor and then having to get up, walk to the baby room, to see how she\'s doing.I bought this co-sleeper and am very happy with it.  It has a sturdy side so you can\'t just roll over on it.  It doesn\'t bend easily and requires some force.  The bedding is fairly firm but it\'s not 100% flat.The material is washable and the unit folds easily for transport.Downside:I don\'t think this will last a whole year.  My baby is only 2 months old and around 10lbs and she\'s pretty much going to kick down the foot-rest soon.  I think this will probably last me another 2 months (total of 4 months) before I need something bigger... or just move the big crib into the room.  :)

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I brought this sleeper for my sister in-law who has just had a baby boy. She absolutely loves it. Since coming out of the hospital she has only used this. I think the reason for this is because it is so light and easy to move.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: It is great but is too short! The yellow wedge is non-removable, and the baby outgrew it in less than 2 months! Boo!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I didn\'t care for this product.The discription was misleading,so therefor this product wasn\'t usable for Me.It would be better for couples who travel&let their children sleep wth them.It\'s made to be usd in an adult bed.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We had the older version which did not come with the extra sides and the wedge at the end. We never had a problem and loved the product. It lasted for our second child and we still have it. The newer product has additional safety features. [...]

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: VERY USEFUL. TOO BAD IT\'S NOT LONGER, AS THE BABY WILL SOON GROW OUT OF IT.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This is the third sleep positioner I have bought since my daughter was born in August.  It\'s a great product for co-sleeping, especially for us since my daughter refuses to fall and stay asleep unless she can see and touch us.  The only thing that I didn\'t like was that I thought the foot positioner was removable and it\'s not.  My daughter is in the 100% for height and now she doesn\'t fit in it.  I will definitely use it for my next one and wish I could still use it.  It\'s a great product and worth the money,

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: Get a bassinet! Those parents who gripe and complain about their babies sliding out of these wedges and onto their beds are idiots!  Your endangering your own babies life by sleeping with them in the same bed.  A safe tip is to buy a bassinet and keep it next to your bed...WOW problem solved!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This item is not useful and I don\'t feel it is safe. I bought this item with the intention of having our new son sleep close to us. The item is not stable and turns to the side if you get close to it, waking the baby up and wrenching it to the side. Our bed is semi-soft mattress, maybe it wouldn\'t do that with a really firm one. Also, the tiny piece of mattress/foam that they have in there is ridiculous for a baby, its like having a baby sleep on cardboard. I bought this on clearance for only 12.99 and returned it 2 days later. Go with the bassinet or co-sleeper!!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: A friend lent me hers and I thought \'what am i going to use this for since I intended to have the baby in his crib right away.\'  Well, I had a c-section and getting in and out of bed twenty times a night was not feasible, nor comfortable.  Any woman who is having a c-section REALLY NEEDS THIS ITEM.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I found this product to be the best product I had for my newborn son.  It is portable enough to move around the house easily.  My son slept in the living room while I was able to get things done around the house.  It then could move to his bassinet at night so I had peace of mind he would be in the same position through the night.  I used this for many many months.  After he became too long for it I took the positioner out and used that in the bassinet.  My son is 3 now, and every friend along the way who has had a baby I always buy this for them.  Every friend comes back after a month to express how great this product is.  One particular friend who travels said this is great because she doesn\'t need to bring a pack & play.  The light that comes with it is great because it is not too bright.  My light still works and is used often to this day as I check on my son at night.  This product is compact, portable, and built well.  Well worth the money for any mom.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This co-sleeper is amazing when you use it as it was meant to be used. My daughter was 10 pounds and 24 inches long so she wasn\'t able to use this for long and I was fine with that. It\'s so nice to sleep with this in the bed if you\'re nursing. My husband and I have a queen bed and used it just fine. It even comes with a nightlight to make it a little easier to see your baby.Great features:Folds for travelSheet is washableNightlightBreathable mesh sidesBottom of bed has wedge to prevent sliding outPad in the bed is nice and comfy

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: My little girl had hard time falling asleep and staying asleep. She slept in her cradle up until we bought this coleeper in December 09. Since then she has slept from 11 pm till 7 am which for a 2 month old child is great! Now she is 5 months old and we are thinking to switch to her crib as she\'s outgrowing the cosleeper.I read in one of the reviews that the light is set very low, that person probably does not know that it is adjustable!I give all five stars and thanks to whoever inverted it!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We bought this item 2 days before my son was born (4 weeks premature) because I planned to breastfeed and co-sleeping was recomended. I wouldn\'t normally let my baby sleep in the bed with me without this bed!It has a flap on the top that goes down around the mattress on your bed to keep it from sliding all over the place. The little built in night light gives enough light to do a diaper change and to look for pacifiers in the dark, check baby\'s breathing, etc. without having to turn on a lamp. I love being able to lay my arm over the side to comfort him as he falls back asleep too.  Travels great as well. It only comes with one sheet, but I have found that regular bassinet sheets fit well. A friend had the traditional bassinet and gave me some baby stuff with sheets in it. I didn\'t think I had a use for them until we had a leaky diaper and needed another sheet. I thought of the bassinet ones and low and behold, they fit perfectly!I rate this item A+++++++++++++ I only wish it was a little longer as my5 month old will soon be too long for it!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: The concept is pretty simple, but I\'m not totally sure it\'s a necessary item. Honestly, I felt like it took up alot of space in the bed (we have a queen sized bed) so if safety is a concern I\'m not sure how useful it is to constantly bump into it while you\'re sleeping (perhaps waking up your child in the process?). Also, if you\'re a big tossing/turning type of sleeper where you\'d need something like this then you probably shouldn\'t have the baby in bed with you anyway.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This is one of my favorite purchases.  Some people have complained about its short length but my baby is in the 95th percentile for weight & height at 4 months and she still has room to grow in it.  We no longer need to use it in our bed as she sleeps fine in her crib but we still use it for other purposes around our home & will for travel soon.  After 4 months it still looks brand new & has held up very nicely.  If I could change anything I would make the yellow bar near the feet, which helps keep the baby from sliding down, removable so I could use it even longer!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: The concept is great, but if your baby is born at over 8 lbs, he/she will outgrow it in about a month.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This is a great product for any family considering co-sleeping. It keeps the child safe and close all at the same time. I have used this product with two children and loved it both times. I also pack it to take places to lay the child down for a nap.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This co-sleeper has made it possible for us to sleep for the last few nights.  I am breastfeeding, and it is very easy to position myself so that I can feed him while he is in the sleeper, then just roll away.  My husband moves a lot while sleeping, and I\'ve watched him roll over toward the sleeper and be stopped by it. The only negative is something true of all co-sleepers - it doesn\'t stop your blanket from landing on the baby, so if you are going to use it, dress warmly so you don\'t need a blanket.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: My newborn very colicky baby would NOT sleep anywhere but ON TOP of my chest, which was exhausting and not safe. When I moved her into her big crib, she\'d wake easily and scream! This gem was the ideal solution. I\'d move her into this after she was asleep and place it in the middle of our queen bed (king size would be optimal though). Amazingly, she\'s sleep for 6-8 hours stretches AT NIGHT in this little bed, despite the snores of my hubby and I on either side of her. This thing helped us all get some order and sanity into our routine and more importantly helped her rest. The down side is she outgrew after about 6 weeks, but I would buy it again in a second  - worth every penny! She just needed to be close to me and this worked beautifully. Afterward she moved to a co-sleeper which was also great, and eventually at about 4-5 months her big crib. I highly recommend it. No concerns about safety or rolling on top as the sides are well reinforced, and the little light is handy for checking up in the middle of the night. If you\'re a stressed out mother with a colicky / needy baby - please try this (though note, I always put her in sleeping and once she was in, that was her for the night, even at 2 weeks old).

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: When the baby moves it makes a crunchy sound as if you were sitting on a plastic sofa!!! Also it is really short, we were only able to use it for 3 weeks (baby was 21 inches when born)It served its purpose for those first couple of weeks, but really there are better ones on the market

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This would have been great except the foot piece at the bottom.  My baby was less than 2 months old when she was too long to fit.  At that time she was under 23" long.  I ended up cutting open the bottom and removing the plastic "A" fram piece so she wouldn\'t be scrunched.  I loved being able to have her in the bed with me when we traveled.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We were looking for something to put in the bed between us and this was an excellent sleeper. We now have transitioned it into her crib and it is working great. The only bad thing about this sleeper is it takes up a lot of room. We have a queen bed and it really does not give you much room. This sleeper helped us quickly transitioned our baby in to the crib.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: My husband and I just had a wonderful baby girl (Apr. 9, 2007) and I simply could NOT live without this item. My daughter loves sleeping in it.It is light; therefore, it can be easily moved from one room to another, as needed. You could easily travel with it.... from hotels to the "Grandparents house." It can be folded compactly and easily stored; and, there is also a handle for carrying. The light at the top is excellent for those who wish to co-sleep as well.  ***Obviously, do not leave your child unsupervised in it!**It is excellent and I highly recommend it to ALL parents!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I loved having my daughter right next to me in bed. She must have also loved it because she slept WAY better in here! She would sometimes get herself smooshed down in the bottom, or stick her leg out the side, but I still felt very safe with her in it.  I think I would have liked it a little better if it didn\'t fold and the sides were hard all around. But that\'s just me...It made a good travel bed, too!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: Just got this sleeper for my 15 days old new born. She is 20.5 inches and this is short in height already. The foot step is non removable !!!Returned the product without using it! The product is good though, if not for the length, I would have used it.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This item saved the day...or maybe I should say the night. My son has reflux and slept best on top of me. I went searching for something that would let him sleep good and let me get some sleep as well. The first night that we used this, he slept for 4 hours straight and seemed very content with the fact that when he woke up he could see me and hold my hand. We both love this item! It has made bed time a lot more bearable.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: After I examined the product more closely, the cloth part where the infant\'s head would be resting, needs to be completely made of mesh and allow air to flow freely. There is a small piece of mesh on either side, but no where near sufficient to keep air flowing. My 2 week old is able to roll onto his side and he can easily move his face into the cloth, which is just like a cloth bumper, and potentially suffocate himself. If your child doesn\'t roll and will stay in the middle, then this product may work for you. I returned it. Wish this company could design a better product for co-sleeping.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: She has had her share of problems and cannot move much so with mostly breast feeding this has been a big help.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: My niece\'s baby was born at 28 weeks. I knew when she came home she would want to keep him close. Knowing the dangers of sleeping with an infant, I saw this and thought it would be perfect. She is absolutely thrilled with it. Since she is nursing, it is be handy to have baby nearby. Also she loved the little nightlight at the top that she can use to check on baby.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: Currently our 2 week old baby (6lb12) is sleeping between us in bed, and won\'t sleep anywhere else. We\'re worried about rolling over and squashing him, and this looks like perfect solution.So why won\'t Amazon sell it, or even ship it, to the UK?

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: We haven\'t gotten this good of sleep since he was born.  We got it yesterday and slept awesome last night.  We didn\'t have to get out of bed and fumble for glasses or light either because the light is built in and he was right there with us!  Thank you SO much, inventor, for making this product.  Thank you Amazon for making it cheap and getting it here one day sooner than expected!  5 stars!  :D

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: It\'s a great idea for parents of newborns. It makes night time feedings in those early weeks easier because you aren\'t getting out of bed, you just roll over and tend to your baby. But if you think you\'ll get a lot of time with this product, you\'re wrong. The inside is short which greatly prohibits the amount of time your baby will be in it. It would have been better if the little yellow bar could be moved to provide extra length for your fast growing baby.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I got this so I could nap with my newborn in the bed - there are a lot of tabs and folds that I am not sure how to use, but my biggest complaint is the toxic smell it emits - like plastic.  This can\'t be good for me or baby.  I hope it airs out soon, before baby outgrows this sleeper.  Otherwise, it\'s a sturdy design for the price and works well if you want to sleep next to your little one without fear.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I was looking for something to act not only as a occasional in-bed co-sleeper, but also to help transition my daughter from the hammock-like bassinet to her crib and also to be a travel bed. This product does it all! She no longer feels lost in her crib and I took the sleeper in a suitcase (and was able to pack clothes in it to save space) and visited several different friends without having to worry about a pack-n-play or crib. It comes completely apart to machine wash and really is a great product. Sure... eventually she\'ll grow out of it (she is three months now), but I knew that in purchasing it. It is very sturdy and impossible for the sides to collapse and has plenty of side ventilation. I am extremely happy with this purchase (maybe the best thing I\'ve purchased so far)!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I so glad I bought this product. I love the nightlight and that it lays safely and comfortably on the bed.I absolutely recommend this product.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I bought this to co sleep with my newborn son, this made co sleeping easier and is easily portable, it comes with a small mattress similar to a plush changing pad, the mattress is water resistant and has a cover that is washable which is a nice feature. There are two drawbacks for me, 1. My son was 22" at birth and outgrew the 24" soon ( the lower barrier is not movable) and 2.  while the upper half is padded the lower half is just netted, my son had the habit of putting his legs out of the sleeper and would be half outside when he was a month old. Also this is just a co sleeper and not a sleep positioner.  still I like this product and would buy again if they made it in lengthier models.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: I had a wonderful baby shower this weekend with the ladies of my office, This is one of the gifts I am just dying to use - why does it have to take so long for my little angel to appear. I wish I knew how to make a list on Amazon of the must have items! Again thank you ladies!

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This item looks like a great solution as a co-sleeper but it is not. Problem #1: It\'s 17inches wide & only fits on a Eastern King size bed if there is a normal size parent on either side of this sleeper. Problem #2: Sheet is not standard & contains long strip of velcro that attaches to everything else in your laundry & has to be discarded since becomes tangled mess. Problem #3: It\'s interior is only 24 inches long, so baby quickly outgrows it. Problem #4: Exterior wall is very hard so parent\'s head can hit not to mention baby\'s head as well. What to buy instead: a changing pad that is cradle shaped to fit between the parents for about $25. It takes standard sheets (without velcro) & is soft, allowing parents to curl up with their baby while in bed & allows baby to still have her/his own space & be secure.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: like many new parents, I had lots of plans including my newborn sleeping by himself in a charming bassinet and later a crib... WELL... upon his arrival, my son showed us that he slept better between my husband and I for the first 6 weeks, plus he helped my husband and I sleep better not having to get up at every new and strange sound he made (for a new parent all the sounds are scary).  we just lifted our heads and knew he was fine, and went back to sleep.  Yes, it was a bit tight in a queen size bed, but most importantly, he was safe and we did not have to get up.  We used in bed until 6 weeks old, and then used it to transition him to his crib for the next 2 weeks.  overall, well worth it, plus easy to transport if need to spend the night at someone elses house during the first 2-3 months.

name: The First Years Close and Secure Sleeper
review: This worked great for us, for a couple of months. I think we would have co-sleept with our baby if this would have been longer. I dont feel we got our moneys worth because it wasnt used for as long as we would have liked.That being said, everything else was great. The nightlight wasnt too bright but was bright enough to find a pacifier in the night.We used this on/with a queen sized bed. It cramped our style. I ended up sleeping on my side for the duration of use with this product. A larger bed would be preferential.

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: When I opened up the box, two clips were already broken. As I was putting the little webkinz on them, another 3 or 4 fell apart just gripping the clip.  However, being anxious to just organize all these stuffed animals I didn\'t bother returning it.  Too bad the clips are made so cheaply otherwise I\'d give it 5 stars!

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: Chain was as described, the price was right, and arrived as expected. It is very durable in holding my daughter\'s 20+ stuffed animals.

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: The chain toy organizer is essential for stuffed animal storage.  The hooks are sturdy and hold quite a bit of weight.

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: My daughter has more stuffed animals than I can handle.  This was perfect to hang all her small ones on.  She loves and and actually plays with her little toys more now that she can actually see them.

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: I love this chain organizer, a few people have asked me how do they order one, its also a nice decor to a play room.

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: I bought this instead of the net. I totally recommend it. My sons is loaded with stuffed animals and it stays in the ceiling and uses way less space than a net.

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: It is just a simple chain... but it help me decluttered my daughter\'s room in minutes.

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: Basically this is a cheap looking plastic chain - I really had my doubts when we opened it up - but my hubby screwed it to a stud in the ceiling and we told our daughter to start hanging up her friends.  Unbelievably - she was able to hang every stuffed animal she had (she put two on some clips so she wouldn\'t run out of clips).  Now they are all hanging in the corner of her room instead of the floor, the bed, the dresser, etc.  They look pretty cute hanging up that way - she doesn\'t have to dig through a toy box to find the particular one she wants to play with and I can vacuum her floor!

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: This has really helped to organize my son\'s small stuffed animals. I would highly recommend it!

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: This has worked great for my sons bedroom. He did pull the screw that came with it to hang it, right out of the ceiling though while pulling stuffed animals off the clips without using the clips. He just tried to slip them off. We replaced it with a heavy duty screw in hook and its held up great! Saved so much space! It hangs behind his bedroom door so when the door is open you don\'t even see all the stuffed animals in his room!

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: I bought this a few weeks ago, and I just got around to putting it up today. My son has a "pet net" but it does not hold all of his stuffed animals. This works perfectly!! I installed it myself, and it was pretty simple. I put the animals that he plays with the most on the chain, and the ones he never touches in the net. If you are needing additional storage for all of those stuffed animals that seem to multiply, then this is it!! I will update once we have had it up for a while, and let you know how it works for us. My son is rowdy so we shall see.

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: Bought this knowing it was plastic but had no idea how cheap it would turn out to be. The clips are falling apart after one week of use and that\'s without any kids tugging at it, just mom carefully storing toys, or trying to. The plastic itself is so cheap it\'s unsightly. The length of it is nice but I wouldn\'t purchase this again. Along with poor quality I\'m disapointed at how few toys can actually be held by the clips and the chain links themselves are too narrow for toys to link directly into them. I would advise you to look around and spend more $$ if you have to!!

name: Toy Storage - Chain Gang (White) (6\' L)
review: This toy organizer works great for hanging wet mittens, scarfs and hats by the door in the winter!

name: Hoyles Super Jumbo Bridge Deck - Twin Pack
review: We use these cards to play with my mother-in-law who is legally blind with macular deneneration.  They are the best we have found for her to use and they work well for all of us.

name: Hoyles Super Jumbo Bridge Deck - Twin Pack
review: My 96 year old mom has macular degeneration and her biggest joy was toBe able to continue playing bridge. She was just about to give up until I foundThese cards. Needless to say she couldn\'t waIt until they arrived, and that they did.Much faster than ever expected. At 96 years old time takes on a different meaning.Thank you so much.

name: Marinoff Low Vision Playing Cards
review: Cards are fine and reasonably priced, but the shipping and handling cost more than the product. So I paid over $11 for one deck of cards that aren\'t especially attractive.

name: Marinoff Low Vision Playing Cards
review: These are a wonderful size.The low visions title is great.They are even bigger type than the "large" card set.

name: Marinoff Low Vision Playing Cards
review: My 87 yr old Mom is a hit at her card parties - everyone wants to use her low vision cards.

name: Marinoff Low Vision Playing Cards
review: Bought the playing cards for my ageing parents whose eyesight has diminished over the years. The cards are great and are much easier for them to see.  GREAT PRODUCT!

name: Tike Tech Double T Jogging Stroller
review: I LOVE my Double T. It is beautifully crafted in every way and the price can not be beat! It arrived in a damaged box from another retailer and pulled badly to the right. I called Tike Tech directly, left a message and got a call back in less than 24 hours. Dave from Tike Tech was very helpful, kind and easy to work with. They offered to exchange it for another if we can\'t get it corrected or for a different model, whatever we needed to be happy with their product. After my excellent customer service experience with Tike Tech, I would recommend them and their products to anyone! This has been the best customer service experience I have ever had! I am very pleased!!!

name: Tike Tech Double T Jogging Stroller
review: This stroller had everything me and my wife were looking for. Two independant reclining seats. Large all terrain tires. Hand brake. Rain cover... We could not wait for it to arrive. Hurray it\'s here!! ....wait a minute something is not right. we placed our two year old boy in the seat and pulled the canopy over him, the canopy was sitting on his head and he looks at me as if to say "you\'re kidding right?" Having the canopy touching his head would give him absolutely no relief from the hot West Texas summer sun. Then we laid him back in the seat. The mesh lining only goes up about four inches and the little brat actually climbed out of the stoller through the top. I was caught trying to hold him from falling and hold the stroller from tipping over at the same time. Our son is not by any means a giant, 67% in height and 45% in weight. This would probably be great for smaller children less than two years I would say. Much to our great disappointment we had to put the stroller back in the box and send it back the next day.

name: Cloth Diaper Doublers
review: I bought these to add an extra skin to liner layer because my cloth diaper fabric has either stopped absorbing or just cannot keep up with the heavier wetting as my son ages. These are indeed hand made as stated in the description. The fabric could probably stand to be pre-shrunk as some of them bunched in the wash but a little tugging to straighten works just fine. The fabric is nice and soft. I\'ve used machine manufactured cheap liners from BuyBuyBaby and they are very similar in design but these are much nicer fabric and USA made by hand. you cant top that! If you think you can make them yourself, then by all means do so if you have the time. They are basic but you dont need bells and whistles to absorb urine, folks. 10 bucks is a far better value than using up a bunch of my time sewing now that my kiddo is on the run. I bought one set to test them out then I bought 6 more sets. Best purchase in my diapering experience thus far.

name: Cloth Diaper Doublers
review: These are atually better then the "liners" of the same brand. They\'re cheap, and abosorb quite a bit, they\'re just small, I have to pair them with something else, and my 1 year old is not a heavy wetter. I can make better ones myself.

name: Cloth Diaper Doublers
review: I love the size of these and they absorb well, but they got all bunched up after prepping. The layers of material are not sown down and it rolled up inside. The company was very kind to refund my money because I do not use since I think it would be uncomfortable for my daughter in her diaper. Wanted to love though!

name: Infantino Euro Rider in Khaki and Black
review: I have been using Infantino EuroRider for carrying my baby and its wonderful.

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: I received an envelope with three small disks in it just as another reviewer did. There was nothing else in the envelope just the three disks. I was also surprised how lacking they were, they really do look like the free disks you get from some places. However, the smell is good but I am not sure how they will work in the nursery for our daughters diaper pail since she is not here yet. They are not very strong so I hope they will be able to mask the odor from her diapers. I am glad they were so inexpensive so I don\'t really feel like I wasted much money if they don\'t work.

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: Used this in conjunction with the Odorless Cloth Diaper Pail (7 gallon: 1-2 days) and the Carbon Odorless Cloth Diaper Pail Filters and it does a great job keeping the odors inside the cloth diaper pail instead of all over my house. They kind of smell like citrus, not the best smell, but a lot better than the smell of dirty diapers!

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: They smell wonderfeul!  After a month, they still smell great.  So they seem to do a good job.  I would recommend these!

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: Wish I had not purchased these.  They look very old and definitely do not smell like citrus.  What a cheap product...don\'t waste your money on these.  Buy the carbon odor absorbers instead!

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: Bought these for use in my cloth diaper pail.  They smelled horrible and did not deoderize anything.  Very disappointing.  Just glad I only bought one package to try first!

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: Okay, right now I\'ve had the same disk in the diaper pail for about a month, and at this point it has lost all its noticeable scent, but when I first put them in, they work pretty well for the first 2 weeks, then start getting weaker. So, if you wait longer than 3 weeks they\'re only slightly better than nothing, but when changed as advised I find them definitely worth it. Plus I like the citrus scent-- I find it much more preferable to a perfumey scent for cutting into the smell of those stinky diapers.

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: Based on other reviews I was pretty skeptical about this disc but decided to try it anyway.  When it arrived I was even more convinced I wouldn\'t like it because there\'s no way to attach it to anything--I assumed it had a sticky backing to it that you could glue to the inside of the lid or something, and it didn\'t.  It\'s just the disc.I have the Diaper Genie II elite and the solution I found is to slip the disc inbetween the blue refill and the white plastic of the pail itself (so the disc is vertical).  I remove the disc and replace it anytime I have to put in a new refill.Like another reviewer said, when you open the pail you can still smell poop, only it\'s mingled with orange.  Kind of a strange smell, but it is a huge improvement over straight poop any day.The one disc has lasted about six weeks.  That\'s in the middle of winter and the pail is next to a cold outside wall.  I\'m sure summer temperatures would change things.

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: They definitely don\'t last too long, but they definitely helped with my diaper pail for at least two weeks. I was satisfied.

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: Great product, after 2 years and lots of missed smells.  That\'s right, works great and last.

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: I guess I was expecting more than just the disks!  There was no packaging or anything, just three tiny disks in the envelope!  They looked like the free things you get from the car wash.  I was expecting a better quality product.  The smell is as expected and I know these things were cheap - but they are just surprisingly lacking!

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: I popped open the plastic and enjoyed the way the disk smelled, but when put into a diaper bucket, the scent was overwhelmed. I must conclude that these were designed to deodorize paper diaper buckets, and not cloth diaper buckets.

name: Citrus Circles Diaper Pail Deodorizing Disks
review: These produce a strong, pleasant, citrus smell that gets rid of the nasty cloth diaper smell in my nursery.  I love them and would recommend them to anyone!

name: Lambs & Ivy Hello Kitty Rug 32\'\'x32\'\'
review: Our daughter is too young to even notice, but everyone in our family is envious.  I just hope she will appreciate it when she get\'s older.  Note:  There are other items on eBay to match, like fan blades and a wall clock.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: Compared to the fuzzibunz wipes I have these are very thin; when wet they are very similar to disposable wipes. They clean well and get the job done. My only concern is that the stitching around the edges seems to be coming undone a little, so we will see how they hold up in the long run. For the price you can\'t go wrong.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I bought two packs of these for cloth diapering and they\'re great!  Material is soft, but sturdy and will hold up to lots of washing.  Excellent wipes by an excellent company!

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I\'m giving these wipes 2 stars only because if you\'d like to use them dry, they\'re very soft and a great price.  I use them as baby wipes as my son is allergic to any other prepackaged baby wipes with the exception of the Earth\'s Best.  Those are expensive so, I only use them when out of the house and I use wash cloths at home. At first glance, I LOVED these wipes as they SEEM super soft.  After wetting them, they change IMMENSELY.  They get even worse after being washed.  I had to stop using them every day as they were rubbing my son\'s little bottom raw.  In addition to all of that, after only 4 washes about half of them are falling apart.  So, if you\'re desperate for some filler wipes then go ahead although, I wouldn\'t suggest them for every day use on baby skin.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: Cloth wipes make so much sense if you are already using cloth diapers! These are so useful in cleaning up diaper messes and just for use as a nice soft washcloth to wipe down a baby\'s face. I usually use a few of these to clean up a dirty diaper and then I only have to waste one real wet wipe to make sure she\'s really clean. I throw them in my wet bag with the cloth diapers and they are washed every few days along with them :)  So easy! I bought 2 packs and there were plenty, I probably could have gotten away with just having one pack of 15.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I laughed when I saw these. I got about 30 of those cute flannel receiving blankets for my son at my baby shower. When I started cloth diapering, I just cut them up into squares and have been using them for baby wipes. They aren\'t perfectly square, but they are free, have cuter prints, and were a great way to actually use all those silly blankets!

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I wanted cotton cloths to wipe up around the house.  Wipe up around the bathroom facets to keep things clean rather than do occasional major cleaning and have it nasty most of the time.  For quick dusting sessions here and there etc.I wanted a general wipe that I could use to replace paper towels.  I was going without cleaning rather than contribute to filling the land fill with endless trash including paper towels made from trees etc.  I have always felt this way; not a recent change.  Cut up clothing for rags just was not doing it for me any more.Now I can clean as I go and throw these cloths in with the laundry and always have plenty of reusable wipes.I had purchased terry baby wipes that were not 100% cotton and only one sided.  They didn\'t hold water as well when I wanted them to and I couldn\'t squeeze them as dry as I would have liked when I wanted to wipe the surfaces dry.These all cotton, double sided, flannel, wipes are exactly what I wanted and expected.  I had dusting cloths made this way so I knew from using those what I wanted.  They were too big for the occasional wipe but these OsoCozys are just the right size.Who says there is no such thing as perfection.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: After just a few washes the multi-colored stitching around the edges are separating on many of the cloths. I\'ve decided to just use these for the diaper bag and get some much plusher and sturdier ones for home.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: These wipes are okay. The seam started coming loose the very first time I washed them. They are a little harsh on my 14 month old\'s skin, but I have read that they get better with time hopefully that is true. So far these wipes havent worked out too well, but I will come back to this review once I have washed them a few more times

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I tried to save some money and decided to try a new brand of cloth wipes. Bad idea. I just got these in the mail today and put them in the washing machine to wash with my other cloth diapers and wipes. Several are already unraveling and I haven\'t even used them yet! My Greed Mountain Diaper brand wipes are just a couple dollars more and they have held up wash after wash after wash. Go buy their\'s instead.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: These wipes work well and you get plenty for your money. The rainbow seam on a few of my wipes is unravelling after only a month, but it does not affect my ability to use the wipes. I like that these leave my baby\'s bottom dry, thus healing/preventing my baby\'s persistent diaper rashes.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: They\'re perfect - thin but strong, perfectly sized to just use one unless it\'s a really big mess. They don\'t seem to stain, and they dry in a snap. They\'re great with the Lionheart Wipes Warmer - use the bamboo ones that come with THAT for washcloths, and get these instead.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: These wipes get the job done.  They are soft and seem to be durable.  I just wet them with warm water and keep them in a wipe warmer and then wash them with the diapers.  I haven\'t tried others so don\'t have a comparison but they are just fine.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: These wipes are too thin and rough for sensitive bottoms. They\'re also a bit too small and I find I have to use more than one to get my little one\'s bottom clean after she goes number two. They\'ve gotten quite pilled and I think they\'re getting rougher and rougher with each wash. We only use them for wiping noses now. They\'re definitely not as cushy and soft as they look in the picture.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: Love these simple washable wipes.  Their colorful border is perfect for a boy or a girl.  They are small enough to fold in half and place in any empty diaper wipe container.  *I use them with a all natural home lotion mixture...to keep them nice and moist...for cleaning.These are super durable and with the natural/cream color over all they are easy to keep clean... *They don\'t seem to stain.  :-)I felt that the price was really reasonable...I searched around and found Amazon.com\'s price to be competitive...and affordable.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: These have proven to be the most useful item I\'ve received since having my baby in September. I use them for wiping up spit up, during bath time, for cleaning up "accidents" mid-diaper change, for cleaning her face, and so many other things. They are incredibly soft, come in a nice size (15/pack), and wash/wear very well.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I love these wipes.  They are the perfect size and material.  I only wish the stitching around the edges was better.  It has come off about half of the wipes in a matter of months.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: You need the warmer for reusable wipes. I have the Prince lionheart : )All the hype about bamboo sold me ... I bought the bamboo, even after reading the bad reviews ... shame on me! They did fall apart! I did not dry them, washed them on gentle, took care of them, but sadly, even after the first wash they started to fray and just fall apart. I ordered these at the same time, and, as stated in the reviews, these are great! They have held up perfectly!They not only held up, but also, you can put far more of these into the wipe warmer! That is important, because you will go through them lolI never dry them! I take them from the wash, fold them, put about 2-3 tablespoons of witch hazel in a gladware bowl with warm water then I drop them in folded, get them wet (not too wet) then transfer them to the warmer. I pour the remaining water/witch hazel into the bottom of the warmer to keep the pad wet (pad for the lionheart warmer) and done!Love these!

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: Great alternative to baby wipes. Eco friendly and safe for baby\'s skin.  They also wash nicely and are well made.  We have been using them for 4 months without having to replace them and they still look fairly new.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: As a cloth diapering mom, I wanted to also use cloth wipes.  I decided to purchase two sets of these rather than sew my own.That was a mistake.The cute colorful threads that are around the border of each cloth wipe are FRAYING. After just one wash, they started coming apart.I do like the size of them and how they feel.  I can fit them in a wipe container that once contained disposable wipes, but the fact that they are falling apart is quite disappointing.Overall, I would not recommend these wipes unless they change how they sew around the border of them.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: These are very soft and easy to use. Many people who CD keep the wipes wet. But I don\'t because of bacteria and mold. I don\'t feel it is the most safest way to use these wipes. I bought a small spray bottle and put a little soap in with water and spray the wipe and/or her bum. Love them!

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: of all the cloth wipes i have, these fell apart first and only. But they are cheap so i ordered more. better than toilet paper and less toxic/irritating.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: These are great sized squares to use for wipes.  They are also cute.  They do what they need to do when you wet them with a wipe solution (or just water).  However, the serge on the edges... after a few weeks of washing, it frays.  And, the unbleached ones seem less absorbent than the bleached ones, and tend to stain easier.  Other than that, these do well in my cloth wipe rotation.  (As another reviewer pointed out, you may want to price compare with the shipping added in, but these did the trick IMO)

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: These wipes are a great size & very soft & absorbent. The price is right and the performance delivers. No need for a wipes solution, just warm water cleans well with no irritation.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I have four different kinds of cloth baby wipes and these are my favorites. The texture is good enough to get the job done but they\'re not too thick or heavy to be cumbersome. I find myself reaching for these wipes first every time.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: they shrivel up and get very rough after washing, they are very thin and cheap feeling.  Baby washcoths work better

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: these are what they say they are "wipes" we use them all the time and even ordered a third set just to have extra for our daughters tummy ache days. they are soft and stains come out real easily.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: Not the softest wipes but great for the price. I use these to get the large portion of a mess off my daughter\'s butt and then fine tune the cleaning princess with a softer wipe. Some of them have tiny balls forming after about three months of use, but overall get the job done.

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I have tried other cloth wipes brands and love these the best.  They are super soft and fluffy, and the stitching around the edge holds up to frequent washing.  They are also a nice size: not too big, not too small.  Just perfect!!

name: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack (White)
review: I started using these wipes as soon as lo came home from hospital. I received 2 sets of these as a gift & purchased 3 sets of charlie banana. I quickly was only using the osocozy & using cb as a pee guard. These are excellent for new born poo & superior to any disposible wipe.
