Someone told me that I needed three full set ups to go back to work and pump each day. That means you need 6 breast shields-- I ordered half as many as I needed on the first try!

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: This shield is easier to clean than the ones I got with pump machine.  I also love the idea of having extras to keep rotation of cleaning them easier for me!

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: I like this complete valve assembly. I bought two so that I could have two sets of shields. One set is with me at work, and then at night that set goes home for the nanny to wash the next day. I didn\'t notice any suction difference between this one-piece design and the valves I have with a removable shield though.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: This replacement piece works better than the original that came with my pump. It is an excellent value, fits with the hoses and bottles perfectly, and has better suction.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: As many people had said, this is a great product. I haven\'t found it difficult to clean at all, and having the extra breastshields (I ordered two) saves a lot of time when trying to fit in pumpings at work--I don\'t have to worry about cleaning the parts until I get home, which is important because I only have 10 minutes to pump most of the time. However, if you worry about milk residue, bring a bottle of water and run it through into another bottle--I found that "cleans" it enough until I get home. The one-piece nature of the product also makes it less likely to spill!

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: For the mom who has to express, multiple shield sets is a must (unless you want to be washing parts constantly).  The one-piece set has worked the best for me.  My pump came with a 2-piece shield, and I\'ve dropped full bottles a few times because the shield got jostled and came apart.  The only problem with the one-piece set is that it is harder to dry in a hurry because towels can\'t get into the little nooks and crannies of the unit.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: This breast shield does its job. I just wish they still made the soft shields as those were so much more comfortable for me.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: When I bought this, the product title was not so explicit that it was one solid piece (shield + connector).  Therefore, you can\'t customize your shield size and I find it more difficult to clean than two separate pieces, and bulkier to store as well.  However, it does work with my pump; I just wish you could take the top apart.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: I love how these are all one piece - so much easier (and cheaper!) than dealing with the individual pieces.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: Mine orignially melted in the microwave when I used on of those worthless steam bags..but this product is exactly what I needed and works great.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: Totally agree.  It\'s way better than the separate one.  Easy to clean and better suck power ( I think it\'s because the different air flow design )  Highly recommend

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: only problem is that it does not come apart like the others I have.  That way they are easier to clean etc.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: This product is exactly as described. The only reason I\'m not giving 5 stars is that it\'s harder to clean than the shields that come apart as this is all one piece.  Milk gets trapped if you don\'t immediately rinse them. Also you can\'t use this with a hands free bra. They work great for me as my backup set though.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: I bought these because they were cheaper than buying shields+connectors+valves+membranes separately, and am very happy w/ them.  I also like that the tubing holes are on top and guarded by a plastic covering, so milk is not likely to get into the tubing (I have problems w/ the original connectors, where my milk sprays into the tubing holes or falls into them when the bottles are tipped).  I find them just as easy (but still annoying) to clean as the original sets.  However, I keep these at home, where I can wash them w/ nipple brushes and Dr. Brown brushes easily- I don\'t think they\'d be as easy to clean at work where I only have Medela wipes.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: According to the wife, these work better than the ones that come with the actual Medela PISA pumps.  The single piece makes it easier to clean and the bottles have no way of falling off when moving around.  The parts that come with the pump have a removable suction cup from the connector, so the connector has a chance of slipping off if its just a little bit loose.  This single piece also makes it cheaper than buying all the parts separately.

name: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review: It is very easy to use and clean. Overall, I am very happy with this product. Would not use anything else.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: We purchased 2 "Bundle Me" products but when the box arrived in the mail, they had sent only one product.  I contacted Amazon and they were apologetic and without asking any additional questions they sent me the 2nd product.  However, this required us to wait an additional week for the product to arrive in the mail.  I thought that Amazon should have at least made good on their mistake by sending the 2nd product via an express shipping method, but they did not.  As for the Bundle Me product iteself, our twins enjoy it and it helps keep them nice and warm as we enter the colder weather.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: We received the Bundle Me as a hand-me-down when pregnant with our first baby, and it has turned out to be one of my favorite items.  We live in extreme Northern New York, and the temperatures can stay below 0 degrees for weeks on end.  The Bundle Me made it possible for me to cart around my daughter on these bitter days without having to use a coat or bunting.  She actually stays warmer in this than in her bunting!  It also has the added feature of zipping off, so if she falls asleep in the car (which she often does), I can uncover her without waking her up from her nap when we get home.  I looked at the cheaper versions that fit over the carseat, but this one surrounds the baby in comfort.As far as the review that it is unsafe, I find that the harness fits tighter to my baby with the Bundle Me than with bunting and that it\'s very safe.I love this item and plan to buy one for at least two baby showers this summer.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: I wish it was invented when I was an infant. It is so soft, cuddly and snugly. This is a life saver for moms in winter months when going out with infant. My daughter was born in winter and it was such a pain to take her to the doctor every week for a month. It is when this life saver saved my life. Just pop the baby in and go no need to layer the baby up with other tons of clothes. And same with at the doctors office no need to take off tons of clothes so doctor can examine her and again putting the clothes on when the doctor is done checking her. Wow what a relief. Every house hold with infants must have this one. Thank you Bundleme for saving time, energy, and money for me.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: My son was born in the beginning of January and we\'ve used this every time we go out. It\'s easy to use and no hastle. Just put the baby in the carseat and merely zip up the two sides. I wished they made something like this to go over a carrier. I can\'t wait to purchase the Lite Bundleme for the springtime.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: This is a great product.  Once installed in the carseat, it stays put with the carseat straps easy to access.  I just strap my baby in, zip up the Bundle Me, and she stays warm and snuggly.  If we have a particularly warm winter day, I keep it in the carseat but leave it unzipped it so my baby doesn\'t get too hot.  The best thing, though, is that the Bundle Me has enough room inside to allow her arms to wiggle around and still be covered and warm.  She won\'t keep her arms underneath a regular blanket, so they get cold in the open air.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: I received the infant bundleme as a gift from my registry. My baby was born in April so we didn\'t use it a whole lot until the fall. One of the zippers broke after three months of use and we received a replacement from J.J. Cole. (Customer service was great.) This is a great product. It never occured to me to use this without a coat so we\'ve always used a coat and hat but it is very warm and I would recommend it to anyone. I\'m on Amazon now looking to purchase the toddler size.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: This is a MUST HAVE item if you have a Winter baby!  So much easier and more reliable than covering with blankets or stuffing baby into a bulky snowsuit.  It is so soft and it stays attached to the carseat so you don\'t have to worry about the wind blowing it off.  With this, baby will not ever have to breath in that cold Winter air at all!  It is just heavy/ light enough that it doesn\'t come down around baby\'s face when you cover him for a few minutes to get in and out of the cold, so he can breath easily and so can you!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: WoW! They are coming up with some of the best baby inventions! This is a must have for winter babies. My daughter is 4 months old now, and it has started to get pretty chilly where we live. I started using this last week and it is very nice to have. I don\'t have to worry about packing her with thick blankets that are sure to fall off on a windy day. It\'s also nice to not have to buy her a winter coat. This is very worth the money to me. And the color is fabulous! A+++++++++!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: This item has been a perfect replacement for a winter coat, snowsuit, etc. My daughter loves the soft lining and the more we use it the softer it gets. The zip off blanket also makes a perfect mat for her to sit/lay on. Even though the blanket does not zip all the way around it is large enough to flip up to protect from wind, rain, snow, etc. I highly recommend this item since it can be used no matter what size your baby is wearing!!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: I bought this item for my daughter\'s baby.  It is so very nice.  It fits the car seat very well.  I know this winter it will come in very handy not to have to fight with big snow suits.  I would highly recommend this item.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: Anyone who has a small baby during cool weather needs one of these. I wasnt sure if I would use it but since I put it on, it hasnt come off. It is so warm and easy to use. I just buckle in my daughter and then zip her up and off we go. I love the color cause it matches our travel system(Graco Quattro-Mocha) and the head support fits inside the bundle me so she still has head support. Its great and I HIGHLY reccomend it!

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: It is warm and comfortble. Before ordering it I read other reviews and noticed that many parents complain that the zipper does not go all the way up - I agree, it doesn\'t. I added buttons and loops couple of inches above the zipper ends, it took just few minutes but helps a lot when it\'s cold and windy - just a suggestion, maybe someone else would find it useful too. Though you still will need warm hat and scarf too keep your baby warm.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: My husband and I love this product.  We have a 5 point hardness and it works great with it.  My son is always comfortable a cozy, and we love that if it gets too warm we can take the top off or unzip it a little more so he is never overheated.  We love it so much we plan on buying the toddle one as he get bigger.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: This is an amazing product. It can very easily be used in a stroller and a car seat. It does what it is supposed to do I.e. Keep your baby warm in those harsh wintery conditions.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: This is PERFECT for us for winter. I don\'t have to bundle/unbundle my 5 month old up everytime we need to go somewhere. Just put her in her carseat, put a hat on her, and we\'re off.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: As a mother of 7, the youngest being twin 5 mos olds... I believe this product to be one of the best investments for my little ones.  Reason being that I no longer have to bundle them all up before going outside in the bad weather.  A hat is all that is needed, even in the coldest of weather.  Cleaning these is also easy.  Throw into the washer just like any other laundry.The top unzips and can be taken off entirely.Let\'s see what else... ease of installing into a carseat is amazing.  I have 2 different snowsuits for each of my little ones (getting expensive, and it is next to impossible to fasten them into the seats easily.  This works out much better.Last but not least, I also have one of those blanket things that goes over the top of the carseat from one of my older children.  Personally I don\'t like these as cold air gets under it easily and you cannot see the babies face all that well, this product folds down just like a blanket to keep baby snug and warm and easily visible.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: This is a totally an awesome product. It will be toasty warm for the cold winters here in Maine. I would recommend the bundle me to anyone who is subjected to cool climates.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: I live in a tropical country so we naturally don\'t use any cold weather clothes or accessories.  We have booked a trip to Beijing, China in March and it was about 40 degrees (this was cold to us!) during that month.  Since we were bringing the stroller with us, i bought this to keep my baby warm, and so that i won\'t have to have her put on extra leggings (that just makes diaper changing more difficult).  Worked out pretty well.  My daughter never felt the difference in the temperature at all.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Khaki
review: We tried using a regular blanket to keep our baby warm, but they were never the right size and constantly had to be adjusted. We put this on and it fits our car seat perfectly, was easy to install and is easy to remove, and keeps our baby warm in the very cold weather we live in.

name: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Powder
review: Got this after finding out it was on sale.  It works great in a carseat during the winter.  We\'re using it now, infact.But it also works great out of the carseat.  We went to my sister\'s house for the holidays and she likes to keep it a little cold and we used this for our baby and it kept her nice and cozy.  Infact, our little girl slept through most of the night, which was a first in 2 months!

name: Winnie The Pooh - Peek a Pooh Wall Border
review: I recently painted and put up the peek-a-pooh border. I am very pleased with the border however, I will say I had difficulties matching up the green color. I painted a two-tone color, blue on the top portion of the wall and green on the bottom using the border as a chair-rail. I love it!

name: Winnie The Pooh - Peek a Pooh Wall Border
review: The border looks fantstic on the walls.  All our relatives loved it and said how professional it looked.  We did buy roll on glueto make sure it stuck to the walls, rather than wetting it and hoping it would last.  It was so easy to apply.  I enjoyed decorating my granddaughters nursery and I would recommend this border to any one who was using the Winnie the Pooh theme.

name: Winnie The Pooh - Peek a Pooh Wall Border
review: My wife and I purchased this border to go with the rest of the nursery....We love the design, however, as with the other reviewer, the border did not stick to the walls at all...We followed the directions to a "T" and an hour later, it fell off the wall in a crinkled mess....We were able to put it back up with wallpaper adhesive, but it was quite a hassle.  You would think that at fifteen dollars a strip, the self adhesive would be a little more reliable.....

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I ordered this product from Rymatt Wellness LLC assuming it would arrive in the packaging that is pictured in - absolutely not true. It arrived in a ziplock baggie which makes me think it\'s used and it\'s definitely false advertising. Gross!

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: OEM membranes work perfectly - and if you\'re having problems with building or maintaining your milk supply or getting enough suction from your pump, try replacing these.  HUGE difference IMO!

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: You really need to have some extras of these on hand, in case during a cleaning one of these tears.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I thought my Medela pump in style pump was loosing power (ie: breaking). As a part of trouble shooting the reduction in suction I ran across a sugestion to replace the membranes. When the membranes wear out they stop working as well, which causes less suction and less effective pumping. As any breast feeding mom knows, getting the most milk in the least amount of time is very important, so replacing these membranes periodically is essential. I tried purchasing them at a local store but they weren\'t available by themselves without the yellow part (and cost a lot because of the extra peices I would have had to purchase). The price was very reasonable, and they made an imediate and huge difference in the amount of milk I could collect. A very easy fix.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: i am using the same pump with the third child and all i\'ve had to replace are the membranes.  good product.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: These are exactly what I needed to allow my milk to be pumped.  There was a tear in one of mine, so I ordered these, and they fixed my pump so I could give my expressed milk to baby:)

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I ordered these membranes expecting they came in Medela packaging, and they were in a plastic ziploc bag. Otherwise they were fine.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I have not needed to open this package yet because my original membranes are still in good shape! I\'m glad to have these extras on hand and I imagine that they will last me a long time!

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: These membranes are great. If you\'re pumping it\'s good to always have extras on hand. If you find your pump losing suction, replacing the membrane is often the trick to fixing it.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: One thing I was always needing was the membranes for the Medela Pumps. The pumps are WONDERFUL- but.... they wont work without the membrane!My other kids would always find them fascinating and somehow pull them off and lose them, or while washing the pump it would get lost... these spares are wonderful!!!

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I am happy Medela makes a replacement pack but I hate the fact that I had to buy them in the first place because the ones I had fell apart.  They are very flimsy and eventually they split in half or the tabs fall off.  You have to use them or else the pump doesn\'t work so be prepared to buy several of these if you plan on breastfeeding for awhile.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: These arrived exactly as described and are essential to keeping my pump in tip top shape. Since I exclusively pump, I must change them on a regular basis to maintain good suction.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: These changed my pumping life! I thought I was drying up. Then one membrane broke, I replaced it and I was back in business! I change mine out every 2-3 months now and I pump 3 times a weekday.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I had this sent to my MIL who lives in the States since it\'s impossible to find the "membranes only" package in Canada (I could only find the "Valve+Membranes" package, which is extremely annoying if you don\'t need the valves).  I hope Medela continues to provide the "membranes only" package since it makes so much sense as the membranes themselves are so easy to lose.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I purchased these replacement membranes from ThinkFast. They arrived in the estimated time frame and they are a good consistent product. I was on the fence about buying the generics and decided to go with the medela ones. They were a little more expensive, but I know the quality is there.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I was trying to buy replacement parts for our son\'s Haberman bottle, and found the nipples easily. Amazon recommended these membranes to go with it.  Since the product description doesn\'t specify what product these are compatible with, I ordered it, but they are completely different.  The seller\'s retun policy is such that it isn\'t worth the effort.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: A much needed part for the pump but its such flimsy materiel. They always rip during washing or get swept down the drain. It\'s best to always have a few spares on deck.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: Ordered this item as a replacement. It was easy to find through Amazon and came quickly, best price as well.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: these work as intended... but a dollar a piece?  They are pretty flimsy and you will need to replace if you pump frequently or if a helper accidentally rips one.  The suction depends on these things so you should have spares, but they just seem overpriced.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: I\'m glad its so easy to order these online. I\'ve been using the PISA pump for 4 months now and the membranes wear out easily. And you can\'t pump if the membrane has a cut or crack. So its vital to always have replacements on hand.

name: Medela Spare Membranes for Breatpumps 6 Pack
review: great replacement part.  I love all of their products and will continue to buy their products.  fantastic, awesome, and I love it.

name: Arms Reach Mini Tan Dot Co-Sleeper
review: I love my mini-cosleeper!  I tried a basinette first; it was not sturdy and the mattress too thin. The baby couldn\'t sleep in in.  I recieved a pack and play as a shower gift, with a basinette feature, but it was too big and bulky for our smaller bedroom (although it has other great uses!).  In a parenting magazine I saw an advertisement for the co-sleeper and did some research online..........and I\'m a happy, NOT sleep deprived Mom.  I really wanted to have my baby close to me at night, but not in the same bed with us.  The mini-cosleeper has made that possible.  It really adorable and very sturdy.  The mattress is comfortable for my son and he sleeps well on it.  Some reviewers mentioned that it is difficult to lock into place....well, it does take some effort, but that is part of what makes it safe and sturdy.  It isn\'t extremely difficult at all, and well worth the effort.  The fabric is sturdy and very attractive.  My only complaint is that extra sheets are a bit pricey.  When my son is too big to sleep in this bed, I will use this as a changing table. This is another item that I wish I would have had for all three of my boys.  It is worth every penny.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I knew a cosleeper was a must when I found out I was having twins. I talked with many other mom\'s of twins and they also confirmed that a cosleeper was necessary. I followed other people suggestions and used the directions on the website to put it together and it was pretty easy. I put it together by myself and I was 8 months pregnant with twins so that\'s saying something. I looked back at the directions that were included in it and it would have been much more difficult. It is sturdy and exactly what I imagined it to be. It is a tad heavy to move around and so I wish it was a little lighter. Overall, I am totally happy with it and would buy it again.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I\'m so thankful I purchased this.  My son is three weeks old and prefers to be right next to me, but half the time I can get him to sleep in the co-sleeper.  One thing I like, even without him in it, is the fact that I can move more to my right (i sleep on the right side) since the co-sleeper is there.  It\'s actually given us more room in our bed.  If I could do it over again I "might" have purchased the mini because it is big, but I\'m not complaining.  We plan on keeping our son in our room until he\'s a good six months.  I didn\'t feel good about getting the mini when I won\'t know my sons weight and measurements that far ahead.*** Update ****One complaint I read a lot was the fact that the co-sleeper isn\'t even with the bed.  My son is almost 3 months old and is rolling!  I can\'t tell you how wonderful it is to place him in there and know that small dip will keep him contained.  If it was even with the bed he could potentially keep rolling until he rolled off our high bed.I\'ve also discovered that I can put his playmat in his co-sleeper and let the sounds/lights entertain him as I shower/clean and not worry about him!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I LOVED, LOVED, LOVED, using the Arms Reach Co-Sleeper. I felt so much better knowing that she was right next to me, but without the fear of smothering her etc. It was so much more convenient to not have to actually fully sit up or get up to get to her in the middle of the night, if she needed her paci, I could just reach over and find it. Breast feeding her was so much easier, neither of us fully woke up LOL. It just felt very natural and safe for me to actually be able to see her beautiful sleeping face whenever I looked over to make sure she was OK. I plan on using it again for the next one due in April!!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I am still waiting for my baby to arrive but I have pretty good idea about this. We got both mini and the original, and we thought we would keep the original. Ended up returning because it\'s bulky. We fly abroad a lot, and this one will not fit in any baggage.The baby likes it or not, that\'s another story. I am disappointed by this product as we had to return two items because they were defective. To unlock a stuck button both my husband and I, we spent more than an hour and ended up with numb hands. We expect more considering what it\'s worth. Folding and unfolding was way easier than what we expected tough.I don\'t know why people suffered that much.We are into safe co-sleeping, so ended up keeping the mini, thank god it was not defective. But be aware, convertible mini won\'t really serve as a playpen in the future, it\'s tiny. You can benefit maybe for a year or so. You can still use the bottom of the convertible mini as a storage, and put items you won\'t need immediately as it doesn\'t come with a zipper on the side.UPDATE AFTER A YEAR: We received a non defective one in the end, and we used it for approximately 4 months. Our son is huge, he outgrew it. Even at 4 months, he could barely fit. It\'s compact, we could carry it in a luggage to Europe. The concept is nice, the baby is within the arm\'s reach. However, it\'s not easy to go in and out of the bed. You can simply put a pack and play very close to the bed, it will be the same without the hassle. And accessories will be a lot cheaper. Although I had a good experience with this sleeper, I wouldn\'t buy it today.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: The product first off showed up late. Second, the product was described as new and turned out to be used, it showed up with the box literally shredded by a cat. The product even had cat hair and a few claw marks on it. I can\'t believe they charged me over $200 for it. I would not deal with them again and recommend you do not either.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: We had our first child last year and I was keen to try co-sleeping with her. I googled \'co-sleeper\' and this product ranked highly in Google and in Amazon, so I asked my sister-in-law to buy it as a baby gift.I\'m sorry I did. When did this company sell its soul and in the interests of maximum profit, decide to offer something so cheap and shoddy? I\'m sure before they became mass market and off-shore manufacturing, it would have been a far better product.Fully assembled (and I second those other reviewers who found the design and instructions un-userfriendly), you just need to put a hand on it and it wobbles. The mattress and the base it is attached to, is so thin and of such poor quality that it is impossible for the baby to lay flat on her back - she starts rolling to the far side. When she isn\'t in it, the corners of the mattress curl up. The plastic cover is just nasty.She has slept in it for just a few months and I\'m already looking for another bed. It has worn so poorly I\'d be embarrassed to give it away.I wish I had done more research as to other options and not fallen for the brand name and the pretty product picture.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I co-slept with my older children, but when I had 3 at once, I had to look at alternatives.  For the first 2 months I swaddled the triplets, lined them up on the co-sleeper and they slept right beside me.  It was WONDERFUL to have them right there.  I got as much sleep as possible as a mommy of newborn triplets.The only thing I would change is the mattress pad is very hard, but the babies did not seem to mind.Team the co-sleeper up with the "Miracle Blanket" and you have a WONDERFUL combination!!!!!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: The quality of the bed is great, and I love that eventually I\'ll be able to use it as a full sized playpen when we\'re ready. I love that I can collapse it for traveling and that it came with a tote for travel. I find the pockets on the sides of it to be very useful to stash things I may need in the middle of the night. It is an effective cosleeper and makes access to my newborn from bed easy as can be.Now, that having been said, after one month of continuous night to night use of this item I have to say I find it an inconvenience when getting in and out of bed. I have unattached it from our bed and put it against a wall where it is still easily accessible at night, but where I won\'t find it such an obstacle to climb around.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I looked around a lot for a product where I could keep my twins close at night. The idea of having 2 seperate bassinets was just not going to work. I didn\'t want to seperate my twins & wanted the convenience of having them at arm\'s reach. My twins are 2 months now & so far the co-sleeper has been very convenient. I could just pick them right up & start feeding. If they cry, I don\'t need to get out of bed to check up on them. I could just pat them while I\'m still laying down. The only inconvenience is the size. Of course I need it to be big so I could fit them both. But it takes up about half the size of my Cal King bed. I have to crawl half way down to get out. But other than that, I really like it. It has side compartments to keep receiving blankets & burp cloths handy. I\'m glad I purchased it & would recommend it. No one said being a mom is going to be easy.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I love our Co-sleeper!!! We have twin boys and they are 13 weeks and just now transitioning into their cribs. They have sleep in the co-sleeper since coming home and it is perfect! The original size is great for twins or for one baby who is bigger. The weight limit is 30 lbs. for the higher level which sold us as the pack n\'plays are only 15 lbs. I can\'t recommend this enough, it truly has been a lifesaver to just reach over and have access to a baby. You can also buy lifts, but our bed is pretty tall and we didn\'t need them.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I still have two more months before my son is born and I can test this product out for real, but it has been sitting by my bedside waiting for that day.  This the easiest thing I\'ve had to set up out of all the baby products that I have bought.  It\'s sturdy and very easily to fold down.TIPS:1. Be sure to set it up in the room that you are going to use it in.  I made the mistake of opening it up in my living room and then I had to fold it back down to fit it through my doorway to get it back into my bedroom.2. The sheets that go with it are too expensive!  I bought portable crib sheets and they fit just fine.  They may be made for a mattress that is slightly narrower and longer, but they have an elastic fitted band which makes them perfect for the mattress in this co-sleeper.  Plus they are about $8 as opposed to $15, available at BabiesRUs and there are more colors to choose from.3. Be sure to measure the height of your bed first!  My mattress is only 18 inches high, so I\'m going to have to adjust the bed frame to make it work.4. You don\'t have to pay $180 for it.  I found it at albeebaby.com for $155 including tax and shipping.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I bought this co-sleeper to use when my baby outgrows the By Your Side Sleeper which will be very soon. I was looking for something safe to put baby in to cosleep. The By Your Side Sleeper was great to use for the newborn stage and to have baby safely right in bed with you. But I needed something bigger and the Arm\'s Reach Co-sleeper was the answer. I have it set up in co-sleeper mode but I don\'t have it attached to the bed yet. I am currently using it as a changing table to get baby used to it so I can hopefully transition easier soon. The co-sleeper is a nice size and I like that it has mesh all around the mattress area on the liner for breath ability. I also love that the co-sleeper turns into a playard so I can use it after outgrows co-sleeper. It\'s a great value. It\'s a 3 in 1 deal for me: extra changing table so I don\'t have to go to baby\'s room for diaper changes in middle of night, co-sleeper soon, and then playard.I did buy extra things for the co-sleeper.I had to buy theArm\'s Reach Co-Sleeper Bassinet Leg Extension Kit, Naturalsince we have a high bed with a pillow top mattress. I haven\'t put them on since I haven\'t attached to bed yet.I boughtContinental Quilting Quilted Waterproof Multi-Use Padfor extra cushion on top of the mattress pad and it will also absorb any leaks that might happen. It fits the co-sleeper great and covers the whole mattress pad.I also boughtAmerican Baby Company Organic Interlock Pack N Play Sheetsince I wanted a nicer softer sheet. It fits the co-sleeper perfectly and its super soft.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: We are yet to try this product out with our baby (to arive any day now), but we set it up a few weeks ago with a great deal of frustration.the directions are VERY unclear.  if you do buy this I encourage you to read through all the directions and added print outs trying to explain set up and use.  It is apparent that there have been issues with the directions because of all the added instructions, including a bright paper with a 1-800 number saying call if you have troubles setting this thing up.things that really are inconvenient is lowering the bar from changing table, to co-sleepler, play yard.  the buttons are alomost imposible to find and push.  i have yet to find the right way to do this.  i have to count on my husband to be around and even then it takes him several tries.  Also, if you buy the recomended sheets and matress protectors, it is difficult to fit the matress protector under the fitted sheet without it bunching up and causing wrinkles and bumps.  What we also found to be troubling is that your bed needs to be acertain height for the co-sleeper.  you can buy leg extensions for your co-sleeper if your bed is too high, but as it turns out our bed is about four inches too short for the co-sleeper.  According to the regulations.  so we were forced either to returnt the co-sleeper, raise the height of the bed, or deal with the four inch deiscrepancy.we like the product in theory.  we like the idea of her haveing her space but still next to us.  we\'ll see how easy it will be to nurse during the night with her in the co-sleeper.bottom line... we like the idea of this co-sleeper but would like it to be more user friendly.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I purchased one of these for my baby due in November because I thought it would be easy to use - to have a play yard and a sleeper in one. I was wrong! This thing is hard to put together and hard to take down - and there is no way I would even bother packing it around for a play yard - it\'s way to bulky and heavy!!The mattress it comes with is to hard so we had to purchase a portable crib mattress to put on top of the mattress it came with. I think I could of spent 150 dollars on other things for my baby.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: We bought the co-sleeper instead of a bassinet due to it\'s flexibility.  We decided to purchase the orginal co sleeper and use this as the babies main crib until the baby is ready for a regular crib. My complaint is that it is difficult to change from play pen to co sleeper the lock on the bar is hard to figure out and the instructions are pretty vague (this is why I give the co sleeper 4 stars). Over all it took me 20 minutes to set up and no tools required.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I bought this instead of the traditional pack and play due to the higher weight capacity.  With multiples I knew the other brands would limit me after just a few months. I never used this as a co-sleeper but used the bassinet and then later on the playpen aspects of it.  LOVE IT!!!!!  Larger than other brands in terms of length/width also. We also used ours on vacation for 3 years with no fear of kiddos falling out of the bed..etc...  Love it!!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I love this! My daughter is now a little over 6 months and for 2 nights she has been in her big girl crib in her nursery...and I\'m so sad about it. We loved co-sleeping with our daughter and this product has contributed to our joy. Not only has it helped with my first time parent anxiety about \'is she breathing\', \'is she on her back\', \'is she too hot/too cool\' by her being right beside us at night, but it has been a super travel crib for us! We don\'t trust hotel cribs and when visiting family or friends who don\'t have cribs or playards, this has been perfect! She still fits in this co-sleeper. So we can still use it during travels for a few more months, until she can pull herself up. My parents have the mini co-sleeper and although she can still fit in it when we go to grandma\'s (our daughter is 16 pounds, 26 inches long now), I don\'t like using it because with her arms stretched out (like she always sleeps), they touch the sides and this wakes her up. So, I highly recommend if you are between this and the mini, to get this one if you want it to last a while. Her arms could touch the sides of the other at around 4 months. Now, we\'ll have it set up as a playard in the living room to carry outside in the backyard for summer-time fun! Great product!BTW, you don\'t have to buy Arms Reach sheets to fit. The major baby retailers sell a brand that fits them and it saves you about $10!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I think this is a great quality product, and I love the idea of it. However, I find that my son whose 7 weeks old is just not comfortable in it. It\'s not very soft and it\'s just so big for him right now. I can get him to sleep in it only if he\'s completely zonked out beforehand.I think the mini co-sleeper might have worked better for us in the beginning. The original might be better as he gets older and can use the play pen part of it.I do have to add that directions were somewhat difficult to understand without going over them many, many times.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: Ok, if you are parent desperate to have a good night sleep for you and your baby, this will definitely make it easier\'\'\'\'\'PROS\'\'\'\'\'\'a) you can see your baby and touch him (no need to wake up desperate and having to get out of bed to see if he is still breathing)b) he can see you and smell you(if he feels safe, he sleeps better)c) it is easier to move your baby from tummy position to back (SIDS prevention)d) firm but comfortable mattress (happy baby, sleepy baby, my baby hated the graco pack n play mattress)e) easy to attach to bed (or if you do not want to do it, just put the bassinet against the wall and your bed against the bassinet)f)has a separation between you and baby (one of the sides of the bassinet), that is not to high, but just enough for you to feel safe you are not going to roll on top of your baby.g) Big enough for tummy time and big enough for older infants (1 inch longer than Graco pack n play)h)Matress stands 2 inches higher than a graco playpen, so to get you baby out and on the bassinet (when you are standing up) is easier on your backi) easy to clean, one piece of fabric lining around the plastic structure (velcro)\'\'\'\'\'CONS\'\'\'\'\'a) if your bed is like mine 18 inches tall, the bassinet is a little high for you bed (it is not that bad, but it makes harder to pick your baby up and you probably will need to sit). the UNIVERSAL bassinet from their line would resolve that issue, but i could not find it anywhereb) the railing that make one of the sides go down is tricky and if you want to put it up, you need to get your baby from itc) It is not the easiest to assemble and it is heavy...even my husband has a hard time doing it and travelling with it is a hassled)it does not have wheels!!!!the mini has them, but the mini is too small for any baby more than 2 months olde)there are two things that support the mattress (the fabric lining and steel tubing) the tubing is very flimsy and if you put too much weight on one side it falls apart)f) it is uglyoverall: awesome, would buy a million times over, my baby would not sleep for 2 months (colic), a place where he likes sleeping in made the difference and now he is good sleeper and im not freaking out anymore to check on him all the time, i can just look at him breathing. ps: DO NOT BUY THE MINI, TOO SMALL

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: This is a really great idea and should be a wonderful buy. We were really looking forward to using it. However, we didn\'t realise it was only for babies up to 3 months, and it proved to be just too big for our little \'un. He just couldn\'t settle in it, and after a few attempts, we had to use a bassinet instead. We\'ll still be able to use it as a playard, but that wasn\'t what we bought it for.I\'d recommend getting the mini co-sleeper, one this big just seems a little pointless, as well as expensive

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: If you cosleep this is the best bed. It is good looking, firm for babies safety. I have it right next to our bed and it is great.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I love this product!!  I had borrowed the mini size from my friend, but at 5 months my little girl grew out of it and we still wanted her to sleep with us,  the original is much roomier.  Of course, it also takes up more space in the room.  the mattress is a little hard, but our little girl doesnt mind.  I love being able to see her lying next to me without having to worry that were going to roll over her or something.  great invention arms reach!!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: This seems like it would be a sturdy baby bed, and even with the extensions does not seem wobbly.  The problem is that is does NOT attach to a bed with a frame.  This fact is not listed anywhere in their product description either here or on their main site.  It must be attached up against the mattress, and the legs do not allow it to get anywhere close, there is about a 5 inch gap left, too much to just pull the mattress over as I also have a memory foam mattress.  So I\'m left with a bassinet that is no different from any other bassinet attached above a play pen, at twice the cost.  The quality of this product is the same as any other name brand play pen, so nothing else justifies the extra expense if it cannot in fact be used as a co-sleeper with a bed on a frame.  Very disappointed that the company doesn\'t give this information in the listing.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: My daughter is currently six months old and has been using this, in one form or another, since the day she came home from the hospital. I did have to buy the leg extensions for mine. I breastfed my baby and do not know what I would have done without this. I never would have gotten any rest. My daughter ate every two hours like clockwork. This co-sleeper allowed her to sleep close enough to be able to see, hear, and smell me. If I had put her in a different room in a crib, neither of us would have gotten any rest. When she was four months old, she started rolling and trying to push herself up, so we removed the bassinet. By then, she was sleeping through the night. We then moved it into her room (we have a video camera in there and she wears a Snuza) and she still sleeps in it. We are now trying to find her a crib.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I choose 4 instead of 5 stars only because of the mattress.The mattress is just too firm and this has been a consistent issue with everyone that bought this product.I bought a mattress topper and cut it to the shape of the co-sleeper. My infant has slept comfortably since thenNonetheless, it is a real great product. Especially for those breast feeding. I would recommend it. Also keep in mind when buying this that it comes in varying sizes. There are smaller ones out there. I got the convertible because it can be converted to a play yard has my infant gets older.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I purchased this co-sleeper because I heard it would be easier to breastfeed during the night.  While I still take her out of it to breastfeed her, I LOVE being able to have her right next to me so I can look at her while we are sleeping.  Also, I like how she has so much room so she will be in it for a few months longer than if it were a traditional bassinet.  Can\'t wait to use it as a playpen when she grows out of it!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I researched sleeping options a LOT before my baby was born. I came across arm\'s reach and decided this would be the way to go for us. My baby took to the co-sleeper immediately...only to hate it a few days later. I completely gave up hope on the co-sleeper, hoping it wouldn\'t be a complete waste seeing as I could use it as a play pen. At about 4 months, my little girl decided she liked the co-sleeper after all and she has been sleeping in it ever since. I love having her so close to me and night time feedings are a breeze.Just because Arm\'s reach talks about easy night time feedings does not mean that your baby is going to magically appear by your side everytime you have to feed. You obviously have to lift him/her out of the co-sleeper to where you are sleeping. So, people looking not to move a muscle at all to get your baby fed at night will have to keep looking. For others, this is SO much better than dragging your groggy self to the crib and lifting the baby out. I absolutely love the arm\'s reach co-sleeper and will be keeping it after my baby\'s done with it for when I have my next!pros:1. Having baby close to you, knowing she/he is safe and only an arm\'s reach away.2. Feeding in the night. You don\'t have to get out of bed AT ALL.3. Waking up to that beautiful sleeping face in the morning, nothing beats that!4. Can be used as a stand alone bassinet and changing table, too.5. Converts to a play pen for when baby grows out of the co-sleeper position. (holds up to 30lbs as a co-sleeper and up to 50lbs as a play pen)cons:1. The terrible sheet. Coarse and thin. Instead, I use Eddie Bauer\'s playpen sheet.Eddie Bauer Quilted Playpen Sheet - EcruThey fit perfectly, wash really well, are soft, thick and cheaper than the co-sleeper sheets. To keep baby safe, I also added the basic comfort sleep positioner. Basic Comfort Sleep Soundly My little girl stays on her back through the night and I sleep with peace of mind.2. Yes, it takes up quite a bit of space next to your bed, making getting out of bed a little bit of a challenge. I had quite a difficult time maneuvering myself out of bed every morning right after the delivery but I\'d definitely choose that over getting up and walking, on very little sleep, to baby\'s crib everytime she cried or wanted to be fed. It just depends on what\'s more important to you. After a month or two, I got used to it.3. Packing it up into its bag is a huge struggle.Update (january 2012): My now 4 year old used the arm\'s reach as a co-sleeper and then as a play pen, which held up very well. After she outgrew the play pen, we packed it in. We\'ve now hauled it out of storage for baby # 2! It is still in excellent condition. I\'ve now boughtAmerican Baby Company Organic Interlock Pack N Play Sheetto use with the arm\'s reach. The sheets are soft, of good quality and a great price!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: It was difficult to decide what type of bed I wanted my baby to sleep in when she arrived. There were cribs, pack \'n plays, bassinets, and then I found this co-sleeper. I sat down with my husband and read the reviews here and elsewhere. My husband was instantly hooked on the idea. On the other hand, I was worried about some of the things many reviewers had pointed out. My worries:Concern 1. Reviewers claimed the sheet was very rough against a baby\'s delicate skin.Concern 2. Reviewers claimed the mattress part was very thin and hard against the back of a baby\'s head.Concern 3. Reviewers claimed that the set-up of the unit was particular difficult and that the manual was confusing.Concern 4. Reviewers claimed that this item is much heavier than something like a Pack \'n Play, making it more difficult for travel.So, when my husband finally convinced me to order this co-sleeper, I also, in turn, purchased a new sheet and scouted out a prospective new mattress to insert if it was indeed too hard for baby. Then, I anxiously awaited the co-sleeper\'s arrival so that I could check it out first-hand.(Concern 1) The first thing I checked when it arrived was the sheet. I expected something rough and scratchy. It really isn\'t though. It isn\'t the softest sheet I\'ve ever had or felt but it is pretty soft. This being said, I\'m not sure if Arm\'s Reach has changed the sheet from the time other reviewers received the item. As it is currently, I wouldn\'t ever hesitate to put my baby\'s skin against the sheet. It\'s pretty nice. I\'m glad I got the spare sheet, but only because it\'s handy to have a spare. The spare sheet I purchased was from another reviewers recommendation. It\'s theAmerican Baby Company 100% Organic Cotton Interlock Fitted Pack N Play Sheet, Naturaland it fits well (and is soft).(Concern 2) The mattress pad is definitely not the softest mattress available. It\'s important to keep in mind that this is a good thing for infants though. If the mattress was any squishier/softer then it would be considered unsafe and a suffocation hazard too. I have no problems with putting my baby on this mattress.(Concern 3) I had my husband put together the co-sleeper. I was a bit worried that it was going to be overly complicated and cause me to get frustrated so it became his task. I watched as he set it up in about 15 minutes with no real issues. He only looked at the instructions twice--once when attaching the mattress pad to the support bars and once at the end of the construction to make sure he didn\'t miss any steps that weren\'t obvious. It really was a breeze. I have no idea what is going on with the other reviewers.(Concern 4) Now, I am not the strongest person. Okay, I am a physically weak person. At 8 months pregnant, I made my husband carry the co-sleeper box in when it arrived to our house. While in the house, I was rearranging some things and decided I wanted to move the co-sleeper (still in the box). It was a breeze. Sure, it isn\'t the lightest item, but I wouldn\'t really consider it heavy. I think it will do well being portable (it does come with a travel bag) when we visit the in-laws. I don\'t think I\'ll have any problems with taking it to the car from the house when traveling. I\'ve also moved the co-sleeper after it has been assembled and it isn\'t difficult at all.The color of the co-sleeper that I purchased (the natural) works well. It doesn\'t clash with any of our current furniture or decor. I had first thought to purchase the Coco Natural brown color, but my husband insisted that the natural color would go much better. I am glad we ended up with the natural color though. I think it is better for naptime and isn\'t so dark that I feel like I\'m putting my baby in a cave to sleep or rest. My husband did say, "It kind of looks...hospitally," and I do kind of agree. It isn\'t ugly, but it does look very clean and professional. There are no kiddy designs or colorful marks on it, but that does make it gender neutral.We didn\'t buy theleg extendersfor the co-sleeper to attach to our bed, but I do want to note that this unit is very sturdy. I have bumped it plenty of times and it has never shaken or wobbled enough for me to have any concerns at all. I\'m quite satisfied with it\'s structure.Also, just in case it isn\'t obvious from the photos here, take note that the side of the bed that can be lowered and attached to your mattress is a little higher than where the baby rests. This helps prevent the baby from rolling onto your bed while you are asleep or away.I could see this possibly posing a minor issue with moms who had to have a cesarean during childbirth. Since it does attach to the side of the bed, it takes up a good portion and you do have to scoot down a little to get off of the mattress. I had thought that if this poses an issue then maybe the dad can sleep on the side with the baby and can pass baby to mom for nightly feedings (if breastfeeding) to help out a little during recovery. It wasn\'t an issue for me though.All in all, I\'d definitely recommend this item to other parents (or soon-to-be parents) who aren\'t sure what type of bed they want to initially use for their little one. Even if you aren\'t going to breastfeed, it\'s nice to be able to check on baby frequently throughout the night without having to get up, walk around, and risk waking the little one.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I am an avid Dr Sears fan, I bought the arm\'s reach original before my baby was born.  Little did I know that I never find use for it as a co-sleeper.  My baby refused to sleep on this for 3 months, think it is way too big for a new born and the mattress "pad" that comes with it must be really uncomfortable to sleep on.  We ended up sleeping side ways on our bed and had baby in bed with us.  While the arms reach laid empty for by our bed for 3 months.  Not safe and believe only baby slept.Right before I went back to work I finally bought the Mamadoo playard topper and got him to sleep in it.  So he did use this for almost a year but mostly in the playard position.  In the end, I still have to buy him a crib.  So why pay so much money for this??If I can do it all over again, I\'d get something like the Fisher Price Rock N Play sleeper for new born stage, a good crib when baby is bigger and a pack n play for a portable sleeper.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: Item was a gift for my son and his wife who are expecting twins.  It was priced online with a healthy discount, shipped and arrived as scheduled and represents an excellent value.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: This review is for the Universal Bedside Co-Sleeper, which is exactly the same as the Original except it\'s sized for beds that are 18-24 inches tall (the Original is sized for beds that are 24 inches tall and taller).After only a few weeks of using a traditional, high-sided cradle for our baby (who gets up to nurse several times in a night), we decided that we needed something to make moving the baby between her bed and ours easier.  We chose the bedside co-sleeper and we haven\'t been disappointed.The low side of the co-sleeper is level with our mattress, and the mattress of the co-sleeper is about 4 inches lower than that.  This means that when my baby wakes in the middle of the night to nurse, I only have to lift her four inches to get her into my bed.  I don\'t even have to sit up to manage this.  Plus, since there are no bars or slats between her bed and mine, when she\'s fussy at night I can easily reach out a hand to soothe her or find the pacifier she\'s let slip from her mouth.  The four outside pockets (one on each short end and two on the long end) are convenient for holding burp cloths, extra diapers, baby wipes, etc - everything I need for late-night feeding and changing.Some reviewers have complained that the mattress is too hard.  Actually, I found that the mattress is padded but lumpy.  This is because it\'s designed to fold up (so the co-sleeper can be portable and fit into a travel bag).  I solved the problem by putting a Quilted Multi-Use Pad on top of the mattress underneath the fitted sheet.  The quilting helped smooth out the lumps and make the mattress more comfortable without making it so soft that I\'m worried about a smothering hazard.  Also, the pad is good protection for the mattress in case of nighttime accidents, since the mattress is made only of cloth with no plastic cover (unlike typical cradle mattresses).  Be sure to buy at least one extra fitted sheet when you purchase the bed (one is included with the bed itself) since regular crib or cradle sheets won\'t fit.My only complaint so far is that the solid fabric sides of the co-sleeper prevented me from hanging my baby\'s crib toys on the bed.  Otherwise, I\'ve found this bed to be an absolute lifesaver and the only kind of infant bed I would recommend.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: Please don\'t even waste your time or money with this product. We never ended up actually placing the baby in it because as its designed its difficult to place the baby in it from your bed after a midnight nurse. Our baby woke up immediately every time.

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: my 3 month old loves his co-sleeper and so do his parents! it\'s comforting to know that he can sleep in his own bed safely but he\'s still within my arm\'s reach so that i can put his pacifier back in his mouth and sooth him back to sleep. also, my son had some acid reflux and before we got medicine sometimes he would wake up coughing and kind of choking on his saliva, so it was great to be right there to make sure he was always sleeping ok.HIGHLY recommended for all parents, new and experienced!

name: Arm\'s Reach Natural Original Co-Sleeper
review: I asked my mother in law for the cosleeper because of the great reviews. We received it and automatically our complaint was the awful instructions and awful graphics to illustrate putting it together. After finally putting it together we realized this thing is huge!!!! But we didnt want the mini because it is just that miniature a growing baby wouldnt last long in the mini and you\'d have to spend more money on a crib.But as huge as this is we should\'ve just bought a crib!Cons:Sheets arent cotton, cheap polyester. Yet they charge an arm and a leg. Had to. Buy leg extenders. Leg extenders are expensive for no apparent reason!Cons/Super big issue:I washed everything because baby will be here soon. The velcro on the liner stuck to the mesh parts of the liner. I washed everything in cold water, on the delicate cycle. When i took the liner out the velcro was stuck to all the mesh parts causing the mesh to fuzz and almost tear. After being in a rage because i want everything perfect for my baby girl i then proceeded to stick the velcro together so i could dry the liner on gentle for 8 mins. I take the liner out the dryer and guess what the velcro was yet again stuck to the mesh!!!!!!I had to as gently as possible pull the velcro off the mesh which then caused the mesh to fuzz and almost tear, unacceptable!!I contacted arms reach customer service (a joke) and all they did was reiterate washing instructions(washing wasnt my problem and direct me to their 800# to pay $35 to order another liner!!!!I just purchased this cosleeper and for the liner issue  i expected as a courtesy they would send me another one without additional costs, guess not.Save your money and just buy a small crib or bassinet. Bassinets can also be used for co-sleeping as well.This is cheap and not worth it in my opinion. It should be waaaay cheaper. They use cheap materials and they do not value you as a consumer.Im upset we have this thing. And the mattress doesnt lay 100% flat either the corners turn up. Every extra item for this sleeper is another $20+ dollars. Sheets are expensive when they arent even cotton, which is better for babies.For the size of it we should\'ve bought a crib w/changing table attachment. Yes its that huge!The same size as a playpen. Defeats the purpose of space saving. And no i didnt want the mini its too small.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: perfect for protecting the seats in my new car from my kids.  they extend far enough to the sides to catch stuff that drops and in the front to catch dirty shoes.  the pockets are nice, but not great for anything that can be damaged by kicking feet.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I finally left the mommy car and went to a luxury sedan. This seat saver is exactly that! Fits nicely and has a pocket for her to keep her electronic play toys.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: The product is nice. Surface is anti-skid, holds car seat very well and fits in the car nicely.I did not find any issues with chemical odor and stains like some reviewers reported.Would recommend to anyone interested.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: What can I say It a must have with car seats, this product it as good as what you could purchase at a store. I works well.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Glad to have these heavy duty covers for the seats in our car.  The front edge of the seat is covered so the feet of children don\'t get the seat all dirty.  Very easy to use and stow away.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: They are thick but they move around so the carseat also slides around.  It\'s ok it gets the job done

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: In looking for a seat protector for my leather seats I looked at a lot of different products and ended up settling on this one which I do not regret.  I tighten the car seat down very firmly so there is definitely the distinct possibility of issues with seat wear.  Due to this protector I haven\'t had any issues over the last two years and just bought another one for our second kid.Bottom line: This item protects the seat from indentation, wear marks, and many child related messes.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: This fits perfectly in my car under the car seat.  Is good quality and durable.  Shipping was fast and I received it in the time specified.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I bought 2 of these when we got new seats for our girls.  I love them!  They keep our seats from being completely dirty.  They also help the seat grip better when being installed.  We\'ve used them on cloth interior and leather.  Both work like a champ.  My only minor irritation is that the part that stuffs into the fold of the seat is hard to get in...of course, part of that is my car.  Overall, it is a very good buy!

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: The design, fit and pocket are great.  But I have a standard britax carseat with a base that is nearly the exact same size as the mat under it.  The car seat easily ends up on the seat fabric which can defeat the purpose of the protector.  A slightly larger size would be appreciated.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Absolutely needed for anyone who has a baby or child car seat in their vehicle.  It stays in place because there is a flap of the mat that slips down between the seat and back.  It prevents all dents and/or tears that might occur from the car seat. It is also very easy to wipe off when spills occur.  Very easy to remove if used by grandparents who only have a car seat in their vehicle for occasionally use.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I bought these for my new highlander, to protect the leather.  They are excellent, wide enough, but don\'t block the seat belt.  Keep all crumbs, play dough, etc. off of my new leather seats.  Plus protect from car seats!

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: This appears to be a durable product and does a fine job of protecting my car\'s seat from the booster itself.  However, I wish it were wider so as to cover more of the car\'s seat to protect the upholstery from little feet as well, since my child uses the outside edge of the car\'s seat to climb up into his booster.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: This works with LATCH and for the price it is awesome.  Does the job!!!!  I highly recommend this product.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I found the flap that is supposed to "anchor" in the crack between the seat back and the seat cushion very hard to push into place.  I couldn\'t get it in very far resulting in the seat protector not sitting flush with the back of the seat.  It is not wide enough, barely covering the area of the car seat which rests all the way on the very edge of the cover. I may go back to using a terry cloth towel.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I have twins so these were a must once I heard of them from a friend...I was using towels for padding underneath the kiddo car seats in our new Odyssey beforehand so although the towels worked it did not look the best. These not only save your seats from indentation from the car seats but also have some extra pockets for storage..nice touch. I highly recommend them...easy to clean as well.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I needed something for our new car to protect from the wear and tear of our carseat and child climbing on the seat. This works perfectly and it doesn\'t stick out a lot from the base of the carseat. If it had, I would probably return it, fear of it being an eye-sore in the back seat. (We have tan seats.)

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I bought 2 of these, one for each vehicle, for use under our son\'s car seat. You never think things are really going to get down underneath the seat, but as soon as you remove the car seat for whatever reason you realize how mandatory this thing is. It has caught so many spills and stains that would otherwise have ruined my gray leather seats. These are a worth investment.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Good price, great item! Does exactly what it says and what I need it to. My kids have fun stashing items in the pockets, I have fun not getting my seats stained and sprinkled with cheerios!

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I was very happy with this it protects the seat as well as keep the toys organized in the car.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I have leather seats and it keeps my carseat base from sliding around and also protects my seats from the carseat so... works out well. Definitely worth it.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Fits great in the car. the storage pockets are handy although you can really only get to them when you are out of the car or if a passenger is with you.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: This is great and it stays in place. I love that is has pockets in the front for a sippy cup, snack or toy.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: It is a good product, nicely made but after using it only for a couple of weeks, I uninstalled my son\'s car seat and I noticed that it doesn\'t protect completely the leather from my back seat. What I found is a couple of dents from the pressure made by the car seat I thought they would come to normality if I gave it some time for the foam to react, but no it didn\'t. You want protection for your car? put a peace of card board underneath the car seat.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Seat cover works very well. Protectes all kinds of seats from crumbs and small spills. We have purchased a total of four of these covers.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I put this over my seat before placing my daughter\'s child seat in the vehicle. It does a great job protecting the seat while providing some extra storage. I have encouraged my wife to get one as well.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Went 2 years without something under our car seats and now that we bought these I feel a lot better about the condition of the seat underneath. The only complaint I have is the part that slides into the seat joint gets in the way of one of my \'LATCH\' hooks.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: We just got leather installed in our new Prius after seeing what the car seat did in my suv, I made sure to get these. So far, so good. Also there is a little pocket to store stuff. Would recommend.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Really helps keep the intentions off the leather seats. Design allows seat belt to easily come through slits I. The cover.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: I had bought two of them for my infant and toddler car seats. It fit the infant one perfectly, but was too small for the toddler seat. It is well made and I liked it. Just make sure that it will fit your car seat before you purchase it :).

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: This has saved more messes than I realized would be coming!  I just take it out and spray it off.  Perfect!

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: This is well worth the price to protect you car seat.  We didn\'t use it with our first car seat and there are now permanent markings on our car seat.  Now that we have a second child, we are using this to save the other seat from the same fate.  I also love the extra storage instead of having toys strewn all over my car.  Having the toys contained also creates more safety in my car since they wouldn\'t become projectiles in a crash.  Great product!

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: It protects the seats well and is easy to clean and install.  Also works great if you use LATCH system.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: The shape of this protector has worked well with both my Honda bench seat and a Tahoe captain\'s chair. There is a flap on the bottom in the middle that is meant to tuck into the seat crease, so as to help with upwards or downwards sliding. This didn\'t tuck in so well with the bench seat, but worked perfectly on the captain\'s chair. The protector doesn\'t slide anyways.  The nonslip material on the bottom works great. The only think I would change is to make it so that it can be used with a forward-facing seat as well. With a forward-facing seat, the bottom portion of the seat is still surrounded, but the upper back of the child\'s seat is still pressing into the actual car seat.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: does what its supposed to do.This is a standard product. I have nothing more to say about it...thanks

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Thry work great but it was a pain latching there car seats in the hooks but I have three of these lined in my car so im sufe wuth just one it wouldve been a lot easier.  Awesome product!

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Fits perfectly in my Hyundai Car. Easy to fix and gives good support to car seat/base. Wide enough for my car seat. Has storage pocket but I am not sure if I will need it as I already have back seat organizer and diapering station to go.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Just unfolded and place it on your seat, as simple as that!It really stabilizes the car seat and protects it from sliding out... at a very affordable price.Love Munchkin products!

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: This is the perfect mat for my Car.  Has compartments for every toy.  Great quality and very heavy duty.  Provides good protection for my seats.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: Very useful. Protects your car seats. Made with good material, easy to install, remove and clean even my kid liked it.

name: Munchkin Auto Seat Protector
review: We had the Prince Lionheart pad in our last car, but bought this one when we bought a new car with dark leather. We definitely prefer this one. So much easier to use during install and looks much better.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I am so grateful that a product like this exists now.  I had my two sons in different rooms and was finally able to find a monitor that I could hear them both.  I searched and searched for one and the money I spent for this one was well worth it.  I don\'t have one negative thing to say about this monitor.  It\'s great.  I even put the third monitor in the playroom so I could hear what was going on in there.  A great product and a must have for those with more than one child.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: This seems like the perfect solution for those with two or three children they want to monitor at the same time.  It would have been great if it actually worked.  I had nothing but static for a majority of the time.  When there wasn\'t static there was this odd clicking/popping noise.  The first night I used it, it woke me up at 2 AM making this horrible SCREECHING noise.  The only way to make it tolerable was to turn it down, so there was no point in owning it.  Thinking I had a faulty model I exchanged it for another one, only to have the same problems with the second one so I returned it as well. Another downfall is that if you only want to use 1 or 2 of the monitors you will get static in place of the ones that are not in use since the system is designed to scan all three.  VERY DISAPPOINTING.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: With 4 kids, three of whom are 3 and under, a monitor with three channels is a necessity. We tried combining several brands with two channels, but there was always interference, if it worked at all. We decided to purchase the Home Connection Monitor, even with its forbidding price, out of sheer desperation. Luckily, it has been exactly what we need: three clear channels (we have had no problems with reception thus far), two receivers which run on electricity or battery, and an intercom system built in (bonus!) so that the grown ups can communicate with one another. It also has a scan feature that, when engaged, will switch from channel to channel for a running "commentary" of each room. Only problem: the receiver "pops" occasionally. A must for those of us with lots-o-kids!

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: The idea is perfect but these monitors are not made properly. No matter what we did or what advise the company gave us we could barely hear anything thru these monitors. The monitor was with in 2 feet of the kids beds and yet even with the volume turned ALL the way up we could hardly hear them on our end! Again, its a wonderful idea but these just don\'t work right.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I received this monitoring system as a gift and I really like that it has 2 parent units and 3 room monitors. The major problems I have had with this monitor include one of the parent units not working and excessive static, even on the second channel. I also hate the lights on the parent monitor. They are VERY bright, and at first, I had a really hard time sleeping with them on. The blue light seems to be the brightest. I did call the company regarding the faulty parent unit and they gave me no hassel on the phone and said they would ship a new one out. I still have not received it, however, and it has been nearly 2 months!!!

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I purchased this item when I had my 2nd child.  I was able to put one monitor in the baby\'s nursery, one in my toddler\'s bedroom and one in the living room.  It\'s great for someone that has more than one child or even if they want to monitor more than one room.  The monitor has a setting to scan the different rooms every 4-5 seconds & an option to stay on one room by pushing whatever color button you wish.  The only thing we didn\'t care for is when we want to scan the different rooms, it was a little noisy or slight static sound and it switched to the different channels loudly.  We didn\'t like this part because we tend to be light sleepers anyway and trying to get to sleep with the scan mode was a little annoying to us.  On the other hand, we tried to ignore it because we told ourselves that we needed to monitor both children at the same time.  We ended up just selecting the baby\'s nursery as the main monitor zone during the night because of nightime feedings.  Since the children\'s bedrooms are right across the hall from each other, if the other child called us, we could hear it anyway.  It\'s still worth the price of getting it if they could just get past the scan mode maybe work on the static issues.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I purchased this monitor and upon setting it up (and yes, I made sure the parent receivers were on the same channels respectively as the monitors), there were nothing but problems. First, the scan button on one receiver was stuck, and it would not scan. I thought this was what was making the constant annoying clicking, so I exchanged the monitor for an identical one that had 2 functioning receivers. Low and behold, the clicking was still there with the new monitor!! As many other reviewers have already mentioned, you have to have the receivers turned to nearly the highest volume to hear anything at all in the room you are monitoring.
