The kicker though was that in the middle of the first night of use, something went haywire with the reception, and suddenly my child\'s room was no longer being monitored. All I could hear was very loud static. It was as though the channel had changed all on it\'s own. I keep the monitor on top of a 6 foot piece of furniture, so I knew there was no way my child had changed the channel by playing with it. So I had to take our old $20 monitor in and replace the expensive worthless one so that we could actually monitor the room. Talk about irritating. Needless to say, the monitor went back to the store the very next day.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: My husband and I bought this monitor thinking it would solve our problem of having two kids and three rooms to monitor (2bedrooms and a playroom).  Boy were we wrong.  It worked great for the first 24 hours.  After that it got squealy and get staticy one one of the channels.  When I calle dthe manufacturer they told me I hade  my receiver and monitors to close together (event though they weren\'t in the same rooms) so they sent me new power cords.  When that didn\'t work and a second channel started acting up I called to get a replacement.  But first I had to send the old one back (leaving us monitorless).  Once I received the new monitor it worked geat for 24 hours and it all started again.  I finally got a refund after about five months.  OVER ALL this product did not work the way it is supposed to and did not make our lives any easier.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: This item is awesome because it can monitor three areas of you home if you use all three bases.  Our only complaint is that sometimes there is a lot of static.  After getting the baby to sleep the last thing you want is to be woke up by your baby monitor........GRRRRR.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I read all the reviews for this product but hoped that I would get the one that acutally worked. Not the case. I didnt have any problems with static. We have a newborn and a fourteen month old. The baby was crying and I could not even hear it on the monitor with the volume turned all the way up. I returned it the next day.  The reason you are paying so much money for this monitor is the packaging. The packaging alone for this monitor is atleast $25 of the cost. Any way dont buy it,it doesent work. I have no idea how long my poor baby was crying that night. I wouldnt recommend this piece of garbage to my worst enemy. The only reason I gave this monitor 1 star is because I had to. In my book it gets no stars.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I got this for the same reason everyone else did 2 kids in different roomS and I want to be able to hear them both. I love this Monitor its a great idea if you are lucky to not have static while you are using it. Also most of the time one of my recevers wouldent let me hear noise coming from  the "A" monitor the only way I knew my son was making noise was the light being lit up. I have since swiched the monitor recevers cords that had helped now no problems but, still static. Whats a mom to do!!!

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: Well after reading some of the reviews I decided to give this monitor a shot. I was needing a second monitor do to a new baby that will soon be here. I talked to a few people and they said if I have two seperate monitors theres going to be a great chance of interferance between the two. I can monitor up 3 three rooms with the scan option, its works fine. SO far I have had no weird beeping or static. But a few of other people\'s reviews said it would pick up phone call conversations. Well my husband and I experinced that 2 times last night, one was actually inferferance from the Sheriffs office. But it only lasted a few seconds and didn\'t bother us at all, we actually think that it\'s funny. So now I have a monitor in each babys rooms and one in the living room so when my toddler is playing while I\'m getting ready I don\'t have to keep running out there to check on him, I can hear what hes doing. The walkie Talkie feature seems to be fine, we havent had any problems with that at all. I have a home that is over 4000sq ft and when I\'m in the computer room the range is fine. Unlike my Sony Baby call that would beep almost wherever I went in the house saying I was out of range. I hope this helps. These reason why I did not give this 5 stars is because we have not had this monitor that long, and are unsure of anything at this point that might happen.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: Thought this would be great for us when 2nd child was born. (we currently have a fisher price Sounds and Lights) But much to our disappointment, proved to be incompatible w/900 mghz phones and whatnot - even when not placed near phones. There was so much static - no matter what we did - as well as loud buzzing. I should note we live in private house - so there was not interference from neighbor\'s monitors. You have to monitor 1 or 3 zones - can\'t just monitor 2. Also, the most wasteful packaging I have ever seen for a product of this size! We returned it and purchased a sony 900 mghz with a lot of frequencies to choose from. Great idea for a home system - but poor execution.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: We, like many of you have been through 3 monitors since our first son was born 3 1/2 years ago.  We are now expecting our third child.  Aside from the fact that ALL THREE OTHER ONES BROKE, we needed something to cover all of their bedrooms.  After reading the negative reviews we were initailly hesitant but knowing the good luck we have had returning things to Babies/Toys r us in the past we took a chance and saved the box, receipts etc.  We have had this product for a few months and I can honestly say it has been a godsend.  It is crystal clear and does not interefere with any other electronics in the house (cordless phones, etc.)  I love the walkie-talkie feature between the 2 hansets and the scan feature for night time.  I will be sure to keep my eyues out and update this review if any problems arise in the future, but for now I give my highest recommendation to this product.  It is the only one out there of its kind and well worth the extra money for families with more than one child.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: When I received the Home Connection Monitor one of the receivers had a constant and intolerable clicking sound no matter where it was placed in my home.  The other receiver worked okay, other than that the volume was extremely low and there was a considerable amount of static.  I was unable to hear my daughter get out of bed and leave her room even at the highest volume.  Because this was the only monitor of its kind that I was able to find, I decided to give it a try despite the problems.  I even went out and purchased a new cordless phone with a different frequency to eliminate any possible interference.  We do not have a satellite dish or alarm system so these were not an issue.  After a couple of weeks of use the one working monitor began to have periods of extremely loud static, so that nothing else could be heard through it, and this soon became constant, so that it was unusable.This is the worst quality product I have ever received and I am extremely disappointed and frustrated. Despite the numerous bad reviews and obvious problems with the product, Amazon refused to cover return shipping charges when I returned it.  My advise, don\'t waste your time or money.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I purchased this monitor because I am a daycare provider and have 5 children in my care 2 and under. I needed something I could use in multiple rooms for naptime and it has been awesome.I had no problem with the clarity or reception at all and we have alot of electronics. After reading the reviews I was worried about the reception but I figured I\'d give it a try and I am so glad I did! It is much better than the monitors Ive had in the past and I have a monitor on every floor of my home. I HIGHLY recommend this.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: After not having any luck finding another monitor that would be compatible with the one I already had, I bought this one to monitor my infant,toddler and play rooms. It worked fantastic for the first 5 hours and then one reciever played static on all 3 rooms after I turned it off and back on again. The other receiver still worked, but why pay $130 and have part of it not work?  I tried all of the trouble shooting tips and this was not even mentioned. Also every 5 minutes or so, we would get a loud screech from one of the monitors. This probably because of too many other devices in our house and neighborhood that use 900 mhz and interfere. Our other one works great and uses only 49 mhz. I don\'t have the time or patience to call the Safety 1st customer service who will probably say to ship it back to the manufacturer to fix the 1 reciever. It\'s going back to the store not even 24 hours after buying it.  We are going to try one with more than 2 channels next to see if that solves the static problem.  But as far as one reciever not working at all, that is unacceptable.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I thought this monitor set would solve all our problems -- ability to listen to 2 children and have receivers in different rooms.  Yes, it does that but there is a lot of static and the receiver had to be turned up too high in order to hear the kids.  The scanning feature was a big disappointment -- probably the biggest disappointment with this unit.  The scanning feature allows you to listed to each monitor for a few seconds each. Problem is, if you are only using 2 of the 3 units then you will hear unit 1, unit 2 and then static for the unit not being used.  That is very annoying.  It should only scan units currently in use -- or at least not deliver static for the unit not used.In short, this unit offers more than is delivered.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I have a 14 month old and a 1 month old.  I read every single review about this monitor, and really did not know what to do because of all the mixed reviews.  I had tried two seperate monitors before and could not even hear my oldest son because of all the static.  Finally the day before I was induced I decided to spend the money and try this out.I LOVE IT!  I have had no problems with it.  There is no interference from the satalite, when I hang up the cordless phone it makes a short static sound, but it only lasts about 2 seconds, if that.  The only other time there is a problem with static is if the battery goes dead in the parent unit.  That too is an easy fix.  We have both of our parent units plugged in all night in our room, then during the day we bring them out to use in the rest of the house.  I only leave them on when we are using them, and the batteries hardly ever go dead.Some people complained that it is too quiet, we don\'t have that problem.  The lights on the parent unit are a little too bright, but it is easy to cope with considering the peace of mind this monitor provides.All in all, I am glad we spent the money on this monitor, and I recommend it to any one who needs to monitor more than one room at once.  It is well worth the money and there are no others like it.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: This monitor system is GREAT!  This is my third monitor purchase and definitely the best of all.  The reception is crystal clear, even with a cordless phone and wireless computer.  For anyone with more than one child, this is the way to go.  It may seem a little pricey but the fact that I can listen in on both my children without interference was worth every penny.  It will pay for itself in no time!!

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I couldnt belive it when I saw this monitor I thought it was purfect until I got it hom then threw away the recipt (big mistake) and the box (trash day too.) This Monitor is the worst monitor I have ever seen. Sure the set up is ok and it is versible but all night it makes this anoying clicking noise. The reception is horrible! When my phone rings it goes crazy! (Click...Click....Click)This thing Has kept me up every night since I have owned it. I do not recomend spending the amount of money on this monotor. I\'m going to buy a 20.00 dollor one today!

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: I have a 16 month old son and am expecting another boy in September. The children will be in different rooms so I needed a monitor that could pick up 2 rooms. I have the Safety 1st Dual Glow monitor and love it. I have actually recommended it to everyone I know that has had a baby and they all love it too. I tried a few different monitors to try with it to see if that would work to keep the one I have, but I only got static and total feed back.  Anyway, since this was from Safety 1st also, I figured it had to be just as good.  For the money you spend on this, it\'s totally not.  If you don\'t have it set up in 3 rooms one of the scan channels will give you 5 seconds of static.  It sounds like no big deal, however listening to it all day, it\'ll drive you nuts! Also, eventhough it\'s set up so you can listen to the rooms individually, you cannot listen to the other room unless you scan the entire time or walk around with both receivers on your side.  So when you go to bed, you either have to have both receivers by your head or scan all night.  That didn\'t make me feel too secure, especially with a newborn coming.  The other problem I ran into is that whenever I picked up our phone or hung it up, it popped.  It popped when the microwave ran, when a light switch was turned on, or it popped for no reason.  I returned it within a week of getting it.  I am now going to try the Sony 27 channel monitor. It\'s gotten a lot of great reviews and I still need another monitor.  September is coming soon..

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: This monitor is terrible!  I bought this one because I live in a 2-story home, and thought it would be great because I could have receivers and monitors in different locations upstairs and downstairs.  Yes, that part was fine, but all the static wasn\'t what I needed.  I tried to change all the channels on every monitor and receiver, but still got static, plus an additional beeping sound every 15 seconds. I can\'t get any sleep with all that noise.  This is the worst product you can buy for the money.  I\'m hoping the new Sony monitor will work better; it seems to have the best reviews.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: Clicking and static is the hidden surprise when you purchase this monitor set.  Don\'t even consider buying this if you own a cordless or cellular phone because it gets real interesting then.  I\'ve tried everything I can think of to improve the quality but nothing seems to work.  Save your money and buy two cheaper monitors instead.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: * This system is noisier than other products on the market.  The constant, low hum of static eventually fades into the background when monitoring just one room.  However, when scanning three rooms, you hear "static-click-static-click-static-click" as the receiver switches between rooms at five-second intervals.  This is annoying if you\'re engaged in quiet activity, like reading.* You can either listen in on one monitor or scan all three, but you cannot scan just two of the monitors.  If you have just two children that you want to monitor at the same time, your choices are to place the third monitor in another quiet room, or to double up in one of the children\'s rooms.  The latter option may increase the static problems.* The lights on the receiver are extremely bright and (if you are scanning three monitors) flash on and off at five second intervals.  This can be maddening when you\'re trying to sleep.Nevertheless, we are definitely keeping our Home Connection Monitor.  We can hear our children rolling over in their beds or sighing in their sleep.  The peace of mind that we get from monitoring our two children at night is priceless and well worth the drawbacks.

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: Okay, so I did not read the reviews until after we registered for this monitor and I figured if some people gave it good reviews than it couldn\'t be all that bad.  Boy was I wrong.  I\'m actually still trying to figure out how ANYONE could rely on this to monitor their kids - but I\'m going on the assumption that it\'s their first monitor.We have twins - 2.5 and a new baby on the way.  We just moved into a new home and we didn\'t get the built in monitor like we had in our old home because it was $1400 and we just didn\'t think we could justify that.  Anyhow, the twins used a lights and sounds monitor for the past two years when we were traveling, etc. and it worked well.  However since they still need to be monitored and the new baby needs one too we looked for a multi room system to purchase.  This was the one we saw and you figure for the price it will work, right?  Well, we hooked it up on Wednesday and used it for a few nights (just for the twins as the baby is not here yet:-)).  I knew right away the sound quality was low and when we tested it, we just couldn\'t hear the little noises they make as well as we used to... but we liked some of the other features so we gave it another night.  Night two at 2:30am loud static came through and scared us both out of bed and that was followed by the mysterious clicking sound for a few moments.  Once we realized everything was okay, I told my husband I was going to look at other monitors in the morning.  So we used it for two more nights and then yesterday we went back to Toys R Us and bought the Sony 27 channel monitor that I read about online.  Some people said you could use multiple units together.So we did the at home test - tried this 900 MHz Home Connection once again and did the talk test and then unplugged it and tried the new Sony in the same room, late at night while the kids were sleeping.  I was in the room whispering and my husband was across the house cracking up laughing at the difference between the two.  He made such a big deal about how different the sound quality was that we switched them again so I could hear the difference and let me tell you there is NO COMPARISON!!!  We could not BELIEVE the sound difference.  You can hear a burp or a whimper or any little sound with the Sony and on this Home Connection you have to almost talk to hear anything.  IT IS A HORRIBLE MONITOR!!!I am so glad I went with my instinct to try another one because we cannot get over the difference in sound.  If you buy TWO Sony 27 Channel monitors it\'s $100 - VS $129 for this piece of junk.  I wouldn\'t even monitor my dogs with this one.  Tomorrow it is going back to TRU.Please do your research and if you buy two and compare them you too will be AMAZED at the sound quality from just about any other monitor than this one.  And I know I\'ve always wanted to hear every little noise my little ones made when I wasn\'t in the room just to make sure they were always safe.Truely it\'s a great concept and if it worked as well as the crazy (and costly) packaging they put it in, it would be worth twice the price.Last night we had the volume up too high on our new Sony and my daughter woke up crying around 12:30 and we both jumped out of bed. We\'ve since adjusted the volume perfectly but once again we were laying in bed laughing at just how much of a huge difference there really is.  And that\'s using the Voice Activated feature on the Sony.  You can hear EVERYTHING with it and this Home Connection did not pick up or amplify ANY sounds they made.I would not recommend this monitor to ANYONE.Hope my feedback helps in some way.  Thanks!!

name: 900 MHz Home Connection Monitor
review: We love this monitor system.  With twins we needed to be able to monitor more than one room at the same time and this does the trick.  The girls often nap in separate rooms at the same time and I can easily listen to both of the rooms with one parent unit scanning between them.  We have not had any problems with static as mentioned in a few of the other reviews but we have experienced a little feedback when we use the cordless phone within a few feet of a parent unit because they both run on the same frequency. We just step a few feet away and the feedback stops so this has not been a problem. If you have multiples or more than one child then I highly recommend this product.

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: So my son is only 6 months old, and these monitors have crapped out on us ALREADY... The base unit is the one that\'s broken, it won\'t pick up any sounds... the 2 parent units seem to be fine.  WTF?!

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: I have my daughter every other weekend. When she would sleep, I would jump to check on her when there was any type of sound that could have been a cry.  I hated how her mother\'s monitoring device had feedback and picked up everything; from a door slamming to someone bouncing a ball down the street.  At first I thought it was so silent (lack of background noise) that it would miss her grumps as she starts to wake up, not so with this device.  It was clear and picked up her first peeps.  Good stuff and thank you. - Single Dad

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: I noticed a lot of people had the same problem I had with this product. The battery operation worked fine straight out of the package, and suddenly both parent units wouldn\'t even turn on with new batteries. Distraught I just kept them plugged in, losing all convenience of having 2 parent units. But having twins, and 1 is kind of quiet when crying, I was determined to figure out why it wasn\'t working with batteries. Here\'s the solution (hope this helps!) Take a flathead screwdriver to the metal pieces which touch the batteries on the flip lid, and slightly lift the metal pieces up. Now it works great, because apparently the batteries weren\'t keeping connection! Otherwise the monitor works great for being pretty cheap.

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: We ordered this last year and it worked for what it was supposed too. We did have a lot of issues with static. However the base station just gave out, its a little annoying that it only lasted one year.

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: I have had this monitor for 7 months + now, and I loved it at first. It is super sensitive and the range is good for my house. BUT the static is now so bad that I can\'t hear him as well as I used to. I am now looking for another monitor and I am not happy about it. I recommend buying a different one from the start.

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: This is the second monitor set we have bought. We have two sets now. We really liked the set for our older child because it has a nightlight with it. This one does not. That being said, the range on this set is very good and the ability to work on two frequencies is a must for us.

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: We started using these roughly eight months ago.  One of them didn\'t work intermittently from the beginning, and now the other is having problems.  It appears to be an issue with how the contact for the batteries is made, so if you only used them on AC power this would not apply to you.  They work just fine when they work, but when this little piece of metal in the battery compartment isn\'t making contact the unit won\'t work at all.  Just a poor design.

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: Like others, I get a lot of of static.  A couple of people mentioned battery life.  Mine gets terrible battery life.

name: The First Years Two Receiver 49 MHz Monitor
review: I received this monitor at my baby shower. The monitor worked well for a few months, then suddenly the static appeared just for no reason. We tried to play with it, plugged into different outlet, switched channels, ect. with no luck. Because of the loud continuous buzzing this thing is useless.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Has been worth every penny.  If it had a plug, I\'d buy two more.Brady gives it 10 stars... he\'s 14-weeks, counting comes later.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I can\'t say enough good things about this swing! We started using it the day my son came home from the hospital and spent time in it (and often napped in it) every day until he was about 6 months old. We loved that the colors were very neutral and pleasing. Since it was in our living room we didn\'t want anything to bright or "babyish". I was a little worried about having to replace the batteries often, but we only had to change them twice in 6 months with daily use. We never used the tray so it was great that it could be completly removed - this also made it easier to get him in and out and to place blankets over him. My son loved the music and nature sounds, and they weren\'t annoying like some musical toys. He didn\'t really notice the mobile and mirror until he was about 2 months old, but once he found them, he was mesmerized. The mirror was great because he loved looking up at his reflection when the mobile wasn\'t moving. One minor issue with this swing is that is takes up a lot of space. If you have a small space then this might not be the best choice.All in all, this swing was among the best purchased we made for our baby and would recommend it to anyone!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I do like this swing and my son likes to swing in it BUT the swing speeds are crazy.  The transition from the slowest speed to the next speed is a lot and when my son was very small it almost looked like he was going to be thrown out of the swing it was going so fast. It is comfortable for him to be in and he often falls asleep in it but too bad about the swing speeds because otherwise my rating would have been a 5.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I have a 5 month old baby and this swing is her Kryptonite. She can\'t resist falling asleep to the gentle natures sounds and the smooth rocking. I got this swing from the my coworkers and I was so excited to get it. It took awhile for her to be able to use it (she was too small). But now, when I can\'t get her to nap in her crib, I put her in her swing and she goes right out. She loves the toys, and she will stay in it for a long time. I have recommended this swing to everyone I know. It\'s a definite MUST!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I just bought this and this has bee a miracle worker at times.  When he fussy or cries, we put him in there and he goes straight to sleep.  He also likes looking at the mobile and the mirror.  It does use D batteries, but it is worth it.  It can give us a break when we are tired to pick him up and cradle him to sleep.  He pretty much sleeps in there at night and he loves it.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I love that this swing goes both side to side and back and forth. i like the neutral color scheme, however i feel like if it were more colorful it would hold my 3 month old\'s attention longer. when she was just a few weeks old she would sit and nap in this swing all day, now she will only sit in it for 20-30 minutes at a time, but hey thats long enough to empty the dishwasher or start a load of laundry !! overall i have been very happy with this swing and found it well worth the money.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I received this swing as a gift for my son. Over the last seven months, I have gotten more use out of it than any other baby gift. It is strong and holds up extremely well. I love the fact that this swing doesn\'t look out of place in your home...the colors go well with all decor. I simply can\'t say enough about this swing....just BUY IT!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Kinda loud...but my daughter didn\'t seem to mind.  Great deal if you can get it on sale and it\'s an older design.  FYI, it doesn\'t plug in.  But did save many nights.  A swing is a must have for most babies.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My baby was very fussy the first 3 months and this swing was a life saver as it was one of the few things that could soothe him.  It outlasted my baby\'s 3 months of sleeping and napping in it.  He finally outgrew it, but now my nephew is using it.  And he loves it, too.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My daughter is currently 4 months old and she has loved this swing since birth!  It is so cozy and comfy, we want one that\'s adult-sized!!  We put her in it the first week of her life and she spent many comfortable naps gently swinging with the soft music playing.  As she got older, we started turning on the leaves/birds at the top, and she really enjoys watching them.  She\'s 4 months now and she doesn\'t nap in it anymore, but she loves swinging in it and watching Mommy clean up in the living room and the kitchen.  The music options are great, the speeds are really good, and the batteries seem to last a long time.  It is also easy to clean as we learned the first time she had a leak!  I highly recommend this swing.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My daughter slept in this until she was 3 months old. She has reflux real bad so this kept her upright while she slept. It has an adorable mobile that my daughter loves to watch (even now at almost 5 months old), great music (nice variety). The only thing I\'m not crazy about is the colors. I wish it was brighter, but that was my choice of course in choosing the swing. Over all, this was a gerat purchase.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My husband and i call this "The Magic Swing". Often, it was the only way to get our baby to sleep at all. After the first couple of months, it was the only thing that would ever get her to nap. It always calmed her down and was the only place i could put her so that she\'d be happy while i grabbed her milk or went to use the facilities. We have told every one of my friends to get one of these first and foremost and everyone has thanked us for the suggestion. GET THIS!!!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My son is now 8 months old (and ~19lbs) and still needs his swing most days for naptime (sometimes with the motion on and sometimes just with the "mobile" on) -- We have tried and tried to have him sleep in his crib with very minimal success.  Anyway, this swing has been wonderful for him.We did start off with the F-P Aquarium swing, but he seems to like this one better.  It is immensely easier to get your swing-napper in and out of the Papasan swing than the Aquarium one... which can be a critical factor if baby falls asleep in your arms (or while nursing) before you\'ve managed to get them in the swing!  My son seems to also enjoy the Papasan "mobile" more than the Aquarium swing -- he hardly gave the fish much notice but loves to watch the moving leaves, bird, and bugs on the Papasan.I do want to mention that we\'ve NEVER had a problem with the motor smoking or starting on fire... and in our house this swing is used a lot!!!  Plus, F-P has really, really good customer service for their swings -- when the bird on our Papasan mobile stopped moving for some reason they sent us out a whole new motor housing unit free of charge (so now... I always have a backup to keep this swing in action!).So, overall... I am extremely pleased with this swing.  Speeds and sounds are just fine and it doesn\'t seem to eat batteries the way others have.  While our Aquarium one still gets used by our son at daycare, I have to admit that were I to do it all over again... I would just buy the Papasan style.  It seems that he is more comfortable in the Papasan seat and still has room to grow (... while we sloooowly transition him to a crib).  ;)

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My son would not sleep in his crib or bassinette as a newborn and I did not like the idea of him sleeping in our bed.  This swing was the only place he would sleep well for the first few months of his life and I felt safe with him in it because it does recline to a fairly flat position. My son really liked the faster speeds.  Thanks to this swing, we both got some sleep.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Our 3 weeks old baby is very comfortable in this swing since 1 week of age. It is the only place she\'ll fall asleep in, other than our arms. Highly recommend it to all new parents especially ones with fussy infants.Update on 1/29/09This swing was soooo useful to us with our baby. We gave it to our sister when she had a baby and she found it invaluable as well. But the swings motor stopped working after 18 months (from purchase). But I think that we got good use out of it till then. My sis in law has one, which is used by my mother in law who watches 2 of her grandcildren (babies) and she wouldn\'t be able to get anything done if it were not for these swings. That swing has lasted more than 2 yrs so far. Babies sleep so well in it.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is a great swing and my daughter loves it.  She likes to look at the moving birds and leaves at the top.  I love that you can change swinging directions.  Worth every penny!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is a great swing, but with a few flaws. Firstly, it BURNS through batteries. I\'m on my 4th set in 2 months. And they are the expensive large batteries.Secondly, I wish there was more song selection. The songs are now driving me insane.Lastly, my son always falls down in the headpiece and his neck ends up all crooked. I wish the head piece was more stable. I\'m scared he\'ll develop tortecollis from this position so I limit his time in here.It is great though as an easy way to get him to sleep so I can do some chores. I know he\'ll stay in here for a good hour and nap.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is the best baby item I received at my shower.  My son has spent hours a day in it since he was born.  He loves it and it allows me to get stuff done.  He is a difficult baby (colick and reflux) but this is one thing that settles him and gives me some time to get to take a shower.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is the best swing ever!!!  Because it reclines back and is so comfy for baby, I was able to use it when my son was a newborn, before he was able to hold his head up.  He\'s almost 6 months old now and he still loves it.  He sleeps in it all the time.  At first, I almost feared he\'d prefer it over his crib.  The motor is quiet and the little bugs and leaves that spin above him are so cute, he loves them.  Even moreso, he LOVES the mirror, he looks at himself all the time and just laughs.  My friends\' babies have all loved using it when they\'re over.  My only complaint is that the music and mobile do stop after 7 minutes and you have to hit the reset button if your baby is still awake and enjoying that part of the swing.  But it\'s worth getting up to see him smile again.  I recommend this swing to everyone!  It\'s a real must-have and has been a lifesaver for us!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is the second Papasan we have purchased. The first one is still in use and going strong. It\'s in the bedroom while the new one is in the living room. Best things about it:  Baby loves the swing. I love that it is multi-directional. One baby liked to go back and forth, the other side to side.  It\'s easy to clean, easy to get baby in and out of. It\'s stable and actually stores well. This would make a great shower gift, or present from the Grandparents!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This item is the greatest thing since disposable diapers!  My grandson LOVES his, in fact; they moved it into the bedroom and the bassenette went in the family room because he sleeps so much better in the Papasan chair.It is wonderful, you owe it to yourself to get this not only for the baby\'s sake but for yours!!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This product deserves a thousand stars! I can\'t even find words to describe my gratitude for it. If you have a difficult baby, you must get this swing! After half a day or night of consoling my baby, my back is too aching to keep holding her. I would feel desperate if it weren\'t for knowing that I can always put her in this swing and she will relax and go to sleep. It has saved our lives! Not all babies need so much consoling, but if your baby happens to be colicky, this swing will become your most precious possession. It is of very nice quality- well constructed and safe, with comfortable soft lining. And it works really well. I don\'t have a single complaint about it. Also, the sounds console baby if the swinging alone doesn\'t work. And if swinging side to side doesn\'t work, then often swinging front to back will relax baby. It\'s amazing. I can\'t imagine how anyone would survive colic without it.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing is by far the best one on the market.  t was nice to change up the direction of the swing, it is easy to use, and it looks nice in your home!  Our son loved this (along with the Papasan bouncer) because it was SOOOO comfortable, and there is room to grow.  He is getting ready to use the toy attachment...He has taken many naps in this and always slept so peacefully.  He LOVED the mirror on top and that was a selling point for me.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing is by far the best one out there. I have several friends/family members who also had babies the same time I did so I saw a variety of other brands at thier homes. This swing is very high quality and one of the best features is the side to side swinging function. Most swings only go one direction, but this one allows you the freedom to use it either way. Our 2 month old loves the swing in the side to side motion...it really relaxes her when she is very fussy.  A GREAT BUY!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing is great! It provides gentle movement as my granddaughter sleeps. When she\'s awake she loves watching the moving mobile and listening to the music. She has disccovered the baby smiling back at her in the mirror. The swing also provides the incline the Dr. said my granddaughter needs for her little tummy problems.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing is really nice because it has so many options.  The seat sits up or reclines, there are several speeds, the mobile and mirror entertain our baby, and there are several different soothing sounds and a music setting.  The mobile and sounds work by themself without the swing motion and there is an automatic shut-off (as well as a reset button to restart the mobile and sounds).  The big papasan seat has been great for our newborn (in comparison to flat and straight-backed seats) and we can use the side to side or traditional swinging motion depending on what he wants.It was easy to assemble and is pretty quiet when running.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing was 1 of my best purchases. My son loves to swing & look at the birds move while listening to music. He falls asleep so fast while swinging (well by the second time pressing reset so he can hear the music). He is 11 months old & I am afraid that I am going to pack it up soon because he is too heavy. This is a great purchase & well worth the money.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We bought this for our daughter\'s new baby.  She loves it.  The grandbaby loves it.  At least I assume he loves it, he goes to sleep two minutes after it starts up.  It is a nice product and well made.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We love the swing. Bought 2 for our twins, they\'re 8 months old and still using them. There are 2 things I would change: it needs a vibrating seat or at least the option to turn on something vibrating. And I wish the seat could turn in both directions. We have limited space and have them side by side, would be nice to be able to turn the seats so that the kids can face each other. Other than that, the best investment we made for our sanity. :)

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We LOVE this swing!!!  My boy is almost 8 months old now, and we\'ve used it a TON since he was born.  It\'s been fabulous for naps and those nights when he just wouldn\'t sleep in his crib, and right now he\'s got a cold and we\'re using it so he can sleep propped up and breathe a little better.  It\'s cozy and he loves looking at himself in the mirror.  The sounds are nice enough, and the batteries last just fine.  It has seriously made our life so much easier these past months.  I recommend it to everyone!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We used this quite a bit with our premmie 4 pound baby girl as it did an excellent job of swaddling her. However, even the lowest speed felt like it might start hovering and take off! Lovely neutral calm colours and can rock side-to-side and back-and-forth which are the 2 reasons we bought it. Nice selection of music/woodsy sounds. The mirror is a wonderful idea. My baby is now (a little 14 Ibs) 7 months old and too big for it - the sitting up position seems very precarious and the tray can be kicked off easily. Quite expensive, would look at others you can use longer and perhaps a bit more portable.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: When our daughter was a mere two days old, I said to my wife, "I don\'t know how much this swing costs, but whatever it was, it was worth it."  This swing seems to help our little girl to fall asleep and *stay* asleep when other bouncy seats fail to soothe her.The swing is supposed to have six speeds, but I rarely turn it above the lowest speed.  There doesn\'t seem to be much variation among the speeds; they seem to range from "very fast" to "really fast."  Frankly, I wouldn\'t care if it only had one speed.I could go on and on about this swing, but really, what else do you need to know?  It\'s wonderful.  You should stop reading this review right now and buy it.  No, really.  Do it now.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My son would not take naps in his crib but would nap for hours in this swing.  The soothing music and sounds are very pleasant and my son likes to look at himself in the mirrored part.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is an outstanding swing in both quality and function.  Very attractive and durable as well.  The fabric seat washes well.  My son will sleep for hours in this swing, which is a huge help for his reflux.  He is only 4 weeks old and is already entertained by the music and the birdies flying overhead.  As a newborn he fits into the swing nicely, and there is clearly much more use of this swing for months to come.  Batteries seem to last a long time, we have used this swing for a few hours each day over the past month.  This swing is definitely worth the extra expense!Update March 06:  at 7 months, my son continues to enjoy this swing.  It has now become a fun enjoyable time for him to sit upright and play with the toy tray, enjoy the mirror and singing birdies overhead, and also his favorite place to watch his video.  This is a great swing that can be used right from birth until they are tipping it over!  Sill a great buy in my opinion.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Al principio no sabía si comprar esta silla u otra. Sin embargo luego de leer las recomendaciones de los otros papás me decidí. Me llegó en una semana, la caja no es grande ( la imaginaba más grande), sin embargo, tuve que armarla, lo que me llevó 20 minutos aproximadamente. Armar la silla fue bastante sencillo, las instrucciones dejan todo claro. Una vez armada sentamos a nuestra hija Sonsoles y ..... le encantó. Ella tiene 4 meses y de inmediato quedó encantada con la música y el movimiento. Además, el espejo que trae en la parte inferior le llamó la atención. Estuvimos toda la tarde viendo como jugaba con su nueva silla y lo mejor de todo es que me di cuenta que no boté el dinero en esta compra. Otro punto importante es que usa 4 pilas grandes "D" de 1,5 volts y el motor  hace un poco de ruido en los primeros segundos (30-45 segundos)mientras alcanza la velocidad de balanceo, luego de esto el motor no se escucha nada....Complemento de la revisión anterior (9/10/2005) (dd/mm/yyyy)Las pilas duran 1 mes aproximadamente, y ahora mi hija pesa 10 kilos y el motor de la silla a penas alcanza la velocidad para el balanceo, es decir, a este peso el motor de la silla presenta poco poder.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: ... even the slowest rocking speed was too fast for my son.  Otherwise the product is fine.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I bought this bouncer based on the positive reviews I read here but was not impressed with the product when it arrived. My husband had a heck of a time putting it together as not all of the pieces matched up. I was going to return it but found that once some of the pieces are snapped in, you can\'t take it apart; hence, I couldn\'t disassemble the bouncer to send it back. Also, the massager/vibrating function doesn\'t even work.On a positive note, the music isn\'t all that bad and the flashing lights work well. Still, I think my advice would be to purchase a different bouncer.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I bought this for my niece based upon the many glowing reviews here and elsewhere.  My sister calls me every day to tell me how much the little one loves her "schwing schwing" as they have come to call it.While awake the baby loves to look up at the mirror and see herself.  And this swing allows her to fall into a peaceful sleep for hours.A coworker also got this for her son and she was telling me how much he loves it and he is nearly 7 months old now.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: If there is one the that you MUST get for your new baby this is it!  My son just love\'s it, as do his mommy and daddy!  The motor is very quiet and the motion is smooth.  Batteries last a long time which is rare for a swing.The toy bar is removable which is good because newborns are not really into the toys.  When it comes time (around 2 months), the mobile and the overhead mirror are great.  Baby will love watching him/herself!I definitely recommend this swing!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: If you would like your child to be happy and to enjoy hours looking at their own image and swinging to musical delight this is the swing...my child is now 8 weeks old, and this swing is incredible.  I had no idea what people meant when they said that their 2, 3 or 4 month old baby enjoyed their swing (unless babies have started to verse their opinions I was skeptical).  Now I fully understand what these folks were talking about because our child loves his swing, the only bad thing is we can\'t fold it up and pack it for trips, but we did find the Fisher price Take Along that\'s great for those trips down the road.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I had a hard time deciding between this swing and the oceans wonder aquarium swing. I was concerned at how much more expensive this swing was compared to the other swing. I choose to register for this swing because 1) it looked more pleasing than the other swing in my family room and 2) many people said that it was a quietest out of all the swings.I feel like I am getting my money\'s worth because my 7 week old son loves his swing. He loves the mobile and he easily spends 1 hour or more happily swinging away. My only complaint which other people have mentioned as well is that even on the slowest setting it is a little too fast for a baby under 1 month old.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I have bought 3 diffrent cradle swings for myself and other people. This is the only 1 so far the motor has not died in. I really like this swing. The seat is nicely padded with the head rest and I love the globe mirror on the bottom. The animals around seem like they are more for others entertainment than the baby\'s because they are mounted to the sides and move and do not hang down. I also really like the nature sounds. My daughter and nephew seem like they enjoyed the sounds. The toy bar on the front is fun nothing fancy but they entertained my nephew. This would be the perfect swing if it had an a/c adapter because it does eat batteries even the expensive ones.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I read all the reviews before purchasing this swing, and like others here, was concerned when we first set it up and saw how fast it seemed to swing.  My one-month old, however, didn\'t seem to mind a bit, and she\'s loved it ever since.  She\'s a small baby, and the headrest wasn\'t quite enough to keep her from tilting at times, so I placed a rolled cloth diaper behind each side to add extra support.  Worked like a charm.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I recommend buying an OBUS FORME (sound machine) to combat having to restart the (soon to be annoying) music/sound of the papasan, and investing in a charger with 8 D-cell batteries as you\'ll use at least 4 D\'s/month.*Don\'t forget The Happiest Baby on the Block book/DVD!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Love this swing.  The good news is that it\'s quiet, has good battery life, and you can turn on the little birds without turning on the swing.  Also, you can take off the fabric cover to wash it.  The bad news is that it takes up a lot of space and is pricy.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My son loves this swing (he is 10wks) and its the only thing he will sleep in. I love how cozy the seat is and how it fully reclines so that he can sleep lying down. I havent used the toy bar yet since he is still so small and just lies in it so far, i love that you can remove it. The mobile and mirror are wonderful. He loves looking up at the mirror, it keeps him occupied for quite a while. I also like that there are several sound/music choices. I like how you can switch the swinging motion but honestly, my son only really likes the normal front to back swing.The one thing that I HATE HATE HATE HATE with such a passion, is the fact that the music and mobile turn off after a few minutes. Oh my word it is the bain of my existence! Ok a little dramatic, but seriously. Some people may like it since it could be timed so that once the baby falls asleep it turns off. Not me though. My son startles awake every time it turns off if I dont jump up and hit the reset button fast enough. I really dont understand why there isnt an option for it to be on constantly. It is also very large and takes up a lot of space. The other thing is that I wish it could have an AC adapter so that you could plug it in. It uses 4 D batteries which are expensive and dont last as long as I would like.All in all this is a great swing that could be 5+ stars with a little improvement. I would definitely choose this one over the other types of swings.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My son loves this swing. He is 8 months old and has taken good long naps in it since we brought him  home from the hospital. It is also great for Mom because baby is entertained in this swing by the mobile and the toy bar. So Mom has time to get a shower,do laundry, dishes ect. It is lightweight. I carry it from room to room with me. I am a first time Mom and this swing is the best baby item we have bought. If you are on a limited budget, this would be the one extra item I would buy.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My son loves this swing now at 7 weeks old. He actually took his first two naps in it yesterday. I normally hold him almost all the time, but yesterday was in the upper 90s and I just needed to set him down for a while to cool off. He fell asleep.He loves how the swing goes from side to side, and about 2 weeks ago, he started noticing the mirror and mobile up above.The reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is that I think the swing is just a little too fast. We still have it on the lowest setting at 7 weeks old. He hated it at first, and I didn\'t like him being in it anyway since it was so fast.It\'s perfect now.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My wife & I were given this swing by a friend. It was quickly dubbed the dream machine. When all else fails this swing will lull our son to sleep or at the very least pacify and entertain him. I have read reviews complaining that the motor burned out prematurely. I can say that we havent had that problem and it\'s heavily used and on its second child. My only complaint is that it is not portable, nor can you plug it in. (I bought the same model with the stars for grandmas & it plugs in, big plus)

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Our daughter luvs this swing!!  Sometimes she prefers it over mommy and daddy\'s lap & her crib!!  She has become somewhat spoiled w/the comfort of the papasan, which is especially nice for her \'chunky frame\'.The only reason I didn\'t give it a 5 star rating was because the motor went out after about 8 weeks...However, all it took was a quick phone call to Fisher Price for a FREE motor re-placement & shipping.We removed & tossed the old piece and it\'s as good as new!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This has been the nicest swing.  I also used a Graco and when the baby got tired his head slumped to the side and hit the support bar when the swing was going back and forth.  This one cradles his head beautifully (and that hair rubbing off issue that has been mentioned is something that happens to a lot of babies at 3 months or so - Jack\'s hair rubbed off in the crib as he moved his head and most of the rest fell out, but at maybe 5 months it grew back.  The swing didn\'t do it to him).  He sleeps so well in this, so I can shower or do other work.  Now that he\'s 21 lbs the swing motor has to work harder - the front to back swing position works better than side to side because his heavy head can slow the swinging if it\'s to one side.  He has grabbed the animals so many times really hard and has never broken the mechanism (you can turn the mobile off so that it is out of baby\'s reach).  It is true that no matter how wide you push the legs, one seems to lift a tiny bit when it swings (on hardwood floor), but I don\'t put it above 2 speed.  The Graco also seemed to have only a very fast swing that did not relax him, whereas this Papasan is perfect.  He loves the mirror as well.  I attach toys to the tray to give him more to play with.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is a very nice swing.  The color of the swing matches almost any decor.  The seat is very plush, my daughter loves laying in it, and sleeps very well in it.  The mobile is adorable and the mirrored bottom of the mobile really keeps her attention.  She is four weeks old and was a month early.  She weighs about 8 pounds now and even the lowest setting on the swing is a little too strong.  I don\'t see much difference between the lowest setting and the stronger settings. The swing does not shut off after seven minutes only the music/mobile.  It would be convenient if this swing had a remote control so the parents could control everything with one remote. Even better would be if this swing had a plug to save on batteries.  Then it would be perfect! It is a little pricey but well worth it.  As far as the swings go this is my favorite, just has a few things that could be improved upon.  It is a little noisy swinging back and forth but that noise actually seems to sooth my daughter.  The toys on the tray could be a little more exciting but at this point my daughter is so amazed by the mirror/mobile she doesn\'t even use the tray.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is one of the best baby gear buys we made. This swing is awesome. It is a little more expensive than other models, but it is well worth it. The seat is very comfy and cozy. My 7 week old absolutely loves it and he is always looking in the mirror...it keeps him content for hours. The spinning birds and bugs are cute too. The fact that it is a neutral color makes it a great product for boys or girls and will match just about any home decor.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This purchase is worthwhile! Every other baby toy has not worked as promised but this surpassed my expectations.  My baby had colic from the time he was 2 weeks to 1 1/2 months and this was the only thing that would calm him down.  He would fall asleep in the swing happily when nothing else would work, not to mention that when mom and dad are busy it keeps him happily entertained.  The 5 different music settings are awesome, the water sound one helps him sleep and the other ones keep him occupied. He loves the mirror ball on top-- it reflects the room so he can see what\'s going on.  When he gets bored, you can switch the direction from side to side or front to back so baby has a change of motion. He happlily babbles to the rotating butterflies and flowers.  If you get no other baby toy--get this swing!!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing is probably the best baby item have. Our six-month-old daughter still loves this swing & we have gotten so much use out of it. Since she was a newborn she has been taking long naps in it & just loves the rotating birds, ect. I do wish that it rotated & played the music longer than it does before turning off, but getting up to hit the reset button is definitely worth it.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing is so nice to have.  Our baby loves her Papasan chair and this is the swing version and we have had great success with both.  The swing is easy to assemble, easy to move, and most importantly, easy to get our baby to sleep!  Our baby is too small to reach the toy bar, but we think that she will like that too.  Naptime and sometimes sleep time are easy to achieve in this swing.  Sometime the baby likes the swinging, music and mobile on, others a variation, and sometimes she just likes to lay there with all the stuff off because it is so comfy.Quality batteries last much longer than the off brands.  Make sure to put the legs back correctly after moving or it will jump a little, it takes two seconds just to make sure.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing is worth the money.  My baby was comfortable in it from the beginning and it is so quiet we don\'t even notice it.  Now that he is older, he is really enjoying watching the leaves and birds rotate and watching himself in the relective mirror above.  He also struggled badly with reflux and had to sleep at a 45% angle at all times and this swing was one of the few places where he would sleep for long stretches.  It is one of the few things I would not want to live without.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This was one of the only big things I really asked for and received as a shower gift. My 5 month old baby loves it. He enjoys the bug and birds on the mobile, and when he gets tired, he just drifts off to sleep. I have removed the tray because as he got bigger it was hard to get him in the swing with it on, and he was never interested in the toys on the tray anyway. I would definitely recommend this to someone expecting a baby or purchasing a shower gift.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We bought it because it has all the features, design, comfort that we would like our little boy to like.  Problem is, he is not convinced of it\'s benefits yet.  He might be a little too small as he sinks down pretty far.  Since it is not a good fit, yet, we really haven\'t used it for more than a couple of minutes at a time.  Unfortunately for us, he hasn\'t really taken to sleeping or being lulled by it yet.  He is really drawn to the mobile, though.  The fabric is fantastically soft, so we hope he likes it.  It is very quiet.  It has a lot of toys and other features, so again, we hope he takes to it.Update after 6 mo birthday:Still hasn\'t taken to it.  The mobile continues to draw his attention, but he won\'t last more than 5-10 minutes before beginning to cry.  The activity table might buy us a few more minutes as he chews on some of the toys, but our little guy will not give this a single "thumbs" up.  Such a shame.  Great quality, no complaints from our side, but we are too big to use it.We also have the same brand/model line "bouncey-seat" that he does like.  We can put him in it and he will rest soundly in it!  It too is incredibly soft and has a music feature built in.  Access to the battery compartment is a little difficult to work with, but not an insurmountable issue.  Very good quality and materials.  We hope it lasts, too!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We bought this swing when our son was three months old. We received the Ocean Wonders Take Along Swing as a shower gift and we loved its compact size and portability, but we wanted a full size, stationary swing as well. The idea of the back and forth and side to side motion plus the cozy looking papasan seat really appealed to us, so we decided to spend a little extra and get this swing. (We did look at the Ocean Wonders version of the cradle swing and just liked the look of Nature\'s Touch better.)For a while, our son seemed like he would never sleep through the night. For several months this swing was the only thing guaranteed to put him out and get him to stay out for several hours at a time (always supervised, of course).He\'s turning one year old in a week, and we have another baby on the way, due March 8th. I\'m sure we\'ll be putting this swing to good use again.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We got this as a shower gift from my mom and dad.  I could never thank them enough.  When my daughter started sleeping for about 5 hours at night, she wouldn\'t always be happy with going back to bed.  My husband and I would put her in the swing, and set an alarm for an hour later.  Then we would get up and put her in her crib.  My daughter also doesn\'t like sleeping in her crib during the day and she will always nap in her swing.  My daughter loves the swing and loves looking at herself in the mirror.  We use it just about every day and we haven\'t replaced the batteries yet and she will three months old on Dec 20!  I highly recommend this to any mom who may want free hands or a nap!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We just got this a few days ago but so far it\'s been great.  The music is relaxing and the swing is quiet.  I also think that the little guys on the mobile could be positioned better. Other than that my son seems comfortable in this swing and it usually calms him down and puts him to sleep when he is fussy.I did notice that the papasan swing sold at  walmart.com has an extra feature.. lights...Well so far I am very pleased with this swing.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We love this swing.  It\'s comfortable for baby, and because it swings both ways it is great at calming her.Only problem is that even on the lowest speed setting, this thing cranks!  I would have like to have a very gentle rocking motion on low, but it really swings the heck out of her at any speed.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Whenever my daughter gets fussy, we put her in the papasan and she falls right asleep. The music and built-in mobile are great for the baby, she especially likes the domed mirror under the mobile.The only con I can think of is that the motor is not very strong for a big baby. I first saw the papasan in use with my cousin\'s daughter who weighed not even 6 lbs, and I thought, cool the baby can use this for a long time.Well my baby was born at 8 lbs 1 oz and from the start the motor had trouble swinging on the first setting. So we put it on the second setting for a while but now that she is 11 lbs, it can barely swing her. Even on the highest setting the swinging gradually slows down and once I even found the thing just sitting still and my poor daughter was sitting and just staring at the mobile overhead.Still with it\'s cons, I am grateful to have this thing to put my daughter in when I have to do something else.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Our son loves his swing and so do I.  It\'s the best nap that I get out of him all day long.  He\'s 3 1/2 months old and has just discovered the mobile and mirror above him - something else for him to "talk" to:)  We have used this since he was about a month old and have replaced batteries twice, but we use this every day - several times a day.  It\'s definitely worth it and I really don\'t think that an average of once a month is bad at all.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This swing was a God send. Initially when I saw it to add to my registry I thought it looked nice and cozy with all the plush swaddling surrounding in the seat; I had no idea it would be such a KEY item for my son. My first son never enjoyed his swing, I wont mention the make but it wasnt Fisher Price. Anyhow, this swing was a definite great choice, my son practically lives in it. At night he likes to swing back and forth and sets the pace for the night and during the day he swings from side to side. He loves it, the swinging and the music. I havent gotten past the first settings with the lullabies but all of the sounds are great. I even find myself getting sleepy hearing them. It was a great buy and I definitely recommend it. I put my son in it at about a month and a half and he was only 7 lbs 9 oz. which is a nice size but not too big- by that time he had to be 8 lbs at least. I think the positioning of the seat makes it more comfortable for a smaller baby, and the more upright seating as they get older and bigger.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: She loved it for about 1 week and then it was over..It was very nicely made and loved the swinging motion of side to side(as did my daughter) the spinning animals were cute too, but she didnt seem too impressed with it after about a week.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: CMD0430 pretty much summed up this swing to a T.  I gave it 5 stars due to the fact that my little girl looooves her space pod (as we call it).  She is 7 weeks old and will fuss just to get us to put her in it.  So while my review is short, I\'m saying read CMD0430\'s review.  You\'ll read all you need to know.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is the best swing I have ever seen or used!  My daughter loves it!  My only wish is that it A) has an AC adapter so you don\'t go thru so many batteries, and B)the pillow was detachable for easy cleaning (seems the pillow gets the drool and ick faster than the seat part).  Other than that this is a great swing..highly recommend

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My 1st baby loved this swing.  We used the swing for 3 months then stored it away.  2nd baby came a year later, we used the swing for a week before it broke.  Seriously for $140 I expected this to at least last for 2 kids worth.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My wife and I have found that the papasan swing is the only place our daughter will fall asleep. Whenever we need time to ourselves for a little sumptin\' sumptin\', we plant her in the swing and do our thing.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Our son loved this swing initially-it was our last ditch effort to get him to sleep when he just can\'t be calmed down.  Unfortunately, the mobile went out 2 weeks ago and the speed of the swing has slowed more everyday.  I contacted Fischer Price 2 weeks ago and was told another motor would arrive in 10-14 days.  Long story short, I have been told 3 different things by the company and have no hopes of a replacement motor within the next 2 weeks - more than a month later is terrible customer service - especially when babies change so quickly.I\'m going to have to buy a new swing all together.  Fisher Price treats their customers poorly!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: It looks great. It appears comfortable, and it does sooth our one month old baby, albeit briefly. So far it hasn\'t either come apart or made some horrendous grinding noise as did the Ocean Wonders Aquarium Swing we bought for our first child.The problem is,every time our daughter has just fallen asleep, the music suddenly stops, immediately waking her up, usually causing a howl that would make Linda Blair proud. Who could possibly have thought this was a good idea?I will say that Fisher Price has great customer service, and quickly cheerfully sends free replacement parts for broken products, however this is unfortunately a feature rather than a defect, so no replacement is forthcoming.I would wait for the next generation of this swing, hopefully someone at Fisher Price who actually has a child will talk to the engineering department and they will correct this flaw in what is otherwise an apparently fine product. In the meantime, Stay Away, unless you want a product that causes more crying than it prevents.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My friend loved the swing until her baby got a little bigger. At 5 months old he wasn\'t able to stay in it anymore. With the swing speed as fast as it was, the baby would tend to fall to the side almost hitting his head on the side, she would have to constantly prop him back up so he wouldn\'t fall out.  The shape was comfy for baby but didn\'t give much support to hold him in.  The Graco swing I bought had enough support and restraint to keep baby in.  Great look but not safe!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: Perfect for the littlest babies.  My little girl was just under 6 pounds and it kept her snug.  The only problem we had was that she was so little, on the slowest setting I thought it would sling her out, we just put a heavy blanket in it that touched the floor and it worked perfect.  She is now 8 months old and loves to just sit in it and watch her Baby Einstein DVD\'s.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: @ 1st, we were extremily happy with the swing and our baby loves it.  Side to side was great when he was a newborn, and now the front to back is what he likes.  It is quiet, but eats d batteries quickly.HOWEVER: after only five months the motor has burned out.  Fisher price will do nothing since we do not have the original box.  For as much as this item is, and since you are supposed to be able to use it up to 24 pounds (1 year), you think it would last longer than five months. I think it is obscene that this swing basically cost us a dollar a day, not including the dollar a day battery cost.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: You need this swing.  You don\'t have to read any more reviews, just buy it. It is SO SOFT and cushioned that my baby girl loves to sit in it.  The music sounds real, not nearly as electronic as some other swings.  The mobile is adorable, and my daughter just noticed the mirror above her, and loves to talk to it.Some reviews have mentioned that the toys are boring, but I only use the swing to put her to sleep for a good nap.  I don\'t expect the swing to take place of me playing with her.  I like how the colors are so toned down - it seems to calm my baby when she\'s had too much activity.  Another concern I have read is that the swing goes too fast for some babies.  If you read the instructions, it says to drape a blanket over the swing so it drags on the ground.  IT WORKS, OK?  I would rather have to slow it down than to get a swing that barely moves my baby.  I tried the blanket draping, but my daugher would kick the blanket until it fell off, then she would go to sleep with the swing rocking her. I think it was my paranoia about her swinging too fast than an actual safety hazard.  She wasn\'t scared, and I never leave her alone in the swing, so now I just let her go.Overall, this swing is wonderful.  I love it, and my daughter loves it so much she will cry until I walk over to it, then she will smile because she knows her swing is coming!!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I loved this swing for several reasons. #1 the options for swinging patterns. #2 The mobile. #3 The mirror. #4 The fabrics #5 The music #6 The volume control on the music. I loved that I could change the way the baby could swing. My first son HATED to swing in the normal front to back pattern so I thought that having the option to swing side-to-side was pretty neat. I\'m glad that I chose this swing because my second son also wanted to swing side-to-side. My son also LOVED the mobile he would watch the birds fly around the entire time it would play...I wish that it would have played longer but I can\'t complain to much it was about 10-15 minutes if memory serves me...it has been a while now. When the mobile would cut off Andrew loved to look at himself in the mirror, he was a little vain but he IS a beautiful baby so who can blame him! :) The fabrics are so soft so it was nice for him to cuddle up in. I can\'t discuss if it washes well or not as I didn\'t have to deal with that but the fabrics seem like they would hold up well but that doesn\'t say much does it? There are also several different music choices and you can control the volume which is nice. The chair adjusts to different heights so that the baby can sit up more or less depending though my son didn\'t stay in it long enough to worry about adjusting the height. Both of my children seem to lose interest in the swing thing before 6 months but he used it daily before he got tired of it.I only have two minor complaints. This thing EATS batteries and the mobile broke after about a month. I must say that the customer service guys were great. They sent me a new motor housing and I didn\'t have a problem again. The customer service was super friendly and helpful and I had the new motor housing within a week. I am very pleased with how the company stood behind their product.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: We had picked this swing & put it on our registry when we found out we were having a girl (our 1st girl) & recieved it @ our baby shower & we loved it. It is a great color which could be used for a girl or boy unlike alot of swings are blue-which I hate. We had a graco with our 1st baby (boy) & he never seemed to like the swing much so when we had our 2nd baby boy & he absolutely hated the graco we looked for a cradle swing which I got off e-bay, it was ok but didn\'t have the braces to make it more stable-although my 2nd would actually swing in it side to side, we re-sold that one & bought the aquarium swing- it was great until it broke beyond repair-the aquarium part @ the top broke off that held the seat together. So we didn\'t really want to buy another just like it esp since we were having a girl. My 3rd baby is now 2 1/2 weeks old & she loves it. I don\'t have to worry about her head bobbing b/c of the headrest & it\'s nice & wide & extremely soft. It is by far worth the price. Everything about it is wonderful. My only gripe is that the music & mobile shuts off  after a few minutes. I love everything else about it.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: My husband and I registered for this swing and someone actually spent the money to buy it for us. It is THE BEST gift that we got for the baby. We are lucky that our son is not real fussy but everytime we put him in the swing he is out like a light. It\'s great when he doesn\'t want to go right back to sleep after those late night feedings. We have used it daily for a month and the batteries are still going strong. I highly recommend this swing.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: we co sleep and my 4 month old won\'t sleep anywhere unless I am next to her- anywhere but this swing...Once she falls asleep at night I put her in the swing and this allows me a little alone time or time with my husband. When I am ready for bed I pick her up and bring her with me!

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: This is a great product.Pros:My son seems to love it. He enjoys the swinging motion and is very comfortable in the papisan.Cons:It seems to be a little pricey.The mirror and moving animals are out of the childs sight.The lowest speed on the swing is a little bit to fast.Overall a nice swing. I would recommend this to anyone, but you might be able to find something else suitable for less money.

name: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing -  Nature\'s Touch N1973
review: I had recieved this swing for a gift off my registry list, and what a choice it was.  I am completely happy with the swing.  My son was born in April and weighed 7 lbs 7 oz.  He was very small, but we began using the swing right away.  It is the only way he would sleep when he was not laying with me.  As he has grown the swing is still his number one choice to sleep in. He is now much bigger, about 16 lbs and 26 inches long.  His feet are begining to dangle over the end.  He still loves to look at himself in the mirror and watch the birds go around his head.
