review: Overall, I think the Diaper Genie is a good product.  It\'s pretty easy to use and refill.  I don\'t think it will be good at keeping the odors concealed once my daughter starts solids.  Right now it doesn\'t contain the smell of breastfed waste.  Her nursery smells like butter when I walk in.  And I change the Genie at least twice a week.My biggest complaint is not so much the smell, but that you have to push the diaper through to a level before it actually seals the dirty diaper.  Pushing a full diaper home is not my idea of fun.I was in IKEA one day, in the changing room and the diaper pail in there was a pleasure to use.  You just put the diaper in a hole and the top rotates and viola!!  It\'s gone!  No need to touch anything.

name: Playtex Diaper Genie Twist- Away Pail System
review: First of all, I appreciate all the reviews here that were definitely helpful to my decision making process.  My review here is to serve the same purpose - helping new parents to make clear and good decision:- Pro: works great, keeps the smell inside, holds about 1 week of diapers, easy to use.- Con: like many have said - use Genie\'s plastic bags, the cutter doesn\'t give a clean cut of bag sometimes. Another issue I had with was the first few diapers might get stuck together since the bag wasn\'t twisted well enough to hold them separately.  This requires additional attention to push extra bag down to give room for the twist.

name: Playtex Diaper Genie Twist- Away Pail System
review: Our first baby is 10 days old.  She has been an easy adjustment compared to using the N&I Diaper Genie.  Hate to see what it improved from.  We received this as a gift.  I wish I had asked around before we used it.  Of course after the fact we found friends who had the same problems.  It is just a pain to use.  You have to use two hands (forget using one)  You have to get the diaper down in the base just perfect between the teeth, close the lid just so, then turn.  Half the time the turning mech. doesn\'t work or gets jammed.  The directions say two fulls turns.  Not enough,.. on the next change you just push right through to the previous diaper.  Need at least 3 to 4 turns.  It is also loud when turning at night.  Of course, you also have to buy new $5.00 cartridges but if it worked correctly I could deal with that expense.  10 days is enough, off to Babies R Us tomorrow to try something else.  One positive, appears to keep the smell contained.  But she is only 10 days old so no major poops just yet.  I would say look elsewhere.

name: Playtex Diaper Genie Twist- Away Pail System
review: I have had the "new and improved" daiper genie for about 14 months. At first it worked great: no smell at all. Then everything went to he** in a handbasket. First the lid broke off the top, now everytime I put a diaper in I have to reposition the lid. Second, the twister part on the lid broke so I have to turn the plastic ring on the inside the get it to "tie off" the daipers. Third, the cutter on the lid got worn down or something and it catches all the time and we have alot of problems getting it cut the bag. Fourth, after having it for so long, my nursery stinks to high heaven. I do change my genie often and it\'s like the smell is imbedded into the plastic so no matter what I do to clean it, it smells awful. And as a personal complaint, I can\'t stand that I have to either tip the genie on its side or lift the whole thing up off the floor while holding the trashbag underneath it to empty it. This can be very difficult to do and (on rare occasion when I haven\'t gotten a good enough tie on the end) a daiper comes flying out the top if I don\'t get every "sausage" in the trash bag on the first try. This is very disgusting. Does anyone else have that problem?P.S.-I have a 1 and 2 year old and use the stage 2 daipers. I am going to try a Neat! Diaper Disposal system and see how well it works.

name: Manhattan Toy Soft Activity Book with Tethered Toy, Buzzing Through
review: Nice soft book, interesting images and things to flip up, etc.  Only issue was one of the pages was not ironed flat properly, so kind of annoying but my baby doesn\'t notice I\'m sure.

name: Manhattan Toy Soft Activity Book with Tethered Toy, Buzzing Through
review: The book is very fun for our daughter, she is 1. She likes the bee that can buzz through the holes in the cloth pages, and she enjoys the pictures that are contained within. The only thing we didn\'t like, is that is it not nearly as vibrant in color as it shows online. The colors are more muted, and dark. We were disappointed about that, as our daughter loves neon colors, and we thought that\'s what this had. It also has a very bad crease in one of the pages, that we cannot fix or get out. It seems as though the page was sewn wrong. She still enjoys the book though. I would still purchase it if I could go back in time.

name: Manhattan Toy Soft Activity Book with Tethered Toy, Buzzing Through
review: Very nice book.  The best part is the interactive bunny that can jump through a hole from one page to another, although I wish the string attaching the bunny was a little longer.  There is a lot of texture and pieces to move back and forth, including a dragonfly on the exterior handle and the ears to the sheep on the front.Some of the pages are a little boring though and do not compete with the adjacent page for my 10 month old\'s attention.  So, some pages do not get played with as much.I Also liked the page with the birds in the nest.  I pop them up from their nest, make them dance around and put them to back to bed.  It is quite cute.  I think this page could have been a little more creative in how they designed it, but it still works.All in all, I think it is a successful book.  It is brighter and has more things going on than most.  I would definitely recommend it to friends.

name: Manhattan Toy Soft Activity Book with Tethered Toy, Buzzing Through
review: A good quality fabric/cloth book that my son will enjoy for awhile. No strange chemical smell or other weird issues, just an adorable little book of good quality.

name: Manhattan Toy Soft Activity Book with Tethered Toy, Buzzing Through
review: This was a really cute activity book. It was well made and had a variety of activities. It was a good value for the price

name: Manhattan Toy Soft Activity Book with Tethered Toy, Buzzing Through
review: I bought this in November to keep my then 9 month old daughter entertained while on an airplane.  She liked it ok and played with it a little, but it didn\'t hold her attention at all (still doesn\'t 2 months later).  It\'s a cute rhyming story and I like that each page has moving pieces to play with or suck on, but it\'s nothing special and doesn\'t warrant the enormous price tag just for a cloth book.  It costs twice as much as other books and is NOT twice as good.  I would give 4 stars if it were under ten dollars.

name: Maternity Pillow
review: I promised myself after my second pregnancy, with the next baby I\'d treat myself to a maternity pillow.  Four months into this pregnancy, I took the plunge (so tired of achy sides and not being able to sleep well).I didn\'t want to wait 2-3 weeks to get one in off of Amazon, so I snagged the last of 5 that were on Overstock.com (they also have this same pillow for $29.99) and periodically get more instock.This pillow is a good concept.  The quality is very disappointing to say the least.  The velcro tabs on the bottom of the middle panel are just about useless.  You\'re better off just shoving the pillows to where you want them than trying to get this velcro to hold the place. The pillow is merely very thin and cheap cotton fabric stuffed with regular craft polyfill.  I atleast expected to be getting something resembling the quality of two regular type pillows with some type of panel attaching them together. I think you\'re better off buying two comfortable single size pillows of your choice and nicely stitching a panel between the two to hold them together.  Carry handles are nice.On the upside I found new cases for maternity pillows from The Company Store on ebay for a steal. They fit this perfect and make it look a ton better.It is nice having something that stays in place to support the preggie belly and back.  I just expected better quality than this, esp. when other places say these retail for $50!

name: Simplicity 2 in 1 Rock \'n\' Roll Bassinet & Cradle Color: White
review: If you could give this bassinet 0 stars I would.  I am so unhappy with it.  The picture of it is very misleading.  To start the lace does not go as far as it is shown in the picture and there is a warning label very large right in the front of the bassinet in orange and the lace does not cover it up either so it is the first thing you see on the bassinet.  A really bad place to put the warning sign.  It is sewed very well on there too, we were able to get it off thankfully.  Also the music box feature with music and light and vibration is underneath the lace on the front.  Which makes having the light pointless because with the light on under the lace you can not see the light even on. If this bassinet didn\'t cost so much for shipping and to ship it back I would send it back but it is not worth the money wasted.  Please don\'t waste your money I can\'t see how anyone would be happy with this product.

name: Simplicity Ellis Combo Changer Finish: Cherry
review: I Received this item over two weeks ago and there were numerous things wrong. I immediately called target and explained the situation, they reffered me to simplicity\'s customer servive.  I have spoke to simplicity three times and was promised each time that the 3 drawers would be replaced and sent ASAP! After not receiving the 1st time, I called and was told they need the model number, I think they should have known that already. I gave them the Model number and was promised it would be shipped over night. 6 days later ( today) I called back to find out what was going on and was told every thing is on back order and they should have it in within 3 weeks. I was told they will call me when it arrives. I am expecting the kid in 1 week but still I have no functionin changing table, lets see how target wll respond? Target has refunded me 20% and offered to replace the item with another item, since I have the matching dresser there is not a similiar combo unit, so we may end up with something that does not match.

name: Simplicity Ellis Combo Changer Finish: Cherry
review: My husband and I looked everywhere for our first baby furniture and decided to go with this style. We were totally happy when the changing tower came and really excited after we got the crib in and put them all together.<br />The furniture is very well put together and we could\'nt be happier.

name: Baby Trend Playard W/Bassinet & Canopy
review: I love this playard. The only thing that needs to be improved is the changing table.The two hooks/bolts that hold the changing table to the bassinet/playard needs to be more secure. Considering all the times you are flipping it back and forth to change diapers you don\'t want the hooks to pop out. It\'s annoying.IT IS NOT DIFFICULT TO PUT TOGETHER! You just got to learn to do it right the first time. Be patient!

name: Baby Trend Playard W/Bassinet & Canopy
review: My husband and I purchased this product before our child was born. We both had an extremely hard time trying to get the sides to lock without breaking the product. Since my husband is due for another tour of Iraq it will be only me trying to set this play yard up. I can\'t do it. We went to the nearest Toys R Us and they even had a hard time with their floor model. I wish I had read the other reviews before I purchased it.

name: Baby Trend Playard W/Bassinet & Canopy
review: I am not sure of the problems the other reviewers had. I don\'t understand the problems they had putting it together after purchasing it and I am wondering also about the collapsing.  Yes, it will collapse, IF it is not properly set up, which will happen with ANY playard if not properly set up.  Maybe they didn\'t like that Baby Trend is only sold at babiesrus and toysrus, and didn\'t want to trust the item because it wasn\'t a "popular brand", or again, maybe they weren\'t reading the instructions how to properly set this up, there are enough warnings and instructions printed all over this item as well.My husband is 220 lbs and was leaning on this and it didn\'t collapse, then he and I BOTH were leaning on this and it didn\'t collapse. We took this apart and put it back together in the store with no instructions in less than 25 minutes and put it back together in no time at all.  He put this together at home in around 30 minutes without reading the instructions because there was nothing really to it, snapping on a couple of wheels, the other end feet, and snapping on the sides to the changer, big whoop.  The other stuff was a piece of cake too.  Just be sure to read the instructions though, because there are safety features regarding the handle on the bottom and how to put up and take down.I looked at all the playards at babiesrus and then all the area stores (Burlington, Sears, Kmart, Walmart, Meijer). I looked at quality, features,looks and prices.Knowing that my baby won\'t be in this item for a very long time, I didn\'t want to spend  $140.00 on a playard with the same features because I won\'t be having anymore children.  I didn\'t want a used one because I didn\'t want to take a chance with recalls and unknown problems.My husband and I while in the store took this one off the shelf, took it apart, and put it back together. At first we couldn\'t get it to lock, but then a lady with an Evenflo playard said she had to pull up the handle in the middle and then lock the sides, well when we did that, they all locked with no problem, so to be sure we could "master" this, we unlocked and locked them again, and leaned on the sides with no problem. Like I said, we did this in less than 25 minutes. I also tried the graco ones and couldn\'t get the buttons to release so I could collapse them, and after reading those reviews about not being able to put everything in the bag, decided against those, what\'s the point of taking it places and not being able to carry it all together? And the evenflo, which I did like also, you have to unsnap everything before being able to collapse. Once I got this home and read the instructions, the handle on the bottom and the way you have to rotate it to put up and take down, this is a safety feature. I liked the features, the flip away changer, the bassinet, the canopy, and the organizer. Added feature is the ruffle along the bottom. I liked the patterns on the other playards, but this one is starting to grow on me, it is a nice neutral pattern and goes well with our home and my husband liked it as well over the others. We also liked the two sectioned bag it stores in, it holds everything to the playard. I do wish it had a mattress sheet though, so I will be going to buy one at babiesrus later. My husband and I found the quality of this item comparable to the evenflo, and graco models after inspecting all of them in the stores for 3 hours. We liked the price of this one for the quality and features we were looking for.Good luck to everyone and I hope this helps someone, especially, after reading all the other scary reviews on this. I don\'t think it was fair to such a nice item. It really is not difficult to use and is really a great value.

name: Baby Trend Playard W/Bassinet & Canopy
review: I haven\'t even had my baby yet and I decided to take out the playard to see how it went together. It was hard to get the sides to stay up. The buttons are inside the material which makes it difficult for the sides to stay up. The middle of the playard where you are supposed to lock it is plastic and it looked like it was about to break the first time I tried to put it together. Then I was going to take it back to the store to exchange it and I had my sister load it up for me and the handle broke. I feel like this playard is a piece of junk. I wouldn\'t buy it. It is hard to put together and take apart. Also, where you connect the changing table to the playard is plastic and doesn\'t look like it will last.

name: Baby Trend Playard W/Bassinet & Canopy
review: ...unless you are able to open it up before buysing and check to make sure it can actually be assembled!After spending nearly an hour trying to decipher the vague and poorly detailed instructions/diagrams for assembly, I reached a point where I could not continue where one of the support poles could not be properly inserted into the bassinet fabric.After contacting customer service, apparently the area had been "overstitched" to where the pole could longer be inserted all the way through and I was told I would have to order a new bassinet fabric altogether and wait an additional 7 business days for it to be ordered and sent to me.  (And Judging from the rep\'s precognitive "guess" as to what my problem was, it was also very apparent that this was not an isolated issue but probably one affecting several other customers in the past as well.)After realizing the total lack of professionalism practiced by this company - selling a defective product - I began to seriously think about simply returning the product in exchange for a NON-Baby Trend product; and after now reading several other reviews warning against the safety of this product as well, I will MOST DEFINITELY return it and never buy another Baby Trend play yard product again!Save you money, time, piece of mind - and YOUR BABY\'S LIFE - by not buying this product!!!

name: Baby Trend Playard W/Bassinet & Canopy
review: We chose this playyard originally because of its neutral colors and it could double as a bassinet. Before putting our son in his crib, we used this playyard with the bassinet feature every night for more than 3 months. The flip up changing table is great too. It\'s conviently there but flips down out of the way so you have easy access into the playyard and bassinet. We\'ve taken the whole thing up and down several times over with ease. And have not once had a problem with it. The Nojo playyard sheets fit it really well so you can have a comfortable surface in addition to the pad. I would definitely recommend this playyard.

name: Dora The Explorer Cowgirl Flip Open Sofa
review: I bought this sofa for my 2yr old and she and her 6 yr old sister just love it.  They both sit in it and read books together or just pretend to sleep.  The colors are very inviting and it\'s easy to clean.  I highly reccomend it.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: The box that held the bear was beaten up like it has been opened.  The sound device was not stored properly making me think it was a returned bear that I received.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: This device had my child falling asleep after he had woken up in the middle of the night- because it\'s sound activated by the babies cries. I know of no other soother that you don\'t have to get up and turn on. The white noise sounds of the womb comforted my child and it saved me quite a bit of sleep.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: This is absolutely amazing! My son has colic, and was only sleeping about an hour or 2 at a time at night, without being held. The night I got this, I transitioned him into his crib and he slept 4 hrs! I especially love the motion sensor on it!

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: I bought this for my granddaughter it is very cute and she liked it when she first came home from the hospital.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: The bear works well, but I wish the sound would go for a longer period of time. It only plays for 5 minutes, which isn\'t enough to get my little one to sleep.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: The previous reviewer was a bit harsh on this product. Maybe it doesn\'t work with colicky babies, but my son didn\'t have colic and he really enjoyed the sounds. My only negative was that the sound shut off too quickly. 5 minutes at the most. To be truly effective, it needs to play longer. It also successfully lulled my husband and I back to sleep when my son was in his bassinet in our room, so that\'s an added bonus! It\'s definitely not something to make high priority, but if you get it as a gift or can borrow on, I would definitely recommend it. Oh and by the way, ALL of the techniques shown in Happiest Baby on the Block work like a charm. Maybe not on colicky babies though...

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: This is a great item. I found out about it on the "Baby Whisperer" forums. We have this hung on the side of my baby\'s crib where her feet can kick it (and start it) when she fidgets. Sometimes she will wake and start to fidget and when this comes on she settles right down and goes back to sleep. We also turn it on for her as part of our routine to signal that it is time to go to sleep. The first time we used it she was two weeks old and she wasn\'t settling down. When we turned it on she perked up, listened intently, and then practically melted into my shoulder! She went off to sleep pretty quickly after that.It is a shame it only runs for five minutes, but I\'ve found that my baby tends to kick it when it shuts off. We hear it run multiple times during the night also. If it didn\'t shut off after five minutes it would run the batteries out even quicker.Ah yes, the great problem with this product.... We go through a set of four AAA batteries every three days with this! Thankfully we got ourselves some rechargeables, but even then you need two sets so one can charge while you use the other one.I didn\'t find the silkie particulaly useful. Maybe when she is older she\'ll want it for something, but right now we can\'t put it close to her without it being a hazard and she doesn\'t seem to know it exists if it isn\'t very close. Perhaps other babies will be different.The sound box is not very loud when it is inside the bear. We ended up taking it out and hanging it by it\'s velcro strip to the bear\'s arm so that it could be turned towards our baby.A great feature of this product is that the sound becomes more and more faint as the battery dies. This way she can still hear it, but we know that the batteries need changing.There is an on and off switch and a volume control knob.In our house this has been very well worth the purchase price. Very worthwhile!

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: we bought the bear shortly after our son was born 5 ys ago.  It worked wonders.  The womb sounds really did work to help him fall asleep.  Then we used it when our daughter was born 19mos later.  She got attached to the bear, and it became her security bear.  Almost 3.5 yrs later, many washings (in the washing machine), a patch and a very large hole later "bear bear" had to be replaced. So, the bear fairy came and fixed Bear Bear like new. She takes it with her everywhere.  A+++++ product for newborns and older.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: I can\'t tell you how many times I\'ve given this as a gift and, after the baby arrived, received a phone call about how wonderful it is! We used it with our newborn. I had him in a co-sleeper alongside our bed, so there were no slats to hang the bear on. With that said, I can\'t really comment on the bear part. We ended up taking the sound box out and tucking it in the corner of his sleeper. It was like a miracle in helping him to sleep. Yes, it is on a timer and won\'t continue on endlessly (I do wish this weren\'t the case), but all you have to do is tap it and it will turn back on. So, if he didn\'t fall asleep the first round I\'d simply tap the box again and it would start up. The co-sleeper was nice for this, as I was right next to him. No matter the work you have to do to make this work, it still is kind of like a little miracle in a box!

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: This is a great item ! My 3 week old daughter loves to sleep on my chest and I was having a hard time getting her down at night ... She only wanted to sleep on me! We have attached it to the side of her crib and for the last week we have been able to just put her down and when she moves or cries it automatically comes on to sooth her! It has been a lifesaver for both me and my husband ! I highly recommend this item, My husband and I now have our nights to ourselves and she is content with the noise of the heartbeat and it doesnt have to be me :)

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: We actually took the heartbeat speaker out and Velcro it to the side of her bassinet since you shouldn\'t have anything in with an infant (and it wouldn\'t have fit anyway). Now that she is in her crib we put it at the end near her feet. It was really more useful in the first 2 months of her life. Now we have a sound machine that we use.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: When my twins were infants, I was given a bear very similar to this one.  Initially, I put them in the same crib with the bear between them.  They always found their way to the bear and had their little heads pushed up against the bear while they slept.  I think it was very comforting for them because they took 2 naps per day for at least 4 years.  Of course, they had their own cribs after they were a few months old but my little Whitney seemed to need the comfort of the heartbeat more than David.  That was over twenty years ago.  Now, Whitney has one for her little boy on-the-way.  A definite best buy for the new mommy and child.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: This is the fourth Slumber Bear I have purchased for expectant moms, recommended to me originally by a new mother.  The bear can be attached to the crib or just left in a corner and moved to bassinet, stroller, etc.  The wombs sounds are supposed to be soothing to the new baby.  My granddaughter\'s parents used hers for many months.The current mom to be wanted a neutral color, but the bear can be purchased with a blue or pink blanket as well.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: The Audio Pacifier has some static noise after the first battery replacement. What could this be from? Is it a defect?  Thanks

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: Great item for helping baby sleep. We have taken the noisemaker out of the bear and use it just by itself.  It is too big of a pain to always open the bear to turn on and off.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: The womb sound quickly soothes the baby to allow him to go to sleep. You can place the bear anywhere in the crib because the sound is loud enough.  I also feel it is safe to have in the crib because the bear lays flat and won\'t tip over onto the baby if placed close.  My nephew loves the silkie trim on the blanket, he\'ll hold onto it until he falls asleep.  I highly recommend this gift to anyone, whether your baby is fussy or not.

name: Prince Lionheart Original Slumber Bear with Silkie Blanket - Blue
review: Its very cute but I had wanted one that you could record your own heart beat this product has its own pre recorded but its still a good product

name: SpongeBob SquarePants Height Growth Chart up to 5 feet tall
review: This height chart was better than I expected for the price I paid on Amazon.  It was thick, heavier material and will last a long time.  It comes with a clip to mark your child\'s height progression.  It required some assembly but very easy.  Don\'t hesitate on making this purchase.

name: KidCo Adjustable Locking Strap - White
review: Enough said, our 16 moth old toddler broke the cheap plastic tab that holds this together within 10 minutes of installing them.

name: KidCo Adjustable Locking Strap - White
review: Got this for our Lazy Susan. Does the job well. Happy with it. Keeps my son out of the cupboard.

name: KidCo Adjustable Locking Strap - White
review: This works really well for a corner cabinet.  Sticker is reasonably strong, and my daughter can\'t get into the lazy susan.

name: KidCo Adjustable Locking Strap - White
review: I should have read the reviews! Not only does the product details claim this lock works on lazy susans, the picture they use is showing it on a lazy susan! Well, I just put the lock on and I can only rotate my lazy susan a quarter of the way. I will also be mourning the loss of my $7 and be seaching for another lock.

name: KidCo Adjustable Locking Strap - White
review: Originally planned on using this for keeping the toilet lid down, but unfortunately it will not stick to porcelain or any glass type of surface.  I was too afraid to use this on my cabinets as its sticky on the back, and thought it may ruin the finish.

name: KidCo Adjustable Locking Strap - White
review: Works well and easy to install.  The only problem I had was that on one of the straps the stick didn\'t hold-but a small screw worked.  I bought 3 and the other two are holding strong.  A little overpriced.

name: KidCo Adjustable Locking Strap - White
review: This locking strap was exactly what I needed.  And it worked perfectly to keep my toddler out of my cabinet.  For awhile.  Now the strap is broken.  And my toddler laughs with glee as he once again rummages through my pantry items.

name: KidCo Adjustable Locking Strap - White
review: While searching for something to keep our 15 month old safe from pinched fingers on our lazy susan, I only found 2 safety devices available. I was skeptical about the adjustable locking strap but gave it a try and am glad I did. It was easy to install, it is easy to use, and the best part is that it keeps the cabinet from moving when our daughter pushes on it. I recommend this safety product!

name: Safety 1st Outlet Plugs - 24 Pack
review: I have read a few bad reviews for these plug covers, but these work great. My son is one year old and they keep him away. Heck they keep me away. I don\'t look forward to using any outlet that these are in. They are hard for me to get out. I have to find something to wedge in it to pry it out of the outlet. So simply put these work fine. Maybe an older child would be able to get these out, but I can\'t so I am not worried.UPDATE: My son is now four and still can\'t get these out of the outlets. The plastic prongs have not worn out and the product as a whole still works great after repeated use. Definitely worth the small amount I paid.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: A little smaller than expected but its a very cute addition to my son\'s hot wheels themed room

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: Small, very small. I should have listened to the other reviewers, because this thing is a joke. My 2 year old loves it however, so I guess I\'m keeping it. Can\'t say if it works great or not, but it blinks and that\'s all I have seen so far... I\'d skip this if I were you unless they lower the price to like $5.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: This was plugged in for less than 5 minutes and stopped working.  Do not waste your money on this product.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: My great nephew loved the light, he is only two half years old, he now knows all his colors. A great learning tool.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: very cheap. do not purchase this light it is a waste of money. the lights did not all work and the dial type switch to turn it on broke within the several times of turning it on and off

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: The lamp (or more of a night light) is adorable maybe a little small, the only thing I don\'t like is it blinks and you can\'t turn off the blinking.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: receipt the product which prendio only once and not prendio mas. lost my money in this lamp that is of adornment.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: This is not very large but it makes a great nightlight for my sons cars themed room. the 1st one we had blew out like a Christmas light after about 6 months. It was cheaper to replace then to fix so we are on outer second one.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: Perfect light for a Toastmasters timing light - easily modified to a 3-stage timing light by installing individual toggle switches on each light.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: The red light doesn\'t work.  The green and yellow blink on and off randomly, though maybe it would make sense if the red light worked.  We thought it would be a cute decoration for my son\'s room, but it is really junky, even for the price.  My son likes it, so if it worked properly I would have kept it.  But it doesn\'t, so we have the hassle of returning a defective toy light.  Bummer.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: This light is fun. I origionally got it because I thought it would be a cool night light but it says on warning sticker not to leave it on for more than 2 hours at a time. Still lots of fun. First they are all lit, then one will start to blink and before you know it they all start to blink. Maybe I\'m too easily amused but I thought it was awsome for such a small light.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: So I bought this expecting to have to rewire it, but I didn\'t anticipate the bulbs.  When you turn on the light, all three lights come on and then start blinking like christmas tree lights.  I had to change the bulbs to plain night light bulbs to stop the flashing and install switches so I could control which light was on at what time.  That said, most people aren\'t going to actually need control over the lights, and rewiring this was much easier than building my own from scratch, it was just those bulbs...

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: Junk..dont buy your wasting your money. Cheaply made and didnt work when I got it...I thought it was bigger and the quality was better.  Requesting a refund. You can have it back.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: The lights have no pattern to them. my son got frustrated that he couldn\'t control the light color. very cheaply made.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: This was a gift for a newly remodeled bedroom. The price you pay is what you get. Works, but it\'s of lower quality, feels cheap and the box is rather cheap looking also.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: It was a lot smaller than I expected but has multiple light settings, overall my husband really loves it but I thought it was going to be a bigger "statement" piece.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: This light is terrific!  I got it to decorate my son\'s room. I love the small size and think it\'s safer and more appropriate for a kid\'s room.  We have had it for a few months and have had no problems with it at all.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: My 2 yo boy was excited for me to plug it in they day it was delivered. Plugged it in. The switch to turn on/off was broken into 2 pieces and the lights flash randomly when it does chose to turn on. Very disappointed to receive a broken item that was supposed to be for my son. Wont buy again.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: I don\'t like quality of the lamp. Lamp is a lot smaller than I thought. It will not stand up by it\'s. I had to put weight in the bottom of the lamp. is

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: I bought this item to use for my son\'s cars 2 party. It is a great add on. I love it. It\'s a great size, definitely not too big or little considering it\'s for younger children. I plugged it up today & all the lights worked just fine. Can\'t wait to use it @ his birthday party this Saturday. He can also keep it as a keepsake in his room, I\'m considering changing his room from sesame street to cars so this will be perfect.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: It worked for just 5 minutes and then the lights was off forever. My child was very disappointed when he found out the lights off.

name: Traffic Light Lamp
review: Cheap, poor, terribly made. I ignored the reviews and ordered anyway. Very small and worked about 5 minutes only. I cut off the electrical cord and made a shelf decoration out of it. Don\'t buy it!

name: Evenflo Comfi Deluxe Gift Set
review: I purchased these bottles with a gift card I had received fron a different store. I have had no problems with them except a little leakage when I\'m shaking them up. I even run them thru the dishwasher and no problems. They are a good buy at a good price. I believe that I paid $5.50 for 3 bottles and the good thing about it is that you only have to buy nipples when they graduate rather than the whole bottle.

name: Evenflo Comfi Deluxe Gift Set
review: My baby was colic when he was born so I used the Doctor Brown bottles.  Now that he is four months old and less [...], I wanted to switch him to a bottle with less parts and that was a little less expensive.  I tried the comfi and my baby loves them.  I still use the doctor brown nipple just because I don\'t want my baby to experience nipple confusion, but these bottles are excellent.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect 900Mhz Nursery Monitor
review: This moniter is great when it has signal.  It picks up my kiddos just fine.  I usually keep the volume at 3/10 and can hear my baby fuss as soon as he starts.  The problem with this moniter is that, when it loses the signal (and IT WILL), it has an alarm that goes off at top volume no matter how low you have the volume set.  So when it loses signal for even a second at 1am and 2am and 3am and 4am (you get the picture) you wake up whether your baby is sleeping through the night or not.  I have had it with this moniter.  I just about threw it through the window last night.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect 900Mhz Nursery Monitor
review: Tired of hearing your baby cry?  This is the monitor for you.  You\'ll be lucky to hear any sounds from your baby on this thing.  Looks like Evenflo  was being literal when they named the product Whisper Connect.  You can barely hear anything at full volume.  I\'m going to return it tomorrow if I can resist backing over it with our car.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect 900Mhz Nursery Monitor
review: My son is 5 months old now and for the first 4 months, the monitor worked pretty well.  We got a bit of static from time to time, but I would have given it 4 stars.  BUT...one night I woke up to reassure myself with the little green "on" light and saw that the monitor was not on.  Thinking it was a fluke, I turned it back on, checked the baby and went to bed.  But, over the course of a couple of weeks, it became more and more unreliable, turning off at will.  It was also hard to turn it back on.  I had to flip the switch several times before it would work. And, this is not a battery issue, since it was plugged in the entire time. I went to the Evenflo website and read the FAQs.  There\'s a mention of a problem with the power light going out, but nothing about the monitor itself going out.  Needless to say, we\'ve thrown it away and have gotten a different brand.  I mentioned this to my friend with an 8 month old the other day and she said the same exact thing happened to hers - just stopped working reliably. She\'s bought a different monitor too.  Both of our new monitors are working perfectly now with less static.  I wouldn\'t recommend purchasing this monitor until they make some changes.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect 900Mhz Nursery Monitor
review: I had the Safety 1st Super Clear Monitor for my first child and LOVED it.  I could hear a pin drop with it.  Unfortunatley nothing lasts forever.  After four years I have to replace it.  I found this Evenflo in Target and decided to try it.  AWEFUL!!!! I can\'t hear anything.  He has to cry for me to hear him.  Not to mention I have to turn the volume all the way up and have right next to me.  (The other I could set it in the kitchen, walk around down stairs and hear all.) After a couple hours of use this thing is going back and I\'m searching high and low for another Safety 1st Super Clear.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect 900Mhz Nursery Monitor
review: My husband and I both love this monitor.  The sound is very clear on it, and we like that it doesn\'t pick up every little sound the baby makes (some other reviewers did not like this). We only hear our baby when he is crying...and we can hear even the smallest cry.  It just doesn\'t pick up the little grunting sounds and such that babies make when they sleep, which has helped us get a little more sleep at night! We also have a Summer video monitor, and really don\'t like that it picks up every little noise. So, we use this monitor for the sound, and the video monitor if we want to check in on the baby. On the Summer monitor, we can hear the baby breathe (which to some might be reassuring, but we moved the baby into his own room so we could get some sleep!) :)  Overall, we highly recommend this monitor.  We\'ve had it for 2.5 years and have had absolutely no problems with it!

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect 900Mhz Nursery Monitor
review: I received this monitor as a gift and it has been a life saver. How nice that I can monitor my baby\'s every move and sound without being in the same room every minute!  The are two different channels, so this usually cuts out the extra static or the alarm going off. Sometiems it\'s also just a matter or re-positioning the monitor to resolve the noise.We were suprised one evening when we picked up what sounded like a phone conversation between two girls, but switching to channel B solved that.I\'ve used the Evenflo Whisper Connect for about 3 months now and am quite satisfied.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect 900Mhz Nursery Monitor
review: HATE IT! We\'ve had nothing but problems with this monitor from the first day. Occasionally it will work correctly but that\'s very rare (and even when it does work properly it does not pick up my daughter very well even though it\'s right next to her crib). On the days when it decides not to work all you can hear on the monitor is a HORRIBLE buzzing sound. Nothing make it go away. You can move the monitor all over the house and it still buzzes. When this buzzing occur you can\'t hear any noises that the actual baby makes because the buzzing drown it out. In other words, the whole point of a baby monitor goes out the window. We have yet to figure out what causes it to do this as nothing changes in my daughter\'s room. The same things are on all the time in her room. It is not worth the money at all. I\'m going to Target today to buy a new monitor and this one is headed for the trash. We have a Fisher Price monitor that we\'ve used for almost 3 years with my son and it still works perfectly. I\'ll definitely be steering clear of Evenflo in the future.

name: Chicco Smart Support Backpack Blue Sky
review: This backpack is sturdy, looks great and our son loves it.  It fits pretty well (we are both over 5\'9, average build with long torsos.)  Even our older pre-teen kids can use it to carry the baby in it.  Some cons:  1)the sun roof doesn\'t quite provide enough shade (just like the shades on the chicco car seats)and seems to block the baby\'s view a bit even when closed up.  Also, it tends to stay retracted unless you have on the rain shield to weigh it down and keep it over the baby\'s head more; 2)it does get heavy quickly especially with an 18 lb. baby in it.  We were used to an old Gerry frame backpack that was very light-weight but lacking any bells and whistles.  Unfortunately, I couldn\'t locate any packs similar to that one or I would have bought it instead of this Chicco pack.  In summary, I\'m not sure if this pack would be ultra comfy if used for a long hike.  But it\'s adequate for short jaunts, making dinner, etc- and it\'s not such a big commitment as the Kelty would be in terms of cost, size and ease.

name: Chicco Smart Support Backpack Blue Sky
review: I am considering getting one of these and only looked at another brand at the store recently.  I just wanted to make a comment regarding Halo Golden\'s comment that you cannot close the frame while the baby is on your back.  This may be very well true but it seems like a non-issue.  The reason I say this, is because from the other model I looked at in the store (similar to this model w/ a frame), it seems there is no reason you\'d want to close the frame other than for storage.  So I think most people would probably leave the frame open while they are wearing it.  That\'s how I would use it anyway...  I\'m not sure why that user needed to close the frame after she put it on...  I haven\'t bought mine yet but if any one else has one and can comment on this point it would be appreciated.  Thanks.  By the way, please disregard my star rating above. I wasn\'t able to leave this comment without choosing a rating so I chose a 3 because it was in the middle.  Actually I have no experience with this product as mentioned above -- I just wanted to clarify the previous reviewer\'s comment.

name: Chicco Smart Support Backpack Blue Sky
review: This carrier frees us to go hiking with our 22 pound child and it works really well.  I\'m a 61 year old grandma and I can easily carry my grandchild on my back with this.  It also frees up my hands so I can carry a leash and walk my dogs while carrying my granddaughter on my back.  She enjoys the scenery and we get our exercise.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: If I could\'ve given a rating of zero stars, I would have.  This basket is such poor quality, and constitutes such a safety hazard, it should not be marketed as a "Moses Basket."  It\'s extremely loosely woven, prickly, floppy (the handles will not stand up, as they do in the picture), and the lining doesn\'t fit at all.  It bunches up!  Placing an infant in this basket would be a grave mistake!  Also, when first removed from the box, it had an awful chemical smell!I had this basket shipped directly to a friend upon the birth of her grandson.  She was appalled at the quality and told me she would NEVER put her grandson or any other infant inside this basket!  I apologized profusely and felt embarrassed and humiliated that I had had it shipped directly to her without seeing it first.When I contacted the seller that I wanted to return this basket for a full refund, I was told I\'d have to pay shipping both ways (it was originally a free shipping item) in spite of the fact the basket was of such poor quality that it was unusable (their standard return policy).  I protested.  Within hours, the seller agreed to give me a full refund of the purchase price, with no deduction for shipping. which I appreciate tremendously.  They responded quickly and courteously and understood my feelings completely.  Good for the seller!  Bad for the basket!

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: I was scared to let my baby sleep in the basket at night b/c I was scared he would get pushed up against the sides. Good for napping though. Can\'t beat the price.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: not that good the basket are so loose that breaks easily,I would rather spend extra dollar,and buy the good ones which is n\'t that expensive compare to this one.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: It was an awesome gift for the birth of my niece. Everyone loved it and I filled it with many clothes books and toys. thanks.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: This is the perfect gift to give at a baby shower filled with much needed baby stuff. Fast delivery and packed beautifullyA great  size and amazing quality.  Would highly recommend

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: It was cute, at first, but with a week of use, this basket quickly became misshapen. Also, the mattress pad was very cheap and indented quickly and permanently.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: If you are looking for an inexpensive Moses Basket, this is perfect! The only problem I had was the basket was a little "bent" from shipping. It\'s been out of the box for a couple weeks now and looks just fine. It\'s actually bigger than I expected.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: Bought this basket to display my decorative dolls and the basket does a fine job of doing this. My dolls look so cute tucked together in this Moses basket. I started collecting dolls after learning how to paint and put them together. They looked cute on the couch until there were three or four all sitting together. Unfortunately there wasn\'t room on the couch for the humans to sit so the dolls had to go. They are now resting in their basket.The basket was very easy to put together. I skimmed the directions and had the basket put together in about 15 minutes.As for use with babies: I don\'t think this would be practical, except for perhaps a place to put the baby while visiting, as this basket is a tad small for its recommended use.Recommend.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: This is very convenient to hold and carry. It can\'t be used for all new baby needs,but does the job it was intended to do.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: This is so poorly made! The sides are rather floppr and it comes out of the boxed with a permanent desire to lean to one side. If the manufacturers boxed it a bit more carefully. it might be a  great value. Howver, it\'s useless in its permanently warped form. I bought this product (Summer Infant By Your Side Sleeper Portable Bedding) instead and love it!

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: I purchased this basket to give to my granddaughter, filled with presents for her first baby.  I really liked the basket, but thought she would really like the presents.  However, the basket was her favorite thing.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: This item broke in four different places along the top during the first day of use. The basket is not as pliable as others I\'ve seen and is made of very cheap materials. Not at all suited for use for a baby. Do not buy this item or you\'ll be throwing your money away.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: Piece of junk. Received it and it was already falling apart.  I wish I could return it. They shouldn\'t even be selling this basket for a baby. What a waste of money.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: The Moses Basket is fine - I am sure it will work well for the 3 or so months that the baby will sleep in it, however, the bedding - \'pink gingham bedding\' is really cheesy and tacky.  The fabric is a flimsy scratchy polyester which is poorly sewn.  The little mattress is cheap and the sheet ill fitting and - again - the flimsy polyester.  I felt that the bedding needed to be replaced so I am sewing new bedding and what a hassle since I am not an expert seamstress.  I have spent hours making a mattress pad and sheet and now am working on the bumper pads. If I had just purchased a more expensive Moses Basket in the first place I am sure it would have come with better bedding.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: I actually wanted one of these weaved Moses Baskets since my first baby 9 years ago! I finally got one this time for my second pregnancy and could be more happy! Wonderfully made! Very pleased about my purchase.

name: Badger Basket Moses Basket, Pink Gingham
review: This basket is just as beautiful as described.  It is going to be for my daugher who is expecting her first child soon.  I just know that she will love it, and it will come in very handy so that she can have her new baby close by.The bottom seems a little flimsy, but since she will not be carrying the baby in the basket, it will be just fine.  I will be sure to mention this to her when she gets it.  Thanks again.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: The Snuggle Nest was probably one of the best purchases we made during our daughter\'s infancy. It\'s so lightweight that you can take it anywhere and have an instant safe sleeping spot for your baby. Your little one looks lost in that huge crib? The nest gives her a cozy spot. Don\'t want to lug a portable crib to GranDa\'s? The nest is a great solution. Co-sleeping, but DH is nervous about rolling over onto the baby? The nest\'s rigid top edges give baby a secure space. Really, I can\'t even begin to tell you how uber-usefeul this item was for us - we\'d purchase again it in a heartbeat, and I recommend it to all the new mamas I know.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: Out of all the baby items I have for my new born this is definatetly one of the best. The crib is way too big for a new born. I am able to use this item in his crib, on my bed, on the couch, etc. It is very easy to transport. Much easier then trying to pack up a pack in play (which is more like a park and play I have come to find out)This was the best $50 I have spent so far. A must have !

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: This is probably one of the best things I got at my baby shower.  We used it religiously and it folds up into this nice little travel pack with a handle so baby\'s bed can go anywhere with you.  When my son outgrew it and started sleeping in the bassinet, the snuggle nest doubled as a great changing station.  We still use it as a changing pad and he\'s 18 months old!  The wipes, diapers, and powder fit nicely inside when it folds up.  It\'s Durable, washable, comfortable.  The only little thing is that if you have anything smaller then a queen size bed, it\'s very crowded.  We had a full and we didn\'t have much room.  Even then it was worth it.  This product was a life saver!

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: I bought this Snuggle Nest on a whim for occasional use, but on the first night I was home after the birth and had to keep getting up and reaching down to get Jack out of the crib every 2 hours, I thought I would try it out.  We have been using it for over a month now, and he loves it.  The hospital had recommended, on the advice of SIDS Australia, to keep the baby in your room with you for 6 months, and not in a crib in another room, as it is important for the baby to hear you breathing in order to \'remember\' to breathe.  I had intended to have the crib next to us as we have an open plan apartment - I imagine many people could not fit one in their room - but this is a fine substitute (we do have a King bed though).  The side wedges are adjustable in width with velcro - I get them snug around his hips so he wouldn\'t be able to get in a bad position.  I just lift him out and put him on my Boppy pillow to nurse - very comfortable.  The light is great as when I put him down he spits up some milk every time and if I was putting him in a crib I don\'t know if I would even know this until he started crying.  My husband would not feel comfortable co-sleeping without this - he doesn\'t seem to wake at the slightest baby noise like I do.  Sometimes when I put Jack in the Snuggle Nest he is not asleep but I can rest my head next to it and look at him and close my eyes, and he closes his eyes in imitation and it helps him sleep.  Basically, co-sleeping is not contraindicated by SIDS researchers - they have a number of caveats though (if you smoke, are drunk, have many pillows/covers, a soft mattress, etc).  This Snuggle Nest keeps the covers and pillow safely away from the baby and keeps the baby from rolling toward you (important if you are heavy) or you from rolling onto him.  My husband is over 200 lbs and if the baby was lying next to him without this, the mattress would sag towards him and the baby would probably roll.  The Nest\'s mattress is firm which is recommended for babies (you can buy extra sheets for it as well).  Jack and I get more sleep not having to get out of bed.  I\'ll be sorry when he grows out of it but I hope I can transition him to the crib by putting this in the crib, as others have.  I hope this helps as I have found other people\'s reviews very valuable when shopping online for baby gear.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: I got this item because our 3 week old loves to sleep with us and since i\'m breastfeeding i thought it would be convenient but after getting it i wasn\'t completely happy with it. First of all, if you have a Queen size bed, there won\'t be much room left for two adults on the sides, second, if you breastfeed, you still have to take the baby out of it or slide him out of it so you can do it. I would recommend the maker of this item to create one on which the walls would come down to make breastfeeding time more convenient. I love my child with all my heart but i also enjoy sleeping with my husband next to me so i did not completely approved of this item. We also have the original co-sleeper that attaches to our bed and that is where our baby will safely spend his nights next to us.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: I bought the snugglenest when my son was 2 weeks old.  After having many nights of getting up 2 and 3 times, I bought this hoping that the feeling of being in close quarters would help him sleep in his pack and play, it worked but will night time interuptions.  I was the parent who said never ever will my baby sleep with me, well with the snugglenest I felt very secure with him being in bed with me.  Beleive it or not at 4 weeks and him sleeping in the snugglenest in the bed with me, he slept the WHOLE night and still does.  He said in the snugglenest until he was three months old and it was a true life saver.  The hard plastic around the top and sides prevents parents from rolling over on baby, needless to say even though he sleeps through the night, I still wake up when he makes the slightest move.  The snugglenest was a great gift of night time sleep and I would recommend it to everyone.  I acutally bought one for my nephew that recently had a baby, these are great.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: We bought this baby snuggle nest and I wanted to share with you the dangers of this thing. A baby is meant to sort of follow it\'s mum around the bed, a full term and normal birth baby who is safe to co-sleep does not need this contraption. All mammals sleep with their mums, it\'s what nature intended.The baby should be wearing what you are i.e. maybe one layer and a nappy, and lying beteen mum and partner and mums elbow of her arm nearest the bed should be off the pillow with forearm on the pillow or under it to make a safe place for baby and to stop baby going up onto the pillow.Babies should not be lying by another toddler or child (if its a family bed) but between the two adults, one of which is the nursing mum. Adults legs will naturally be bent up til knees nearly touch, to form a safe haven and to stop baby going down the bed.Howver as we found, when baby is in this mum loses that touch and baby follow response and as others have said as baby gets older it will seek out mum and may go off down the bed and as mum and dad may be lying on their opposite side os back there\'s no safe haven.A baby can be safely breastfed in bed without this, with this a baby has to be moved further down the bed thus may be more covered then if was at chest height, and also as mums hormones mean she should go back asleep whilst feeding she may leave baby down the bed and then this thing is in the way, as we did. Or she has to stay awake to oput baby back! Why when a baby doesn\'t need it!This is an ill conceived badly designed piece of un needed baby equipment, made to make money where there isn\'t a niche in the market!Save your money! Buy a side bed guard instead ( no I\'m not a bed side seeler nor have any vested interest in them) as that is a far more useful pice of equipment.Speak to your breastfeeding counsellor or supporter and learn about safely co-sleeping without this instead!BWS,Jenny.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: The Snuggle Nest is a nice thought, but did not work for us at all.  We received it as a gift during the pregnancy and decided to try to get used to it before baby came, so we put it in our bed to "practice".  It stayed there for 5 minutes, if that, then went into the closet.  Even being thin/athlectic parents, in a queen sized bed, it still took up too much room.After baby came we gave it another try.  Still, we felt like it took up too much room.  It just wasn\'t pleasent waking up with the side of it in our faces.  Not only that, we did not feel the closeness to baby that we wanted, which was [one of] the reasons we chose to co-sleep in the first place, so back in the closet it went.If you plan to co-sleep and you are concerned about rolling over baby, I suggest using a doll to "practice" with.  Also, keep in mind that mom and baby will be so in-tune with each other that it\'s rare that an accidents happen.  "SIDS" deaths are way more common than co-sleeping accidents.With that said, I haven\'t had any problems waking up when baby or husband move and actually wake up prior to baby waking up wanting to eat.  Husband, who is a deep sleeper, also hasn\'t had any trouble waking up to baby\'s movements and hasn\'t even come close to rolling over him.  If you are wanting to co-sleep because of the closeness you will feel with baby, I do NOT suggest buying this product.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: Initially I was very happy to use this product.  However, as my baby started to grow(aprox 3 weeks of age) she begin to move her way down to the bottom of the snuggle nest.  I would wake in the middle of the night to find her little face in the bolster! I found this item to be a real risk.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: I love this product.  I slept so much better knowing that my baby was in a safe area in my bed. I love the way the end is open so that nothing interferes with my access to the baby and it also allowed me to use the product longer since nothing was blocking my baby\'s growing legs!

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: I put the snuggle nest on my registry for when I wanted to go out. I did not want to carry the pack \'n play, because I found it to be too heavy. I use the snuggle nest when I go out, on the couch during the day and in our bed at night. I felt more secure having her in bed with us the first two months, so I can keep an eye on her without getting up. I also put it in the crib to help her get used to those surroundings, and now she sleeps in her crib without it. It is well worth the money!

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: This was an item that I thought would be really cool to have.  My husband and I got it as a gift and we never really got the chance to use it.  We tried it out and it just didn\'t work.  We have a really big queen sized bed and with the snuggle nest in between the both of us, we were nearly falling off of the bed.  You would need at least a king sized bed in order to sleep comfortably with the snuggle nest nestled between the two of you.  Now my son has outgrown the snuggle nest and is in his own crib.  The snuggle nest has nested itself in his closet now.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: I bought this after my 3 week old baby had surgery on his stomach. He would not sleep in the bassinet. This is excellent for protecting him from Daddy rolling over on him. It also makes it easier for me since he is now eye level with me in bed. I love the light feature, and the CD it comes with. I was even able to roll up a towel and stick it under the pad to incline my baby to prevent reflux. Very happy with this.

name: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review: We absolutely love this co-sleeper.  Our baby is 18 days old and has slept in it with us every night since we came home from the hospital.  We even took it with us last night to her first visit to her grandparents house, it wasn\'t used because no one put her down.  I put her in it when I am putting laundry away in our bedroom.  It is a wonderful item.  I read all the reviews and most of them made comments on the size and not being able to comfortably use it in a queen size bed.  After having been pregnant for eights months and having used up to six pillows at the end (two of which were body pillows)the size of this thing isn\'t that big of a deal to us.  We both have room to sleep comfortably in our queen size bed and we have her near us and feel more secure.  I am going to hate when she outgrows it and we move her to her crib.  She absolutely loves the nightlight and has to sleep with it on.  She likes to stare at it and we call it her "moon".

name: Quilted White Terry Cloth Sheet Saver - Set of 2
review: Don\'t bother buying this matress pad. It leaks right through it, on to the sheet!

name: Quilted White Terry Cloth Sheet Saver - Set of 2
review: Every time my infant\'s diapers don\'t catch everything....it leaks right through this "sheet saver" and wets the sheet.  I am very disappointed and would not recommend.

name: Quilted White Terry Cloth Sheet Saver - Set of 2
review: This product was great!  Some of the other reviews disagree, but they seem to be relating to diaper related leaks.  I used this under my child\'s head in order to prevent a total bed change if she were to spit up.  It was great for that...no leaks, and I didn\'t have to change the whole crib in the middle of the night just because of a little spit-up.

name: Quilted White Terry Cloth Sheet Saver - Set of 2
review: While I found these sheet savers to be super handy, I\'m using them in a different way than most reviewers. These are perfect for on-the-fly diaper changing. Most often one of these lays on my changing pad and when it\'s soiled, I just toss in the wash and replace it with another!

name: Multi-Use Blue, Yellow and White Baby Pads - 3-pk.
review: These pads are great for protecting surfaces but, pill so badly (even when air-dried only) that they become very unattractive after one washing. Still, very functional for newborns.

name: Multi-Use Blue, Yellow and White Baby Pads - 3-pk.
review: These were exactly what I expected and seem to be good quality. They have been very useful with her new baby around.

name: Multi-Use Blue, Yellow and White Baby Pads - 3-pk.
review: Versatile pad because of their larger size - I mostly use them as changing pads but they also work in the bath and as extra padding between the skimpy mattress and the sheet in the bassinet, but they don\'t stand up well in the wash. They pill and snag so badly you can\'t use them again until you cut all the strings and lumps off - some of the loops are big enough for baby to get hands and feet caught - and it\'s too much for a pill remover to deal with. I\'m hoping they\'ll get to a point where there just isn\'t anything left to snag, but I imagine that will leave too thin to use for much else than changing pad covers.Update 11/30/2007 - these have now completely worn out after 3-4 months of use and washing a couple of times a week. The vinyl waterproof layer inside has broken down and any spills soak straight through. However they did prove pretty durable despite the pilling problem (I constantly get my nails caught in them when picking baby up) so I will buy more if I can find them.

name: Multi-Use Blue, Yellow and White Baby Pads - 3-pk.
review: These are the perfect changing pad to use anywhere: changing table, couch, floor, either at home or on the go! Wash well--don\'t come out looking like new, but still functional. For those wondering about the waterproof element: the tag says there is a vinyl layer between the outer polyester flannel.

name: Multi-Use Blue, Yellow and White Baby Pads - 3-pk.
review: They are sturdy and soak up the messes wonderfully. We also use these on the diaper changing table as well. We love them!

name: Multi-Use Blue, Yellow and White Baby Pads - 3-pk.
review: I only use these under the sheet in our pack-and-play, where I rarely have to change it and it doesn\'t come into direct contact with the baby, because they pill so excessively whenever they are washed that the lint gets all over anything it touches.  There are definitely better quality options on the market, though given the price they are alright as emergency back ups.

name: Chicco Butterfly Spinner Toy
review: We have had several of this type of toy over the years by different companies: Infantino, Fisher-Price, and Tolo.  This one is the best out of them because of it\'s bright colors and the interesting sound the cute bug balls make as they spin.  My baby loves it.  The Tolo Pony Carousel is another choice if you want one that is quieter, but the sound never bothered us.

name: Chicco Butterfly Spinner Toy
review: My 10-month-old always wants to play with this toy as soon as I pull it out of the toybox, but she has a hard time actually getting it to do anything that interests her. She\'s figured out that you have to depress the plunger to get the little balls to roll, but the plunger is too stiff for her so they barely move. It\'s almost as good to just shake it and make the balls roll that way. But we have better rattling toys, so she usually lets this one roll away and plays with something else. Like another reviewer, I love that it\'s a self-contained toy. Unfortunately, it\'s also loud and bulky, so even though I had hoped it would be a good toy to take on outings, it\'s just not practical. I still have hope that she might enjoy it more in a few months. If not, it\'s going on the donation pile.

name: Chicco Butterfly Spinner Toy
review: I was really unsure about this toy when we received it as a gift for my 6 month old son, but he loves it.  The push thing on top is too hard for him to push himself but that does not stop him from loving this toy.  He kicks it, rolls it on the ground and shakes it to get the balls to move on the inside. He also has another toy that is similar that he can push down and he still prefers this one.  It is great when we were teaching him to sit up because we could put it between his legs and it gave him motivation to continue to sit.  It\'s durable and can go anyway which is a big plus. Overall it\'s a great toy!

name: Chicco Butterfly Spinner Toy
review: I received this toy as a gift for my 1-year old son. It was one of the most frustrating toys he\'s had. The handle requires too much strenght to press down, so he was not able to operate it alone. He could press it down only when standing up (using his body weight), but the size of the spinner made it very inconvinient to play this way: he had to lean and  crouch. The noise that the balls make is rather loud (in my consideration) and can irritate the adults after a while, too. Because my son was already walking, this static toy got very little attention. The positive features: it is made of sturdy plastic and the colors are nice and bright.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: Good product

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: Just what we needed

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: We really liked this product, but just be careful to make sure you have it centered (top and bottom) properly. It was working great for us, until last night my daughter crawled under it as a blanket and coincidentally had an accident that morning! We will make sure that it is pulled up high enough so that she isn\'t able to do that in the future. Other than that it is so easy to pull off and switch in the middle of the night while still keeping the bottom sheet dry since you are typically half asleep when these things happen. ;)

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I bought this and the PottyMD version at the same time to alternate almost daily.  I prefer this one.  It washes well and seems to be working well. I like the wings that help it stay in place.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: Other reviewers love this, but we haven\'t been able to make it work for our daughter\'s twin bed.  It does not stay in place very well for us.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: Use these things with the bedwetting alarm.  Purchase 3 to 4 of them... if you purchase only one then it makes it difficult since you need to wait to wash it before using it again.  It truely stop the urine from reaching the bed.Hope this helps.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I bought this for my daughter who is just starting to sleep without a diaper. Her first night she made it through dry. On the second morning, I checked her and she felt completely dry. I didn\'t notice until later that morning that there was a big spot on the pad. She had had an accident but the pad absorbed it all! This is a great pad for night-training toddlers.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I have used this pad for almost two weeks, and I have had to wash about three or four times.  Already the fuzzy quilted top has begun to fuzz up and pill like crazy.  The pad protects the bed well but if you don\'t put the pad in the washer immediately after an accident it retains an awful pee smell, and contaminates other clothes as well. The sides that wrap under the mattress are flimsy and difficult to get in place.I have previously used a similar waterproof pad (from another company) to put on top of my potty-training preschooler\'s bed sheet.  The other pad had a nice smooth sheet-like top and protected the bed from accidents well, up until the time the waterproof material on the back deteriorated due to age/washings (at least three years).  It was also easier to tuck under the mattress than this new one.  I am not impressed with this pad.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I really wanted to like this product because the shape and tuck-in flaps are perfect for its use.  After opening the package, I still wanted to have faith that this super thin and lightweight pad would somehow puff up and soak up any accidents.  On its first use, the pad became saturated to the point that liquid not only soaked through but also managed to  spill over the sides.  I consider the pad to be water resistant with little to no absorption.I still use the pad. I found that if I place a bath towel on top of the pad, the bed itself will remain dry. The pad was tested on an incontinent parent who wears and wore a "Depends" like product during its use.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I ordered two of these mattress pad overlays for my eight year old daughter who still has a bed wetting problem and often has leaky pull ups at night.  Prior to getting these pads, I was often up 2-3 times a week changing sheets at 2am.  These pads have been a lifesaver for me and have also given my daughter a bit more independence in dealing with her accidents.  She is able to change the pad easily along with her jammies and go back to bed without having to ask for help. She has appreciated having these pads as it makes her feel like "she can do it" by herself without having to ask for help with changing her sheets.  I wish I would have ordered these years ago.  Great product!!

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I am very satisfied with this pad.  My son was having a lot of trouble getting through the night without Pull Ups.  He wet the Pull Ups so heavily that I was afraid to ever try to take them off.  Once I got this pad, we tried going without them.  He wet the pad 5 nights in a row, but it never went through to the sheets.  I bought two of these pads, so I could wash one and have a fresh one on the bed.  I would recommend doing that.He nows sleeps through the night without wetting the bed, but I keep this pad on the bed for occasional accidents.  The only reason I didn\'t give it 5 stars is that it sometimes comes a bit loose during the night.  However, it has never moved so much that an accident was not contained on the pad.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I was happy with the quality just disappointed that the pee pad does not cover a normal size twin mattress and the siding starts before the sides of the twin bed begins. So, I hope my son is never laying near the sides of the bed and has an accident or it will leak through!

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: My daughter started taking off her pull up sometime during the night, then would wake again when she wet the bed.  Even though I had a rubber pad under the fitted sheet, I got tired of washing the sheet every time she had a night time accident.  Prior to buying this pad, I tried the throw away thin protector pads like they use in hospitals, but my daughter moves around while sleeping and they always ended up somewhere other than directly underneath her.  I even tried taping them to the sheet but it looked stupid and the tape didn\'t always hold.This pad is great.  It\'s nicely made and is soft to sleep on.  Would highly recommend to anyone who has a toddler who\'s not quite trained through the night.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I got this for my brother-in-law whose car was rear-ended, leaving him a paraplegic. My sister says these are fantastic! She has to wash them every day (due to treatment for a pressure sore) and it\'s so much easier than having to change the entire fitted pad. She says they are very absobant and makes her life so much easier.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I thought this would be great for my son because he moves a lot at night and the other mattress pads shift out from under him. I like the wrap around sides but they are a little hard to tuck in all the way, and this isn\'t as absorbent as described. My son actually thinks this one is garbage.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: My grandchild had no problem accepting having this placed above the sheets because it is very soft. Haven\'t had an issue with her having an accident during the night, but I am glad this is so portable and replaceable without any difficulties.

name: Saddle Style Soaker Mattress Pad - Will Absorb 6 Cups of Liquid - Made in America (34" X 36")
review: I highly recommend this mattress pad. We bought this for potty training our 3-year-old daughter and it works well. She had an accident overnight and the pad captured it with no leaks through.
