It does the job however and the price is right, which is why I gave it 3 stars.  If I had known that I was not supposed to form anything other than a hexagon, I might not have purchased it, and it seems too large to return.  Also, I\'m pretty sure that once my girl is able to pull up and stand, she\'s going to have no problem moving this across our wood floors.  It might work better if you have carpet.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I received my play yard yesterday and it arrived with broken pieces of plastic on two of the six panels.  I did not notice this until my 6 month old had one of the pieces in her mouth and had already managed to scratch the side of her face.  I am thankful I noticed what she had before anything worse happened.  I have notified the company (VMInnovations) about the problem and am hopeful they will remedy the situation.  My concern about the gate now it that there are exposed pieces of sharp plastic where the pieces broke off.  I will update my review once I hear back from the company.UPDATE: Not long after I sent an email to VMInnovations they got back to me saying they would send me 2 panels to replace the ones that were damaged.  There is something to be said for a company with good customer service.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought 2 of these to fence in a whole room.  They don\'t snap together easily, and there\'s no gate which is a bummer.  Also, it\'s a super pain in the butt to open each angle. They take a ton of strength to unfold.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: They are a little hard to get together and apart and you have to step over them to get in but they work well for us.  We have 2 sets put together.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this for my seventh month old. It is large enough that she is able to crawl around inside of it. We are able to hang toys on the inside panels for added exploration. It is easily reconfigured for smaller rooms or different shapes. It also works well as a deterrent for large room openings that traditional baby gates cannot block off.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I needed some sort of barrier between my puppy and the walls where I keep him during the day because he discovered he likes to chew drywall when momma\'s not home.  I had looked at dog pens on Amazon.com and compared them to this item.  I didn\'t find too much difference at all - except this item was a nice bit less expensive that the ones that are for dogs.  It takes a little effort to bend the hinges, but I think that\'s probably a good thing if you\'re considering this as an actual play pen for small children.  It\'s shorter than I imagined, so be sure you pay attention to the dimensions & that they\'ll fit your needs.  It\'s not too small for what I\'m using it for, though, so I\'m not disappointed.  I\'m actually quite pleased with this purchase.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Huge. Can be taken apart and used in multiple places at once if you don\'t need to make a giant baby playpen. Cheaper then buying multiple ones for different locations. A little difficult to take apart, but it\'s sturdy.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a great gate for new crawlers and toddlers alike. It\'s got enough height to keep little ones from climbing over, but short enough for caregivers to step over and enter. It\'s neutral; it doesn\'t really detract from the playroom or family room (besides, everyone knows it\'s a baby yard).  We love it because it keeps our child in one spot and our pets out of her play area. There is room enough for movement and play without taking up too much space. Also, it can be used in a small space by removing gates, and for a more open area (say, the beach) you can add to the gates (just purchase the gate extension for $20. Totally worth it!). Make sure you check the dimensions; it\'s bigger than you think! Our little girl loves \'her\' space and our older children appreciate and respect that. Well made, and well worth the money.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We borrowed another pen from a friend and my son was able to push it over.  This one keeps my son contained.  Its big enough he plays in it, but most of all I\'m impressed with Amazon\'s return policy! The first one  we got was broken.  I got a new 1 within 2 days!  Amazon made it easy!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I didn\'t believe it until I saw it with my own eyes.  My 9 pound dog can jump this fence.  I suppose it was a waste of money-my pup figured it out in less than one month of owning the fence.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: this was the first play yard my wife and i purchased for our one year old.  Guess what after opening and closing the play yard a few times the product broke at one of the joints.  Like allot of people have said the product is light and flimsy.  Besides if you do not want your child to climb out of the gate dont buy this product. So instead we purchased another gate system that we returned and finally settled on the north states gate system 3 in 1 metal.  buy this instead

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Love this play yard, our daughter is extremely busy and does not like to be confined in small spaces like a pack and play, this is perfect for her to crawl around in and she does not feel confined. I would definitely recommend this item to a friend.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this fence to use in a month long vacation of travel with my 3 dogs. It is easy to set up and transport, sturdy and doesn\'t have the potential of falling down if your dog stands up on it like the metal folding pens. There are no parts to rust and I realized I could also use as a gate for porch steps at home to allow my dogs to stay on my porch when I can\'t keep a constant eye on them.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this for my daughter who has a 1 yr old and 18 mo old AND is expecting another. She is very happy with the superyard as it keeps the kids contained so she can do things nearby. The kids actually seem to enjoy their special play area too. We also got the extension which makes it a very nice area for the children.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Wow, this is one of my best baby purchases so far! I\'m so happy with this baby yard. Right out of the box it was very easy to set up, it was not overly packaged either. Took about 3 to 4 minutes to set up and baby is very happy. Gives a nice piece of mind. I can give baby his crawling time and play time without having to worry about him crawling under my futon or getting into things that I just can\'t baby proof. It\'s not too small and not too big. Gives ample play space for baby. Would buy again!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I have a 1 year old and a 2 year old who constantly were getting into everything no matter how much we baby-proofed... I set this up  differently than the pictures shows... I made a long rectangle and a smaller square portion to prevent tipping. It is great. I bought some of the bright color padding on amazon and the kids actually get excited to go into the play yard! Love the ivory color as it looks nice in the living room. I bought the 8 panel play yard. More than happy with this purchase! Both of my children have plenty of room to play and now I do not have to chase my kids around 24/7. Definitely worth the investment, it has really made life easier!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I really like this play yard. It opens and closes fairly easy (easier with two people). Very sturdy. It is good for keeping my on-the-go 9 month old safe, especially when I need to get a few things done around the house. My only complaint is that there are some \'sharper\' edges on each panel in the middle, and as my little one was learning to pull up and stand, she would fall into the side. If she fell in the middle it would scratch her face. Other than that, it\'s great.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This has been a lifesaver for us. Our baby started walking at 8 months and this enclosure gives her the freedom that she needs and the peace that we need. The only complaint is that it is pretty difficult to take the pieces apart and requires quite a bit of force. Otherwise, a great investment.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: As other reviewers mention, no it\'s not beautiful.  But I definitely did not buy it for it\'s beauty.  I bought it along with an extension set to have a safe area for our children to play.  It\'s much roomier than a playpen, but still can be folded up to be mobile if needed.  It absolutely does get scooted all over our hardwood floor, but I\'m ok with that.  It still keeps her from going through doors or opening up cabinets.  Most of the time, we let her run free in the house, but this is so fantastic if she wants to watch TV while I\'m making dinner or just give her some boundaries while running around.  It is quite difficult to get the ends together, but I can do it without my husband\'s help.  With our first child, we used it also around the Christmas tree and around her bed to keep her from wandering if she woke up and I didn\'t hear her.  For these two jobs, we left it as an open semi-circle, but it\'s never gotten toppled over for us.  We just used the strongest/most stable angles at each joint.  Overall, this is wonderful, and one day, we may even use it as a puppy pen outside.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I am so glad I decided to purchase this!!  It works wonders for my little crawler.  I bought the 2 panel extension kit to go along with it so he has so much room to roam.  I put him in it with all of his toys and he will play for hours and I don\'t have to worry about him getting hurt.  It is very sturdy and has not been knocked over and he has even pulled himself up to a standing position while holding on to it and it stood strong!!  Definitely worth the money!!  I may buy another extension for it when he starts walking so it will definitely last for a while.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: well, i\'m not as impressed with this gate as most of the other reviewers seem to be. it does seem durable enough, though perhaps a little too much so -- it\'s almost impossible to open and close it. i\'ve given in to just always stepping over it, which is a pain, especially with a baby, and sometimes more, in my arms. it\'s very heavy and NOT something you will easily be able to move from room to room. i\'m also not certain of how hard it will be for my son to knock it over when he gets a little older and a little stronger...lastly, it\'s pretty much necessary to buy the extension, b/c the space is just too small without it. which is annoying.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I just love the play yard it is ever thing i wanted and more from me it gets a10 star rating. it is light weight and you can take it any where.it also keeps my little one safe.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Holds up well.  Our child is able to stand up on the sides and we have no fear of it tipping over.  Well built, fun colors and party time.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Great Product for small dog pen. It comes with Six panels which is large enough for any dog.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: The play yard is made in good size and is great overall. It does its purpose that is to keep my 10 month old, who is crawling, out of trouble. He loves to stand up holding onto to it also and i guess it helps him walk better. The only thing that is a little hard is to fold it as it is large and I am always trying not to bang to furniture.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: The gate was very hard to put together and had a hard time getting it into an octagon shape. If I moved one side another side would pop out of place.also, my 8 month old could fit her feet into the holes and climb to the top. Very scary....wishing I wouldn\'t have purchased this play yard. Tried to do a return but, it never got picked up by UPS from my house...

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: got to use at baby\'s grandparent\'s. saved our niece from the dog that got out. sets up well. a bit hard to open and close, but, hey, saved the baby!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We bought this a few weeks ago for our 11 month-old and bought the extension kit just in case. It is a great little unit -- big enough to occupy her and incredibly light-weight when you break it down. The fact that it is easily expandable is also a real plus. When you set it up into a stable shape, the baby can cruise around along the fence, shake it, bounce up and down, lean on it and it doesn\'t give. Highly recommended!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This play yard was an excellent purchase, super fast delivery, excellent price...  I use it for when my grandson visits- Thanks!!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I decided when I was planning on getting a new puppy I would need something to keep her contained, but yet enough room to sleep , play , eat and do her business. This was perfect!!!I have my own business , a shop that restores leather furniture. I set it up at work  so she cannot get into anyplace where i cannot see her.(Coco)Coco enjoyes her space in her play pen!Its safe, comfortable and easy to set up..Thank You Amazon!Sincerely,Debra Russo

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We got his to protect the Christmas Tree from our 7mo. old this past Christmas.  Boy has it delivered.  Now, we have a section of it protecting the home theater equipment and another section of it keeping the cat litter off limits.  It\'s sturdy enough for the little one to pull himself up on without toppling over and can easily be bended to form new shapes.  Adding and subtracting pieces is a snap as well.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Ordered this yard online at Amazon. It came with 5 sections connected. All you have to do is to unfold all sections and connect the last link. The installation was very easy but noisy (when you unfold it some sections click loudly). My baby is 11 months old, he leans on the yard walls pretty often. And the yard is strong enough to hold him. Baby doesn\'t feel separated by the yard and can be left alone for a few moments.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this for my toy poodle because she runs all over the backyard when she\'s supposed to be taking care of her business. This play yard along with treats has totally house trained her. And I know she is safe.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This started out as an enclosure for our son when he was about six moths old and worked very well in combination with a padded floor mat we also bought on Amazon (B003SPA1K8).  Now that our son is older and does not respond well to being cooped up in an enclosure we can open this gate up and wrap it around areas of rooms we don\'t want him to access (like our wood-burning stove).This was a great purchase.  One down side is that it is a bit flimsy, but that hasn\'t been a problem yet.  It has done it\'s job well. Also, there is no "walk-through" gate, so you are going to have to step over this thing to get past it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: the play yard gate really comes in handy. I use it for my puppies. It cost me half the price at Amazon versus a local department store.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This would have worked alright if we had a huge living room, but it was impossible to break down. Also, it just looked like a cage. My baby didn\'t like it, but I know that is not the fault of the thing itself - he is just pretty clingy.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This product is extremely good and very useful....well constructed, good design and very sturdy.  Either used as a confined play area, or as barrier against areas you want to corner off from the child.  Highly recommend this product.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Bought this fence to use for my 10 month old daughter, works great and its easy to assemble.Love the product.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a brightly colored, inviting play-yard.  It does what it needs to do by corraling little ones into a designated play area.  However, it\'s hard plastic and not very pliable.  It only folds ONE way but that\'s not really clear, since either way you try to fold it is met with resistance and just feels wrong. Thus, I used it once and the plastic snapped when I attempted to put it away.  When it breaks, it\'s dangerous because the plastic is so hard and creates jagged edges.  Thus, the extension gates I bought to make it bigger, actually served as replacement parts. I will leave it set-up all the time now and let it do the job for which it was intended!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: It arrived in just one day!I ordered 1 set of extension because it comes with three panels. It made a perfect square which covers the entire foam pad on the floor.It is sturdy yet flexible, and it helped my little one get up when he fell down. It seems to be doing its job.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I really like the play yard and bought it with soft foam mats to create a \'baby jail\'. However, it is a little more flexible than I expected and my little one pulls up on everything these days. Also, there was a piece of the fence that had broken at the joint and wasn\'t in the box, so it must have broken before boxing. That was rather disappointing. Otherwise, it\'s a good play yard and serves its purpose.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We\'ve used this gate for years in all kind of shapes. We\'ve used it to corral the kids, but also to block our driveway so the kids couldn\'t run out and now it\'s in the basement blocking an unfinished area. Still going strong after 4 years!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Only for young fathers because have no door and is difficult to open, you have to jump in with your baby but anyway well made

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a great way for outdoor play as well as indoor play for toddlers.  We took this to the beach and set it up under the umbrella.  Everyone was able to relax and enjoy the day.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a great size for our 8 month old baby.  He is able to pull up to standing using the gate now.  It came pretty much assembled already.  It gives me a little freedom to make dinner or use the bathroom.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I got this for my new dog. Note: they sell this as a yard for kids and also for dogs. As far as I can tell, it\'s the same product but the cost of getting it as a dog yard is usually MORE than for kids!We don\'t use it as a yard though. We use the pieces (usually 2 at a time) as barriers to rooms. Since they can form a "V" shape, they stand up on their own well.As the dog got bigger it learned how to move the fence out of the way. For the main use (kitchen to family room) I put a nail in the wall near each side of the opening and use bungee cords to hold the fence in place. It\'s working fine so far.We\'ve been trying to train the dog to not jump over the fence. It\'s working so far (I think it could make the jump) but big dogs (and children) will need something taller. Using additional bungee cords, I\'ve been able to double the height (there\'s plenty of holes to connect to) and make the barrier tall enough to work.The product is easy to use, high quality plastic, and (so far) the dog hasn\'t been able to chew through it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We use this across our garage when in the garage & it keeps our dogs in and not visiting the neighbors.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Allows freedom for the child. They are able be more independent and safely emplore and Mommy can get things done.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This fence works great.  Our boy just started to crawl, so we bought this to protect him from household items.  He immediately used it to stand and has been trying to stand on his own since.  The hexagon setup is good for a 5 x 7 rug.  We put padding under the rug since we have a hard floor.  It also works great for outdoors on a blanket on top of grass.  We bought two thinking we needed two for the size of our house, but one is a good size.  We use the second for outside.  Works best in hexagonal setup as that provides the most sturdy configuration.  It is big enough for an adult to lay inside and play with baby.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: the kids love this new fence.  it serves the purpose of keeping the kids intact... great item to purchase .

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Useful for large openings and can be taken apart to use in several places at once.  Tall enough to keep baby from crawling over it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I am so glad I purchased it! It is so sturdy and holds my dog in so well:) I highly recommend it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Fairly easy to put together (even for a weakling like me!) and very sturdy.  My son can pull himself up and walk around the edges.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We installed these for our baby when he was 6 months old for his playpen. He started to sit and crawl in the playpen shortly after. The fence did its job of keeping the baby inside. A month later, he learned to grab onto the holes of the fence to pull himself up into standing position. We were excited for his early motor skills.Then another two weeks went by, he started to climb the fence by putting his little toes in the grids of the fence. We were surprised that he was able to accomplish this at all. At 8 months old, he was able to climb half way up the fence, which has become a dangerous situation. We now have to watch him constantly in case of him falling off the fence or the fence breaking.If we had known that our baby would be a little monkey, we would have gotten a fence with vertical bars instead of grids.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Very sturdy. Good quality. Find it hard to open and close it though, takes a lot of pressure and I feel like I\'m going to break it every time I do it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this to help protect my Christmas tree from my 8mo old daughter.  I also bought one for my sister in law for the same purpose.  We both love it... it is perfect for the job.  I\'m not sure how it will work in the summer when I use it as a kiddie corral in the yard... I guess I\'ll have to wait and see.  All I know for now is that it certainly keeps the pine needles out of the baby\'s mouth!!!!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Bought this play pen for my 5 pound poodle and realy like it becayse it gives him enough moving room and yet keeps him from making mistakes in the house.  I reduced its size and only use 4 sections and therefore it makes a neat rectangle which can be put in a corner out of the mainstream.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I give this item 20 stars. I put the purchase off for a while. With twin boys, I needed it. It is a lifesaver, truly. It sets my mind at ease when I have things to do.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I was thrilled with the purchase ( as was the young mom I bought it for?\\!) Most amazing was the prompt delivery - the NEXT DAY!!!!  I would recommend this product to anyone.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Wish we had gotten this thing soon. Helped my little one learn to stand up as they can grab onto the fence, surprisingly sturdy but you have to read the instructions for it to work safely.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We use the superyard gate for our teacup chuau and mini maltese.  It works great for in the yard or camping to keep our puppies safe!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased this play-yard to confine my litle dog to family-room/kitchen area of our home when we are gone. It is very sturdy and can be set with many angles to work in most any area as well as an octagon play yard. Definitaly worth the money and it was less then retail stores.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I ordered this product for my 4-month-old cockapoo puppy.  I have an open floor plan and I use it as a fence to keep the puppy in my family room.  The SuperYard extends over a 12 foot opening and it works great. Other similar products on Amazon were either too short or too expensive. I did NOT have to anchor the SuperYard to the walls as some others have had to do (I have it on carpet, hard floors would be more problematic). If you set it up in a zigzag fashion (see the product photos) and brace the ends against your door frames, the puppy can\'t easily push it over. I gave the SuperYard 4 instead of 5 stars only because it is not easy for people to get through the fence.  The joints between sections are stiff (to improve the strength of the barrier), but this means that you can\'t swing a section open like a gate. What we do is to pull the end of the fence away from the door frame enough to slip by. This trade-off is worth it to me since my puppy now doesn\'t have the run of the house. I think the SuperYard would also work well as a fence or barrier for toddlers and crawlers.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This play yard was easy to assemble and was very roomy !! I am very happy with this product,would definately recommend ! Arrived in less than 2 days too! Wow !!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We love this item. We use it to protect our electronics, cords and a bunch of other things we don\'t want our puppy to get to for safety and economic reasons. It is very versatile and can be configured around many different things. We bought 2 and separated one to block off 3 areas. Even though it\'s not high, we don\'t need height to keep our large breed puppy out of small spaces blocked off. It sure beats constantly yelling no. We will start taking them down gradually as he gets older.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: My wife and I bought this to keep our 18 month old out of our Christmas tree this year. It served its purpose well. I suppose it is difficult to mess up a child barrier/gate. However, my complaint about the play yard is the hinges. This is a very bad design. They move in about 15 degree increments, but there is no way to release the ratcheting mechanism before moving. So you just have to apply enough force to disengage the locking teeth. It feels like I am going to break the hinges every time I move one. (So far none have broken.)I would not hesitate to recommend this play yard in a set-and-forget application that will very rarely be moved. However, if you need something to set up and tear down quickly, look somewhere else. I feel very confident that it would not take long to break these hinges with repeated movement.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: my one year old learned how to climb out of it two weeks after being purchased. so I decided to put it up and once it is put together you cant put it away. broke after my 3rd attempt to fold it back up.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I don\'t use this to encage my kida, just keep them away from highly expensive 61" tv and surround sound.  This gate is great since I put it up the kids don\'t even try to get near the t.v. and it prevents little hands from smearing or damaging my $2,000 t.v.  I highly reccomend.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased this to make a "kid cage" for our kids. We have a 10-month old that loves to crawl around. I purchased this along with foam letters and it\'s like a giant play pen. Everytime we have visitors, all adults of all ages go into the "kid cage" to play witho ur kids! I would recommend this to anyone that has toddlers or children. It\'s very durable and the colors are bright! Worth every penny!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This gate/coral was a godsend for when my wife or I had to step out of a room and leave our little guy unattended for a minute or two.  This worked good up until he was maybe 2 or 2 1/2 I can\'t remember.  This worked great both indoors and outside in the yard.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is my second set.. I wanted my baby to have more room to run so I bought the second set.. Its a great way to keep her safe and have her own space..

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This Play Yard is exactly what I was looking for to cordon off a large portion of a room as a play area for our crawling 7mo.  It\'s sturdy and colorful.  It\'s much larger than I anticipated, I ordered the extension with it and didn\'t end up needing it, but it\'s really the perfect size for a spoiled little rug rat.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I shopped around and read reviews, and honestly this is the best thing I own for keeping my (now) 7 month old grandbaby.  I purchased one locally, then found a much better deal online.  I ended up with both sets and an extension.  I kept the one purchased locally, but intended to return it.  After baby began crawling, I opened it up quickly and set it up in another room.  She LOVES it.  She can crawl over a large area without being grabbed up and told NO.  She can explore the area safely and if I need to attend to something, I put her in there with her toys and she doesn\'t seem to notice I have left the room.  I don\'t have any trouble setting it up or taking it down.  I thought they were difficult to adjust at first, because I thought I would break them.  I discovered they are quite easy to adjust now that I am comfortable changing the configuration to fit my needs.  I am actually looking for another set for outdoor use and for my 2 small dogs (baby really doesn\'t like being sniffed by the dogs).  I can\'t say how it will hold up as she begins walking or pushing the fence, but it does come with anti-skid pads (that I haven\'t had to use).  She pulls up on the fence and it wiggles, but doesn\'t move out of place.  They may not add to the decor, but my baby\'s safety is much more important to me than \'looks\'.  I know that the Christmas tree will be protected with a fence this December, and I am already thinking of ways to safely decorate the fence.  If any of those people who didn\'t like theirs want to sell it cheap, I am in the market.......

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I use this product as a playpen, I LOVE it!  I like it better than your usual playpen because it is larger and more versital.  It can also be used outside if you have puppies.  It is very sturdy and when I\'m not babysitting it folds up almost flat.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: does what it is supposed to do. one complain is that it lacks a good gate, pulling one panel on and off requires a man\'s power.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is the 2nd Superyard XT Gate Play Yard we have purchased and believe me it is worth the money.  One of our daughters has 1 year old triplets and our other daughter has 1 year old twins and I cannot tell you how much easier life is when they visit. We\'ll be getting a 3rd one when it\'s time to put up the Christmas tree to keep the kids OUT!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We bought this play yard to box off an area around our sectional couch. It has worked perfectly and keeps my daughter out of harms way. It is sturdy and allows her to pull herself up into a standing position. I would recommend this product to anyone with little ones. We can put her inside the play yard and know she will be safe.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We bought this for my 11 month old daughter to keep her in while cooking, doing dishes, etc. She isn\'t a fan of being in her pack & play & is now walking so getting stuff done around the house isn\'t very easy these days! A friend has this for her 8 month old & they love it so we thought we\'d give it a try. It definitely looks like a dog kennel, but not many kids gates are cute anyway. My daughter can easily push it, even with the stoppers on, if it\'s opened up. When we have it set up as a hexagon, she can\'t move it but it is a 2 person job! It doesn\'t shape very easily, it feels like I\'m going to break it & it wasn\'t that easy to get the 2 pieces to lock together. It took both my husband & myself & even then it was hard. I\'ve seen better, seen worse, but my daughter likes to so that\'s all that matters!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: totally worth every penny. purchased when my baby was 8 months. no assembly required. we don\'t have to worry about my baby getting the dog\'s toys and bones anywmore.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I am a daycare provider and the superyard is wonderful for baby\'s and toddlers.  I us the superyard for infants when I am making meals or playing outside, I also us the superyard for toddlers if they are playing and the infants are bothering them.  I love it!!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I got this for my grandson.  At eight months, he is able to push the sides and move it across the floor.  He almost pushed it down the other day.  That being said, It still proves useful in containing him for play and gives him more freedom that a play pen.  I would not leave him alone in it as I would be afraid he would push it down and fall.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I really like the superyard. Felt really comfortable with my pets in it. I felt they were really safe. Only issue it is hard to open and close if you had to get inside. Overall great product.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Although fairly industrial looking, we have this in our living room, with colored foam squares underneath it, and it looks and works great.  Highly recommended, especially if you hang some mobiles and toys from the sides.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I have a Lhasa Apso, and have used this product for over 4 years, and currently own several sets of this item. In addition to its intended use by the manufacturer, I have installed it around my patio, and around a large circumference of my lawn, with additional support. It is attractive, and easily moved for lawn care. The last five sets were purchased from Amazon, and their price was the best by far from other dealers. Overall, it is a great product for small pets.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: love this pen for our little shih tzu/yorkie.  its perfect for her.  and the adjustable size is ideal for our small area and small dog.  i highly recommend for puppies.  for kids, it doesnt do much good unless made to not get pushed around.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I am using this product with the 2 extension pieces. The order came very quickly and in perfect condition. There is no assembly required. My daughter is 10 months old and it is perfect. It is very large and takes up a huge chunk of my living room. This is great for her, though, because she has lots of room to play and crawl. I can play in there with her, too! I use it for when I need to get some cooking done, etc. I did have to put lots of toys and activities in there to distract her. Of course, there are still times that she does not want to be in there and will cry. That is always going to be the case, though. It is very tall, too. I also like how easy it is to move around. Sometimes we use it to block sections of the room off, too. LIFESAVER for us!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: My wife and I bought this product for our 8 month old son, who regardless of how much we baby proof still manages to get into everything. It wasn\'t expensive at all compared to similar products. Our son is a big boy (24 lbs 26 inches long), and we were afraid that he would hurt himself by pulling up on it, but it seems to stand just fine with his weight. WE needed the peace of mind knowing that he wouldn\'t get into something dangerous while we were washing bottles, cooking dinner, cleaning house, ect... We\'re so happy we bought this, you wont be disappointed!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We bought this to keep a distance between our two-year-old and the Christmas tree.  We anchored it with furniture on both ends and it has served its purpose well.  She can push on it but not enough to be a problem.  I\'m thinking of using it on the deck later and we can see all kinds of uses for it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We plan on using this play yard for our new puppy. It is easy to set up and with the extension creates a large area. The non-skid pads the mfgr provides prevents it from slipping on tile. Sometimes the panels are hard to move (to change the angle).I checked many other websites and stores and this was the best deal. I requested that is show up on a Saturday but it arrived on Friday. Great job, Amazon!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We use the play yard everyday. we have fenced the tv or fireplace off with it open or closed the play yard and used it for our grandson outside.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this item about a month ago and really have loved i it.  A nice spacious area for my 6 month old to play in safely....until I tried to fold it back down to travel for the holidays.  The 8 panels are connected with joints.  Unfortunately, in trying to fold the joints, the panels did not fold at the joints, instead the plastic seemed to just snap.  This happened in 6 of the 8 panels.  It produces sharp shards of plastic.  Clearly not something that is safe for use around a child.I am disappointed because it was great having a large area for my daughter to play in.  But, it certainly does not open up easily or fold down without issue.Back to looking for another safe play yard!!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Thank you.  I wasn\'t expected two day shipping. It was awesome and this play yard is very strong enough to wiggle by baby.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Awesome product!!! I absolutely love this to my baby. However,  I highly suggest also purchasing the extension piece that is sold separately.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: OMG...love it.  healthy boundaries...great forcrawling and useful for support when pullingup to stand.  super easy to configure anddisassemble when needed.  got the extension forextra space.  GREAT PURCHASE.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: My son loves it! And I feel safe running to the kitchen to get a soda now that he\'s up and running all over! A must-have for parents with small children who have just started walking.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Very useful, easy to use and store.  Light and compact folded, my grandson loves to play in it.  Great value for the price!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this to contain my litter of Scottish Terrier puppies.  Works great, is easy to set up and easy to keep clean

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I used this for awhile like it\'s supposed to be set up but my son started crawling & cruising at 6 months and quickly learned that there was more places to go & he would scream anytime I got near the gate.  So I ended up buying 2 of these and I have them stretched out across the openings to the living room, the fireplace and in front of our DVD\'s, so that he has the entire living room to explore.  He is now 10 months old and he still doesn\'t mind being confined to the living room for play time.  I babysit my friend\'s 8 month old who is just learning to crawl and he likes the free roam of the living room too.  Having 2 babies on the go, I can\'t live without this gate!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Thank you, thank you!  I needed a place for my little one to go that had plenty of room for her to run around in and was safe.  I like that you can open it up and make a u shape with it open against the couch, she likes to be able to get to us.  When I want to close it off into one circle, I can do that, too.  It\'s durable, too.  I bought the 8 panel one.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: My son was 7 months old when he started roaming our living room trying to find things to get into. We immediatley needed something to contain him in for short periods of time when we are cooking, going to the restroom ect. He likes being in his playard for short periods of time, 30 minutes tops. After 30 minutes he wants to pull up on the gate and try to escape. He only weighs 17lbs and the gate gives a little but doesn\'t seem like it\'s possible for it to fall because of the way its assembled. It seems sturdy. I put mine as a rectangle as that is how our living room made the most sense, the octagon looks like kids would enjoy it also. I did not have to order the extensions although I thought I would. If you are tight on space and you munchkin is into everything like mine was then this playyard is a must have for being able to take your eyes off your little one for two minutes at a time. I filled it with toys and non toxic foam mats and he was good to go. It\'s tall enough where even when he is able to stand up there\'s no way he can get out of there on his own.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This play yard is easy to set up and move from place to place. I use it for my puppies and they love it. This price is way lower than I could find it in any store.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I got this play yard because I had a super awkward stairway (rounded edges, uneven widths, etc.) and couldn\'t find a gate that would fit my space.  I instead took 3 of the pieces of this play yard and folded them into an open triangle-ish shape and used it to block the stairs at the bottom.  (Obviously, this would not be a safe strategy for the top of a stairway.)  It served the purpose when my child was an early walker because she couldn\'t get to the stairs without me moving the gate to the side.  Now she\'s a toddler and can move the gate on her own, but it still creates some kind of barrier to delay her at least so I can be there to supervise.The play yard is nice quality and could be used for lots of different purposes.  It comes with some pieces to attach to the bottom to keep it from moving easily on a hard-wood floor.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is perfect.It arrived with minor damage from shipping. There was a hole punched in the box and there was minor damage to one of the panels. I contacted customer service and they shipped me a new panel no questions asked.Love it. Love the customer service. I would not hesitate to order from this company again.Oh and the playpen works great too. I can fold it up and move it around the house really easily and my daughter stays safely in the area without any fuss.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Bought this pen to corral two Miniature Pinscher puppies until house broken.  Worked much better then anticipated. It was perfect set up in the hexagon shape while they were little.  Once they were older we removed two panels and set up small square which gave us some place to put two hyper puppies when carrying groceries in, taking out trash, etc.  The two left over panels made the perfect gate to span the wide opening to the living room.  It would probably not have worked as well or for as long with a larger breed of dog but for our purposes it was perfect. Folded up it is easy to slide back in the box and store in the garage. Don\'t know how well it would keep a toddler confined but would definitely recommend for a puppy.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Gate was exactly as described.  We\'re using the gate to keep our 10 month out of everything she can get her hands on.  I know some people have mentioned that the gate is easy to break, but that\'s only if you bend the gate the wrong way!  The gate does take a little getting use to, but overall great buy.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I have twins and this is a life saver... now that they are older we are going to need more panels though.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Was so upset to open a damaged box and bring out an item that had obviously been used all ready and was so broken...its sad.Unreal...I was so excited to get this item and turned out so disappointing.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this play yard specifically to keep my toddler out of the Christmas tree. I\'ve had it up for almost a month and the tree is still standing, yay! It doesn\'t feel as sturdy as I\'d hoped but she doesn\'t really try to shake it so it stays in place. It was about $40. less on Amazon than Toys R Us. Excellent buy. Totally worth the money even if I just use it at Christmas.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Overall this product is as described and I am satisfied with the purchase.  The only flaw is if you use it to block something rather than using it as a playpen.  There is a small plastic knob at the bottom of each section that is used to connect them together, so when the gate is not connected it is sticking straight up in the air and a child could easily fall on it a get seriously hurt.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: When looking for a gate that could enclose a nine foot space, I realized how expensive things were going to get. We purchased this instead and found it to be wonderful. It provided more space than your average playard, and it could be taken outside for my son to enjoy the grass too. I could shape it how I wanted (rectangle, hexagonal, square...) to fit my home. The color is a neutral grey, and I found I could hang some of my son\'s toys on it because of the way it has a criss-cross pattern. The best thing about this is that you can add more panels (or remove them) to create the size you want. At our congregation, another mommy and I had put ours together to create the perfect space for three to four babies to play and crawl around in comfortably (with us in there with them). I am currently looking to buy yet another one that I can have here at home permanently. Yes, they are portable, but not on a weekly basis when I need other things packed in my trunk. It is not THAT burdensome, but I am growing weary of packing it every week.I would buy the next mommy-to-be one. It simply gives me the peace of mind knowing I can put my son down in it for a few minutes and not worry about him. I have mine placed between the kitchen and the living room, where we can see each other while I cook dinner, or fold laundrey, or do what needs to be done around here. He plays safely and comfortably...I can get stuff done. It\'s GREAT!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We have this in use already, works so much better than having to rearrange the whole room to pen down my grandsons whereabouts.was really surprised by the bright colors, and to use the foam mats as flooring outside was perfect.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I got this for my 11 month daughter... And its one of the best purchases I\'ve made. She always wants me to hold her so it was hard to get things done around the house, but after I got this for her, I put some toys in there with her and she plays while I get things done. It\'s very easy to set up, I got 2 extentions to make her space bigger.  It makes my living room look colorful, but what can I expect with a Baby around the house :)

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I like how the product came already together.  It is large and covers a good amount of space.  It appears to be sturdy and my 1 year old pulled up on without it falling over.  I mostly like that we can fold it and move it as needed.  After she is older we will keep it to block the dogs.  Overall a good purchase and I prefer it to a mounted gate.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Large enough to give a toddler space with all his toys and have room to move around.  The larger size is really big enough for two toddlers to play in while I cook or clean or watch TV too.  He loves the bright colors and it is another way to teach them to him.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: The superyard does exactly what I wanted it to do i.e. keep my 10 month grandchild in a safe place where he can play with his toys and still be with the family.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I use this for my Boston Terrier puppy and it works great.  I am able to leave his crate open, food, water, toys and a litter box in the pen and he still has room to move around.  I use mine in a rectangular construction.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Overall this is a great product.  Very sturdy.  It is a little difficult to manuever the panels where you want them to go.  I also had a little trouble connecting the panels to complete the circle.  I use it for my rabbits and it works great.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased this play yard for my home day care. It is very sturdy and works wonderfully to keep a crawling 9 month old safe. I also purchased the gray one with the extensions for use outside!I also open it up to block off a portion of my living room so he has more room for crawling - as long as you keep the panels at the recommended angles it stays upright even when he stands at it.Definitely worth purchasing!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Beautiful bright colors and covers a  large area for kids or pets. Also purchased one with a gate opening and would order that style over this one next time.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this play yard years ago for a new puppy, it was invaluable...after I lent it to a relative, I never saw it again.  Years later I have now purchased this for my first grandson...again I find it invaluable.Once he started to crawl, this became a safe haven for him and a way for me to get a break from running after him.  He liked using the honeycomb lattice to pull himself up and walk around the parameter of the gate.After a while I used the gate in pieces...I used a three section piece to keep him safe from my wood burning stove...now keep in mind it was not all that stable but it kept him from getting burnt and if he did knock it over and it fell on him it was light enough to not hurt him.  I used a two section piece to keep him away from an artificial tree in a corner of the living room...and sometimes used a 2 or three section piece to block off an entry way...again not all that stable but it does deter and if it does come down on them it wont cause any harm in my experience.The unit folds up nicely for storage and has a very sturdy canvas strap with two snaps that can be used as a handle for carrying around.Breaking the sections apart are not all that easy...you need a bit of muscle but I was able to handle it on my own.With the ease and compactness of storage, I highly recommend this unit...if you have any small children in your home or those who may be visiting, this unit will be invaluable to you.  I have many North States products...gates and such and find them to be well made and worth the price.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: When I purchased this it was used to keep my daughter (she was 1 at the time) away from the Christmas tree.  It help a whole bunch, she kept away just reached for the decorations.  We used the gate when outside and it was sturdy and never collapsed.  I think it\'s a great produce for children or to keep small pets inside.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Not easy to put together.  It is heavy and you need help putting it up. need someone strong to close pieces together to form the play yard

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This gate is excellent!  We got a new puppy and she chews on everything! You cant let her out of your sight for a minute, so this gate has been great.  I can put her in with her toys and not worry about her hurting herself.  She is about ten pounds and and stand up on the gate but not get out.  I would highly recommend this product!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Well made product. Folds down compactly for easy use when traveling and home storage between use.  This play yard provides a safe area for our little grandchild. We also purchased the expansion unit (optional) to increase play area.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: The only problem I have with this product is that my daughter can move it, even with the little attachments on the bottom to stop it from slipping, I like it, its very good material, but that is the only problem I have with it. I recommend it all the time though.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a functional solution for a young baby or toddler but I am not sure about someone older than that. The gate gets the job done for a good price but I think it will be too flimsy in a few years.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: this gate works well for us. It does need to be secured with furniture or my 13 mo. old would push it around the room. We put two together and circled them around the back of the couch so she can\'t move or tip it. On it\'s own i think she\'d push or lift it up and it would cause more harm and hassle than keep her safe.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I\'m very please with this product.  My son is unable to re-organize the bookshelves, dvd\'s, vhs\'s and all other things that his not suppose to touch.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: It works quite well.  I think I would like it better as one color, but the baby loves the different colors!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This gate is perfect to keep my puppy out of the front of the house.  It is great that I can bend this gate to fit an odd space over six feet wide.  It is affordable and it was free shipping.  I saved $40.00 by buying it from Amazon.com and not Petsmart!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Of course my seven year old is my best helper, but this Superyard is #2.  I used this product for my other two grandkids and it provided me a a great sense of security.  I use mine in a rectangle shape so it doesn\'t take up the entire living room.  My new grandbaby is not too thrilled with it, but he will get used to it.The product is easy enough to fold when the kids leave and doesn\'t take up much space.All in all, I love it and I will reiterate, I love the sense of security it provides.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: keeping my first grandchild safe with out him feeling caged in wasn\'t easy. He likes this because I can change the shape of the play area, and the colors make it feel more like just that, a play area.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Great for keeping our 1 year old daughter safe. We originally ordered 1, then ordered a second so we had enough to cover the perimeter of the living room. It gives us peace of mind knowing she can\'t get near the TV or fireplace.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We have 4 children 3 are 4 and under. This is a big help both in a circle and straight out to keep little ones away from Christmas tree and Fire place. Plan on using outside in nice weather. Much better looking then the plywood we were using.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Easy to set up and I was able to shape it to fit great in the space I need it to. Once the girls (I have twins) need more space I can going to open it up and use it as a gate to keep them out of the kitchen (We have an open concept space).

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I absolutely love this product.  Love it so much, I intend to buy a second one to make her play area larger.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We have gotten a lot of use out of this gate blocking a wide entry to the kitchen.  The ends are sandwiched behind the sofa and entertainment center so we don\'t have to worry about it tipping over.  It\'s great just stationary but I have broken two of the panels now when folding it/unfolding it.  I\'m not very strong so I don\'t think it\'s a good sign that I\'ve already busted two in the six months we\'ve been using it. I wish it were made out of better material.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This has worked great with our three pups.The only thing I really didn\'t like was tryingto snap the pieces into place but if you have twopeople it works great.  I would recommend gettingtwo and putting them together!!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I can\'t recommenend this product too highly!  This is the neatest in that you can use it to form a myriad of shapes to fit any size space you have available.  You can work around furniture ,posts,etc.  It is a sturdy fence that does not tip easily even when strung out across a room. It also holds the shape you put it into until you decide to reshape it. You can\'t go wrong.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I knew when purchasing this gate that it wasn\'t the most advanced gate out there, but it would work as a play area in our living room for my 9 month old. He is obsessed with the wide screen TV and any other electronic we have in his line of vision. haha. So far he seems to not mind playing in the gate. Of course I am there to supervise, but it\'s nice to have him play in it while I am cooking dinner or something. I have it in the hexagon shape on the letter/number mat and he pulls himself up on it all the time, and he is a good almost 20 lbs, it holds up just fine. :) I am glad I purchased it, I just wish that it was a little easier to open up, or had some sort of a door on it. But for the money, it\'s worth it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: He hated the pin , but would have probably hated any pen. The good part it comes in sections and we used it to just block doorways and worked well.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I have been using this product for about 2 months now, and it is great.  I bought a second set so I can have one in the basement.  It is modular, so I can make it into a hexagon from an octagon and use the additional panels elsewhere as barriers to hallways etc.  I highly recommend this item.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Fantastic portable prison for the baby. no escape he wont be getting into anything on my watch. portable baby prison

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this play yard to help my wife out since work keeps me away from home all too often.  I read that someone thought this item seemed cheap, I disagree.  It is very sturdy and even helped my son to stand up for the first time.  I am extrememly pleased with this play yard.  It was very easy to set up and fits great in my family room.My son didn\'t like it at first, he was annoyed by the seperation it caused between him and my wife, but was over that extremely quickly.  This play yard gives my wife the opportunity to take a break from chasing him and having to pick him up and away from the things he shouldn\'t be playing with.  The break allows her to give her back a rest as well.I did buy the extensions so he would have more room to play.  My wife has not connected both ends as of yet, she just uses it to connect two walls together and it keeps my son at bay.  If you have the space, I definitely recommend the extensions.All in all, my wife and I very happy with this product and would recommend it to anyone with an active and roaming child.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Iam happy i bought this play yard ( along with extension) when my 6 month old baby girl started crawling and exploring around. This is a wonderful product and we put it up in the living room so that she has enough space to move around within the play yard, also blocking her from messing up with the entertainment set, furniture etc. highly recommend this product.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Much bigger space than i expected.  It gives my wife some time to do things while my 9 mo. old plays with all her toys inside.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Fast shipping and item was as advertised.  I purchased it for my 11 month old, but the only problem is my 4 yr old makes me feel bad when he calls it a cage.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Purchased for a strong willed soon to be walking child. It works well with a play mat placed under it, though it needs to be periodically monitored to make sure that Ms. Hercules hasn\'t managed to slightly shift it to the left or right during her last play stint. HA! I\'ve no worry of it tipping and it\'s a piece of mind to place her in there and walk away to housework. One thing, opening it and closing can be a bit of a pain, I simply step over it to place her in it or take her out of it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this play pen for my small dog. It\'s big enough so that he has plenty of room to sleep, play, and even do his business in there. The play pen is easy to fold up if I ever need to put it away. The hinges are a little ridged, but maybe it still needs to be twisted and turned a bit more. It comes with these rubber stickers to put on the bottom so the play pen won\'t slide. Since I use it for my dog, he tends to get the panels dirty. So I have to wipe it down everyday. It can get difficult with all the little holes and crevices on each panel. But overall, the play pen is very sturdy. My dog can\'t move it or tip it over.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this play yard for my 6 month old grandson.  It works well for letting him crawl around and pull up, but keeping him within bounds.  It is roomy enough that I can get in with him.Very easy to set up.....just pull it out of the box and you are ready to go!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: These are GREAT for blocking/sectioning off large areas that are too awkward or tricky to really baby proof. We are military and move a lot so I don\'t like to invest in a million baby proofing gates that I don\'t know if I\'ll need in 6 months. This has worked out perfectly for a certain area of our house. Definitely recommend!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: The main kit is big enough for my 10 month-old to play in adequate space in my living room, but not overwhelming in size for my small living room. It\'s strong and sturdy, though a bit industrial-looking. Overall, I\'m very pleased!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We\'ve used these panels (and extensions) for a number of things when the girls where younger. Mostly used during Christmas time to keep them away from the tree and presents. I\'ve also used it around my office desk when it was exposed to the crawler/toddler at another house. Or just to block off a room without having to close the door, so they could see me and be with me, but not reach the cords. Used them with both of my girls. And they\'ll go to another family to use for their young children.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: If you are using this type of play yard at your house as a permanent item to use for several months, the metal version is much more sturdy.  We keep this plastic play yard at Grandma\'s house for our 17 month old twins, and it is okay as a temporary play yard.  It has the advantage of being lighter than the metal one.  You definitely need at least one extension panel set.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: My son was an early crawler & this was a a MUST HAVE. We lived in a townhouse & couldn\'t gate the stairs going up & down from living room so this worked to keep him in one area. Especially helpful as I\'m a stay-at-home-mom & sometimes you just need those few seconds to leave the room to pee, answer phone, whatever. I also bough the extender to make it as LARGE as possible. 2 panels larger to be exact. My only complaint is that it is a little heavy & hard fold, which proved to be a pain when our home was on the market & I had to snatch & fold it up quickly for a showing. Definitely pinched my fingers a few times in my rushing around trying to do it quickly.  But the good news is it\'s VERY sturdy b.c it is so heavy. MY son could pull, hang do whatever & this gate held him IN. And my son is VERY tall for his age  and this gate stood the test of a very active toddler. Definitely hanging on to it for baby #2!!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: its ok product, it is a little wobbly and purchasing it the first time but didnt send the product and never saw the money again so i just repurchased it. its decent size and my daughter loved it

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I got this gate originally planning to use it for my 8-month old. Needless to say, when I got it - I felt it was more suited for a pet, as opposed to a baby. The gate is fairly secure when it is used as an independent unit, but is not so great if you are trying to "box in" something and use a wall as the remainder of the unit. I found it to be pretty wobbly for a baby who may try to pull up on the gate. However, I think this would work for a pet. I only mention this because some of the pictures showed this being used for children, but I found it to be less than ideal.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is the same item that sell at other stores for approx. $30 more. This unit has 8 pieces which makes it a much more usable size than the 6 piece model. It\'s easy to fold so you can get it out of the way quickly.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We purchased this gate because the play room that we have for our three year old isn\'t "baby proof" and after looking at multiple gates and play yards decided that the reviews on this one were the best for the price of the play yard. Some of the reviews are correct in the fact that this play yard doesn\'t look expensive, but I didn\'t expect it to. If I wanted something that was more expensive I would have paid more and got the gates that permanently anchored into the walls and built another baby safe play room.It is a heavy duty plastic construction, white and it has blue on part of the corners of the play yard. My 9 month old is no where near strong enough to move it, it\'s pretty heavy actually, but I could see how the type of floor you have it on might affect that, ours is on carpet in the corner of one room currently and works just fine. It has a small "handle" that is blue and has snaps to make it a little easier to transport. I will easily be able to put it in the back yard in the summer for my daughter to play in. If I were looking to make it more permanent in the yard I would use tent stakes or something similar and anchor if wherever I placed it only due to my yard configuration and I could put my 3 year old in it that way.We are purchasing the foam mat to put under it and taking one users suggestion to add the rings to clip toys on the gate itself. All in all I am pleased with the product. I would mention it is six panels so if you want to use it in more of a square shape I would suggest buying either a second one or the 2 panel extension which is what we are doing. Otherwise the square is actually a rectangle and it\'s not as large as it is in the octagon shape.PROS:- Inexpensive (ours was $48 w/ free s&h;)- Gives me the freedom to do chores without worrying.- Gives my daughter the freedom she craves in a environment I can easily move and baby proof.- Heavy material but light enough to move easily.- It\'s short enough I can reach over it without having to climb in (see CON below).CONS:- The color of the gate (if that bothers you, it is a "cheaper" looking heavy plastic)- If I had known the shape configuration I would have bought a second or the extension immediately.- No gate - So if you are short like I am if you needed to get in it would take a bit longer.Personally the color didn\'t bother me and we are satisfied. Since today is our first day of ownership I will update after we own it for awhile if there are issues.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased the Play Yard for my grandson and he loves it!  He doesn\'t cry to get out like he does in his crib or playpen because he has so much room to play.  The family even takes it they visit others because it creates a safe place for him to play.  I would highly recommend it to anyone with small children.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We bought two of these play yards intending to make one big play yard for our son in the house to keep him out of the breakables. We ended up using it to box in our breakables rather than our 2 year old :)  We connected the two yards into a zig zag - sturdier that way - and ran it along one side of the livingroom in front of the tv and curio cabinets so that he couldn\'t reach them. It worked great and it allowed him to explore without breaking things or hurting himself.This is a very sturdy fence. The sections can be pulled apart to adjust the length of the fencing. About waist height, easy for an adult to step over, but a child cannot step over or push it over if set up correctly.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Gate is awesome for the price! We use it to block our dogs from the baby area in the basement. Great product and great price from Amazon!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We were so disappointed with this enclosure system we returned it the next day.  The hinge mechanism between the panels is not easy to use.  To position the panels into a circle is surprisingly difficult.  The worst part is that as I forced the hinges into the angle required I could feel the plastic flexing.  I could tell that it was a matter of time before I either broke off a plastic hinge or broke a plastic panel.  I thought for sure I was doing something wrong because this product has received so many positive reviews.  I carefully re-read the instructions, and I concluded that I was using the product as directed.  We were hoping to easily deploy and then store this enclosure on almost a daily basis.  Given the difficulty of operation, and poor design it was an easy decision to return this product.  Fortunately, the Amazon return procedure was quite easy.  I hope this review is helpful.  I usually do not take the time to write reviews, but hopefully I can help someone avoid wasting their time on this piece of junk.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Very filmsy, difficult to shape, more headache then its worth. DO Not BUY you might as well spend the extra buck for a good product

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Great to create playpen- but I recommend getting the extensions at the same time you buy the gate, otherwise, it\'s too small.  Make sure to make the angles, otherwise, it is not steady.  I also recommend putting the interlocking pads under this gate.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought a couple of sets of these gates to keep the kids in the great room.  It\'s nice that we can string together as many of these as we need.  We just had one giant gate going across the room about 20 feet.Nowadays, we put some of these in a circle to make a dog run for my little 6 lb. dog.  We also use it to block the dog\'s access to the living room and upstairs areas.The gate folds up easily and it\'s not difficult to put the panels together and pull them apart, once we got the hang of it.  I have read some of the negative reviews.  One of them describes a mom unlatching and latching a panel to get in and out.  It is not made for that.  To get in and out easily, step over the gate.  It is not made for short people, but my 4 and 7 year olds can climb over it easily.  I agree it would be nice if they could make a door panel for the gate.As for durability, we\'ve had this one for at least 5 years.  It\'s held up through daily use and is still going strong.  Nothing has broken or fallen off or bent.As for kids pushing it around.  I agree that is possible to slide it easily on tile or wood floors.  It\'s harder to move on carpet.Also, if you have a climber, this gate is not for you.Overall, this is a durable product.  It\'s great for puppies or small dogs as well as children.  Just don\'t use it on hard floors if you want the kids to keep it in one place and don\'t use it if you have climbing kids.  Definitely don\'t use it if you need a door.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased this so my nephew 2 years ago could start preparing for MMA fighting while he was still young.  Welcome the Hexagon.Oh, wait this was safety device to keep him from going places he shouldn\'t go.  Ever time my sisters family traveled and stayed in hotels or at my place they had this with them.  Looked to be a good purchase and would do it again.This did have a cheapy plastic feel to it, but it has held up.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased the play yard gate to protect my christmas tree from my son and the kids that come over for playgroup each week (and vice versa).  It worked perfectly!  I don\'t know what I would have done without it.  As long as you place it in the positions the directions require, it is sturdy.  It\'s taken apart now and protecting my little boy from climbing up the stairs!  Well worth the money!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We bought this gate for our small 7lb dog.  Rather than use it in a round, closed in configuration, we use the panals (4 and 2) to block the two entrances to our dining area to keep our dog inside during the day. For this purpose, this product is awesome (and very versatile!).  You can use as many or as few panals as you need and for the price there is no way you would find a dog gate that spans a large opening.I don\'t think I would be happy keeping my dog in this gate if I formed a circle though - I would probably look to buy 2 sets if that was my intention (just so that the space wouljd be bigger).I have absolutely no complaints about the product, the sides fit together well, it is a great height (easy for us to step over) and looks decent.  Again, for the price I don\'t think you can ask for anything more than what you get with this set.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: The package arrived as described. The gates were already assembled and took less than 5 minutes to open up and place the little one inside. It works great...definitely not flimsy. The little one is able to hold it and walk around. It gives us peace of mind too knowing the area is marked off and secure.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Great for keeping babies out of places.Can fence them in or use as a gate. Has plenty of room. Very sturdy. Can take pieces off or add to make different sizes.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Our family has used this fencing for everything imaginable!  Not only is it a great play yard but its possibilities are endless.  We purchased 2 sets because we found it to be useful as a barrier around the perimeter of the room to keep our baby/toddler safe from cords, electrical outlets, fireplace, screen door, patio door, computer desk, etc.  we placed the fencing about a foot or so away from those I things and then tucked the ends behind furniture heavy enough to keep it in place.  Because the panels are bendable and foldable you can shape them to fit whatever size room you have to keep your baby safe.  We travel with these always and it takes all the worry out of our baby\'s playtime.  Once you get this item set up, which is quick and easy, you can then enjoy your visit or at home time knowing your baby\'s play area is secure.  I would have given this 6 stars if possible!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I really liked the strength and lattice design. My Grandbaby can pull herself up to standing position and walk around. I bought the two extensions that make it roomie enough to have one, two, or more little people to enjoy each other.  I\'ve even got in to play! My only struggle is opening and closing the panels. Either you need better instructions, or I just don\'t have the strength! At any rate, I like it!!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Excellent product! Nice sturdy joints and holds up to my small grandson and my obnoxious puppy!  !!  !!  !!  !!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
