review: That\'s right, I have two.  I might could use a third one.  I also bought one as a gift for someone.  I would only use the product in the hexagon configuration pictured, but other ways are also possible.  The price seems high, for what is essentially six pieces of plastic, molded into a basic shape, but a secure area for your child to safely and independently play is priceless.  The hinges are also very basic.  It feels like you\'re forcing it when you unfold it from the box.  They don\'t function in the way I would expect pressured hinges to, but so far, no breakage.  Colorful and portable, a quality purchase.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This item is very useful.  It is sturdy and sets up easily.  Lots of room for at least 2 toddlers.  Folds easily to carry.  It is a bit heavy for carrying too far, but we have used it at home , camping ,and at the beach!  Also, this price at Amazon.com is the best around.  Wal Mart (if you can find the item) sells for 64.97,  K- Mart  54.99.  I got free shipping here!!!  You could also use this for small animals.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a great product. It made my life so much easier. I used a 6-gate kit with 2 extra, and I think you really need those to get good space- those two extra really expand the area. I used mine in a big rectangle in a corner, so maybe that made mine sturdier, but I never had any issues with kids getting out or pushing it around. I put all the baby toys in there, keeping the rest of my house neater. I wish I would have had this with my previous kids because it really helped me out when I am too busy to watch everything a baby is sticking in their mouth. My kids never liked a tiny playpen, but these are much roomier. I highly recommend getting this!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Great product!!!!  Sturdy and holds its own against my strong, physical 9 month old son. I like the larger size of this.  Also, it blends in with our cream colored carpeting which is a huge plus! Worth every penny when dinner time, school work, and chores are at hand.  Don\'t hesitate....if you are reading this, you need it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I don\'t know why I didn\'t buy this sooner! It was a life saver while I needed to get things done. Daughter could play in a spacious area but still be confined to a save area

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is perfect for a new pup.  It can be formed into an enclosure for inside or outside use and can be reconfigured to close off larger spaces like a kitchen to keep a puppy within a safe area.  And the price was right!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Super fast delivery from Amazon of this Baby Play Yard.  It works well and is just what we were looking for. We can even get right in with her and let her know it\'s a safe play area.  If I have to run to the kitchen quickly I know she is not going to crawl into an unsafe place.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: My daughter has been mobile and rolling since 3 months so a playpen wouldn\'t cut it. She is now 8 months and this is still enough space for her to crawl around. I use it in the den. Love it!!!!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I don\'t have a lot of space in my living room, but I do have a lot of STUFF, and rather than moving all our STUFF away for a couple of years, I figured it would be easier to contain my baby.It\'s a far cry from fancy, but it serves its purpose. Lots of people commented on how they returned it the next day because it was so hard to maneuver the panels. When we first opened it, it was VERY difficult to open the gates and change the shape of it. However, with time, it\'s loosened up and now we can open and collapse it with ease. The "gate" function just takes some practice, too.This is meant to be a play yard, NOT a gate. It\'s very unstable when it\'s not connected to itself, and it\'s super easy for Baby to push over or move. When it\'s connected, though, it keeps my 11 month old in one spot. He doesn\'t try to drag it around the room as others have mentioned, but we also keep a bin of toys in there and I think it would make the structure too heavy to drag, anyway.As far as climbing out of it...babies are like little Houdinis. They will find a way out everything, eventually. My son has taken to stacking up toys in a corner and seeing if he can reach his leg over the side. He hasn\'t managed an escape, yet, but then he\'s never alone for very long, either.I like it. It was exactly what I was looking for and at a decent price, too. I purchased the expansion panels, also, but they are still in their box in our laundry room. Right now, it\'s a good size for us, although I like having the option to expand it, if needed.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This gate is great. Easy to set up and take down. Its lightweight and easy to carry and store. Highly recommend.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this item with a few concerns, but once we got it, in the set up was extreamly easy, it\'s the best product to keep an eye on your kids. I love the fact that it came with small rubber protectors. It\'s nice to see a company thinking ahead for the customer, espically for those of us who do have hard wood floors. Thanks for thinking ahead for the customer. I highly reccomend this item.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this for my quadruped baby and within 25 minutes, she had climbed out of it. I suppose it works better for babies than puppies. Frankly, I was really disappointed. Apparently the "mesh" on the playpen makes it ideal for little doggy feet to get a toe-hold and just climb right on out.However, it is quite sturdy and strong and I was impressed with its quality. The downside is, it is NOT easy to set up and move around. The hinged-joints at each panel are hard, hard, HARD to adjust and move.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Does everything I expected. Kind of difficult to open one gate from another, but not complicated. The plastic is just resistant. Besides that, it is really perfect. I like the colors, but be warned, they are BRIGHT.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This was the best thing I have ever bought for my twins, it has gone camping with us, to the park, it really light and easy to use

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Colourful as the pics show. Assembled easily. Main issue is access since there is no door. The other problem is that my son cries since he feels isolated :-)

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: best thing ever invented...ok not really but I love this thing! my daughter is a mover & shaker and hates to be "locked up" but this is the best thing ever!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I love this play pen! My daughter has so much room and I am able to remove one of them to leave it like a door. I unattached one of the sides so she can go in and out as she pleases, and when I need to keep her contained I will just put it back together and I love hanging her toys on the play pen! Works perfectly! Soon I will have to buy a few more to expand it! :)

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I would buy this over and over again. Best quality gate I have ever purchased as a mother. I tell everyone how wonder it it. We bought 2 to make it bigger for outside use and take some sections out and use it around the christmas tree. Absolutely wonderful!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I have 3 sets of these play yards. I like the fact that I can configure different size pens to meet my needs.  I have puppies of different ages and these pens allow me to keep them very secure, with no worries of escape.  The only thing I struggle with from time to time is being able to easily take the panels apart and then get them back together again -- (I guess that is why I have a husband)<LOL>.  Anyway, they are easy to clean and overall work great for my needs.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: The "superyard" works great as a baby corral or as a fence.  It can extend pretty far and still stand on its own.  We have it standing along our TV stand.  Our boy stands up against it while watching Sesame Street.  He can even dance around with his weight on it and it holds well.Its not super easy to adjust the angles of the joints, but that is a good thing.  It does fold very nicely.  For a road trip, we folded it up and threw it in the back of our car and couldn\'t hear it rattle.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This was a little difficult for my husband and I to put together but we managed finally.  We have a small living room and it takes up quite a chunk of space.  Its great for putting all baby\'s toys in one area.  My problem is that my seven month old is now pulling herself up to stand and can push on the walls and move it on the wood floor.  I\'m pretty sure she will soon be able to move it a lot further across the room.  The thick play mats underneath have helped keep it in one place for now at least.  I would\'ve liked to see some kind of door on it - a little hard on the back to reach in and get baby out if baby\'s in the middle.  Yes I realize I could step over it but I have short legs and definitely not as nimble as I used to be.  Would also like it if it came in different colors so it didn\'t look so much like a dog kennel.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought eight panels so we would have the larger space for my granddaughter.  She learned to sit up and to stand up in it and is safe and happy most of the time.  She sleeps in it.  Keeps all her toys in it.  Plays in it and has temper tantrums in it.  The panels are sturdy and grab-able. She can look out and see the world around her. It stays together even when she leans or  pulls on it.  It was easy to assemble.  It does not seem to have any edges or hinges that pinch or scratch.  I look forward to warmer weather when we can test it outdoors.  (BTW, we have used it every day for about 2 months.)

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought the Superyard for my 2 shelties.  I actually own a total of 3 of them which I link together to create a large area for my dogs.  I bought my first set 10 years ago and just purchased the other 2.  I go camping every weekend and use this so my dogs do not stray away.  This pen will not work for dogs that jump.  I also use 2 panels for blocking off doorways in the house when needed.  It is easy to move around and also to take when I go places.  I highly recommend this for pets.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: It is too big for our living room but we gladly give up space so the little guy will have a great play area. When he is in there you can get things done around the house and not have to worry about him hurting himself or getting into everything, of course, someone is close by at all times but he loves it and so do we.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a mothers savior.  I can actually do the dishes without running after my little whos crawled over to something she is not supposed to be into. She loves it since it is much bigger than a playpen.  We have tile so we went out and got an area rug to put in on.  Works great.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a great product for children or pets. I had one when my twins were young and I have used them for my pets too.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Our granddaughter needed a place to play safely, this is what we bought for her.  It\'s good because you can use all of the pieces or just a few, depending on how you want to set it up.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This playyard is very spacious and easy to use. It is simple to set up and take down and easy to move around. The instructions recommend that you set it up as a hexagon or octagon for the most stability and thats what we did. There is enough space in this for my toddler and a lot of her large toys! It\'s definitely worth the money

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Our little monster (9 month old) can\'t get to breakables but our older kids get in and play with him.  We got a full setup + 2 extra pieces and they all match, work together properly & we can relax without chasing him around every minute.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Great play yard gate. We use it to block off the tv area and kitchen so my baby can\'t access those areas.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I agree, if your kid has some muscle and determination, s/he will be able to push it around, especially on a hard floor.  However, my kid never got into that, and it was great for having a playpen-type area for my son that was much bigger than just sticking him in the pack in play.It\'s not good as as one of those doorway gates, or for something like walling off the TV area, unless you get creative with ties and furniture.  It isn\'t secure unless it\'s attached to itself, so your two options are a hexagon and square.  If that\'s what you want, it\'s great.  I also like that you could use it outdoors and that it folds up well.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought two of these to keep my one year old away from things.  One is around the Christmas tree and the other I split into two sections to keep her away from the fireplace and my records (she loved to wave them around and put them all on the floor).  I anchored them to the wall so they stay in place well.  She likes to throw her toys over them sometimes but other than that she ignores them.  They do a great job of keeping her away from things.  I wouldn\'t use them to put her in because I like to let her have the run of the house except for the areas she shouldn\'t get into.  They aren\'t very nice looking but they work well for what I\'m using them for.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We are using this product for our duck when we want to have him indoors. He is small and cannot fly, so this enclosure works perfectly for him. This product has worked great for us, is a nice size and easy to move. The only problem we have had is the mechanism that is used to lock/unlock the gate requires a lot of strength to operate. Other than that it is a great product for anything that you want to keep in a certain area, as long as the occupent is not strong enough to move it or climb over it. It would be especially good for many types of pets.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We got this play yard to put up around our TV and it works great.  Our son thought it was a lot of fun to bang on the TV screen so we set this up around or TV and it works great to protect the electronics.  It is also really easy to pack up and take to non baby proofed friends houses.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We purchased this for our puppy that we getting. It has worked wonderful for helping w/housebreaking. Our puppy also likes it when she can get away from our youngest child.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: After setting this up I was able to let my son play all day and not worry about him. I put in a bag of candy and chips and a bowl of water and he is good for the entire day. Before buying this cage I had to tie him to the table leg and had to check on him every couple of hours. Thanks for my freedom again!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: the connection parts between 2 panels appeared easy to break when you open and fold the panels, should improve the connection. The biggest problem are the hole pattern in the panels, my grandson started to climb the panel by putting his little feet in the holes. He did make it for 2 or 3 holes high but fell back on the mat for his hands were not strong to hang on. That will be a serous problem when the mats are too thin to receive the fall.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this Play Yard for my 1 year old kid. We found it very safe. Well designed. Sturdy Product. It has enough room for my 5 yrs old daughter and my son to play. Both of them enjoy playing in this Play Yard. Using this for couple of weeks. No issues.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: It\'s great for chihuahua puppy\'s, they have room to play, without being underfoot. Also has room for there food, water & litter pan.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this play yard to corral my two young granddaughters.  I can use it as a pen or I can secure it to other items to make barriers or a bigger "yard."  I took it to the beach last weekend so the babies would be safe and easy to take care of.  We put a sheet over 2/3 of it for shade.  We had many many compliments on our ingenuity.  We were asked where we purchased the Play Yard.  We told them Amazon.com.  But no matter where you purchase this item, you will find it well worth every penny.  I purchased the two panel extension to give the two girls a little more room when they are together.  My kids loved mine so much they bought their own for their homes.  Great sturdy product.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: My kids love this.  They are currently 9 months old and like to pull themselves up.  i would definitely go with the 8 panel vs 6.  I have both as we have twins, and we keep the 8 in the play room, and when it is too cold we move the 6 zone and put it together in the living room.  Definitely a must!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We have used this outside for our son, and also inside to protect the TV, DVD player, stereo, etc.  We have also used it for our dog to keep her contained while we weren\'t home.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We only use this to go around the christmas tree and we have used it 2 years now.  It works but it is really hard to get it in a circle.  The hinges are really really tight.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased the Superyard for my tiny Yorkie to give him a safe place to play outside.  I\'ve also used it to block off my jewelry studio from my boyfriends labs and it works perfectly!It\'s so easy to adjust and the panels come apart to make shorter sections.One of the BEST purchases I\'ve made all year! And the price was perfect too!This is a great product!  Don\'t think twice!  Get one today!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We have used this for our new puppy when we travel and it is effective.  Stores easily and is lightweight and compact.  My complaint is the ease of setting it up - it sucks!  The detects in the panel connectors require manly strength to open and close - very frustrating!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We bought this to use as a fence around an area of the living room that was a little dangerous for our son who nine months old at the time and starting to really get into everything. It filled the purpose we hoped it would fill for a couple of months, but as our son got older, stronger and more determined, he found ways to circumvent it.He would push and pull to move it around, and when used as a fence he\'d push the end of it around and slip past it. It was still more useful than not, but after about six months the level of usefulness started to drop.Then by the time he hit one and a half years old, he found out he was able to climb over it. That ended the period of its usefulness. He can now get out by climbing whenever he pleases, which simply adds the danger of a fall to whatever danger we were trying to keep him away from in the first place. And there is danger of a fall. Sometimes when he got to the top, he\'d get an "oh no, what do I do now?" look on his face.So we got nine months out of this playard/fence. Not too bad, maybe, and it did keep him significantly safer for maybe about six of those months, before circumventing it became a lot easier. If you are on a tight budget, you might want to think about this level of investment for so short a time.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Excellent product, easy to set up, easy to fold and keeps your little ones from getting into trouble. My grandson loves being in his play yard and I can get something accomplished.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a useful product that help me create boundaries for my child as well as keep her safe. She is quite strong and the play yard has held up to her bumping in to it .

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Having just received the play yard, we set it up in our living room so that our 14 month old can have some safe space for moving around and playing with toys.  The simplest comment is that you get what you pay for and this is a China-made plastic fencing.  It is safe and light and prevents the child from going where they shouldn\'t go.  It is ok to assemble, as it can be a bit tricky to get the pieces to interlock but it works well enough to configure the shape to work within your room.  Another reviewer mentioned the lack of aesthetics and this is truly not an item of beauty... but it does the job.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This play yard is very versatile - we have it snaking around our TV room to protect the TV components as well as keep our toddler hemmed into an area we know is completely kidproof.  The panels are light enough for our Kindergartner to move so she can get around, but not for our toddler to knock over.One thing you do need to do is have strong angles at each intersection to make it hard to knock over.  Long straight stretches will not stay up with kids pulling themselves up or pushing on them unless they are braced at either end.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We ordered this for our 9-month-old who was becoming increasingly mobile.  Our small house is impossible to child proof, with a wood stove, a heavy wooden ladder for the attic, etc. so we wanted to create a safe, fenced-in play area for our little one.  I wish that I listened to the negative reviews instead of considering the overwhelming majority of positive reviews.It could very well be that our gate would\'ve functioned if it hadn\'t snapped as soon as I adjusted it for the first time.  All I did was bend the joint to create a slight angle, which it should\'ve been able to do without breaking.  The hinge broke at the top so, in addition to a sharp piece of plastic sticking out, we had an extremely unstable gate.  It buckled every time our son pulled on it.  Again, whether this is because the hinge broke or because of an otherwise present structural flaw, I don\'t know.  All I know is that it was a risk to my boy\'s safety and certainly didn\'t give us the safe space we intended to create.The only reason I don\'t say "Don\'t waste your time or money" in my title and only implore you not to waste your time is because Amazon has an excellent return policy.  Because I returned it due to a defect in the product, Amazon refunded me the cost of shipping, too.  I will probably end up getting one of the metal gates with straight, vertical bars.  They are pricier, but they are far more structurally sound and will hold up to a lot of pulling and climbing by my boy, who\'s almost a year old now.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: 4 of 5 stars. Good quality product. Simple to use. Would love to have the option to stand this gate alone without having to connect it to itself, as in a stand alone gate.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: The panels helped to expand the pen for my puppies to help monitor them while outside.  It\'s easy to set up, move and store!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We actually bought two of these and have put them together to make a bigger version.  This unit is REALLY meant to be used as shown, that shape is the most stable.  If you do put two together the shape does not work out perfectly so we have used zip ties to attach the play yard to a railing to give it some extra stability.  If you have wood or laminate floors you MUST use the pads or the play yard will slide all over the room.This has allowed us to give my son some room to play and it keeps him safe if I have to answer the door or go to the bathroom.  He doesn\'t like to be in it all the time but there are times where he just plays for hours without even noticing I am sitting near by.  It helps us contain the toys and it really helps contain him now that he is walking.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: This is a great product for our 1 year old!  Only one drawback...the panels are a little diffcult to fold back and forth...other than that, no complaints!

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: wish it had a door or swing door attachment. we use it along with our sectional sofa, but have to climb over it everytime to get out, the twins love it and it is sturdy, will find other uses for it once they outgrow it.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We used this when our twins were crawling, we blocked off a section of the house and it was perfect! Study enough that they could tug and pull on it with out it tipping over, and big enough to accommodate a large area. I loves how it can be made into different shapes to fit around things.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We bought the mulit colored gate for better wear and tear.  This set makes a large circle or you can use outer walls as the other side of the perimeter.  It seems heavy enough to slow down our toddler for a minute.  We\'ll see how long it takes for him to figure out how to scale the walls!  Good product and fulfills intended purpose.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased this play yard to keep my new puppy confined when needed. It arrived already assembled. All I had to do was connect one gate to another and it was ready to go. A friend had one for her puppy (a Golden Retriever) and it served its purpose well for her too. It will not keep an older, larger dog confined. They\'ll be able to move it and climb over it. But, it\'s good for puppies.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: We just got a new puppy Chihuahua and he loves it! We keep it in our kitchen for when we can\'t watch him or have to leave the house. It\'s big enough for us to keep his crate, bed, puppy pad and toys for when we\'re not home and still has prenty of room for him to play.  We don\'t have to worry about him tearing up the house. It\'s pretty easy to open and close once you get used to how it works. Would definitely recommend.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: Good, solid gate. If you are short, you are going to have a challenge going in and out of the gated area. There is no latch system to open and close, and it is difficult to climb over if you are lacking height. I am 5\'1" and can barely get in and out.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought this for my 8 week old lab x hound puppy.  I chose this model over a specific "puppy playpen" because it doesn\'t have the horizontal slats that makes it easier for a puppy to climb.  So far, my pup is respecting the boundary.My only complaint is that it is not that easy to adjust the individual panels - whether for setting up for folding up.  I suppose they have to make it that way so that kids and pets can\'t take it apart; however, I find it very difficult.  It\'s almost  a whim when a joint suddenly allows you to adjust it - there is no rhyme or reason or "trick" to make it easier to adjust.Other than that, The play yard does what I want it to do; it contains the puppy so that I can get stuff done in the house or outside in the yard (like mowing) without having a puppy underfoot.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I bought two superyards as a pet barrier for a new puppy.  It assembles and disassembles very easily, keeps the pup safe (and our house from the pup). Not sure the puppy likes it as much as we do, but once we\'re through the house-breaking she won\'t care.

name: North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
North States Superyard Play Yard, Grey, 6 Panel
review: I purchased this for my 2 little puppies.  I use it to kennel them and its wonderful.  I love that you can arrange it in various shapes.

name: Tomy Walker Bike
review: We got this as a hand-me-down from my sister when my son was quite young. It sat in the corner until he started to pull up and cruise at about 9 months. First he loved to play with the panel with the phone (especially) and the rotating snail. When he got better at cruising, he liked to push the walker on a carpeted surface. Now at 11 months (not yet walking) he loves to push it up and down a long wood-floored hallway. He just gets a huge smile whenever he walks with it! The toy is very well built, and not flimsy like some other walker toys. I also like that we can reassemble it as a ride-on toy later and get more use as he gets older. I\'m surprised at how reasonably priced it is.

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: My wife and I got this for our new puppies inside the house. It works great both inside and out.

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: I love this.  It has so many uses from keeping my little one contained in one small area, or blocking off part of a room.  Great outside too.

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: This is a pretty good gate.  Helpful that it came all connected already.  We use it in a U-shape with the couch sealing off the "U".  We do need to put stuff on the other side for support as my baby can push the gate and stand up holding onto the gate and shake it.  He can push the gate open but at least it keeps him away from the TV and fireplace.

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: These gates are a nice idea, but in reality they only work for very small children. When set up in a circle they\'re easy to shake, although I\'m fairly certain they wouldn\'t fall down. They\'re also pretty unattractive. We used them for a short time and then ended up putting them away.

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: This is almost a necessity when you purchase the Superyard XT.HINT:  Do NOT buy two extensions, as the superyard becomes unstable with more than one set added (per manufacturers specifications).

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: my wife and i purchased the superyard fence for our living room because our baby girl kept crawling over and exploring all of daddy\'s electronics.  the fence is great it is moldable to any shape for your living space or room.  with the extra panels you can make the area big enough for you and your baby to play inside.  it is great piece of mind to know that if you take your eye off your kid for a second to answer the phone or doorbell that they are in a safe space and can\'t get into anything.  it has also helped in my baby in standing up.  she uses the fence to pull herself up and stand and play watching us.  it is definitely a limited use fence and not a babysitter for you to run off an leave your child but it is a nice product if used properly.  we have been very happy with ours.

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: I would just buy two sets of the panels instead of the extension because it only comes with two for half the price of 6 ...you will wish you had bought two ( I later bought a second set after wasting my money on the extension.) Just saying my opinion.

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: This extention makes such a difference when placed with the Superyard XT. It gives so much more space (more room for toys!)

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: I bought two and made this into a baby bed for our new puppy because she banged around all night when we put her in a crate.  Now, she literally sleeps like a baby.  We actually get to sleep all night and it is wonderful!  Super fast shipping too!

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: This is an excellent product,reliable, easy to use, strong, easy to clean. Two years ago we used to have two of these to keep away from the plants, treadmill, and other dangers our 2 small kids, and 2 dogs, a Husky, and Lab mix . So  I didn\'t think twice to get a new one to keep our new Australian Shepherd puppy in the kitchen area during night. In two weeks he figured out how to climb over using the corners. He is just 2 and a half months. He will be trained soon but in the mean while...

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: I purchased the original fence for my granddaughter and then bought the additional panels to give her more room.  Easy to assemble and fairly sturdy.

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: Adding 2 more panels provides my daughter with enough space to toddle safely while I tend to household tasks. I have not had an issue with my daughter moving this structure far or pushing it over. She leans on it which moves it slightly but it has maintained is shape and not caused any safety issues, or escapes!

name: Pet Yard Plastic Exercise Pen Expansion Panel, 2-Piece, Gray
review: I ordered this to increase the inside pen for my dachsies.  I\'ve also reordered 2 full pens for traveling.  Secure, durable, washable, indoor/outdoor, shape modifiable, great buy for the price.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I researched video monitors to a great extent before purchasing.  I asked friends, read reviews and talked to store associates.  The Summer Infant Deluxe got the best reviews by everyone... despite a few poor reviews on Amazon.Once we got it home, we were disappointed with the audio.  It cracks and pops frequently.  The light bar across the front of the monitor bounces higher when there is a loud noise, such as your baby crying.  Unfortunately, it also bounces high when the cracking noise gets loud.  Therefore, unless you have the volume up, you may assume the bouncing light means your little one is crying.  If you have the volume up, you won\'t be able to sleep because of all the noise cracking and popping.We keep the volume off, have covered up the light bar across the front, and only use the video screen.  The video is nice, it is well lit at night and in the day.I don\'t have a better recommendation, do you?

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: works well, clearer picture than we thought. However there needs to be an option upon purchase, to purchase an extended warranty. I think this is essential with a product like this.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: My husband and I have used video monitors for our two children for three years now.  We recently purchased this one for its portabilty and convenience.  It is great.  The reception is clear and works from quite a distance even outside.  I can carry the monitor with me throughout the house and even outside.  Something I could not do with my other tv monitors. The audio is crystal clear and you can use it with or without the video.  This is my first review of a product, but as I Mom I wanted to pass along the experience.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I ordered my Summer Infant Day & Night Color Video Monitor w/ 2.5 inch screen on May 19, 2010.  At first, it worked beautifully!  Do keep in mind that the "color" video only works when the room is well lit.  For night viewing, the video is black and white.  We had clear video and great audio.  There were (and still are) definite interference issues, with static rippling across the screen and coming out over the speaker, but it usually just takes some repositioning to get it to stop.  The interference rarely bothers us at night, thankfully.One thing about the way the controls are set up:  The brightness dial operates the way I expect it to, but the volume dial does not.  To get the video brighter, I turn the dial up; to turn the brightness down, I turn the dial down.  With the volume, however, to turn the volume up, I have to turn the dial down and vice versa.  I still forget about that in the middle of the night if I have to adjust the volume, so I wish the volume dial operated the same way the brightness dial does.Another thing I wish is that, when the monitor is running on battery power, the unit didn\'t go into battery-saving mode automatically.  It only keeps the video turned on for about 3 minutes, then shuts the screen off to save the battery, so if you want continuous video (even at the expense of battery life) you have to keep hitting the video on/off button to turn it back on.  I wish there were a switch by that button where we could select battery saver mode vs. continuous video.In mid-July, I started having problems with the monitor.  Every time I plugged it in, the video would get distorted, the vertical sync out of whack so we\'d have such rapid horizontal scrolling that the image was unreadable.  The longer the unit was plugged in, the longer it would take for the image to stabilize.  It did this even when the battery was completely run down.  I contacted Summer Infant on July 19, and they shipped me a replacement AC adapter the next day by UPS Ground.  It arrived July 27 and sadly did nothing to fix the problem.  I contacted them again, and they immediately offered to send me a full replacement monitor setup as soon as they received my current unit.  They had UPS email me a prepaid shipping label the next day, and when they received my shipment they had UPS send me a shipping notice for my replacement unit.  It arrived August 12.  For the most part, this unit is working fine.  Sometimes the video on/off button doesn\'t respond right away, but it does eventually, so for now I\'m satisfied.I do appreciate that Summer Infant\'s customer service shipped me the replacement unit for free and even sent me a prepaid shipping label so I could send my original unit back at no cost to me.  I do wish, however, that they\'d shipped my replacement package at the same time that they sent me the prepaid label (with the option of charging my credit card if I didn\'t send the original unit back within a certain time frame).  I\'m also not very happy that the one year warranty will expire based on my original purchase date, even though I no longer have that original unit, and wish the warranty could be extended by at least two months (since I called to report the issue 2 months after purchase date).Overall, I do love the monitor because I LOVE being able to see what my little man is doing and how he\'s sleeping without physically going into his room.  It\'s so reassuring.  There are just a few quirks that I\'m not crazy about.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: There is a lot of upside to this monitor. The infrared video is great when the kid wakes up at night and is running around in the crib and you want to know what she is up to. I was surprised how well it works in a very dim room. It even has some a/v out jacks, so you can plug it into your TV, videocam, etc.  The people complaining about the video quality in other reviews seem to have unrealistic expectations for the product, perhaps created by the packaging.The reception (on 900 MHz freq., 2 channels) is very inconsistent. It will be fine and then when someone walks the past the monitor it will lose track of the signal and be completely unable to regain it.  I don\'t know if this is a problem with their signal processing or just a poor antenna set up, but I have been looking into ways to increase the transmission power. The monitor tends to run a little hot when the video is on, which may also be a factor in reception. I wonder if the addition of an external antenna on the transmitter would help?Overall, I think they should have taken the crowded nature of the 900MHz spectrum into account and offered more channels, or more error correction in the system.  The plus on this one is the portable video monitor, it\'s really great and a somewhat unique feature.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This was a great monitor, worked so well.The screen picture stopped working after we dropped it a few too many times (after about 3 years) - then we used it for sound.If we were upstairs and my son was in bed but sick, or if we were outside.It just now completely died and my son is 5 1/2.That was definitley worth the money and a great product, gave us more years than I expected.  :)

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: We love this monitor as it provides a very good picture of what is happening while your baby/toddler is sleeping, or more importantly, not sleeping!  When you hear a noise, you can see what it is.  If you hear crying, you can see if it\'s necessary to actually go to your child or not.  And sometimes it\'s just fun to watch what happens when they\'re alone and don\'t know you can see them.  We\'re very pleased with the monitor and highly recommend it.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I purchased this monitor some time ago and it worked fine (though it buzzed all the time...we just got used to it).However, after reading other reviews mentioning security issues with the monitor channels showing other neighboring babies, I thought I would check my other channel.  Needless to say, I was horrified to see our neighbors little boy sleeping soundly on the other channel!  After calling Summer Infant, they confirmed that if I can see them, they can see us too!  We have the monitor set up to see our daughter\'s entire room and it runs 24/7, so when we go to tuck her in at night (in our pajamas), or anything else throughout the day, our neighbors have been able to see and hear everything!  Summer realizes this is a "problem", so they offered to replace my monitor with the Secure baby monitor at no cost.I WOULD NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT as anyone with the same monitor can also see yours.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I really was in love with this product until my next door neighbors started talking on their phone every night at my daughter\'s bedtime!  We\'ve had it about 3 months and for the past 4 weeks, we\'ve been having this problem.  The video turns to awful static as soon as they get a dial tone and I can hear their entire conversation from the first number they dial until they hang up!  Of course I\'m polite and turn off the monitor until I think they might be done talking, but it\'s almost as if I am on the phone with them too when I have it on!  With only 2 channels to pick from, it\'s pretty much impossible to avoid this problem!  It also picks up interference from truckers going by.  The weird thing is that it doesn\'t pick up MY cordless phone conversations, even though my phone is a 2.4 Ghz model.  If I had known interference was going to be this big of a problem I would not have purchased this product.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: Handheld monitor is good for those who move around the house a lot.  The range is surprisingly good.  I even used it at a hotel to check on how our babysitter was doing (from the lobby to the fourth floor).  You can only get color in full lighting, but the night vision is decent.  Not a cheap monitor, but an okay value.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I AM SO DISAPPOINTED I WAS LOOKING FORWARD TO THIS PRODUCT FOR MY NEWBORN SON.  THE RECEPTION IS HORRIBLE I THOUGHT IT WOULD BE GOOD SINCE I HAVE 2.4G TELEPHONE SYSTEMS BUT I THOUGHT WRONG. EVERYTHING INTERFERES WITH THE VIEW I GUESS YOU HAVE TO NOT OWN ANYTHING ELECTRONIC FOR IT TO WORK GOOD. WHEN YOU DO GET A GOOD SPOT IT DOES COME CLEAR BUT WHATS THE POINT OF IT BEING PORTABLE THEN? P.S I HAVE YET TO SEE COLOR THE VIEW APPEARS TO BE BLACK AND WHITE AT ALL TIMES OF DAY ..........  I WILL BE RETURNING IT TODAY

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: Very convenient to use. We are training our baby to sleep at seven in the evening. This device has really helped us achieve our goal. Now she can sleep in peace in another room while we do our chores in living room. The picture quality is fair enough and sound volume is loud enough.Nevertheless, the static noice is disturbing.The video, when the handset is on battery power, turns off after a time. This feature is annoying. There should have been an option to override this.All in all glad we bought it. It may not be excellent but perhaps the best option available in market today.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: We got this as a gift for our new baby.He\'s 11 days old today and the video on the monitor has not worked for a few days now.While it worked it was great. The picture was sharp and it worked well throughout the house. Then one day, when the screen timed out it refused to come back on at all. Audio still works, but it\'s not worth the price without the video function. We tried with it unplugged, plugged in and on different channels, but still nothing. The units were not dropped or abused in any way.When I called to get it replaced, the customer service representative was friendly and polite. They were willing to send me a pre-paid label so that I could return the defective unit and then they would send me back a new unit. That seemed like a good deal to me until I asked about the shipping lengths. They try to send out the new item within 2 days of getting the defective one, but it\'s shipped UPS ground, so it takes 7-10 days. This means that once the item was delivered to the carrier it would take up to 10 days to reach their service center. Then there could be a day or two turnaround on sending out the replacement, after which there would be another 10 days to wait for the replacement to come. So overall, from phone call to replacement item, it could  take up to a month. That\'s a month without a monitor. Which to me is excessive. When I complained they told me I could give them my credit card information and they\'d send me a monitor first and I could return the defective one. So the choices are ultimately to either be prepared to wait for a month for a monitor or to be prepared to pay for a new one. I was clearly not terribly impressed by these options.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I needed this product for a reason other than to watch my child....I got it to watch my computer. I work from home and wanted the freedom of going out in the yard and still be able to detect an incoming email, IM, or phone call. I wanted a product that I could clip to my hip, plug in a headset, and go work out in the yard...and have the monitor do the following these for me:1. Pick up the sound of a phone call.2. Pick up the sound of an email.3. Pick up the sound of an Instant Message (IM)4. Optional Bonus: Make it possible to see my computer screen.It is advertized that it has a 350ft range. That may be true over flat land, with no walls, or interference. In reality (in a home), it averages about 90-150ft (depending on walls)...Once it reaches 150ft it goes in and out of range of the base unit. So I\'m not able to use it, since my hope was to be able to do yard work at a 250 ft range.The hand unit speaker has a constant hum when it is on, even when using a headset, which makes the use of a headset intolerable. My other baby monitor (Sony - BabyCall) does not have that hum, but it doesn\'t have a headset either, which is why I bought the \'Summer Infant\' unit to begin with...that and it\'s advertized range.Also the camara was not high enough resolution to distinguish text on a computer screen, no matter how close you put it. This was not that important to me, but would have been convenient. No biggy.I now use it as a baby monitor, and the Summer Infant Monitor is very nice, especially the night vision camara, where you can see your baby even in a dark room. Very cool.I also liked the fact that it has two channels, which is nice if you are chaining monitors for more range.I deducted one star for its weak (in a home) range (90-150ft), and another for the intolerable constant hum when it\'s on. The hum isn\'t that bad when you\'re not using a headset, but if you intend on using the headset...it\'s pretty annoying.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I bought 2 of these.  One for each kid.  I used them until they were about 4.  It gave me peace of mind to have the monitor on the nightstand at night.  The picture we pretty clear, even in the dark.  I would definitely recommend this to a friend.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I was very excited to receive this monitor and when we got done with the charging for 18hrs and got ready to use it, it was horrible we could not see any picture all we got out of it was sound. Save you Money!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I spent 2 to 3 hours reading reviews of baby monitors on Amazon before we bought this one.  It became clear that a video monitor is the only way to go.  This one had the best reviews, no doubt about it.  We are very glad we made this purchase.  We could not be happier.  From what I read, there are defintiely some junky video baby monitors out there selling for just as much money as this one, so be careful!My wife runs on a treadmill in the basement in the morning, trying to get this done before our baby wakes up.  The baby\'s room is on the second floor.  The picture and sound comes through great.A sound monitor tells you that you need to check on the baby.  The video allows you to check without running up the stairs or getting out of bed.  This lets my wife finish her workout or stay in bed and get some much needed rest.  Also, if our baby wakes up and gets a little fussy, but is likely to go back to sleep on her own, my wife can check on her without going into the room which would really wake her up and have my wife up with her for another hour or more.The sound on this is incredible.  It picks me up in the driveway as I am leaving in the morning.  The picture is not high definition, but it is plenty serviceable and much better than what I have read of reviews of other similar products.  The night vision is wonderful.  It does go to black and white, but it looks like there is a bright light shining on her when there are no lights on in the room.We rank this very high on the list of essential big-ticket baby items: crib, car seat and this baby monitor.To sum up: buy a video monitor, not just an audio monitor, and buy this one.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: We bought this product 4 months ago and just now started using it.  It works great!  Until one night my husband put our daughter to bed and we went back to our room and turned on the monitor and our baby wasn\'t in her crib.  We ran back to her room to find her fast asleep.  Then we realized that wasn\'t her crib on the monitor.  We were picking up a clear picture and not to mention sound from 7 houses down.  This is very scary, you don\'t know who could be watching your child sleep and hear what you say.  If you have purchased this product call summer infant, they replaced my monitor with one that is digital....which means it\'s private.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I bought my first one when daughter was an infant. I highly recommend you get the one with the bigger screen! It was the best purchase out of everything I have ever bought or received. What is great is that you can be in another room while baby is sleeping and see what is going on. When they are crying you can see if they are okay. I have purchased another one for my son. Taking it back because I got the small screen. Hate it. I can watch both kids on one monitor (although I have to switch back and forth). This DOES NOT INTERRUPT OR BOTHER WI-FI IN THE HOUSE. I know this for sure because I ended up with a high tech camera for my son and for months we couldn\'t figure out what was wrong with our wi-fi till we hired a computer guy and it figured it out. Duh! Money thrown down the drain. So I am selling that one on ebay and will let the buyer know.Put it on your baby list. I am buying another for my best friend.Deb

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This is the best video monitor I\'ve seen. I\'ve messed with some of my friends\' monitors and eventually settled on this one. We actually have 2, an older model and this one. They work pretty well together when they\'re not too close to one of the cameras. But we\'ve made it work. This gives so much peace of mind for us!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I got this when my son was born. It is wonderful to not only hear but see what he is doing. He is almost 2 and I still use it at naptime. Also, I was having issues with it, and Summer Infant replaced it (within the 1 year warranty period) at no charge. Amazing! I love it!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: It\'s a good purchase. The image is clear, even in the dark.I got surprised because the camera does not work with batteries! So you should pay attention to have an electric outlet nearby. And also think about the esthetic, because you\'ll have an wire passing through. It comes with some guides for the wires, sou you can hide them. Also comes with a screw, so you can fix the camera wherever you want. The manual recommends 3 feet or more, but I don\'t think it\'s a problem if you fix it on the crib.Another thing: it can take interference of other cameras nearby. I DID get the image of a baby nearby. So if you don\'t think it\'s a problem, go ahead!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I\'m sure its not the best video monitor out there but it might be the best one for the price.  It works well to keep an eye on my daughter from the other room while I am working. I only wish it had a wider viewing angle to see more areas in the room.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I bought this monitor with some reservations also. I was attracted to the portability of it, which is something I haven\'t seen in other video monitors. We do not get perfect reception throughout our entire house but the fact that I can see my baby from wherever I am (without going into her room to check) is a benefit that far outweighs the "not so perfect in every room" reception. Our bedroom is down the hall from our baby\'s and I sleep with the monitor on. It gets excellent, color reception there. The sound is excellent, and I can even go outside and still see what she\'s doing in the crib. My husband and I didn\'t even know she was rolling over until we bought this monitor! She makes all kinds of noises in her sleep and it\'s so nice to be able to look at the moniter and determine if she needs us or is just babbling in her sleep. I love it and can live with the inconsistent quality of the picture. If it were less expensive, I would give it 5 stars.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I definitely wanted a video monitor, because my bedroom is upstairs and the baby is downstairs.  Having a video monitor is great because you can check if the baby\'s awake or just squawking in his sleep before you go all the way in there.  I\'ve tried three: this one, the Mobi Cam, and the new Safety First version.  Both the other two got constant static that caused the picture to flicker and a clicking sound to come through on the audio.  This one is USUALLY static free, accept for a periodic BLARE, usually in the middle of the night. It\'s pretty frustating, but I\'ve now found a low enough volume level whereby the static won\'t scare me out of bed when it hits but I can still hear if my son cries.As for the other features, the "color" is pretty poor, but the night vision works fairly well.  It\'s very nice that it\'s portable, and that you don\'t HAVE to mount the camera--you can place it on a flat surface and angle it to see.  I also like that when it\'s unplugged, the video shuts off after a couple minutes so it doesn\'t drain your battery.  Then you can pop it back on (or off) with the touch of a big button on top.  When it\'s plugged in, the video will stay on all night, but I feel like it starts to get warm when I leave the picture on too long.  I generally shut it off until he makes noise, then I turn on the picture to see what\'s going on down there.Since I\'ve tried THREE video monitors, and this worked the best in my house, I thought I\'d pass the research along.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: our son is almost 4 months old now, and i wish i had this monitor from the beginning!  we didn\'t have a monitor because we have a small house and i\'m a stay at home mom, but after running back and forth in and out of his room to check on him, we decided to get one.  i researched basically every monitor out there and my main concerns were: 1) interference issues 2) quality of product 3) portability.  there were several audio only monitors that got okay reviews, but the really good ones were close to or over $100, or even $200 (philips).  we decided on this monitor because we kept running into the room, thinking he was awake, when in reality he was asleep and we ended up waking him up.this monitor is fabulous.  we have a 5.8ghz phone and sometimes there\'s static when we use channel A on the monitor, but our phone has a ton of static anyway so a slight increase didn\'t change our opinion of the monitor.  we like that it\'s portable (compared to summer\'s regular monitor) and that you can hook it up to the tv.  i like the energy saving feature that turns the video off after 3 minutes, but when washing the dishes, it\'s kind of annoying to dry my hands and press the button to turn the video back on every few minutes if i hear my baby making noises.  i just plug it into the tv and it stays on, and i can just glance at the tv every few minutes to make sure he\'s still asleep and his feet aren\'t caught in the railings or anything.  we plan to take this on vacation and it will be great when we have to put him to bed at 7 in an upstairs room at my parent\'s house.  we can watch him from downstairs and not have to run up everytime we hear him.it\'ll also be great when he\'s older, as kids get into trouble without making noise!  that was definitely something that concerned us about an audio only monitor.  just because they\'re not crying doesn\'t mean you don\'t need to go in there!  and likewise...just because they ARE crying doesn\'t mean you have to run in there.  we were doing both :)  and now i can get more done and still feel secure knowing that he is okay.  i can even see him breathing on the screen, and even better when it\'s hooked up to the tv!  a great purchase.  it\'s definitely not movie quality, but i found it to be better than a surveillance video (that you would see at a store) and it seemed like the quality got better as we used it more.  the color is great and the night vision is FANTASTIC.  our baby is still in our room because we are building our home and his room is not finished yet, and i sometimes keep the monitor next to the bed even though he is 8 feet away because i can check on him in the dark without turning on any lights and risking waking him up.  i would definitely recommend this to anyone, especially for 1st time parents of newborns.  i love that i can check on his breathing.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This product is great and easy to use.  This is the second one I purchased for the second grandbaby.  I was a bit disappointed in the fact that as I was shopping at Target, I found the exact same thing for $30 less and whould, of course, not had the shipping charge.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I wish I had gotten this from the very beginning of my daughter\'s birth.  She is currently 8 months.  We just got it recently because we have been doing some sleep training with her where we were letting her cry for a while.  The video monitor makes the training so much easier to handle as a mother.  I also enjoy just watching my baby sleep which was something that I was able to do when she was a newborn when nothing could wake her up, but now I am too scared to wake her up with any slight noise I make if I went in her room.  It is also nice for babysitters so they feel more assured by noises they may hear from the baby\'s room.  The grandparents feel like they got to see her even though she is only sleeping.I definitely recommend this if you can afford the splurge.  This particular model the screen is nice and big but I\'ve also tried the 1.8" one and it was fine too.  Actually the 1.8" one had slightly better video quality.  The color does not work on either one unless the room is very brightly lit (the manual notes this too), so unless you have a baby who doesn\'t mind sleeping in a bright room, you won\'t ever see color.One function I find lacking is a screen brightness option.  It is really bright and hard on the eyes when you flip it on in the middle of the night to see what is going on with the baby.  But other than that, I don\'t have any complaints.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This video monitor is worth every single penny.  I bought just a week ago when we were moving our 3 month old baby girl into her crib and out of our room.  I don\'t think I could have made it through the night with out being able to see her every move.  The quality is so good I can see and hear her breathing.  If you are nervous about crib training your baby I highly reccommend getting this monitor, piece of mind is priceless!!!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: when we were looking at monitors, this one was definitly the one we wanted.  the others didn\'t compare with all of the features this one offered.  we were so excited to use it when we recieved it for our shower, we used it on our dog while he was in his cage in the basement to try to figure out why the cage was always sopping wet while we were out.  i don\'t know why the other reviews are giving it a not so great rating because when we were checking out our dog, it worked in our driveway while we pulled out!  now that our son was born, we use it on him and really like it.  the picture is very clear, my husband even saw him spit up!  i love the portability and the sound lights (for when i want him to cry a little but not listen to break my heart).  the picture works all over our house and even in the dark.  we would recommend this, definitly, to those who could afford it and for those who want the best!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This is a much better monitor than last years video monitor.  The screen is better, the range is longer, and the colors are brighter.  I still has limitations.  Although better than last year it still has a kinda\' choppy picture.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: We had the $149 Saftey 1st one, 1st model - after 6 months the Night vision went, got another, This one had little less static than the first. A friend had the Summer (this model) I got it confused with the Mobicam, but once at the store said let me try it. Of course problems from the start. Color, yeah right, mine seems to be only 4 colors, almost no diff from the night vision. Running a wireless household helped the reception on the saftey 1st but this one does NOT supress interferrance like the product says. I have to lean the antenna against my Wireless G card to kill the interferrence when it\'s next to me or ly it down on it\'s side and their is less zapping noise. Today this one is going back and I will try the Mobicam from Target, yet I really hate their crappy return policy. It would be so nice if babiesrus would carry the mobicam.The only positive this about this one was it was smaller so it didn\'t take up the whole nightstand, and my wife loved the fact she didn\'t have to sleep with her glasses on anymore, she just leaned over grabbed the unit and out it in front of her face to see what this little one was up to.Good Luck with your choice.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: My wife and I have owned 3 of these cameras over the past 4 years or so.  We initially moved to a video monitoring system because our first little one woke up without us noticing and wouldn\'t make much noise so the audio-only systems were very limited.  Overall, these cameras are good during the day.  At night they are very poor unless you have an alternate light source helping with the video feed.  The video monitors are decent at first but progressively get worse as you use it more and more.  Within a year, the volume control starts wearing out and you can hardly adjust the audio anymore without turning it on really loud.  Another annoyance is having to replace the batteries in these monitors.  I\'ve only been able to find similar batteries through the company itself.  If you only use these in a limited fashion, then you might be able to extend their life for more than a few years.  But after running through 3 of these cameras with the monitors all having volume control issues, my wife and I are looking for new video monitoring systems.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: We purchased this product in December 2009.  We have been happy with its reception and the screen nice.  However, after about a year we had to order a replacement charger because the charger connector broke.  Then after about 15 months, the speaker began to die.  We now have to spend 2-3 minutes adjusting the volume button to get anything but silence.  We do run a white noise machine in our baby\'s room when he is sleeping, so the speaker gets lots of use, but I expected such an expensive to last as long as I would want to monitor my child.  When I called customer service today (and sat on hold for 30 minutes) I was told it is out of its one year warranty so the best they could do was to let me purchase a refurbished version of the same monitor from their website.  Moral of the story, if you expect to need a monitor more than a year, this is probably not the one for you.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: We bought this product, as we live in a two level garden apartment in the NYC area. We brought it home and was able to see the full crib and we loved it! Once the baby was in the crib, we noticed that there was feedback with the sound. You can hear him cry on the monitor, but we have to keep the sound down, to avoid the feedback. We are now facing the hot and humid months of summer and are finding that we will have to purchase a regular sound monitor, as doors will be closed and there will be an air conditioner in his room.I am sad that we spent all this money, only to have to spend more on another monitor. :-(

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: The picture is great if you want to sit and stare at the monitor like you would dial a phone.  You must be very close to see what\'s going on. Lots of Interference. But when you get good reception, the audio is incredibly clear! A little color during the times of bright daylight. The video portion broke on the fourth day. Will return and exchange for another brand!!! If it seems a little too good to be true... It is!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: We bought this monitor with some debate due to it\'s cost and some of the negative reviews that were on Amazon.  But we decided to take our chances and get it.  We are very glad that we did.This monitor has been a trooper.  Our little guy is over a year old now and not only did this monitor survive some superficial roughing up when he got hold of it, but we are very sure we could use this for our second child if we have one.  The battery is still the original that came with it and it has never died on us even when left on for a hours at a time.  We leave it on and unplugged when he\'s napping and when he goes to bed up until the time we go to bed, a good four to five hours.The picture clarity is great when there is enough light, but when it gets dark it can be a bit hard to see the baby in the crib, but you CAN see them.  Hey it\'s a low grade form of night vision, what do you expect?  There is very little static and the picture comes through anywhere in the house and even outside the house; noting we have a poured concrete and steel house, wireless internet and 900 and 2.4 Mhz cordless phones.  These things do not deter the transmission of the picture.The fact that you can attach this monitor to your side is a plus as well.  And getting a video monitor is so much better because you don\'t have to walk into the room to check on your baby and disturb it\'s sleep.  Or, god forbid, wake the little monster.  They need their sleep...and so do you.  All I can say to those who had issues with their units is that either they got a defective one,  or they didn\'t read the directions.  We are very happy with this monitor and it\'s performance and would certainly buy it again.  Very much worth the money.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: My baby, at 2 months, had no problem transitioning from our room to his room...it was ME who had the problem. With this video monitor, my mind was completely at ease. Not only is the audio reception much better than the audio monitors we have, being able to see what he was doing in his crib was SO helpful. At night I would watch him for a while on the video, and make sure he was sound asleep...then I would press the button on top which shuts off the video part, and I would leave the audio monitor on. If I heard a noise in the middle of the night, I could just hit the top of the monitor (like an alarm clock snooze button) and see what was up. It\'s great. Highly recommended.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This is the best! We had an audio monitor and later bought this on recommendation of my sister. It is so wonderful to see your child AND hear them. I would say skip the audio only and register for this it\'s a MUST. We are having a second child and I\'m getting another one.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This is a must-have!!!!! Great monitor, although we needed a new one after 1.5 years. It would no longer charge properly after that amount of time. We bought another one.......

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I love this monitor to keep an eye on my granddaughter and now never second guess if she is still sleeping or awake.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This monitor works great.  We have had no static.  There has been no interference with wireless internet, cell phones, cordless phones or our Graco Audio Digital IMonitor.  I can hear my baby fine and can see her whole crib, even in a dark room.  This helps me to know if she really needs me or is just in there babbling, which will help when my new baby is born next week.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: Love it, with hesitations.  The monitor is never really in color, because it\'s never full daylight in the rooms with the cameras when I\'m monitoring my kids (naptime, and night-time).  So, it really probably isn\'t worth it to get the "color" screen, as it\'s always in night vision mode if the shades are drawn.  Even in dawn light, it\'s still not in color.  Second, the brightness mode isn\'t really that helpful.  There\'s not enough definition between the intensity levels for it to make much of a difference on the screen.  Would be nice if they could do a better job with that, as my older monitor by Summer has several knobs to play with to adjust the screen brightness.  Also, I have 2 cameras (had one before this purchase for my older Summer monitor), so I use both A and B channels to monitor rooms for both my kids.  It\'s not so bad at naptime to flip back and forth between the channels to see how they\'re doing, but it\'s totally useless at night to try to switch between the 2 cameras.  You would never know what the second kid is doing unless you manually switch between the channels, and who\'s awake enough to do that very often?  So, I ended up using my other old monitor to watch Channel A at night, and use the new monitor to watch Channel B.  Lastly, it\'s kind of a nice feature to have the camera automatically shut off.  But, if you want it on all night, it will stay on, as long as you have it plugged in.  I\'ve had a little problem with static with one of the cameras, but the other one is fine.  I generally just have to move the unit to the right or left a little bit for it to work better.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This monitor had way too much static.  I could not stand it so I returned it.  I wish that someone had warned me that I could barely hear my child because the static was so bad.  I would not recommend this monitor.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I ordered this product and turned it on and I picked up our neighbors baby.  I think any monitor that picks up someone else\'s baby is bad news!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: Our first monitor was just for sound, but every time we\'d hear somethhing, you had to go and check. With this monitor, if you hear something, all you have to do is look at the video to see if you need to go in the room. I was worried with the negative reviews I read for this product, but it works great for us. You can strap the monitor to your belt, and get some things done around the house. The video in the dark is great. The monitor is color, but you\'ll only see that if your room is brightly lit.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I agree with the other  reviews.  The reception and picture on this monitor is HORIBLE!  I have a 5 inch video monitor for my first child and wanted another for my newborn.  I like the portability aspect of the handheld unit, but honestly, it is not worth the high cost.  My 5 inch monitor is crystal clear but the 2.5 inch handheld is practically indecipherable.

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This hadheld monitor has great audio, sound much much better than any other monitor I have purchased. But I don\'t know how they could call this a color screen monitor. There is vertually no color even during the day. Picture gets scrambled when the phone rings or sometimes it\'s hard to find a signal. Over all it\'s nice to be able to see my daughter instead of just hearing her. Save your money and buy one of the black and whites video moitors

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: This monitor has lived up to its expectations....i could not imagine not having a video monitor...being able to check on our baby without having to go into her room with every noise that she makes is great....you can tell if she is really upset or just moving around without disturbing her when not necessary.....the portability of this monitor is great...we dont have a large house but being able to take the monitor with you really sets my wife at ease....the picture is not the clearest, but if you are expecting a HD like picture you are kidding yourself...we have the camera about 8 ft away and can see everything we need to....the color picture during daytime is better than the black and white image shown at night, but both have met and surpased our expetactions....definitely opt for the 2.5" screen...Very pleased with this monitor....highly recommended!!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: I can actually see and hear into my neighbors home! It picked up our neighbor\'s signal which is creepy to think they can watch us with our baby. Not secure!!!

name: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen - Pink
review: When my first child was born, I thought I didn\'t need a video monitor...until he started rolling around in his bed, and eventually climbing out.  Now he\'s 2 and I just purchased this to keep an eye on him as he gets out of bed on his own now, and for our new baby that\'s on the way.  Can\'t believe I didn\'t get one of these sooner!
