review: I am surprised that for the money these bags did not hold up in the freezer.  Many have holes and I have to put them in a bowl to make sure I don\'t loose the milk.

name: Medela Pump & Save Breastmilk Bags - 50 pack-5 oz
review: Although these breastmilk bags are pricey, they are worth it when you want to pump directly into the storage bag and skip the step of pumping into a bottle. They do not hold quite as much milk as other brands I had tried but it was more than sufficient for our needs.

name: Medela Pump & Save Breastmilk Bags - 50 pack-5 oz
review: I have been using these for quite some time.  For some reason I decided to smell the inside of the bag.  There is a strong plastic odor inside the bag.  I put some water in one and froze it.  Then I thawed it as I would milk for my son.  The water absorbed the odor and tasted funny.  I have about thirty bags left in the package and am throwing them out.  Who knows what chemicals are leaching into the liquid inside.  In addition, I noticed that the packaging states "Packaged and printed in the USA"...but where is the actual plastic used to make the bag made???

name: Medela Pump & Save Breastmilk Bags - 50 pack-5 oz
review: These bags are good for freezer storage, as they are compact and hold enough for about two feedings for a newborn.  However, the little attachment clip for hooking to the breast-pump is clumsy, and allows for leaks.  We gave up trying to pump straight into the bags after a few attempts because of the leaks.Again, the bags for freezer storage are fine, but you won\'t save any time trying to pump right into these.  It\'s just too messy.

name: Medela Pump & Save Breastmilk Bags - 50 pack-5 oz
review: These are the worst storage bags! They don\'t freeze flat. They are had to close and you\'re not really sure if it is closed all the way and secure. And if you leave them in your freezer for about 3 months or more, they crack. So when I\'m defrosting my milk, the bag starts leaking! My milk is basically mixed with water because im defrosting it in a water bath. All my hard work pumping ounce after ounce of milk is just wasted!  Get the lansinoh breast milk storage bags. They are so much better!

name: Medela Pump & Save Breastmilk Bags - 50 pack-5 oz
review: It takes a lot of strength to close the zip. Sometimes you think it is closed but it is NOT! And when you try to store the breast milk, it leaks! It happened to me a few times already!

name: Medela Pump & Save Breastmilk Bags - 50 pack-5 oz
review: Love these storage bags. My daughter takes 3-4 oz at a time, so I am able to freeze smaller portions. I have not had trouble with leaking on the zip loc seal. Will definitely buy again!

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I received this at my baby shower and it is one of the best gifts I received.  Highly recommended for new moms like me who struggled through learning how to nurse.  This was a lifesaver because it makes nursing so much easier.  I used it consistently every time I nursed for the first three months. I also had a boppy pillow but it doesn\'t compare at all to using this product.  This is truly a new nursing mom\'s best friend!

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: This has been the best product I have ever purchased!  I had a scheduled C-Section with my son and it came in so handy in the hospital since it was hard for me to move around.  It is comfortable and convenient to use.  I would recommend it to everyone!

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: For my second baby I received the My Brestfriend pillow as a gift and love it! My older child is only 16 months older - so I had to jump up and tend to her while still trying to nurse the baby - this pillow snaps on and stays in place. You can move to another room if need be. The boppy pillow would never stay close enough around my waist, the baby would always fall between the pillow and my lap, with this pillow it fits securley around you and holds it\'s shape. Highly reccommend it to a nursing mom.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I had received a Boppy as a gift and found it awkward in the beginning stages of breastfeeding because baby would slide towards my belly.  The lactation consultant at the pediatrician\'s office recommended My Brest Friend and I sampled it there and found that the "table" like design worked better.  I have continued to use the Brest Friend at night in the nursery and the Boppy during the day in the living room.  Now that I am confident with nursing, I don\'t bother clipping the belt closed.  That is somewhat unnecessary and adds more steps.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I inherited this breastfeeding pillow and I both love it and hate it.PROs:-The pillow stays put. I\'ve tried a Boppy and while it\'s easy to put on, it tends to move around a lot. This was really helpful when getting my baby to latch properly when he was first born (I had to try so many different positions and this pillow was wonderful at it!).-The pillow is WIDE, which can be both a pro and a con. I love how wide it is now that my son is 3.5 months old--he still fits comfortably on it! I used my friend\'s Boppy a week ago and noticed my son did not fit as comfortably on it.CONs:-I HATE the velcro closure. It is so LOUD it often wakes my sleeping baby.-The pillow is WIDE so I often have to nurse my son sitting at the edge of my glider, which is not the most comfortable for me. It\'s better to use this pillow on a sofa or bed.-It\'s hard to use--I need two hands to put it on, although I\'m getting a lot better at putting it on with one hand now (yes, it only took me 3.5 months to get used to that!). Now I have a system where I put it on and then pick my baby up from his crib to nurse him.-The cloth cover is horrible. It is so faded from just a few washings...it doesn\'t stand up like the Boppy fabric does (I\'ve only used the Boppy Luxe--not sure about other Boppy fabrics).

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: this is the best nursing pillow i\'ve found. love that it wraps all the way around, has a large surface area for me to rest my arm w/baby and that it has a mechanism for securing it around me and tightening/loosening it as needed. a must have for us long waisted nursing moms.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: This pillow is wonderful!  It has a nice firm support that is comfortable for the baby, but not too comfortable for them to fall asleep halfway through feeding.  It is nice how it straps onto you so that you can move about.  You don\'t have to fiddle around and keep readjusting this pillow, like many others---this one actually stays in place.  The only thing I don\'t like is the little "pillow supports" that are on the pillow.  I have an infant and the pillow suports just shift his head around because he can\'t adjust his neck.  But I just position him below the supports and they will come in handy when he\'s a little older.This is the ONLY pillow you will ever need, don\'t even bother looking at the boppy or other pillows.  This is well worth the money, and your comfort (it supports your back with a nice firm cushion)!

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: Got a Boppy.  Didn\'t help.  Got a Brest Friend.  Changed my life!  This is the most FANTASTIC breast-feeding product on the planet.  Just bought some more to give as shower gifts.  I\'m now a Brest Friend evangelist.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I went to a nursing store and tried several different pillows and this was the only one that was truly comfortable and not awkward to use.  My only complaint is that you cannot take it off in the same room in which your baby has fallen asleep... the velcro is LOUD!  LOL!  Otherwise, I can\'t imagine bf-ing without this pillow.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: People either love the boppy or my brest friend. .. I love this pillow.  It positions the baby in the perfect position and makes a very hard job a lot easier.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I originally thought I could do without a nursing pillow and just use regular pillows.  After all, it was a bit on the expensive side.  After my son was born and struggling to feed him in the first two days, my husband went out and bought this pillow.  It made my life so much easier!!!  If you are a new mother and your new born has trouble latching on, the last thing you want to do is trying to deal with 2 or 3 pillows that don\'t stay around you and slip away constantly.  Not only dose this pillow stay put while you position your infant, it provides back support for the mother, and the infant has an easy time to stay on the flat surface!I have to say that this is the best purchase I\'ve made for my baby and I!  I would recommand it to any nursing mother.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I used the Brest Friend two years ago when my daughter was born, at the recommendation of a lactation consultant.  I loved it!  It worked wonderfully--much better than the Boppy.  I\'m quite petite, so I particularly liked that the Brest Friend was so adjustable and could fit close to my body (my newborn would slip into the space between my body and the Boppy), and that there are bumps on the pillow that hold a newborn\'s head up to just the right spot.  I used it until she was several months old and wished I\'d had it in the hospital when I was first trying to figure out how to nurse.  A great product!Now I\'m due to have my second child, so went to wash the cover of My Brest Friend.  The zipper broke, although I\'d only washed it a few times.  I called Zenoff, using the number on their web site, explained the problem, and asked where I could find a replacement cover.  Not only did they volunteer to send me a new cover free of charge, but they walked me through a description of the different covers so I could choose which one to get, and shipped out my choice immediately.  I recieved the replacement cover in 3 days.  Couldn\'t be better!

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: Hi all, I ordered this pillow two days before I delivered and by the time it came in I was almost pouncing on the door every time I heard someone outside.  What a life saver!!  Breastfeeding was so stressful at the hospital trying to use all those pillows.  After using my brest friend I plan on bringing it to the hospital for any friend wanting to try breastfeeding.  It lets you focus on you and the baby and eliminates the need to hold the baby up which is tough in the beginning due to fatigue and lack of experience.  No sliding off of the breast once you get your ravenous and rooting baby latched on!!  And when they do pull off in their feeding frenzy you have one hand to hold your nipple/breast and the other to guide their head to it.  With my little guy it was definitely a two-handed process until he was almost a month.  He goes a little nuts when he\'s hungry.  The only reason it didn\'t get five stars from me was that I found when sitting that if I didn\'t put a pillow behind my back that the part of the pillow that wraps around behind jabbed into my back when I sat all the way back in the chair.  Very uncomfortable when you\'re trying to relax.  Overall though the best things on the market.  This is the way to go.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I used it from day one and love it, i recommend this to anyone breastfeeding.  I have eaten at the dinner table with it on, i work on the laptop with it on, i can leave my baby on it to sleep and be close to me with out wearing out my arms.  I love the support you get in the back and the straight line support the baby gets to the breast. It is hands free breastfeeding once your baby learns how to latch on well.  If you are serious about breastfeeding you need this pillow!!!

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I\'ve nursed my little one several times with both My Brest Friend and with a boppy. I wish I had My Brest Friend at the very beginning - it\'s much easier to situate the little one appropriately, the back support for mom is GREAT, and the removable washable cover is very convenient. It\'s much easier to use than a boppy, and doesn\'t slide around. My only complaint is that the glue the manufacturer uses to keep the two foam pieces together is a little stinky. When mine arrived, I left it sitting out of the cover for a full day before I felt the fumes had dissipated enough for me not to worry about what the baby was breathing in. And I washed the cover a few times before using, too.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I\'ve had time to try out several of the breastfeeding pillows on the market and this is my top pick to recommend to friends and doula/childbirth ed clients.  It is thicker (lap to chest-wise) than the Boppy, which works better for most women, and the firmer, wider (belly to knees) surface helps position new babies.  While I only used a nursing pillow consistantly for the first four or five months with each child, they are very, very helpful in proper positioning, which helps with proper latch, which helps prevent sore nipples and also helps baby get the right amount of milk.  This pillow attaches around the waist, with extra lumbar support, which helps mom\'s posture and prevents shoulder slouch (which can become a huge problem), protects mom\'s joints and so forth.Great pillow.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I have both the boppy and this pillow.  This pillow keeps a baby positioned better than the boppy.  With the boppy, she would slip down between me and the pillow all the time.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: I have both the boppy and brest friend. Th boppy doesn\'t compare to this product, it is the BEST. It\'s so comfortable and the pocket to keep things in is so handy.It perfectly positions your baby and helps him/her falll asleep. THe boppy is good for putting your baby down for a minute while you do stuff, other than that, brest freind is priceless. the only thing is when you are beat tired, it\'s a pain to strap on but well worth it once it\'s on.

name: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review: My son has acid reflux and feeding was hard enough as it was, let alone having to have my husband hold the Boppy so that it wouldn\'t slip away from my body.  The velcro (though loud to take off if the baby falls asleep) on the Brest Friend and the back support are a FABULOUS pairing.I\'ve loaned this to 2 other friends who also tossed out their Boppies for the Brest Friend, and I won\'t even bother with the Boppy when my second arrives this spring.

name: Maclaren Baby Carrier - Charcoal/Tan - Free Shipping
review: I tried several carriers before finally trying the Mclaren carrier.  This product has saved my life!  The pod the carrier came with was perfect when my son was under 11 lbs and all the others carriers looked like they were going to eat him alive.  Now that he has grown out of the pod he still loves being in this carrier.  It is also so easy to snap him in this carrier.  I defininitely recommend this carrier over all others!

name: Maclaren Baby Carrier - Charcoal/Tan - Free Shipping
review: This is a good product, however I did not like it at first.  We tried to put my baby in this after she was about a week old and I was afraid she would suffocate in it.  Her head would flop to my chest and I couldn\'t tell if she was getting enough air.  Also the straps would leave marks all over her tiny head.  Now that she is bigger, this works great.  She is able to hold her head up now so I do not have any problems.  I also love the material on this, it is so much softer than other carriers.  All in all this is a good product.  I received it as a gift and probably would not have purchased it on my own.

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: This is a fun toy for most kids, my 5 month old will stay in it for about 10-15 min before he tires of it. I purchased it at half price on Amazon and am happy, but I would not end up paying full price. It\'s not that amazing.

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: My mother saw this playnest on a show for the smallest girl in the world. After seeing how the child played safely in the nest my mother begged me to seek it out and I found it here on Amazon. When I bought it I believe I paid around 30 bucks and got the one with the play gym attachment.Not only did the play gym fully support my newborn daughter it also did a great job of keeping her interested. The toys and sensory objects that came with this product are amazing and the vibrant colors kept her interested. She learned to sit up in half the time which improved all of her motor functions. I do recommend getting the product without the play gym attachment. The arms of the play gym are difficult to attach and when they are finally in place it hangs to low and can irritate the child. My daughter hated the dangling toys that pratically layed on top of her because they were so low. A problem for me, but maybe you will have better luck :-)I am giviing it 5 stars because even with the gym attachment problems the play nest itself is an awesome product that exceeded my expectations. Baby find of the year and every new mom I encounter will hear all about Galt\'s Amazing Playnest!!UPDATE: My daughter is now almost 3 and every child in our family since her birth have used this play nest! Currently my 6 month old nephew loves to roll around in it. I still recommend and gift this to new moms!

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: This is the only place that I could put my baby down without him screaming to get back in my arms.  He Loved it!  Even after he learned to crawl and get out, he would love to come back on his playnest with other toys he would bring into the nest.  This was really a life saver for us.  As far as the assembly, I have no idea why the other reviewer had a problem.  We used the pump we use for our bicycle\'s tires and there was nothing complicated about it at all.  I highly recommend this product!!!  Well worth the price!

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: This "nest" was bigger than I thought.  Baby sits in it nicely and seems to enjoy it very much.  If you purchase this, just remember not to blow the tube up first thing (it will not fit in the cloth liner slot - found out the hard way).  I think this thing is neat!

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: I love the playnest!  My daughter has hip problems and we could not put her in an exersaucer type activity center.  This playnest was exactly what we needed!  It\'s perfect for babies who aren\'t sitting up completely on their own but who are ready to move past lying on their back on a play mat.  I can set her in it and she literally just hangs out, happy as a clam and I don\'t worry about her tipping over and bonking her head.  Within a week it improved her \'sitting skills\'.  I don\'t understand what the other reviewer found hard about the assembly of this product.  There are two pieces; the inner tube and the cover.  You slide the empty inner tube into the cover and then you blow it up.  Couldn\'t be easier.

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: This was a baby gift from my sister for my son. Three and a half years later he is still using it all the time. He sits in it and watches movies (like a little nest), sits on the edges and bounces, flips it over and uses it as a trampoline, pulls his baby sister around in it. This thing has stood up to 3 years of major abuse! Now I have fights over who gets to sit in it! It takes up space but it is worth it the amount it gets used. It is the one an only toy I am buying two of!

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: My sister-in-law bought this for our first son and now the second boy is enjoying it. It is perfect for an active little one who doesn\'t want to just lay around but can\'t go anywhere on his own. My 5 month old is sitting up, turning around, and doing push-ups on the edge. It really helps a little one build upper body strength and safely learn how to move his/her body. Babies do eventually dive over the side, so make sure the playnest is in a safe place.

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: teaches kids to sit up......if they fall over.....it won\'t hurt  very nice, it is being used for a 61\\2 month old.

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: So my baby was very frustrated when she was in that awkward "I don\'t want to lay down but I don\'t have the physical capacity to sit up yet" phase. It\'s the phase I hit after 4 glasses of wine. She hit it at 3 months. I brought this with us everywhere we traveled, my dad found it hilarious, called it a baby container. This nest propped her up and gave me a break, she loved sitting in it I would haul it into the bathroom and I could take a shower. A shower! Thank you Galt, my husband thanks you as well. I was getting pretty desperate. And stinky.  Once she got the knack of sitting up and crawling I stopped relying on it so heavily. But, still a nice spot for her to relax when she first wakes up, she\'s 9 months now and she likes to look at the animals and recline in it. It looks so cozy, I want one in my size. It\'s bright, colorful, very high quality fabric. This is a very well made and amazing product, those Germans, they know how to make nice things.

name: Galt Playnest - Jungle
review: I loved this for my daughter starting at about 4 months because she loved it and it was supportive and portable. When she started sitting up this was perfect because I could let her sit up and not have to worry about her falling over and hurting herself. She also spent a lot of time looking at all the bright colors and the squeaking toy on there always got her attention. I stopped using it around 8 months when she started to crawl because she would spring herself out of it pretty easily.

name: Bedside Bassinet with Vibration & Music - White
review: It worked for us just fine, even when we hardly used the music box and the vibrating because we didn\'t see that it helped our baby at all, we tried them a few times and just stoped using\'em.And even when the instructions are so simple, we just couldn\'t find how to remove the cover to wash it, which will have to get washed eventually.

name: Bedside Bassinet with Vibration & Music - White
review: I got this bassinet as a gift and I love how it vibrates and has music, my baby is always right to sleep. I also like the way it folds down, I travel alot and then I take it with me. It can also rock or roll.

name: Burlington Baby Moses Basket with Liner, White
review: This bassinet was exactly what I needed. I wanted a bassinet that was larger in size since my babies tend to be large when they are born and the smaller bassinets are too small in just a few weeks. This bassinet is very spacious and easy to move around your home. I love it!!!

name: Burlington Baby Moses Basket with Liner, White
review: This is a great basket for the price. It seems sturdy enough for the amount of time I will be using it. I didn\'t care what the bedding looked like because I was planning on making my own, but it really isn\'t too bad looking- it is fairly simple and fit the basket. I\'m using the basket without any liner, just the mattress and sheet, and it\'s adorable. I paired it with a rocking Moses basket stand (also at a great price on Amazon) and it is just what I wanted- something simple and natural looking, not frilly or plastic.

name: Burlington Baby Moses Basket with Liner, White
review: I bought this based on the previous review. It is utter garbage. The basket is one size and the interior liner with which it arrives is another smaller size that does not stretch. so when you stretch it to fit over the sides of the basket, it buckles and breaks the cheap woven material of which the basket is constructed. I would return it but the manufacturer  but they will not refund postage in wither direction, and it arrives in a big box. So by the time that postage is accounted for I would ultimately be refunded $15, and out the time of dealing with this. It looks cute but turned out to be a waste of money and time. If you have a heavy child this basket seems rickety. I would not trust it.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: Meets all expectations.  I think the massaging action of this unit is better that other units we have had. I can feel the vibration not only in the feet, but in the legs clear up to the thighs.  The machine is well built, sturdy, and putting pressure on it does not cause the motor to lug. The unit is louder than other units we have had, but isn\'t so loud to be disturbing. I recommend this to anyone who needs, or wants a massager for their feet.  I\'m diabetic with numbness in my toes. By using a massager am able to keep numbness from spreading to the rest of my feet. This is a great machine.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: A great adjunct to the care I receive at the clinic. Nice to be able to get relief at home when needed.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: My husband is diabetic with hypertension and always has a lot of swelling in his legs and ankles and feet. His circulation isn\'t what it used to be. This massager is so strong and works so well, we use the "low" setting instead of the "high" because it\'s just that efficient. It\'s great after a long day on your feet. The tingling sensation when you\'re done let\'s you know the blood is really flowing to your feet!

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I\'ve had this about 6 months now, as the other reviewer said, it\'s very powerful, I keep it on a pillow because I live upstairs and don\'t want to aggravate my neighbors. This has seriously eased my foot pain to the point where it is almost completely gone (I have large heel spurs in both feet) and it also eases my knee pain. I\'m not sure why exactly, but it does. After I turn this off after about 20 minutes, my feet and half way up my calves will tingle for a few minutes. I really recommend this for circulation and relief of foot pain. It\'s money well spent.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I bought this massager for my 87 year old aunt, who suffers from leg cramps so bad that they wake her up at night.  She is a heart patient, so even though she is thin, she has some restricted circulation problems.  I asked her doctor before hand if this would be a good product (always a good idea to ask the doc, especially with the elderly).  Any way, he said it couldn\'t hurt, so I got it.SHE LOVES IT....NO MORE CRAMPING AT NIGHT AND NO MORE NUMBNESS IN HER LEGS..  She is one happy camper.The only negative is that it is a bit pricy.  By the looks of it, they could sell it for less, still make money, and a lot more people could be helped.  I thought long and hard before spending nearly 300 bucks for this item.Bottom Line...If you can afford it, buy it..It\'s great..

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I also place this unit in a full-size indoor chase lounger with large armrests that\'s covered with a large fleece throw-blanket.  In addition to a good position for the usual foot oscillations with my legs extended, the Medi-Rub angle can be slid upwards and under my calfs or posterior thighs. In this particular chase lounger, it also comfortably fits behind my back and can be moved up and down from my lower neck-thoractic vertebrae and moved to my mid-lower back. This worked surprisingly well.  Additionally, it fits well in a large desk chair for a lower back massage. The additional back positions worked well while stretching a bit from side-to-side and digging deeper into the oscillations.  It stays firmly in place on carpet. I\'m 71" and 185 pounds - other sizes may require a bit of experimentation.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: Relieves tension in the muscles.Time saver  - 15 minutes will dothe trick.ends to not stay stationary whenon the high level.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I have used several other massage devices but Medi-rub is hands down the best! Very easy to use and simple to put away when not in use. I am currently using it 2-3 times a day on low, have NOT had any feet cramps. Hope it will make a difference with the neuropathy in a few more weeks!

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I have bad ankles since birth , this product is amazing . I have tried other products that were a scam . this really works I only wish I had it 30 years ago

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: This is one of the better foot massagers I have seen and used. It helps me with my nerve pain. I use it a couple times a day.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: Great machine for aching feet. Highly recommend to anyone who likes this type of massage. Only negative is, no heat function.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: My father is a diabetic, this really helped him with the circulation in his feet & leg cramps. Best gift I could have purchased for him. Thank you!!!

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: This foot massager does not really massage--in the sense that it applies useful pressure at particular points to relax or knead muscles. It simply vibrates, tingling the feet and ankles with vibration. If this is what you are looking for you might like it. If you are looking for any kind of deeper massage you will be disappointed.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: After experiencing this machine at my foot reflexologist\'s office today, I came to this page to check the price. If it was affordable I would buy one this instant. (It\'s definitely worth the money if you have the ability to pay.)My reflexologist put me on the Medi-Rub machine to get me warmed up for my treatment. She didn\'t do that for my first appointment and I could tell the difference. It really got my circulation going big-time. The reflexology treatment then seemed to "follow" the increased circulation up my legs and into my pelvis. It also increased the relaxation aspect of the treatment considerably.I use a wooden footsie roller at home for a general tonic effect on my feet (a quick, non-specific burst of reflexology is what I\'m looking for during my busy schedule). This now seems like a caveman tool. I thought the roller effect was pretty darn wonderful until I experienced the Medi-Rub Foot Massager. Even on "low" (there are only two speeds - high and low) this machine puts my humble footsie roller in the shade within 15 seconds when it comes to sheer stimulation.The Medi-Rub is also more comfortable and less awkward. I can sit back in an armchair and allow the tilt of the footpad to support me, instead of perching on the edge of a chair and running in place on the rollers. The "running in place" action makes my back ache, whereas the Medi-Rub Massager doesn\'t require a straining posture of any kind. You don\'t have to do anything but close your eyes and let the bliss happen.This is an excellent therapeutic device, but it\'s also a superb way to get completely relaxed in the space of a few minutes. I\'ve moved this little beauty to the top of my birthday wish list.P.S. The product photo is absurd - anyone using this machine while wearing business shoes is a looney toon.P.P.S. I take that back! I visited the manufacturer\'s Website (medirub.com in Texas) and found out you can use it either while wearing shoes or barefoot.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I cannot attest to any medical aspects of this machine, as far as the abilty to open up any arteries for increased blood flow, but it does feel great and prvides a great deal of relief.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I bought this for my folks (Over 65 years old). They say it gives them relief for a while. So, I guess at this price this item is definitely worth it.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I was just looking for a simple foot massager. This isn\'t the one for me! Too rough, and just shook and shook. Didn\'t really do anything but shake.

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I use it sometimes. It was great. Good job!

name: Medi-Rub Foot Massager 2000 Plus
review: I was recently on vacation in California and tried out one of those commercial foot massagers at the San Diego Zoo called "footsie wootsie."  If you have ever spent all day walking around a theme park or zoo and then treated yourself to the experience you know what I am talking about.  I fell in love with the thing and wanted to buy one to keep at home but didn\'t have the extra $1500 bucks plus shipping.  After some research I decided to try this one out as a possible substitute.  PERFECT CHOICE!  I love the vibrating/massaging action.  It makes my feet and legs feel amazing and didn\'t cost thousands or require me to keep feeding it quarters.  Yay Medi-Rub!

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: This May we went on a three week trip to Europe with our twenty-seven month old son.  Aside from the wisdom (or lack therof) of that decision, I panicked about two weeks before the trip.  I\'d given up my diaper bags a few months ago, but didn\'t think a big purse with a couple of diapers would be sufficient for sightseeing in a couple of cities.  So I started the frantic search for an appropritate baby backpack.Can I say the Baby Sherpa was a disaster.  I swear to God it was the worst baby thing I\'ve bought in the time I\'ve been a parent.  First, the bag came broken.  It was probably my fault for not noticing that the bungee cord had no tightener, but honestly, I can\'t remember the last time I\'ve used a bungee cord.  Second, it came with a couple of laminated pages that recommended that you keep extra Ziploc type bags in the bag.  Apparently, whomever designed this thing didn\'t think to make waterproof pockets and had you bring some bags as an afterthought.  Aargh.The cold/food pouch at the bottom?  Useless.  The main packet (which is tiny because of the food pcocket?  Useless.  The side water bottles Velcro add-ons - a pain in my you-know-what.  The changing pad in the back mesh area?  Useless.  It kept sliding out and was bulky as all get out.I ended up using my purse most of the trip and my husband\'s backpack instead.  (I highly recommend the DadGear bag).This has got to be the worst $75 I\'ve ever spent.  It\'s going right back today.

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: I received the Baby Sherpa and within a few weeks, the zipper on part of the compartment broke making it impossible to hold a baby bottle of any type.  Also, the mesh is falling apart. You can\'t hold as much as they advertise.  I don\'t use the Sherpa more than about 4 times a month and it looks like I have had it for years.  NOT WORTH THE MONEY EVEN IF IT ONLY COST $20!!!!

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: I purchased this backpack b/c we have a 16 month old and a newborn.  We used the packpack for 2 months and the mesh is pulling apart, I\'ve mended it several times!  It is just not holding up well at all.  Also, it doesn\'t hold nearly what I expected.  The only good feature is the insulated food compartment.

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: Too much space is used up by the cooler compartment and leaves little space for diapers, snacks, or an iPad as advertised. The side bottle holders aren\'t sturdy enough.

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: I asked a question about this item before I purchased as I could not find regular camo ANYWHERE else, so I wanted to make sure this was the "regular" and not the "digital camo". (As I had ordered it elsewhere and was told the "regular camo" was discontinued. So, from the answer I received from the customer, I went ahead and ordered...Super excited because I was going to give it to my husband :)So when I received it I opened and was immediately disappointed...IT WAS DIGITAL CAMO. I contacted Amazon and they informed me they did not carry the regular camo anymore and gladly refunded me 100%I had an amazing experience with Amazon, but the product is NOT Described correctly and the picture should be changed so this doesn\'t happen again!

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: This is a great backpack for men who are not trying to lose their identity by carrying a chicks diaper bag.  There not many options for men in this category.  It is well equipped and with ample storage room for all the things you would need to take care of your child on the fly.  My wife likes it better than her bag. this was a very good purchase

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: I purchased this backpack thinking it would be great for myself or my husband to use while traveling. What a terrible design. The main flaw for me is the velcro placement. The Velcro on the change pad holder has the rough side of velcro facing your back and ruined your clothes if it\'s misaligned and also the velcro on the removable pouches also causes your clothes to stick and causes pulls. So far it has ruined the shirts we were wearing every time we used it.  All the dividers are more of a PITA then they are worth. All the divisions and pouches have you constantly opening and searching for every little thing. Go for something less busy. Also the chest strap is made of elastic and stretches rather than moving some of the load. Another useless feature. We have now just thrown it out. Don\'t bother with this for a diaper backpack.

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: I used my backpack like for 5 months and the seams by the zipper falling apart after like 40 uses. It never happened to me ever in my entire life though I\'m complete "backpack person" and I never had anything else but a backpack.. Next time I will rather go than for a special backpack for normal backpack with all life warranty and buy changing pad for it.

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: this is great, this our 4th diaper bag (we have a 16 month old and 1 on the way) and this is the best for sure. not too big and bulky like the regular tote style, you can sling it over one shoulder or two or a stroller. well balanced, LOVE the insulated lunch section and bottle holders, all the multi purpose pockets are great. we have plenty of room for two kids stuff in ours and its still not heavy- very durable too.

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Black
review: I purchased this product in April didn\'t use it until our first Family Vacation in May and have used it once a week for swim class.  The product has now ripped on the main strap side - (where you put your arm through) Where the strap attaches to the back pack how did it rip already.  :(  So sad!!!!I was under the impression the product was built to last.

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Navy
review: Got this about 7 weeks ago and it is already started to rip from seams and falling a part, poor quality, DO NOT BUY this bag, instead buy something from walmart or any other store. This is expensive and really bad quality bag.

name: Baby Sherpa Diaper Backpack - Navy
review: I am in love with this bag and so happy to have found it.  It\'s the perfect bag for long days out and more adventurous excursions. It would make a great baby shower gift or one for any parent with babies, toddlers or kids in general who needs to regularly haul stuff around. My husband doesn\'t mind carrying it and saves us from carrying 3 or 4 bags.  We use the inside padded compartment for carrying our iPad. I highly recommend the Baby Sherpa.

name: Stork Craft Kayla II Changing Table, Natural
review: It isn\'t the best constructed changing table out there, but for the price, it is a great deal!!  And visually, it is just as attractive as many of the more expensive changing tables we\'ve seen.  Very happy with this purchase!

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: My toddler can now sit at the dinner table.  This booster does not slip on a wooden chair. Very easy to clean...rinse in sink.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Most kids booster seats come in super bright colors with obnoxious patterns on them. We wanted something that would blend in with our furniture and be stealthy under our dining room table. This booster fits perfectly under our table and blends right into the cushion and dark wood, making it unnoticeable.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This is just a great little booster seat for my  little Prince Lionheart (grandson).  He immediately goes to the closet to take it out and put in his chair the minute he arrives.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I bought two for my 22 month old twins. I love them! I love that there are no straps and they clean up easily!

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This booster seat is easy to clean, aesthetically appealing and gets the job done. It doesn\'t have any bells and whistles, but that\'s exactly what I was wanting. It does not attach to a chair or have a seatbelt which I personally appreciated, but if you are looking for "safety features" this is not the booster for you.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I was having a hard time getting my 2 1/2 year old son to sit at the table for ANY meal.  So I thought a booster would be the ticket.....I was right!!  And the Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat was the perfect choice!  It gives him the lift he needs to feel part of the family, and the security and comfort to stay seated with us, even if he\'s finished his meal.  The orange is also a great compliment with the earthy decor in our house!!  I looked at a lot of these and kept coming back to this one.  Wipes easily, just perfect!!

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: My 18 mo old daughter loves the chair, does not try to stand up in it (like she did in the regular chair) and actually takes it out to the deck when she wants to sit outside. However, it definitely has a funky smell (like moldy fungus) on the underside that I only smell when it is wet. I have to call the manufacturer and see what I can do about it.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This booster seat works well. The seat doesn\'t slide around on the wooden chair even though there is no fasters holding it to the chair. My son is constantly in motion so i am really impressed. Easy to clean and my son seems to find it comfortable.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I bought this hoping it would make my 3 year old want to sit at the table and eat dinner. He is small for his age, and I was worried he would sit too low. The booster is the right height that he sits comfortably and can feed himself. The foamy material is soft but sturdy and wipes off easily. It has held up well for daily use, but it sits on the chair at the table (he doesn\'t drag it all around the house to play with). I bought one in orange for at home and one in green for my parents house. We have had good luck with the booster and would recommend over the more expensive versions.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: The color wasn\'t exactly what I wanted but the size and weight are perfect. Easy to clean and great for my pantry, much better than the bulky high chair!

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This is an excellent booster seat for "grammy\'s house".  The material is soft, sturdy and stays in place while not doing any damage nice wood chairs.  The height is perfect for a 2+ year-old to sit at a normal height table for meals, crafts, etc.  It is also easy to store.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: My daughter has used this chair since she turned 3.  It helps boost her up to the table but is not held down or has straps that would be too young for her.  It is very portable and can be moved off the chair if you need another chair for visiting adults.  It is very easy to clean.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This seat was exactly what I was looking for. My son is really tall to the seats with bars across the legs just don\'t work for him. Now he wants to sit no where else! It is a rubbery material to so it\'s comfortable for him and not easy to tear up or break. It also has little grips on the bottom that help it stay on the chair.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I debated between this and something that could be strapped down. I have 22 month old twins and I am so glad that this doesn\'t strap down. My kids are very good at getting in and out of the dining chairs and booster seat by themselves. We have not fallen off of the chair once. I feel that if the booster was strapped down then I would probably never take it off to clean it because who wants to unstrap and restrap and clean two booster seats everyday? It is easy to clean and stays put on our dining chairs. It is also easy to just throw in the car when we are traveling. What more could you ask for?

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I was worried about getting this vs. the more expensive Cushee, but am glad I didn\'t fork out the extra money. This seat is very durable, doesn\'t tip over (no matter how weirdly my son climbs in), cleans easily and looks good too. Highly recommended.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This booster works perfect for my 3-year-old daughter.  I bought in the blue color, and it looks exactly like it does on the screen.  We have dining room chairs that have a bit of a slant back, and they have indentations (so they are not perfectly flat) and they stay on perfect.  The booster does not slide around and fits just right.  The material is soft; I would compare it to the bumbo material, but it is a bit more solid, and it has a shiny "finish." There is no strap/buckle, which I like, since it seems more like a big girl seat (very important for a 3 year old :)).  My cousin has the bumbo booster for her toddlers, and I prefer this one much better.  Buy it, you won\'t regret it!

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Comfortable seat but the bumpy texture on the seat makes it impossible to clean. I think the color might also be rubbing off (from the scrubbing) so it makes the seat look even dirtier.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Great product! Sturdy yet soft, great back support, love the colors. My child can carry it by himself. Love it. Recommend it.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This seat allows for a perfect transition from the high chair. It\'s light, comfortable, and stays put on the kitchen chair.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: My 2 yr old loves this seat.  It\'s comfy, he will stay in it all dinner.  He loves the bright orange color.  Easy to clean and remove from the chair - I hated our old one with all the straps.  We are very pleased with the Prince Lionheart booster and I\'m glad I got it over the more expensive Cooshie.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Bought this for my 4 1/2 y/o son. He has a "difficult" time sitting still at dinner. Surprise! This helps him get closer to the table so we have fewer crumbs for the puppy to snack on after dinner!

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Easy to use, easy to clean....that\'s what I need for two little ones that make a monster mess at the table. No straps needed....no one has fallen.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: My older grandchild has this same seat and we love it.  She has had it for 3 years now and it was used by a neighbor\'s grandson  originally.  Held up perfectly.  So we got one for the second grandchild and she is thrilled to have the same seat as her sister.  Again, nice seat and easy to use.  We also bring them whenever we take the kids to a concert or children\'s theater performance as it helps them see better and sit more comfortably.  Great at restaurants too- cleaner alternative to seating there.  The highchairs are not always clean or sanitary.  Highly recommend this product.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Great for my almost 4 year old grandson, although he insists he\'s a big boy and doesn\'t need it, but he\'s rarely at my house so don\'t get to use it that often.  I think it\'s "bearable" for him because it doesn\'t really look like a toddlers booster chair.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This is the second one I have owned. I love them.  They are great.  They find it comfortable.  The child feels like he/she is part of the family.  It is also very easy to travel with to restaurants or other homes.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: What I like about his chair is that it is one solid piece with no cracks to clean with out with a butter knife. The only reason I say that it is "ok" is that the seat part has a raised texture that makes it difficult to scrub clean. It is heavy enough to not need strapped down to the seat so we can move it around easily, but quickly started to look worn about a month in.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Perfect for a two year old to sit at the table. Coupled with a chair which has arms, you can be sure a toddler can\'t pitch over. It\'s easy to clean, doesn\'t stain and is pretty unobtrusive when it\'s not in use. Compact enough that you could take it with you on vacations if you wanted.  Great product for the money

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: easy to carry and care. make highchairs look clumsy. space saver. goes well with my dinning room theme. not adjustablele.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: easy to clean, non slip material, soft surface for sitting. great product, love the color selection offered -  highly recommended

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Relatively inexpensive, easy to clean, sits well on our kitchen chairs and the grandkids love them (we bought two).  They are sturdy enough to travel if you like and soft enough to be comfortable for little ones.  We have vinyl-covered padded kitchen chairs and they sit quite nicely on them.  The two boys are not perfect little angels and get up and down and up and down at times.  The chairs stay on the seats and take the activity very well.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: My kids love this item. It\'s soft and comfy and very easy to carry around..... Not heavy. The material its made of doesn\'t make it very easy to clean.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: We wanted a booster seat that was both comfortable for our son and easy to clean for us.  That is exactly what we found in the Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat.  With a little effort our son is able to climb up into the seat, which has become a nice bonus for my wife who was struggling having to constantly lift our son up into the seat for meals.The only small issue we have found is that it does tend to slide a little on our chairs.  We haven\'t had any mishaps yet, but we do have to readjust quite frequently, maybe every other use or so.  Our child is pretty active and likes to push off the table when we don\'t happen to be looking.  We do have to remain diligent in watching him in order to prevent any accidental tipping from occurring.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I thought the booster would grip the chair better. I just realized yesterday that the booster I was thinking of us sold through the One Step Ahead catalog. It auctions to the chair it\'s placed on.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I have a 2 1/2 year old of average height (36") and when I put him in this booster he could barely rest his arms on the table.  He definitely wasn\'t boosted tall enough.  It is too bad because I loved the material and softness of this seat.  I am returning it.  Just not tall enough.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I bought this for my 3 yr old son so he can eat at the dinner table. It\'s easy to clean and I bought it with the "Prince Lionheart Seat Neat". Can easily take it to a restaurant instead of using their sticky booster seat.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Easy for 2 year old to get in and out of by himself. Just the height and material we were looking for.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This is a really great product.  I bought it for my 4 year old who is long over the high chair, but still needs a "boost" to be tall enough at the table. It\'s really light weight and she says she is comfortable in it.  Would be nice if it had a strap to attach to the chair because my kids keep taking it off and dragging all over the house but it\'s not that big of a deal.  would highly recommend for an older toddler.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I bought this seat based on the other reviews and I\'m really glad I did.  My two year old is tiny for his age but too "grown up" to stay in a high chair, now that he uses "real" dishes and cutlery I wanted him to be able to join us at the table.  This seat has great cushioning and is easy to keep clean, but your child won\'t slip around in it. It has tiny feet that keep it from moving, which is key for a wiggly toddler, my son climbs up into it by himself sometimes and it doesn\'t move.  My son loved it from the first time I put him in it and is happy to sit in it for meals and also to play or color at the table.  He will sometimes even pull it down to sit in to play on the floor.  I chose the grey color and it\'s quite nice.  Very happy with this purchase.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Purchased for our 3 year old granddaughter and fits her nicely.Well made and stays in place when in use.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: We recently purchased a second one of these when our younger child was ready for a booster. It is the best we have every used. They grip well on most chair surfaces and have fit on any chair we have tried it on. It is lightweight enough that we even sometimes take it to restaurants as it is much more sturdy than those hard plastic wobbly ones. The smooth parts around the edges are easily wiped clean. The bottom of this seat (where the child sits) is slightly textured, which keeps kids from slipping out, but also makes cleaning the part that gets dirtiest a little harder.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This booster seat is just what I wanted.  It works great when my two-year-old granddaughter comes over and it\'s easy to store when she\'s not here.  It has been very safe and secure, doesn\'t move at all when she climbs up or down.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This booster is comfortable and stays in place. Because there are no straps, it\'s seems suitable for kids 2+ and they can easily climb in and out of it safely. I have not had any problems with it tipping or with the material cracking or peeling. My daughter also likes to sit in it when sitting on the floor.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: We love this booster seat!  It\'s so much softer and more comfy than most boosters that are hard plastic.  I really like that it doesn\'t require any straps, yet it is extremely sturdy, well-balanced, and stays in place.  It\'s easy to transfer from one chair to another if necessary and is low-profile enough to fit under any table I\'ve encountered.  I would\'ve given it 5 stars if not for only one complaint.  The actual seat portion is textured instead of smooth.  I think it\'s intended to aid in slippage-prevention, but it is very difficult to clean.  It doesn\'t wipe off well.  Instead, I have to take the seat to the sink and use a scrub brush with soap to get it clean, which is a bit of a hassle. Before moving up to this booster, we had the Prince Lionheart BeBepod, which had all smooth surfaces--very easy to wipe clean.  I wish this booster had all smooth surfaces, too.  The smooth surfaces it DOES have are a breeze to wipe clean.  Other than the textured seat issue, we\'ve really enjoyed it so far and would buy it again.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I was nervous about this working, but it works great with our flat dining bench.  The seat of the booster is a little smaller than the depth of the bench, and our 20 month old sits on it nicely.  She leans back and rests on the back with no tipping.  The foam kind of suctions to the wood without really adhering, if that makes any sense.  We love it.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: It is a good booster. Fits my 2 year olds well. Cleans up nicely. Doesn\'t slide around too much. I do wish it had a strap to attach it to the chair (but none for the child) - I looked for this feature in many seats and couldn\'t find it.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: We got this seat because we have a breakfast nook and I wanted a booster that didn\'t need to be tied to a chair. It\'s a great height, doesn\'t slide, and our 19 month old likes it.  It\'s also very lightweight and easy to clean.  However, our 3.5 YO doesn\'t like it as much as his younger brother because the bumps (my guess is they are there so kids won\'t slip off) bother him. He\'s very sensitive to things like that so it wouldn\'t be an issue for all kids but if your child is the type to be bothered by things like that, then it may be an issue.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: It is just what I was looking for. My daughter needed some height, but not a belt. She is comfortable and squirms a lot less.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: My kids love this booster! It\'s very comfy. I would definitely recommend to others. Great products for kids. Easy to clean.Love it! Cute color. Perfect for the kids. Very portable. Great product. Very safe stays put on the chair doesn\'t slide off. Love it love it love it!

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Hard to keep this item on a dinning room chair.  Especially with a three year old moving around constantly.  Needs to be held down somehow.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Used for transition from a high chair to sitting with the grown-ups.  This seat is thick and easy to use and clean! Very happy I got this instead of some of the other types. My granddaughter is tall for her age and the back is just right for. She appears to like it and uses it willingly.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: The seat does not suction to the chair so it slips off when the child climbs in, but is good quality otherwise.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This is a very easy booster seat to use for every day or to toss in the car when headed to a friend\'s house.  The material is suceptible to deterioration from direct sunlight exposure and food can make some superficial stains on it.  Than being said, every week or two we give it a good scrub with a soft brush and the stains disappear and its just a bit faded from the sun.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This seat is great. It wipes off easily. It\'s very lightweight. It doesn\'t slide around when my kid climbs up into it. The one problem we have is that the back is too short. In my experience, kids will lean back whenever they can. Using this seat means I constantly have to tell my kid to sit up straight, which I really don\'t enjoy repeating 20 times a meal...

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: We like that our son can just jump in and out of it and not worry about straps - because he\'s too big for that now, but I do wish it anchored to the chair in some way to make it a little safer while he\'s climbing in and out of it.  Otherwise - it\'s great!

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This is the second one of these seats that I\'ve purchased. The other was for our second son.  It holds up well. My only "beef" with this booster seat is that the seat is textured so tiny food particles get caught in there.  Not the end of the world, you can clean it, it just looks a bit dirty.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I love how simple this seat it. It\'s the perfect size for my 2 year old. It\'s also lightweight which makes traveling with it easy. My only complaint is that it doesn\'t strap down to the chair. It doesn\'t move a lot while he\'s in it but I\'m fairly certain if he really started wiggling he could make it slide around in the chair. I just make sure he\'s never sitting alone at the table though.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This booster seat is perfect for my toddler grandbaby It\'s washable and the perfect size for the chair. I\'ve used it several times and the durablity is awesome. Love it although in my house it\'s the Princess Lionheart Booster Seat.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Cleans easily, travels easily. It was a great transition from high-chair to big table. My son calls it his big-boy chair.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: In terms of boosting my daughter up to the proper level for eating, this booster is great.  It stays on the chair without sliding, and seems comfortable for her to sit in.  However, prior to using this booster my 2.9-year-old daughter could get up on and off of her chair completely independently, and she can no longer do that with the booster.  It doesn\'t leave enough chair surface for her to step onto and get down from, and makes the surface too tall for her to just slide down off of.  She usually tries to stand up and get down herself, but often ends up flipping the booster sideways, and has fallen a few times.  I don\'t know a way that a booster could be designed to eliminate this problem so I don\'t fault the booster itself, but it is a bummer that we have to help her on and off her chair when we didn\'t before.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: My daughter was tired of her \'baby\' booster with the buckles. This booster works perfectly for my 3 year old, doesn\'t slip around in the chair (wood), fits perfectly, color options are great, super comfy and perfect size for her to reach the table.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Just what I expected. Now my grand daughter can sit at the table without sliding all over the chair seat.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: We were having issues with our child no longer wanting to go in the high chair and this booster chair was the perfect solution. Light weight, easy to clean and the right height for our table.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This does it\'s job.  I have to scrub the seat with a Magic Eraser because a normal wash cloth sometimes will not remove the food.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Our two year old is too big for the Booster w/tray style Graco seat that we\'ve been using since graduating from a highchair and just a bit too small for the chair on it\'s own. This booster is exactly what we needed to bridge that gap. It makes eating a lot more comfortable, a whole lot tidier and most of all safer.The seat raises her up adequately, is soft but firm and has sufficient grip so as not to slide around on the chair. Other reviews have rated the seat negatively for the inability to be stacked on objects such as books to make them taller. If this is a concern to you, do not purchase this seat. Purchase a seat that is made for smaller children, or with adjustable height as stacking any items under a booster seat is not much of an idea for those concerned with the safety of their children.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: perfect for what we needed.  we have a leather bench seat that nothing could stick or tie to.  this sits fantastically and my toddler loves it.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I already have a soft booster seat for one grandchild and needed another for second child.  It is very soft and stays on the chair well.  Doesn\'t slide off when she is trying to get up and down.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I was looking to get a "big kid" booster for our 2yr old and this one seemed perfect. The price is great and the product is well made. She loves having a big kid booster without straps. Perfect transition for her.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: super easy to clean!  super comfortable,  portable,  what more can I ask for? (maybe to be a bit less expensive, but it is worth it anyway)

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in GreenThe seat sits on the chair securely.  The height is good for the child to reach his food easily.  It washes easily with soap and water.He liked the color.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: Exactly as the description says as well as the other reviews. Extremely happy with my purchase and will order another for my next child. The green color is good since I know other products had problems with their colors and it is exactly like the picture. Soft, light and my daughter uses it as a play seat and fits perfectly at the table. Nice and small with just the right height.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: This has to be the most stable boosterseat for kids. It is cushiony, sturdy and stays safely on the chair. Compared to other hard plastic, it is the best.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I love that I can throw this unit under the table when we\'re not using it, it is soft enough not to mar my wood chairs, and is comfortable for my toddler grandsons.  It\'s exactly what I was looking for.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: It is easy to clean..big plus. It\'s relatively stable..but it\'s not literally stuck to the seat so it can move around when the kid tries to climb onto the chair that houses this.  Perfect height for a toddler. I recommend it.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I bought this for my 2-year-old and it works perfect!  He can color the dinner table while we finish our dinner.I had a friend visiting with a 5-year-old and it was perfect height for her to eat with us at dinner table.The only thing I wish they had was some sort of buckle or rope to tie on the back of chair.  Our chair has cushion fabric which the silicon static at the bottom wouldn\'t work as it would on a wooden/plastic surface.  But this product is heavy enough that my kid can sit on without shifting around.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: I purchased green one last time for my 3 years old daughter.She loves it much and she said it is very comfortable.I ordered yellow for my friend\' baby and will order more for others as a Christmas gift.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: After a couple months of daily use I do like this booster but wish it wiped clean easier. I still think that the price was reasonable and the color is cheerful. I also like that it is lightweight making it easy to move from the main dining table out to the patio and back depending on the weather. Our daughter enjoys carrying it all by herself. So far it has been sturdy and no complaints about her comfort when sitting on it. However the trade off is that it takes a bit more to clean than I had initially assumed. A quick wipe with a damp paper towel was what I had in mind but that really does not get the job done. The spongy material always seems to cling to at least a few crumbs and the texture in seat, while good for preventing her from slipping out, also holds on to spill residue. That quick wipe with a paper towel is ok if the meal was not too messy or I am in a rush but after a messy meal I know I will need to give it a scrub with soap and water in the kitchen sink. I admit this could be a matter of my choice of cleaning solutions. I am reluctant to spray it with anything too harsh as I don\'t like to use them around the kids too much and am also not sure how that spongy material would hold up to stronger stuff.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: The seats fit on our kitchen chairs and stay in place.  They met our all our expectations except they are hard to clean.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: We purchased this for my son who was 2 at the time and it worked great. After having this for close to a year I would recommend this to anyone but with the warning that if anything spills on it CLEAN IMMEDIATELY. My son was going through that phase of not really needing it anymore and using it only every so often and we kind of neglected it. Some things can stain it. But it has held up structurally and my kid never complained about it.

name: Prince Lionheart Soft Booster Seat in Green
review: The Prince Lionheart soft booster seat is a good buy for the price. I was concerned about my son trying to climb out (or falling out) because of the lack of straps, but that has not been an issue; he seems pretty secure in it. Although the color isn\'t my first choice, the fact that it\'s easy to clean, lightweight, and made in Canada make up for that.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Armoire Chest, Cherry
review: I ordered this three times and each time the same piece was broken. The first two times I ordered it through walmart.com because it\'s cheaper, but they wouldn\'t replace the part. The third time I ordered it through babyage.com and was able to replace the part, but I\'m still waiting on it. This is a beautiful armoire and matches my nursery set, but it\'s a major pain. I originally ordered it in July and to re-order and send it back three times has taken 5 months. My son is now 3 months old without an armoire or any kind of dresser.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Armoire Chest, Cherry
review: AFTER READING ALL THE HORROR STORIES, WE WERE LEARY TO PURCHASE BUT DECIDED TO WELL IN ADVANCE OF OUR CHILD\'S BIRTH.  WE RECIEVED THE ARMOIRE WITHIN 2 WEEKS OF PLACING THE ORDER. IT WAS EASY TO PUT TOGETHER (LESS THAN 1.5HRS). THERE WERE SOME SCREWS MISSING FOR THE DOORS, BUT I CALLED STORCRAFT THE NEXT DAY, AND WAS IMMEDIATELY PUT THROUGH WITH NO BUSY SIGNALS.  THEY SENT OUT THE SCREWS AND I HAD THEM WITHIN 10 WORKING DAYS (THEY COME FROM CANADA).  IT IS BEAUTIFUL WITH NOT ONE NICK OR DING IN IT. WE\'D RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT TO ANYONE AS PART OF THEIR CHILDS NURSERY.  FYI - IT WAS NOT CHEAPER AT WALMART ONCE TAX AND SHIPPING WERE INCLUDED.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Armoire Chest, Cherry
review: What frustrates me about the comments I have seen here about this particular brand/items by storkcraft is a little harsh.  The same comment on this item is posted on every item.  I can understand if the matter was involving safety but when its simply because you had bad service doesn\'t mean it will be like that for me...and while i do respect the opion to an extent I feel like that the company is being dragged trough the mud for no reason.  Who knows it might happen to me but I am empressed with the quality and overall appearance and think that I shall decide for myself how well I like it.  At least you can return it if there is a problem...and nothing should be too much of a hassle when it involves your child.  Wish me luck...

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Armoire Chest, Cherry
review: I got this armoire for significantly less on ebay, it was easy to put together (I did it by myself in an hour or so at 6 months pregnant) and none of the pieces were damaged. However I\'m not sure what Storkcraft considers "hard wood", the armoire scratched very easily (you could scratch the wood with your fingernail) when I put it together. Otherwise it is a very nice piece of furniture, I would not have thought it worth the $300-$400 price range some websites have it listed at because the wood is so soft (it seems to be pine). I did end up taking out one of the shelves and installing a clothes rod, and adding a few hooks inside the doors for extra storage.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Armoire Chest, Cherry
review: My husband and I are very happy with this armoire!  We have a small apartment with little storage space and this armoir is the perfect size providing loads of extra storage.  I read other reviews so I knew it didn\'t have a hanging bar, but I knew I wasn\'t going to be hanging clothes.  One thing I didn\'t expect was that it was white inside, but it makes it easier to see.  We had it put together within an hour, instructions were easy to follow.  A solid piece of furniture well worth $240.Jessica,NY

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Armoire Chest, Cherry
review: I was very disappointed in the product.  The picture does not accurately represent the armoire.  The entire back is just cardboard paneling and the inside of the armoire is white plywood, not cherry wood at all.  The pictures should show the inside view of the cabinet, in addition to the outside.  Also, pieces did come chipped, cracked and one piece was also split into two!!! I returned the item and wish I hadn\'t ordered in the first place.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Armoire Chest, Cherry
review: This was returnes shortly after we received it.  Very disappointed in the quality.  Would not have held up very good

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Hutch, Natural
review: Looks good all together.  Twist cams in the unit that hold sides together are have the hole in the wood a bit to large and the wood will distort/spliter slightly

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: I purchased this bedrail last week and everything looked good until last night. My daughter sat up in bad and then fell backwards onto the edge of her pillow. She cracked her head on the SQUARE corner of this bedrail. Why would you put a SQUARE, METAL tube near a toddler\'s head. I quickly returned this product for the Safety First bedrail that folds down.

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: I use this bed rail for my 6 month old who sleeps with me.  It\'s great.  It\'s quiet enough that it doesn\'t wake her when I put it up or down and she is not big enough to push it and get stuck between the rail and the bed.  This may be a problem shen she is bigger.  I definately feel safe leaving her in bed while I do other things.  The only complaint I have about this product is that it is so tall that it does not lay flat when it is down.  It hits the floor and is at an angle from the bed.  I have learned to work around that and it wouldn\'t be as safe if it weren\'t as tall as it is.  My bed is also old and not as thick as the beds they are making now so this is probably a factor.It is also very easy to make the bed when the rail is down and it isn\'t on top of the covers when it is up.  The other rails that I have seen look like they have to be on top of the covers when they are up.  This is a great product with many more advantages than the other bed rails that I have seen.

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: The dex bed rail has really worked out well for us. I found the instructions easy to follow and it took about 10 minutes to assemble. More importantly this bed rail fits on a king size bed, giving us more options on where we can use it. I used to worry that my baby would fall off the bed without the rail. The bed rail has alleviated that concern. When we vacation, we take it with us. It\'s small enough to take with us in the car. I like that we have the option of leaving the side down when the bed rail is not in use. The best thing is that it pretty much does the job that is advertised by the packaging. It\'s pretty simple, yet effective!

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: I purchased this bedrail (well, the white one at Wal-Mart) after reading some of the reviews.  I am using on my daughter\'s toddler bed, and can\'t seem to find any safety issues with that, except that there is not a 9 inch gap from the headboard.I pushed the rail all the way towards the headboard so there would be a good space for her to crawl into her bed at the bottom.Some of the reviewers stated that they don\'t like this system because it has to be used with a mattress and box spring, and the metal bar is square.  You do not have to use a mattress and box spring, just leave those straps and round piece off (it states in instructions that it is optional).And you do not put the metal stabilizer bar in the pocket if your mattress is under 10" high.  If your mattress is high enough, this bar will be BELOW the mattress height, thus eliminating the worry over your child hitting his/her head.I am very pleased with this bed rail, and will sleep much better knowing my 20 month old toddler won\'t be falling onto the floor any more!

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: I bought 2 of these rails (in white) and the instructions do say to be used with a matress & boxspring. I had to use commonsense to install it since the instructions are of no real help. We have a twin size bed with a high matress for our 2 yrs. The square bar is just below the top of the matress so that it does not touch her when she\'s sleeping. She\'s been taking her naps in her bed and no roll overs or falling out. So far so good. The only con is the instructions. It does not say how to fold it down. I got it by looking at the image. When you have the lower bar set to unlock,each of the hidged bars have arrows on it. Pull them up at the same time and voila! it folds down! Sorry if my comment is long but I want to give out as much info for those who are thinking about buying it, especially those that cannot figure out how to fold it down.

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: This bedrail is a definate "must have" for todays growing mattresses!!  We have searched and searched for a bedrail tall enough to not only reach the top of the mattress, but extend above it enough to hold our son in.  This is the only one we\'ve ever found that is safe, strong, and tall enough to do that.  Not only is it functional, it\'s extremely compact and easy to operate.  We highly recommend this product to anyone who has recently purchaced a new mattress.

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: This is not really a review but a question to those that have purchased this.  Someone mentioned that the maker of this is Dex Products.  And that you can find it in Walmart under "Parents Choice".  I couldnt find it.  But I did find the "Safe Sleeper Bed Rail" which is by Dex products.  Is this the same product everyone is talking about that is rated great?  I just want to be sure I am purchasing the same one that got the good ratings. I went to [...] and the only bed rail they have on their website was the "safe sleeper".  Please advise if anyone could.  Thanks.

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: This installed very easily and is very secure, even when my son rolls into it or climbs up it, it doesn\'t come loose.  It is also a good height and length, centered along the side of his twin bed, it stops him from accidently rolling off at night, but allows about a foot space on either side where he can easily climb down from the bed once awake.

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
