review: This is the best bedrail that I found for the money.  It is simple to set up and folds easily for compact storage.  I was not disappointed.

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: Since my son was falling out of his toddler bed after we removed the side rail of his crib (due to the fact that he could climb over the rail), I searched for a side rail that was short enough to use on this abbreviated bed. This one seemed like it would work, and several reviewers mentioned that they were using it on a toddler bed. However, when the package came in the mail, I noticed immediately that the text on the box had very clear warnings against using this rail on a toddler bed. First of all, it has to be used between a mattress and a box spring, which most toddler beds do not have. Secondly, there is supposed to be an 8 inch gap between the headboard/footboard of the bed and the end of the rail. I think that it would be risky to use this on a toddler bed, and when it comes to my child, I do not take risks like this. I returned the rail.

name: 36 x 20 Bedrail
review: We got this for our son\'s bed and it has worked out great! He is 2 1/2 and has the bottom bunk bed. The rail fits great between the matress and the bunk-board. I am thinking of getting another for our twin bed!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 3 Drawer Chest, White
review: When assembling this product, I ran into 3 problems.1st-the draw rails, that were previously attached to the side panels were not flush.  With this being said, the drawers would not go in the dresser completely.  I was able to get a drawer completely in, but when I went to pull the drawer out, it was completely stuck.  I had to take the drawer rail (with the rollers) off, in order to get the drawer out.2nd-knobs do not get tight when assembled, so they will constantly spin.3rd-when pulling the knobs to slide the drawer out, the knobs come off their screws.For the price, you would think it would be higher quality.  Find something else to buy.  Don\'t waste your time.  I am returning mine.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 3 Drawer Chest, White
review: We bought this dresser to match our Storkcraft Portofino Crib, which we like very much.  However, the dresser seems very cheap.  I\'ve had to move it a few times as we put our baby\'s room together and it\'s not very sturdy.  If you pull on the drawers too hard (not yank, but just to open them) they will come all the way out, which concerns me for when our baby becomes a toddler.  The wood scratches very easily.  I have no complaints about the color.  We bought the Portofino crib because it turns into a toddler bed and then a full size bed, but I do not think this matching dresser will last that long as our baby grows and it will need to be replaced.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 3 Drawer Chest, White
review: The dresser was cheap and flimsy. The side drawer boards split while screwing in the railings. I tried repeatedly calling the manufacturer to get the issue resolved and the no one ever answered the phone. I tried emailing them with the issue to get new pieces sent. I was told to send pictures and details of the issues. All of this was done promptly and repeatedly and each time my email would come back undelivered. There is on way to get in touch with the manufacturer and we now have a broken worthless dresser.Do not order anything from Stork craft!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I hesitantly purchased this item because my husband and I have a hard time agreeing and we both liked this style.  Ultimately it looks wonderful, but it took us 3 hours to put together.  The instructions are in pictures which are suprisingly harder to understand than words!The pieces don\'t fit together perfectly, but I\'m satisfied with the result.  If i had to do it again, I would probably spend the extra money and get a higher quality table in hopes that it would go together easier.***UPDATE ***10 months later. . . It\'s still held up remarkably well!  I really do like this item.  I\'ve forgotten how difficult it was to put together, now it is just a very nice piece in my son\'s room that\'s the perfect height for me as well as my husband.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: None of the many, many parts are labeled, which makes the assembling process a good bit longer since you have to spend the time figuring out which piece is which. It arrived slightly banged up, some of the parts showed how flimsy they are, but fortunately they are not the ones that you usually see. Be careful when putting the screws to hold the backing on, they tend to not go straight and you can end up poking holes in your furniture. Once assembled, it does seem sturdy enough and looks nice. We noticed that it does scratch a little too easy, so be careful.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I bought my crib and tower/hutch oak combo in February of 2006.  I didn\'t open the boxes until March, because the nursery was not finished.  When the boxes were opened, we found that the crib had many dents and scratches.  The crib was well packed, so I do not believe it was from being shipped.  The tower/hutch was very damaged, again packed very well in the boxes with no damage to the boxes, and I needed to have parts replaced.  I didn\'t receive my replacement parts until 2 MONTHS LATER!  I called their customer service line multiple times asking when my replacement parts will arrive.  I was told it would take 2-3 weeks, then they were on back order and it would take another 2 weeks, I called to get a tracking number which I was never called back for, then it would arrive on a Friday (which it didn\'t), and so on.  I finally got what I needed after having to contact a manager at Storkcraft.  They sent what I needed the VERY NEXT DAY, by next-day shipping!  I believe I have been very patient with this company and I don\'t feel that you should have to contact a manager to get what you need.  The quality isn\'t what I expected either.  If you decide to buy from Storkcraft, make sure you open the boxes immediately, have enough time for replacement parts, and be VERY persistent with their customer service.  I will never buy a Storkcraft item again, because of this experience.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: To start, the dresser looks amazing.  Great quality for the price, fairly easy to assemble.  A little time consuming, but most furniture is.The only problem we had was that the knobs were missing from our shipment.  I contacted Amazon\'s customer service and was told they could not replace the knobs, but I either had a choice of returning the dresser and they would ship me a new one or they would give me a $20 credit.  Since we had the dresser completely assembled, I didn\'t want to send it back and graciously accepted the credit thinking I could just buy some knobs.  Before I did though, I checked with Stork Craft and let them know about the missing knobs and they are shipping them out to us for free!  Amazing customer service from Amazon and Stork Craft.  Normally I would be frustrated at having to wait and them being missing in the first place, but I am so happy with how it was handled I can\'t even complain.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: This piece was beautiful ad very well made. Heavy!!!! Only bad thing is it has a strange strong smell...like a wood stain.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I bought this piece from Stork Craft while awaiting my newborn baby.  The first one they shipped was the wrong style and color.  So I had to wait two more weeks to get this product that when we put it together cracked and split at almost every screw hole.  The funny thing is, is that we have the matching crib that is built beautifully and sturdy.  This Changing table/dresser is not.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: After reading so many negative reviews on this dresser, I was a bit skeptical about getting it. I am SO glad I did! First off, the shipping for this was SUPER cheap (I live in Alaska and the shipping was only $22 for UPS 2 day). Stork Craft did a great job packaging everything. Nothing was broken, every piece had it\'s own wrapping, and none of the hardware was missing. The wood for the insides of the drawers and the parts that are not seen are made of thick particle board, but the outsides are all a nice stained wood. There is LOTS of room in this thing to store baby gear and can be used as a dresser for when the baby gets older. Also, the lower portion of the dresser is the perfect place to put a changing pad. One down side to this dresser is that it takes a while to put together. There are quite a few parts, but the instructions are very clear and easy to read (much easier than putting the crib together). All and all, I am very happy I purchased this for my kiddo\'s room. It looks nice and is of exceptional quality. As long as you take care of this, it will last a long time!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Well, we finally finished assembling this thing. Let\'s just say you\'ve got your work cut out for you.Pros: this thing was a steal at $152.27 with the furniture on sale beyond the already low MSRP. That made it too tempting to pass up. The look is very clean and it\'ll impress visitors who think you bought the thing for a $800+ price tag. It is functional in that it has 3 drawers, a large vertical cabinet, and two tidy and sturdy counters all made of solid wood.Cons: The structural pieces that actually bear all the weight are flimsy plywood. Doors and counters aside, essentially all the pieces that you "don\'t touch," is "budget construction." Also, the amount of assembly required is almost comical. When you take out all the pieces and try matching it to the instruction manual, you realize that you have your work cut out with over 100 screws and every piece needing multiple-component assembly. In fact, it\'s as if the manufacturer fabricated and painted the pieces. You have to do ALL of the labor. All in all, I would estimate that if you are a professional furniture assembler, it would take you the better part of 6 hours non-stop. If you are either a handy or pretty sharp, adroit person, it\'ll take you somewhere between 8-12 hours of non-stop work. If you have no experience with assembling and are generally clumsy, you\'re screwed (pun intended) and this is definitely not the right purchase. You will be knocking your head against the wall in complete frustration for multiple days or the better part of a week. There are simply that many parts that require assembly, so patience, short breaks, perspiration, and a penchant for hand callouses are in order if you want to take this thing on.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: First of all, this looks much nicer in a photo, but that\'s not a big deal.Pros:Price - This is less expensive that most other dresser/changing table combos that I found out there.Hutch - Nice addition to have!  Not too many dresser/changing table combos have a hutch that can be attached.  The only issue with the hutch is that I don\'t see an especially secure way to attach it to the changing table combo.  Looks like it only attaches in one spot on the side...Cons:Soft surface - I read a review of someone who said that you can make a dent in the furniture with your finger nail.  It\'s 100% true!Overall quality - the screws continue to turn even when they\'re in all the way.  Not sure how many years this will last.Knobs - don\'t tighten at all.  We will probably get our own knobs that actually screw on tightly!If I had to do it all over again, I\'d still buy it.  I just don\'t see spending 3 times as much for a changing table combo.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: My husband and I received this changing table, along with the 4-drawer chest and the Monterey crib, as a gift from our parents. We were skeptical, because we wanted a nursery that was affordable, yet not too flimsy.  We were pleasantly surprised once the pieces were put together. The pieces coordinate beautifully with the nursery, and will take our soon-to-be-born infant into childhood. And the nicest part is that you don\'t have to spend thousands of dollars to have a nice nursery. My friends and family are constantly complimenting us on how great the pieces look and how sturdy they are. * The only reason I rated this 4-stars instead of 5 was because two of the drawers rubbed together slightly once assembled. It was very easily fixed by adjusting the drawer tracks, took 5 minutes. BOTTOM LINE: If you are looking for a beautiful, quality nursery that is affordable, this is a great choice.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I received this product (Beatrice Tower) sooner than I ever thought and I was pleased with that part.  When assembling the product, it was easily assembled until we got to assembling the drawers and realized that the sides of the drawers were all for the left side and none for the right side!  I called the manufacturer\'s number that was on the instruction sheet and they have agreed to send the correct sides for the drawer assembly.  Hopefully, I will get them soon so my new granddaughter will be able to have this beautiful piece of furniture in her room.  The wood had a few dings and knicks on it, but like others before me have written, I plan on using a black magic marker for that part.  Otherwise, I am sure we will enjoy this product and it will be a great addition to my granddaughter\'s room whenever I finally get the correct parts!  The price was very acceptable, so I hate to complain too much!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Received the chest in 12 days, just as promised. We took everything apart and checked each piece to note any damage. Out of all the pieces there is one minor scratch that will not be noticed unless you take a magnifying glass to the piece. Overall very pleased with the quality. There is alot of solid wood along with the manufactured stuff. Not much diffrent than the same dressers you will find at Babies R Us. Unless you go to the very high end solid wood furniture that would cost well over 3 times this price it is a very good value. Checked all the nuts and bolts. Everything is there. If you want a decent looking nursery piece that will function for you after baby is older you would be hard pressed to find something less expensive with better quality. We received the matching hutch which was in good condition also. As far as the size of the changing pad, Target has one that is 30" long. It seems to fit this chest.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: The color is just what I wanted however, the changing table part is quite small. The changing pad hangs over about an inch. The drawers are anything but smooth and were a headache to put together, they keep getting stuck. The drawers are also very small. The instructions were a bit confusing and some of the pictures were incorrect. I am just crossing my fingers that this piece of furniture will last at least a year. The smell is quite bad, thankfully the baby has not arrived yet and we can ventilate her room.  If it had not been such a pain to assemble it would be going back.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: This dresser is exactly the look I wanted at the price I could afford, so I took a chance & ordered it despite mixed reviews online- though I am not unhappy with it- it is along the "get what you pay for lines"- I would not say it "exceeded" any expectations- but it\'s what I expected for $200 and I\'m satisfied overall. It was packaged well & we had no problems with its condition upon arrival as others have mentioned- it also arrived within about a week. If you have a bigger budget, I would suggest going for a better brand in hopes of a little better quality piece of furniture, if you are like us though and you simply can\'t spend more- this dresser will serve the purpose and it does LOOK very nice- it def. appears more expensive than it is. My husband put it together pretty easily with only minor "glitches" visible to us once it was done- the door on the front hangs just slightly crooked/doesn\'t latch perfectly because the pre-drilled holes for the hardware are slightly off & there are also some small (inconsistent) spaces in between the drawers that also probably shouldn\'t show... while these things are noticeable to us- it\'s highly unlikely anyone else would notice them unless they really inspected it. The drawers slide smoothly in & out and to me, there\'s plenty of space in them, which is a plus compared to some reviews I read prior to purchasing. Parts of the piece are particle board and you do feel like you have to be extra careful with certain parts during assembly- once all together though it does look & feel sturdy... All in all- it\'s not a 5 star product but I think we will get $200 worth of use out of it at the very least.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Of course it is as much fiberboard as they can use. The front of everything that  you see is nice quality and looks great.There was one piece, drawer side left, that was broken. It was easy to call them up and tell them. They are shipping it at no cost. The dresser other than the drawer took me, a 6 month pregnant mommy, 4 hours to put together. The back panels you are supposed to screw into the frame did not line up completely. Screwing into fiberboard or chipboard, whichever it is called made it just split apart and now there are 3 places on the inside of the drawer tower that i have to hot glue back together. They should have came up with a better way to do this. Keep in mind that with any product nowadays unless super high end, is going to have these unfavorable materials.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: We ordered this product, that matching hutch, and crib. The crib was fine. This piece had scratches and dings as soon as we took it out of the box. Looked like someone else had sent it back and they tried to cover up the scratches and sent it right back out to the next customer. Where they had tried to fix it the color of the stain just flaked right off and looked horrible !! There was a phone number on the box that said no not return product to store for damaged parts just call us and we will ship just what you need. The phone number did not work and was impossible to reach the company (located in Canada). So now we have to pay to ship the entire thing back to amazon wait for a refund and hope for better luck with the next one we order so it will match our crib. Still waiting on the hutch to ship was supposed to be here a week ago and item is not even on backorder ! Goodluck for you guys and hopefully I will get everything squared away before the baby gets here ! Next time I will def. just find something at a local store.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: This is a very cheap piece of furniture.  The finish is super thin and easy to mark up, it came with a few marks I was not able to fix and I will probably have to repaint the whole thing in a year or two.  The drawers are flimsy and I had a hard time getting the door to fit on properly.The item was easy to assemble although it did take about 3 hours.  You will need to pre-drill holes to attach the back, or switch to small nails instead of the screws provided.I would not recommend this item if you want something sturdy for a kid\'s room.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Didnt have any of the problems of the other reviewers, one small easily touched up knick in a side, but other than that, all parts accounted for and in good condition. Although, we\'re looking at a move and I am concerned about how soft the wood is, it will need to be protected more than normal to make the move in as good condition. Would have preferred a wardrobe and shelf on the shelving side, but overall, think we\'re going to be very happy with this piece

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Although this chest is beautiful, it took quite some time to put together and there were scratches in various places. Many of these scratches are visible from the front of the unit. I am quite satisfied with the space available in the chest, but very disappointed in how scratched it is.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I bought this piece hoping it would work with the crib that we bought that didn\'t have a dresser with it.  I was so happy to see that the finishes were perfect together and it looks beautiful.  I was nervous from reading some of the reviews that it would come damaged and not in good shape.  When my husband and I opened the box everything was there and nothing was damaged.  It took us about and hour and half to put it together and was very easy to following the directions.  I LOVE IT and would recommend this item to everyone.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I decided to go with a cheaper piece of furniture as this had some decent ratings at the time. We only used it for about 6 months and the back legs have broken off (cheap particle board). When putting it together, you can tell that it is not a sturdy piece of furniture. Very disapointed. I know it is cheap in comparison to a lot of furniture but we had hoped to get a little more use out of it.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Horrible customer service! The stork craft company does NOT stand behind their products.  I bought a whole set from this company through amazon and each piece arrived damaged (not shipping and handling issues it is how it is packaged).  Stork craft has a parts department that you submit issues online and then they respond with emails needing pictures and original purchase receipt submitted, understandable!  I originally started each of my "claims" on August 2nd, it is September 17th and I am still trying to get the issues worked out and parts sent.  Just to explain, some issues were that parts were simply not included, dents/scratches upon even removing from packaging, and also discoloration (the hutch doesn\'t match the dresser, the overcoat is spotted).  They also said that the mis-matched color is due to the products being made in different countries, using different wood and stains. The material is also made out of pressed wood so upon assembly, many of the pieces cracked.  As I said, it has been a month and a half since the claims were started and there have been over 100 emails regarding the claims.  I have tried to call the company directly as there is also a number and it is constantly busy, the first time I got through the lady said they were processing the order, the second time I got through I was put on hold for 20 minutes and then hung up on.  Who knows if I will ever receive the necessary parts!I called amazon on this issue and I was told to pack everything up and send it back for a refund or replacement.  HONESTLY!?  First of all, there is no way I am able to pack all the parts back into the small boxes that they came in.  Secondly, I put how much time into this and that is what you are going to tell me?  So then they offer me a measly discount, which let me tell you I had to argue for even the smallest amount and the products are STILL not worth how much I ended up paying.Needless to say, I will continue to wait to get my parts needed but I hope no one else has to deal with this.  Plainly Stork Craft only communicates via email and nothing can be handled that way and Amazon also has issues with customer service and pulling things from the market of poor quality.  We should not be supporting these companies like Stork Craft!!  Yes I am one pissed off mommy!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Not sure how its going to look in a few years when we don\'t need it for a changing table anymore, but we love it now. It has plenty of storage space and the drawers open easily. It does not come preassembled so you may have a disaster in your room till you get it all put together. Over all it was easy to assemble and looks nice in the end. Read directions CAREFULLY! Took my husband about an hour to put together.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Product was delievered in perfect condition with all pieces.  The only issue we had was the door on the tower didn\'t seem to align well at first but now it opens and closes easily after using it several times. It looks beautiful. Great price! I would recommend to a friend.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: The dresser took about a week to receive, and I was worried about the pieces since it was a heavy package and looked like it got a little beat up in the process. When we opened the box, it was well packed and everything was in tact :) it took a while to put together but the instructions are easy to follow, (it was just a lot to assemble.) it went together pretty easy without complications.  It looks great, and is perfect for baby clothes/ things. (I\'m not sure how sturdy the drawers will be with heavier clothes, they do seem a little flimsy on the bottom, but we will see) Overall we are very pleased with the dresser/ tower.*my only complaint is that the shelves in the tower are not adjustable.  (unless you drill your own holes into the sides)

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Although I received this item quickly, was able to put it together without much difficulty and was able to order an extra screw without charge, the overall product quality was inferior to what I expected.  The wood on the highest level top shelf is scratchable with the fingernail and most of the parts are not solid wood.  I guess for the price it\'s a fair deal, though.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I bought the tower despite the bad reviews and so far I think I made a great decision.  I didn\'t buy it at Babies R Us, but chose another vendor instead that offered free shipping and ended up costing a bit less.  I ordered the tower on 10/28/05 and it arrived 11/23/05, which wasn\'t a problem since I knew that Stork craft products tend to take awhile to ship, so I ordered early.  The box came in perfect condition and when we took it apart all the pieces where undamaged, in great condition and there was nothing missing.It took my mom and I (I am 5 months pregnant) an hour to put it together, the directions where easy to follow and the assembly was a piece of cake.  The only difficulty is to screw on the back panel.  There were a million screws, so have your electric screwdriver handy.  Also be careful with those screws the tolerances are very close and the wood is soft so is you don\'t screw them in just right you may end up with screws sticking out.  We simply redid them and now there are a few chips in the back of the tower, nothing to worry about.Upside* Looks absolutely amazing.  The wood is beautiful and shiny, the design is elegant and looks great in the room* The drawers are deep and allow for lots of storage.  Easy to take out and are finished with white on the inside for a very clean and appealing look.* The side cabinet is great.  Shelves can easily come out to allow for larger items to be stored.  Might be a good place for a diaper genie...* Very sturdy and heavy, and as a bonus comes with a wall attachment so that you don\'t have to worry about it tipping when the little one starts walking.* The top of the tower can be used as a changing table, or you can buy a hatch that can be easily attached for additional storage.* Very easy to assemble, everything is predrilled and the directions are super easy.Downside* The wood is very soft, so you have to be careful during assembly not to chip or damage the pieces.* While most of the tower is very sturdy the back panel is made out of flimsy material and the screws are a pain to use.  In hint sight we should have nailed the back panel.Overall absolutely great product.  Functional and looks really beautiful.  I suggest ordering elsewhere and ordering early, in case there are problems.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: The materials are of good quality, the instructions to put it together are not the best.  I am very handy and this one annoyed me.  Also, the way they have you assemble it means that it is not very square when you\'re finished.  Ours had to be shimmed with cardboard on our wood floors.Not an issue with carpeted rooms, but still, it should be designed to square itself some as it is put together.  That was not even addressed in the instructions.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I love this dresser, good size, nice color and good quality.just the assembly might be a little hard for somebody who is not handy enough. but it has a complete instruction

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: Overall we are very please with this dresser.  It matches the crib we bought almost perfectly in color.  The area to place the changing pad seems a little smaller than what I expected but we\'ll see how it fits once I get the changing pad for it.  The assembly for it was a bit ridiculous and took my husband many many hours to put it together.  Way too many small pieces and the directions are nothing but picture diagrams to follow making it confusing at certain points.  Overall, it\'s a very nice dresser for the price and I\'m happy with the purchase.  :)

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: We purchased this, assembled it, and within months hardware started popping off. Within a year, the drawers started falling apart. We ordered it hoping to shift it from a changing table to a dresser when our son got older, but it has not even lasted for a changing table. We are looking for a replacement and this one will be going in the trash, as it is not even repairable. We are so frustrated and disappointed, as we thought we were buying something of decent quality, and it has just been a hassle.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: This is a sturdy, beautiful, functional piece.  We purchased this combo, the hutch, 5 drawer dresser and Rochester crib.  I put this together myself in about 45 minutes and I am 6 months pregnant.  I have not assembled the hutch yet, since the nursery is not yet complete, but I can\'t wait to see it together!  I am very pleased with my purchase.  It looks exactly as shown, although the oak was a little darker than I expected.I\'ll post my review on the crib when I get it together!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: My husband and I spent 4 hours putting this piece together.  Once it was finished it was beautiful, sturdy, and will work great as a dresser/changing table.  Be aware...there are a hundred different pieces and none of them are marked or labeled.  Give yourself plenty of time and patience to put this piece together.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: We originally purchased this combo chest and the matching hutch for my first child back in 2007.  It has held up extremely well over the past 6 years and matched our crib perfectly in finish.  We even found a bunk bed for her now that matches the finish (we have the Oak color).  I have had no problems at all with the dresser - the drawers still function perfectly, and while it shows minor dents and scratches after 6 years of daily use it\'s nothing I wouldn\'t expect from any wooden piece of furniture.We are expecting baby #2 any day now and since we are re-using our old crib and I liked this dresser so much, we ordered a second one, along with the hutch.  It was shipped promptly from Amazon Prime and they called to set up a delivery time with us.  The boxes arrived intact with no damage, the dresser was well-packaged and padded inside the boxes, and only one of the pieces of the hutch part we ordered at the same time had a small scratch, but not in a visible area.  (our first set of these also arrived with no issues as far as damage).It took us a few hours to put it together.  It\'s not complicated to put together, though the cardboard backings that go on the hutch and chest are the worst - they are nearly impossible to line up correctly, but I find that with ALL consumer-assembled furniture that comes with those types of thin backboard pieces - they never line up right!  It is not something that is unique to this piece of furniture.My only other complaint is the drawer glides on the new chest we just purchased.  They do not go all the way to the backs of the drawers, thus the drawers do not open completely.  It renders the back 4-5" of each drawer nearly useless, as you can\'t get anything out of the back of the drawer unless you also take out what is in front of it.  Our original chest purchased in 2007 had drawer glides that went the full length of the drawers so you can open them all the way (and we\'ve had NO issues with that - I\'ve never had a drawer fall off or anything, it still all works as perfectly as it did on day one!).  I\'m sure I can get replacement drawer glides for the new one somewhere, I just have to get them measured and look into it, but it\'s frustrating to not be able to use the back portion of the drawers easily.As some of the other reviews mentioned, the hutch doesn\'t really firmly attach to the dresser - it\'s only attached on the back via a couple of screws through those thin backboards, however that could be easily remedied with a couple of small brackets if you were really concerned about it.  We never did anything extra to our first daughters, it\'s just attached to the wall with the anti-tip bracket provided with the chest.  The weight of books and things on it, the few attachments it does have, and the anti-tip bracket have kept it firmly in place in my oldest\'s room for 6 years.  It\'s never budged even a slight bit.Aside from that issue on the newer models, it\'s an amazing chest/hutch set IMO.  I never expected my first daughter\'s furniture to hold up so well for as little as we paid for it.  I\'m very pleased and highly recommend the set to anyone who doesn\'t have a lot or doesn\'t want to spend a lot of money.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: This looks wonderful and is much prettier in person.  Lots of good storage in the side door.  It took my husband about an hour to finish putting together. Easy directions.  We are very happy with the way this turned out.  Love it!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice Combo Tower Chest, White
review: I had been searching for baby furniture for a while, then I came across this lovely oak combo tower.  I saw it online for sale and bought it.  It was easy to assemble, good quality and within my budget. Great Buy for your Buck!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: This arrived 2 days ago, and my husband and i put it together last night!!!!  looks great with no problems.  The only thing we weren\'t crazy about was the back.  we knew it would be the feaux back, but it didn\'t seem to be quite as good as the other parts.  All in all, its very sturdy and looks wonderful.  Can\'t beat it for the price!!!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: My mom bought this for my unborn son\'s nursery and I absolutely love it! It is very sterdy, the drawers are safe, it has a great finish, and it is beatiful!!! Also, it has tons of space inside! My boyfriend put it together and he didn\'t have any trouble with it - however it does take a few long hours because it has a lotttttt of parts! 115 pounds there!! lol but yeah I absolutely love this chest and would highly recomend it!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Given all of the OVERWHELMINGLY negative reviews on this dresser, I was hesitant to purchase; however, it was the only piece that ever truly "caught my eye" in terms of the design and style I was looking for in my son\'s nursery, not even expensive furniture showrooms had anything better, so..I bought it anyway! I\'m extremely pleased with my purchase, which was made over a year ago. I say that because some people are concerned with the quality of products as they may change over time. I could see by Walmart\'s many review dates that it has been available for at least 3-4 years, and consistency seems to have been maintained throughout.The dresser is completely solid, which I didn\'t expect but was anxiously hoping it would be. I was not disappointed. My son\'s nursery is carpeted, but I even tested it on my ceramic tile kitchen floor first for sturdiness, and there is no difference. The height and width also makes this piece very standout and substantial, which is amazing for the price I paid. I got mine in the espresso color and it is a truely deep, deep chocolate brown, exactly what I wanted. It matches the other espresso items we have great!I did encounter a few issues though also, that I do feel it is only fair to mention. First, this dresser is a complete pain in the a** to put together! I purchased this after I had my son, so being NOT pregnant, it still took me about 7 and a half hours to get this sucker together..and I have assembled my fair share of furniture. It was ridiculous, and the instructions are almost entirely inept, but whatever. Once together, everything else is forgotten. I also had trouble with the screws for the knobs stripping so much, that they would spin and never tighten. To rectify this, I went to the hardware store and purchased some longer and slightly thicker screws, and also used some wood glue around the inside edge of the knob that makes contact with the dresser front. Once the screw was tightened and the wood glue in place also, I used a wetted piece of folded paper towel to "clean up" the circular area around the knobs so the glue wouldn\'t show. This did absolutely nothing negative to the wood or dresser itself, and in the end was still well worth the effort and the $2 it took.Please do not hesitate to try this piece, it is soo lovely! As with all assemble-yourself furniture, there is bound to be some issues of quality on occasion, or even a few "duds". If you are proactive however, I believe you could quite easily receive a replacement. Should you choose not to and be stuck with something you paid for but are unhappy with, then that is your fault and yours alone. I dislike when people post negative reviews based on something like that. Laziness to return a defective product doesn\'t make every single item in this line to be total crap. Remember that!P.S. - To complete the room, we plan on ordering the matching tower and combo hutch (in espresso of course) this week. Reviews on that one are wonderful, so I already got the risky piece over with and am totally satisfied, so I can\'t wait to get that one home as well and have such an elegant nursery for my little guy :)

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I purchased this for my granddaughter, and it is so cheaply manufactured, it is unusable and must be returned.The dresser falls apart when any one drawer is opened. In fact, the front of one drawer was routed so that it would have had to be put on upside down! (they did send another drawer front)The back of this piece of "furniture" is the thinnest of cardboard.I am very disappointed in the lack of quality, even though I did not expect an heirloom piece for the price, this was just terrible.The only positive is the customer service that allows me to return it.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I dont get why there are so many terrible reviews on this dresser. Perhaps the prior reviewers were putting it together wrong? It took my husband about an hour or so to put this together. Its absolutely beautiful and is holding up well. No scratches, no dings, and the drawers slide open and closed smoothly and have plenty of room. This dresser is used every single day as well. I am totally and completely happy with it.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: This product arrived quickly. My husband found that the assembly was tedious as the dresser arrived in a million pieces. He was able to assemble the dresser by following the instructions, although some of the pre-drilled holes were off. Some were to wide and acted as if the hole was stripped while others were off at angles and at one pount caused the wood to crack along the right side panel. After the finished product was completed however the dresser looked very nice and has a great color. As far as quailty of the dresser, you get what you pay for. Its a good dresser for the price, however we would of like to have sturdier bottoms for the drawers. They are not very strong and we have had issues with drawers made like these before of bending and falling apart easily. Other then the drawers being weak and the spliting wood due to mis-drilled screw holes the dresser is nice.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: The piece is fine for what it is. Assembly was pretty standard, and no pieces arrived broken this time. Assembly took about an hour.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I read other reviews that said it was headache, but I went ahead and purchased this item because it\'s less expense than anything I else I saw. I should have listened... I ordered it in Feb, it is now May and we still don\'t have the dresser together. There were pieces missing, and a major piece broken. When you try to call, the line is busy. I had to hang up and redial, what felt like forever. They said my piece would come in 3 weeks, it was more like 7 weeks. The piece that was broken had the drawer rails on it, but when it came, it had no rails. So, I said I wanted to return the entire thing, they were fine with it, but it can take up to 8 weeks to get your money back.  So, at this point in time, we are going to go to the hardware store to buy what we need so that I can have a dresser in my son\'s room.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I would like to state that I take issue with the previous reviews, in that they claim this piece is flimsy. It is NOT at all flimsy, nor does it look cheap. In fact, my husband and I have the entire set (changing table and dresser), along with the Montery Crib.  When you receive the boxes, there is an instruction booklet that clearly states that the manufacturer, not the store, will handle all returns, exchanges, or shipping of missing parts. Well, we had a question regarging set-up of this product and thought there was a defect. We spoke with Storkcraft directly, and found thqat we were not following the assembly directions properly. Storkcraft was exremely helpful and pleasant, and promised us that we could return the item at any time to them DIRECTLY, and they would arrange for a prompt exchange.  This piece looks beautiful, and serves its purpose as a infant/child dresser. I am sure that you could spend $1,000 on a high-end piece, but if you are looking for something that is 1) AFFORDABLE, and 2) WELL-MADE, and 3) BEAUTIFUL, then Storkcraft is a good choice.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I have been using the product for less than 6 months and it is already falling apart. It cannot be returned at this point and I hate it. It is a total waste of your money. Do not even think about investing in this product.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I bought this piece because I had purchased this brand of furniture for my other son and loved it.  This particular dresser is a piece of junk.  It resembles something from Target, rickety and not durable.  I am sorry we bought it!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: This dresser is beautiful.  Listing says solid wood but drawers are particle board except for the front.  This was a little difficult to put together.  The previous reviewer complained of the drawers falling apart, I can see how that would happen if they were not put together correctly.  Mine came with all the parts and instructions so we had no problem with that.  It is sturdy and drawers open and shut properly.  Very nice.  ([...], it is cheaper there).  Shipped within 2 to 3 weeks from manufacturer.  This furniture seems to be in high demand and is on backorder often, so check before ordering.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Half the dresser (top and drawer front) are wood but the rest is like a particle board. I don\'t see how the drawers are going to hold up once you start filling them..two of the them split while assembling drawer glides.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: We ordered this for our son... and we love it.  I will admit that the box did arrive rather beaten up and soaked (as it was raining that day), but despite the beat up box it, once opened the chest was in excellent condition.  It was a bit of a challenge to put together, but overall, a great chest.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I hate this dresser. It is EXTREMELY poorly made; the pieces don\'t snugly fit together, so the dressers are constantly falling off the rollers, the pieces that hold in the bolts rotate on their own making the parts fall apart, and the whole dresser shakes when you open a drawer like it is about to fall apart. When I am tired at the end of the day and trying to get my kid ready for bed, nothing is more frustrating than this piece of junk falling apart on me. I hate it. DON\'T BUY IT.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: drawers work well, could be better, quality seems to be above average but for the price can\'t be beat worth the money

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Sorry it took me so long to review.we didn\'t put it together until today.It\'s so beautiful.I know it\'s a baby dresser, but the dresser was for me.I\'m 26.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I was so pleased with this purchase. It was VERY difficult to put together. My husband is a carpenter, so it was ok for him but I could not imagine if I had to put together myself.  The dresser was much nicer than I thought it would be as well as larger.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: We bought it 6 months before my son was born and probably got 6 months of actual use out of it. The particle board legs have broken and the drawers no longer stay on the tracks. It scratches and warps very easily. I wish I would have spent a little more and got a quality piece of furniture because this is useless now.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: This item is packaged horribly. If you are lucky enough to get intact a great product for a great price. Received changing hutch and tower, crib and toybox intact. Very happy. Ordered this dresser twice, both times damaged. Good luck trying to put back in crummy box to return and good luck trying to get damaged parts replaced unless you can wait 6-8 plus weeks. My suggestion is to order two dressers, take the best pieces from each, and return the rest. Believe me, you will be glad you did.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: We bought this 5 drawer chest for our son\'s nursery in cognac. It looks great in the nursery and is very sturdy. The price is good and this was the only amber wood we could match up to the crib we bought which was a Babysdream Serenity crib in amber. The only thing that is frustrating about this dresser is putting it together. Give yourself about 4 hours with the help of another person. Be patient and don\'t try to hammer in any screws on the back to save time. My husband lost his patience and started to hammer the backboard into the dresser and it splintered a little of the wood. Thank goodness you can\'t see where we messed it up. This dresser does take patience but looks like you spent some money on it. I would deem it very sturdy. Great buy overall, I am happy with it.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: The dresser came in perfect condition with all pieces for a very easy assembly. Looks beautiful and was a great price! I would recommend to a friend.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I never write these reviews, but I had to comment after so many negative reviews. First of all, it is CHEAPER at walmart.com with the shipping and taxes included it came up to a total of $254.66. I have both the dresser and the changing table and they are both beautiful pieces at affordable prices. No, everything is not solid wood, but don\'t waste your money on solid wood when you know you will want to buy your child the latest and greatest bedroom set in the future that matches his or her personality.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: The dresser is very nice and sturdy. My husband built in about an hour. The only complaint I have is that the dresser doesn\'t match the crib or the changing table. Although the box was marked natural an we had to have another sent out because the top drawer was missing, its more of a maple finish. The crib and the changing table were ordered at the same time and from the same store so I don\'t know if that has anything to do with it. But I am happy with it. Looks great in my little boy \'s nursery.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Just annoying to put together and the instruction booklet could be a bit more detailed with the picture. The material is the pressed board, which IMO is really cheap. Will upgrade to quality furniture in the future.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I bought this dresser for my baby girl.  I haven\'t been able to use it continuously yet, since she\'s not due to be born for another month.  At 8 1/2 months pregnant, I was able to start putting it together myself...but towards the end, thank goodness for my roommate and her friend, I got tired and they finished the rest with little to no problems.  All in all, it took about 2 1/2-3 hours to put it together.I bought the Delta Shelby crib (in the color expresso) from Amazon.com and unfortunately, the same company doesn\'t make a matching dresser, so I went to Amazon.com and started reading reviews about dressers close to the same color as my crib. Fortunately, I found a review from someone who recommended this dresser as a close match to the Shelby crib.  I was a little nervous, but it actually did match closer than I thought it would.  The crib is a little shinier than the dresser though.I didn\'t give it the full 5 stars for 2 reasons: 1) The directions were a tad bit hard to understand; especially since none of the dresser pieces have stickers or easily identifiable markings, and the instructions are in black and white (color would be so much easier to understand when they explain the different parts and where they go).  2) It scratches easier than I thought it would, being that type of grain.All in all, it\'s a beautiful piece of furniture, and very sturdy.  I look forward to using it for years to come!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Easy to put together. Only took one hour and it looks beautiful! If only all the pieces were as easy to put together.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Finished product turned out to be worth the price. I was expecting that it would be made with more wood (only the top and end of the drawers were made of solid wood).

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: low quality and I wouldn\'t recommend this chest.  I would totally return it if I knew how to take apart put back in box and ship back to amazon.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: This brand is just awful!  It\'s made of cheap, flimsy particle board.  It dents and dings very easily.  Most inportantly, the runners are too narrow for the wheels so the drawers fall out.  Not only is it horribly made, but it\'s dangerous!  DO NOT BUY!!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: We purchased this dresser to match the Graco espresso crib set and it goes perfectly.  My husband put it together with no problems in about 2-3 hours.  For the price, it\'s perfect and appears that it will last just as long as we would need it.  We had no problems the other reviewers had related to putting it together, mismatched drawer sizes, missing parts, and scratches.  It looks much more expensive than it actually is.  SO glad we purchased it!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I wish I could give it 0 stars. Very flimsy, horrible...unfortunately there is no way I can dismantle it and pack it back to return, ...what a waste

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Bought this to match our daughters crib and I LOVE it! It\'s taller and wider than I thought it would be. It looks very fancy. Would definitely recommend this piece of furniture!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Okay, I needed a cheap dresser for an outside spot that may need to be replaced after a few years so I went cheap. But even as cheap goes, there were marks on the drawers & I didn\'t realize that the drawers literally fit the holes in the box of the cabinet, they do not overhang the frame or vice versa. There is no bottom on this either. For the price I guess I should have expected this. It\'s small & very light.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: We purchased this dresser in natural because we needed something larger that would also match our daughters toddler bed.  I regret buying this product for so many reasons.  Obiously, we knew it wouldn\'t be perfect at such a cheap price, but I still think for $200+ it should have some quality.  The instructions were horrible, although my husband was able to get this together without too many issues.  The bolts and screws are awful and DO NOT hold well at all.  After a few months of use, they just starting falling out, with the dresser drawers barely hanging on.  The drawers are very, very shallow and small, so this is really only ideal for a small child for a small period of time.  Clothes obviously get bigger as the child grows, so unless they have very few garments, this would not work.  My almost 4 year old is wearing a 4T and the drawers are so small that I have to end up hanging most everything in her closet.  As I said before, we didn\'t purchase this dresser with the hopes of it lasting forever, but I think just a few months is ridiculous.  We are constantly having to tighten the bolts and fix the drawers.  I would never recommend this product!!!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: Stork Craft Beatrice is a very nice chest.  The only thing is that it took 2 to 3 hours for two people to put it together.  Other than that it is a wonderful chest for my 2 year old great grandson.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I now have the whole set of this product and have not had any trouble with any of the pieces.  It was packaged great and had no damage upon arrival.  I would recommend it to my friends!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I have never been so compelled to write a review. There is nothing good about this Chest. It\'s very Wobbly so if you\'re concerned that your child will pull or climb on it YOU MOST NAIL IT INTO THE WALL.. The wood is not stained well at all. The depth of the drawers is very deceiving it looks like you are getting allot room, well your not it\'s less then 1/2 of what it looks like. The nubs do not fit!! How can the nobs not fit??If you have the extra 100 dollars buy something else you will not regret it. I do not recommend this product not even to my worst Enemy..I hope this helps you in some way.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: I had been searching for baby furniture for a while.  I was working within a budget, but at the same time was picky on quality.  This chest I saw at babys R us and was exactly what I was looking for, to my surprise Amazon had it on sale that week!..Easy assembly, great value and good quality. Great Buy for your Buck!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest, White
review: A beautiful piece of furniture - we enjoy the look. It was extraoridinarily easy to put together. All of the pieces were there and fit properly. My husband didn\'t complain a bit! The only complaint I have was the depth of the drawers - too shallow. The drawer size is mis-leading, so don\'t plan on a lot of storage. Other than that - nice chest of drawers.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: I received the dresser after many delays.  The condition of the dresser is good it just took awhile to receive.  The dresser is good and heavy and worth the money.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: I purchased the Storkcraft furnature for my daugher\'s room, after over a year of use I am really disappointed in this furnature. The finsh scratches really easily, the drawer gliders are coming apart, this is just very cheaply made. I wish I would have purchased something else.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: Purchased this for a nursery. Their are many pieces to assemble. I was 32 weeks pregnant at the time. Unfortunately after spending an hour assembling dresser I came to the realization that the piece across the bottom of dresser was broken. Had to e-mail amazon for replacement. Second dresser had no broken pieces, however I wouldn\'t recommend this dresser to anyone. The drawers are flimsy. I am hesitant to try an move the dresser because I do not think it\'s made well.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This dresser was fairly easy to put together. Paint quality is not that great (as there are areas that were not fully covered, so you get a bleed through effect from the material); only a couple of pieces made from real wood; very easy to damage; cheaper slides provided for drawers; Overall this is an okay dresser if you can\'t find a real wood dresser to buy or restore for a low price.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: I was so excited to order this dresser. It is built really well and only took my husband and I 2-3 hours to assemble. It has a lot of pieces, but it\'s worth it and looks great!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: The drawer chest is ok looking, but I think its a bit flimsy for its price, I probably would have gotten a cheaper chest from a different brand, with the same quality

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This is a good quality "assemble it yourself" dresser.  The fit and finish are very good overall and when completed, the appearance is on par with decent quality pre-assembled furniture.  The drawers slide easily on metal double roller gliders - although the thin fiberboard bottoms feel a bit flimsy.The box this comes in is heavy! and ours looked like it had received some rough treatment during shipping but the packing seemed to be effective at protecting the contents and nothing was damaged.Assembly is a bit time consuming but not difficult.  The only obstacle there was faulty directions.  I have assembled a TON of DIY furniture since I first started buying Ikea stuff back in college and I have a pretty low bar for these multi-lingual, ESL directions - but these were flat out wrong.  The pictures showed a parts configuration that was different from the parts actually shipped.  This caused temporary panic while looking for a "missing" part which was shown in the directions but  was not actually part of the piece.  After 20 mins of head scratching, I finally realized the part was not part of this assembly and figured out how to finish assembling the dresser with the included parts some of which were not shown at all in the directions.If Storkcraft can get the directions corrected this would be a 5 star piece at this price.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: I purchased this item because it had pretty good reviews and is available on Amazon prime. After eighteen months of ownership I regret my purchase. The bottom of each drawer is made of low quality panelling that droops over time. The fronts for two of my drawers have warped and bowed out, which leads the bottoms of the drawers to sag. This is really just a junk product.Do yourself a favor and don\'t buy this junk.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: I purchased this item on line.  It appeared to be a nice product.  I love the color and it gets a lot of compliments from on lookers.  The main issue with this product is that the drawer holders come already attached to the interior of this unit.  They were all hung incorrectly at the factory.  I had to get a drill, measure each and every drawer for proper alignment and re install the factory attachments.  It took over 2 hours to complete.  Once I put items in the drawer (added some weight), the alignment is still a bit off.  The same is true for the hutch/changing table.Also, the items purchased came in with scratches and dents from the factory.  The shipping boxes were not really that damaged and items were packaged well with a lot of Styrofoam.  Luckily, the damaged areas are not that visible due to the location the items were placed in my baby\'s room.  I also had some pens to match the paint color, as these items are the exact same color as my kitchen cabinets.Would I purchase this item again?  No.  I would spend a little more and buy a better product.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This is a very beautiful piece of furniture. Assembly was a snap, it went together like IKEA furniture. & it didn\'t get all woobly after I put it together in my kitchen, then moved it to my daughter\'s bedroom(am very happy about that, cause I am sure alot of you out there know furniture of that kind does sometimes have the tendency to do that). It\'s a winner in my book.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: You pay for what you get. It was a good price compared to the in store prices. A lot of pieces to sort through and figure out which is which and the instructions can be a little confusing but you\'ll figure it out eventually. Once set up it looks really nice.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: Love the dresser.  It looks great with my son\'s cherry crib and changing table/dresser.  The only reason I\'m not giving it five stars is because during the assembly, there are a few spots where the directions aren\'t very explanatory.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This dresser disappointed me upon completion. My husband put it together and he found that the instructions were adequate, but here are the problems we found overall: half the knobs couldn\'t grip the screws provided; it seems as though the holes that were predrilled into them were too big for the screws. One of the drawers doesn\'t pull out smoothly, so it seems like there\'s a hitch or hiccup in the track as you pull it out. We tried putting the drawer into a different slot as three of them are interchangeable and that didn\'t work. The top drawer wasn\'t flush with the drawer beneath it (minor, but still noteworthy). There\'s a slightly noticeable crack on the top of the dresser that seems to have been painted over because it\'s not that obvious. It isn\'t split, I just noticed it in the lamplight as it reflected off it. And, lastly, but most importantly, the paper coating on the inside of one of the drawers was too long and peeling off on one of the edges, like paper, literally, so my husband attempted to use a box cutter to trim it, but there are still two spots that expose the particleboard underneath. It\'s a pretty dresser at a good price, but there are some things to consider when purchasing.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This chest was hard to put together but looked nice when it was all said and done!!!  The directions are not that easy to follow. Have patience with this one!!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This comes completely in pieces, and while the assembly took a little while, it was straightforward and not difficult. I am not using it in a nursery, but for myself, and I really like it. (I chose the oak finish.) It is relatively lightweight but not flimsy, looks beautiful, and has plenty of room for my clothing.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This dresser is exactly what one would get if not wanting to spend a lot of money. It\'s extremely affordable, easy to put together, nice finish, and does the job. It\'s not top of the line where you would spend $500. plus. You get what you pay for. I am exteremly pleased with this product. It matches the other pieces in the room very will. Shipping was very fast and when it arrived packaging was great. I constructed it in less than an hour. There are no "tools" that come with this dresser. It is called "hardware" I put it together with one screwdriver. Everyone who gave this dresser one star is an idiot! They seem to want five star product at a one star price. Complaining on how to put it together, what its\'s made of and so on, Blah, Blah, Blah. This is not rocket science people. Stop bitching about crap and get a clue! You want top quality? spend top money! As for me, I would buy this again and yes it\'s worth what I paid for it. Thank you for taking the time to read my review.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: Well you get what you pay for. Super cheap quality dresser. The front panel of the drawers keep falling off because the screws are poor quality. I would keep shopping.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: The product is nice but I misunderstood "hard wood" to mean the entire dresser. Instead, it had the typical composite on unseeable parts. It went together easily, however, and looks quite pretty. It\'s holding up nicely so far.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This is a lovely dresser, however, you do have to be careful putting it together. The wood damages easily and the instructions aren\'t great.  The drawers roll out flimsily but so far I haven\'t had any problem with them.  I wouldn\'t recommend it for high usage but it is absolutely fine for light usage.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: After reading some of the reviews on this product, I was reluctant to make the purchase. However, I decided to take a chance on it, since the product looked like it would so perfectly match my toddler\'s cherry bed. Not only did it match perfectly, but it was simple to assemble, and it is surprisingly sturdy for the price and materials. The drawers are deep and spacious. The color is deep and beautiful, with not a single nick from the shipping or assembly process. I am very pleased with this dresser! I gave it four stars instead of five, because the packaging was damaged upon arrival, making me nervous about the contents. Fortunately, the dresser pieces were in perfect shape, but I can see why this product gets many complaints about damage during shipping. The company needs to address this issue.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: Product came with instructions for a 3 drawer unit, had extra parts, holes for KD fittings were too large so fittings fell out during assembly making assembly difficult at times...for the price was not near the quality a product that one would expect. Once completely assembled was fairly sturdy but don\'t expect it might be a long term investment.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: Great product for the money. Was very sturdy and solid. Easy to assemble (I did it without my husbands help!) only complaint would be that you can\'t fit much in the 3rd drawer because of a cross brace support. Other than that, it\'s great! I would buy it again!

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: My husband and I purchased this dresser a few weeks ago for our twins\' nursery.  We decided that yesterday (08/07/10) was the perfect day to assemble the dresser and get the nursery set up.We started assembly at 2:30 PM.We finished assembly at 7:30 PM.We\'ve purchased numerous DIY items over the last 10 years and this was, by far, the most difficult we\'ve ever dealt with.  The instructions are simply pictures, which doesn\'t help much since several of the dresser pieces look exactly the same except for very very small differences.  We had to take the dresser apart numerous times because the pieces weren\'t well marked and we used the wrong pieces in the wrong places.  The small silver screw pieces (I don\'t know their official name) were a total PITA to deal with.  You had to place them in large holes in the wood but as soon as you moved the wood from laying completely flat, the silver pieces fell out.  It took us awhile to figure out the only way to keep them from falling out was to place a small piece of tape over them to keep them in the wood while we assembled the rest of the dresser.  Several of the holes indicated in the directions were not even on the wood pieces, so we had to drill them in ourselves.  Anyone who tried to put this together without having an electric drill would have been SOL.It also would have been very helpful had each wood piece been marked in some way to indicate which piece it was.  Each piece is referenced by name in the instructions, but two pieces called "Front brace" and "Back brace" don\'t mean much until you get the item assembled.  They look exactly alike, except for one of the holes is slightly off-center and the other is centered perfectly.We have yet to use the dresser, but the drawer bottoms already seem a bit on the flimsy side and I\'m not sure how long it will last.  I expected that an item that retails for over $200 would be of better quality.  We could have gotten a better quality dresser at Target, Fred Meyer or IKEA for half the price of this one.  In a year or so, we may end up having to do that.Based on assembly issues alone, I would not recommend this dresser to anyone.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: This product was packaged very well for shipping. There was only minimal scuffing due to shipping, which was not noticeable once it was assembled. It only took my husband and I about one hour to put together and it was fairly simple. The directions leave out a few steps, but nothing major, and we were able to figure it out. The pieces all went together extremely well--the pre-drilled holes were all in the correct spots (which many times doesn\'t happen). The dresser seems very sturdy. I am very pleased with this product. The wood that shows is all very nice.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: The completed dresser was exactly what I wanted--the perfect size and look for the space we had for it.  However, we had several issues.The assembly takes a lot of work.  There are just a lot of steps and screws.  It helps to have a large area to spread everything out before you begin.  Don\'t be surprised if it takes an hour to complete the project, so have plenty of time set aside.The back panel is a thin not-quite-wood panel, as is typical in this class of furniture.  It attaches with screws, which is a bit nicer than using nails as is often the case.  However, it\'s very easy to get the screws going at a slight angle, which can cause them to damage the finish if they point the wrong way.The only serious problem we had is that upon completion, the top drawer wouldn\'t close.  I emailed a set of photos to the manufacturer, and they sent a replacement side panel which corrected the problem.  The drawer still isn\'t completely level, but it\'s close enough that I\'m not worrying about it.All said, I don\'t regret the purchase, but I wish the process of getting it completed had been simpler.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: We got this dresser to match the crib we bought elsewhere.  The dresser matches the espresso color of the crib.  The only thing was that one of the cam lock pieces was damaged and there were not any extra in the container so there is one place on the dresser that is not locked together correctly.  Other than that i am happy with it.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: Cheaper construction than looks. Scratches and damage right out of package. Top drawer is not double drawer as it decieves

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: Beautiful dresser, bought to also use as changing table but a couple inches to tall when you get a pad. Will still be used as normal dresser

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: I purchased the Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest in Black. I was a bit worried when I first ordered this product. I had read the reviews and they were not all that positive. The dresser has a very strong odor which I am assuming is from the paint. It is a good idea to put this together before baby gets there so it has time to air out. I don\'t have too many complaints.One of the bottom drawers is a little crooked and catches on the last drawer and pulls it out tho. My boyfriend put the drawers together using wood glue. So hopefully that will make them last a little longer. Overall I like the product. It looks very beautiful once it is assembled and goes beautifully with the other furniture we purchased from Stork Craft.

name: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest, White
review: Great quality at an excellent price. I purchased this to complement existing crib and other furniture in the toddlers room, as running out of clothes space when her sister was born. Good mid-level quality if you don\'t want to spring for the super expensive stuff....Not difficult to assemble, takes a couple hours.

name: South Shore Furniture, Popular Collection, Changing Table, Natural Maple
review: I wanted a changing table that was more enclosed than most and that stood higher, as both of us are tall.  What wasn\'t clear is how much smaller the changing area is than most.  A standard changing pad (16x20) does not fit on it, and you NEED a pad, as the lip is VERY VERY small as well as sharp.  Baby can easily roll off this if unmodified as well as bump his head on the lip. We wound up strapping a curved pad on the top and using the changing pad cover to help anchor it.  Other big problem: it arrived without the entire back piece, which is what stablizes it and makes it usable. It is now 3 weeks later and still the part has not arrived.  I\'m 38 weeks and want this taken care of!  Granted, they have 7-day customer service, but as my husband said, why not get it right to start with?  The part is on back order and was probably not packed because it wasn\'t in.  Unacceptable!  Only good points: the drawers are good quality and work smoothly.  Not bad looking, except the top is funky now with the improvised changing pad.  And we\'ll be able to use it later as a bureau IF THE BACK PIECE EVER ARRIVES!

name: Comfort U Pillow -For Total Body Support
review: I had a bi-level lumbar fusion at the beginning of January 2014 (happy new year!) and I ordered this from my hospital room more or less on a whim.  I knew I was going to have issues with getting comfortable in bed plus my wife and I compete for the other body pillow we have, so I ordered this and a navy blue cover.  I could not be more pleased.  The pillow can be shaped however you want it, which was ultimately exactly what I needed it to do.  I had to sleep flat on my back for a few weeks so I would get nestled into this beast and pull the ends together under my legs.  Perfectly comfortable.  Now that I am somewhat recovered, it still manipulate it all around to get support exactly where I need it.Awesome pillow!

name: Comfort U Pillow -For Total Body Support
review: Out of all the products I bought for my pregnancy this was by far the best. I slept comfortably throughout my 9 mos. and still use it today. The only downfall is that your bedfellow might feel neglected.

name: Comfort U Pillow -For Total Body Support
review: This allows my wife to have support on all sides during sleep. She now can sleep through the night with waking. This is an exellent buy and well worth the investment.

name: Comfort U Pillow -For Total Body Support
review: I suffer from osteoarthritis in both shoulders and will one day have them replaced. Pain pills upset my stomach so I was looking for anything to help me sleep. Though most reviews were from women using this pillow during pregnancy I did find a couple from others with a similar situation as mine. So I made the jump and purchased the pillow. I will say I had a few uncomfortable nights - no worse than without the pillow - but finally after a few weeks it has \'broken in\' and I have figured out how to prop myself up between the two legs (with the u at my feet) and my tempurpedic type pillow at my head. I grab onto the leg with one arm under and the other over and that keeps my shoulder from crumpling under me. The opposite leg is at my back so I lean into that too. Last night I took no pain pills, grabbed the pillow just right and had a pain free night. The first in I can\'t tell you how long. I am very pleased with this pillow. Give the pillow some time. Others had great results the first night and I did finally find the right position for me but it took a couple weeks. It is comfortable right from the start though. I sleep in a queen size bed and sleep along. I am not sure how another person could sleep with me. I am 5\' 7" so this size is right for me. I did purchase the 100% cotton cover. And it was very well made and easily put on. Haven\'t washed it yet so can\'t comment on any shrinkage.

name: Comfort U Pillow -For Total Body Support
review: I have fibromyalgia, restless leg syndrome and endure much pain during the night. It was totally impossible for me to get comfortable until the Comfort U Pillow was delivered to my door.  I can honestly say that it truly does help me get a better night sleep in addition to decreasing the pain.  This pillow has brought me many painfree nights of sleep.

name: Comfort U Pillow -For Total Body Support
review: I have had long term pain from inflammation of the bursa in my left hip. This pillow allows me to nestle into a comfortable position where I can actually sleep in my own bed rather than in the recliner. Love it!

name: Comfort U Pillow -For Total Body Support
review: My wife purchased this item after all the great reviews and after using another, less supportive product. She likes the overall design but after a few weeks of use, despite the lifetime guarantee of the pillow retaining its fluffiness, found that the dependent portions of the pillow at the sides lost their fluffiness. If the product had, say a firm foam core, it would probably be perfect.

name: Comfort U Pillow -For Total Body Support
review: Some reviewers here have complained that the pillow flattens too easily. Note that according to the web site sitincomfort (The Comfort Store), there are two kinds of Comfort U pillows: one is stuffed with Fusion Fiberfill, and the other is stuffed with Fossfill. The Fusion Fiberfill is what\'s being sold on this Amazon page. Read carefully; other Amazon sellers stock the Fossfill version.This is an important point to consider, depending on your priorities.
