My understanding is that the Fusion Fiberfill is supposed to feel more like a real down pillow--which means it\'s likely to need to be fluffed more, too.  Tricky with such a big pillow.So I recomend doing a little research and checking out the Fossfill version. The Fossfill version is allegedly better at maintaining its shape, and also lets air circulate better so it\'s not as hot.

name: Graco Seatbelt Locking Clip
review: We were desperate to buy this clip for our son\'s carseat because it didn\'t come with the second base that we purchased ... and couldn\'t find it anywhere in stores! I should\'ve known to check amazon first, they have everything! It was very in-expensive and I am so thankful I found it. One of our vehicles is an older model, and this clip was a requirement to tighten the carseat base. It works great - gets the job done and I can drive easier knowing my son is properly locked in and secure. Thank goodness amazon sells this for a good price!

name: Graco Seatbelt Locking Clip
review: Great locking clip that will secure any car seat because it locks the seat belt itself.  It is not specific to any car seat model so it will work with any of them.

name: Graco Seatbelt Locking Clip
review: This does the trick, however, check the back of your car seat. Our Evenflow Tribute Sport had one stored on the back that I never noticed. Now I have two!

name: Graco Seatbelt Locking Clip
review: It can come loose very easily, but will do the job it you are careful. very useful for car seat

name: Graco Seatbelt Locking Clip
review: It is important to clamp the seat belt when using a child\'s car seat but this clip is hard to use and a pain to get on and off. A better system is the red clamp that comes with other car seats.The Graco seat is a design nightmare and should be avoided at all costs.Always test the seat installation before buying.

name: Graco Seatbelt Locking Clip
review: Does exactly what it is supposed to do and seems to be quite sturdy. Left me confident that it would stay in place and keep my little guy safe.

name: Graco Seatbelt Locking Clip
review: So tired of losing these darn things so I bought a few extra, they do what they should.

name: Child to Cherish \'\'A Block To Grow On\'\' in Pink
review: We love this bank. I have one for my older child and had to order one for my newborn. A great keepsake thats usable and to keep track of their weights and heights. Super cute too!

name: Child to Cherish \'\'A Block To Grow On\'\' in Pink
review: I received this item as a gift shortly after finding out we were having a boy.  It is adorable.  Each side has different milestones to fill in, fine tip marker included.  I like that it doubles as a bank for use years down the road.  It is much larger than the picture makes it out to be.  Will be purchasing this item for my expecting friends!!

name: Child to Cherish \'\'A Block To Grow On\'\' in Pink
review: I love this for a baby gift.  I\'ve used it 5 times this year.  Easy to slip in a college donation for the baby. Moms seem to love it too.

name: Child to Cherish Baby To Bride Bracelet
review: I am hoping that I get to order another on soon.  This gift exceeds my expectations.......I am very proud to be the \'giver\' of this beautiful memory gift!

name: Child to Cherish Baby To Bride Bracelet
review: I love to give this item as a baby shower gift.  I replace the penny with one that represents the year the child will be born.  It is always a big hit.

name: Child to Cherish Baby To Bride Bracelet
review: I wanted the bracelet for my Granddaughter\'s Baptism. I recieved many compliments on this sweet little gift. I purchased this particular item because it had the bracelet and it was less expensive than other options. I did not expect that the packageing was a pretty nice frame, and I do believe that when my Grandaughter is grown, she will appreciate the sentimentality of the gift.Arrived in 2 days, just in time for the Baptism, and in perfect condition.

name: Child to Cherish Baby To Bride Bracelet
review: Bought this  small acrylic  plaque as an "extra" for a baby shower gift basket that I was devising for my lovely but overworked daughter in law. She\'s a physician that seldom gets a moment to herself. There were many lovely baby girl things given to her  at the shower but she said she loved the plaque for her future "bride to be" daughter. She felt the little keepsake was unique and thoughtful . Plaque photos are  accurate and dimensions are provided . It also comes in a little white netted sack .

name: Child to Cherish Baby To Bride Bracelet
review: I bought this as a gift for my goddaughter.  I was pleasantly surprised at how awesome this is for the price.  it certainly is worth every cent and will be a great keepsake for her.

name: Child to Cherish Baby To Bride Bracelet
review: The bracelet in this gift is adorable.  My Goddaughter wore it for her baptism and now it will mean even more on her wedding day.

name: Child to Cherish Baby To Bride Bracelet
review: This was a little smaller then I expected but it was worth it seeing the mom to be\'s face when she opened the gift and read the poem. This was the best gift.

name: Child to Cherish Baby To Bride Bracelet
review: Love it, love it, love it. The quality was even better than I expected, and it was a huge hit at my sisters baby shower. I wanted to give her something special and unique, and it was perfect. I would recommed this for sure.

name: Blue/Yellow Toy Box
review: I love this thing.  We bought this for my daughter shortly after she was born.  A year and a half later, it\'s still in perfect condition.  It holds much more than I thought it would, and I love the drawers at the bottom for smaller items such as blocks, figurines, and other items that would get totally lost in the big part.No assembly is a definite plus in my book.  Sure, the lid isn\'t attached and doesn\'t lock into place, but this prevents your child from getting themselves stuck in there, pinching their fingers in a joint, or whatever else.  Also, like another reviewer said, you can just remove the lid altogether. it\'s also true that the drawers just slide on the floor underneath the main part, but that isn\'t an issue for us because we have carpet.  Also, when she was younger it was great because we would just take the drawer with the small toys into the other room with us and it held plenty to keep her entertained, while the main toy box stayed where it was.The material is sturdy and wipes clean easily, unlike wood which is heavy, dents easily, and doesn\'t clean as easily.  I absolutely love this toy box and I would buy it again.

name: Malawi Chair
review: Our grand-daughter loves this chair.  The day the UPS man dropped off the big package, our grand-daughter was present to receive her first chair, and she was excited first, about the box, and then the big surprise her Malawi Chair.  She checked out all of the animal characters and then finally sat down with a small book.  The smiles our 11 month old grand-daughter gaves us was worth every penny.  The Chair fits with our standard furniture and looks like a real piece of furniture. After reading all the reviews on Amazon about this Malawi Chair: I took the advice of others reviewers, and had the Malawi Chair Scotch Guarded to protect the chair from stains, and from getting the fussy balls on the material.  This has worked very well!... :-) Thank you reviewers for this information.  Overall this Malawi Chair is a Great Buy, and I would buy it all over again.

name: Malawi Chair
review: We purchased the bedding set for our son last year. My mother in law found the matching chair, I was so excited to get it. Its not as nice as the bedding set, the pictures of the animals are screenprinted on the chair but its still cute, and goes nicely with the bedroom set. My son sits in his chair all the time, I can tell he is going to love it for years.

name: Malawi Chair
review: This chair is cute and is the perfect size.  Unfortunately the fabric is very thin.  The first chair we received had a small tear in the left arm.  We decided to return it and get a replacement.  The second chair had a tear in the fabric of the right arm.  We e-mailed the customer service department and asked their opinion on wether to exchange or get a refund.  They replied that the problem was more widespread than they originally thought an we should just get a refund.  I guess we will look elsewhere.

name: Malawi Chair
review: My son got this chair for his first birthday and loves it!  It is big enough that he has lots of room to grow into it.  It seems to be very well crafted and sturdy.  We scotch-guarded it, so it\'s protected against stains.  I love this print because it matches his nursery theme, but also because it isn\'t so "kiddy-themed" and won\'t look gaudy in our living room.  We would highly recommended this chair!!

name: Malawi Chair
review: He got it for his 1st b-da, he loves to sit and watch TV in it.... GREAT chair!!

name: Malawi Chair
review: We purchased this darling chair for our 18-month old son.  He loved it immediately, climbing into it and naming each of the animals on the chair.  Since his room is done in the Malawi theme, this chair was a delightful addition.  Sadly, he got just a smudge of dirt on it.  When I tried to clean it by dabbing it with water (just dabbing...not rubbing, as I had read others\' advice against rubbing), the green color fabic faded badly right away.  This was just with a dab of water!  So we returned the chair (amazon was great about this!) and got a second one.  The second one had a small rip in the arm upon delivery.  So we have returned it and are awaiting a third chair.  Hopefully the third time will be the charm, because this chair really is CUTE!  But if there\'s something wrong with #3, then we will give up on the Malawi chair and buy something else.  So sad.

name: Malawi Chair
review: The chair is perfect for a toddler. It has a fun, colorful design. Its size makes it easy to get in and out of, and it\'s sturdy, yet easily moveable. It\'s soft so there aren\'t any points or edges to worry about. We are very pleased with this purchase.

name: Malawi Chair
review: We bought this for our little guy who is approx 15 months old.  LOVES IT!  Don\'t waste your money spending tons... this little chair gives you a lot of bang for your buck.  Durable, easy for little ones to climb in and out of (another favorite of the little kiddies since it\'s difficult for them to climb the couch!) and cute.  Not an eyesore!

name: Malawi Chair
review: I bought this chair for my grandson\'s first birthday and he loves it.  The safari print is cute and the chair is well-made, and just right for a little toddler to watch his favorite show.  I originally had picked out a small rocker, but found I was reluctant to spend so much on something I wasn\'t sure he\'d like or would even be able to sit in.  This chair is adorable and half the cost of the upholstered rockers.

name: FunToSee Room Makeover Decal Kit, Outer Space
review: Colorful and big stickers. Will be a problem if you have a small wall.Go for it if you have plenty of space or intend to use only some of the stickers.Would buy again. wish you could choose different colors...

name: FunToSee Undersea Adventure Nursery and Bedroom Make-Over Decal Kit, Underwater
review: These were very cute characters with tons of character.  Stick well to walls but not properly cut and several ripped when removing from the non stick sheet.  Product description states 96 pieces however almost half are bubbles.  Don\'t feel these were worth the price charged but am happy with the overall purchase.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: My son used this until he refused to sit in the basket anymore.  I just washed it every so often and kept it in my car for next time.  Maks them more comfy and keeps them warmer in winter.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I purchased the Floppy Seat before reading all the reviews. I had never heard of the Buggy Bagg until reading these reviews so I took their advice and purchased it to compare. I have to agree that the Buggy Bagg is better and I paid only ten dollars more for it at Onlinestore.com. The Buggy Bagg is so much easier to use, you actually place it in the cart, and with one hand you unzip it, fold the back over the seat and stretch the elastic around the front and sides, and just as easy to pack back up, so much neater than the Floppy.  And there\'s padding between the legs that velcros to the cart and the pillow is awesome for a lounging baby or just for support. The padding is quilted so that it molds to the seat and lays perfectly and it is thicker than the Floppy. There are also two great pockets behind the seat that zip closed for baby stuff, sometimes I stick my wallet in there so I don\'t have to carry a purse. And the fabric choices are great, I got the navy/khaki plaid, very cute. It looks much nicer when carrying into restaurants as it rolls up neatly and zips with two handles like a real tote.  I returned the Floppy and I\'m so glad I bought the Buggy Bagg. The Floppy does the job but the Buggy Bagg does it better.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: This floppy is a godsend.  I love how it can hold toys and protects my toddler son\'s mouth from so many nasty store germies.  The material is soft and comfy so baby isn\'t sitting on a cold hard seat and it\'s easy to pack back up into the bag.My only gripe is the price.  Money is no object for my son\'s safety but $40 can be a lot of money, especially for a full time student.I would recommend this for any parent and I\'m very satisfied with this floppy.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: My son is 2 and still uses this cart cover!  Everywhere I go people are asking me where I got it.  It is WONDERFUL!  Actually this purchase was a gift for a friend that just had a baby!  So I loved it enough to buy another as a gift.  It is definitely worth the money BY FAR!  There is no better seat cover than this.  It covers the whole area where the baby has no access to any germs!!!  That is the point right?  It washes well and has held up beautifully so far.  I would recommend it to everyone of course I just bought one for my best friend!  Enjoy!!!

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: Like the others say, it\'s great for shopping carts and high chairs - coverage and protection as well as padding.  We got it for my daughter when she was about 4 mos and starting to sit up but not exactly stable - the thickness of the padding helped hold her up and kind of soften the blow if she tipped (plus the strap helps with that.)  But what I use it for more than anything is baby swings at the park!  We live in NYC and live for outings to the park.  She\'s 6 mos now and can sit up better, but still flops around in the hard baby swing if it\'s pushed.  I throw in the Floppy Seat and it pads her all around so she doesn\'t move (plus keeps her warm as the weather is cooling off).  Now I can push her in the swing and she loves it!  When done, we just stuff it into it\'s own bag and hang it on the stroller to go home.  We are definitely getting our money\'s worth.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I personally was not happy with the Floppy Seat. I do not like the way it moved around in the cart & it was not convenient to store. I then purchased the Buggy Bagg & was extremely happy with that product. The padding, convenience & features of the Buggy Bagg were far more superior than the Floppy Seat. I would like to see Toys R Us carry the Buggy Bagg. It is the absolute best.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I have a one year old and the Floppy seat goes everywhere with us . To the grocery store , out to resturants and even to Home Depot with my husband . Our daughter loves the softness of the Floppy seat and loves to relax while we shop. I would highly recommed the Floppy seat to anyone who is thinking about buying it . Also just think those grocery carts and high chairs in resturants are filled with germs .  Kara , Syracuse, NY

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I\'m not sure about other parents, but I spend a great deal of time in the market (seems like daily!) And not only does this serve as a \'healthy\' purpose, it makes marketing more fun...my child has toys handy, the bottle in the pocket (or snacks)..and I\'m not sure about those that say you can\'t put it on one handed while holding a child, I\'ve done it one handed MANY TIMES! It\'s nice and padded, so on the rare occasion she\'s fallen asleep (twice) I have literally just laid her in it sideways (do that at your own risk! It\'s not in the instructions as \'recommended\') :) it\'s very padded & cozy comfy!!!EXCELLENT...I love it!!! I don\'t always stuff it back into itself, most of the time I pop it back in the trunk as is, only because it is easier to do one handed when it\'s that way, and I\'m not a total germ-a-phobe, I like that aspect, but I really love the \'entertainment\' aspect of it!!! :) Everything right there nice n handy for my child!!! :)

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I purchased this amidst much skepticism from my husband, yet this is one of the most used baby gear items for my now one year old.  I purchased it about 5 months ago and I use it at least 2-3 times a week.  It keeps the baby away from the unsanitary public carts and high chairs, while also providing a soft, comfortable and cozy surrounding.  It is simple to place in the seat, and it is so easy to wash/dry.  I used to get the stroller out every time I went into a store or to a restauraunt, which became such a chore, so this is a great relief!  I get compliments every time I use it.  It is a great investment for the safety, comfort and peace of mind.  I highly recommend this to every parent who leaves the house with the baby!

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: This is the best thing ever.  Immediately after buying it we went out to lunch and used it in the high chair.  It was so easy to use and just as easy to fold up. My 8 month old son has been known to fall asleep in the seat at the grocery store and this makes is so much more comfortable for him, Makes for wonderful shopping.  I don\'t have to worry about germs or about my son slipping and hitting his head on something hard.  It is very cushioned and worth every penny!!!  I love it!

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: We have used this seat for our son since he was about 10 months old, in shopping carts and at restaurants. It is easy to install and fold up-it has pockets in the sides so he can keep his toys with him and keeps his hands clear from all the germs from carts and high chairs. Plus, he looks so much more comfortable in this seat cover! A must for new Moms concerned about germs and keeping baby healthy!

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I have the old Floppy Seat Shopping Cart Cover (red with jungle print), but I just saw the new one at a store.  I was so glad to see that they added loops for toys and changed the color!  I have had mine for 4 months and it goes everywhere with me!  I get comments like, "where did you get that," all the time.  It is the most wonderful invention for toddlers!  Completely machine washable-I have washed mine so many times and it still looks brand new!

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: Per Wired Magazine\'s May 2005 edition (Page 61):Shopping cart handle germ count: 1 MILLION.If just 10 percent were influenza virus, you could pick up: 510 germs.Number that would make you sick: 1.When I think of my children touching those surfaces and then putting their little hands in their mouths, or rubbing their eyes... yuck, makes me squeemish.I\'m ordering two today: One for each car so dad and I can cut down on the contagion we battled this last year.[The number of germs on a toilet handle, btw, is only 50,000]

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: The first time I saw this item, I laughed and thought what a waste of money.  Then, my mom tried to talk me out of it saying it was too much money.  So I went to Babies R Us and tried all of what they had to offer with my son and this is the only one he liked.  I also love this cover.  It works great, I can do it one handed and it has it\'s own carry case. No more eating yucky germy carts!  I don\'t know how many times I have been out and people have come up to me asking where I got this item. Two thumbs up from us!!

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I registered for this item and never received it.  I didn\'t think much of it until my son became old enough to ride in the shopping carts and sit in the restaurant high chairs.  I cringed the first time I had to put him in a Wal-Mart shopping cart.  He kept trying to chew on the handle bar.  After that experience, I immediately went out and bought the Floppy seat.  I researched and found that this one has tons more coverage than any of the others. It fits in any shopping cart and high chair.  In some of the restaurant high chairs, there is a little extra Floppy Seat hanging over the edge, but it doesn\'t pose a problem.  My sister and sister-in-law are having babies within weeks of each other and they will each receive a Floppy Seat from me as part of their gifts.  It is very easy to wash--just throw it in the washer and then the dryer.  It has loops all around the front and sides for toys to be clipped on.  It has a pocket which is great to put a sippy cup/bottle and/or some snacks.  My son loves it and so does my husband and I.  I have people stop me all the time commenting on it and wanting to buy one.  Couldn\'t bear to be without it!

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: Although a bit pricy, It is well made and we use it all the time.So it is worth it. Plus I feel much better that my baby is touching his stuff rather than the germs of other fingers and hands all over the grocery cart.Very pleased with purchase.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: If your a germ freak or just want to be careful and clean with your lil one, this is perfect. Has places for toys and so forth. It works on public highchairs too.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I recently purchased an EZ Floppy Seat for my 7 1/2 month old son. It is the best thing I\'ve purchased for my son so far. I quickly realized I needed something to protect him when he outgrew his nice little infant carrier. Couldn\'t even think about putting him in a yucky shopping cart or public high chair and holding this little chunk was defintely not going to work. Not only does the floppy seat provide a safety barrier from germs in shopping carts and restaurant high chairs, it provides cushioning for my baby. Everyone is happy!

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I cannot tell you how long this saved my little boy from catching one of every sickness, circulating out there! This is the greatest investment in the world. EVERYONE needs one of these. Little ones who want to sit up and see the world, but still stick their hands on everything and then procede to put their germ covered hands in their mouths, are saved by this ingenious cart cover. My little one even slept in the cart a couple of times, when he was tired and we were out. The cover is very cushiony, washes well, and has nice little storage pockets for snacks, toys, bottles.....etc. Another nice feature is that there are little places to hook on your child\'s favorite car seat/ stroller toys. I honestly would have spent twice as much on it.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: The Floppy Seat is a piece of junk. I bought one and after opening it, I found there to be some fabric bleeding where the colors had run together. I called the compnay right away to inform them of the defect in mine & to see what I could do about returning the one I had & getting one that was not defective. I was made to pay shpping on something that was not even my fault. About a month later I received a replacement. It was ok for about a week until I washed it (on the gentle cycle) & the colors on that one bled together. When I called the company about this problem with the colors running together they were extremely RUDE and unwilling to help me.I have totaly wasted my hard earned money. The FLIMSY Floppy Seat is a piece of junk! I would not recommend this to anyone after my experience of receiveing 2 defective Floppy Seats & dealing with one very rude company.

name: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review: I love this product! I had originally bought another cart cover that was less expensive, had toys and seemed good enough. But no way, it didn\'t fit most carts and didn\'t cover the sides. My son would search for the metal to chew on. YUCK! So I spent the money on this one and don\'t regret a dime. It even covers the push bar of the cart so my hands can stay clean. With just a bit of practice, its easy to put on and take off. While the padding is nice, it can be bulky to store.

name: Stroll -N- Go Stroller Bunting
review: This zip & go blanket attaches easily to the stroller while allowing easy access & removal of the top blanket with zipper.  Warm, soft & easy to use & wash.  Definately recommeded for spring, fall & winter!!!

name: Kettler Baby Swing Seat - Kettler 8355-000
review: Really make our swing set a lot more fun. And much more secure than the buckets seats that are so dangerous!

name: Kettler Baby Swing Seat - Kettler 8355-000
review: This is a great swing.  We bought the Kettler gym set (we call it monkey bars and you can\'t find steel anymore) and bought one of these swings and a normal swing.  We needed a second baby swing for a 3-1/2 year old who felt safer in it for higher swinging, and came back to Amazon.  Both work great, with good German quality as is the entire set.

name: Butterfly Kisses - Wallpaper Border
review: the edges come off, the glue doesn\'t stick. The length is also shorter than most of other Lambs and Ivy wall borders, so I couldn\'t cover up a previous border.

name: Double Jogging Stroller Rain Cover
review: Fit schwinn tourismo double stroller perfectly! Strong, durable and easy to throw on and off. We loved this at Disney :)

name: Double Jogging Stroller Rain Cover
review: Okay for the price, but thin plastic tears easily, and we have to just keep taping the tears.  We have one for our single jogger that we bought at babysRus several years back, and have had no such problems with.

name: Double Jogging Stroller Rain Cover
review: Excellent product covers very well to my daughters does not go cold and much less water highly recommended, for those rainy days.

name: Double Jogging Stroller Rain Cover
review: I was ecstatic to find a double stroller cover for so cheap, but it\'s very poor quality plastic and has already torn. Does not stand up to the elements, and I\'m quite dissappointed. It fit great though.

name: Flower Playbar
review: very versatile - can be used just about anywhere - stroller, car seat, etc., and amuses too!

name: Double Stroller Travel Bag
review: I used this bag to transport a Bugaboo Cameleon  from the Us to Asia. Lots of room to spare even with this big stroller. In fact I felt I had to add things to help fill the bag. Tie-down straps from the bottom would be a good addition. Bag arrived, after 3 flights, with no damage or wear signs.

name: Double Stroller Travel Bag
review: This item has one major flaw...the zipper is cheap and inadequate for this bag. The rest of this bag is really nice, very durable. But the zipper is tiny and it derailed itself the first time I opened it.

name: Jogging Stroller Rain Cover
review: I love the cover.  I use it all the time.  My only complaint would be that the velcro fasteners aren\'t very sturdy.  One of them came off and I had to sew it back on myself...which if you\'ve ever tried to do that you know it\'s no easy feat.

name: Graco:Stroller Starter Kit
review: Rarely do I write reviews, but for this one I just had to. I ordered it 3 days ago & just received this today. I\'ve never seen anything on the market like this. Wow, I got everything I could possibly need for my stroller -  you don\'t have to buy anything else. A local store wanted $10 for the rain cover alone! For $20 how could you go wrong. Though I\'m using this myself, this would probably be a great gift idea.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: I saw this at Babies r Us and thought "it was cute and what a perfect toy to keep my son occupied while in the car." Boy - was I wrong, you continuously have to press the button for the music and when you put the bar down it sits right on top of your baby\'s head. I returned it as soon as I brought it home and tried it out. I wouldn\'t recommend this.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: The fish and star that hang down and the music & water sound it makes are just ordinary. In a way that is good because you dont want to oversimulate a baby\'s mind, however I see this as being a waste of money.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: First of all, I am truly astonished at the number of reviewers who were making comments about the toy bar potentially injuring an infant if in a car accident...which I am in no way denying, however...the alarming fact remains that parents are actually leaving the infant carrier/car seat bar up at all while driving.  I thought it was common knowledge that this, in of itself, is a very real danger to a baby if one was to get into a collision.  This toy would be perfectly safe if not used while dangerously propping the handle up while the car is in motion.  I suppose I was just being a bit pressumptuous to assume most people knew not to do this, but apparently this isn\'t the case.  So, with that said, I do not believe that this toy is a danger on it\'s own merrits, as far as injuring a child while in the car.  It is the bar/handle being propped up at all, and I think more people should take heed of this piece of advice.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: We bought this for our 1 month old daughter because she seemed to be getting bored and needed some sort of entertainment. I agree with all the reviews, that there needs to be another way to attach it to the car seat. It makes the car seat hard to carry as well as blocks the sun visor on snugride seats from being able to to cover most of the baby. The music selection is great, but WAYYYYYY to short. All but 1 songs seem as if they are shorter than 20 seconds long, hardly enough to catch her attention, and lose it since the song is already over. We are now looking into the toy that attaches to the seat and is controlled with a remote, so we arfen\'t turning around to find the button for the music every 30 seconds, this toy also plays longer songs.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: Cute, yes, but smart this toy is not. 1)When this toy is attached to the handle of the infant carseat/carrier, taking hold of the handle or taking baby in and out becomes difficult. 2)When my daughter really began enjoying her hands she was just a little over two months old, but the dangling items on this toy were still too far for her to ever succeed in reaching them. She would soon get frustrated or just plain bored. 3)The under-water part of this toy is really boring, too, the fish do nothing to captivate. 4)The music does need to be restarted often.Get the WHOOZIT Activity Spiral instead. It\'s takes less than a second to place, or remove: it simply stretches between the two sides of the handle, and you can place it at whatever height you want to. It\'s colorful, interactive, soft (so it can be left with baby while driving). It doesn\'t play any music, but that\'s no big loss compared to the Einstein Neptune Bar.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: I agree that this is a great toy and my daughter would grab it as soon as I put her in the carseat, but it is in a tough spot on the carseat for getting baby in and out.  Unless you unattach it and attach it each time, it was a little difficult getting her in without moving her head to the side or moving it up out of the way without hitting her head.Now we are in a big carseat without the handle, so I\'m going to do what the other parent suggested and have her play with it on her lap.  But of course that negates the thrill of moving the fish back and forth.  Any other suggestions of where or how this can be hung???  I\'d love to get some more use out of it and would hate to have to sell it on eBay so soon :)

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: This toy bar is cute. The music plays a very short song. The toy bar will not work on Graco carriers.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: This is by far my favorite gift recieved.  I dont know how it has such few stars because I would give it 5 1/2 if I could. My 3 month old son, Cameron is facinated by the colors and movements when strapped to the handle of his carseat (and it is Graco)!  When I play the music, he gets even more excited. Above all other toys, ranging to hundreds of dollars, Cameron seems most in love with this! It also is the first thing that got him to reach for something.  I would recommend it to anyone!  All of the Einstein toys are wonderful!

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: I love Baby Einstein products but this one is rotten. I agree that when its attached it is really hard to mauever the carrier, plus it hangs low and in baby\'s face. We never noticed ours leaking, it was just empty one day....I told Baby Einstein about it and they mailed me a replacement toy. They were very nice and apologetic.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: My son liked the music of this toy, and would bat at the toys on the bar, but I couldn\'t get him into and out of his car seat with it attached without bopping him on the head.  If the handle of the seat was all the way back, the toy was resting on his head when he was only three months old.  He would cry every time I put him in the car, and I finally realized that he hated the feeling of the toy on his head as I put him into the seat.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: I love this toy BUT..... the way that the elastic velcro attaches to the carrier bar makes the toy hang perpendicular to baby\'s face (I use the Graco Snugride car seat). All that the baby can see are the fish that dangle from the bottom. I haven\'t found any other place that I can use this toy so that baby can see the "water" area.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: We loved this item when our daughter was in her infant carrier.  She loves any Einstein and this item was no different.  She would sit there and bat at the fish and watch Neptune bob around.  She also loved the music.  The only problem was that it was way too loud for an infant!  My husband but 25 layers of masking tape across the speaker to get it to a level that wasn\'t deafing.  It also got a little annoying when it would play the some songs over and over.  So it\'s good item that just needs a bit of improving.

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: Our baby loves this toy , she also has the Baby Neptune video ( which she LOVES too)  Characters float around inside , she can play with the dangly toys and the music is TOO CUTE!!!This is the perfect baby shower gift along with Baby Neptune DVD!!!!!!!

name: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar
review: I love this item but can someone tell me how to keep the music going.  It only plays one song and then stops.  My baby is too little to press the button and I am constantly restarting it. Help me.....my baby loves this toy!!!!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife loves it. Definitely worth the money

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Not as comfortable as it looks.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I\'ve had my pillow for a few months now. I still love the pillow. My husband has started to take naps in it too. He was impressed on how comfortable sleeping in the pillow can be. I love to use the pillow sitting up in bed and reading or working on the computer. I highly recommend this pillow for everyone.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love this pillow, it is a life saver.  One small set back is its hard to get in and out of bed in the middle of the night for the inevitable frequent bathroom runs, but otherwise it has helped me imeasurably to get comfortable and get a good nights sleep.  I imagine the one sided one would be just as good.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am six months pregnant and recently purchased this massive pillow.  It\'s not worth it.  If I used the top of the horse-shoe as a pillow for my head then I got a very stiff neck and the sides just pused away so it didn\'t support my back at all.  If I flipped it over the sides still spread giving no back support and it was a chore to get in and out of bed. Becasue it really gave no back support I wish I had just purchased a regular one-sided body pillow.  Also, as far as using the thing for breast-feeding - No.  It\'s HUGE.  A boppy is much easir and takes up 1/10 of the space.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am currently seven months pregnant and began using this pillow at around 3 or 4 months.  It took a little time to get used to, but I can\'t be without it now!  I love how it supports my growing belly, as well as my back.  I used to be a back-sleeper, but since becoming pregnant, I exclusively sleep on my left side.  This pillow really helps to keep me on my left side, because even if I try to roll onto my back during the night, I\'m not totally flat since I\'m supported by the pillow.  As far as some negative comments go regarding the material of the pillow case, I don\'t have a problem with it.  Also, the seam at the top is tight, which some have said is very uncomfortable for them, but it doesn\'t bother me at all.  Maybe I lay my head far enough down on the pillow that I don\'t feel the seam; I think there are ways to adjust yourself around it. FYI I am 5\'5".

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love sleeping on my back and couldn\'t get comfortable on my side, which is the recommended sleeping position for pregnant women.  I would go to bed on my side but naturally turn onto my back.  The Leachco helped to tilt me up so I wasn\'t directly lying flat on my back.  It also made side sleeping more comfortable by supporting my belly.  As the belly grew I added a couple pillows under the Leachco to prop me up so I was sleeping on an incline.  The Leachco is also flexible enough to double over onto itself for daytime sitting.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: One of the negative reviews I read before I purchased was that the pillow was too heavy and when I saw the size of the box it arrived in, I thought maybe a pillow can be too heavy. It\'s not heavy at all. And I don\'t have a problem with the fabric either. I love the multiple positions of the pillow and the \'nursing\' position. It\'s great that you don\'t have to move the pillow when you switch sides. The only drawback is that you do have to move one of the \'legs\' of the pillow out of the way to get out of bed or it does become a difficult to get a pregnant belly up and out of it. But i\'m for sure going to be using it post-pregnancy as well.My husband loves it too!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is great. I\'m 30 weeks preggo right now and will probably continue to use this pillow long after baby is born.  I\'m 5\'6 and a plus size gal and I feel like this pillow fits me perfectly.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Core Body Pillow Set - Body Pillow with Blue Staph check cover and White Poly/Cotton Pillow casePurchased it for my niece for a baby shower gift. She loves it. She ready to delivery any day and this gives her a lot of comfort and back aupport.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow has helped me sleep when I couldn\'t! It supports my stomach and my back. I was skeptical, but I am glad I purchased it!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow has been a life savor. I am typically a back sleeper so it was not easy for me to get used to sleeping primarily on my side. I can sleep through the night and stay comfortable on my side with this pillow. Worth every penny in my book.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: If you are a person that moves a lot in bed, this pillow is huge, heavy and too high for my like, although it can be use in different positions.  I am hoping to get a better use of it when the baby comes.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I\'ve had this pillow since my fourth month of pregnancy. This pillow is the only thing that I\'ve found that allows me to sleep without pain shooting down my leg due to the pinched nerve that I\'ve developed during pregnancy. In fact, the nerve seems to be healing itself and no longer causes pain when I bend over. This pillow works really well to turn a confirmed stomach sleeper into a side sleeper, because you put your head on the curved portion, one of the long sides between your knees, and then the other long side tight behind you to hold you on your side. Before this pillow, I was getting backaches from the strain of using muscles that I\'d never used before to hold myself on my side, and I\'d always roll back onto my stomach as soon as I went to sleep.There are some downsides to the pillow--firstly, it is huge. My husband jokes that it is my two new boyfriends. Unless you have a  queen sized or larger bed, this will not fit in the bed with you and your husband and you may end up sleeping by yourself in the guest room. Secondly, it is a little tricky to get the cover on and off, although this really is no big deal. Lastly, it does tend to hold you in one position all night, so if you toss and turn a lot, it may frustrate you a bit.Despite those downsides, which caused me to give this pillow a 4 star instead of a 5 star rating, this is the only thing I have found that allows me to get comfortable, relax, and sleep without pain.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I initially did not want to buy one of these pillows because I thought they were sort of silly.  Boy was I wrong!  The pillow is firm enough that it doesn\'t go flat when you\'re all wrapped around it.  I also like that the cover comes off for washing (although it is white, which is kind of a bummer).  All of the different positions you can use this pillow in make it very versatile.  Even my husband wants one!The only con is this pillow is HUGE.  I sleep in a queen sized bed, but anything smaller would probably be too small.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I\'ve been on bedrest for over 10 weeks. I couldn\'t have survived without this pillow!  I started using it even before my tummy became oversized.  It\'s great to be able to turn over without having to readjust the body pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was skeptical at first, because of the other negative reviews.  The pillow is amazing, it is a little short but other than that I am sleeping great!  My hips feel so much better and I wake up only a few times a night but quickly fall back asleep.  Definitely a must have!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Oh my goodness! I\'ve tried all kinds of maternity pillows, with varying success. But this pillow... wow. This is my 5th baby, and I have tailbone issues, usually I find that these pillows are too squishy and soft. Not this one. It fit me (I am 5\'11"), and it gave great support for my back, hips and expanding stomach. I can not say enough good things about it. Instead of dread when I am going to bed, now I am looking forward to nap time and sleep time.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This product worked while I used it.  It just took over our whole bed!  I was so big I didn\'t want anything because I was always uncomfortable

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Best pillow ever I love it! If you have alot of back pain this pillow will help you out soo much :)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I wish I had bought this as soon as I got pregnant.  Well worth the money since it means I get a MUCH better night\'s sleep.  I\'ve recommended it to 2 other pregnant friends and they both love it too.  Some people talked about the seem by the "neck" being too tight.  It is a little tight but I just readjust the pillow a little and haven\'t had an issue.  Love that you can toss and turn and not have to rearrange 20 pillows!  Only downside is that the cover is not that soft.  I\'ve been using it for 3 months or so and its gotten a little pilly in places.  Also, the cover IS removable and washable but its a pain in the tush to get on and off.Not just for pregnant women, my husband got into it when it arrived and immediately asked if we could order another one for him!  Oh, we have a queen sized bed and it takes up slightly more than half the bed.  Fortunately my husband just snuggles up to the outside of it and uses it as a body pillow too so that\'s not a problem for us.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love it, but my husband hates how much room it takes up in the bed- so only 4 stars!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I\'ve been using this thing for almost a week and LOVE it! It\'s made such a difference. Before I used to sleep between two rows of two pillows (five pillows total, counting the one under my head). It was pretty ridiculous...too many moving parts. This is a way better system. I like that it keeps you upright and makes it harder to roll over onto your back in your sleep. I usually tuck a firm tempurpedic-type pillow between my back and the inner back of the pillow to keep me even more upright as well. I see what people were saying about the shoulder seem. They should definitely fix that, but I have been able to overcome that without too much trouble.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is amazing! I borrowed a pregnancy pillow from a friend that was not nearly as good. This is able to support my belly, and back so well. It\'s big and takes up lots of room in the bed but is definitely worth it. And, as always, amazon delivery was amazingly fast!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is a great alternative to having pillows all around me. It\'s fairly comfortable, however getting out of it once you\'re in is tricky. Also, with a queen sized bed it takes up more of my share. Good product though.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow has been a life (well sleep) saver since about 12 weeks into my triplet pregnancy.  It is perfect for holding up and supporting a large belly.  The other side of the pillow is prefect for supporting your back.  I even use it to prop up in bed while eating reading and using the laptop.  Perfect for those confined to the bed for any reason.  I LOVE THIS PILLOW.  My husband even sleeps with his head on the pillow so we don\'t feel so separated.Perfect present for the expectant mama.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Worked good until it became flat in the head section then I had to have another pillow on top of it. Took up most of the queen size bed and was hard to get the cover on and off. Eventually stopped using it. Mainly because I hated fighting it to get up and go pee all the time. Otherwise it was a life saver!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I have never been so immediately comfortable when getting in bed. I am a side sleeper who likes to be surrounded when sleeping, so this is perfection. The seem at the top a uncomfortable at first, but I find if I move down slightly that it doesn\'t rub my shoulder. I also have terrible acid reflux, and pregnancy has made it much worse. I usually sleep with a pillow on top of this to sit up a bit. Overall, this is making my pregnancy sleep so great that I sleep like a baby!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Amazing best thing for any woman who is pregnant looking for support my boyfriend doesn\'t like it not very good for very snuggly couples!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I have been using this pillow since I was about 3 months along (I\'m now in my 8th month), and it has been a lifesaver!  It\'s incredibly comfortable - my husband is always trying to steal it!  Lots of reviewers have mentioned the seam being a problem, but it has NEVER bothered me at all.  I rotate from side to side, and this pillow has consistently been comfortable for me.  I credit it for the fact that I am still sleeping through the night at this later stage of my pregnancy!  It does take up a lot of the bed, but my husband and I have a queen-size bed, and we still make it work.Earlier this week I traveled somewhere and forgot the pillow, which I thought wouldn\'t be a big deal.  Wow, was I wrong!  I had a terrible night\'s sleep - propping myself up with various small pillows was just not the same.  My friend recommended this pillow to me, and I\'m now recommending it to my other pregnant friends!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I have a rare condition this pregnancy called vasa previa. Because of it I\'ve had to be in the hospital since 31 weeks (I\'ll deliver at 34). My sister sent me this pillow as soon as I came in here and I\'m so grateful! I went 3 days without it and the difference in comfort between those days and now (I\'ve been in 1 1/2 weeks now) is huge! It\'s so so comfy!My sister is pregnant with twins and has been using it to sleep since the beginning of her pregnancy. She always talked about how awesome it was, but since I wasn\'t uncomfortable at night I didn\'t look into it. Now I\'m wondering how I\'ll ever be able to sleep without it, even when not pregnant. Love it!!! I keep saying it feels like I\'m sleeping on clouds now.Because it\'s a bit pricey and not a necessity this is what I\'ll say. If you\'re having a hard time sleeping and getting comfortable at night, it\'s worth the price. If money isn\'t an issue, get it even if you can sleep at night; you\'ll be even more comfortable with it.  If you\'re on bed rest at home or in the hospital GET IT! It makes a huge difference!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife has been using this pillow since the beginning of her pregnancy and has eased back pain. I recommend it 100%

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I read so many reviews about this pillow and was aware that many women had trouble with the seam at the top of the pillow (it digs into your neck / shoulders)...but I was so desperate for a front and back support pillow that I bought it anyway.  What a mistake!  The seam is worse than I thought - I tried covering it with a blanket, then a pillow, then I tried flipping the pillow around so my head could rest on the two "legs" of the pillow.  That didn\'t work either.  Honestly, WHAT is this company thinking?!  Why don\'t they just change the design?  Isn\'t the whole point to sleep comfortably?!  I was almost in tears I had been so excited for a restful night\'s sleep after weeks of discomfort, and after ten minutes of wrestling with the pillow I put it back in the box and I\'m returning it today.PS: I\'m 5\'7" which might also contribute to my discomfort.  I tried to scoot down to avoid the seam altogether, and the pillow then became too short.  I can see that if I were much shorter and scooted down, it might have been fine.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Where has this pillow been all of my life?  Not just for pregnant women!  I should have gotten this pillow long ago!  My children even pile on with me!  It is great! I just purchased it as a gift for my mom too!  Enjoy!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was thrilled to receive this maternity pillow because of so many good reviews and claims to alleviate back and body tension. So far it has failed for me in every category and I am very disappointed I wasted the money. List of complaints below:CONS:-Can\'t lay on your side with it comfortably because the large weight of the pillow cause your arms to fall sleep or go numb. (Needs thinner sections there like the Boppy maternity pillow has)-Causes added pain to my lower back instead of helping-BURNING HOT, causes me too sweat since the fabric is horrible and pillow so large.-ITCHY fabric cover, despite having washed several times with various fabric softeners-no cover available for it, needs to have a soft cover option available because one that comes with it is horrible itchy-bulky and huge, don\'t recommend for anyone who doesn\'t have a king size bed. (I have a king so least of my issues with this pillow, but notable for queen or smaller beds)PROSHolds thickness shape.Synopsis, don\'t waste your money on this pillow. I have honestly yet to find a maternity pillow I really like, but I do think my Boppy maternity body pillow provides far more comfort for side sleeping than this pillow ever could. I can NOT side sleep with this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This body pillow was great at first. I was 7 months pregnant when I purchased it.  I am now 8 months and the pillow has gone completely flat on both sides. This is where you need support for your belly.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Started using at 14 weeks when hips, back, & knees started hurting. I\'m 6\'1", works awesomely. Is large, but even in a king bed, my husband is still the main bed hog.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This was a life saver with my twin pregnancy. I didn\'t like it in the initial months,until my third semester. It was more of a discomfort until then.With the third trimester every thing changed. The double sided pattern gave excellent support for my protruding belly and sore back. I had no back aches all through my pregnancy and I believe  this pillow to be one of the main reasons.I had to wean myself out it, of a month after the delivery, since it was becoming difficult to get up frequently.The only other thing that I wish for, is a cover. Highly recommend this product for pregnant moms.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Mom started using this at about month 5 and loved it through out.  Much better than separate pillows which come out during the night.  Great product.  Only issue is covering it so it doesn\'t get dirty...we used a bed sheet.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: my wife loved this pillow and was great for travel. I am guilty of using it when she wasn\'t. cover does come off for washing but can be a little tricky to put back on. post pregnancy we use it to sit in and watch tv or for support holding the baby

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: She wanted to keep using it even after my son was born, but it was too big. In fact, she still has it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Before ordering the Back \'N Belly, my wife\'s hips were hurting her so badly that she could hardly get any sleep at night. She was incredibly stressed due to this. As soon as my wife received her Back \'N Belly pillow, she was able to sleep wonderfully, eliminating her sleeping problems. She was waking up every two hours to change sides, but with a chiropractic adjustment, she was able to sleep as much as five hours straight on her Back \'N Belly pillow. I highly recommend this product for pregnant women with pelvic pain or husbands being attacked by their pregnant wives due to their pelivc pain (just kidding - don\'t hurt me hunny)!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: While this pillow offers a lot of support I found it restrictive and a little overwhelming. I also did not like the the stitching on the inside seam; particularly where my neck would rest because it would cut into my neck as I tried to sleep. Overall, this pillow was too cumbersome and the stitching too tight. I prefer the Snoogle.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: If you\'re thinking of buying a contoured pillow you\'ve found it. My husband purchased this pillow for me early on in my pregnancy because I was having an issue getting comfortable with traditional pillows. I absolutely LOVE this pillow and sleep with it every single night and have not had one night of restless sleep since our purchase. My husband even sleeps in it when he can pry it away from me and finds it just as comfortable.Some things to consider:-The pillow is slightly flatter now that I\'ve used it consistently for 7 months but I\'m sure if you fluff this pillow often it will retain its shape.- It is a large pillow and takes up my whole side of the bed on our Cal King. We have also used it on a queen bed and it takes up a great amount of space BUT there no complaints from either my husband or myself.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I\'m 7 months pregnant and reaching that stage where it\'s hard to find that comfortable position. While I\'m not as thrilled about this pillow as I thought I was going to be, it is easier to get comfortable and sleep with it. It has it\'s pros and cons. First, I found this pillow is super flexible. I can fold the side up and slide out of bed in the middle of the night for my bathroom runs. I was thinking I would have to climb over it but that\'s not the case, so hubby can still sleep.  I think I\'ll still use this pillow after the baby is born because it\'s so flexible you can bend it however you like. Keep in mind it won\'t just stay in that bend position of course, it isn\'t a pipe cleaner, but it\'s flexibility makes it versatile.However, while the flexibility is great, I was hoping for more firmer support in the belly area and the area just above where your bump would lay. If you look at the photos of this product, from the area in the middle for bump support to the area of the "u" bend is leaves much to be desired. It seems there is less filling there, and mine naturally folds there. That\'s how I flip it up to get out of bed.  It\'s also bad because that\'s where I want to ideally lay my head since the "u" bend is so uncomfortable for the neck and shoulders. It\'s the seam there I think, there is another review that explains it.I used to be more of a stomach side sleeper, but as my pregnancy progressed I found myself more and more wanting to sleep on my back. The main reason I got a pillow like this rather than a candy cane shaped one is cause I thought it would help keep me on my side and still support my back and bump.  Not really the case for me, like I said, it\'s super flexible.  I like this pillow rather than continuously propping myself up all night with 3 or 4 pillows, but it wasn\'t my dream pillow.  I say take your chances and return it if it\'s not the one for you.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this body pillow at random I\'ve heard of them from my girlfriends who have carried there children and they sware by them. The pillow it\'s self is huge but is well worth the money the pillow is beautifully made although I do wish it had  a zipper for easy cleaning.  But my husband has already fell asleep on it and swares by it. It also breathes easily it seems... anyway I am in love with this pillow

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My daughter is now 6 weeks old, and I bought this pillow early on in my pregnancy.  I didn\'t like the Snoogle, which seemed like it didn\'t support your whole body.  This pillow did the trick though, and I could sleep without any backpain or even lay it on the floor to watch TV.  My only complaints are that it\'s HUGE and will most likely push your partner out of the bed.  Also, it\'s absolutely useless for breastfeeding.  It advertises that you can use it similar to a Boppy, but it\'s too difficult to manuever, and by that time your child is screaming for food.  If it actually did work as a breastfeeding pillow, it would get 5 stars.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Awesome product. my wife is 7 months preggo and she love this thing.a must have for preganacy!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Saved my sleeping!!! I was not comfortable at all before I got this pillow, now I sleep! Highly recommend this to anyone!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow in my first trimester - it was my first pregnancy related purchase.  I had just come back from spending a week in a hotel bed and was having trouble finding comfortable sleeping positions so I made the splurge.This pillow is better than the other body pillows because when you turn over onto your other side (which you do a lot during the night when you are restless and pregnant, you don\'t need to flip the pillow with you.  This pillow feels like a big hug!  It also replaces your actual pillow and I find it props your head up a bit more which is helpful with the acid reflux that comes later in pregnancy.There are two cons to this pillow.  First, if you sleep in a queen bed with someone else, they are going to have a lot less room once you start using this.  I have become such a restless light sleeper that my spouse and I can\'t share a bed right now anyway (he\'s a loud sleeper) so it\'s a non-issue but otherwise be warned this may not make your spouse happy!  The alternative for many people is similar though because you end up using multiple pillows to prop yourself up during the night and make sure you don\'t roll onto your back.Second, the cover that comes with the pillow pills very quickly - I noticed it within one month and the replacement cover that\'s sold on Amazon is really expensive.  I will have to buy another one if I try to resell this when the baby is born but I\'m just dealing with it now.  Some other reviewers said that the pillowcase seam is sharp - I don\'t agree - and that it\'s hard to get on and off to wash - not really.All and all highly recommended!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I think the biggest problem with this is that its so overstuffed. This doesn\'t seem to be an issue except that at the very top the inner piece of fabric is so tight that it cuts into your neck. It really hurts! And if you try to move some stuffing around there is nowhere for it to go, so you are just stuck. We washed the cover and could barely get it back on. I have thought many times that i just want to cut it open and pull out some stuffing.Also if you dont sleep in a king size bed dont expect another person to sleep in the same bed with you.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am 6 monthes pregnant and I was just starting to have alot of trouble sleeping.  I bought this pillow and I love it!  I sleep straight through the night now with out tossing and turning trying to get comfortable.  I have alot less trouble with back pain throughout the day since using this product.  Unlike some of the other pregnancy body pillows I\'ve seen, this one supports both the total back and belly at the same time. It feels so cozy.  It also helps keep me on my side because with out it I tend to end up on my back every night.  My husband says I look so comfortable sleeping with this pillow that he wants to use the pillow to sleep after I have the baby. He\'ll have to fight me for it! Sometimes I even use it to sit or lay comfortably on the couch or floor.  You can use it in so many ways.  Definetely worth the money!  At first I was afraid when ordering the pillow that it would take up too much space in our queen size bed and bother my husband but I was so glad to find out it really doesn\'t.  Great product.  I would recommend every pregnant woman who has back pain and trouble sleeping to buy this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife was a bit skeptical at first, since I bought this for her as a surprise, but once she actually slept on it, and realized she can roll over, without having to move the pillow along with her every time, she\'s been in heaven.She\'s been using it for the last few months now and I\'m always hearing how great this pillow is.  Definitely a winner.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I would recommend this product.  I wouldn\'t give it 5 stars only because my hip pain isn\'t completely gone.  I will state that I\'ve slept much better since I\'ve gotten this pillow.  My hip pain has minimized quite substantially.  I love how you can go from one side to the other.It is quite large.  My husband says it takes up WAY more than half of our queen bed.  I don\'t agree.  I think it takes up a little more than half (he is just not used to being totally on his half).

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was hoping this would help me sleep more comfortably and help my back but it did the opposite.  I went from slight back pain to sciatica that caused me to not be able to walk for 2 days.  I am not saying that the pillow caused it, but it certainly didn\'t help it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I couldn\'t sleep well after my belly is getting bigger.Even though I have some pillows, that was not that comfortable.But, this pillow made it easier.Thanks :)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow was very supportive to my baby belly and my back.  My husband was worried I would keep using it after our daughter was born, and I was tempted!  Will use again for 2nd pregnancy!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was hesitant spending this much money for a pillow I would only use for a few months.  This pillow however, has made a world of a difference!  It took a little getting used to, but now that I am used to it, I am not waking up with a aching back anymore, and have the support that I need.  I cannot sleep without this pillow now that I am 30 weeks pregnant!  I highly recommend this pillow for any pregnant woman!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I have two major gripes about this product.1) It\'s made for someone around 5\'4".  Since it\'s "contours" are the appeal, you had better be the right body size or else it\'s no different than a normal body pillow (only much more expensive.)  If you are any taller the benefit is lost.2) How expensive is stuffing?  You would think very pricey by they way they skimp on this.  Mine was missing about a cubic foot from one of the ends, but more importantly, missing another cubic foot right where the head goes.  Huge empty spot.  And you can\'t really "re-adjust" the stuffing.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow for my wife, and needless to say she loves it. She takes it everywhere we go (if we are staying overnight) and it is very comfortable to lay on. The only difficulty she had was getting the pillow cover back on after she washed it. That took some muscle and some patience, two things that a pregnant wife would much rather her husband do than herself.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I have to say right of the bat, this is the comfiest pillow ever! It is nice and firm and stays put. It has really helped with side sleeping which is insanely painful for me. Actually its so comfy 3 year old son (who fits exactly inside the pillow) keep trying to steal it from me. As does my husband! Honestly, I can\'t say enough good things about this pillow!!! I am actually able to sleep almost entirely free of pain because of this! And even with me cuddled up with this, it still only takes up half the queen size bed. My husband complains about how little space he has, but he does that even when it\'s not on the bed so I ignore him. The only thing I hate about this thing (yes hate!) is that the pillowcase is a complete pain in the butt to put back on once you have washed it! If they made it with a zipper instead of a regular style case this would be perfect. Oh,the seam along the curve of the U is kinda painful on your neck and shoulders when you use it next to your head instead of at you feet but bunching a sheet or regular pillowcase along it completely solves that problem.  For me as I have at least a dozen pillowcases this is no big deal. But it might be for others.  It\'s still so amazing that even these flaws don\'t deserve to knock down the rating. I am so glad I bit the bullet on this and got it. We almost didn\'t due to it being $40 for a pillow but it is way worth the cost even if your on a tight budget. As an extra note, I was previously sleeping on my side bundled up in about 6-8 crappy Walmart pillows that went everywhere, never held their shape and that are NOT much help. My main problems were due to pain in my knees, hips, and shoulders and now it\'s almost 100% pain free! Normally I sleep on either my stomach or my back, so this is also invaluable at keeping me on my side.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: VERY COMFORTABLE. HELPS WITH FINDING A  TOLERABE SLEEPING POSITION DURING PREGNANCY.  ONLY COMPLAINT IS IT\'S SIZE...ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE TO USE ON A QUEEN SIZE BED WITH YOUR SPOUSE, BUT I WAS DESPERATE!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Great pillow.  The only thing I don\'t like is how tight the fabric is at the top where your neck goes.  You almost need to cut a slit in it or something.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Love this pillow! It made sleeping so much easier for me while pregnant. It gives you support where you need it and you can move it around however you like to add comfort. It also keeps wild sleepers in one position. This is the main reason I bought it so I would make sure I was not sleeping on my back, which is a huge no no while pregnant. I love it so much I don\'t think I will put it away after I give birth. It\'s awesome. Definitely a necessary item to have when your pregnant!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow just before i got pregnant. Sadly it didnt even last all the way throught the pregnancy before it started bunching. I have had it less than a year and it has some spots with no fill and some with lots. It is to bulky so you have to lift up one side to get in and out of bed which makes breaks in the fill. After less than a year most of the fill has gone flat.The pillowcase is very difficult to get on and off and it ripped trying to get it over the pillow. Can you say zipper?I am going to purchase a diffent brand of full body pillow that comes apart and has a zippered pillowcase.Shop around before you buy!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought 2 - one for a pregnant friend and one for me (several pinched nerves in neck, arm and lower back).  I day dream about it when I\'m not at home!  When my friends come to my house and try it they don\'t want to leave!  My pregant friend\'s husband is jealous of it!  I think I\'m developing deep feelings for it! :-)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This maternity pillow is a great improvement over having nothing at all - or just a regular pillow between your legs, but I find that I still have to get another pillow to put between my back and the maternity pillow for support when I\'m laying on my side because the back support is just not there for me - this is why I gave it only 3 stars.It\'s comfortable and better than nothing. I am happy I purchased it just wished it supported my back a little more.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is not just for pregnant women.  It works great for arthritics, too.  I\'m only 51 and already have very bad arthritis pain in my knees, hips, foot and sometimes back.  I love sleeping with this body pillow.  It helps me sleep on my back better (I WAS a stomach sleeper) and longer.  I am short and this cuts in at the bottom in just the right place to elevate my legs just enough.  For side sleeping, it keeps my knees from having to touch, which causes great pain, quickly.  This pillow also helps keep me snuggly and warm, which helps my arthritis, too.When I just want to rest or read a book, it can be folded to prop me up at just the right angle.  It would be perfect for bedtime TV watching, too.The down side is the inside curve of the head part of the pillow.  It should have been made with elastic and shirring.  It tends to cut tightly across my shoulder at times.  I have to readjust my position to avoid that.  Also, this seems to be molded more for short people.  At 5\'2", it\'s just perfect for me.  But, I don\'t know if it would be as helpful for a taller person.  I\'m going to try some of the other suggestions of turning the pillow around and using my own pillow for my head and see how that works.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am 7 mos pregnant and this was the best purchase I have made so far this pregnancy.  It supports my tummy and back at the same time helps me get good sleep that has evaded me for a while.  First drawback is the head pillow part w/c is not that supportive so I use another pillow on top of it to lay my head while I sleep.  Second point is the size.  It is big.  We have a Cal King and you can see how this pillow could gobble a sizeable portion of the bed.  Otherwise every one in the family loves to use it so most of the time it is unavailable.  My daughter wants a small one for herself.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love my pillow. It was just the right price. Highly recommend. Most comfortable pillow I have ever owned. If you have neck pain at night this is a must purchase.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was desperate to find anything that would help me get to sleep at night during my pregnancy and this pillow is the answer! It is bulky and takes up alot of room, but it truly is comfortable and helps with back/hip pain.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My Wife loves it, it has good back support for good nights rest and cost less than in store pillows

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife she ordered this a week or two ago, since then it helps keep her snuggled and warm in between her pains of growing a baby. She loves this pillow, and recommends it to anyone! My wife is about 5\' 10, she loves how the pillow holds her, so ya if you need a good preggo pillow swag, I recommend this one! :)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is the greatest purchase of my entire pregnancy. This pillow provides my body with the extra support I need to sleep comfortably. I also look forward to using it for nursing when the baby is born. My husband and my dog love it too!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Pregnancy must have. It is huge but helpful. I had a lot of hip and shoulder pain during pregnancy, got this at 5 months and used it until a few weeks after delivery.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is worth the money! In my 6 months of pregnancy, I was having sleepless nights. Trying to shift from side to side while sleeping and avoiding the back proved too hard for me! What made it worse was when I had to rearrange or shift my wedge and regular pillows each time I switched sides. With the Back \'N Belly pillow, I don\'t have to worry about this at all! I begin sleeping on one side and end up moving to my other side during the night with zero problems.I borrowed the idea from one of the submitted reviews. She suggested taking a pillow case, cutting off one end, and sliding it onto the Back \'N Belly. You can rest your head without worrying about getting any makeup stains or oily face stains on your pillow during naps or throughout the night. No frequent washes of the entire body pillow needed - just the pillowcase. It works!My husband and I have a king-sized bed. The pillow takes up half the bed, but it would still work with a queen-sized bed. If you are already using regular pillows for your back and sides, this body pillow is no different! In any case, you may find that your husband will want to cozy up to the pillow with you. My husband does - leaving plenty of space on the bed.I recommend this pillow to all pregnant women!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I has having such trouble sleeping until I got this pillow. Its great because it wraps around my entire body and I don\'t need to turn it over if I want to switch sides while sleeping. I would highly recommend it!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am a pillow person and I love this pillow.  Yes, it does have a seem that can be tight across the neck and it gets pretty warm but it cannot be beat for comfort.  As far as the seam goes, I just have to move the pillow up an inch and it no longer bothers me.I am already a side sleeper and toss and turn a lot so that is what I like best about this pillow.  Also I did not realize initially that it has a washable cover but it does so that was a bonus!I recommended this to a friend and she is enjoying hers too!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Have been using this for the past month and really like it. I am NOT a side sleeper, and I knew I would have issues staying on my side once I got to that point in my pregnancy.
