This pillow hugs the body really well and helps keep you in a side position throughout the night. Of course I do wake up on my back every now and then, but far less than without the pillow. I really like the curved contour of the pillow, as it provides great support for back and belly--which some of the other, straight pillows don\'t provide. My biggest gripe is that the section of the pillow where your neck and head goes is really tight so that if you put it directly around your shoulders it cuts into your skin. I had a hard time with that at first, but just adjusted the way I sleep with it and that seems to have worked. I kind of sleep on top of the neck area, rather than having it hug my shoulders and neck. Would recommend this pillow to others.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is amazing!  Starting with 2nd trimester I had a really hard time getting comfortable and didn\'t sleep well.  This pillow is sooo comfortable and I can finally sleep through the night.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow has given me the best sleep I\'ve had in four months!!!  It is like a full-body snuggle, whether I\'m sleeping on my back, side or tummy.  That\'s right -- at 31 weeks, I can nap on my tummy with this pillow!  It takes the place of all four pillows that I was using to sleep only half-comfortably.  It can actually support both your back and your belly and knees as you sleep!As the other reviewers said, the major drawback is the built-in distance from my husband.  However, my husband has also napped on this pillow, and will probably fight me for it after the baby comes.I\'ve had some trouble supporting my neck, because I was used to chiropractic pillows and dog-bones.  There is so much to love about this pillow, though.  I\'m sure I\'ll continue to find better positions as I get used to it.If you need sleep, and you\'re willing to wait until the baby arrives to see your husband again, this pillow is worth the price!!!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow has been the best material investment I\'ve made during my pregnancy and I don\'t regret the money spent at all!  I have 4 more weeks to go and have slept great every night since buying this pillow.  I am so glad I decided to go with the full wrap-around pillow because I like the option to switch sides without having to roll the whole pillow over to the other side with me.  If I want to feel like I am sleeping on my back, the other side keeps me tilted up a bit so as not to be flat on my back.  I tend to get claustrophobic easily, so I was worried this pillow would just be too much for me, but it has been great all around!  Highly recommended!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I started getting horrible back pain while sleeping when I was only 12-13 weeks pregnant.  After trying to find a store that carried maternity pillows with no luck, I ordered this one online.  I hated having to wait a week to get it, but what a change it has made in my sleep!  I am supported in a variety of positions and wake up with no back pain about 95% of the time.  The downsides are that you probably will need a king size bed if you still want to sleep with your partner, and the case is difficult to get off and not very high quality fabric.  Neither of those things is a reason not to get it if you are in pain, though.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I waited until I was 7.5 months pregnant to purchase this and I wish I bought it sooner.  It supports my back and my belly at the same time and allows me restful nights.  It is quite large and takes up a lot of room, but it is worth it.  There are many options on how to use it and it is a great investment.  I am not sure how it will be as a nursing pillow, but we will see.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow when I was pregnant with my second child. I am a side and back sleeper and have slept for most of my life with a little pillow under my knees. But it gets awkward when switching from side to side or from back to side, having to readjust the pillow without waking up. With my first pregnancy I got a long pillow but that was even more of a challenge to move around without stealing all the covers from my husband while transferring a very large pillow over a very large tummy.So with my second pregnancy I found this pillow and never looked back. There is no need to readjust the pillow as I turn from side to side. There is full support for knees, arms and back, and tummy (when you are pregnant). In a queen it was a tight squeeze but it fits no problem on a king size bed.The only problem is I can\'t wean myself off it. After my dd was born I tried to get rid of it but was begging my husband to let me use it again after only a few nights. He calls it the "Great Wall" but humours me since I am much happier with a good night\'s sleep. I love the full support it gives. It is like being a big body hug all night. The pillow case is somewhat of a pain to get back on after taking it off to wash, but I can live with that inconvenience for the comfort it brings. I like this pillow so much I even took the time to write this review. :)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this when pregnancy forced me to start sleeping on my side.  I\'ve never been a side sleeper and initially tried wedging normal pillows around me.  That didn\'t work so I eventually sought out this fabulous item.  It has literally made the difference between me being well rested or exhausted and uncomfortable all night long.  I was initially concerned because of the seam issue raised in a previous review.  However, when the pillow arrived, I found that although the seam might be uncomfortable, the issue was 100% resolved simply by placing a pillow on top of this one in the area where your head will go - thus covering the seam and eliminating any potential discomfort.  The pillow is large - if you have anything smaller than a queen sized bed you or your partner might need a new place to snooze, however, the size is what makes it comfortable.  At night I can roll over without having to relocate anything but myself.  Since it wraps around, it mostly prevents accidentally sleeping on my stomach or back which could be harmful to baby and it\'s substantive without being too big to be cuddly as the person inside it.  This pillow is amazing and I\'d highly recommend it if sleeping on your side doesn\'t come naturally to you.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: The BEST pregnancy pillow!! (granted the first one I\'ve ever tried)- but the fact that it wraps around your whole body gives you support belly and back.  And, it can help you lay on your back a little bit on an incline and relieve belly pressure too.  It is big and takes up over half the queen size bed but its worth it. My husband doesnt mind it because now I dont drape my legs over him in the middle of the night making him all hot and sweaty...  This pillow is a pricey one but worth every penny. I am so happy I bought it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: MY wife loves it.I can see getting rid of this after the pregnancy will be a problem :DGreat product!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I did A TON of research before purchasing. Ultimately I LOVE THIS PILLOW... just took some alterations and some trial and error with sleeping positions.First is the price.... is it worth it? I think so! I used a simple body pillow while pregnant with my son 4 years ago, it worked, okay, and we were more strapped financially so I didn\'t really have the option of spending the extra money on something like this. This time around, I decided I would treat myself to some comfort in the last 6 months of my pregnancy. But still couldn\'t justify spending more then $40/$50 bucks on a pillow that would maybe be used after pregnancy. if you have a little wiggle room in your budget, go for it! If funds are more on the tight side, I would stick with the body pillow and save the money for diapers and wipes that you absolutely must buy once baby comes :o)Second, the neck seam!!!!! I will say that the other reviews are right ... the seam that rests where your neck goes is TERRIBLE!!! like leaves a mark terrible, If you want to buy a pillow and use it right way without having to do anything to fix it... this is not for you... BUT I found an easy solution, and if you are willing to take about 15 minutes... it will be a perfect solution!(((take the outside cover off and get to the main pillow... simply rip the seam (where your neck will rest) straight across.... I hand sewed a new scrap of material to make that more rounded, (took maybe 15 minutes) and now its FANTASTIC! I also made a satin slip cover (have basic sewing machine skills) and now I know that I will use it once home from the hospital ... as long as my husband lets me take up half the bed with the pillow.Third issue, YES ITS GIANT!!! we have a king size bed and it definitely takes up half the bed, sometimes, depending on how I"m sleeping it will creep over into my husbands side... but honestly, when being pregnant, if he has to deal with the occasional pillow interference, I think he will survive, he also hates that it\'s basically a snuggle cocoon and does not allow for any contact at night ... but again, LADIES, sometimes you just want to get a good nights sleep!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Definitely recommend this! I can\'t imagine what I would have done without this pillow.Makes sleep very comfortable. Definite value for money! Must have :)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is an amazing pillow! Although my husband has to look over my pillow to even see me, I have been sleeping so much better since I received this pillow. If you have hip pain and you hate dragging a pillow from one side to the other when you turn over to the other side at night, then this is the pillow for you! Sleeping on the closed end of this pillow is just okay, but I prefer my own pillow and sleep with the open end at my head. For those who complain about the seam at the neck, just sleep with it the other way like I do. This has proven to be even more comfortable and it does not bother me to rotate the other leg under the pillow when I turn over in the middle of the night, it becomes second nature and I hardly notice it. While I do have to pull the other side close to me every once in a while, having to do so does not keep me from liking this pillow. I move so much at night that I\'m not even sure if I have to pull the pillow closer because I moved or the pillow moved. This is a very big pillow (my son refers to it as "mommy\'s boat") but it has been worth it for every good night of sleep I have gained with this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I got this for my wife as just before her birthday we learned that she was expecting.  While she says it does get the job done she keeps complaining about how hard the inseam is.  I tried it out for myself and it dug into my skin. We\'re going to try loosening the seam but in the future we\'ll be sure to look for one that doesn\'t have an inseam.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I tried this pillow during my pregnancy at various stages and it did nothing for me. It is gigantic and hard to move around. It is overstuffed and uncomfortable. All of the curves hit me at the wrong places, maybe I am too tall for this pillow at 5\'9". It is expensive and costs a lot to ship back, so make sure you really, really want this big uncomfortable pillow before you buy it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife loves it! The shape allows it to have multiple uses and folds to support your body depending on your need.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I loved this pillow it has helped me so much with the back pain and sleeping at night especially in this last trimester.The only thing is that the pillow is huge but its so worth having trust me you will want this on the last month pregnancy there are so many ways you can position the pillow to fit yor needs.I have a king size bed so its really not that bad.I think if you have a queen bed you will still be ok it will take up ur whole side of the bed.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am in my fifth pregnancy. For my first 2 pregnancies I didn\'t have a pillow like this, and I had so much difficulty getting a good night\'s sleep with the extra aches, pains and weight of pregnancy. For these last 3 pregnancies, I have slept SO WELL. I curl up into this pillow and rest comes EASILY. I am totally comfortable and there is a place to rest my back, my belly and my legs all while sticking with the recommended sleeping position of being on my left hand side. You can even position yourself to be able to sleep semi on your back because the sides of the pillow keep the weight from being directly on your back. I am always so comfortable on this pillow! From the first trimester to the third trimester this pillow is the one thing that will SAVE your pregnancy sleep! I couldn\'t recommend it more. It\'s a little tricky the first time you go to wash it--figuring out the pillow slip is pretty complicated, but once you get the hang of it, subsequent washes are no big deal.I couldn\'t recommend this pillow more highly!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: At 4.5 months of pregnancy my back and hips started to hurt.  I knew that it was related to my sleep because it hurt most when I woke up.  My husband bought me this pillow and it was a life saver.Plus:-Hip Support-Belly Support-Back Support (bring the back side of the pillow close and below you)-You can flip sides without having to flip a huge pillow-Although very big, my husband and I still fit in the bed and he says he likes that I am now kept from moving so much by the boundaries of the pillowNegative:-Its Big (But, this is the only way you are going to get that back support as well.  Before I bought this pillow I was sleeping with a pillow between my knees.  Every time I switched sides I would have to bring the pillow across, etc.  Plus, the support that this pillow provides cannot compare to having a pillow wedged between your knees.)-Seam (I put the pillow up just a tad higher or sleep a little bit a way from my arm.  Both of these strategies work for me and the seam has never been an issue.No Pillow is perfect.  But, hands down I think this is the best pregnancy pillow out there.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am currently 29 weeks pregnant and have been sleeping with this pillow since very early on. I love it. I didn\'t have one with my first pregnancy and was miserable all the time. This makes the sleep i get at least a little more comfortable.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: If you are pregnant, this is a must have. I wish I would have purchased it earlier in my pregnancy. The support it offers all around while sleeping is great.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I can\'t say enough about this pillow.  I love it!  I was worried it would be too short since I am 5\'9", but I guess because I have a short torso and long legs it works well for me.  I read reviews that people found the head part to be too full and thick, but I don\'t think it is too thick at all.  All a personal preference, I guess.This has been a great purchase that has really helped me to get some sleep!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this for my wife and she absolutly loves it.  She is able to get a good night sleep, everynight.  Great product.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I received this body pillow for Christmas. It is the best gift ever! I am 20 weeks into my pregnancy and so glad I will have it for those uncomfortable last few months. We have a queen size bed and it does take up about half of the bed. But it is well worth the bulk and I\'d recommend it to anyone.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was nervous about buying such a big pillow, but after several months of poor sleep I had to try something.  The first night I used this pillow I did not get up even once!!  I cannot believe the difference it makes in how well I sleep.  And even though it\'s rather large, my husband sleeps better because I am not tossing and turning every 5 seconds!  This pillow is so cozy and comfortable I wish I\'d bought it sooner.  It is a little cumbersome to get into and out of until you get the hang of it, so I would suggest to make sure you have everything you need before you crawl into bed.  You won\'t regret buying this pillow, but you might regret how long you waited to buy it!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I can not say enough good things about this pillow!  It was bought as a gift for me and i ABSOLUTELY love it!  AFter a few months of not sleeping well, I sleep perfectly now!  I also like that it came with instructions on different ways it can be used during and after pregnancy, it made us laugh at the time but really I wouldn\'t have thought to use it that way!  This is a great pillow and the price is reasonable too.  If you\'re pregnant and having a hard time getting comfortable, meet your new best friend!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Got me through the second half of pregnancy with more sleep than I would have had without it! Definitely a must for pregnant mamas!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I feel like I\'m sleeping in a plush little nest, so comfortable and supportive in all the right places.  I can see how other reviewers have said the cover isn\'t the softest, and yes is a bit tight in the u-end of the pillow.  I find it most comfortable with my shoulders on top of the U with a flattish down pillow on top of the Leachco pillow.  The extra elevation helps my sinuses and alleviates the shoulder in the u-seam problem others have noted.  Very happy with this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: It helps relieve pressure off my back when I use it between my knees. I don\'t regret the purchase! I\'m satisfied!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was starting to wake up from bad back pain in the beginning of my third trimester.  I bought this pillow and it\'s been great.  I can sleep longer without waking up from back aches.  I also plan on using it for nursing.  I like that I can sleep on either side without having to adjust the pillow.  Some reviewers complained about the seam digging into their shoulders.  I did not have this problem.  I\'m 5\'2" and found that the size of the pillow was fine for me.  Seems pricey for a pillow but the comfort is well worth it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: There is lots to love about this pillow. The shape, it\'s machine washable, and can serve a variety of purposes. But, this product has lost a lot of points with me because it\'s just not thick enough.  Although I gave an average weight and height, I\'ve found that when I lie on my side I have to add extra pillows or bed coverings to alleviate the weight of my top leg on the supportive leg. That\'s aggravating because it requires constant adjustment.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: perfect body pillow for my pregnant wife! it was very useful now that she is on her 7th month. it provides her comfort for her back and tummy as well.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Like others have mentioned, the seam around the neck can dig into your shoulder and be quite uncomfortable. I use a very thin down pillow to pad that seam, but my problem is more related to the overall length of the pillow. I am 5\'9" and would prefer support at least to my ankles, if not all the way past my feet. Unfortunately, this pillow only reaches just past my knees and my bulging belly doesn\'t let me pull my legs up high enough to keep my ankles supported. I don\'t find it very helpful for sleeping.I do however love it for lounging in bed. If I add another pillow for my head, it provides great support for watching TV or reading in bed.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this for my daughter who had been having back pain so she was having trouble sleeping.  This pillow allows her to get comfortable and get the sleep she needs.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife loved this! She was having some back pains and interruptions in her sleep. This helped greatly with both! Kodos for dad to be... She thought this was the greatest thing!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Thankfully I have a king size bed because this takes a lot of room.  It is very comfortable and well made.  My husband and my dog LOVE to cuddle with it.  At first, I thought that the cover would be diffucult to get on and off for washing but it\'s pretty easy.  I would recommend this product.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is such a comfortable pillow! Definitely helps take the pressure off my back and belly. I\'ve been using this for 2 weeks now and this was the best purchase I made to help me sleep better. This pillow is big, but it fits perfectly on a queen sized mattress, and my husband has plenty of room on his side. This pillow cuddles you, so you won\'t toss and turn all night. It literally feels like I\'m sleeping on clouds. I also love the feature that this can be used as a breast feeding pillow later on. The breast feeding pillows in stores are $40 and up, so for $25 more I get to sleep in comfort for my pregnancy and then use it when the baby arrives. If you\'re pregnant and debating whether or not to get this pillow, from one pregnant woman to another, trust me it is worth the money!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow was wonderful when I got it, I really liked that I didn\'t have to move the pillow from side to side if I flipped over. But the filling really doesnt hold up well at all, and after just a couple months it gets pretty flattened especially as your belly grows. I\'m at the end of my pregnancy now, and I really wish it still had the filling like when I got it because now is when my back is hurting the worst. I dont want to buy another pillow at this point, so I am jsut toughing it out....

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Extremely comfortable and reliable.  Lasts forever and makes sleeping so much easier while pregnant. It definitely helps me sleep on my side being pregnant since I use to be a big time belly sleeper.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I absolutely love this pillow. It supports you everywhere. It did take me a few nights to get used to it, but now I don\'t know what I would do without it. It is huge and takes up a lot of room, but if you have a queen size bed or larger, it\'s perfect!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife was uncomfortable sleeping before the pillow ,and now she sleeps with less complaining which is expected from her when expecting twins.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow worked so great and was very comfortable. It gives support in all the right places and helps you sleep comfortably. My husband was not a huge fan of the amount of space it took up in our queen size bed, but he also understood how much it helped with back pain and just my overall quality of sleep.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: We purchased the pillow when I was in my fourth month of pregnancy; currently I am in my last couple weeks before our baby\'s arrival. The Pillow has been great! Since doctors recommend sleeping on your side rather than your back, I purchased the pillow so that I could learn to sleep on my side comfortably. Sleeping with the pillow as my body changed has made sleeping more comfortable! I get support for my belly and hips and back while I sleep. When I read reviews, there were some negative comments such as the seam being really tight around the head/neck area. It has not been a problem for me; I can see how that could be an issue. However, I didn\'t need to sleep with the pillow right up against my shoulder to get the head and neck support. One aspect that takes getting used to is just having something that large in bed. My husband didn\'t complain because he slept up against it too! I do recommend this pillow!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wifed loves using this. She said its helps take the pressure off of her back while she is sleeping

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Amazing product.  My wife thought it was a lifesaver during pregnancy.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I like this pillow, it provides support in all of the right places and makes it easy to turn from side to side at night while still feeling supported. I don\'t, however, like the pillow cover fabric. It feels cheap and a bit scratchy. There doesn\'t seem to be any alternative to this as the only replacement cover is said to be made of the same material. I\'ll keep using this pillow but found myself waking at times due to how awful the pillow felt on my face.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: First, let me say that I\'m a guy and obviously not pregnant (nor do I look pregnant, at 150 lbs - ha!).  I am 65, though, with the usual aches and pains that normally come with getting older.  That being said, here are my thoughts on this product:The seller made some pretty tall claims about this product, but they ALL turned out to be absolutely true - and then some!!How the hell does a pillow prevent acid reflux?  I have no idea, but it actually does, for me anyway.  Gotta say I\'m totally amazed by that.  I figure I\'ll save the cost of this product in about a year with the money I\'ll end up saving in antacid expenses alone - and no, I\'m not exaggerating at all!Additionally, I couldn\'t believe how well rested I felt and totally pain-free upon getting out of bed after the first night, and every morning thereafter.  Believe me, that\'s HUGE for us old farts!  My only regret is that I didn\'t get one of these about 20+ years ago.  I over-slept this morning for the first time in probably 35 years.  Now, I guess I\'ll need to get an alarm clock.I have no negative comments whatsoever.  If you want a body pillow, try this one, regardless of your gender. I can\'t imagine that you\'ll be disappointed, but if you are, it\'s returnable anyway!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: The price was the first thing that had me sold. I talked to a few friends who have a similar one and said they couldn\'t survive a pregnancy without it. However the "seam" reviews are true. It doesn\'t dig into my neck as much as it does my shoulders. And the pillow case is HORRIBLE to put back on. You would think with the lack of patience with pregnancy they would find a more convenient way to put the case back on. I am def not looking forward to having to wash it again! Other then that it\'s very comfy and makes for better sleep!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I\'m currently 6 months along in my pregnancy and now that I\'ve had this pillow for about a month I feel pretty qualified to write a review on its behalf. Before purchasing the Back \'N Belly I had been finding it hard to stay on my side without rolling onto my back at some point in the night because the pillow barricades I created would get pushed out of place. That being said, this pillow is great for that. I love that I can switch sides without having to readjust pillow mountains, and even if I do end up on my back I\'m half propped up because of how the pillow is shaped. It also does take up some considerable space, but on our king size bed fits nicely and is certainty worth it. I can only imagine as I get further along it will come in handy even more so. I will note though that overall it did take quite some getting used to as I found/find the pillow very firm (to the point that whichever side I am laying on my coinciding ear will sometimes ache) and the seaming around the inner curve is pretty painful if you don\'t position yourself right. Basically I think if they could upgrade this pillow to be softer and reconsider their seam placement it would be perfect!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: So comfortable, and great for several sleeping/relaxing positions. I love to push both sides together and sleep on top of it with my regular pillow underneath the headrest part of this pillow, but it\'s also good to lay in between on your side and have the pillow cradle you. I got this around 26wks pregnant and have used it every night since (and am now currently 33wks), it\'s the only way I can get relief from my hips and lower back hurting in order to actually sleep. It is a very big pillow and takes up a lot of space in our king size bed, but the comfort is completely worth it!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow has been one of the best pregnancy buys so far.  I have always been a stomach sleeper but we all know that is not good when you are pregnant.  The pillow actually helps me get comfortable on my sides without rolling on my stomach in the middle of the night.  Another good feature is it is an all over body pillow so you don\'t have to adjust it under the covers at night and wake up your partner.  It is kind of bulky but I have a queen size bed and my husband still has pleanty of roomon his side.  I would definatley recommend this pillow to all pregnant moms!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is one of those things that is as good as it looks. I bought one for my wife two year ago from Amazon, and she is using it for the second time. Lasts long. Provides back support. My wife feels much better with this pillow for her backaches. Worth every penny.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love this pillow!  I love being able to roll over without hitting my husband in the face while he\'s sleeping with the "snoogle"  With this pillow, there\'s no need to re-adjust, just turn over.  it\'s great.  I can even lay on my back and sleep because I can prop the pillow under my right side and still be really comfy.  Also, I found it cheaper on another website w/free shipping so shop around before ordering.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is so comfy and I am sleeping much better. It is nice to have two sides to the pillow so I don\'t have to readjust to turn over. My husband and dog are jealous of how comfy it is!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is wonderful! At 22 weeks, I had been sleeping with a regular body pillow, and I just got the Leahco pillow in the mail. I sleep with a normal pillow under my head and the closed part of this pillow at my feet. I had a lot of back pain that didn\'t let me sleep through the night (or at least wake up rested), but with this pillow I sleep like a log. I can\'t say anything about durability or long-term use because I haven\'t had it very long, but so far it\'s wonderful! So glad I got this.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My DIL likes this pillow but finds it too bulky and takes up too much room in the bed.  She uses it on nights she is very uncomfortable to sleep but other than that it collects dust.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am pregnant with twins and was having trouble finding a comfortable position.  This product is great in that you can go back and forth sleeping on different sides without having to shift the pillow at all.  I found that the part for the head (the bottom of the u) is too high/firm for me - seems to tilt my neck at too much of an angle.  I found that if I switch the pillow around and have my head at the open spot between the two arms and use a normal feather pillow instead, it\'s much more comfortable.This pillow works great also if you want to sleep at an angle facing toward your stomach, or slightly tilted toward your back, as it provides support from both sides at once.It does take up an enormous space in the bed, but then again, so do I :-)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love this pillow!!! This pillow is great to have because at night I can just turn side to side without having to readjust and worry about all the pillows falling off the bed.  It is big but I can still make it in and out of bed without problems.  I am also almost 5\'10 and I have no complaints about it being too short.  I still use a pillow under my head and one under my feet.  My hips were hurting horribly before I bought it and since the pillow they hurt just every once in awhile and usually if I adjust the pillow the problem is solved.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: After reading other reviews for all these types of pillows I decided on this one for my wife. She absolutely loves it and I can\'t imagine what she would have done without it. The delivery was super fast, as promised. I highly recommend this product as it is everything that it claims it is and more. I even used it myself once when my back was hurting.Buy on amazon with confidence.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow does provide support when you are sleeping on your side, but it will not help you remain in that position. The problem is that the two legs of the pillow will move apart from each other when you turn your body. Turning the pillow around won\'t help because the two legs will still move apart and your head will be on the mattress. One suggestion (for the manufacturer) is to put Velcro on the two legs so that they can be tied together.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: The seam of the pillowcase at the neck part of the pillow cuts into my shoulder quite a bit. I cut the seam off and put a pillow case over the top, which solved that problem, but left the pillowcase underneath ripping every time I turned over. I think the idea is great but the design needs A LOT of work around the head area. Besides the now ripping pillowcase, I love this pillow. It supports my back and belly and prevents me from rolling onto my back accidentally in my sleep. This pillow will work if you cut off the top part of the case and keep the case covering only the sides. Then cut a regular pillowcase so it\'s open on both ends and slip it over the pillow to the top. Since you have to do this to the pillow I do not think it is worth $60.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love it.  I bought this pillow around 4 months and have slept better ever since!  Several different positions are suggested on the box and I\'ve tried all of them.  Now I\'m eight months, I am having trouble sleeping again but I am convinced it would be worse without this magic pillow!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: LOVE this pillow! It has saved me from many sleepless nights. It\'s super comfortable.  I just went on vacation and really regretted not taking it with me.  I sleep more throughout the nights now, besides the middle of the night trip to the bathroom of course! :)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I LOVE this pillow. It has gotten me through two pregnancies and will get me through my future ones. It gives just the right amount of support for my growing belly and my back. And I love the comfort of snuggling it. But I will warn you that if you share the bed with someone that you should have at least a queen size bed.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: The first thing I want to say is that the ladies that are having issues with it digging into their necks need to flip the pillow over. There is a seam that is angled so that it is possible to have it upside down. It is absolutely not a problem if you simply flip it. You also have the option of turning the whole thing upside down and using the part that is not connected to further elevate your head. There is no seam to worry about at that point.This is my fifth pregnancy, and my first one with an actual "pregnancy pillow." It really helps to keep me on my side, and is improving my back pain. It\'s not too big for the queen bed I share with my husband, and I like that I will be able to use it after the baby is born (not only because it is comfortable!) as a more supportive alternative to the boppy pillow. I\'m sure I\'ll be packing this at the hospital with me, too!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: The pillow is great to help me stay on my side, especially when I flip over in my sleep.  It is big, so if you don\'t have at least a queen size bed, your significant other will need to sleep on the couch :).  The seam at the inside of the curve is pulled too tight and can be harsh on the neck, but I find that if I just slide down a little, it doesn\'t bother me too much. I would definitely recommend this pillow for any pregnant woman.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Very comfortable and keeps it shape. Does take up a lot of space but can be used for another person on the outside of the pillow as well.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: If you are short, you need one of these!  It\'s the only thing that has helped keep me from laying on my back, keeps my head elevated, and allows me to put it between my knees for proper alignment no matter which side I lay on.  One-sided pillows or multiple standard pillows have to be moved with you every time you roll over, but this doesn\'t: it\'s right where I need it to be no matter which way I turn.  For extra head elevation, if I\'m experiencing heartburn, I just add my regular pillow underneath the head piece and it works like a charm!  It\'s very comfortable, not too hard or soft, and the seam that some reviewers mentioned bothering them hasn\'t bothered me at all.  I think being of smaller stature helps with this pillow because ever section is right where it needs to be.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I\'m glad I got the pillow, because it at least provides support in the main back and belly areas. I do wish it was about a foot longer so that I could rest my ankles/feet on it, too. I have to put another pillow at the foot of it in order to keep my entire leg apart from the other one and sleep more comfortably. I also use a wedge pillow underneath the neck part, and my bed pillow over the top of the Back \'n Belly pillow, so that my shoulder doesn\'t fall asleep just using the "U" pillow. The cover isn\'t very soft and is difficult to remove and wash and put back on, so I have to use a combination of four king-size pillowcases over it, which are easier to take off and wash.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: overall quite a good product, supports belly and beck and what is important, you don\'t have to adjust anything when moving from one side to another. However I found it too high and thus uncomfortable for the neck.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Love this pillow. When I was pregnant I started having a lot of back pain. This helped to relieve the pain and was very comfortable.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow was the best purchase that I have made thus far during my pregnancy.  I was having horrible back aches trying to sleep on my side with my old pillows, but no more!  Yes, this pillow is quite large (it takes up half of our king size bed) but it is worth it!  I would highly recommend this pillow to anyone (pregnant or not) for a better night rest!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I purchased this in my 5th month of pregnancy to try and get some better sleep.I did not like it very much due to the length being too short (I\'m 5\'8)Also the material made me get hot.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I got this pillow about a month ago and I absolutely love it.  I was concerned about rolling onto my back and belly while sleeping, so I wanted to get a 2-sided pillow instead of the normal C-shaped pillows.  It is so comfortable.  I use the top instead of a regular pillow.  It\'s easy to turn from side to side and continue sleeping. It takes up about 1/2 of our queen size bed, but my husband doesn\'t mind. He will actually use the side closest to him as a body pillow too!  Don\'t worry about the top seam cutting into your shoulder. I can see how that can happen, but you just need to scoot down to avoid that.I would definitely recommend this pillow. It\'s like sleeping in your own litle cacoon.  I\'m not sure how I\'ll be able to give it up after giving birth!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Overall comfy, but seam does rub. It is too large for any bed but a King. Further, If you are taller than 5\'8, it is not long enough to go between your legs are well. Provides good support.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was starting to get very uncomfortable at night when I decided to purchase this pillow...and I REALLY need (and love) my sleep!  Although I still cramp at night sometimes as my pregnancy progresses, my sleep is much more sound with this pillow.  I\'m very pleased with this purchase.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is worth every penny and more. I would glady have paid upwards of $75 bucks for it. This is my second pregnancy and second body pillow-I foolishly threw my first one out after I didn\'t need it anymore because it was so big! I\'m 24 weeks and I started using this one at about 16 weeks, and immediately noticed the difference. My back doesn\'t ache anymore and I don\'t stay awake at night tossing and turning. Lay on your side, wrap your legs around it like it\'s the best cuddle buddy you\'ve ever had, and enjoy. The only thing that wakes me up at night is having to pee. Trust me, I have a large cyst in my lower back which causes lots of lower back pain, and this pillow really helps with all of that. The only negative thing I can say about this pillow is that it is just so big. It almost takes up half of the bed, but if your man is a gentleman, he won\'t complain and will understand. An added bonus: ladies, if you\'re not in the mood to be messed with, jump right in bed and cuddle up with your pillow. Your husband will get the hint. The pillow\'s a nice barrier between the two of you (which my man hates). But overall, wonderful pillow and does what you need it to do. Every pregnant woman needs one!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is so comfortable and helped greatly when I was pregnant.  It\'s so comfortable, that if it didn\'t take up so much room in the bed, I would sleep with it all the time!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow when I was 8 weeks pregnant with twins. I\'m now 20 weeks pregnant and MUCH bigger :)I have scoliosis so my back started hurting from very early on in the pregnancy, which is why I bought the pillow so early. The first night I slept with this pillow was the first night my back did NOT hurt. It was the answer to my back pain and still is. B/C it\'s U-shaped, I rest my legs on it, I prop my belly against it, and it supports my back wonderfully and helps me stay on my side and not fall to my back (I\'m a strict back sleeper so the side sleeping is a challenge!)I tested different ways to sleep in it and the best way for me is to have the open end head-up. That way I can sleep with my own down pillow and my head is very comfy. I have the support of the pillow back and front, and what\'s great is when I\'m not feeling too great or having ligament pain and my feet need to be elevated, I prop them on the U part on the bottom and it keeps my feet up. So it\'s pretty much perfect.Also, during this pregnancy I have very sore breasts and leaning them on the pillow also helps!!!My hubby has taken advantage also. He leans on the other side of my pillow and loves it. So we all get something out of it.I have a King size bed. We both fit great. My hubby is a big guy at 6\'4" and 240 lbs and we have no problems fitting on the bed. He still pretty much gets his half :)Also, I wear the heck out of this pillow. It\'s so durable yet flexible at the same time. I can get it to stay any way I want depending if I\'m sitting, lounging to watch TV or sleeping. I love it\'s versatility.I honestly don\'t know how I would manage sleep without this pillow!!! I can\'t even imagine having a body pillow with only one side like most I see out there. This is really the best!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I first bought the Snoogle Body pillow and like it.  I needed more support for my back and bely--I am 7 months pregnant, so I bought this pillow and love it!  It gives the right amount of support for my back and belly that I needed.  It is quite large but there is enough room for my husband, his body pillow (my old snoogle) and me with my new pillow in our king size bed. The pillow helps keep me in the side lying position and helps keep me comfortable.  This is a great buy!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: With mirrored sides, i don\'t have to adjust the pillow when i rollover. i do place a soft pillow vertically over where you should place your head. its more comfortable with a pillow. i got a bad headache when i slept on the body pillow as is.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was very excited and impressed with the quality when I opened the box, and couldn\'t wait for bedtime! BUT once in bed, I realized it was MUCH too large, and MUCH too thick. I was stuck in it, and if you are anything like me and have to pee anywhere from 5-9 times in the middle of the night, you may need diapers. I would have had to wake up my husband to help me out of the pillow in order to get up. The thickness at the head is extreme, and if you are already having back pain it only makes it worse. I tried flipping it upside down and putting my own pillow in the space, but that didn\'t work either b/c the thick part was between my thighs, making it too uncomfortable. I didn\'t even sleep with it one night, and I am in the process of returning it now. The quality is impeccable, but the design needs to be altered.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This was just what I needed. If you sleep with it without a pillow for your head, it can be a little hard on the ears. Otherwise, an amazing sleeping solution for a pregnant woman... or anyone really. My husband takes naps with it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love my new leachco pillow. It helps me get better rest while I\'m pregnant and uncomfortable. However, it was not ideal to clean this pillow as soon as it arrived because the box it was shipped in had a huge hole and it was traveling and collecting rain water. When I found my package that was left in my carport, the top of the box was missing because the box had become so soggy that it literally caved in. So naturally this huge pillow was wet on the top side. That was very aggravating. As far as the pillow is concerned, I cleaned it up, and I use it daily for all my aches and pains while trying to sleep comfortably.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was hesitant to spend so much on a pillow but this is one of the best purchases I\'ve ever made.  It is so comfy it\'s unbelievable.  I started using it when I was four months pregnant and I began to have some back pain and needed support.  Now it is two months later and I can not bear the thought of sleeping without this pillow!  It\'s true that it is difficult to get in and out of but an easy fix as suggested by another reviewer is to lift the side up and get out rather than trying to climb out over it.  Unlike some other reviewers, the size seems to fit perfectly for me, I am 5\'4".  I highly recommend it.  Money well spent.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I feel bad giving this two stars because I think it\'s just a preference thing.  This was too much bulk to go under my head.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is a godsend for pregnant women.  It supports just about every part of the body that needs it and it\'s SO COMFORTABLE!The only complaint I have is that it takes up a lot of room so hubby doesn\'t have much room left in the bed!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow for my daughter because she is carrying twins.I know how uncomfortable it is carrying one! I was very pleased when she told me that she recieved it and in her words, " it\'s amazing!".

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I wouldn\'t say I am very happy with this pillow. Maybe that\'s because I am not used to very thick pillows and it hurt my neck after I tried to sleep on it. Also, it\'s a little bit short and I cannot place my legs comfortably. The cover is made of polyester and everything sticks on it, and it was very unpleasant in summer - cotton would be much better and healthier. But I sewed cotton covers myself. The only 2 points I am giving to it - it gives great support to my back when I sit - I am experiencing some lower back pains during my pregnancy, and for that purpose it is great. So, I hope I can use it much better when I will be breastfeeding my baby - at least it would not be waste of money then.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Good things:-Good investment, gives you a comfortable position so you can have a good sleep during pregnancy-It allows you to turn sides while sleeping without moving the pillow (it can be very uncomfortable if you have to remove your blanket and everything else in order to move the pillow from one side to the other)-Very soft materials-Good support for you backThink twice about getting it:-if you sleep in a very hot place, it is like having a blanket all around you-if you sleep in a small bed, it takes a lot of space!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is a great pillow soft and firm at the same time very fluffy, only downside n are queen bed theirs not much room once this pillow is around u..

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought the body pillow for my wife who is 4 months pregnant and she loves it.  She has found it to decrease back pain and increase comfort while sleeping.  I myself have had back problems on again and off again, and though I haven\'t slept with the pillow I have tried it out and can easily see that it would be quite relieving when my back does eventually flare up!  My only caution is to be aware that it is BIG.  We have only a queen size bed and I find myself very very .... crowded.  Otherwise, worth every penny!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My daughter pregnant with twins and asked me to get it. Came quickly and she says it has made a huge difference for her. Very happy with product

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I had a double mastectomy in November and this pillow was  suggested  to help me be comfortable when I slept  The doctors suggest you sleep sitting up for a few weeks until you can lay flat comfortably.  The pillow wraps around you so you can rest your arms on the sides away from your body and keeps your back elevated.  I used this not only during the first surgery but even during my reconstruction.  I suggest purchasing this pillow to everyone going through this type of procedure. I would not have slept with out it!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow for my wife in the first trimester.  She absolutely loves this pillow.  She cannot say enough good things about it.  Very comfortable and she loves the way she can roll over and have the same pillow on the other side.  She tells me she is never sleeping without it again, even after the baby is born.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I LOVE this pillow everyone should have one really does help back and hip aches and everything else and it\'s just really confterable

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: "Ok I had a body pillow that I thought was going to do the trick for my entire pregnancy, but after I got into my third trimestre it wasn\'t cutting the mustard. I will admit i only paid $15 at Costco, another one from target for $25 and now both my children own them. This pillow is the BEES KNEES! holy cow it cost more than I would have liked to pay but so worth every penny. I just wish that it came with a pillow case. But I love it so much that I\'m making one for my new pillow :-) LOVE IT!"

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is unbelievably comfortable!!! Laid on it for the first time and felt IMMEDIATE relief, especially after a long day!!! NO COMPLAINTS at all. If anything should change, I will post an update.6-9-12Ok, I said I would post an update if necessary, and here I am.  I have already had my baby at this point, so I\'ve gone through the entire process.  First off, I\'m only 5\'2" and the length of the pillow was not even long enough for me.  Second of all, the case it comes in, should be made of some sort of stretchy material, so that way the top inside part that curves, does NOT cut into your shoulders.  I had to use another pillow at my head to supplement the shoulder problem and another one by my feet for the length.  My husband called this "my fortress of solitude", now he uses the pillow and obviously he loves it, but he uses another pillow for his head too.  When feeding our baby, and the boppy is not around, he curls the pillow around him and uses it to lay the baby on it.  So it IS useful, but needs improvement.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am pregnant with twins. Even though I am only 5 months along, I look as if I am ready to deliver any day. This pillow has been a lifesaver! I was hesitant to buy such an expensive pillow, but after much research decided to give it a try. I have not been disappointed. I agree that the pillowcase has a poor design, but at least it has a pillowcase which many other models don\'t offer! This pillow is very comfortable for lying on my side as well as putting the bottoms together to cradle my hips and provide support for my back. It has eased some of the discomforts of pregnancy including my backache, insomnia, and nightly heartburn. My husband is so jealous at how comfortable this pillow is, he has added it to his Christmas wish list. I highly recommend this product!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I agree with other reviewers about the seam being in a really horrible place. I sleep with my head at the bottom of the "U" shape and if I am up too high in the pillow, the seam cuts into my shoulder. They really should fix that...that being said, I can\'t sleep without this pillow! I\'ve been a stomach sleeper my whole life and once my belly was too big for that I was forced into side sleeping, which was not working for me until I got this pillow. I didn\'t want to fuss with a single sided body pillow every time I flipped from one side to the other. This way I flip over and there is a body pillow already there and ready for me!This thing is huge...takes up my entire side of our queen bed. My husband calls it my escape pod because it\'s so big I literally have to climb in and out of it. It was also a little too puffy at first, but it has calmed down with use--I\'ve had if for about a month now. If something happened to this pillow, I would buy it again.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Around my fifth month of pregnancy I was having a hard time getting comfortable enough to sleep.  The first night I had this pillow, I slept great!  It beats trying to position several pillows around yourself and keep you in place throughout the night.  I love that I can flip over to my other side and the pillow is properly positioned.  Worth every penny!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Love this pillow - I don\'t know what I would do without it! I was having trouble staying asleep (and staying on my side) during the night after my 3rd month of pregnancy - this pillow helps so much, I wish I\'d gotten it sooner.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: When I was pregnant my husband got me one of these and I finally could sleep at night. Recently a friend of mine got pregnant and she had troubles sleeping so I ordered this for her. She was telling me how much she loved it and that she is able to sleep peacefully.Also this pillow is great for feeding. I would flip it around and use it like a boppy pillow. I still use it 4 months after giving birth to our beautiful baby girl. =)I suggest this pillow to pregnant women and even if you are not pregnant and have trouble sleeping because of your hips... you NEED this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: MY WIFE IS SUPER HAPPY WITH THIS PRODUCT. I WOULD DEFINETLY RECOMEND THIS PRODUCT TO ANY ONE LOOKING FOR A PREGNANCY PILLOW.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: If you\'re a big snuggler/spooner, this is not the right pregnancy pillow for you. If you\'re like me, and you like to have your own comfy little zone in a big bed, this is the one! I got this pillow when I was 11 weeks pregnant (super early!) and now I\'m 31 weeks pregnant and have used it EVERY night. The only thing I don\'t like about it is that if you shimmy up in the night, the fabric at the top of the pillow digs into your shoulder. You can just scoot down, but they should put some elastic in the fabric right at the place where the pillow rests on your shoulder. Otherwise, it is everything I could have hoped for and more. I\'m just nervous about weaning off of it when the baby comes!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow has been amazing. Before I was sleeping with every pillow I owned in the house packed around me and nothing was helping. Since I bought this pillow I have slept better and it has helped my hip pain in the middle of the night (well as much as a pillow can when your 8 months pregnant). The only down side is my husband and I have a queen size bed and it takes up a lot of the bed. He is learning how to use it also since half of it is on his side. It also makes a great spot for my 6 year old daughter to lay when she is in our bed taking a nap. Lots of ways to use it and I still finding more!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this product for my daughter.  She had been having excrutiating back pain, and insomnia.  Since she began to use this item, her back pain has gone away, and she is able to sleep through the night.  She loves this pillow, and uses it whenever she sits or lays down.Leachco Back \'N Belly - Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: SERIOUSLY IN HEAVEN def allows me to sleep on my stomach and side very comfortably...yes it doesn\'t come with an extra cover but I just used several pillow cases...this pillow is awesome and price is  just right best of all the neck is very comfortable

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: When I received this pillow, I was super excited to try it out.  The pillow is super comfortable.  The only complaint I have is that I\'ve only been using the pillow for about a month and it\'s already starting to get a little flat.  This bums me out because I was hoping it would last me the entire pregnancy, but I\'m afraid I might have to get a different one to make it through until my due date.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: So comfortable and easy to use. It is really big so keep that in mind if you have a small bed! It comes with a white case but I really wish they had different color/patterns available to swap out!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is my third pregnancy, my first I didn\'t get the luxury of having a body pillow just stacked up blankets or what I could to just go by, then my second I got a long pillow and it did fine but my back always hurt. Now as my back pains have started sooner, having this pillow to have at night or when I can grab a quick nap -- is perfect to help give me relief and comfort. It\'s soft as well and makes it easier to relax anytime of day. My recommendation over any other maternity pillow out there!~

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: It is way too big.  After purchasing this one, we saw one that is half the size with back support.  It was too late

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife is in love with this. It got her through her pregnancy. Every pregnant woman needs this. Buy it!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I ordered the Leachco Back \'N Belly pillow hoping it would help me sleep better and relieve lower back pain while pregnant.  It hasn\'t relieved the back pain, and I still find I wake up in the middle of the night every time I turn from one side to another.That said, I am glad I purchased this pillow.  It is VERY comfortable (I love snuggling into it) and it\'s supportive.  It\'s definitely better than using regular bed pillows to support my belly and to place between my legs.  Not having to turn the Back \'N Belly pillow whenever I turn from one side to another is another advantage (and a big one) over regular bed pillows or other pregnancy pillows.I was concerned about the size of this pillow.  My husband and I sleep in a queen-size bed, and I was worried there would not be enough room for me, the pillow and my husband.  I\'m happy to say the two of us still fit comfortably in our bed, even with this big pillow.I should also mention that I\'m 5\'4" tall, and this pillow fits me fine.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow when i was about 2 1/2 months pregnant.  I could never sleep for some reason.  I got the pillow and fell in love with it.  I\'m now 27 weeks pregnant and couldn\'t live without it.  As far as the review where the seam digs into the neck and shoulders, occasionally if i push myself too far up into the pillow this happens... so i readjust and i\'m fine.  I love that it goes around both sides of the pillow.  I\'m notorious for waking up in the middle of the night on my back (in tremendous pain), so i tuck the side of the pillow on my back under my back snugly and so if i happen to roll over at night it won\'t allow me to be flat on my back I\'m at an angle (which is better for baby and me).  I think the only downfall for the pillow was the cover.  When i ordered mine there was not a replacement cover, so i take it off and wash it.  The cover now has those little beaded balls on it which aren\'t the most comfortable.  I bought 3 1/2 yards of fabric and made myself a new cover and whalah everything is good.  I do like the idea the person had of cutting the end out of an existing pillow case and sliding it to the middle, I\'ll have to do that.  Great Purchase, i highly recommend this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: It is a large pillow so you really need to have a King size bed, but it is amazing!  I most loved the fact that you didn\'t have to adjust the pillow during the night if you wanted to change positions.  You move, not the pillow.  This pillow helped by hurting back the first night I used it.  I have not had back pain since.  I am currently 21 weeks pregnant.  Definitely would recommend to pregnant women or anyone with back pain!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I have had this pillow for about a month and I really enjoy it. Its comfortable and helps a pregnant woman sleep. My only concern is that where you lay your head goes flat pretty quick. Once that happens the cloth is a little uncomfortable but I still feel its worth what we paid for it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this for my sister-in-law because she is expecting a baby this year with my brother.  It is the number one thing I think every pregnant women should have.  My husband bought me one for each of my two pregnancies because I used them completely out!!  They allow a pregnant mom to stay comfortable and be completely supported,even with all the changing of positions and getting up to use the washroom all night.  Plus, you get the extra bonus of having a very comfortable pillow for feeding or resting with your new baby when they are born!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This one is a back saver! I loved that I had support for my back on both sides. Pre-pregnancy I slept on my back and so needed some support for my back when I needed to start sleeping on my side once pregnant. Now (I am 8 months preg), I sleep on my left or right side and it is super helpful to have support on both sides and easily flip in the night. Also early on, I was afraid what if I accidently went to my stomach or back in my sleep and did not realize it? This product helps you with that as it completely snugs you around. BTW - I am 5-2 and sleep with my head on a normal pillow and the closed (contured end) near my feet. I snug the sides around me. The closed end was a bit too high for my neck (so giving one star less). Also the cover is painful to remove and put back on when you have to wash it (thankfully DH dutifully does that :-) )

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: The pillow is nice and fluffy. My biggest problem with it is the seam by the neck area (as previously pointed out by others also). The seam digs into my neck/shoulder which makes it uncomfortable during sleep. I like that it\'s just about my body length - I\'m 5-ft tall. However, I do wish that the seam were maybe stretchy or more contoured - more comfortable. I honestly barely use the pillow. I only use it to lean on when I\'m sitting on the bed. It gives great cushion for the back while seated.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: its wonderful it helps my back so much and helps so that my neck doesnt cramp up. i can just lay flat and be slightly slanted so that i dont hurt the baby. highly recommended. !!! love love love it

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Great...exactly what my wife needed!  Wraps around the body perfectly and supports with ease!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow allowed her to sleep well and awake feeling good. She\'s happier and I\'m a hero! Guys! Get one for her.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow for my wife when she was pregnant and she had a hard time setting it every night when she went to bed.  I would recommend searching for something lighter.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I LOVE This pillow! I\'ve had it for a little over a month now. I gave it four stars because it\'s not really meant for tall people. I\'m a pretty tall women but it\'s still very comfortable. If it were just a little longer it would be prefect.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I cannot tell you enough good things about this pillow. I got it when I was 20 weeks pregnant, when the backache started to come & the headaches because my body & head were not positioned properly thru the night. After much research & talking to friends about a body pillow I decided to purchase this one and can honestly say I don\'t regret it at all. The price was a little hard for me to swallow for a pillow I would only use until the labor & delivery but something had to be done since I wasn\'t sleeping well. The pillow supports your belly & legs & is long enough & fluffy enough that I don\'t even need anything for my head or back. It\'s pretty large but does the job of 6 pillows and stays in position all night. After the first night I would have paid double what I did because I felt so much better. Now, 2 months later I can\'t sleep without it and have even talked about missing it after my babies are born!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I wouldn\'t recommend this body pillow for someone who is tall.  I\'m 5\'9" and it is too short.  The edging around the curve where your head/shoulders hit is unforgiving.  It\'s rough and just not comfortable to me.  I tried a pillow and it still doesn\'t work.  I\'d like to cut it in half and use it behind my back and in front of me.  I\'m 5 months along and would gladly give it away if I knew someone who could use it.  I gave it one star because it does feel good along my back when sleeping on my left side.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: best pregnancy pillow you can get, would recommend it to all pregnant women. Really great back and belly support. Fantastic!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: The concept is awesome, and the back and belly/leg support is great. But there is a neck seam that DIGS into your neck if you sleep on your side with your legs/back touching the pillow. If they could fix this one error, I think it would be a fabulous product. I didn\'t want to cut the seam and deal with the fuzz all over. Not for 60/70 bucks.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow when I was just entering my second trimester. It has been a life (or should I say sleep) saver! I usually sleep on my back, so not being able to has been difficult, but this pillow has made the transition much easier! Spend the money girls! It\'s worth it!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: this pillow is way too short so the only way to make it work is to use it upside down. this also solves the second main problem: that its cover is made of a poor material and pills badly, so that it ends up being itchy as hell. i have been sleeping with my head on my normal pillow and wrapping the pillow around my body to support my legs and belly -- which ever side I sleep. It works well this way. still itches, but using pjs instead of a nightgown solves it. I still would buy it I think, but it is a bit pricey for all the adjustments it needs.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Bought this for my "very " pregnant daughter ..  .she absolutely loves it.  Finally able to sleep with support from the pillow ..  she AND her husband enjoy this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: So comfortable... but takes up a ton of space in a queen bed! My husband has been relegated to a third of the bed... but he likes sleeping with his back to the pillow for support for him!Really supports me and helps with an expanding tummy.  Wish it came with more washable covers, and it does lose some of its shape unless you repeatedly turn it and plump it daily! Overall summary: its a great buy and I don\'t intend on giving it up after the birth without a fight!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I started using this pillow because regular pillows were beginning to give me massive back and neck pain and I wasn\'t able to find a comfortable position to sleep in much longer.  During my 6th month, I purchased this pillow and I couldn\'t have made a better decision.  This pillow has been a life saver and my back and neck pain are now gone.  The pillow is soft yet sturdy and super comfortable.  By sturdy, I mean that the pillow has retained its original plushyness (if that\'s a word), softness, and hasn\'t lost its shape.  I have slept so much better since purchasing this pillow and my only regret is that I did not buy it earlier in my pregnancy.  One of the best things I love about this pillow is the fact that I can turn from one side to the other and still have the same level of comfort on both sides.  My back and growing belly stay comfortable and supported whether I am sleeping on my left or right side.  I am now 33 weeks pregnant and still sleeping comfortably.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought the boppy full body pillow first, but it did nothing for me. The Leachco is amazing. It\'s firm enough that it offers support and i\'ve slept so well since i got it. I use the closed end for my head and use a small pillow towards the end for ankle support.That\'s not to say it doesn\'t have it\'s issues. When you toss, you have to rearrange yourself around the pillow (but this is a minor issue compared with non u-shaped pillows where you have to re-arrange the whole pillow when you turn). It\'s huge. So on our queen bed, I take up waaayyy too much space.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: She was four months pregnant when I got it for her and she hasn\'t slept without it for the last month...I\'ve been replaced!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This was truly a blessing to have throughout my pregnancy! Only complaint is that I wish it would come with a cover that\'s easier to take off to wash!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: this is a must have!  had morning sickness which was actually all day sickness the entire pregnancy and this somehow gave me some slight relieve towards the end of my first trimester, along with the medicine from my doctor that shortly followed.  i could not be pregnant without this pillow.  only downfall is it takes up an enormous amount of space in our queen bed, sorry sweetie :(

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was getting desperate for additional support and based on all the postive reviews, bought this pillow during my sixth month of pregnancy.  The first moment I tried it out, it felt comfortable, as it is very stuffed and does offer support.  Within minutes, however, it became uncomfortable and then painful.  The problem lies in how the top u-shaped portion is sewn--it is sewn so tightly and stiffly that it digs into your neck.  When I pulled myself down a little bit to avoid this, the pillow became useless for two reasons.  First, the side wasn\'t long enough to fit between my legs for support.  Second, it didn\'t provide enough support for my head and I needed another pillow.  This defeated the entire purpose.  If only the pillow were either longer or had more flexibility/was sewn differently at the u-shape!  I am five nine, and it was too short by several inches.  We have a queen size bed, and it\'s true that this pillow takes up so much room that it\'s like having a third person in bed with us.  If the pillow worked properly, it would have been worth it.  It\'s winter now, and I was worried that as it got warmer, it would make me and my husband too hot.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Too good. My wife loved during her pregnancy. Very comfortable and cost. Helped her sleep during the night and rest easily on the couch while watching tv.I bet that every pregnant lady should have this. After our cute little daughters birth I use it sometimes and helps me sleep like a log. Heeheehee

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow made resting and sleeping so comfortable.My hip pain and some of my back pain went away. This is the best pillow ever!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I\'m 6 months pregnant and have been using various pillows for head/body/legs, including a "Made for TV" side sleeper pillow. The one I\'ve been using is U-shaped but uneven, so each time I turn over I need to turn the pillow. However, it also has an "ear well" - an indentation that keeps my ear from getting sore while sleeping so much on my side.I had hubby buy the Leachco for me so I could have one big pillow that doesn\'t need to be turned over in the night. I love it so much - EXCEPT that my ears start hurting in a matter of minutes. I\'ve tried making it work for a couple of nights, but I\'m starting to lose hope - I just end up with this other small softer pillow, in the middle of this huge leacho thing that just isn\'t working out :-(This pillow would be SO PERFECT if they added that "ear well" feature!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am pregnant with Twins and nighttime was gettting rough! This pillow is like a slice of Heaven!!! Plus it will work great as a twin nursing pillow when the babies are born! My husband works 3rd shift and when I get out of my pillow he gets in! He loves it. It is just so comfy!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Started off great, comfortable arrived quickly. Unfortunately within a couple weeks it flattened completely. Complete waste of money. Very irritated and upsetting.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I have had back trouble since I was a teenager and being pregnant made it worse.  My lower back has hurt for weeks and using a body pillow didn\'t help when I needed to change sides.  I\'m 16 weeks pregnant and haven\'t gained a pound, but sleep was horrible.  I got this pillow and expected it to take a while to get used to since its a lot fluffier than what I normaly sleep with, but the first night I slept like a baby for the first time in weeks! My back and neck feel great!  LOVE!  This pillow is big, but definitely worth it for good sleep!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this for a friend of mine for her birthday and she loves it! She had trouble sleeping and lower back pain but now she sleeps much better. If you sleep on your side you will love it.
