It supports your front and back as you sleep. Also this has great support for you spine. Overall, I am happy I bought it for her, great product no complaints from her.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I cannot sleep without this pillow.  I was 7 mo. along when I bought it, wish I had purchased it sooner.  I am now 9 mo. and use it every night....a definite must have.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Good to have this pillow to have a good & comfortable night sleep during your pregnancy. Initially my wife found the pillow not so great but one day when she slept without this the next day morning she was having body pains and was uncomfortable and then from that day she never sleeps without it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I never got around to buying a pregnancy pillow with my first pregnancy but since I\'m already having a hard time getting comfortable in bed this time, I figured I\'d go with the big guns.  So I have nothing to compare to and while it\'s not perfect, it sure beats using multiple pillows and having to rearrange all of them every time I roll from one side to the other.  I don\'t at all find the seam to be a problem, something a lot of other reviews point out.  I do, however, find having to keep your bottom arm under the pillow a bit awkward at times.  I\'m not sure what the perfect design would be and may try this with the opening at top, using a regular pillow for my head so I have more freedom for my arms (with space between the pillow I use for my head and the one I use for my belly, etc.), but that is my only piece of negative feedback so far.  I love having both belly and back support - this keeps me from rolling onto my back and I think I\'ve woken up less since it\'s so much easier to roll from one side to the other, again, without having to rearrange a bunch of pillows. Also, I have a queen bed and this takes up just about half, so my husband has plenty of room.  It would work better with a king and I definitely wouldn\'t get it if you have a full/double, but a queen is definitely doable.  If you want belly and back support in one, this seems like just about the best all-in-one option out there.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: LOOOOOOVVVEEEEEE this!!!!! I used this from my first trimester into the first few months my son was born. These are super expensive in stores but this was a great deal. My friend liked mine so much she bought one too.  Thanks!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was having trouble sleeping once I got to the third trimester, and this pillow is a lifesaver! It literally changed my life, allowing me to get some much-needed sleep without all the tossing and turning, and less waking up in the middle of the night. I don\'t have any trouble with the seam at the top of the pillow like other reviewers said - it doesn\'t affect me in the least. I will say you do need a king size bed (if you share a bed) and if you live in a warm climate and don\'t have A/C, it would be tough to use this pillow. It acts as a blanket that surrounds you on all sides. I am normally run "cold" but this pillow really heats up your sleeping space. With a fan and some A/C, it\'s a perfect pregnancy pillow. I highly recommend it!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: just taking it out from the package, my wife was already in it, and still she is in it, she gave to me all the rest of the pillows, this is her new frind

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is a great product my wife loves it and when she is comfortable we both sleep better

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I thought this would be the perfect pillow even when the pregnancy is over. The size of the pillow upset my husband (we have a King-sized bed). The nights that I slept with this I woke up too hot...so did my husband. If it were longer and not wider it might stand a chance (I am 5\'7"). The head section has extremely tight fabric and not enough filling so it is very hard and not ergonomic. I find it comfortable flipped around for reading in bed. I plan to use it for nursing or maybe I can turn it into a toddler chair or something. I plan on purchasing another for sleeping :(

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this item knowing my pregnant sister would be using it.. turns out this little pillow is down right AMAZING! When I find out she is out for the night I end up taking it and using it for the night! :) I might buy one next paycheck!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am used to sleeping on my stomach but by my 4th month it wasnt too comfortable, so i orderd the pillow. Great support. I definatly sleep a lot better now. Its Great!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Bought this pillow for ongoing back pain. Have used it from 20 weeks on. It works well to prevent pain and keeps me on the recommended left side.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am about 5 1/2 months pregnant and bought this pillow a few weeks ago.  I was weary of its size because it is quite large and takes over a large portion of our bed (we have a queen).  But it does work wonders.  First night I tried it, I slept the entire night (and actually slept in late vs. getting up early like I have been, with aches and pains in my back and shoulders).  My husband hasn\'t minded the "pillow takeover" one bit.  Its actually makes us laugh b/c it takes a little bit of effort to hop into bed and get yourself situated with it.  But it\'s well worth it.  You are less likely to toss and turn all night and actually enjoy some sleep!  I did flip the pillow around and have the open space near my head so I can still use my own comfortable head pillow.  It worked for me!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Loved it so much! Has helped my pregnancy so far! Very big, kinda didn\'t expect that lol. Was worth every penny.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This is a well-made, comfortable body support pillow that I used during the mid to late stages of my pregnancy. It came highly recommended from a friend and I am very glad I listened.It is quite large, however it was perfect for positioning a seemingly ever-changing body into a relaxed but supported position.The cover is very easy to remove, clean, and put back on the pillow. I did experience some pulling of the fabric, however I washed it a lot (every few days when I changed the sheets).This is now safely packed away for use when we have our second.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Loved this pillow.  I don\'t know why I waited until my third pregnancy to get this pillow but I did...rather harder pregnancy and decided I didn\'t want to deal with 5-6 pillows on my bed.  Was rather overwhelmed by size of it and just like some of the other reviewers have stated, it is rather large for queen size beds but okay if you have king size bed.  The first night, I laid in it...man, I thought I died and went to heaven....it supported my back and belly and I had a great night of sleep (well, better than normal)....Definitely worth price and I am glad I finally got it!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow while I was pregnant with my first child, and I\'m now on my third pregnancy. Around month 7 and on, it is a lifesaver and the only way I can get sleep. The pillow provides support on your back, stomach and knees all at the same time, and it\'s nice because you don\'t have to change the pillows around during the middle of the night - you can just switch sides. It also helps if you also use a thin pillow at the curve for extra support on your neck. I highly recommend this pillow to all pregnant ladies!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: She had a hard time getting comfortable even though she is only 4 months pregnant. She cuddles up with this and goes right to sleep. I want one!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I had heard wonderful things about the Leachco Snoogles, so I bought this body pillow from Leachco with high hopes. Unfortunately, I have been disappointed.The pillow is designed to go under your head and down either side of your body.  It does give great support to both your back and belly.  It is great if you frequently flip from side to side- you don\'t have to reposition the pillow.There were several things I didn\'t like, however.  First, it is uncomfortable under my head.  I\'m used to sleeping on a down pillow and I like to be able to squish my pillow around my head.  I couldn\'t do that with the Back \'N Belly because it was flattened by the fact that it was connected to the parts that went down each side of my body.  I tried putting a thin down pillow over it and that helped, but then it almost lifted my head too high.I also found that the cover caused the pillow to be too stiff.  It felt like the cover was stretched too tight across the top.  It was quite uncomfortable stretching over or under my shoulder.  I finally removed the cover and it is much more comfortable without it.  Unfortunately, it is not washable without the cover and the fabric on the pillow itself is thin and pills very easily.Overall, I\'m disappointed and I wish I hadn\'t spent over $50 for this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am currently 21 weeks pregnant with twins. For the past few weeks I\'ve been waking up every hour to two hours feeling uncomfortable and pained. My hips and back ached from lying on my side and my legs were restless. Since this pillow arrived I\'ve been sleeping through the night (with the occasional midnight trip to the bathroom which this pillow can\'t help...). It is absolutely wonderful - I\'m rested for the first time in weeks. The best part is that I can roll from side to side without having to wake up an reposition 4-5 different pillows. I can\'t recommend this product highly enough - it\'s worth every penny.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I brought this pillow for my 2 sisters and they both loved the pillows. They even sleep on them still even after their pregnancies..

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love this pillow! All though it\'s huge, it really helps me to stay on my side...which is the whole reason I got this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow gives support where I need it, but I had an awful time trying to get the neck/shoulder part to be comfortable.  The pillow and the cover were both taunt and dug into me making for a very uncomfortable night.  I ended up cutting into both parts and adding extra fabric to make it comfortable.  Now it\'s comfortable, but it doesn\'t look good!  I would also recommend using a fabric that makes you a little cooler.  Despite these problems, I am now happy with the comfort the pillow provides.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Love this item,,pregnant or not! Perfect for back support or just to snuggle with. Very Comfortable. Need to purchase a cover

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I dont no how i ever slept without this pillow. I have had it for a month and still loving it. I even went out of town for a week and a half and i packed this big pillow...lol I will never leave it. I slept so much better and my hip problems have calmed down with this pregnancy too. witch is a BIG plus. I have a king size bed, myself my husband and my 3 yr old sleep in my bed and there is plenty of room even though i have to fight both of them for my pillow..lol My husband likes to through his leg over one side of the pillow and normally when i come to bed i have to get my 3 yr old out of the center of the pillow cause he is all sprawled out in it passed out. I read the reviews about the "seam" that everyone is complaining about..i see what they are talking about but i really dont find it that big of a deal, i get comfy and if it is tight against my neck i pull the back support up a bit and it is fixed. I plan to buy this pillow for ever prego friend i ever have it is just a life saver. While out of town we slept fine on a queen size bed. I wouldn\'t go any smaller than that unless you are sleeping by yourself. But if you do get it, it is like sleeping by yourself but in a good way anyways..giggle so kick hubby to the couch..HAHA

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I recommend this pillow to anyone who is pregnant. Its great to sleep on during those difficult toss and turn nights. Pregnancy is not easy especially as your belly gets bigger and bigger but without this pillow I dont know how I could have slept without it. Also I had two C sections and it helped a great deal during the recovery periods. It keeps you in angled position and makes it much easier to get up without hurting a lot.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My husband got me this pillow as a suprise when he noticed I was tossing and turning night after night when I was about 4 months pregnant.  I love it!  At first I didn\'t know how to use it, (because it\'s my first pregnancy and I\'m completely clueless), but after I googled it, I jumped right in.  Felt like I was floating on a cloud.  The whole pillow supported my body and I got a good night\'s sleep.  I can sleep on either side with support on both sides.I read other\'s reviews about this item being big and they are correct.  We have a California King Bed and I didn\'t notice it until we were moving and had to use my old bacherlotte Queen bed in the meantime.  Me + the Pillow+ Husband could not fit comfortably!  Most of the time I noticed him gripping the other side of the pillow to not fall off the bed.  So basically we were sharing this thing!Another thing is that I still use a head pillow for my head.  I have neck, back aches, and allergies for years so I have specific pillows to help with that.  The expensive ones and I will never give those pillows up.So, I just see this pillow as an added bonus to prop up my pregnant body.  It\'s not an end all solution to problems, but it does help.  People who have complained, you have to understand, there are more ways than one to help your body get a good night\'s sleep.  Just have to find what works for you and it differs between individuals.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I found the pillow cover very itchy and not soft.  Also, I thought I would like the contours, but I found it very restricive.  the pillow is not long enough (and I am only 5\'2").  I was very disappointed in this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was never a good sleeper.  Then I was about 4 months pregnant and not sleeping at all. Heard great things about this pillow.  None of them were lies. It is heaven.  Since receiving this pillow and now 6 months pregnant, I sleep all night every night.  TOTALLY worth the money and the space it takes up in bed.  I even travel with it!...not easy to do but again worth it.  The pillow comfortably fits in my queen size bed along with my husband and me.  I catch him sometimes trying to steal it from me...lol.  This pillow is a PREGNANCY MUST HAVE!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Currently 29 weeks.  I got this last month because I wanted support mainly for my belly.  I would normally use pillows to support my legs and belly but got tired of having to shift the pillows every time I turn at night.  It is hard enough to turn at night, not to mention shifting everything to make myself comfortable.  So I bought this pillow.  It is actually very comfortable and replaces all other pillows that I have to use (head, leg, & belly).  This also supports my back too, which is nice.  The belly is getting larger and heavier now, so thank goodness that I got this pillow.  I definitely recommend this product.I have a California King bed and this really takes up half the bed.  I asked my husband before I purchase this pillow.  He was amazed at how large it was.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: It has definitely helped my wife sleep better during the second half of her pregnancy.  We have a queen size bed and I still have plenty of room on my side of the bed to sleep while my wife is using it.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: It is pretty big, but provides lots of support and comfort especially as you get bigger.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I bought this pillow, not because I am expecting but because I am a stroke survivor with left side paralysis this causes a lot of hip snd shoulder pain for me. Its nearly impossible to get comfortable in bed with the paralysis and pain. this pillow is so comfortable. It alleviates pressure on the paralyzed side. It rather snuggy and warm therefore I wouldnt recommend it for hot summer days. Other reviews I\'ve read have complaints about some sort of a seam which causes discomfort. I dont have a clue what they are talking about. I slept a whole night with little discomfort. the best is that it kept my paralyzed arm from hanging off the bed. that in itself is invaluable!!. my hubby refers to the pillow as my nest!! thats just what it feels like. I love it

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I use this pillow because I have a herniated back disk that needs surgery to repair.  It\'s very hard for me to sleep on my back (or any way, actually) and some one had told me about these pillows, and I went and bought one to try.  IT WORKED! I am able to sleep in just about every position very comfortably.  And this pillow can itself be adjusted to fit specific sleep problems and I have tried them all with much enthusiasm and I can\'t even begin to pick which way is the most comfortable because, I don\'t know myself.  They ALL work.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: If you are pregnant, this is a must have. Why have back pain and uncomfortable sleep? This is the solution

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Just entered the 4th month of pregnancy and had been having some hip pain from pretty early on. Tried using various pillows tucked everywhere with no relief. Finally I got this body pillow after much researching and I\'m SO glad I did!! I sleep soundly through the night now and wake up with no hip or back pain! The pillow is about as big as I expected, and there\'s room in the queen-sized bed for both me, my husband, and our 26lb cat to sleep.The seam that a lot of folks mentioned in their reviews is indeed a bit stiff, but it doesn\'t really hit my shoulder (I\'m about 5\'1). I do put one of my bed pillows in there to give me a more soft incline.My one recommendation to the company would be to make the removable cover easier to get on and off! My husband wrestled with the cover for a good fifteen minutes to get it back on after he\'d washed it. I think I\'ll just put a fitted sheet over the pillow from now on so we won\'t have to fight the cover when we put it in the wash.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: my pregnant wife LOVES this! although it takes up half the bed and leaves me dangling on the edge haha! and when she\'s not sleeping on it i\'m knocked out on it!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love this pillow. Before I was just using a regular body pillow and it was difficult to take the pilow with me when I wanted to roll over. This is pillow is awesome b/c you don\'t have to worry about that. I also love the back support it provides. I got this pillow when I was about 4 month pregnent. I\'m currently 35 weeks and still using it. I think the further along you are the more helpful this pillow is. I was having trouble sleeping and it definitly helped!It would be nice if it were a little longer though. It works pretty well for me (I\'m 5\'6") but for someone taller it might be to small- unless you really curl up when you sleep.I\'ve washed the pillow case a couple of times. It\'s a little difficult to put it back on. I ususally need my husband to help me. It\'s more time consuming then anything. Over all though I highly reccomend this pillow.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Seams are very uncomfortable, flattens very easy and came with no pillow case, but it is Big and wraps around me,

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I love this pillow.  I\'m now using it for my second pregnancy and don\'t know what I would do without it.  I really love the U shape instead of just a candy cane.  It means I don\'t have to move the pillow with me if I turn from one side to the other.  Plus I can pull whichever side is behind me up close to support my back and hips from behind.  That seems to be even more helpful for this pregnancy.There are some things I would mention, but I wouldn\'t exactly call them all cons...1. The pillow case is not easy to remove.  It\'s a slip on from the bottom of each end and you really have to work to get it off and on.  But the value for the cost of getting another pillow with a zippered cover was not worth it to me.2.  For me, I find it most comfortable to sleep with the open end down at my feet so the pillow is in the inverted U position.  The only problem with this is that, for me, the pillow is not thick enough at the top for how much I like my head elevated.  So I sleep with my normal pillow on top of this pillow to raise my head more.  This one\'s not really a problem for me, it\'s just what I\'ve found works best.3.  If it were not for #2, the other reviewers comments about the seam digging into their shoulders would have been true for me too.  But the addition of my own pillow on top negated this issue for me.4.  When I\'m laying in the pillow, the two sides come down to about my knees.  I\'m not very tall, just 5\'1".  I would have liked it to be a little longer, but again, for what I was willing to spend this still worked well.  I normally sleep with my knees bent anyway, with one under the pillow and the other on top, and it is long enough for that.  But if you are much taller this might be an issue and you might consider a longer pillow.5.  My husband and I jokingly call this the monster pillow.  It really is huge and takes up a lot of room on the bed.  We have a queen sized bed and it\'s not too over crowded or uncomfortable trying to fit.  I don\'t think I would be comfortable with two people and this pillow in any smaller sized bed.  It definitely nixes any comfortable snuggle time unless I completely kick the pillow out of bed and really keeps my husband at a distance from me.  I guess some women might actually like that during pregnancy though.  The size is really necessary for what the pillow does for you though.  Just be aware that it is big.5.  The pictures show the pillow being used for nursing, but I found it to be too bulky for this.  My Boppy worked much better.  I pretty much stopped using the pillow as soon as I got home from the hospital the first time around.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: It feels like you are constantly being hugged and is a life saver for a bad back. Just turn and no adjustment needed. When you first get it, it may seem WAY too puffy. I gave it one less star because it gets flat relatively fast but this is the best price around and for the comfort it gives me, I\'ll just keep buying them.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: pretty good. The same as I have expected. Good quality and competitive price. My wife loves it very much. Thanks.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: this pillow rocks, it does take up some space, but if you get more sleep who cares i do recommend using an old pillow case and cut hole in it so you dont have to remove cover to wash its a pain to get back on and i ripped mine, but  still its like a dream and was hard to give up lol

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I LOVE this body pillow!  I\'ve been sleeping like a baby ever since it arrivedThe only negatives are that it is a very large body pillow that takes up half of my king size bed.  I really don\'t have anywhere to store the pillow as well, so it\'s always in eye sight in my bedroom.But, overall this pillow is a lifesaver and I\'m so happy I got it during my pregnancy

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I couldn\'t have done without this item during my pregnancy.  I began using it around month four and never removed it from my bed until I came home from the hospital with the baby.  It\'s a little difficult to stuff the pillow back into the cover. Towards the end of my pregnancy I needed help putting it back together.As someone who is picky about my sheets, I found the pillow cover to be lacking.  After just two washes, the fabric began to develop uncomfortable pilling.  Also, even though I took care to fluff the pillow stuffing regularly, there were definite signs of wear and irreversible compression around month seven (about three months of use).

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This pillow is amazing!  I bought this for my third pregnancy.  The first two pregnancies, I used a different body pillow.  Hands down, this one is the winner.  I\'m currently 2 weeks away from my due date and am shocked at how good I feel.  I\'m getting a good nights sleep and I don\'t have any of the aches and pains in my hips, legs or back that I had with the other two.  I went back and forth when buying this pillow because it\'s so expensive, but it has proven to be well worth the cost.  The seam at the shoulder IS annoying but I just learned how to position the pillow around me and it\'s not really a big deal anymore.  LOVE!!!

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This item is obviously made for someone 5 feet tall or so.  I am not.  When trying to use it with my head on the top as a pillow, the seam is very painful and the "arms" don\'t reach far enough to offer any support for my arms or legs. When I tried using it the other way, it was still very short and uncomfortable. As others have said the cover is very difficult to remove and replacement covers very expensive.  To huge to return, had to give it to a dwarf friend.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Could use a little more stuffing, other than that it\'s a great product. I have heard from friends that the regular Snoogle doesn\'t work well for people that are taller. Also I like having the additional back support. I still tend to roll over onto it - but it helps.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I don\'t usually write reviews but thought I would for this. I love this pillow. I am 24 weeks along and started having bad hip pain from having to sleep on my sides and a body pillow was not working. This works great, I love that whatever side I turn in the middle of the night I have support on front and back without having to shift the pillow. I was worried about it being too big for my queen sized bed, but I have no complaints from the hubby. Fits perfect.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I ordered the pillow after reading rave reviews - I found the pillow for me actually made my back pains worse.  Haven\'t used it since the first week I ordered it - I keep it though since maybe when I get even bigger it may be of comfort to me.  We\'ll see.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: The pillow is comfortable and better than stacking a variety of pillows but I wished it held its shape better. There isn\'t enough back support when lying on your side so half of the pillow seems useless.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I was 7 months pregnant when I purchased the pillow.  I needed something to support my back and help me sleep better and it has done the job.  It is pretty big, but I have a queen size bed and there is still room for my husband in the bed.  I would recommend this pillow to any pregnant person.  I haven\'t washed the cover yet so I\'m not sure how difficult it will be to put it back on.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: This was a gift for my daughter, she thanks me everyday.  She can sleep much better.It\'s so soft and comfortable.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: While I can appreciate other reviewers\' sentiments about the seam, I haven\'t found this to be a fatal flaw by any means. I usually just scoot down a bit, so it isn\'t right up against my neck and am able to sleep fine. I say this, in part, because I am a notoriously finicky sleeper and, prior to pregnancy, was sleeping with a memory foam pillow. The Leachco pillow does make sleeping on my side much easier and more comfortable, eliminating mild hip pain I was beginning to develop in the 4th month. I do find myself flipping onto my back during the night sometimes, but because of the design on the pillow, I\'m never flat on my back. The pillow does, however, take up a lot of space in the bed. I\'m not sure how much I\'ll love it in July when it\'s super hot and I\'m super pregnant.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: I am 22 weeks pregnant and I was recommended to sleep on the sides. My hips were aching like crazy since they were not able to take my body weight. My belly would feel like there are many parts hanging in there when I change positions especially. After much research I decided to order this product. It is a boon I would say. It supports your back and the belly as the name says. I do not put the entire weight on my hips anymore. I slightly tilt on either sides so my belly gets supports from the curved portion of the pillow and back rests comfortably on the other side of this pillow. As many other have reviewed, it does have an uncomfortable seam. I just wrapped a soft towel over it and have a pillow on top of it for that extra height so I do not get heart burns. I have a queen size bed - my husband and I fit in comfortably. This is the first time I have reviewed a product since I felt it is totally worth the money and would be helpful for many others who are going through the same problems.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My goodness was this the right choice for me! Back ache-gone! Thanks!! I highly recommend this pillow! Not even sure how i lived through my first pregnancy without it! Second was a breeze! :)

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: ...Mom to be? Not so much. But maybe as she gets further along she will find it a handy thing to have.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: Perfect in every way... For those complaining about the neck portion... You really need to use a head pillow in addition to this pillow; this is mainly for your body.  So, throw a head pillow on top of this and get this most perfect night sleep every (mainly for those pregnant moms).  Only con is that it takes up a lot of room.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My wife was willing to overlook the uncomfortable top seam, but when the cover ripped we lost faith in Leachco.

name: Leachco Back \'N Belly Contoured Body Pillow, Ivory
review: My sister loved this product. She said it\'s so comfortable and soft. She used while she sleeps and sitting down. It\'s a great purchase. No discoloration and maintains its shape.

name: Basic Comfort Toddler Neck Support
review: i bought this when my son was about 1 month old, hoping it would keep his head from slumping so much in the car seat/infant carrier. it didn\'t work. first of all, it wouldn\'t fit comfortably around his neck, and then it kept falling off. i gave up after a few tries. wouldn\'t recommend buying this product.

name: Jardine Dark Pine Glider with Beige Micro Fiber Fabric
review: I shopped and shopped and shopped and ended up with this rocker and ottomon. So far so good. The chair was VERY easy to assemble and the ottomon comes assembled. Is very stable and doesn\'t creak or pop at all. The back cushion was the most comfortable out there as far as plushness and height (I can lay my head back on it and am 5\'5"). Wide seat. Very thick bottom cushion that was softer in the store but I think that is because of so many people sitting on it. You will not feel the wood underneath the cushion!!! Looks great in my living room!!! I sat in the cheaper models and could not sell myself short. Even my 6-year old fell in love with this model. THIS CHAIR IS WORTH EVERY PENNY!

name: Jardine Dark Pine Glider with Beige Micro Fiber Fabric
review: I love the way this looks and it was great at first. There was damage on the base but we called the 1-800 number and they sent a new one (however it took about 6 weeks so we ended up puting it together w/the scratched one). It is very attractive and sturdy enough, plus the microfiber is easy to clean for the inevitable milk spills - the reason I\'m giving it a low rating is the seat cushion. It went flat where you sit within a month. I am not huge or anything - to give you an idea, I was using it w/a newborn and I am about 133 lbs. I have not called to get a replacement but even if they send one I\'m sure it\'ll go flat again. Although I\'m not using it quite as much now that my son is a little older.

name: Jardine Dark Pine Glider with Beige Micro Fiber Fabric
review: I bought this at the babies r us store. I sat in several gliders to test comfort. The "spaure" back cushion (in comparison to the "butterfly" style" or rounder style) was much more comfortable on my back up at the shoulder level. I chose this pine glider for that very reason (the square back cushion). When I got the glider home and opened the box, the cushion was not what it was supposed to be. It was the butterfly style. Plus it was damaged in packaging. It was deformed from being squished into the box. The assembly instructions say in big red letters "Do not return this item to the store" and gives a 1-800 #. When I called to see if I could have the correct cushion sent to me, I was told that I couldn\'t. What the heck??? I paid over $200 and they can\'t even give me the correct cushion. Now I will have to see if babies r us can do anything for me. The only thing good aobut this chair is that it truely is easy to put together. The snaps that hold the arm rest to the chair are cheap and rip out if you try to remove the arm rest after snapping it on. So make sure you don\'t ever try to remove it. That stinks incase you need to take them off to clean or for moving houses. I can say I\'m 30%satisfied with this chair. Oh and the bottom cushion at the store was soft, the one that came w/ the chair, not soo smooshy. Kinda like sitting on a stiff cushion.

name: Jardine Dark Pine Glider with Beige Micro Fiber Fabric
review: I got this glider for my best friend\'s nursery.  I was a little nervous ordering such a big item online but I had already seen it in a store and thought it would be perfect.  I was not dissapointed at all when it came in.  It is very comfortable and looks great!  It also did not take very long for it to come in.  I think we received it within 1 week and we didn\'t even pay for speedy shipping!

name: Safety 1st Intera 4-in-1 Convertible Car Seat
review: This is an ok carseat...not as good as it looks in the pictures.  Be ware if you order from amazon.  The company who sells it will not take a return if the box is open- it does not matter if you used it or not...don\'t open the box if you want to return it.  Also, the worst feature, that I did not see explained anywhere is that the buckle is a puzzle buckle...very difficult to buckle a child in who does not cooperate!!  I would go with another seat if I were you!

name: Safety 1st Intera 4-in-1 Convertible Car Seat
review: we bought this seat for my daughter when she was just 8m old (now 2.5yr old). it fit just fine in our minivan both rear facing & forward facing. not easy to install but with my DH strength he got it in very tight. i don\'t dare undo it. tho we have on occasion but that\'s Dh job to get it back in. hee hee. my daughter is comfy in it & in fact we left her rear facing til she was 16m with no problems. i have no problems with twisting straps like i\'ve had with other seats. when she falls asleep in the seat her head rests on the side (the wings). my boys have another seat (the alpha omega) & to this day their heads flop when they sleep in it. i love how this will be the ONLY seat she will ever need. i\'m gonna buy the same one for my 3rd son very shortly too.

name: Safety 1st Intera 4-in-1 Convertible Car Seat
review: I bought this car seat thinking it would be great to have since it converts into a booster seat....not a bad price for several years worth of car seat safety.  What a mistake! I should have known when I started getting confused reading the complicated owner\'s manual (I\'m a TEACHER and it was still very confusing).  Just to adjust the buckle you have to remove the entire bottom base part of the seat, which just so happens to involve removing some type of metal rod.  After getting extremely frustrated because I simply could not remove the rod (and I\'m no wuss), I decided to return it. You have to remove this same metal rod to install the cupholder....as if a 7-month-old needs it anyway! I bought the Evenflo Triumph 5 and I am very pleased with it.  There\'s no cupholder, but we are surviving!  You can\'t go wrong with the Triumph 5!  I was told at Toys R Us that the Intera is returned more than any other car seat.  Maybe someone should take a hint and get them off their shelves!!??

name: Safety 1st Intera 4-in-1 Convertible Car Seat
review: This is a very comfortable seat for my 7 month old.  However, I had alot of difficulty installing the unit rear-facing in my midsized SUV .  The latch strap was lacking 2-3 inches from reaching the latch if I used the base/booster.  I could install the unit without the base but it defeated the purpose to me so I called the 1-800 number and found out the latch belt included was not long enough to accommodate the rear-facing position with the base/booster unit.  They promptly took my information and mailed me a longer strap.  My daughter seems content so far...

name: Safety 1st Intera 4-in-1 Convertible Car Seat
review: Extremely hard to understand instructions and does not fit in a 2004 Subaru OutBack wagon properly with or without base.Brought in by the local Police station to have the safety officer look at it and he even tried to install it and said it was not a very safe seat.Lots of safety issues with it.Seat leans to far back and extra straps in the back of seat just dangle.Manufacture says to tuck extra strap under seat while using the seat in the rear facing position.Not a very good idea belts are still loose and floppy.Not a very good buy.

name: Evenflo Traditions Booster Seat - Devon Black
review: I purchased the "Greystone Generations Harness Booster Seat" and returned it within 3 weeks. I loved the fact that my son would have armrests since most carseats seem so uncomfortable because there is nothing there. The right armrest broke off after just a few weeks of minor use. I returned it and purchased the "Traditions Booster Car Seat" -- I love the fact that the straps are adjustable from the front (it hurts to have to squeeze your hand through to the back - especially when you don\'t want to have to unbuckle everything, safety harnesses and whatnot). Too, the armrests are very easily attached but very sturdy and you can take them off whenever you want. It is a great feature. It seems that with the "Generations" seat instead of being comfortable, my son seemed more uncomfortable with the arm rests. The "Traditions" is a good buy and a wonderful car seat. No kid loves a car seat, but at least this one keeps him comfortable.

name: Evenflo Traditions Booster Seat - Devon Black
review: We tried several seats the day we bought this one.  Even took them out of the store and tried them in the car before we picked one.  Had our son sit in them, but made the mistake of not actually latching it.  We thought the one sided strap adjustment was a little weird, but we thought we\'d get used to it because the seat was nice otherwise.  Well, it was awful.  It was hard as heck to adjust the harness, and the latch between our son\'s legs dug into his thighs, plus the latch across his chest had to be squeezed very hard to get it open.  Since this seat was going in the back of a two-door compact car, this seat was WAY too much trouble to get him in and out of.  I absolutely do not recommend this seat at all.We have a Cosco Alpha Omega in one car and it\'s great aside from a little twisting on the straps.  And the one we replaced the Evenflo with is a Graco Ultra CarGo and so far it\'s fantastic.  If you\'re interested in this seat, please make sure you try out all the adjustments and latches and get your child to sit in it to make sure it\'s comfortable before you buy it.

name: Evenflo Traditions Booster Seat - Devon Black
review: I bought this carseat to fit in the back of my 2001 Sentra (which isn\'t too roomy in the back). It fits wonderfully. I felt that this was a pretty good car seat. However it has its pro\'s and con\'s.Pro\'s: inexpensive, a lot of little extra\'s including the goodie bag, cup holder, head pillow, and extra lumber padding on top of an already very padded seat, also very nice looking for the price.Con\'s: Getting the shoulder straps to adjust was EXTREMELY trying...they definately make it seem much easier than it is. Also, the armrests seem pretty cheap considering they "pop" into place and are not attached to the seat.Overall I\'m happy with the purchase and my daughter loves it!

name: Evenflo Traditions Booster Seat - Devon Black
review: I don\'t even know where to begin, that\'s how horrible we found this seat to be.  First off, the harness: 1) took us 30 min. to adjust to my 3 year old\'s height, and when we got the straps into the slots they needed to be in, we had to HAMMER them back in place...how good is that for the integrity of the seat? 2) the adjusting strap for the harness is on the child\'s right side of the harness (see pic. in the description..look really close).  The strap just flaps around in their lap making it easy for them to pull and potentially get too tight while you are driving 3) the crotch strap is EXTREMELY uncomfortable.  It has no padding around it and rather than snapping up on their belly somewhere it snaps IN their little crotch area.  My daughter was crying instantly.  The pillow...WHO thought that would be comfortable for a child?  Someone who must not think very well, honestly.  The arm rests and cup holder are CHEAP.  There is not enough "seat" around my child to make me feel she is safe.  Please take this to heart and don\'t buy it.  Ours didn\'t even make it to our van.  We returned it the next day.

name: Paper Dolls Pillow
review: First the set is not being taken off the shelves and replacds with Blossoms.  It is NOT on the list of discontinued bedding patterns at BRU.  I got that straight fromteh manager who called corporate to make sure.  They have just brought in more items to coordinate with this line so it\'s not going anyway.This was one of those final touches that we weren\'t sure if we wanted to spend the money on but I\'m glad we did!  I kept it in the closet until we converted our crib into the toddler bed.  I dug it out of the closet to use as a toss pillow on her daybed nad it really is a nice touch.  It makes her bed look not so plain now and it\'s teh perfect size for her to play with.  So it was a good purchase and great finishing touch to a wonderful pattern.

name: Hohner / 8" Toddler Rainmaker
review: Great toy for 9 months and up.  Once they can hold it in their hand and twist on their own.  The adults liked it as well!

name: Hohner / 8" Toddler Rainmaker
review: This toy was well received by my toddler grandtwins Lucas and Nora. All the adults wanted to play with it also!

name: Hohner / 8" Toddler Rainmaker
review: I ordered this toy for my 8 month old son and he loves it! He really likes the sound it makes and watching the beads go from one end to the other. My only complaint is that the ends are pink and purple and in an item that you cannot select the color I would have preferred more gender neutral colors. Overall though, a great toy and pleased with the purchase.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: My husband and I originally wanted a video monitor, but decided to go with this monitor since our son\'s room was only next door.  This monitor is perfect. We hear EVERYTHING, from his breathing to the kids outside playing.  I love this monitor.  I\'m giving it 4stars because the alarms goes off on it\'s own sometimes.  My son is 6 1/2 months and it\'s gone off only about 3-4 times, but it was very annoying when it did...especially in the middle of the night.  Otherwise, it\'s perfect and I\'m glad we registered for it.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: I have never written a review before, but after reading all the bad reviews this monitor has gotton, I had to write one.First, the sound is crystal clear, I can hear my baby breathing at night, and her monitor is across the room.Second, yes my monitor may beep in the middle of the night, but it\'s NOT the parent unit finder...it\'s the motion detector.  That\'s why I bought this monitor.  It picks up if one of the animals goes into the babies room.  It will also pick up baby movement once the baby starts moving more, but you CAN turn the motion detector off.This monitor does EXACTLY what it is suppose to do!  I love it!

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: This monitor seems to work great, except for the annoying alarm clock sound that occurs at random times of the day and night.  I did contact evenflo and they offered to send me a new monitor.  This is the only model with pet detection, so they are going to send the same model, but if the same issue occurs, they will replace the unit with a different model.  At least they are owning up to the problem and trying to do something to replace it.  Other than the random alarm, this unit works great.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: Like the other reviews have said, this monitor beeps at random for no apparent reason. Last night we spent the evening (again) trying to determine the reason it was beeping to no avail. Our daughter was sleeping peacefully while we were up w/the monitor! The pet sensor is great, but the random beeping ruins the monitor\'s advantages. If you want to sleep, I wouldn\'t recommend this monitor.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: We bought this for out two year olds room, when the old Evenflo died.  We sleep down stairs and he is up and we just want to hear if he needs us in the middle of the night.  It was a bad choice, it beeps when it can not find the signal and my house is not that big.  It is going back to the store.  We have no problem with the fisher price monitors we use for our daughter.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: This monitor is horrible!  As for any good reviews all I can say is that those people must have just started using the monitor.  I really liked it when I first got it, too.  But then it started going off randomly.  I wrote to Evenflo and they said I must have a faulty parent unit.  They were vary nice and sent me a new one right away.  It malfunctioned the first night!!!  The clarity is incredible when you first use it.  So much so that we actualy had to turn on a sound machine in our daughter\'s room so we didn\'t hear every breath she took, but the alarm (NOT THE PET DETECTION SENSOR, THEY ARE DIFFERENT SOUNDS!) goes off for no reason, sometimes 6 times a night.  This product will be great once Evenflo admits it is flawed and fixes the random alarm problem.  I was impressed with its initial performance, but please, new parents have enough trouble sleeping without adding this random alarm clock to the bedside table!

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: This unit worked well for the first few months.  However, like the previous reviewer, our unit also beeps randomly for no apparent reason, even though we have the pet detection system OFF. Nor is it a low battery issue- it happens even when the receiver is plugged in.  The system now seems perfectly timed for the alarm to go off the instant the baby has fallen asleep.  It has awakened our baby more times than we can count, so we will be getting another system after we throw this one in the pool. Save your money!

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: We have yet to use the pet detector feature-decided to hold off from bringing the cat into the house with the baby, but the rest of the system works well. The reception is very clear-can hear the baby breathing and moving around. Have had no problems with range, although the farthest we\'ve had the units apart was 100 feet. The monitor does beep sometimes-we thought because the unit was running out of batteries when unplugged-but has not been annoying.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: I bought this product in 3/2005 for that it is the only one in the market that I have found that comes with rechargeable batteries and that it recharges them.  The receiver starts beeping which is the paging feature that goes off all by itself, also the sound is very low even when put on high.  You must have the unit right next to your ear to hear the baby.  I do not recommend this product, if you want to sleep in peace.

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: After seeing all the bad reviews, I too wanted to tell you of my good experience. I LOVE this monitor! It is whisper quiet...I can hear the baby breathe. I leave it on 24-7 and have never had a problem. No fuzz or static, no beeps, nothing. I don\'t use the pet detection. I had another monitor and hated the static it produced. This is SO quiet.And no...I haven\'t just started using it! I\'ve had it for 6 months and still no problems! Love it! :)

name: Evenflo Whisper Connect Sensa Monitor
review: We have had this monitor for 5 months and loved it... till last week. It wakes us up every night beeping and the only way to get it to stop is to turn it off and turn it back on, only to have it wake us a few hours later.  I traded it in for another one, and the very first night, it did the same thing.  So, if our son is not waking us up it is the monitor.  I am returning it tomorrow for a completely different brand.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: My husband and I put this swing together fairly quickly and easily.  We did not have any missing parts or a hard time.  However, when it swings, it is very loud.  I don\'t know if all swings are like this because this is my first one, but the sound of the swing drowns out any chance of your child even hearing the music.  The batteries lasted me about 2 months which I didn\'t think was that bad because I do use the swing almost every day.  I don\'t really like how the tray snaps on though.  The way is snaps on is kind of awkward because you have to bend it a little bit.  Sometimes because it takes me a little while, I feel like I might close my daughters hand in it.But, on the good side, I love the head support it gives and all the different swing modes.  I have not had a problem with mobile, it always stays just where I put it.  Also, it is not heavy, so it is easy for me to move it where I need it to be.I only gave it 3 stars because I think that few adjustments need to be made to make it better.  But, I wanted everything to be the same pattern, so I didn\'t even think about taking it back.  However, if in the future I wanted another swing, I am not so sure that I would get this one again.  I think I would do some shopping first.  But, I didn\'t buy it, and it gets the job done, so I gave it a 3.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: With our first baby we had a travel swing. It worked fine but it didnt swing as fast as we would like since it had such a small motor and we had to bend down a lot to pick her up so close to the ground, which was harder the bigger she got.Now with our second we decided we would go for a full size swing, and decided on the Windsor. Its a beautiful pattern in sage green with toile. But as I looked at the toile pattern I realized it was boys at the fishing hole, so while it might look girly because of the toile dont shy away from it for a boy.My husband and I put it together in about 40 minutes.....pretty standard for a piece of baby equipment. We did struggle a bit with the fabric fitting but it did fit....snuggly. And really you want things on baby products to fit snuggly.Ive had no problems with the mobile as other posters have said. I also know that unless you are missing parts when you put together baby items 99% of the problems are user problems. Trust me, Ive had my share of "why wont this work?!" and then realized "Ooooh, it\'s silly me!".Beautiful swing, great movement for all ages of babies and a true necessity from the first day home. You will be able to use this swing for several babies. Dont hesitate, you and your baby will love it!

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: My 2 sons used the same Graco 6 speed open top swing (we have a different pattern than the pictured Windsor pattern). I am expecting my 3rd son very soon, so I thought I might try one of these newer model swings i.e Graco Hug swing, Graco Silouette swing, Fisher Price Cradle swing, etc. After careful research and actually looking over them all at Babies R Us and Target, I have come to the conclusion that my "old" swing is better. I like that it is higher off the ground, so I don\'t have to bend over as far to put my baby in it. Like the newer models (that I suppose are advertised to be improved and better), my older swing has the same recline position, legs fold for storage, snack tray, safety belt, some models have an overhead mobile, music option, and speed varieties. I happen to think the older models can be used for longer. The "Papasan" and "Hug" and "Siloutte" are like a round bucket so when your child is bigger they look as if they are way too big to be in it, but the traditional seats make your child look normal to be in it as they grow. I believe the weight limits are ll the same too in the 25-30 lbs range. I also found that the seat covers on the Graco open top are easy to remove and wash (as most Graco products). Can\'t see spending $130 for a new swing when I am content with my old $80 swing, it has given me it\'s worth.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: I just bought this swing last week. The lights don\'t work and neither does the music. We have to take the batteries out of it in order for it to stop swinging. Makes loud clicking noise. It still works though, surprisingly. My daught loves the swing, but the type and brand don\'t matter. We are going to get a new one.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: I have to say that this swing was a lifesaver for my colicky baby. She had the need to be swung rapidly since she was abt 6 weeks old, and now at 5 mos, she can still get it crankin! It is pretty, quite comfy w/ 2 sized head supports, and it reclines well. I found the music to be kind of tinny sounding, but we rarely used it. I also found that in 5 months of CONSTANT use, Ive only had to change the batteries once! I only gave it 4 stars b/c we had some problems w/ the mobile. Every time it swung, the mobile inched backwards until it was behind the swing. Not really useful if baby wants to look at it and it is behind them. I had to tape it so that it doesnt move. Other than that minor complaint, I love it. Ill be saving this one for the next baby!

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: I am a first time mother. One thing that I have learned is never to pick something beacause you like the pattern. I love the Windsor pattern, so I figured I would register for all of the items in Windsor print. I recevied them all. The item I like the least is the swing. It wasn\'t exactly easy to put together. The mobile was the hardest part. Once you think you get it on, it just keeps falling off. I got so aggravated, I just gave up and kept the mobile off. When my six month old son falls asleep his head always ends up falling to the side or in his lap, no matter how far it is reclined and even with the head insert in. It sure isn\'t a quiet swing, it makes a clicking noise everytime it goes back and forth. It goes through batteries like crazy. My son has learned to unhook the tray and when he does he just about falls out. I\'m not happy with it at all. The only reason I gave it two stars is because the pattern is very nice. I went and bought the linkadoos take along swing, which I love and am completely satisfied with. Never register for an item or buy an item just because you like the pattern and want a matching set, you may end up with something you hate :)

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: This swing is all right, my son loves to swing in it and it\'s useful when he\'s fighting sleep...it\'s what will finally get him to give in.  But, my son is only 3 months old and the mobile has fallen off and hit him in the head twice now.  The first time it fell off I thought I had attached it wrong, or too loosely.  I left it off for a few days, and today I reattached it, assuring that it was SECURE...I was doing the dishes and my son had fallen asleep in the swing and all of a sudden I hear a bang and he just started SCREAMING.  The mobile had once again fallen off and hit him square on the top of the head, leaving a red mark just to the left of his soft spot.  I immediately came here to my computer to write this.  BEWARE of the mobile! Also, my mobile, like the other reviews, also swings back out of baby\'s view.  I have now taken the mobile off and will LEAVE it off.  Too dangerous for baby.Good swing, terrible mobile attachment

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: My baby boy is just past 4 months old. My husband and I have been using this awesome swing since our little guy came home from the hospital.In the beginning we must have attached the mobile wrong because it kept falling to the back. After looking at the mobile connection again my husband attached it correctly and it no longer falls to the back. Also, in the beginning we did not realize that the swing reclined as far back as it does. So for about two weeks we wadded up dish towels around our baby\'s head to keep his head from falling forward. It was just by accident that I realized it reclined as far as it does. After that our baby\'s neck and head were fine.We have used this swing for over four months now and have NEVER HAD A PROBLEM except for us assembling it incorrectly. Not to mention, until last week my son spent all of his sleep time in it. He would sleep 8-9 hours within two weeks of his birth swinging all night long. He also took his naps in it. He didn\'t like laying flat. He is now sleeping flat but, still swinging for his naps.We also got the Aquarium swing and are not impressed. Yes, we have two swings. The Graco one is our favorite. The Aquarium doesn\'t swing fast enough, takes a lot of batteries that don\'t last, and the motor already died once (called Fisher Price and they sent a new one within a week). The Graco one swings faster, takes less batteries, the batteries last MUCH longer, and is just overall the better swing. The timer and 6 speeds are also a plus.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: This swing is beautiful but awkward to move from room to room.  The toy bar does not come close enough for my daughter to ever get interested in it and when it\'s swinging the toy bar moves itself back behind the seat every time so she can\'t even see it.  I guess the motion of the swing causes it to do this.  We also have a small portable swing that my daughter likes much better.  The portable swing was quite a bit cheaper too.  The colors of the portable swing are brighter and the toy bar actually comes a lot closer to her.  I do like the open top of this swing . . . we purchased a cradle swing in the beginning but bumped our daughter\'s head on the toy bar every time we used it so we got this one.  This swing really hasn\'t been worth the money for us.  It basically sits in the living room as a beautiful item to look at.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: I love this swing and the pretty print...perfect for a little girl! I like all the features such as the different speeds, music and mobile. My daughter likes to look at the mobile while she swings. The motor does make noise while swinging..but then again don\'t they all? I don\'t think it\'s too loud though. The only problem we\'ve encountered is when the swing was on & no matter which setting it was on, the mobile would end up swinging itself towards the back where the baby can\'t see it anymore, it took a while but after messing around with it for about the 20th time I figured out the problem, it wasn\'t turned far enough to the front left side, I was always scared to turn it further thinking I would snap the arm, but once I finally did it it was fixed and has stayed put ever since. I think the only reason the arm ever moved was because one of my older kids would play with it and move it around. I think taking the arm off the swing and reattaching it (like just out of the box directions) would\'ve fixed it too. All in all I love the swing and wouldn\'t switch it for another. I would also recommend it to anyone with a baby girl because of the lovely print...just don\'t be afraid to adjust the mobile arm all the way to the left (almost touching the part that connects legs) if it gets whacked out of place!

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: If I could go back, we\'d get the Ocean Aquarium swing.  We got the Windsor one since we had the carseat, stroller, pack and play and travel crib.  The Ocean Aquarium looked like an eyesore.  Our daughter was bored in the Windsor swing though she spent hours in her Ocean Aquarium bouncer watching the fish.  We never had any mechanical issues with the swing.  In hindsight we should have gotten the Ocean Aquarium swing.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: We LOVE our swing! It is not only very pretty but has 16 great songs with volume control, 6 speeds & best of all - PUTS THE BABY TO SLEEP, which is the object of the drill, right? It was very easy to assemble & it quite sturdy as well.As for the other reviewer\'s comments about \'loud\' clicking noises - there are noises but we have found that MOST swings make that sound & ours does not bother us or the baby at all. After all, there is a little motor working inside working away & doing its job. Also - we have not had any problems with batteries, etc.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: We registered for this swing.  It took about a month for our little girl to start using it, but now she sleeps in it no less than once a day.  The six speeds make it very versatile.  We put her in it when she gets tired and she is asleep within minutes.  Very light to move around the first floor of the house.  I wouldnt want to drag it up and down the stairs.  The straps are very secure and the head supports are good too.  The only drawback is that the mobile will slowly rotate to the back of the swing(meaning it wont stay put) at higher speeds.  Truth is that it seems rather difficult for a newborn to look up at it at such an angle anyway.  All in all we are very satisfied

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: My son is six months old today and this swing has now become a hazard.  I used to put him in it when I had to run to the bathroom or to throw laundry in the dryer.  I figured it was a safe place to leave him for a few minutes.  My very curious son, however, has learned that he can reach out and grab the bars!  I would have never seen this trick coming, and I wouldn\'t believe it had I not seen it myself.  If I knew then what I know now, I would have gotten one like the Ocean Wonders which does not have bars in front of the child.  When he was younger and a bit less grabby, it was a good swing.

name: Graco Swingomatic 6 Speed Swing - Windsor
review: This swing never worked consistently.  At first thought it was draining batteries but realized it\'s a motor issue.  Now the motor is shot (of course it\'s past the warranty period).  Seems a common theme based on other reviews.  We didn\'t use it very often either.Bought the Fisher Price Ocean Wonders Swing used for our second child (didn\'t want to spend another $100 on a swing) and have not had any problems.  Have used it twice as much as we used the Graco.

name: Fisher Price Smart Stages 3-in-1 Rocker Swing
review: Works great as a swing, however, for newborns, I would definitely suggest a snugli head rest because it comes with no support, once the child can sit up, you can remove it. Also, although it does recline as an infant seat and is more than adequate it does NOT vibrate so we had also a vibrating infant seat. Now my son is 1 and he sits in the rocker all the time and seems to enjoy having "his chair" whereas the vibrating infant seat has been in the attic for 4 months awaiting a yard sale.

name: Fisher Price Smart Stages 3-in-1 Rocker Swing
review: We registered for this, but also recieved a bouncy chair, so never used it as the infant seat.As a swing, my son didn\'t really like it until almost 7 months. For smaller infants, I think it doesn\'t recline far enough.  The seat holds a child almost sitting upright.  Our son prefers the higher rocking level, but both are fine. We don\'t use the music  much, though there\'s no problem with it. I tend to put him in this to watch his Baby Einstein videos, so the music is unnecessary.My son doesn\'t use it as a rocker, yet, but my almost 3-year-old niece loves it and spent plenty of time sitting in it last time she visited. It\'s a nice comfy chair and I look forward to my son using it up to that age at least.It\'s great that it folds up, we put it away anytime he\'s not in it, and I\'ve even been able to easily fold it up and take it outside to swing on the porch.I took off one star because it\'s far too easy to stop the rocking when it\'s in swing mode.  Walking past it and bumping it, or the dog bumping it, or even the baby\'s blanket sliding down until it drags on the floor causes the rocking to stop.

name: Fisher Price Smart Stages 3-in-1 Rocker Swing
review: I bought this for my son. I thought it was a good buy and that he would use it for a long time. He is now two weeks old and the motor has gone out on the swing. That makes him mad, so I am having to replace it. Not very smart buy if you have to replace it.

name: Fisher Price Flutterbye Music Crib Toy
review: This thing projects on to the ceiling and has been through 2 kids so far! My 2 year old learned to sooth himself with this toy in the middle of the night. He stands up turns it on lays down talks to the birds and falls asleep within the 10 minutes it plays for. My sister wants it now for her babies since she can\'t find it in the store but I\'m not giving it up till mine shows no interest at all.

name: Skip Hop Duo - Cord-Camel
review: I love the color, but just like the bag. I thought it would be bigger. It holds my stuff, but doesn\'t open very wide. And it only holds the bare minimum... not much room for toys or more than 2 bottles... it\'s not an ALL day or overnight bag. But it does the job I suppose. If you only need to take the bare minimum then it\'s fine otherwise go for something bigger!

name: Skip Hop Duo - Cord-Camel
review: Great bag. Functional. Lots of places for stuff.Really liked the way it attaches to the stroller. (interchangable straps)Good diaper bag without being too feminine.

name: Skip Hop Duo - Cord-Camel
review: This bag does not look like a diaper bag so I will be able to use it long after the baby gets bigger.  It is not huge (which I like) and holds enough items for a day trip.  It has a side pocket for a bottle and the other pocket I use for pacifiers.  The two zipped pockets on each top side are great for keys, cellphone, wallet, etc because they are not very deep so you are not searching for your items at the bottom of the bag.The outer two pockets are great for toys or bibs.  The inside has some pockets that I use for diapers.  It is large enough to hold a blankie, change of clothes, wipes, diapers & 2-3 bottles.  The strap is adjustable in length and it converts so you can hang it on the stroller handle(s).  It comes with a changing pad.I love the cord material and the color is also my favorite.  If you don\'t care for the cord material, you can get one made from canvas at Target for $30 in either black, red or camo.  I have the black one and love it as well.  It is called Spark instead of Skip Hop but is made by the same company and both look very similar.

name: Skip Hop Duo Diaper Bag BLACK
review: The delux has better features however this is the best diaper bag.  It\'s not bulky, however fits everything.  i love the color red, it looks so cool on the stroller and doesnt bother me at alll.

name: Skip Hop Duo Diaper Bag BLACK
review: I got this for my husband but ended up using for myself when my bag broke and it was twice the money!  Great buy, I would recommend it!

name: Skip Hop Duo Diaper Bag BLACK
review: My husband wanted something we could both use with comfort for carrying the odds and ends of our precious little one to be.  We both love the durability, the stylish and sporty look.  We both felt it was a little short on space, it looked bigger than it really was. Overall a great bag, but a little bit too small.

name: Skip Hop Duo Diaper Bag BLACK
review: I tried several diaper bags when my first was born, then ordered this when #2 was on the way. I have used it every day for over 2 years and it is perfect!! I can hold two sippy cups, my water bottle, snacks, diapers & wipes. I carry my personal stuff in one of the zippered pouches with no problem. It is so deep that I also have a pair of socks for each of us in the bottom, plus band-aids,Tylenol, Desitin, etc. and you don\'t even know they are there. I also have my ipod, heart rate monitor watch/band in other zippered pouch so I always have it but it can\'t be seen. I borrowed a bigger bag traveling once and it was TOO HEAVY and hard to find things. This is the perfect size to carry quite a bit, but not the kitchen sink. It also has a cell phone holder on the side that makes access really easy. It\'s also washable and really durable. Oh, and the best part is-it\'s lightweight before you start packing it. That\'s really important when you\'re carrying three drinks with you. This is an awesome bag at an awesome price. I\'m about ready to graduate out of diaper bags, but can\'t find a purse/bag I think will work as great as this yet. Oh, and added bonus my husband has not complained once about carrying this bag!

name: Skip Hop Duo Diaper Bag BLACK
review: I am an internet shopper.  I review everything before I buy it.  This diaper bag seemed great after I read the reviews, but IT IS NOT!  I don\'t require a lot of space every day, but I would like to be able to fit 2- outfits (newborn!), burp rags, bibs, and one thin blanket on the inside of my bag, without having to take all the items out to find anything.  There are these long shallow pockets across the top.  If you put anything in them (paci, tiny motrin bottle, cellphone), then you really can\'t reach into the bag below, because those top compartments are sticking out into the middle of the bag, trapping the bottom items in the bag.  And the main compartment and outside pockets all have velcro, so try getting your outfits and blanket in and out without snagging them.  Try putting your own arm down in there, without snagging the sleeve of your shirt or sweater.  Impossible!  I just absolutely hate this bag.  No other way to say it. I have never reviewed anything so negatively on Amazon.  Very disappointing.  Maybe I can sell it for half of what I paid, so that someone who feels the way the other reviewers do can buy it!

name: Skip Hop Duo Diaper Bag BLACK
review: This product is a good idea, but the bag is too narrow.

name: Combi Deluxe Activity Rocker
review: We have two for our twins.  The 5-point harness is much too hard to use.  The lower straps are clearly not meant to be buckled and unbuckled every time, because they\'re much too cumbersome.  We just slide the baby in instead, and attach the upper straps, which are also a real struggle to undo.  The footrest doesn\'t stay down.  Our babies like the vibration but the battery doesn\'t last real long, and it sometimes vibrates loose and we have to shake the footrest to get it going again.

name: Kathe Kruse 18\'\' Towel Doll, Bear
review: We have five of these currently in rotation.  This particular towel doll was one of the first toy we gave our daughter when she was adopted at ten months old.  The original as well as a lambie sit on a bookshelf, loved to patches and still needed to be looked at and handled occasionally although not loved quite as hard.  At age eight she still has her lovies -- lambie bear (actually two separate towels dolls but needed together in extreme emergencies), pink lambie, polar bear and bunny foofoo.  These dolls are a very soft material and held up well to constant handling and many washings.

name: Kathe Kruse 18\'\' Towel Doll, Bear
review: Beautifully made, lovable and safe snuggle bear. Easily washable and dryer-safe. This little bear will be your baby\'s friend for a very long time.

name: Sigikid-USA Dog Snuggly
review: When our son was a newborn, we received a Sigikid towel bear from friends in Europe.  By the time he was 4 months old, he could grab the bear\'s body and jam a knot into his mouth for comfort.  This was a great comfort to us because our little boy had colic and was a fitful sleeper.  When our son started speaking, we learned that the bear\'s name was "Baby" rather than "Bear" as we had been calling him.  For his first birthday we gave our son a more bearlike bear that has shared the crib with Ted and Baby for 10 months.  In this time Ted has only developed a polite acquaintance with the bear; he saves all his love for Baby.Baby is durable.  The towel bear stands up to a sanitary cycle in the washing machine every two weeks.  We are not neat freaks.  Baby gets so much love that we can smell him from across the room sometimes.I do recommend that you tie the knots high on your towel animal\'s legs so that the little corner of fabric gets sucked on rather than the whole knot.

name: Kathe Kruse Terrycloth Baby, Blue/White
review: I purchased this doll for my nephew at my family\'s request. I have to say that the only reason I purchased it is because I was asked to. The quality is good but not luxurious by any means. The doll is only 12 inches long and pretty narrow. I was really not impressed. I paid $42 for the doll and I can confidently say it was only that expensive because of the name "Kathe Kruse." You could get the same quality doll at your local value store for about $12.

name: Mobile Volabella
review: This mobile is even better than it appears online.The birds are so big and vibrant.The angle it hangs on gives it the appearance of birds in flight.The price was the best I found.

name: Mobile Volabella
review: This mobile is absolutely lovely and looks even better in real life than online. The colors are very bold and the woodwork is quite nice. Not sure why people had trouble installing it. It comes pre-assembled. We simply put a hook/twisted screw in the ceiling and voila! It was installed. We put this on our Amazon Baby registry and are so happy that we did!

name: Mobile Volabella
review: I thought about getting a cheap, small, unidentifiable stuffed toy-hanging mobile. I am so glad I didn\'t. This adds color and energy to the baby\'s room. The wooden birds are classy and never boring. For people who\'re wondering about the delivery estimate, it was shipped from Japan and it took me about 10 days to get it here in central NY from the day I placed an order.

name: HABA Rattling Caterpillar Dangling Figure
review: We discovered HABA about 6 years ago, and collect the toys one by one-each of my 5 children have gotten one as a baby and have loved them.  They are such high quality we will save them for grandkids.

name: HABA Rattling Caterpillar Dangling Figure
review: I love that this toy is made w/ non-toxic paint. It\'s very cute and I\'m sure will be very durable. The string that holds it all together is elastic...so when you pull on the ring on the bottom, the little pieces click & clack together. The red loop on the top looks like it will be able to stretch and attach to anything (car seat, stroller, etc.)  Nothing fancy - just a simple, cute toy.

name: HABA Rattling Caterpillar Dangling Figure
review: My two month old is very intrigued by this toy.  If she\'s fussy, making the discs clap together will distract her.  I can\'t wait until she is older and can make them clap on her own.  I like the quality of the wooden toys, and the finish is awesome.  I buy this toy for my friends when they have kids!

name: HABA Rattling Caterpillar Dangling Figure
review: This is a really cute little toy, but neither of my children ever showed any interest in it.

name: Haba Ladybug Pacifier Chain
review: I love Haba products & this pacifier holder is another winner from Haba.  It is beautifully crafted and the colors are vibrant. The clasp is strong & the length of the chain is just right - not too long to be tangly & not too short to limit its functionality.  I deducted one star because I was hoping to use it with all the various pacifiers I have, however it does not work with pacifiers without a "handle" in the front. I ended up buying one of the Heimess brand pacifiers; which works even with pacifiers without the "handle" in the front.

name: Haba Ladybug Pacifier Chain
review: I get a ton of compliments on this. I bought this one as a gift for someone else, but received a similar looking one (same maker) and it is perfect to attach to my daughters carrier/car seat. From 0-5 months, it provided me easy access to find the pacifier in a hurry, even while driving when I had to reach back and do it blindly. Now after 5 months, she picks it up herself and plays with it & looks at the colors. I can easily detach it from the carrier & re-attach it to her clothes when I take her out of the car. This way she has it with her if she wants it, and it\'s never falling on the floor. I love it!

name: Haba Ramba Zamba
