review: All the Haba toys we have purchased are well made, and bright and fun.  So far, they have all been sturdy and well liked by my daughter from when she was about 3 months old, and she still plays with them at 8 months.

name: Max Clutching Toy
review: This isn\'t my sons favorite toy but it does keep him entertained when his attention finally falls on it. Plus it\'s so cute in his little hands.

name: Max Clutching Toy
review: This clutch toy was purchased for a baby who hasn\'t been born yet, so no indications from the recipient yet, but I think she\'s gonna love it!  I\'m a huge fan of Haba toys because they\'re beautifully designed and well built.  This toy appears to be complex enough to be interesting for quite a while and is so hold-able.  Also, Haba toys do not suffer from Disneyesque cutesiness, as many U.S. toys do, and for that alone I am willing to pay more.  I urge everyone else to do the same.  Vote for quality, people!

name: Max Clutching Toy
review: This toy is absolutely wonderful! The wood, the colors! Everything about it is simply great.  Such a simple, yet useful toy.  My son loves it!

name: Max Clutching Toy
review: Max is a HUGE hit in my house.  We have him on the carseat/stroller handle, and he is endless fun for the little one.  I put him on just before a plane trip and it kept his attention for so long.Note, the picture has him attached to a green snap - maybe to attach to clothing?  He doesn\'t come with that - just the yellow elastic loop.

name: Max Clutching Toy
review: My 6-month-old really enjoys when I hold this and move it in front of him, and he\'ll grab the bottom ring and want to hold it. He\'s really interested in anything that makes noise right now (the wood hits together when you shake it around), but I think that he is still a bit small for this. He\'s hit himself in the head with it a few times, and it is a pretty substantial wooden toy. I\'m also a bit worried because it does have small pieces. The elastic seems very strong, but if it were to ever snap then he could choke on the beads. Overall, I think that it is very cute and fun for him to play with when I am playing with him. For solo play, however, it\'s probably better for older babies. We also have the similar but smaller Haba squeak-squeak toy, and it is a better size for him to hold and play with.

name: Max Clutching Toy
review: Max is by far our favorite baby toy!  My son (still only 4 months old) loves his bright colors and cheerful click-clack sounds.  I hope that as he gets older, he\'ll start to notice the facial features and get attached to Max even more.  He\'s just the right size for babies and somehow is such a cheery toy!  The colors are the perfect hues and the ring on the bottom is perfect for grasping and chewing.  The cord (ours is red, fyi, not yellow as pictured here) is knotted and glued within the wood pieces, so I hope it doesn\'t come undone one day, but it shows no signs of doing that and seems to be extremely well made. Obviously this is a bit pricey but totally worth it. You get what you pay for and this one will be easy to keep clean and last through many kids.  I typically love the design and quality of Haba toys but keep in mind that a lot of them are still made in China, just fyi.  Overall, would highly recommend this toy.

name: Max Clutching Toy
review: This makes a really pleasant, delicate, clacking sound.  It\'s durable, the wooden stain stays brightly colored and is non-toxic, and you only have to wipe it with a damp cloth to clean it.  It was even cuter in person than in the picture and it made my 3-month-old sons smile and reach forward.  Total winner.

name: Max Clutching Toy
review: At 14-months, our daughter still plays with this toy. Love the fact it\'s made of wood and not plastic. We have tons of pictures from last summer when she was an infant with Maxe in her mouth! Great toy for the young ones.

name: Haba Baby Ballino
review: I bought Haba\'s Ballino for my daughter sometime just before she turned one. As a huge fan of anything ball-like, I thought it would capture her fancy.The toy itself is essentially 6 wooden pieces strung together on a very thick rubber cord. Each piece is separated by a small wooden ball to give even spacing. The pieces can be clicked together, and because it never forms a perfect ball, ballino can be rolled on the floor but will go in a fairly random direction. I thought this aspect would pique my daughter\'s curiosity, but it did not.The first day she received it, she played with it a little, but it has been virtually untouched since then. I assumed perhaps she was too old for it, but having read the other reviews on Amazon, I don\'t think this was the case. Since this toy is too large and awkward to be chewed or easily manipulated by the hands of a young baby (6-9 months), and doesn\'t have any entertainment value beyond rolling it a bit for a baby older than 9 months, it becomes less a practical toy with possible play value and more a pretty and rather pricey bit of toy box decor.It is pretty and well made. It will probably last forever - or at least a few decades until the rubber cord dry rots. But if I had it to buy again, I would absolutely pass it up. There are far better toys out there with much more long lasting play value. In fact, Haba\'s plain wooden balls have received far more play time than this fancy and seemingly more interesting toy.

name: Haba Baby Ballino
review: It\'s not the first go-to toy for my sons by any means but does get some use in rolling it across the floor and spinning it. I think it\'s a good addition to the other Haba toys as an extra little toy to play with on occasion.

name: Haba Circo Pulling animal
review: My son loves toys that he can drag behind him and this is his new favorite toy.  Even my older daughter likes to pretend it is a "dog" on a leash.  Haba\'s toys are always well made and very durable, I bought baby toys for my daughter 4 years ago that still look brand new after 2 kids. The little cogs do fall out very easily, but I just keep them out until one of them wants to play with them.  Worth every penny!

name: Girali Square
review: We were introduced to this line of fine wooden toys while stationed in Germany many years ago. The toys stand up to teething and remain in great shape. They\'re ideally shaped to be fastened to strollers, car seats, etc., so they can\'t be dropped. I heartily recommend them -- they will be in the family for generations.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: This simple, natural grasping/teething toy was a favorite of my little son. I highly recommend it.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: My 3 1/2 month old son loves this, and so do I.  It\'s just the right size for him to grasp and practice putting in his mouth, as well as shake to make the rings rattle.  The noise is just right too- enough to keep him interested, but not obnoxious to the adults in the room.  Highly recommended.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: Bought this for my child when an infant.  My hubby thought it was dumb - just a ring.  But my kid proved him wrong - one of his favorite infant toys!!!!!!!  Simple, yet perfect.  Perfect size for little hands to hold, bright colors, rings make just enough noise (without driving mom & dad batty), and SAFE!  HABA is a trusted brand in our house.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: This was one of the first toys that my son was able to grab and play with. He is now 5 months and shows a preference for it. He stares at the colors, shakes it and seems very interested in the two small blue rings. The fact that it is a circle makes it easy for me to attach to the diaper bag and take with us. I love that it is wood and is easy to clean.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: This was the first toy that my baby was able to hold.  It is light and small (maybe three inches across, about the size of a bracelet), perfect for two month old hands.  I put it in her hand, and she was able to shake it.  The toy is easy to stick in my diaper bag.  What I love about the toy is the nice, soft rattle sound.  It\'s really pleasant and not annoying like other toys.  When the baby started teething, she enjoyed putting it in her mouth, and I was glad it is made of wood and safe dyes.I only wish she played with it more.  Although she always takes it from me when I offer it, the ring doesn\'t hold her attention for long.  For the price and the two minutes she will look at this toy, I\'m not sure it is worth buying.  The only portable toy that has ever been able to keep her attention is chewing on the rubber Sophie giraffe.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: When I was picking toys for my 4 month old daughter, I thought this one looked like a winner.  All of the colors, and the interesting shape, plus those other two rings--doesn\'t that look fun?Eh.My daughter isn\'t really impressed.She likes the triangles better.  I thought theTriangle Rattlelooked kind of boring, but it had such high reviews I thought I would give it a shot.  Turns out my daughter is crazy about the triangles.  I think it\'s partly because this toy is wider around than the triangles are, so it is easier for her to hold the triangles.If the triangles are not available, my daughter will hang onto this for a few minutes.  I suspect she will probably like it more as her hands and mouth get a little bigger.I\'m still glad we bought this, but if you\'re choosing between this and the triangles and you\'re purchasing for a young child, I\'d recommend the triangles.  Even though this looks more fun.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: My daughter loved this teether since she was 4 months old.  It was the first toy she was able to transfer from one hand to the next -- a big milestone as any mom will tell you!  It was a favorite for a long time.  She\'s a year old now, and the Haba Ring is still in great shape after much abuse (7 teeth by 9 months!).  Would highly recommend this...  I include it in all my shower gifts.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: My daughter is 5 months old and she LOVES this toy.  She reaches for it and gets excited when I bring it out!  It\'s funny because she\'s had lots of toys given or handed down to her - toys that have flashing lights, music, squeak, etc, but this one is her absolute favorite and we never leave home without it.  She\'s a little small to teeth on it yet (she tries, though!), but she passes it from hand to hand and loves to rattle the smaller rings.  She also stares at the colors, turns the ring around, grabs at the smaller rings - all this is really good for her motor skills development!  It feels great to know that such a simple toy can bring so much enjoyment to my child and also awesome that it\'s non-toxic, so she can chew it all she wants.  This is a great company!

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: I\'ve become a big fan of Haba toys lately.  With all the stuff made in China its nice to see some quality made toys!  This is an adorable little teether that has some added little rings that make it a cute jingly noise...but nothing overly loud & annoying.  Easy to clean and maintain - durable and a kids favorite...you can\'t go wrong!

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: This toy is perfectly designed for grasping by little fingers and for biting.  Even though it is simple, it is the best rattle out there and holds my daughters attention for ten minutes at a time.  It also gives me some piece of mind that she is not putting plastic in her mouth.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: Haba toys are always of high quality and I love that they are made of wood. This one was especially cute.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: This is a great toy that doesn\'t seem to get old.  My little one has had it since he was about 5 mths old.  As he has gotten older he is enjoying it more.  Great to chew on and rattle around.  Bright colors and simple.  Not plastic and is safe!! Highly recommend.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: I don\'t know if the baby we gave this to loves this little toy but I love it. so hopefully the Mom loved it too. Excellent quality. Bright as it appears. It looks better in real time. Haba always delivers. i wish it were an American product.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: I didn\'t realize the colored pieces were not solid, and it\'s hard to tell from the photos. They aren\'t loose enough to pinch little fingers, but still add an additional element to the toy. The sound is nice when rattled, and the colors are bright and cheery. The simple design is perfect for my baby who gets over stimulated eaily. It\'s pleasant sound has a calming effect. This is the best little teether I\'ve found.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: I bought this for my older son when we were caught at a mall without any activities in my bag.  It has been a great distractor & teether for 2 babies now - and I see no signs that it will give out anytime soon!  We love HaBa products!!!

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: I purchased other(plastic) teething toys for my son, but he likes the Kringelring the best.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: I bought it well before my baby girl was born \'cause it looked good and had lots of good reviews. Now she\'s 9 month old and this toy remains one of her favorite. She started playing with it probably within 3-4 weeks after she was born. The surface is so nicely polished, the wood is warm in the hands, two little wood rings create a little calming sound and run around the big circle, the rainbow part is flexible... All these features were carefully explored by my little baby month after month. Even now, I often find this rattle in her hand when she falls asleep. Amazing that something so simple can be so useful.

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: I bought this for my 6 month old son for Christmas for his stocking and I love it!!!!!  He is my third child and this is the most I have ever seen any of my children play with one single baby toy.  He loves this the most out of all his presents and it is constantly in his hand.  It is easy for him to hold, pick up, and chew on.  A must-have baby toy and I definitely wish I had this when my other kids were babies!

name: HABA Kringelring Rattle Clutching Toy
review: I bought this thinking it would be great for our 4 month old to bang around and chew on since she is teething early. She definitely likes it as a rattle (tons of fun when you slip it on her wrist). But as a teether its a little too thick. Very durable, colorful toy that will last forever...just serving a different purpose than what i originally intended.

name: Haba Flutterflies Mobile
review: This mobile is really well made and very cute.  My baby is only 2 months old and she loves gazing up at it while she laying in her crib.  It makes her giggle and smile to see the little flutterflies move.  The only complaint is that it is just on fishing wire so it doesn\'t self propel.  I find myself having to go back in repeatedly to twirl it to keep her attention.

name: HABA Patience Block Set
review: I am a huge fan of Haba\'s many interchangable block sets, but on the whole, I regret this purchase. These blocks are pricey, and just not that much fun for kids or adults. They\'re merely novelties and just not really worth the cost.

name: HABA Patience Block Set
review: these are great for babies. they can shake them, watch the insides move, click them together, begin to stack and knock down. we bought more haba blocks and these just incorporate into the larger set that my 3 year old plays with. beautiful and excellent quality blocks.

name: HABA Allezhoop
review: This is a little expensive, but it\'s worth it.Since the day it was arrived, he loved to play with it.6 months---He put blue parts in his mouth.10 months---shake, shake, shake,1 year old ---He still goes to grab this toy and shake it.I love HABA toys. It is very durable and non toxic. The paint doesn\'t come off.I feel safe giving HABA toys.

name: HABA Allezhoop
review: We just got this for my 8-month old, and she is in love.  This offers so many textures of interest to the mouth, and curious little fingers are busy moving each of the parts and then pausing to give the whole thing a big bang on the table.  Definitely a hit with her, and I\'m thrilled that it\'s wood with non-toxic paints!

name: HABA Allezhoop
review: I thought this was pricey for what I received, but my 9 month old grandson seems to really enjoy playing with it. It is made well and the colors are bright.

name: HABA Allezhoop
review: I buy wooden toys to work my hands with rheumatoid arthritis. This one is great. It\'s delightful to look at, and fun to hold and manipulate. Makes a little sound, but it\'s not loud to bother anyone. I love the cheerful clowns on it.

name: HABA Allezhoop
review: My son hasn\'t shown a ton of interest (7months) but it\'s cute and easy to grasp - well made.

name: HABA Allezhoop
review: This is my sons favorite toy and mine. It\'s beautifully hand crafted and fun for him to play with. He\'s 6 months old and loves to shake it, eat it and spin the little men. This is something I will be saving for the next baby..

name: HABA Discovery Block Set
review: baby loved the blocks, it was not the most entertaining toy but certainly better then all the Chinese plastic pile of things people push on you.

name: HABA Discovery Block Set
review: My biggest issue with these blocks was the quality of the ones we received.  One block had a crack running up the side, and we had to put it out of commission as soon as they arrived.  Terribly unsafe for a baby.The block with the bell and the one with the clicky balls inside it also had a wooden dowel visibly poking through the side on each block.  Not sanded smooth or anything.I\'m disappointed as I\'ve always loved HABA toys, and even after my husband spent a LONG time on the phone with their customer service, the best they said they "could do" was to offer us a discount of 20% if we bought any other products from them!

name: HABA Discovery Block Set
review: My 10 month old son loves the 3 of the cubes, the ones that can make som sound. The other 3, the visual ones he ignores because he is to young to get what they do and play with them. Still they are good to stack and trow around. I know that when he gets older he will enjoy all the cubes. They are great to discover sounds and images.

name: HABA Discovery Block Set
review: We love Haba toys in our household and I find these blocks to be very reasonably priced. I first presented them to my daughter at 5mos and she was just barely able to get her hands around them but loved batting them around. Within just a couple of weeks she developed some pinching skills and was able to grab and mouth these blocks by just squeezing her hand around them. I keep a couple in my purse, a couple in her play area and a couple by the computer for when she is sitting in my lap and I am working. I also think the colors of the paint look much better in person than in the photo.

name: HABA Discovery Block Set
review: I received these blocks in the mail and there were less blocks than I expected for the price--only 6.  They are super cute but my child never really played with them at all. I wouldn\'t recommend them.

name: HABA Discovery Block Set
review: Overall it\'s a good product. I\'m happy with the quality and that the blocks are made of safe materials. Your baby will have a lot of fun playing with them. Just make sure you know that the blocks are VERY small. I thought that they would be a little bit bigger.

name: HABA Discovery Block Set
review: Both my daughter and I like the toy, but I expected better quality for the price.  The coloring on the inside edge was coming off when I cleaned them with a wet cloth. I imagine the same thing happens when my daughter put them in her mouth.The blocks were finished poorly too.  I expected something a little bit smoother.

name: HABA Discovery Block Set
HABA Discovery Block Set
review: These blocks are great -- well constructed and safe, like all HABA toys, but also brightly-colored and fun.  Our baby (now 8 months) has been enjoying these blocks for months, and she clearly prefers them to her other set, which seem so much more drab in comparison.  The yellow block with green bell is her current favorite and she loves make it jingle.  These blocks were my introduction to HABA toys and I am now a convert.

name: Haba Salto Rattle
review: I wanted to get some wooden toys for my 3-month old daughter instead of the standard plastic ones, mainly to avoid the whole BPA issue.  We didn\'t want to spend a lot of money on them but did want quality.  This toy, while being slightly more expensive than others, is a great investment.  My daughter clutches the sides and gnaws on the round ring, while the little colorful wooden parts are fun for her to watch.  It\'s her favorite toy (if a 3-month old has favorites).  It\'s exactly as it appears in the picture.  The wooden stick in the middle seems sturdy and doesn\'t appear to have any "give" in it -- I worried it might break easily, but it has withstood my older two playing with it.  A great investment!

name: Haba Salto Rattle
review: When I first received this toy, I was a little disappointed at how small it was, but it is the perfect size for tiny little hands. When we first gave it to her, she would just grab onto it and wave it around, then as she got older, she would hold it with one hand and focus on turning the rainbow beads in the center. She also uses it as a wooden teething ring, and still enjoys banging it around, tambourine-style. Well-made, solid toy that will certainly still be around for a younger sibling.

name: Haba Salto Rattle
review: I bought this from another retailer in November. My daughter, now 5 months, didn\'t really play with it until a month ago. She broke the large ring today--it cracked next to the rod that holds the pegs. The pegs can now come off the rod, thus it\'s a choking hazard. She didn\'t play too hard with it either. I\'m assuming we got a defective one because Haba toys are normally top quality. I am in the process of returning this toy to the retailer. Buyer beware.

name: Haba Salto Rattle
review: We received this toy as a gift when our baby was 6 months old and she loved it! Hands down her favorite rattle. However, this past week we left her playing with her toys for a couple of minutes and in the time we were gone she had managed to remove the center bar and all of the little rattle pieces. It was a miracle that she didn\'t choke on any of the pieces. I\'m not sure how she managed to remove it because when I tried, it required some strength to remove, but clearly she was able to do it. We had put the rattle in the dishwasher so I\'m not sure if this compromised the glue\'s integrity, but since I\'m pretty sure we aren\'t the only people who would do that I just wanted to give everyone a head\'s up about our experience.

name: Haba Salto Rattle
review: I own about 6 types of Haba toys.  I have a 6 month old and this is his favorite.  It\'s easy to grab and he doesn\'t drop it fifty-million times like other toys.  Haba is such a wonderful marker of wooden toys.  I recommend this toy whole-heartedly.

name: Swing Seat Ikarus
review: My daughter LOVES this swing. It is well made and seems so comfortable for her. It is strong enough for she and I to swing on it. It is well worth the price and we expect to have it for a long time!

name: Swing Seat Ikarus
review: we have owned 2 of these (haba sent us a replacement after the first one broke).  its a very comfortable swing but the stitching simply does not hold us to heavy use.

name: Elephant Grasping Toy DC
review: This little toy is adorable. I didn\'t look at the size of it when I was purchasing it though and I should have. It says it is approx. 6" long, which it is, but bare in mind that a good 3" of that is nose! Still, it\'s not called a "grasping toy " for nothing. It is small enough for my newborn to hold it and I like that about it.Just be prepared though, it is small for the $13.00 (after you also pay for S&H;) you pay for it. It apprears to be of good quality, and well it should be for that price! I think if I had known it was going to be this tiny though I would not gotten it due to it just being too expensive for what you are getting. The pic they have of it makes it look a lot bigger than it actually is. But I am going to keep it and just be more careful in the future and look at the size of items before buying them. However, if you\'ve got the money to blow on really cute but really small toys, I say go for it because it really is very sweet.

name: HABA Fidelia Flower Developmental Toy
review: This is such a great toy, both my daughter and son have loved this, it worked great for keeping even the littlest baby happy, plus it is super durable.  This will be a toy I hang on to for my grandchildren to play with.

name: Playskool Step Start Walk \'n Ride
review: this toy has now taught two of my children how to walk!  It is cute and way functionable.  Even my four year old still plays with it.

name: Playskool Step Start Walk \'n Ride
review: My daughter loves this toy. She is 8 1/2 months old and has only been using the push car option on this toy. I love that is is sturdier than other products like this and doesn\'t topple over as easily. The wheels aren\'t spinning "freely" they are leaning against the plastic a little so it doesn\'t move too fast and make the baby fall forward. Overall great product so far

name: Infantino Baby Bugs
review: My son is three months old and we got these little bugs as a gift.  He loves the bee with the orange face the best.  The wings make a crinkle noise and my son loves grabbing them.  He also picks up the little bee and waves it around in the air to make the rattle noise.  This one little bee gives him hours of entertainment.  I can see that maybe these toys would be too boring for older babies, but for a three month old they are perfect.

name: Infantino Baby Bugs
review: My daughter loves these bugs! They are a little larger than I thought (maybe 6" long), but are a good value at 3 for under ten bucks for what\'s packed in them. 2 of them have crinkly wings and rattles inside; all 3 have a little teether plastic piece and a place to attach to links. I keep one in her diaper bag and it\'s a good way to distract her in a pinch.

name: Infantino Baby Bugs
review: They are great stroller toys or car toys. My daughter has been playing with them since she became aware of their existence, she\'s now 1 and still enjoys them.You\'re not supposed to put them in the washing machine,so they can get dirty easily. I still washed one and it came out just fine.

name: Infantino Baby Bugs
review: The Infantino Baby Bugs are colorful and light weight enough for a three month old baby just beginning to reach out for objects to grasp.

name: Zanzibar Nursery Wallpaper Border
review: While it wasn\'t a cake-walk to put up this border, I didn\'t find it to be quite as difficult as the other reviewers did.  At first I tried using large strips of the border and putting it up all at once.  Doing this resulted in the same problems others reported.  Then I started cutting it into smaller strips (about 3 - 4 feet each).  I carefully cut along places in the border that were easy to line up once they were placed on the wall (you can\'t even tell where I cut now that it is dry).  I also made sure and soaked the border in water slightly longer than the 10 seconds recommended on the instructions.  After soaking, I unrolled the boarder as I pulled it out of the water, leaving the inside of the roll in the water until the end, so that all of the glue was exposed to water  at some point in the process.It was well worth the effort - very adorable in our nursery!

name: Zanzibar Nursery Wallpaper Border
review: I\'m 5 1/2 months pregnant, and I had no problem hanging this border up by myself while my husband was at work. I used the suggestion of another reviewer - cutting it into smaller sections, 3-4 feet, before hanging them. Also, I used a washcloth and not a sponge (as the directions say) to smooth down the border once it was up. It was very easy!

name: Single Animal Jingle Bell (Assorted Styles)
review: This was a great purchase for my baby. We have the green turtle and it gets handled pretty roughly with no problems at all. My baby enjoys making it jingle and really helps out with auditory stimulation. These toys are frequently used by pediatric physical/occupation therapists. Very high quality.

name: Single Animal Jingle Bell (Assorted Styles)
review: Brought for 3 years old grandchildren. We have started our own marching band. Quality was excellent and it was a teaching tool as well.

name: Single Animal Jingle Bell (Assorted Styles)
review: these pieces will be easier for the littler ones to hold on to, and the bells will attract them visually

name: Single Animal Jingle Bell (Assorted Styles)
review: My little guy loves this. He enjoys shaking it and hearing the bells. Its light enough for him to hold it on his own.

name: Single Animal Jingle Bell (Assorted Styles)
review: However, it might be a choking hazard for younger kids. This animal bell ended up in a drawer for a while after Christmas because she liked to put the bells in her mouth. For bigger kids it\'s lots of fun, and it is now looper around her babydoll stroller. Overall good purchase!

name: Single Animal Jingle Bell (Assorted Styles)
review: My baby grandson received the Animal Jingle Bells for Christmas along with other musical toys I ordered for him.  He can keep himself entertained for quite a while with his "musical instruments".  These are great toys for babies  It\'s easy for my grandson to handle them and move them the way he wants to.

name: Single Animal Jingle Bell (Assorted Styles)
review: This was a Christmas gift for my 9 month old. Before I wrapped it up, I decided to see if she would like it.........SCORE for Mom, she loved it. She loved it so much, I had to give it to her right then and there because when I went to take it from her (easily that is) she threw a fit, lol.

name: Glenna Jean Isabella Musical Mobile
review: the mobile is beautiful and is the only one I found that matches the bedding on my daughter\'s crib.  We love it!

name: Dora the Explorer Flip-Open Sofa with Slumber Bag
review: Got this for my 4-year old neice.  She loves it.  It\'s cuddly.  She really likes to tuck her stuffed animals in things, and now this is the spot.  She resists naps, but now, the sofa/sleeping bag has become her napping spot and she looks forward to taking naps.  Well made and fun to use.  Thanks for the Toys r Us recommendation!

name: Dora the Explorer Flip-Open Sofa with Slumber Bag
review: My mother got this for my daughter, who is now 1 1/2, this past Christmas and she has not missed a day watching tv on it, just lounging or taking a nap. We have taken it on road trips for her to sleep on and it travels well. The cover does come off from unzipping underneath, you need a paper clip to unzip it for safety reasons, just remember the order you take the cushions out in and which way they go back in!  We made that mistake the first time :) I highly recommend this couch!!!!

name: Dora the Explorer Flip-Open Sofa with Slumber Bag
review: I bought this for my 2 year old daughter for her second birthday.  She loves it.  She uses it everyday to watch tv and take naps.  She is the perfect size for it.  My four year old wants one too.

name: The First Years FoldDown Single Bedrail
review: Just bought this from a local Target tonight.  Instructions are mediocre, and could be improved - for instance, why is it necessary to insert the rails under the mattress then shorten the rails by a peg?  Unless your mattress is made of granite, you could easily get the right width by measuring, then wedging the mattress to the bottom of the rails.  The way the instructions are stated you have to simultaneously hold your mattress up far enough to push in the peg with a screwdriver while also constricting the rail to fit into the next closest peg - not easy at all if you\'re installing without someone to help.Also, the pegs themselves are of poor quality - one on our assembly would not slide back through the hole until I pulled it out of the rod, straightened, and reinserted it.  If I\'d left it as it was the assembly could shift with weight, negating the entire reason I purchased the product.Finally, getting the fabric assembly around the rails was very difficult.  The structure must be taut, which explains some of the difficulty - you don\'t want your child to get caught in loose fabric - but I\'m not sure why this part doesn\'t come assembled from the manufacturer.Haven\'t tested the assembled product yet.  If there are flaws during use I\'ll post again.

name: The First Years FoldDown Single Bedrail
review: This rail is NOT easy to assemble; it is frustrating, as the directions are poor and the parts do not always fit together perfectly. On top of that, nothing on the box told me it would require assembly! The supporting rails extend underneath the entire width of the mattress, which makes it very cumbersome to install, remove, store, or transport. Once you get through the unclear instructions and actually get it put together, and then have someone help you install the awkwardly long supporting rails, it does function well. However, I decided to go back to my old-style rail.

name: The First Years FoldDown Single Bedrail
review: This really worked great for my mom.  I got it for after she fell out of bed a couple of times.  You would think an 83 year old would have learned how to sleep in a bed by that age.  Well after I put this on her bed she never fell out of bed again.

name: The First Years FoldDown Single Bedrail
review: I love this rail.  It\'s the perfe ct size and easy to put up and down.  Yes, it is very difficult to get together because the fabric is so taut that you have little room to manuever. It was very easy to attach to the bed and adjust once it was up.  I\'m looking to buy another one for our shore house.

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate works perfectly...installs easily...stays put no matter how much my dog tries to knock it down. Better yet I can take it with me when I visit my parents so she stays out of trouble there as well.

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
review: I bought this gate to keep my black lab out of my room while I\'m at work - so it needs to be high enough that she won\'t jump over and sturdy enough in case she pushes it - so far it\'s working perfectly!  It arrived very quickly, and arrives ready-to-use so it literally took 5 seconds to test a couple settings to get the right snug fit in my doorway.  Done!

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
review: Very nice and once you mark the spot in ink where the lock goes it works without problem.  If you don\'t mark the tooth placement then you will spend more time and get frustrated.

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
review: We purchsed this gate to keep our cats out of our basement because one of them had decided that the entire carpet was his litter box. It\'s well made, easy to use, and lightweight. Two of our cats can jump over it (which I honestly expected...I mean, they\'re cats for goodness sakes!) but the cat that was peeing in the basement is too fat to jump over it. I think this would work great for small to medium sized dogs and small children. It\'s very sturdy and doesn\'t mark the wall. It\'s a phenominal deal, as some other similar gates are $50 and up! (Plus this gate has free shipping if you buy one more product to put you over $25!). I would highly recommend this gate.Update 10/2012: This crate is now at my parent\'s house, which they use to keep their puppy confined to the linoleum. It has held up very well, and we are very impressed with the quality for the price.

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate is working out great. It is very strong and sturdy. It is better than the plastic gate we bought prior. So far we haven\'t any problems, except getting used to how to lock it in place. I recommend it!

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
review: Was received very quickly, I liked that alot. The gates are what they say they are. I was very pleased.

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
review: This is a great gate and simple to use.  The one thing that could improve it are a bit more detailed instructions for first time use.  I had to compare the picture to the wording printed on the product itself to determine correct placement.  Once in place though it is very secure.

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate is not functional with baseboards that stick out more than 1/2 in.  Also, the locking mechanism is shoddy and not as effective as I hoped.

name: North States Supergate Wire Mesh Gate
North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: As wooden expandable barrier gates go, the North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate is a decent product. Quality of materials and construction is appropriat to the task. This gate loses one star for the wood being unfinished, but a clear finish is easy to apply. The extra wide size fits my application perfectly, and I prefer the wood construction to the plastic alternatives.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I purchased this gate to keep my 9 week old lab puppy out of the kitchen and it works perfectly.  I really only needed the length and not the height but I couldn\'t find a shorter gate to fit a 48" opening.  I\'m a little over 5 feet and I have slight difficulty getting over it, you kind of have to straddle it at the top and swing the other leg over -  but I don\'t intend to use it forever.  If you are looking for a permanent gate, just spend the money and get one with a door.  But, if you only need something for training this will work.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I bought this two years ago, and keeps in one piece. It\'s really useful on wide doors or large space between walls, keeps my dogs in one place on the house when we need it.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I BOUGHT THIS FOR $10 AT WALMART. WORKS GREAT UP TO 42". I REALLY WANT ONE FOR MY 52 INCH KITCHEN WALKWAY BUT AM DISSIAPOINTED I CANT FIND ONE THAT\'S PRESSURE MOUNTED. I DON\'T WANT TO DRILL A BUNCH OF HOLES INTO MY WALLS! SOMEONE PLEASE MAKE \'EM LONGER!!

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: It works for our oversized door opening at keeping the dog in the kitchen. You just have to be sure you set it up with enough tension so it stays in place. A strong big dog might be able to knock it down but not our 12 lb puppy.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This was wide enough for the large doorways between rooms, and the cost was quite reasonable. The only complaint that I have is the adjustment can take a bit of time to work out.  It is trial and error to find the appropriate notch for a given doorway, and is a bit difficult to operate when you only have two hands. With experience, it is a bit better.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: Literally, a lifesaver for my dogs! I use this everyday and use it to contain like in the movie The Others my dogs in this part of the house or that on a daily basis. It is easy to adjust and very light but sturdy so I can lift it with one hand while I move the dogs with the other. It is also tall enough that my Min Pin can\'t launch herself over the top. Great product for the price.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I have three Bernese Mtn dogs two days a week and this gate is high enough and sturdy enough to keep them in place.  It\'s easy to use and slim enough to store beside the fridge.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I have extra wide doors and it is hard to find a gate to fit them that doess not require screwing into the wood.  This works great, just not as attractive as I would like.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: It was not usable as delivered, as the wood frames were warped and as a result, the rubber bumpers on the outside of the frame didn\'t fit against the wrought iron stair railings I have.  However, I was able to engineer a fix by removing the rubber bumpers and then nailing a 1"x1" strip about 14" long against either side of the wood frame (where the rubber bumpers originally were).  Then, since the verticals on my wrought iron stair railings are 1" square, I was able to attach some 1" x 6" boards (30" long) vertically onto either side of the wrought iron vertical posts and then I drilled holes in these 1x6\'s and bolted them to either side of the wrought iron 1x1\'s.  This provided a 1" gap either side, which the 1x1s that I nailed onto the sides of the wood frame could fit into.  THEN, I had a really tight fit, which I made even tighter by clamping the 2 pieces of the gate together, thereby making the gate completely immoveable. So as far as raw materials for a really strong gate that you can engineer yourself, this is good for that.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate is just what I needed.  It is sturdy enough for my dogs (2 beagles) to jump up on it yet light weight, quick and easy enough to move easily.  It holds firmly in most any doorway.  I like the fact that the mesh is wire as I believe it will last longer than my last gate which was made of a plastic mesh.  This is not the most expensive (looking or built) gate I shopped for but for the price it was perfect for us!

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: Very solid, secure gate, high enough to keep the dogs out but the cats can get over! I can easily move it and use it on two different width openings. Once you set the width it\'s easy to open with one hand but I need two hands to set it back up. I would buy a gate with a hinge if I had to go through the opening on a steady basis, it\'s too tall for an adult to climb over.(that\'s why the dogs stay out!) If the gate works loose it\'s not tight enough and you must set the width 1/2 inch wider. I wish I\'d bought this years ago.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This is a quality made and very sturdy gate, but I was disappointed that it caused some of the paint to come off of my walls as well as some dents in the drywall.  Especially since the whole point of us buying pressure mounted gates was to avoid damage to our walls.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I bought two to use as a barricade to keep my cats in one area of the house while having granite installed. They were not able to jump or climb over the two gates which I put on top of each other. It was less expensive than boarding my cats while the work was done.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate is exactly what it says, a wider than average gate.  Works as expected.  I only with the retaining clips on the top and bottom are very weak.  But, for the price it is exactly what you expect.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: Ok product. Although, I was expecting a more solid product for the price that I paid. A couple of the wood edges are cracked from (manufacture) tightening of screws. Needs gentle handling for edges not to give out.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate is perfect! I have a wider hallway and none of the other pet/kids gates would work. Once I figured out the "just right" measurement on the grooves, I marked it with a sharpie so it would be easy to put into place every time.My dog doesn\'t push, lean or try anything with the gates, but this does keep good tension when up.I would suggest this pet gate.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I bought this gate for a 50" wide opening in my kitchen. I wanted to keep my dog behind it and after reading some of the reviews, I was skeptical. This fits nice and tightly in the space. It\'s certainly not the most heavy duty wide gate I\'ve seen but for the price, it absolutely cannot be beat.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I ordered two of these and could not be happier.  They are super easy to adjust making setup and take down a breeze.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: We bought this gate for our dog to keep her blocked from the rest of our house when we are at work. The gate fit our 43 inch wide doorway perfectly, and the height is exactly what we need to make sure that she doesn\'t jump over the gate. Once it\'s locked in place, that thing isn\'t moving! Very easy to set up and use. Doesn\'t leave any marks or scratches on our wall, either.Others commented on the quality of the item, but for $34 I think it\'s fine quality and didn\'t think it felt junky at all. As noted above, once it is fitted and locked in place, it\'s very sturdy!

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: The gate perfectly met the need for our wide door opening that we don\'t have to go through on a regular basis AND easy to put up.  I like the numbered inch measurements on the gate--just measure your opening and you will know exactly where to put the stabilizing bar.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This mesh gate was purchased to keep a Yorkie puppy within a specific area in the apartment. All of the gates I found in local area stores would not extend wide enough to cover the doorway and the few that did were quite expensive. However, this gate met the measurement requirements and despite the Yorkie continuously jumping against it in an attempt to get out, it has stood firm and has met all of my expectations.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: Solidly built.  does what every other presure gate does.  I like it.  If i had another doorway of similar size, i would get another one.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I bought these to keep my dogs from scratching my nice doors when I need to lock them in a room. This gate is excellent because the mesh is wire and they can\'t scratch or chew through it.  The wire mesh has a rubber/plastic coating so it doesn\'t have a harsh or ugly look of metal, it looks just like an other gate.  It\'s easy to use and I recommend it for children and pets.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: Used this for my brand new puppy . She was really small so she was able to put her paws in the holes and climb up it. The gate also leaves marks on the wall if  the notch on the gate doesn\'t match the width of the opening you\'re using it for. The gate is well made and definitely stays in place. I can see this gate working for children or dogs who\'s paws are larger than the holes (approx. 1 1/2 inches wide). Super fast shipping !! This transaction was perfect from start to finish.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I will email the company but I am too busy trying to hammer, glue and curse this gate into actually fitting all of the pieces together and being square. I am supposed to be able to just take the gate out and use it, but 2 of the wood pieces do not fit right (too short), and so when I glue/hammer it in it isn\'t square... I would return it, but I need IT RIGHT NOW and don\'t have the time. It was sold as "open box", but that does NOT mean that they can send out substandard quality. I hate that this is made in the USA, I can\'t even blame China. Other than that, the size and height are what I expected.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I give this a three star because though it does do it\'s job and a great price and looks easy enough to assemble, it\'s not quite so. While assembling it into it\'s desired position, it\'s very flimsy and very awkward when it\'s not "locked in", doesn\'t hold it\'s shape, and simply not what I was looking for.  I need a gate that is about 5 inches longer, and can easily but most importantly, quickly be put up and taken down.  With this, it requires too much of my time to align while making sure it hasn\'t sort of lost it\'s shape (when it does this, it\'s locks up in all sorts of places where you can\'t really even slide it to adjust it\'s width) and also be sure that I haven\'t applied too much pressure when I lock it so that I dent my doorframe.  I would return it, but I do need a second gate so this will serve as the back up.  What you see is really what you get... flimsy wood and wires.  I would use this as more of a permanent indoor gate, which then tells me I made a bad purchase because it\'s too high for me to walk over...sigh.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate does it\'s job - snugly fastens to walls or doorways to create a barrier. However, i noticed after using the gate for a week or so that it has left a series of indentations or dents on the doorframe. It seems this gate has a design defect in that the main bar used to expand the gate extends slightly past the edge of the gate, cutting into the wall when it is used. Since i am a renter, i am not so pleased with the damage it has caused. It is mild, but still noticeable, and will require repairs.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: Good quality pet gate.  Works as intended and is sturdy when put into place.  The only drawback is the mechanism can be a pain to operate, and quite frankly took me a while to figure out.  Overall it is a good piece of gear.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I love my doggy/puppy gate.  I am writing this review to let you know I have three 7-9 lb Shih Tzu and they do great with this gate. I love my new gate and my dogs can jump against it at the same time.  I used my old baby gate before and the mechanism that you use to tighten the gate in place quit working.  I only had the gate for 1 year and it died.  I had this new gate years before only shorter and my dogs could climb it and get out.  No problems like that with this higher style gate.  Anyone who complains about the gate making marks in the wall are putting it in the wrong place.  If they rent they should put a piece of material between the walls and make sure the clamp part of the bar is not pressing on the wall.  If you have a doorway nearby use that instead but still make sure that the longer piece of the bar is not pressing on the wood of the doorway.  There is a wider part and that will allow the most pressure on the gate.  MY COMPLANT:  I can\'t step over it but that\'s the only bad thing I can say about it.  Sure if my legs were longer I wouldn\'t have that problem, but I never wanted to be 6\'4".  You\'re gonna love your new gate.  People with smaller dogs will love it -- you can even use it for kids.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: new house, new walking for granddaughter.  Great for when they come to visit.  It fits tightly into the basement doorway.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate is exactly what we were looking for to place on our deck while the kids are outside playing.  I wanted something taller than the standard gates you find in stores.  However, we used it one time and the metal piece on the bottom of it snapped off, the wood actually split off to be more specific. I am returning it and have already ordered a replacement in hopes that it was just a defectives one we received. However, after reading some of the other 1 star reviews, it may just be a poorly constructed gate. I\'ve had ones that cost half as much that have lasted me for years. So we shall see I guess.  I recommend you save the box just in case.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I am delighted to find this gate at the taller heighth. Like we did many years ago, we are using it to keep a puppy on a tile floor when we are not watching. It is fairly basic, but is portable and mounts securely with pressure to both a standard doorway and a hallway. As our Golden continues to grow in heighth and weight, we believe this will work. He does not try to chew through the plastic coated mesh wire.  Way to go Amazon, for offering an improved (taller and wider sized) basic product at a reasonable price.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: We bought this gate because its extra wide and tall and fits the door jam into our kitchen.  This gate uses tension to stay in place.  Since we use this for our dog and not a child, it works fine but I\'m not sure it would stay in place if a toddler pulled really hard on it since they could stick their fingers into the mesh.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: Ordered the child gate as a replacement for the same item purchased locally at a much higher price. It was exactly the same and arrived earlier than promised. No problems and very satifified.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I got this gate to contain my puppy in the kitchen. It stood good and strong and was easy to put up. Unfortunately hoodini puppy figured out within seconds that she could put her feet in the little squares and lift herself right over the gate.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: The gate works great and is very easy to set up single handed. Creates a very secure barrier for our dog. One minor design flaw means that if you locate the gate inside the lip of moulding in your door jam, the locking arm mechanisms can mar the wood moulding. There\'s no need to set up inside the moulding as the locking is very secure wherever you set it up, but a minor change in the design could eliminate the problem.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This gate will adjust to fit in any door. It keeps the pets in. Lightweight and versatile. It takes some practice to use the adjustment arm though.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I needed an extra pet gate for our big puppy and this works well. it was not expensive and am glad I got it

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: We bought this gate to keep our new cat separate from the old. We actually ended up extending if to the widest with and flipping it up  like a screen door. The older cat did not jump it, but did manage to climb up it. Boy were we and the new cat both surprised! It\'s a standard issue type of gate and did serve the purpose. It did arrive quickly and without any shopping issues. As long as u don\'t have cats with super power like ours, it\'s a good deal!

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I use this gate to block a large hallway and keep my dogs in a structured area.  It\'s wide and tall - just the right dimensions for a Golden Retriever.  The dogs don\'t challenge the gate.  If they did it probably wouldn\'t hold up that well.  Price and shipping were typical Amazon - great!

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: wide enough...I have a 47 inch opening. Easy to lock in....works great....looks good. Great for pets....safe for children. reasonable price.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I am using this gate in a 48" opening.  It has held up well to my toddler repeatedly pulling on it - the center wire section has stayed in place and the gate itself is firmly pressed against the wall.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: Love the ease of putting it up for when we have our bunny out of his cage.  He can\'t jump over it and it works well for our dog also.

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: I have several of these and will continue to use them throughout my home.  Sets up easily and is very sturdy!

name: North States Supergate Extra Wide Wire Mesh Gate
review: This item was ok. if you have trim work along the bottom where you plan to place this gate, you will have to remove it to make fit snug.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: I bought this gate and tried to install it at the entrance to kitchen, as my toddler daughter tries to crawl to kitchen to often. However this gate when installed is not sturday. It falls down when a bit of pressure is applied. Needless to say I did not install it as it was potentially dangerous for my daughter (she likes to crawl, and then try to stand with whatever she can hold onto).I would not recommend this gate to anyone.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: It does what it needs to, and keeps our dog out of areas most of the time. It\'s a little clumsy to use, and difficult to secure against walls with a baseboard. If it has a baseboard, then the gate will be tight at the bottom, but looser on the top - making it easier for our large dog to push it over.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: We first got a regalo doored gate because i didnt want to have to hop over it but I needed a way to lock my baby out of the kitchen so I got this and after using it for few months, my love handles went away!It\'s light I can carry it downstairs whenever I need to block off a room or to use it for locking in my two small dogs.The only downside is once the metal ring locks, it\'s really hard to get it back out to change the width. I have to slam it from under and it can cause cuts. If that was easier i would give it a 5 star.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: This gate is sturdy when in place.Set up was easy and delivery was fast!The plastic did crack on part of the gate. I am not sure if this happened because it was too tight or my 9 mo old did it by pulling up on it. I was able to easily fix it with duct tape. I did not mind this because I did not expect it to be superior quality for this price.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: keeps my dog in.  it doesn\'t span the width of my parents\' entryway, but it works for times when I want to open my door but keep the dog in/out.  I initially used it to keep my pup in the kitchen and then at the top of the stairs at my parents\' house.But later I used it to keep him in my yard, so I can regulate what he brings in from the yard or to be able to open my door and enjoy the fresh air without him running about and getting muddy, etc.affordable and sturdy.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: The gate\'s not the prettiest thing.  But that\'s obvious prior to purchase.  As for functionality, it works.  We have them in two doorways to keep our granddaughter from sneaking into un-childproof rooms.  Sliding the width adjustment is a little clunky at first.  Once the adjustment is made, opening and closing the gate is simple.  We (adults) typically just step over it.  The height is just right to keep a one year old in. Our five year old is the only one who can\'t just step over the gate.  But he climbs well and the gate holds up great to him standing on the tension bar to climb over.  It can also support his weight (45 lbs) without falling or bending.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: need this gate for dogs when we were painting rooms and it is a vary strong gate just love it .......

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: The gate seems a little bit weak and it was a little difficult to put up the first time. The locking pin did remember where it needed to stay though. However, I will be returning this gate first thing because the bottom bumpers hit my molding at the bottom of my stairwell and prevent the top bumpers from being pressed into the wall. Just won\'t work for us, but not that bad of a gate for the money.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: For the cheap price, i expected a POS to arrive, but this gate is very solid.  The latch, however, is almost too sturdy and can be tricky to unlock.  If you frequently remove the gate during the day, or have weak hand strength then this one might not be your best choice.  If you set it and forget it once or twice a day... this is the least expensive way to go, while still having a sturdy gate that won\'t be problematic.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: I have grandkids and dogs and this gate didn\'t last 6 months with them. The plastic stretched out and it wouldn\'t secure itself any more. I know you want to because it\'s inexpensive...but don\'t do it!

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: great price for this sturdy gate that is easy to set up and leaves no damage to walls. Highly recommend this gate.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Definitely works well.  Love the memory aspect of the locking mechanism.  We purchased this to use as a barrier for our small dog.  Granted he is not a jumper and doesn\'t push against the gate but it feels solid enough that I wouldn\'t worry about it coming loose if he did.  It arrived in good time and excellent condition.  It isn\'t the prettiest thing ever but definitely does the job.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Gate does not work as described. Does not slide easily, or secure properly. A complete waste of money.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: I followed all the instructions as close as I could, but I simply could not get this gate to work. It simply would not stay in place. I think we eventually threw it out.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: This gate works really well for our needs.  We have a small opening in to our kitchen that we wanted to keep our toddler out of. We rent so we couldn\'t install a gate with screws. This pressure gate works really well as far as pressure gates go.  There are times when our toddler can pull it down but it is pretty rare.  That is why I gave it 4 stars and not 5. It was also confusing to figure out how to make it work for the first time. But once we figured it out it was great. It has a memory feature so it is easy to open and close it without having to adjust it every time.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: I bought this gate to protect my elderly dog.  I used it on an outside door to prevent her from going down the stairs.  It worked just great.  I came back today for 2 more.  The gate is made of strong plastic, is easy to install and easy to open and close.  The locking mechanism is very simple and works well to keep the gate secure.  I would have no problems recommending it for use with children.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Don\'t make the mistake of going with the cheap thing. Once you get it small enough to get it in the spot you need to fit, it is impossible to expand it just by 0.5 inch to sit firm in the spot where you want it to be. Just terrible. I am a young male, who does not have a problem putting furniture together, yet this product was just a worse nightmare than any Ikea nightmare you might have ever had. This is being returned tomorrow.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: I ordered 2 of these gates and I am using one at my home and one at my son\'s apt. We are very happy with this gate since it doesn\'t mark the walls and is very secure. It is a great product and pretty easy to use.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Bought this gate to keep my min pin from running up and down the stairs in my house.I have at the top of the stairs between two narrow wrought iron rails.This gate is not really good for larger dogs but for my purpose it\'s great.I had a wooden gate that had the memory feature but over time the screws kept coming loose and finally the screw holes were no longer any good.The price was right for this gate and it\'s not as ugly as people say.The hardest part was trying to get the product out of the box.I would buy this product again.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Packaging has no instructions on how to install - it\'s a gate so it should be easy to figure out but the design is not intuitive.Once I figured out how to install, I then had trouble opening and closing the gate because it doesn\'t slide very easily without two people pulling on either ends of the gate. Anyhow, it proved to be a solid gate once installed. I kicked it and it didn\'t budge. Satisfied, I locked up my 6lbs puppy in the kitchen behind this gate and left home.But alas, my tiny puppy used her little paws like a rock climber / spiderman to climb over the gate that very first day.I\'m impressed by my dog, but not impressed with this product. If you have a crafty dog, get a gate with bars, not a gate with criss-cross barrier like this one that dogs can use to climb.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: I just received this gate in the mail maybe 15 minutes ago and I already dislike it. I would have given it 0 stars if I could. The thing does not fit our standard size doorway. It\'s either too big or too small in the settings. I tried putting towels on both sides to hold it up, but it is still loose. Also, the gate is practically impossible to adjust I pinched/bruised my finger trying to adjust it. Waste of money!

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: My wife and I bought two of these to keep our 15-month old son from going through either of the entrances to the back of our apartment.  They took a bit of effort to get into our doorways, but now that we understand how to do it, it\'s pretty simple.  They don\'t stay in place very well, especially if you accidentally kick it or if your kid is determined to get through.For those of you who plan on stepping over this gate regularly, be sure to do so with care or wear socks/shoes/something to protect your feet.  Both of my feet already have scars from having chunks of skin cut off while hopping over them.  You never realize just how useful your toes are until they\'re injured!!All in all, it does the job well enough for our needs, but if you need something that\'s sturdy, this might not be the best option.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Cheap and cheap. It looked sturdy but if you extend it more than 35 inches it bends. I had to use a small rope to tie the locking mechanism back to the fence.. so yes I made it work but wow.  I\'d give it zero stars but it didn\'t break with the rope helping.  It will scratch your child if it isn\'t put all the way to the ground (and your child reaches under) as there are rough edges. And it will scratch your leg if you flip it over and brush against it on the way over.  Definitely not worth the cheap price.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: This gate, though not particularly fancy-looking, fits perfectly in the space where I need it at the bathroom door to keep my puppy inside during times when I\'m away or at night since he\'s not yet housebroken.  He can see through it, it\'s sturdy and certainly fits the purpose at a very reasonable cost.  I\'d recommend it.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: This product was received promptly and packed well..I love this gate, no brainer to use and won\'t hurt my walls or doorways.  I am using this gate on little Yorkshire Terriers, they don\'t need much to hold them back.  I would not recommend this gate for any larger dog then a small terrier type..and for children, well, I believe you would need a stronger one as there are some pinching areas to the slide.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: We love this baby gate! It is high quality and works well! Plus...it is made in the USA!

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Works really well, a good height for stepping over if you are an adult. lightweight but sturdy. definitely recommend! For the price you can\'t beat it!

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Our new house has an odd feature where the back is fenced in, but the dogs can run up the steps and out to freedom due to the lack of a gate.  This gate basically seals in our steps so that the dogs can run around without us worrying about where they might be in ten minutes.For me, that means 5 stars as it was cheap, quick to install, and completely what I needed.  However, less than 2ft high might be problematic for containing some kids/animals.  Also, as noted by others, I wouldn\'t want to have to adjust this gate often, though maybe only being 23inches tall could solve the need to take it down!

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: this gate works I guess if you have straight walls.  it really doesnt stay still and tight.  I am sure there are much better ones out there but for 13.00 dollars i guess you get what you pay for

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: This is a pretty easy gate to use.  I move it back and forth between two doors.  The metal bar can get stuck in the grooves a bit when readjusting for the door width, but it really only takes a few seconds to pop it out.  Have 4 kids so I adjust pretty easily to different gate designs having bought quite a few over the $100 range.  This works, is inexpensive.  Like the other reviewers I agree it\'s not that attractive but sturdy and functional. Also it\'s lower than most gates so you might want to check the dimensions prior to getting one.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: It\'s a \'baby-gate\'.  Except, instead of soft wood and metal, it\'s plastic.For what you pay, it works just fine, and we will keep it.  But, compared to a 10yr old wood baby-gate, it feels flimsy.It does not slide open smoothly, and, once you find which notch is the perfect fit, you can\'t open it far enough for easy removal without taking it out of the \'notch\'.  Plus, if you simply push the lever down, the lever bows out, you have to do the second step of sliding the end-cap into place.  One more step than the average wooden baby-gate.So, why did I buy this instead of a wood baby-gate?  /shrug - it was of course much less $$$.  You now need to spend three times more than the cost of this plastic gate to buy a wooden one.Again, the gate works, once closed, neither a dog (my use) or a child can push past it at all.  Just realize like most everything else you buy in this world, you get what you pay for.As always, I get an email if a comment is posted, and I will reply within a day or so if you have any questions.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: Well, I thought this would be a great gift for my parents as they have my nephews living with them who are 18 months, 3, and 5.  The 18 month old has started climbing out of his crib and getting into everything.  The gate lasted 15 minutes before the 18 month old climbed over it...another 15 before the three year old figured out how to open it.  Wish it had worked a little better.  Oh well will be returning it.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: I ordered this product even after reading all the negative comments. I needed extra gate to keep my toddler out from the kitchen, and wanted to try different brand from the two gates I already have. Some have mentioned problems with memory locks, but I haven\'t have any problem with it. It was very easy for me to install the gate and i actually love this product. I give four stars because the gate has to be totally removed in order for adults to pass through, unless you don\'t mind stepping over to pass through.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: I use this gate everyday for my German Shepard- works very well and is very sturdy.  For $15 bucks shipped you can\'t do any better!

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: This is going back immediately.  I can barely move the sides back and forth.  After spending thirty minutes with this gate my wrist hurts from the strain. It wasn\'t locked.  The metal piece was free from the notches.  The one I have is simply extremely hard to slide wider or more narrow.  I have had several pressure gates over the years. I would have never dreamt that one could be so difficult to use.  I hate this gate.I bought it at a local store.  And it was much more expensive than the price on Amazon.  Whatever I buy to replace this one will most likely be from Amazon.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: We purchased 3 to keep our husky in an area and help with potty training. Granted, you must have a dog who understands not to just jump over them, but they worked great for us. just make sure you don\'t plan on moving them often. you need to be able to step over them. moving them is not easy, but the very low price makes up for it. they are sturdy too.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: The mechanism that locks and unlocks the gate is hard to set, making this frustrating to install and hard to move.  It seems sturdy though, although my daughter can unlock it by reaching over (but thats with any of these gates).  It is more durable than the wooden gates, which snap after a while.  Recommend, with adequate supervision.  Also, keep the lock on the other side from curious babies and toddlers.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: the packaging was bad and the gate came damaged - no \'functional\' pieces were broken so i didn\'t bother sending it back.

name: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate
review: We used this as a "dog gate", to keep my dog out of certain areas of the house.  It has worked well!  It is easy to use, and sturdy enough that my dog has not been able to knock it down upon attempt.  Also, it is not too tall, so I can step over the gate without needing to unlatch and latch the gate every time.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I bought this gate years ago and have used it for all 5 of my children.  It is great at blocking off a wide opening.  I had to stop the boys (when they were 3 and 1) from pushing on it, but it lasted through all my kids.  For the price, it is excellent!  I was going to give it to my sister, but I lent it out and didn\'t get it back.  I\'ll have to order her a new one.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We bought this for our dog because he had knee surgery and we were trying to restrict him from going up the stairs. This product is wide and high enough to cover an open area that we needed to cover. It\'s adjustable and it worked fantastically!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Worked great! Used this gate to keep the kids out of the kitchen.  It was hard finding something big enough to block the whole area but this worked great... Also great because it is adjustable and can use it anywhere!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I bought this gate because I have a huge doorway into my living room and this is the only one that would fit and still be able to swing open (not a metal, leave up gate)..... I got it in the mail, opened it up and it was all broken!! EIGHT (8) spindles were broken at the top. I called the company and they said that if I took it out of the box like that then it was a shipping issues. I told them the box was in PERFECT condition (because it was) and the lady said I still had to return it from the place I bought it because it was still a shipping issue! I will be returning this and NOT buying this gate again!!!!!!!!!!! The thing is EXTREMELY CHEAP and even if it was not broken when I got it I would not trust it!!! HORRIBLE PRODUCT!!!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Was easy and fast to put together. It does the job though is a lil flimsy but so far holding up to 3 kids and a dog.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: The gate was fine, but our dog (Chihuahua) was able to escape by either going between the bars or jumping over so it didn\'t meet our needs for that, so we have a perfectly good gate that we have no use for. That said, I think for the right purpose, it would work fine.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: The Product Description from the Manufacturer is incorrect.  The gate DOES NOT span 28" to 103" (the product description under the Manufacturer description IS correct stating that the gate spans from 60" to 103").  Unfortunately the gap we were trying to span is 58" (but we did improvise a solution).The wall hooks do seem a bit flimsy but the height is high enough to keep our 17 month old from trying to climb over it but low enough that I, at 5\'2", can step over it.  It seems a rather imperfect solution for an awkward opening between our hallway and kitchen, but at least it\'s not incredibly expensive and it does work.  If you have a wide opening and a bit of extra money I\'d go with another option, but this gate isn\'t terrible for the price.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We bought 2 of these because we have 2 really wide openings and were concerned for our grandaughter.  Being that our openings were more than 60 inches, we were kind of limited to gates that are a bit costly.  If I had kids daily I think I would buy a a stonger structure, it can be alittle flimsy.For the price it works for us just fine for us.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This is a great gate easy to put together and install. Unfortunately I wanted to go one place but the wood was so hard ex had to first drill a hole. Now that is jump is easy to use and the dogs can\'t get off the porch now.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This gate is a great barrier between our living room and our dinning room.  We have been training our dogs to stay out of the dinning area during dinner time for the humans.  This has helped with that training.  We sometimes leave it open enough to see if they\'ll come through during dinner time.  A few times one has slipped through, but we\'re making progress

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Looked high and low to find a gate with this length.  It is rather thin and flemsy but is doing the job.  It is to contain two dogs and I really wish I could have found something a little thicker and more substantial; this was the only gate available online in this length.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: The reason for four stars is because of the two different descriptions in widths given.I should have thoroughly read both the manufacturer description and the product description. Both say exactly the same thing word for word except for the width. I bought this simply because in the first description the width ranges from 28" to 103" which would have fit easily my 42" doorway. I would not have purchased the gate if I knew it would have been to large.There really wasn\'t a way to adapt the gate without taking it apart.I was able to send it back and UPS picked it up right away.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
