review: This gate has the structural integrity of a wet paper towel. I had to add several screws to the extended gate just to keep it from falling apart. This thing is dangerous.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: If you have a large opening or archway and you need to keep your toddler out, this gate is perfect.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I purchased this to close a room off from our new labrador puppy. It was simple to install and is easy to install. It is not a super strong gate and could be broken in you push on it too hard but I am happy with the purchase.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Easy installation, and sturdy enough to keep out dogs, or, keep children safe !!!  I recommend this for anyone that wants to keep their kitchen, dog free, or stairways, child safe !!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This is an aesthetic gate that simply is too flimsy when spanning near its maximum length - but keep in mind that there are few [if any] other gates that can span this far. I reinforced the joints with screws at the section overlaps and added steel plates where the gate sections abut, and it works fine. I\'ve had mine now for 4 years and it isolates my giant schnauzers as well as grandkids from falling down a wide staircase or separating the dogs from the kids. The caveat is that with these reinforcements the gate is fixed length - and this works only if you are attached on the hinge side to a wall that is at least as long as the gate so it goes flat against a wall without blocking something while open. Without reinforcements it could slide together to shorten the gate when open. Buy it only if you are a little handy with tools. The eye screws for the locking side must be spaced vertically at their PRECISE specified distance apart or else catching both locking eyelets becomes impossible.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Just received this but found out that the Manufacturer description above is incorrect (lists 28in - 103in). Box and further down in the product description list dimensions of 57-103in. Will be attempting return.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Just like it says, it\'s ok. It was nice to find a gate this long, but it\'s really flimsy. It will come out of the wall really easy if the baby shakes too hard, so you really need to drill these suckers in. You get what you pay for, it wasn\'t that expensive.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: NorthState\'s extra wide gate. I am a professional child proofer. This is the only gate I use when closing off wide openings. It is inexpensive. Easy to install. You can remove it from time to time. It is not intrusive.Over all a very workable and affordable solution..

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We purchased a new home with beautiful wood floors and white chairs and squares.  Needless to say I wanted a gate that would look nice.  Being that we needed 3 gates, but only for a year, I didn\'t want to spend and arm and leg for them.  We primed and painted these gates and added felt to the bottom so they don\'t scratch the floors.  They are high enough to keep my 3 and 1 yr olds in the kitchen/great room and low enough to step over.  So far I\'m happy and probably saved at least $100.  If we had needed gates longer, I would have gotten something a bit more durable, but my 3 year old was comfortably climbing stairs at 2 1/2, so I anticipate the same with my 15 month old in a year.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Well made wooden gate, made in USA, fits extra wide doorways and openings.  We use it as a dog gate, but it would be good for a child gate as well.  Only complaint is the latch hardware is a bit difficult to press down to latch/unlatch, but not so much that I wouldn\'t buy this gate again.  It comes unfinished, but you could put some poly on it for a more finished look.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: The gate is okay but the wall anchors keep getting pulled out. I have tried three different types of anchors just wont support the constant use and swing motion.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: i have two small dogs that i was trying to keep out of my living room until i got home in case one of them had an accident. This is hte perfect width and height for both of them.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We bought this gate after moving in to our split level home...we needed a gate for two sets of steps that was extra wide.  I also wanted something that would open at both ends and not have a center walk thru (like many of the other gates on the market for wide openings).  It serves it\'s purpose in that my almost one year old daugther is safe from the steps but I must admit it is really hard to open and close on the ends.  We end up climbing up and over the gate most of the time (which is probably not safe considering we are climbing down or up stairs in doing so).  The other issue we had was with the installation.  On the one end we have wood trim, which is perfect for this gate...on the other end is sheet rock, which it did not stay in.  We ended up trying to use an achor for the screw - and it still popped out within an couple hours of the install (too much wear & tear)...right now we have a butterfly anchor in the wall but the latch turns in the wall and looks like it, too, is going to seperate from the wall.  Our next step is to install a piece of trim to the drywall to install the latches to it.  Either that or buy a new gate - which is more likely!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Good for keeping our large dogs on the porch;  mechanism to open gate difficult to use.  Easy to install, nice to look at, would buy again.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This gate was ordered to block off a wide archway leading to our livingroom with new carpeting. Exactly what we needed.Well made,and we received it quicker than we expected.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Got this gate so that my two large breed dogs(an akita and a pit bull) can hang out on the front porch. Perfect height, easy to install, all around a good buy!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This gate works well for our needs. We have two mini dachshunds, 8 and 10 lbs each, and wanted to start keeping them in the kitchen during the day. We do not have an open floor plan but the transition from our kitchen to living room is open and just over 80" wide. It was a tough search for something to cover this gap, and to do it in a way I thought looked good was just way too expensive. If I\'m not going to like the aesthetics any way, might as well go dirt cheap. This gate was easy to install and works perfectly to keep these pups on the right side. The day my husband set it up, he put the dogs on the "wrong" side when I came home and it seemed like the little one could maybe squeeze through if she tried really, really hard, but she had the motivation of Mom just getting home and I don\'t expect them to test it like that regularly (when we use it daily they are on the "right" side when we come home). If she ever does I think it would be easy to create a fabric barrier to add on to the gate - but since they don\'t test it out, I don\'t know how the gate would hold up to more aggressive interaction. (We have had the gate for three weeks at the time of this review, and used it almost every day)We don\'t have a great place to set it aside when not in use, so an aesthetically pleasing walk-through gate definitely has a leg up there; however I\'d rather hide it in the bedroom when company is over (in a small house that\'s just around the corner) and save my money.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Out of the package, this gate was exactly what we wanted. I almost left a great review. But I\'m glad I waited because after only two weeks, it has broken - from wind. (Yes, wind.)We initially got it to contain our small dachshund on the deck. I was thrilled to find something that stretched to the width we needed it, which was almost 7 feet. It was easy to install and we didn\'t have a problem with any of the parts it came with. As other reviews have said, it definitely feels flimsy. I wouldn\'t advise it for toddlers or animals who would be pushing/jumping up against it. But for use as a visible barrier, it does the trick.  The press-down latch to slide the gate open is somewhat stiff and kinda hard to use, but it works with some fussing.I almost purchased another one... but then it broke after normal April weather. Built-in wooden pegs that attach the gate to its stationary post, which is attached to the deck, just broke right off. (See my photos in the shared Customer Images above.) Yes, it rained pretty heavily and the wind has been strong. But if it can\'t withstand wind, that gives you an indication of just how weak it really is. Perhaps it\'s intended for indoor use only, I don\'t know. But, because I paid $44 for it and it otherwise suits my needs, I\'m just gonna try to nail it back together.  But I don\'t have much faith in how long it will actually last.[Update: I was able to nail it together. It has held up fine so far.][Update #2:  Broke again in the same spot. I think the wood is just too soft, especially in damp outdoor weather. May be best for indoor use only. This has all been in two months\' time.]

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Bought this for our door between our living room and kitchen to keep our 1yr old from gettingin there.......it was a great gate for a month Or so but after being used regularly its all wobbly

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This is a good product for the space it covers we have a trailer and it separates the living area from the kitchen the area is 100 inches... it was a good buy for its size... It is kinda wobbly in the middle but it works good enough. Thanks for the product

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Because it will just slither RIGHT through the bars. For kids, it is okay I guess. Until they know what they are doing.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I have to edit my review of this gate because after having it for a few months my husband tripped on it and it busted... I initially was very pleased with the gate, but I am now looking for a different gate instead of buying the same one. I bought this gate to block a 72-73" doorway.Heres my list of Pros n Cons:Pros:*VERY easy to install (included measurements for placements of eye hooks)*Easy to open and close (which can be a bad thing i guess lol, but my 3 year old was able to get her self in and out, it was bought to contain my walking (at the time 9 month old).*Easy to remove since it has latches on both sides (for cleaning or whatever)*PRICE (cant really beat it for a gate that big)Cons:*I had to tighten brackets that the gate sections slide between (they were very loose when i received the gate)*Gate its self is made of pretty thin and flimsy wood*The middle section has no way of locking in place (so little fingers can be pinched)*The wood pieces were different colors*Broke by just a foot catching on it (my husband is 6\'3 so hes tall enough to walk over it)*There was a small crack in one piece of wood under a bracket from when they installed screws (not where the gate broke tho)I was bummed when the gate broke because like i sd I was initially happy with the gate it did its purpose and was very affordable. But since it broke so easily I dont think I will be buying another.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Shipping out this items was great arrived in two days, items is exactly what I was looking for.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I needed a really wide gate for the top of the steps on my front porch.  I have to keep my domestic geese off the porch or they eat my door mat and the porch furniture.  This gate is very sturdy for this purpose and would be good for small to medium-sized dogs, too.  Since mine is exposed to the weather, I painted it.  The only thing that would make this better is if it were available either painted or varnished.  It is easy to open and you can either slide it like a sliding door to make an opening or swing it like a gate.  It took all of two minutes to install, so you sure can\'t complain about that!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This gate is extra wide to secure large areas like a dining room. The mounts for this gate do not hold the weight of this gate or an 8 month old baby. My son has pushed on the gate and the mount was ripped from the wall leaving an unsafe gap for him to crawl through. I\'m my opinion this gate was poorly designed and could really injure a child. I would not recommend this product.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: When I read that this was a "swing gate", I took that to believe it had a door portion that would swing open.  That is not the case.  You have to mount this to both sides of the walls then detach one side to "swing" the entire gate open.  It is not what I was looking for.  On top of that, we got it because we have a very wide space in our kitchen that we needed to close off for our 11 week old Pomeranian puppy, but the slots in this gate are too wide and he can actually get through the gate!  So for us, this gate is totally useless.  Unfortunately, I discovered this on the 4th day I had it and I didn\'t realize that Amazon\'s free return policy expired 2 days after it is delivered, so we are stuck with this.We ended up purchasing another tension mounted gate with a REAL swing door which will be arriving tomorrow.  I hope the slots aren\'t as wide so it keeps our puppy within it\'s confines.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We have 3 cats,and they have claws.It works great to kept them away from our banana leaf dining chairs !!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Great and sturdy gate. Easy to install! And so happy they make this long of a gate for such a great price!!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I\'ve had this gate for almost two years since my daughter started crawling and we needed a wide gate for an entryway.  This gate has been very reliable, durable, and importantly safe for my child.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I have to start with my general assessment, great product for the money, and go on from there.  There are inherent weaknesses in wood gates that I was aware of before I bought the product knowing that I was going to modify the product to remedy and modify the product for my specific use.  The inherent problem that I find in wood gates is the looseness in the sliding design, metal lips which I think have too much clearance with the gate sections (probably to allow for easy opening/closing without binding).  This looseness allows a child to push the gate front to back to an alarming degree in my opinion and raises the possibility of the child being able to break the gate.  The wider the gate and the more towards maximum the gate is opened, the greater the gate can be moved front to back.  This issue can be addressed many ways with varying degrees of success, the simplest of which is to bang down the metal lips so that there is less and less clearance between the wood sections. Less clearance means less front to back movement with a proportionate increase in potential binding when the gate is expanded or closed. This is fine for casual use but we have a wide opening with active toddler twins who act in concert and I fear would easily overpower the gate so I decided to make the gate rigid and fit one specific location to eliminate front to back movement.  I first installed the eye screws and installed the gate in the intended location.  I then evenly spaced the sections and temporarily clamped them in place.  I installed fasteners through the overlapped gate sections close to each end of the overlap.  I utilized the supplied long barrel nuts and screws supplied to secure the ends of the two slider sections by drilling through at the start of my overlapped sections and installing the extended fasteners that I had and also used 1" countersunk decking screws when I ran out of the supplied extended fasteners.  I then removed the clamps and the result was a fixed strong gate that fits only one location at the expense of expand-ability/collapse-ability.  I had previously experienced the problem of excessive front to back movement with the twins pushing on another wood gate and turned their abandoned glee in wildly push/pulling the gate to and from with this fix into one of resigned captivity.Bottom line, great product for the money and even greater raw material to easily make a stronger fixed position gate.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We\'ve had this gate for about 9 months now. I have a "circular" house (can run around in circles on the main floor) and one of the doorways is about 6 feet wide. I couldn\'t find anything that wasn\'t extraordinarily expensive until I found this fate. It\'s easy to install - two hooks on each wall and you\'re ready to go. It keeps my daughter and my dog where I want them to be. It\'s also easy to slide in half and "swing" to one side. If you are somewhat gentle with it, it should last you a long time. It is just plain wood so it\'s not the best thing to look at, but it does the job well.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We have 3 dogs and no way to contain them until I bought this gate. We have a 93" opening from our kitchen/dining and I was having trouble finding a gate that would fit. It\'s very functional and does the job I ask it to, which is, keeping the dogs in the kitchen area. Although, I will say some of the hardware seems cheap and not very sturdy. Some of the hardware that came with it didn\'t even fit the small hooks for the bottom latches that connect to the wall. My husband replaced them with smaller ones from around the house and it works fine.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: When it comes to using this for your children you\'d have to first know what your needs are. I can\'t imagine it stopping any determined child without some reinforcing; it would be more like a psychological barrier. But depending on their temperament and age it may be good to deter them from getting to things they shouldn\'t have.I ordered this to use for my puppy.  In my case I don\'t have the problem of her pushing on it so I can\'t say how long it would last through that.  For this price I was quite happy with the quality and it was amazingly simply to install.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This is a great product. I bought it to block my den when i got my puppy home. Didn\'t find many gates that were long like this. Best part, it is very easy to install. i installed it myself.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I am so glad I didn\'t pay a lot of attention to the negative feedback of this product.  It is everything and more.  I have 2 dogs and 5 cats.  The cats use this as a spring board and the dogs jump on it and yet it holds up perfectly.  I am tempted to get another one for the front of the house.  This product is much better priced than the others.  Extremely happy.  Thank you

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This gate has worked great for my deck.  Needed to keep my puppy on the deck. It\'s a little flimsy, though, and I primed and painted it to make it more weather resistent. It\'s a good non-permanent option.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: The package arrived quickly so that was nice, however when we pulled it out of the box one of the bars was broken.  I now have a duct tape holding it together, and its not very sturdy!  wouldn\'t recommend this particular gate to anyone!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We needed to keep our pet out of our livingroom, but found it impossible because we have an extra wide opening going into our living room. We could not find any affordable product of good quality that would do the trick. That is until we found the North States Supergate. It works great, looks equally as nice and was so much cheaper than buying from the big pet stores.  The product arrived before the stated date in perfect condition.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: Works great.  Wide enough and easy to use.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This gate closes off a 72 inch opening at the top of six deck stairs.  It was super easy to install & is of high quality.  It can be opened from either side & is sturdy...definitely 5 stars!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: We bought this gate to close off an opening on our exterior deck, so the kids wouldn\'t accidentally fall down the deck steps.  This was the only one I could find that had enough width/length to fit our needs.  Installation was easy.  But the gate itself is not very sturdy, it\'s rather flimsy and unstable.  It can be easily broken by a strong push or hit.  If you plan to contain a big strong-willed dog with this gate, it won\'t work.  It\'s cheaper than making a custom deck gate, that\'s about it.  If there is a newer/better product out there with the same length that is stronger, someone please tell me.  Thanks!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I found this gate to be great for the price. At first when it arrived, I thought it was bulky and not what I really wanted, it took some muscle to install, you must install it into hard studs in the wall or I could see it ripping out. Once I got it installed, and I\'m not a very strong girl, and I was able to drill it in! It was wonderful. We have a large opening to the kitchen with a fridge in the way so this ended up a bit diagnol on the entrance but it works fabulous. Even my 7 year old had a time figuring out how to open it,  I had to show her a couple of times. My wild 20 month old is very strong and shakes it all the time but it has not fallen off the screws or wall yet and keeps him out very well, he gives me death looks when I\'m in the kitchen and yells at me to let him in. Overall, it\'s great!

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: This is a very sturdy gate, solid construction, great design, and great price (cheapest ultra-wide gate I could find).  The anchor eye screws must be screwed into a stud--no substitutes.  It is fairly easy to open the gate from the side, but I usually just step over it.  A third of the time I my second foot doesn\'t completely make it and it gets caught, but the fence doesn\'t budge.  I did add some felt feet to the bottom so it wouldn\'t scratch the floors.

name: North States Industries Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate
review: I spent a lot of time searching for a wide gate and was frustrated at the lack of quality options, so I decided to go with this gate as an inexpensive option.  While not the most impressive or sturdy gate, this gate is decent quality for what you pay (I paid $48). It is very easy to install, but is a bit cumbersome to open and close.  Overall, I am satisfied.  I feel like I got what I paid for, no more and no less.

name: Supergate Auto-Close Walk Through Pressure Gate
review: This gate is amazingly easy to install.  I wanted a pressure-mount gate so it could easily moved to different locations in the house, and this one is PERFECT!  The auto-close feature is also wonderful.  My 5 year old doesn\'t have to put much effort into making sure the gate is closed, to keep her baby sister safe!I highly recommend this gate!

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I ordered this product hoping it would be the perfect solution to keep my baby boy from going up the stairs.  The bottom of my stairs is in a kind of crowded area and I wanted the gate to expand and contract to fit into a small area when not in use.  Unfortunately, the gate stays very large and doesn\'t swing like I thought it would.  I returned it before even trying to install.  Disappointed this wasn\'t a good solution.  Back to the drawing board.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: Hooked it onto my back deck outside. It works great to contain 3 toddlers and my dog at times. It opens and closes with ease. Hard for kids to unlatch the squeeze latches on either side. Stands about waiste high. I left it out in the rain and have had no issues with it yet.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: We have a puppy we want to keep in our back yard, so my husband installed this (quickly and easily) and it is perfect. Pup stays in the back yard, but it isn\'t difficult for us or our house guests to open the gate. We love the swinging feature and that the gate extends easily to make it smaller if desired.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: Wonderful idea for a gate, we have an extra wide doorway which when extended fits really well but when not in use we can push it back so it\'s small and not intrusive. Very pleased highly recommended.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I ordered this gate for my entry way, I have a French Bulldog who likes to dart outside when our screen is opened by anybody. The length is great, but the way you latch the gate to the wall is awful. You have to line up the bottom hook while clenching the top latch into place. It takes way too much effort and coordination.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I had previously purchased the North States Supergate Extra Wide Swing Gate and it was so easy to install that I decided this Expandable Swing Gate would also be easy since the mounting hardware and hinges appeared to be identical.  This is true to a point.  Unfortunately, for whatever reason, North States does not ship their Expandable Swing Gate with the same long screw eyes they ship with their Extra Wide Swing Gate.  This poses a huge problem if you are planning on mounting to a stud behind drywall.  Technically, North States does mention in their manual that the gates must be mounted directly to wood, but they say the same thing about their Extra Wide Swing Gate, and yet they do provide screw eyes long enough to drive into a stud behind drywall for those.I called and spoke to North States this morning, and they are going to send me several hardware packs intended for the Extra Wide Swing Gate which I will use for this Expandable Swing Gate...free of charge.  That is nice of them!

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: This gate does exactly what I expected. It was easy to install, easy to use.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I wanted a tall, sturdy gate to go across the top of our front porch steps so my two border-aussie dogs could be on the porch without being hooked up to leashes. The gate was easy and quick to install and I like that it opens from either side and is also easily removed from the hinges when I don\'t need the gate there.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I\'ve used a lot of these gates for both children and pets.  My satisfaction is usually dominated by how easy they are to operate.  This is the worst one I\'ve used.  I am physically strong but cannot compress the latch spring without using two hands.  The latch components are cheap and ill fitting.  I doubt many mothers could operate it with a baby in one arm.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: excellent sise and work weri well i dont have more problen with my dog walk alway for ewery part from my apt

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: Good gate, easy to use and install. Just what I needed to keep my pooches contained on the deck. The shipment arrived in great time and shape. Very pleased.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I will have to return it because it did not work well for what I wanted to do.  There was nothing wrong with it and the service was great

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: This is the second of these gates we own. We\'ve tried other styles but our lab figured out how to open them. This is the only one we found that she can\'t get open. When it expands the bottom of the gate remains close to the floor, unlike others we tried. This makes it difficult for dogs to get their noses underneath it.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I purchased for my dog and it has worked so well! It didn\'t take long at all to put up and it is so easy to use. You can open from either side and is easily stored away.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: We have this baby gate set up between our kitchen and dining room.  It is the best baby gate.  It can swing open either direction so it\'s very convenient.  It can also expand to various dimensions, which is great.  This gate is way better than the plastic ones, and it holds up a whole lot better as well (I have had both before).

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I have a rough and rowdy silky terrier which will just run out my front door and not come back without chasing him so I have two sets of steps on each side of my porch with railings all around. I now can open my front door without Scout getting out. They are easy to assemble and so easy to operate.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: This is the one and only gate i could find that fit my 24 inch wide doorway.  it also works well in another room in my house that has a 48 inch opening.  Keeps my crawling 10 month old girl out of harms way!

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I purchased this gate for a the opening into my kitchen. It is an odd caddy corner shaped opening. The gate was easy to install and works great. We purchased it to keep my 8 month old son from crawling into the kitchen to eat the dog\'s food! He is almost 2 now and we still use it to keep him out of the kitchen. He has never pinched a finger or any other part of his body. My 5 year old is able to open and shut it with ease. It is very durable and his withstood my son shaking it back an forth. I guess you could say it is kid tested and mother approved.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: I can now sleep late without my neighbors dogs giving me a wake-up visit which was always followed by my dog going goofy in response.  Easy to latch and easy to swing away.  Will also keep my great grandson in a safe area.  Great product for the price.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: Ease of expanding and contracting the gate is a little rough, but okay. The clasps that close around eye hooks feel a bit rickety, can be challenging to secure, but once you get the hang of it it\'s workable.Overall decent. Keeps an Airedale on the deck.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: The product description is false, this only expands to 40 inches, not 60. I\'m returning it for only this reason.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: As advertised.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: Good quality and easy to install and use.  The top plastic guide separates sometimes but not a real issue.  I would definitely would buy again.

name: North States Supergate Expandable Swing Gate
review: this product is grate, very durable, I like that it\'s high enough so my dog won\'t jump.  And installing the gate was very easy.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: THE GATE CAME ABOUT A WEEK EARLY WHICH WAS GREAT,, HAVN,T PUT IT UP YET BUT IT IS JUST WHAT I WAS LOOKING FOR AND A GOOD PRICE EVEN WITH THE EXTRA TAXES ETC

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: This has worked pretty well to keep our dogs out of areas that we don\'t want them to be if we are not home.  It\'s sturdyand would work well for children as well.  It can be hard to slide if you don\'t grab it in the right place.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I am so happy they still make this gate, because I moved our old one out by the swimming pool for our dogs last year,and now we have a new puppy, and I needed a new one for the kitchen. I didn\'t need to adjust anything,as the fasteners were all in place from our puppy days 9 years ago.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: certainly wouldn\'t trust this gate at the top of steps!  A waste of ~$40

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: Item as described.  Nice sturdy gate. I purchased it for a gift, but was missing a part when it arrived so I had to send it back.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: This gate is heavy duty and well worth the money.  I wont have to worry about this one getting broken for sure.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: This gate has worked well to keep our new large puppy out of our front room  I am no longer worried about our Christmas tree and presents.  I gave it only 4 stars because at times it is difficult to collapse and will jam, however it is easily remedied and is not a major issue.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I bought another gate which was made of woodand our dog chewed the _____ out of itthis one she can\'t chew as well and it keeps herin pretty goodsticks a  bit to lengthen

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I had a huge entry way door to block my dog from going into, so I purchased this product.  It was absolutely worth it.  The install took a few tries, since I have molding around the floor boards, but ultimately it does exactly what it is supposed to do.  I really like that the gate swings like a door when unlatched.  THis is helpful for my mother who cannot step over such a tall gate.  Worth the buy even for a smaller doorway.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: We have had this gate installed on our covered porch for 6 months now and it has held up great!!!  I was hesitant to put a gate on the porch because I didn\'t want to ruin the vinyl posts.  (We only need a gate while our kids are young)  Instead of drilling into the vinyl posts, we attached wood with zip ties and drilled into the wood instead.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: This is a very well made gate. Unfortunately it wasn\'t wide enough for the xtra-xtra wide space I needed it for, and I had to return it.  I had absolutely no problem in returning it, but was sorry to see it have to go. But, if you\'re looking for a sturdy expanding gate for a great price, this would be the one for you!

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: Was easy to install and covers a wider than normal (55") opening at the top of a long staircase. When installing be sure to offset the the wall mounts on each side to allow for the thickness of the gate. It\'s very convenient to swing open and closed, and even to detach the gate and store elsewhere if desired. We use it for a small dog and a 1 year old toddler. Works great, and great value!

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: This is my second North States gate.  First one has worked great until I lost a part during a move.  The company sent me a replacement part FOR Free! You can\'t beat that for customer service.  When we needed another gate, it was an easy choice.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I\'m not sure why so many people like this gate. We used ours for about a year before taking it down (our 1 year old was climbing on it)We installed ours going into our kitchen and it got used ALOT. I took 1 panel out as per the recommendations of another reviewer. Installing the gate was simple just bolt the uprights to the wall and your ready to go.Other reviewers complain that they needed to add wood to support the gate, well that\'s going to depend on your installation as this really must be screwed into a wood stud so you will need a studfinder.Once you mount the support to the wall the gate snaps on to it and your ready to go.My main complaint is that the gate isn\'t self supporting which to me seems like a basic thing that should have been addressed based on how wide this gate is. What I mean by self supporting is when you have the gate completely extended the part you are holding and swinging sags severely. The sagging makes it difficult to collapse the gate inwards for storage when not in use.In our situation in order to open the gate we had to unlatch it then close it about 8\' to clear an obstacle (bottom step of a staircase) and then swing it. The fact that it was hard to close made it an incredible pain in the butt to use.originally I was looking for a wood gate. Back when our fist child was an infant we had one upstairs that had a metal handle on it that you squeezed and listed and that gate rocked unfortunately i could not find one like that which opened to 48"So all in all the gate worked its 100% plastic its ridiculously bulky, Its not attractive but like i said it did work.Lesson learned for me was I could have made a nice gate out of oak in about two hours that would have looked a ton nicer and worked better but it was winter and the garage was too darn cold.Look around make this your last resort if you can\'t find a better designed gate that meets your needs.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I have two small dogs and a 6 ft opening from the kitchen to the living/dining room/front hall.  I did not want to spend $100 plus on a gate.  It must be improved recently because I did not find any of the problems mentioned in other reviews.  My husband had no problems installing it, granted he is an engineer.  It moves smoothly and I have no problem unlatching it with one hand while holding a wiggling puppy in the other.  It does the job and did not cost me much.  If it is not as attractive as a wooden gate, so be it.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: Super sturdy gate but super hard to get the hang of locking/unlocking it.  After I did, I love it.  It keeps my furry little man safe in my back yard.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I love my Baby Gate that I got, I wasn\'t able to find this in a store and so of course the first thing I did was search on Amazon and of course I find it here and it was cheaper than the gate that they sold in stores that was smaller and useless to me.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: This is the second baby gate we bought. The first one (a different model) was flimsy wooden one  and it broke so we bought this one as a replacement. This gate is sturdy , works well, and is a decent length.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: this is the second one we\'ve owned. our other one held up for at least 8 years, as it is at the top of the stairs at my mother\'s ranch house, with constant grandkids in and out. the only problem we\'ve had after having it awhile, was sometimes the gate would get stuck and you\'d have to keep yanking to get it to seperate to close it. the reason for having to purchase a new one, is someone was latching it shut, slipped, and fell down the steps trying to catch the fall by grabbing the gate and taking it with them! other than that incident, it is a very sturdy gate that kids are not able to figure out how to open.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: Product exceeded my expectations and I would recommend this item to all my family and friends! Great quality. Still working after almost 2 years!

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I recently purchased this gate hoping that it would work better than the wooden ones they have out there and I was so pleased! It was easy to screw into the wall and it doesn\'t get stuck like some of the other reviews mentioned. GREAT PURCHASE!

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: Product does the job but careful of it dragging and scratching your hardwood floors !!! Also when pulling out gate to desired width gate seems to hang up time to time. But it is a sturdy product and does serve its purpose.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I would recommend this fence to anyone with a big opening and or have animals. This has stood up to so much abuse. It still works just as good as the first day I bought it. I bought a second one for another door way cause I love this fence so much. Awesome is all I can say

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: EASY TO ASSEMBLE ONCE THE TWO SIDE RAILS WERE SENT DUE TO THEM MISSING .FOLLOW DIRECTIONS AND WILL GO .

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: I have two dogs that need to be kept separate because one is aggressive and attacks the other. This gate helps me to do that without having to crate one at a time and switch them out every 1/2 hour or so. Kind of cumbersome to open and close but that\'s to be expected due to the size of the gate. I have this in a 5\' doorway between two rooms and it works as it should.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: What a great plastic sturdy gate!  We needed it for our porch so our little doggie can\'t get out but can see the world. The gate slides in to put it out of the way or pull it all the way out for extra wide openings! I truly recommend this gate to anyone who wants a sturdy plastic gate!

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: Very easy to install and very sturdy.  It latches securely and works well for keeping my pets out of trouble.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: We bought the gate to keep our kids out of the kitchen while we cooked dinner.  You get what you pay for!  Not the most sturdy gate and our walls are angled so makes it difficult to latch closed.  Not bad, but not sure I would buy it again.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: With the great reviews on this product, I thought it would be an inexpensive way to keep my 9month old out of the kitchen. And being that the doorway to the kitchen is just over 42" I couldn\'t go with a traditional gate.I am not impressed at all with this gate. It is difficult to slide, and lock into place. Not to mention it looks horrible. (But that I expected.)It functions, barely, but I would not recommend this product to anyone!

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: This is the best gate I have ever used.  When I put it up it was kind of hard but now that it is up I love it.

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: We purchased this gate for the top of our stairs for our granddaughter. The opening is extra-wide and this gate is perfect for the space. It is made of a strong, heavy plastic and is easy to open and close. I highly recommend this!

name: Supergate Extra-Wide Gate, Ivory
review: Bought two gates to contain my child.  Plastic is durable.  There are a lot of screws, which helps strengthen the gate, but I\'m not looking forward to when I remove the gates.  I\'ll have a million holes in my door jam.  One doorway was a little smaller, so I took off one of the four gates.  It was a little work.  If you\'re not mechanically inclined, I wouldn\'t recommend that you try this.

name: Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base Black
review: Its great to have two of these. We have one for my car and one for my husband\'s. We never have to take it out and mess with it. Perfect

name: Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base Black
review: We needed a second car seat base for the childcare provider.  It works GREAT!!

name: Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base Black
review: This item was shipped to my home is less than 24 hours!  I was extremely impressed with the shipping speed and the price was great also!  Having a second base is going to be very helpful for my 2-car family!  I recommend this product to anyone with an infant!

name: Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base Black
review: This is a wonderful item for a GMA or babysitter.  I bought it for my mother that babysits for her Great Grandson.  She is no longer homebound when she babysits.

name: Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base Black
review: this product is good so that you do not have to move the base from one car to the other.

name: Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base Black
review: The installation of the Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base in our daughter\'s car heavily taxed my strength and patience. Then, after my brother tried and gave up, my sister-in-law, a nurse, kept saying how important it was to the baby\'s safety. She and I working together finally got it fastened in and cinched up tight. As a new grandparent I felt compelled to order a second carrier seat base for our van. This installation took much less time and effort. And I did this one alone. Now, the baby rides safely, and the carrier hops from car to van effortlessly. It was worth the effort.

name: Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base Black
review: Fits perfect just a taupe color but it was cheaper to get this color than to get black. We needed for an extra vehicle so it worked perfectly.

name: Evenflo Embrace Infant Car Seat Base Black
review: I liked this brand of car seat and base.  The base was easy to install and easily adjusted.  It was durable.  I had no problem with this base during my daughter\'s first year of life.

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: This is not a chair your baby can stay in for three years.  The seat doesn\'t sit up, so my 15 month old slouches while he\'s eating.  We\'ve had nothing but trouble with the tray for the last few months.  I have to beat it every day to get it off and on.  We called Evenflo and they told us the tray was defective, but wanted to charge us for a new tray.  They also couldn\'t guarantee that a new tray wouldn\'t have the same problems.  Life is too short to fight with a high chair everyday.  We\'re buying a different brand.

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: Who on EARTH designed this for an infant, toddler, or a preschooler?Our baby is now 9.5 months old - and she STILL doesn\'t fit in this chair.This chair is for a CHILD who must be something around 10 years old.  For a GIANT.  You need about 6 inches - NO KIDDING of more height for the child seat relative to the tray where they eat!Who would design this.  This is terrible.  It does adjust.  That\'s great.  It adjusts - so when your kid is old enough and tall enough to sit in this chair - you can remove the tray and adjust the height of the overall high chair to fit up to your own table - what ever table height that is.  Unfortunately - I really really hope that if you kid is old enough to fit in this chair - he/she can SIT in a real chair right at the table.It does also recline... great for a 1 month or younger ... but 1 month or younger babies - are not eating solid foods.  Hello!  So it DOESN\'T actually sit perfectly straight up either!  So your child is always sort of leaning back... this is TERRIBLE for a baby who is learning to eat finger foods.  Ideally you would want your infant who is learning to eat finger food to lean his head forward not backward and spit out the food.  Don\'t get me wrong - I don\'t mean that the kid should be able to lean forward and fall - but a permanent lean backwards is undesireable in a high chair.Don\'t be like us, don\'t waste your money on this horrible design.

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: After reading all the negative reviews on this highchair I was a little hesitant to purchase it but I\'m very pleased with the chair.  I can understand how someone could dislike how the seat doesn\'t sit completely straight up however it doesn\'t seem to recline as much as others have made it sound.  Our 7 month old son sits very comfortably in the seat and he is an average size baby.  The tray does seem a little on the high side but I have read reviews on other highchairs with the same issue. We really wanted a highchair with a fabric seat cover and we were having a difficult time finding one with a pattern or color scheme that we liked, but this one had it!

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: This chair is horribly awkward.  The chair is too low in relation to the tray, and the seat reclines too far back.Do yourself a favor and shop around.  This chair isn\'t worth it.I have other Evenflo products, and I was very disappointed with this product.

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: We have had this now for 6 months.  And, I agree with most of the other reviews...I am disappointed that it doesn\'t sit straight up and it is too low.This is our first child.  At first, the baby is small and you have to recline them, and you don\'t realize.  But now that he sits up to eat, I hate that it doesn\'t sit upright all the way.  I can\'t use the tray because he still is really not tall enough (even though he is 95% percentile at 10 months).  So, I just use the bottom thing that just holds him in and separates his legs and has a small place for finger food.  But, he pulls his legs up all the time and reclines in the chair and rests his legs above the chair and kicks.  It is annoying.As far as the tray and toy...he isn\'t even big enough for the tray let alone the toy.  I just put the toy on the floor for him to use.  I don\'t even know if he really would be able to play with it properly when he gets bigger since he will never be able to sit upright.Wish I could get my money back.

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: I rarely write reviews.  I did for my fisher price booster which I love and now I must for this highchair that I hated.  My biggest pet peeve about this chair is that it does not allow your child to sit upright.  At the highest point your child is still reclined somewhat.  And once you put the tray on, your child can barely see over the big tray and has to struggle to reach for food and feed themselves.  And my son is not small, he is a healthy 25 pounds and 30 inches at 10 months old and should not have trouble reaching on his tray, it is because the tray is way too high!  I have sent this highchair over to grandma\'s for when baby visits, it is ok for a spare.  I did in fact just buy the Chicco Polly which is awesome, my son sits upright when needed and reclines nicely when needed.  The tray is in perfect position for him to feed self.  My girlfriend has this highchair and she couldn\'t stop bragging.  It is unfortunate that Babies R Us doesn\'t carry this line of highchairs as they use to just 8 months ago.  Baby Depot and most specialty stores carry Chicco.  Don\'t waste your money on this highchair.

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: I am 7 months pregnant and went this weekend with one of my friends and her little girl to finish my registry and when we started looking at the high chairs, this was the last one I looked at and thought that it was by far the best.  The other ones were all awkward and difficult to fold.  One of the Graco chairs that was about the same price and comparable in options, took my friend and I both to get it to fold and not to mention figuring out how to recline it.  I had to use both hands and it still took a lot of effort.  I found this one to have a sturdy frame and very easy to use.  I "tested" it out with my friends little girl and while holding her was able to work everything on it with one hand.  Once I put her in the chair we didn\'t see any problems with the recline feature, she sat up just fine and seemed perfectly happy in it.  I am surprised that so many people seemed to be dissatisfied with it once I read the reviews, but was happy to see some of the more recent reviews from people who like the chair. I have not used it yet and this will be my first child, but considering that my husband will not be home to help me every time I will need to use it, I found this one the most efficient and easiest to use.  And I like that it is a darker color, because I can only imagine how dirty those things get and the lighter ones seem like the mess would show up a lot easier.  I only gave it 4 stars because I have not actually used it at my house with a baby yet, but as far as comparison shopping goes, this chair has my vote!

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: I absolutely hate this product.  Why oh why did we spend the money on it?I liked the idea of the removable plastic piece that seperates their legs - as they grow - you can remove that section - and just have the upper tray.  Pretty nice!  One handed tray removal...Then the whole caster thing.  Ahhhh - also something I desired.  The cool toy on top - man - I was sold.Can I just say - I don\'t believe the few reviews that put 4 or more stars on this product.  No way.  I don\'t believe they are real.This is my first written review for a reason.  I hate this high chair.  I can\'t believe how awful it is.It\'s always leaning backwards!  Wrong wrong wrong!  We\'re getting close to a year old now... I thought just the other day - surely now it\'ll work - now we\'ll give it another try - still don\'t fit, still can\'t use the tray, and this stupid lean makes it so you can\'t even use it without the tray.  Arghh!  I am so upset - I decided now is the time to write a review.Then - the darn tray - it\'s AMAZING how someone got this height so so so so so wrong.  It\'s way too high.  It\'s right in your baby\'s face.I tell you - if there is ANYTHING that you take away from this review - take whatever size/age baby you have - put them in the display high chair before you purchase it.  Looking at this product simply does not do it justice.Then put them in anything else - even those cheapy chairs...just to review the proportions for yourself in person.  Shocking.  This one is the worst.The fancy casters, material, toy, removable this or that - doesn\'t mean squat if it doesn\'t function at all.  We wanted the best for our baby.  Buy anything else than this horrible high chair.

name: Discovery High Chair - Tattersall
review: Although this chair looks great and has some fun features it was not very functional. My son was not able to sit up straight in it.  He could not get his arms up on the tray even though he\'s 29 inches tall.  It prevents him from being able to grab "snacks" off the tray. After spending 1/2-1 hour to assemble it I found out that many other chairs already come assembled. Because of it\'s poor function I was forced to disassemble it and return it.

name: Sealy All Natural Crib Mattress Pad
review: I bought this same mattress pad in 2005 and sure it was a little snug but it fits the crib mattress.  Since I already had one of these I was wondering what the previous reviewers were talking about.I know now!  They are absolutely right.  These pads are way too small.  They changed them.  The one I have from 2005 fits - this new one I just bought is so tight that it bends the mattress and it stays bent.  It never flattens back out.I really liked the fact that it\'s 100% cotton and the one I already have fits ok but this new one doesn\'t.  They changed the material around the padded part that fits over the mattress and it wasn\'t a good change.  You can easily poke your fingers through it because it\'s so flimsy and because it\'s so tight.I need another 100% cotton pad so I will be looking at a different brand.  I hope I can find one!

name: Best Rest Dual Pregnancy Wedge by Leachco Pattern: Denim
review: It\'s great made easier for me to sleep on one side while pregnant, specially during the last trimester.

name: Lilac Luxe Blanket
review: Best blankie ever!!!Baby\'s r us dosn\'t carry these anymore have a different version just as comfy!But my daughter can notice the difference this is a must have!Washes well and very durable and soft!

name: Lilac Luxe Blanket
review: I bought this blanket in lilac, pink, blue and sage to match my daughter\'s nursery. It is so soft and washes so wonderfully. Its a wonderful blanket that I have gotten alot of use out of in the col winter months. At first I bought those fleece blankets, but they came out a mess (looked very aged and was very stringy) so I tossed out those awful blankets and brought in these and I have been very happy with them.

name: Lilac Luxe Blanket
review: I got this blanket as a baby gift and it is my favorite one out of the many that I have.  It is so soft that I wish it came in "adult size" for me!  The color is also so beautiful.  It is the perfect shade of purple. I would recommend spending the money or registering for these blankets because they are so worth it.

name: Lilac Luxe Blanket
review: I love this blanket!! At first I got the blue, white, and sage. Then I had to go back and get the pink and lilac ones. The colors look so pretty online and even prettier in person. The edges kind of gets loose but its not too bad. It\'s so soft and the colors are beautiful! They really are better than the fleece ones.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: I\'ve bought many of these corners.  I do find that they "soften corners.". However, the double sided tape provided is fairly useless.  Even the corners that my toddler has learned not to mess with (which wasn\'t easy to teach) have still fallen off after a few months.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: What a waste of my money. Of all the money I have wasted in my life this has to be the worst. It is impossible to get the backing of the tape and than it doesn\'t even stick. It is a horrible product.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: I highly recommend these.  Cheap.  Works.  Come in a pack of eight.  I might get some more just to have around the house or give to friends and families whose homes we go to often.Buy them!

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: I purchased these for a 3 platform, 12 corner table in our living room. The table is wood with metal edging so the corners are very sharp and dangerous.. definetly a hazard to my 7 month old baby.The actual foam like protector peices are good, they really cushion the many blows my baby has already taken to the head. Unfortunately, the tape is worthless. They give you hardly any, and it is easily pulled off (or falls off) by little baby fingers. Not one of the 12 on our table has lasted more than a week. We are going to take a trip to the hardware store to see if we can find something a little stronger before our kid bashes his face into the bare corners.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: Yep, these are a staple in our house.  I prefer the coverage of these larger deeper corners to the smaller type.  I have just had to cover the corners of my kitchen island and counters as my youngest has just reached head banging height.  The tape that comes with them is 3M and works a treat.  Other brands use inferior tape that just doesn\'t stick.  Great product!

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: We bought these because we have a black coffee table and they were the only ones we could find in black.  It was a waste of money.  Like everyone else said - the tape is horrible!  They do not stick at all!  I tried putting on some other tape and it didn\'t work either.  My dogs knocked them off in one day and chewed them, so I can\'t even return them.  They are actually kind of small too - if you have a larger coffee table or corners, these might not work for you.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: My husband and I purchased a Hopen bed from Ikea six months ago and he constantly bumped his shins against the bed corners. Multiple bandaids later I bought the kidkusion corner kushions to try on the corners. We have no kids or pets and our furniture is dark wood, so I wanted something functional and non-conspicious. I bought the black version. The cusion on my side of the bed has stayed put for five months. The cushion on my husband\'s side routinely comes off. Again, there is no toddler running around peeling it off. Overall, I think it was a great purchase as it does the job well and is inconspicious.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: Our 13 month old pulled these off the corner of the crib and table within seconds.  They became dangerous chew toys in a matter of seconds.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: Provides good cushioning and is easy to install.  Still too early to comment on wear and how long it lasts.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: Great customer service on refund  product was too small for the tables but refunded with no issues at allProduct was represented online incorrectly under large always read fine print and measurements

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: Im just going to be honest, These do not stick very well. Try anther brand it may work better for you.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: These cushions are ok.  They are a lot smaller than I expected.  I had previously bought the Lionheart cushions and they are double the size of the Kidkusion ones.  But these were cheaper and now I know why. They do the job and add safety to the room but as most have said, the sticker adhesives are not good.  The cushions constantly get knocked off with a touch of them and when he learns, I am sure he will pull them right off.  We are going to get some better stickers to secure them.

name: Kidkusion Toddler Corner Kushions Brown - 8 Pack
review: It\'s near impossible to get the backing off the tape. Get your own doublestick tape - like 3M one. Sometimes you could find it local $1 store. The supplied tape will make you to angry birds - simply waste of my time and money. Cushions looks fine and decent quality. I will try cushions and update review - just installed while my baby girl is sleeping.

name: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 Pack
review: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 PackHi,I am disappointed that I cannot directly contact the company to ask why I cannot order the item and have it sent to the UK.I would pay the extra for postage and that I would be happy to waive all warranty terms and conditions that would apply for US customers. I cannot see what they would be considering it is corrugated plastic with screen print.Anyway if this changes it the future I would gladly purchase this product.CheersChris

name: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 Pack
review: Great just what we needed to slow cars down! They are very light so I would recommend placing something heavy in the middle so they don\'t fall over

name: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 Pack
review: I wondered why the price was so low, they are not durable.  I don\'t expect them to last more than a year.  Whatever it takes to keep my kids safe.

name: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 Pack
review: Its ok, i did get two of them in the package, not sure why some people only got one. But they are very lightweight, kind of like cardboard but made of plastic. I am going to fill a bag with sand and put it in the middle so i doesnt fly away, because seriously an ant could knock these things over. I would not buy again.

name: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 Pack
review: suitable for our use, easy to blow over, had to add weightsmight be better on a pole or elevated platform

name: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 Pack
review: I don\'t like to malign a product, but the whole point of reviews is to enhance the experience of other consumers. This product was unsatisfactory and we returned it. We purchased the iconic "yellow child" Kid Alert by Step 2 and like it a lot more.Issue #1) This sign is advertised as a "2 Pack". That was the only reason we purchased it. It is NOT a 2 Pack, but a 2-sided sign.Issue #2) The sign is rather small and not nearly as noticeable as the Kid Alert product. The whole point of putting a child safety sign out is that it gets noticed. We found the small size of this sign to be ineffective in this respect.

name: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 Pack
review: I love everthing about these signs except for the fact that they are a bit lightweight.  This makes it easy for them to blow over on a breezy day.  The good part about them being lightweight is that my five year old son can carry them from the garage to the street with no problem.  I have had many motorists comment that they like the signs out when the neighborhood kids are playing since it gives them an extra warning to watch out for them.  They are bright enough to be seen from far down the road.  We put one at each end of the playing area which also serves a boundary for when our kids are riding bikes.

name: Kidkusion Driveway Safety Sign -2 Pack
review: Overall the item met my expectations, however the order only included 1 safety sign.  The description described the item as a 2-pack.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: We bought this for our porch and it works perfectly. It\'s barely noticeable from the street (unless you\'re looking for it) and was super easy to attach. Glad we won\'t have to worry about toys falling over the edge.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: This was hard to put up, it does not provide any protection my soon was still able to put his arms through, and very sharp. It was not protective. It actually cut my son.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: I use this for my rabbits on the porch. It is good during the summer but when it gets colder it gets brittle and breaks.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: I was quite skeptical about the looks but this product looks better at home than I thought just by seeing the picture. The price is great, and the size too. It is easy to cut and trim around the edges to fit where you need. The plastic is sturdy and it does the job keeping the children safe.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: At first I really liked this deck guard -- it is very easy to install and its see through so it really is not as ugly as others. However, I was very disappointed recently. I\'ve had the deck guard installed now for about 7 months, and my deck gets direct sun light in the afternoon for about 2 to 3 hours every day. And now the plastic is chipping off, with very little effort I can pull on the guard and it crumbles at my fingertips. Where is the safety there? My daughter is walking all ever the place and I defiantly don\'t want her to fall off the deck, but also now I\'m worried about the tiny scraps of plastic from the guard all over the place. Buy something different, don\'t waste your time or money...

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: this is NOT even close to being invisible.  it looks like cheap plastic chicken wire and is not even half as nice as the other products i purchased for deck/balcony safety.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: I ordered two of these for our two story terrace in order to keep my 1 and 3 year olds out of harms way.  I\'ve read some negative things about the edges, but I seriously do not see a problem.  The netting is made out of a very strong transparent material.  You can not see the netting from a distance, and the product is quality in my opinion.  We are very pleaseed with this product.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: I like that it\'s made of durable, but transparent plastic. Works very well for our daughter preventing her from sticking out her head and other body parts and us not obstructing the view.It was very easy to install using the provided zip ties.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: This product is as described. It is a clear mesh that is very strong.  It is very easy to install and easy to cut down to size. We installed it on a condo balcony and it fit just right. It only took a few minutes to unroll and tie on to the railings. Worth the price and the peace of mind for our 3 yr old grand daughter.

name: KidKusion KidSafe Deck Guard
review: Very pleased with this product. I have a 3 lb. Yorkie puppy and I bought this deck guard to secure the second story balcony railing at my townhouse. It fits perfectly and was easy to install with the included hardware. The look of the clear mesh is very low-key and unobtrusive. Which is helpful because the HOA at my complex can sometimes be a little finicky. Most importantly I no longer have to worry about my puppy slipping through the railing and falling to the concrete driveway below. While I don\'t ever leave her on the balcony unsupervised it\'s now safe for her to be outside with me while I\'m grilling etc. Installation goes much easier with two people. I had a friend help me stretch and tighten the mesh as I attached the eye-screws and the zip ties. Since my puppy is so small it was very important to make sure the netting was really secure and tight. The way my balcony is constructed we were able to slide the netting in between the wooden slats and the edge of the decking at the bottom so there\'s no chance of her slipping underneath.

name: Blossoms - Musical Mobile
review: Great Item.  It arrived quickly and in great shape.  My grand daughter loves it!

name: Blossoms - Wall Border
review: This wall border provided the finishing touch for our baby\'s nursery which has all of the other Blossoms bedding and accessories. We applied the border to a painted wall, and not realizing that the border comes pre-pasted, we had already bought some wall paper paste. Lucky for us that we did, as we found that when the border was up, there were areas where the border was coming away from the wall because of lack of paste. I am sure this is not a fault if the product, but probably down to our lack of experience hanging pre-pasted wall paper. So if you are not an expert at hanging wall paper, I would make sure that you have a pot of wall paper paste and a small brush handy.Other than this, we really like the product which we feel has excellent quality.

name: Blossoms - Wall Border
review: If you have the Blossoms bedding set the boarder is an absolutely adorable finishing touch. It has a flower, mushroom, and butterfly that coordinates with the rest of the set. It would look beautiful on a range of wall colors. In my little girls nursery I placed it on a pale pink color (Olympic brand paint called "ballerina"...goes perfect) at the top of the wall. It would also work at chair rail level on a pink, white, or offwhite wall with cranberry or sage accents. It is a little pricey and not a necessary item but definitely gives a nice touch to the nursery. Also, it is easy to apply, even if you are a wallpaper novice.

name: Blossoms - Wall Border
review: I LOVE this item! It was the perfect touch to our nursery, we painted the bottom a dark pink and the top a shade lighter, with the boarder in the middle, it was perfect. The wallpaper was so easy to hang, it went up without any problems, I would definatlly recomend you buy this for a finishing touch!!

name: Blossoms - 4 Piece Set
review: This is just the best.  The bumper is nice & thick, so my angel doesn\'t hurt herself (she sleeps all over the place, then ends up against the bumper).  The colors are great & she loves the characters on the bumper.  The great thing for me, is that the colors don\'t run together in the wash.  It\'s a great set & my daughter LOVES her blanky.  There aren\'t enough great things I can say.  This was a great buy.

name: Miniwear 5 Pack Short Sleeve Bodysuit in Pink: 0-3 Months
review: Our daughter weighed 7 lbs 5 oz when she was born and to our surprise everything swallowed her.  We literally had a closet full of clothes that she couldn\'t wear and they were all 0-3 months.  Even the few newborn outfits we had were too big for her.We got a packages of these onesies at our shower and I figured they were just like the rest...too big...so they were in a drawer for later.  Well after a terrible day of spitting up (later we discovered she had reflux) we were out of onesies, sleepers and gowns.  So I opened this pack.  To my delight I discovered they fit her better than anything we had for her.Granted tgey were still a bit big but after they were washed they fit her perfectly.  I went back and bought the blue and yellow packs too!  They aren\'t made as good as say Gerber but they hold up just the same and they fit her just as long.  Well actaulyl they fit her longer because she could wear them sooner.Theses have become part of our standard shower gift now and so far all our friends and new mom all say the same thing...they are the only thing that really fit well that first month or so!

name: Magic Moments Learning Seat
review: We purchased this bouncer for our 2.5 month old son and he absolutely loves it.  The mirror is great because he can see himself and it also lights up which really locks his attention.He is able to activate the sound and lights by himself already and I noticed that with some of the other seats this was nearly impossible.  The music is at a pleasant volume and the vibration isn\'t too rough.  It was extremely easy to put together which is always a plus and the base and seat are very sturdy.  I would definitely recommend this seat to any one who is looking for some thing entertaining and educational for their little ones.

name: Magic Moments Learning Seat
review: I am hoping to find someone that is willing to sell a Magic Moments Learning Seat. Our daycare provider has one and our son absolutely loves it!!!! and we want one for at home but we have been unable to find one :( Please let me
